description_zh_TW: Annexin A1 衍生的三胜肽 Ac2-26 在轉錄水平上調 SIRT3，同時減少氧化損傷並促進粒線體生成和粒線體自噬。在缺血性腎損傷模型中，Ac2-26 增加 SIRT3 並增強粒線體功能以限制損傷，將促消退發炎生物學與粒線體品質控制聯繫起來。

label: Central nervous system
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Among the sirtuin family of proteins, SIRT3 is the most abundantly expressed in the central nervous system. This neuronal predominance positions SIRT3 as the primary mitochondrial deacetylase governing brain energy metabolism. However, its mRNA expression exhibits progressive decline from clinical Alzheimer's specimens to experimental rodent models, making SIRT3 loss a candidate early biomarker of neurodegenerative mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 在 Sirtuin 蛋白家族中，SIRT3 在中樞神經系統中表現最豐富。這種神經元優勢使 SIRT3 成為控制大腦能量代謝的主要粒線體去乙醯化酶。然而，从临床阿尔茨海默病标本到实验啮齿动物模型，其 mRNA 表达逐渐下降，这使得 SIRT3 的丧失成为神经退行性线粒体功能障碍的候选早期生物标志物。

label: Lys143 (suppressing ROS-mediated mutagenesis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: By deacetylating IDH2 at K143, SIRT3 suppresses ROS-mediated mutagenesis and tumorigenesis. Distinct from the caloric-restriction-linked K413 activation that drives NADPH antioxidant regeneration, the K143 modification couples mitochondrial redox control directly to genomic protection. Directionally, SIRT3-IDH2 crosstalk sits upstream of reduced oxidative DNA damage in transformed cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過在 K143 處去乙醯 IDH2 來抑制 ROS 介導的突變和腫瘤發生。與驅動 NADPH 抗氧化劑再生的熱量限制相關的 K413 活化不同，K143 修飾將粒線體氧化還原控制直接與基因組保護結合。從方向上看，SIRT3-IDH2 串擾位於轉化細胞中減少氧化 DNA 損傷的上游。

label: Intracellular acetyl-CoA and NAD+ levels
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Emerging evidence indicates that SIRT3 acts as a key metabolic regulator that senses intracellular acetyl-coenzyme A (CoA) and NAD+ levels by transducing these cues through deacetylation of mitochondrial proteins. Directionally, acetyl-CoA and NAD+ abundance sits upstream of SIRT3 activity. This nutrient-sensing role lets SIRT3 tune mitochondrial enzymatic efficiency under fasting and caloric restriction, positioning it as the mitochondrial arm of cellular energy sensing.
description_zh_TW: 新出現的證據表明，SIRT3 是一種關鍵的代謝調節因子，可透過粒線體蛋白的去乙醯化轉導這些訊號來感知細胞內乙醯輔酶 A (CoA) 和 NAD+ 水平。從方向來看，乙醯輔酶A和NAD+豐度位於SIRT3活性的上游。這種營養感應作用讓 SIRT3 在禁食和熱量限制下調節粒線體酶效率，將其定位為細胞能量感應的粒線體臂。

label: ox-LDL-induced foam cell formation (via AMPK and UCP1 modulation)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In atherosclerosis, SIRT3 promotes AMPK activation and modulates the activity of uncoupling protein-1 (UCP1), thereby suppressing oxidized-LDL-induced foam cell formation. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced macrophage lipid loading. Gut microbiota-derived metabolites further influence the SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a axis that antagonizes lipogenic programming governed by the SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 cascade, indicating functional linkage between SIRT3 activity and host-microbiome interactions in vascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 在動脈粥狀硬化中，SIRT3 促進 AMPK 活化並調節解偶聯蛋白 1 (UCP1) 的活性，從而抑制氧化 LDL 誘導的泡沫細胞形成。從方向上看，SIRT3 位於巨噬細胞脂質負荷減少的上游。腸道微生物群衍生的代謝物進一步影響 SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a 軸，該軸拮抗由 SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 級聯控制的脂肪生成程序，顯示血管疾病中 SIRT3 活性與宿主微生物組相互作用之間的功能連結。

label: SHMT2 at Lys95 (serine metabolism)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In colorectal malignancies, SIRT3 optimizes serine metabolism via serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2) deacetylation at Lys95, enhancing tumor aggressiveness. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated SHMT2 activation sits upstream of intensified one-carbon metabolism supporting colorectal cancer cell proliferation and survival.
description_zh_TW: 在結直腸惡性腫瘤中，SIRT3 透過絲胺酸羥甲基轉移酶 2 (SHMT2) 在 Lys95 處去乙醯化來優化絲胺酸代謝，從而增強腫瘤侵襲性。從方向上看，SIRT3 介導的 SHMT2 活化位於強化一碳代謝的上游，支持大腸直腸癌細胞增殖和存活。

label: GLDC at Lys514 (nucleotide biosynthesis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In glioblastoma models, SIRT3 promotes nucleotide biosynthesis by deacetylating glycine decarboxylase (GLDC) at Lys514. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated GLDC activation sits upstream of expanded nucleotide pools fueling glioblastoma proliferation. Together with PYCR1 and SHMT2 regulation, this underscores how SIRT3's control of amino-acid metabolism can be co-opted to support aggressive tumor growth in specific contexts.
description_zh_TW: 在膠質母細胞瘤模型中，SIRT3 透過在 Lys514 處去乙醯甘氨酸脫羧酶 (GLDC) 來促進核苷酸生物合成。從方向上講，SIRT3 介導的 GLDC 活化位於擴大的核苷酸庫的上游，促進膠質母細胞瘤增殖。與 PYCR1 和 SHMT2 調節一起，這強調了 SIRT3 對氨基酸代謝的控制如何能夠在特定情況下支持侵襲性腫瘤生長。

label: Src kinase oxidation (mammary carcinoma metastasis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In mammary carcinoma, SIRT3 inhibits Src kinase oxidation to suppress metastatic dissemination. Directionally, SIRT3-controlled redox state sits upstream of restrained Src-driven migratory signaling. This illustrates a tumor-suppressive facet of SIRT3's ROS management, whereby maintenance of mitochondrial redox homeostasis prevents oxidative activation of pro-metastatic kinases.
description_zh_TW: 在乳癌中，SIRT3 抑制 Src 激酶氧化以抑制轉移擴散。從方向上看，SIRT3 控制的氧化還原狀態位於受抑制的 Src 驅動的遷移訊號的上游。這說明了 SIRT3 ROS 管理的腫瘤抑制方面，即維持粒線體氧化還原穩態可防止促轉移激酶的氧化活化。

label: Histone methyltransferase complexes
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In the context of viral infection, SIRT3 dynamically modulates the transcriptional output and replicative capacity of viral genomes by guiding histone methyltransferase complexes to viral episomes. Exogenous SIRT3 overexpression significantly attenuates viral gene expression, whereas deletion potentiates viral replication efficiency. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated chromatin targeting of episomal DNA sits upstream of suppressed viral transcription.
description_zh_TW: 在病毒感染的情況下，SIRT3 透過將組蛋白甲基轉移酶複合物引導至病毒附加體來動態調節病毒基因組的轉錄輸出和複製能力。外源SIRT3過度表達會顯著減弱病毒基因表達，而缺失會增強病毒複製效率。從方向上講，SIRT3 介導的附加型 DNA 染色質靶向位於受抑制的病毒轉錄的上游。

label: PYCR1 at Lys228 (proline biosynthesis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 catalyzes Lys228 deacetylation on pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 (PYCR1), facilitating proline biosynthesis, a critical process for tumor cell proliferation. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatic modification of PYCR1 sits upstream of enhanced proline-dependent anabolic support for tumor growth. This exemplifies the oncogenic facet of SIRT3's metabolic-enzyme control in certain genetic or microenvironmental contexts.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 催化吡咯啉 5 羧酸還原酶 1 (PYCR1) 上的 Lys228 去乙醯化，促進脯胺酸生物合成，這是腫瘤細胞增殖的關鍵過程。從方向上看，PYCR1 的 SIRT3 酶促修飾位於增強的脯氨酸依賴性合成代謝支持腫瘤生長的上游。這例證了 SIRT3 在某些遺傳或微環境背景下代謝酵素控制的致癌方面。

label: SASP (senescence-associated secretory phenotype)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 functions as a negative regulator of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype through its control over mitochondrial function. Loss of SIRT3 increases expression of SASP components including TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP9), whereas activation of SIRT3 ameliorates inflammatory tissue damage. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of restrained SASP output, linking mitochondrial quality control to the inflammatory dimension of cellular senescence during aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過控製粒線體功能，作為老化相關分泌表型的負調節因子。 SIRT3 的缺失會增加 SASP 成分的表達，包括 TNF-α、IL-1β 和基質金屬蛋白酶-9 (MMP9)，而 SIRT3 的活化可改善發炎組織損傷。從方向上看，SIRT3 位於受限制的 SASP 輸出的上游，將粒線體品質控制與老化過程中細胞老化的發炎維度聯繫起來。

label: Bcl-2 (preventing mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 regulates apoptotic commitment by deacetylating Bcl-2, thus preventing mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP). Additionally, SIRT3 delays cytochrome c release kinetics and subsequent caspase activation, modulating apoptotic signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated Bcl-2 deacetylation sits upstream of preserved mitochondrial integrity and cell viability under stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過使 Bcl-2 去乙醯化來調節細胞凋亡，從而防止粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP)。此外，SIRT3 延遲細胞色素 c 釋放動力學和隨後的 caspase 激活，調節細胞凋亡信號通路。從方向上看，SIRT3 介導的 Bcl-2 去乙醯化位於壓力下線粒體完整性和細胞活力得以保留的上游。

label: p53/p21 axis (senescence initiation)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 regulates canonical senescence markers such as SA-beta-gal and inhibits the p53/p21 axis, thereby delaying senescence initiation. Directionally, SIRT3 activity sits upstream of suppressed p53-p21 checkpoint engagement. By restraining this axis alongside its antioxidant and metabolic programs, SIRT3 minimizes DNA damage accumulation and postpones entry into the senescent state during aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節經典老化標記物（例如 SA-β-gal）並抑制 p53/p21 軸，從而延遲老化起始。從方向上看，SIRT3 活性位於受抑制的 p53-p21 檢查點參與的上游。透過抑制此軸及其抗氧化和代謝程序，SIRT3 最大限度地減少 DNA 損傷積累，並在老化過程中推遲進入衰老狀態。

label: miR-297 and miR-421
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: The microRNAs miR-297 and miR-421 act as upstream modulators of SIRT3, repressing its expression and consequently influencing apoptosis-related pathways. Directionally, these microRNAs sit upstream of diminished SIRT3 output. Their dysregulation shifts the apoptotic balance in stressed cells and adds a noncoding-RNA regulatory layer to SIRT3's control of cell fate decisions in aging and malignancy.
description_zh_TW: microRNA miR-297 和 miR-421 作为 SIRT3 的上游调节剂，抑制其表达，从而影响细胞凋亡相关途径。从方向上看，这些 microRNA 位于 SIRT3 输出减少的上游。它們的失調改變了壓力細胞中的凋亡平衡，並為 SIRT3 對老化和惡性腫瘤中細胞命運決定的控制添加了非編碼 RNA 調節層。

label: PDE4
description: Resveratrol acts as a competitive inhibitor of cAMP phosphodiesterases (PDE4), leading to cAMP accumulation, Epac1 activation, Ca2+ release, and AMPK activation.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 作為 cAMP 磷酸二酯酶（PDE4）的競爭性抑制劑，導致 cAMP 累積、Epac1 活化、Ca2+ 釋放與 AMPK 活化。

label: Sas2p
description: A more recent epigenetic mechanism: Sir2p and the HAT Sas2p regulate H4K16 acetylation at the telomere-euchromatin boundary; Sir2p levels decline with age as H4K16Ac rises, and constitutive H4K16 acetylation shortens lifespan, linking subtelomeric silencing to yeast longevity. Directionally, the Sir2/Sas2 balance at telomeres determines lifespan. By maintaining H4K16 deacetylation at subtelomeric regions, Sir2 preserves the silenced state that supports longevity. This mechanism extends the sirtuin-longevity link beyond ERC suppression and highlights the importance of chromatin state in aging.
description_zh_TW: 一種更近期的表觀遺傳機制：Sir2p和HAT Sas2p調節端粒-常染色質邊界的H4K16乙醯化；隨年齡增長Sir2p水平下降而H4K16Ac升高，持續性的H4K16乙醯化縮短壽命，將亞端粒沉默與酵母長壽聯繫起來。方向上，端粒處的Sir2/Sas2平衡決定了壽命。透過維持亞端粒區域的H4K16去乙醯化，Sir2維持支持長壽的沉默狀態。此機制將sirtuin-長壽的聯繫擴展到ERC抑制之外，並突顯了染色質狀態在衰老中的重要性。

label: Bleeding risk with concurrent anticoagulant use
description: Because resveratrol inhibits platelet aggregation, concurrent use with anticoagulants such as heparin or warfarin may increase bleeding risk. Directionally, resveratrol combined with anticoagulants sits upstream of heightened bleeding liability. This is a practical safety caveat for supplementation, and clinicians advise caution in anticoagulated patients. The additive anti-platelet and anticoagulant effects raise the risk of hemorrhage, particularly at higher doses. Anyone taking blood thinners should discuss resveratrol supplementation with their healthcare provider, since the interaction is plausible based on resveratrol's pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: 由於 resveratrol 抑制血小板聚集，與肝素或華法林等抗凝血劑同時使用可能增加出血風險。在方向性上，resveratrol 與抗凝血劑的結合位於出血風險增加的上游。這是補充劑使用的實際安全警告，臨床醫師建議在抗凝患者中謹慎使用。附加的抗血小板和抗凝血效應增加出血風險，特別是在較高劑量時。任何服用血液稀釋劑的人都應與其醫療保健提供者討論 resveratrol 補充劑，因為基於 resveratrol 的藥理學，此相互作用是合理的。

label: Cytochrome P450
description: Hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes contribute to resveratrol catabolism, alongside phase-II conjugation, determining its metabolic fate. Directionally, CYP enzymes sit upstream of resveratrol clearance. This hepatic handling caps bioavailability, and it is relevant to drug-drug interactions and dosing, since resveratrol both is metabolized by and inhibits cytochrome P450 activity. The combination of rapid conjugation and CYP-mediated oxidation explains resveratrol's short half-life. Because resveratrol can both be metabolized by and inhibit CYP enzymes, co-administered drugs may see altered clearance, a clinically important consideration for supplementation.
description_zh_TW: 肝臟細胞色素 P450 酶參與 resveratrol 的分解代謝，與第二相結合作用共同決定其代謝命運。在方向性上，CYP 酶位於 resveratrol 清除的上游。這種肝臟處理限制了生物利用度，與藥物-藥物相互作用和劑量相關，因為 resveratrol 既被細胞色素 P450 代謝也抑制其活性。快速結合作用與 CYP 介導的氧化的結合解釋了 resveratrol 的短半衰期。由於 resveratrol 可以既被 CYP 酶代謝又抑制其活性，合併用藥可能看到清除率改變，這是補充劑使用中臨床重要的考量。

label: 0.15 to 1.3 mg per 100g
description: Raw red grapes contain roughly 0.15-1.3 mg resveratrol per 100 g, mostly in the skins, making dietary intake from fruit modest. Directionally, grape content sits upstream of limited resveratrol exposure. Skin concentration explains why wine, not flesh, carries most of the compound, and it reinforces that supplementation, rather than diet alone, reaches high doses. Even so, grape-derived resveratrol contributes to the polyphenol intake associated with Mediterranean-style diets. Understanding the natural abundance of resveratrol is important for interpreting both dietary and supplement-based research.
description_zh_TW: 生紅葡萄每 100 克含有約 0.15-1.3 mg resveratrol，主要在果皮中，使得從水果攝入的飲食量有限。在方向性上，葡萄含量位於 resveratrol 暴露量有限的上游。果皮中的濃度解釋了為何葡萄酒而非果肉攜帶大部分化合物，並強化了需要補充劑而非僅靠飲食才能達到高劑量的觀點。即便如此，葡萄來源的 resveratrol 對地中海飲食相關的多酚攝入量有所貢獻。理解 resveratrol 的天然豐度對於詮釋飲食和補充劑研究都很重要。

label: calorie restriction in lower organisms
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Resveratrol (3, 5, 4'-trihydroxystilbene) is a natural plant polyphenol found in grapes and red wines. In lower organisms, resveratrol replicates the effects of calorie restriction, and mice fed a high-fat diet have lower insulin resistance. STACs interact directly with SIRT1 and other isoforms, and resveratrol remains the most prominent natural sirtuin activator with longevity-relevant effects.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇（3,5,4'-三羥基芪）是一種天然植物多酚，存在於葡萄和紅酒中。在低等生物中，白藜蘆醇能夠複製熱量限制的效果；餵食高脂飲食的小鼠在白藜蘆醇作用下胰島素抵抗降低。STACs 直接與 SIRT1 及其他亞型相互作用，而白藜蘆醇仍然是最具代表性的天然 sirtuin 活化劑，具有與壽命相關的效應。

label: Dual mechanism (direct + indirect)
description: Resveratrol activates SIRT1 through both direct allosteric binding at the N-terminal domain (Glu230) and an indirect cascade via PDE4/cAMP/Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT/NAD+. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of dual SIRT1 activation. The indirect limb raises NAD+ to fuel SIRT1, amplifying the direct effect, and this dual mechanism explains resveratrol's robust pleiotropic metabolic benefits. Because the two arms are complementary, blocking either reduces but does not eliminate SIRT1 activation. This layered regulation is a defining feature of resveratrol as a sirtuin-activating compound.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 透過 N 端域（Glu230）的直接變構結合和透過 PDE4/cAMP/Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT/NAD+ 的間接級聯兩種機制活化 SIRT1。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於雙重 SIRT1 活化的上游。間接臂提高 NAD+ 以供 SIRT1 使用，放大直接效應，這種雙重機制解釋了 resveratrol 強大的多效性代謝益處。由於兩條臂是互補的，阻斷任何一條都會減少但不會消除 SIRT1 活化。這種分層調控是 resveratrol 作為 sirtuin 活化化合物的定義特徵。

label: Cytochrome P450 activity
description: Resveratrol both is metabolized by and inhibits cytochrome P450 activity, creating a self-reinforcing effect on its own clearance and on co-administered drugs. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of CYP inhibition. This can alter the pharmacokinetics of other medications, since CYP inhibition slows their metabolism, and it also affects resveratrol's own disposition. It is a clinically relevant interaction caveat for supplementation, especially in patients taking drugs with narrow therapeutic windows. Understanding the bidirectional CYP relationship is important for predicting both resveratrol's bioavailability and its potential to influence drug exposure.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 既被細胞色素 P450 代謝也抑制其活性，對自身清除和合併用藥產生自我強化效應。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於 CYP 抑制的上游。這可以改變其他藥物的藥動學，因為 CYP 抑制會減慢其代謝，同時也影響 resveratrol 自身的處置。這是補充劑使用的臨床相關相互作用警告，特別是在服用治療窗窄的藥物的患者中。理解雙向 CYP 關係對於預測 resveratrol 的生物利用度及其影響藥物暴露的潛力至關重要。

label: PDE4 (phosphodiesterase 4)
description: Resveratrol competitively inhibits cAMP phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4), the enzyme that degrades cAMP to AMP, thereby slowing cAMP clearance. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of PDE4 inhibition. This indirect action raises intracellular cAMP, which then engages the Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT cascade that further activates SIRT1 through NAD+ elevation. It is one arm of resveratrol's dual (direct plus indirect) SIRT1-activation mechanism, alongside allosteric binding to the SIRT1 N-terminal domain, and it explains how resveratrol can activate SIRT1 even when direct binding is weak.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇競爭性抑制 cAMP 磷酸二酯酶 4（PDE4），即降解 cAMP 為 AMP 的酶，從而減緩 cAMP 的清除。在方向性上，白藜蘆醇位於 PDE4 抑制的上游。這種間接作用提高細胞內 cAMP，然後啟動 Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT 級聯反應，通過 NAD+ 升高進一步活化 SIRT1。這是白藜蘆醇雙重（直接加間接）SIRT1 活化機制的一個臂，與對 SIRT1 N 端結構域的變構結合並列，並解釋了白藜蘆醇即使在直接結合較弱時也能活化 SIRT1。

label: Anti-viral effects
description: Resveratrol demonstrates antiviral effects in some experimental systems, though the evidence base is moderate and mechanism-dependent. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of viral inhibition in those models. Potential mechanisms include modulation of host stress and inflammatory pathways, inhibition of viral replication enzymes, and effects on cellular signaling that restrict viral spread. Clinical relevance remains preliminary, and the poor bioavailability of resveratrol limits translation. Nonetheless, the antiviral observations contribute to the compound's broad bioactivity profile and warrant further investigation of its role in host defense against specific viruses.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在某些實驗系統中展現抗病毒效應，但證據基礎為中等且取決於機制。在方向性上，resveratrol 在這些模型中位於抑制病毒的上游。潛在機制包括調節宿主壓力和發炎途徑、抑制病毒複製酶以及影響限制病毒傳播的細胞訊號。臨床相關性仍處於初步階段，且 resveratrol 的低生物利用度限制了轉化。儘管如此，抗病毒觀察結果促進了該化合物廣泛的生物活性特徵，值得進一步研究其在宿主對抗特定病毒防禦中的作用。

label: Coronary relaxation
description: Resveratrol enhances coronary relaxation, reduces ventricular arrhythmias, and inhibits platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation, collectively protecting the heart. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of improved coronary function. These integrated effects support myocardial perfusion under stress and reduce the risk of ischemic events and arrhythmogenesis. They reinforce resveratrol's cardioprotective profile, which is largely attributed to SIRT1, eNOS, and AMPK activation. The combination of improved vasodilation, reduced thrombotic tendency, and restrained vascular remodeling makes resveratrol a multifaceted cardiovascular agent in preclinical models.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 增強冠狀血管舒張、減少心室心律不整並抑制血小板聚集和平滑肌增生，從而整體保護心臟。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於改善冠狀血管功能的上游。這些整合效應在壓力下支持心肌灌注，並降低缺血事件和心律失常發生的風險。它們強化了 resveratrol 的心臟保護特徵，這主要歸因於 SIRT1、eNOS 和 AMPK 的活化。改善血管舒張、降低血栓傾向和抑制血管重塑的組合使 resveratrol 成為臨床前模型中的多面向心血管活性物質。

label: leukemia, DMBA-induced mammary tumors, skin cancer, prostate cancer
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: Resveratrol exhibits chemopreventive activity against leukemia, DMBA-induced mammary tumors, skin cancer, and other malignancies, in part through SIRT1-dependent and -independent pathways (reviewed in the sirtuin literature; Baur 2006 PMID 17086191).
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇對白血病、DMBA 誘導的乳腺腫瘤、皮膚癌和其他惡性腫瘤表現出化學預防活性，部分透過 SIRT1 依賴性和非依賴性通路（參見 sirtuin 文獻綜述；Baur 2006 PMID 17086191）。

label: ~8–14 minutes
description: Resveratrol has a very short plasma half-life of roughly 8-14 minutes because of rapid conjugation and clearance. Directionally, rapid metabolism sits upstream of low systemic exposure. This severely limits the duration of any SIRT1 activation after a single dose, and it is the central pharmacological obstacle to translating resveratrol's preclinical benefits to humans. Sustained-release formulations, metabolic inhibitors such as quercetin, and delivery within the red-wine matrix are strategies to improve exposure. Understanding the half-life is essential for interpreting both negative clinical trials and claims about resveratrol's efficacy.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 的血漿半衰期非常短，約 8-14 分鐘，因為快速的結合和清除。在方向性上，快速代謝位於低系統暴露量的上游。這嚴重限制了單次劑量後 SIRT1 活化的持續時間，是將 resveratrol 臨床前益處轉化到人體的核心藥理學障礙。緩釋製劑、槲皮素等代謝抑制劑以及在紅酒基質中的遞送是改善暴露量的策略。理解半衰期對於詮釋陰性臨床試驗和關於 resveratrol 療效的主張至關重要。

label: Platelet aggregation
description: Resveratrol inhibits platelet aggregation, reducing thrombotic risk and complementing its vascular benefits. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed platelet activation. This also creates a bleeding-risk caveat when combined with anticoagulants such as heparin or warfarin, since the anti-platelet effect adds to the anticoagulant's action. It is one of several anti-atherothrombotic actions of the compound, alongside its vasodilatory and anti-inflammatory effects. Clinicians therefore advise caution in anticoagulated patients, and the platelet effect is considered when assessing resveratrol's overall cardiovascular profile.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 抑制血小板聚集，降低血栓形成風險並補充其血管益處。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於抑制血小板活化的上游。這在與肝素或華法林等抗凝血劑合用時也產生出血風險的警告，因為抗血小板效應會增添抗凝血劑的作用。這是該化合物的多種抗動脈粥樣硬化血栓作用之一，與其血管舒張和抗發炎效應並存。因此，臨床醫師建議在抗凝患者中謹慎使用，在評估 resveratrol 整體心血管特徵時會考慮血小板效應。

label: Smooth muscle cell proliferation
description: Resveratrol inhibits vascular smooth-muscle cell proliferation, limiting neointimal hyperplasia and atherosclerotic plaque growth. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed VSMC expansion. This restrains the remodeling that narrows vessels after injury, and it complements resveratrol's anti-platelet and vasodilatory effects. The anti-proliferative action likely involves SIRT1, AMPK, and cell-cycle regulation in smooth-muscle cells, and it is relevant to restenosis and the progression of atherosclerosis. By controlling VSMC growth and migration, resveratrol contributes to preserving vascular lumen patency.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 抑制血管平滑肌細胞增殖，限制新生內膜增生和動脈粥樣硬化斑塊生長。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於抑制 VSMC 擴增的上游。這限制了損傷後血管縮窄的重塑過程，並與 resveratrol 的抗血小板和血管舒張效應互補。抗增殖作用可能涉及 SIRT1、AMPK 和平滑肌細胞中的細胞週期調控，與再狹窄和動脈粥樣硬化進展相關。透過控制 VSMC 的生長和遷移，resveratrol 有助於維護血管腔的通暢性。

label: Direct antioxidant (weaker than vitamin C)
description: Resveratrol is a relatively poor direct antioxidant, weaker than vitamin C or cysteine at scavenging free radicals in vitro. Directionally, its redox-scavenging capacity is minor. Its biological benefits therefore arise mainly from signaling modulation—activation of SIRT1, AMPK, and eNOS, and inhibition of PDE4—rather than from stoichiometric antioxidant action. This corrects the simplistic antioxidant framing of resveratrol and explains why its effects can persist well after the compound has been metabolized. Understanding resveratrol as a hormetic signaling molecule rather than a direct antioxidant is central to interpreting its pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 是相對較弱的直接抗氧化劑，在體外清除自由基的能力弱於維生素 C 或半胱氨酸。在方向性上，其氧化還原清除能力較次要。因此其生物學益處主要來自訊號調制——活化 SIRT1、AMPK 和 eNOS，以及抑制 PDE4——而非化學計量的抗氧化作用。這修正了對 resveratrol 簡單化的抗氧化框架，並解釋了為何其效應在化合物被代謝後仍能持續存在。將 resveratrol 理解為激效性訊號分子而非直接抗氧化劑，是詮釋其藥理學的關鍵。

label: Grape skin
description: Resveratrol is found concentrated in grape skins, where it contributes to the anti-atherosclerotic benefits attributed to red wine consumption. Directionally, dietary resveratrol sits upstream of vascular protection. Skin content is modest and matrix-dependent, influencing how much reaches circulation, and typical red wine contains 1.5-3 mg/L, so a single glass provides only about 0.3 mg. This botanical source motivated the French-paradox hypothesis, and the presence of resveratrol in the skin rather than the flesh explains why wine, not grape juice, carries most of the compound.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在葡萄皮中濃度較高，有助於歸因於飲用紅酒的抗動脈粥樣硬化益處。在方向性上，飲食中的 resveratrol 位於血管保護的上游。皮中的含量有限且受基質影響，影響其進入循環的量，典型紅酒含有 1.5-3 mg/L，因此一杯酒僅提供約 0.3 mg。這種植物來源催生了法國悖論假說，而 resveratrol 存在於果皮而非果肉中，解釋了為何葡萄酒而非葡萄汁攜帶大部分此化合物。

label: Polyphenol stilbene (3,4',5-trihydroxystilbene)
description: Resveratrol is the polyphenolic stilbene 3,4',5-trihydroxystilbene, a plant defensive compound produced under stress such as pathogen attack or UV exposure. Its chemical structure features three phenolic hydroxyls that confer redox activity and enable binding to sirtuin and phosphodiesterase targets. Directionally, resveratrol acts as the small-molecule upstream activator of SIRT1. Though a weak direct antioxidant compared with vitamin C or cysteine, its biological impact flows mainly through signaling modulation—activating SIRT1, AMPK, and eNOS, and inhibiting PDE4—rather than through stoichiometric scavenging of free radicals.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol（白藜蘆醇）是多酚類芪類化合物 3,4',5-三羥基芪，一種在病原體侵襲或紫外線照射等壓力下產生的植物防禦化合物。其化學結構具有三個酚羥基，賦予其氧化還原活性並使其能夠結合 sirtuin 和磷酸二酯酶靶標。在方向性上，resveratrol 作為 SIRT1 的小分子上游活化劑。儘管作為直接抗氧化劑其效力弱於維生素 C 或半胱氨酸，但其生物學影響主要透過訊號調制實現——活化 SIRT1、AMPK 和 eNOS，並抑制 PDE4——而非透過化學計量自由基清除。

label: Vasodilation via nitric oxide synthesis modulation
description: Resveratrol promotes vasodilation by modulating nitric-oxide synthesis, principally via SIRT1-mediated activation of eNOS. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of NO-dependent relaxation. Improved vasodilation lowers vascular resistance and blood pressure, and enhanced NO bioavailability also reduces platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation. This is a direct mechanism behind its cardiovascular effects, and it connects resveratrol's SIRT1-activating action to endothelial function. Because endothelial NO is central to vascular health, resveratrol's ability to boost the SIRT1-eNOS axis underlies much of its reported cardiovascular benefit.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 透過調制一氧化氮合成促進血管舒張，主要透過 SIRT1 介導的 eNOS 活化。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於 NO 依賴性舒張的上游。改善的血管舒張降低血管阻力和血壓，增強的 NO 生物利用度也減少血小板聚集和平滑肌增生。這是其心血管效應的直接機制，並將 resveratrol 的 SIRT1 活化作用與內皮功能聯繫起來。由於內皮 NO 對血管健康至關重要，resveratrol 增強 SIRT1-eNOS 軸線的能力構成了其大部分報導的心血管益處的基礎。

label: Endothelial cells from lipid damage
description: Resveratrol protects endothelial cells from lipid (e.g., oxidized-LDL) damage, helping preserve vascular barrier and nitric-oxide function. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of endothelial protection. This action is mediated through SIRT1/eNOS and antioxidant pathways, reducing the injurious effects of oxidized lipoproteins on the endothelium. It is a foundational vascular benefit supporting resveratrol's cardiovascular reputation, and it is consistent with resveratrol's inhibition of Lox-1-mediated foam-cell formation and its promotion of vasodilation. Preserving endothelial integrity is central to preventing the initiation and progression of atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 保護內皮細胞免受脂質（如氧化型 LDL）損傷，有助於維護血管屏障和一氧化氮功能。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於內皮保護的上游。此作用透過 SIRT1/eNOS 和抗氧化途徑介導，減少氧化脂蛋白對內皮的損傷效應。這是支持 resveratrol 心血管聲譽的基礎血管益處，與 resveratrol 抑制 Lox-1 介導的泡沫細胞形成和促進血管舒張的作用一致。維護內皮完整性對於預防動脈粥樣硬化的啟動和進展至關重要。

label: Ventricular arrhythmias
description: Resveratrol reduces ventricular arrhythmias in preclinical models, likely via antioxidant, ion-channel, and eNOS-modulating actions. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of reduced arrhythmogenesis. This adds an electrophysiological benefit to its cardiovascular profile, and it is observed in animal studies with uncertain human translation. The anti-arrhythmic effect may reflect stabilization of cardiac ion channels, reduced oxidative stress, and improved NO signaling in the myocardium. These findings support resveratrol's reputation as a cardioprotective compound, though the relevance to human arrhythmia remains to be established in clinical settings.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在臨床前模型中減少心室心律不整，可能透過抗氧化、離子通道和 eNOS 調節作用。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於減少心律失常的上游。這為其心血管特徵增添了電生理學益處，但在動物研究中觀察到的結果其人類轉化尚不確定。抗心律不整效應可能反映了心臟離子通道的穩定化、氧化壓力的降低以及心肌中 NO 訊號的改善。這些發現支持 resveratrol 作為心臟保護化合物的聲譽，但其與人類心律不整的相關性仍需在臨床環境中確立。

label: Hormetic (biphasic) dose-response
description: Resveratrol shows a hormetic, biphasic dose-response: at low-to-moderate doses it acts as a mild stressor that triggers beneficial adaptive responses such as sirtuin activation and antioxidant defense, whereas at very high doses it can produce off-target or pro-oxidant effects. The directionality is dose determining outcome, not simple monotonic benefit. This complicates dosing in therapeutics. It also rationalizes why modest, diet-like exposures may be more effective than pharmacological megadoses.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇表現出毒物興奮效應的雙相劑量反應：在低至中等劑量下，它作為輕度壓力源觸發有益的適應性反應（如 sirtuin 活化和抗氧化防禦），而在非常高的劑量下，它可能產生脫靶或促氧化效應。其方向性為劑量決定結果，而非簡單的單調益處。這使治療中的劑量確定複雜化。它也合理化了為什麼適度的、類似飲食的暴露可能比藥理學大劑量更有效。

label: Anti-neoplastic effects
description: Resveratrol shows anti-neoplastic effects in preclinical models, including cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction, though confidence in human translation is moderate. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed tumor phenotype in those systems. Mechanisms may involve modulation of SIRT1, AMPK, NF-κB, and p53, which together restrain proliferation and promote death of cancer cells. Robust human anticancer efficacy is unproven, and bioavailability remains a major limitation. Nonetheless, the breadth of resveratrol's anti-cancer mechanisms continues to drive interest in its use as an adjunctive agent in oncology research.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在臨床前模型中展現抗腫瘤效應，包括細胞週期阻滯和凋亡誘導，但對人體轉化的信心為中等。在方向性上，resveratrol 在這些系統中位於抑制腫瘤表型的上游。機制可能涉及 SIRT1、AMPK、NF-κB 和 p53 的調節，共同抑制癌細胞的增殖並促進其死亡。resveratrol 在人體中的抗癌療效尚未被證實，生物利用度仍是主要限制。儘管如此，resveratrol 抗癌機制的廣度持續推動著將其作為腫瘤學研究中輔助用藥的興趣。

label: Blood glucose and insulin
description: Resveratrol treatment lowers blood glucose and circulating insulin in animals on a high-calorie diet, improving glycemic control and insulin sensitivity. These metabolic benefits are linked to SIRT1/AMPK activation and improved insulin signaling in liver and muscle, together with reduced hepatic steatosis. Directionally, resveratrol activates SIRT1/AMPK to lower glycemia. Caveats include that human trials have been inconsistent, likely owing to the compound's poor oral bioavailability, short half-life, and extensive first-pass metabolism, which limit the translation of preclinical efficacy to physiological exposures achievable through dietary or supplement intake in people.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇治療降低高熱量飲食動物的血糖和循環胰島素水平，改善血糖控制和胰島素敏感性。這些代謝益處與 SIRT1/AMPK 活化以及肝臟和肌肉中胰島素信號改善相關，同時減少肝脂肪變性。在方向性上，白藜蘆醇活化 SIRT1/AMPK 以降低血糖。需要注意的是，人體試驗結果不一致，可能是由於該化合物口服生物利用度差、半衰期短和廣泛的首過代謝，限制了臨床前療效向人們通過飲食或補充劑攝入可達到的生理暴露量的轉化。

label: Oral bioavailability
description: Resveratrol undergoes extensive first-pass metabolism, including glucuronidation and sulfation in the gut and liver, yielding very low systemic free concentrations after oral intake. Its plasma half-life is roughly 8-14 minutes. Directionally, oral administration leads to rapid conjugation and poor bioavailability. This undermines many preclinical benefits when translating to humans, because tissue concentrations rarely approach the levels shown to activate SIRT1 in vitro. Formulation strategies, higher doses, and co-administration with absorption enhancers are being explored to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇經歷廣泛的首過代謝，包括腸道和肝臟中的葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化，導致口服攝入後系統性游離濃度極低。其血漿半衰期約為 8-14 分鐘。在方向性上，口服給藥導致快速結合和較低的生物利用度。這在轉化為人類時削弱了許多臨床前益處，因為組織濃度很少接近在體外顯示能活化 SIRT1 的水平。正在探索製劑策略、更高劑量和與吸收增強劑的共同給藥來克服這些藥代動力學限制。

label: Traditional East Asian medicine (Veratrum formosanum)
description: Resveratrol-containing plants such as Veratrum formosanum have long been used in traditional East Asian medicine, foreshadowing modern interest in the compound. Directionally, the traditional botanical use precedes and motivates contemporary pharmacological study. This ethnobotanical precedent parallels other stilbene-bearing remedies, and it contributed to the identification of resveratrol as a bioactive compound with cardiovascular and longevity-associated properties. It is historical context rather than a mechanistic claim, but it illustrates how traditional medicine has repeatedly pointed modern pharmacology toward bioactive natural products.
description_zh_TW: 含 resveratrol 的植物如台灣藜蘆（Veratrum formosanum）長期以來被用於傳統東亞醫學，預示了現代對此化合物的興趣。在方向性上，傳統植物使用先於並推動了當代藥理學研究。這種民族植物學先例與其他含芪類的藥方相似，並促進了 resveratrol 作為具有心血管和壽命相關特性的活性化合物的鑑定。這是歷史背景而非機制性主張，但它說明了傳統醫學如何一再指引現代藥理學發現活性天然產物。

label: Sirtuins (SIRT1–7)
description: Sir2 (silent information regulator 2) is the founding member of the sirtuin family, first identified in Saccharomyces cerevisiae as a regulator of mating-type locus silencing and replicative lifespan. The seven mammalian paralogues SIRT1–SIRT7 evolved from this ancestral NAD+-dependent deacetylase, retaining the conserved catalytic core while diversifying in subcellular localization and substrate repertoire. This phylogenetic continuity means insights from yeast Sir2 historically informed mammalian sirtuin biology, although the mammalian enzymes acquired lineage-specific regulatory domains. The relationship is directional: yeast Sir2 is the evolutionary precursor, not a downstream effector, of the SIRT1–7 family.
description_zh_TW: Sir2（silent information regulator 2）是 sirtuin 家族的始祖成員，最早在釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中被發現，作為交配型基因座沉默和複製性壽命的調節因子。哺乳動物的七個旁系同源物 SIRT1–SIRT7 從這個祖先型 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶演化而來，保留了保守的催化核心，同時在次細胞定位和受質譜方面多樣化。這種系統發生學上的連續性意味著來自酵母 Sir2 的見解在歷史上促進了對哺乳動物 sirtuin 生物學的理解，儘管哺乳動物酶獲得了譜系特異性的調節結構域。這種關係是方向性的：酵母 Sir2 是 SIRT1–7 家族的演化前體，而非下游效應因子。

label: Mother cell
description: Sir2p maintains cellular polarity so that oxidized proteins, misfolded aggregates, and dysfunctional mitochondria are retained in the mother cell, allowing daughter cells to begin life undamaged; this asymmetric segregation extends daughter-cell lifespan at the mother's expense. Directionally, Sir2p promotes asymmetric segregation of damage to the mother cell. By ensuring that daughters are born free of damage, this mechanism supports the longevity of the lineage. It illustrates how sirtuins contribute to cellular rejuvenation, a concept that has influenced thinking about asymmetric cell division and aging.
description_zh_TW: Sir2p維持細胞極性，使氧化蛋白、錯誤折疊的聚集物和功能障礙的粒線體保留在母細胞中，讓子細胞在無損傷的狀態下開始生命；這種不對稱分配以母細胞為代價延長子細胞的壽命。方向上，Sir2p促進損傷向母細胞的不對稱分配。透過確保子細胞出生時無損傷，此機制支持了譜系的長壽。它說明了sirtuin如何有助於細胞回春，這一概念影響了關於不對稱細胞分裂和衰老的思考。

label: Extrachromosomal rDNA Circles (ERCs)
description: Sir2p protects yeast from toxic accumulation of self-replicating extrachromosomal rDNA circles (ERCs); deletion of the replication-fork-blocking protein Fob1p rescues the short lifespan of sir2 mutants, establishing ERC suppression as the first mechanistic explanation for Sir2's longevity effect. Directionally, Sir2p suppresses ERC accumulation to extend lifespan. By preventing the toxic buildup of these circular DNA molecules, Sir2 preserves genome stability and replicative capacity. This was the first molecular mechanism linking Sir2 to longevity and remains a foundational finding in sirtuin research.
description_zh_TW: Sir2p保護酵母免受自我複製的染色體外rDNA環（ERC）毒性積累的損害；刪除複製叉阻斷蛋白Fob1p可挽救sir2突變體的短壽命，確立ERC抑制是Sir2長壽效應的第一個機制性解釋。方向上，Sir2p抑制ERC積累以延長壽命。透過防止這些環狀DNA分子的毒性積累，Sir2維持基因組穩定性和複製能力。這是第一個將Sir2與長壽聯繫的分子機制，至今仍是sirtuin研究的基礎性發現。

label: 1.5 to 3 mg per liter
description: Typical red wine contains 1.5-3 mg/L trans-resveratrol, up to about 5.8 mg/L in some cool-climate wines, with a 5-ounce glass providing only about 0.3 mg. Directionally, wine content sits upstream of modest resveratrol intake. This low dose highlights why drinking alone may not reach pharmacologic exposures, and it contextualizes the French-paradox and matrix-bioavailability discussion. Because red wine's co-constituents, including quercetin and ethanol, may improve resveratrol's bioavailability, the whole-matrix effect matters for interpreting epidemiological associations with wine consumption.
description_zh_TW: 典型紅酒含有 1.5-3 mg/L 反式 resveratrol，在某些涼爽氣候葡萄酒中可高達約 5.8 mg/L，一杯 5 盎司的酒僅提供約 0.3 mg。在方向性上，葡萄酒含量位於適度 resveratrol 攝入量的上游。這種低劑量突顯了為何單靠飲酒可能無法達到藥理學暴露量，並為法國悖論和基質生物利用度討論提供背景。由於紅酒的共同成分（包括槲皮素和乙醇）可能改善 resveratrol 的生物利用度，全基質效應對於詮釋與葡萄酒消費的流行病學關聯至關重要。

label: ER stress
description: TFE3 is activated in response to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress through a pathway that is mTORC1-independent but requires the ER stress sensor PERK. Under unfolded protein accumulation, PERK signaling promotes TFE3 nuclear translocation, engaging lysosomal and autophagic genes to alleviate proteotoxic burden. This distinct trigger allows TFE3 to contribute to the integrated stress response without relying on nutrient sensing. The mechanism expands the repertoire of stressors that can recruit the MiT/TFE degradative program.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 在回應內質網（ER）壓力時透過一條不依賴 mTORC1、但需要 ER 壓力感測器 PERK 的途徑被活化。在未折疊蛋白累積時，PERK 信號促進 TFE3 核轉位，啟動溶酶體和自噬基因以減輕蛋白毒性負擔。此獨特觸發因子使 TFE3 能在不依賴營養感知的情況下，貢獻於整合性壓力反應。此機制擴展了能夠招募 MiT/TFE 降解程序的壓力因子 repertoire。

label: Xp11 translocation RCC
description: TFE3 is recurrently involved in Xp11.2 translocation renal cell carcinomas, in which it fuses with partner genes such as ASPSCR1, PRCC, or SFPQ, creating chimeric transcription factors that drive tumorigenesis. These gene fusions define a distinct subset of RCC, often arising in children and young adults, with characteristic clear-cell or papillary features. The fusion proteins typically retain the TFE3 DNA-binding domain and are constitutively active, deregulating MiT/TFE target genes. Detection of TFE3 rearrangement is important for correct diagnosis and classification of these tumors.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 反覆參與 Xp11.2 轉位性腎細胞癌，在此它與 ASPSCR1、PRCC 或 SFPQ 等夥伴基因融合，創造出驅動腫瘤發生的嵌合轉錄因子。這些基因融合定義了 RCC 的一個獨特亞群，常發生於兒童和年輕成人，具有特徵性的透明細胞或乳突狀特徵。融合蛋白通常保留 TFE3 的 DNA 結合域並呈組成型活化，使 MiT/TFE 標的基因失調。偵測 TFE3 重排對於正確診斷和分類這些腫瘤至為重要。

label: folate
description: MTHFD1 metabolizes folate as a trifunctional enzyme catalyzing NADP-dependent methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase, cyclohydrolase, and formyltetrahydrofolate synthetase reactions in the cytosolic folate cycle. These steps produce 10-formyl-THF used in purine synthesis and contribute to the one-carbon pool that supports methylation. Disruption of MTHFD1 perturbs nucleotide synthesis and the methyl donor supply downstream of folate, indirectly affecting COMT by limiting SAMe availability. It is a central node in cytosolic one-carbon metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 將 folate 代謝為三功能酶，催化細胞質 folate 循環中的 NADP 依賴性亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫酶、環化水解酶和甲醯四氫葉酸合成酶反應。這些步驟產生用於嘌呤合成的 10-甲醯基-THF，並有助於形成支持甲基化的一碳庫。 MTHFD1 的破壞會擾亂核苷酸合成和 folate 下游的 methyl donor 供應，透過限制 SAMe 的可用性來間接影響 COMT。它是細胞質一碳代謝的中心節點。

label: methionine synthase activity
description: MTRR maintains methionine synthase activity by reducing the enzyme's bound cobalamin (vitamin B12) cofactor back to its active form after oxidative inactivation, using FAD and NADPH. Without MTRR, methionine synthase loses function, halting homocysteine remethylation and depleting the methionine and SAMe pool. This positions MTRR as essential for methylation cycle continuity and for sustaining the methyl donor supply that COMT requires. Its activity links B12 status directly to one-carbon metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MTRR 透過使用 FAD 和 NADPH 將酵素的結合鈷胺素（維生素 B12）輔因子還原至氧化失活後的活性形式來維持 methionine synthase activity。如果沒有 MTRR，蛋胺酸合成酶就會失去功能，停止同型半胱胺酸再甲基化並耗盡甲硫胺酸和 SAMe 池。這使得 MTRR 對於 methylation cycle 的連續性和維持 COMT 所需的 methyl donor 供應至關重要。其活性將 B12 狀態直接與一碳代謝連結起來。

label: HDAC
description: HDAC stands for histone deacetylase, a family of enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histone tails, counteracting the activity of histone acetyltransferases. By deacetylating histones, HDACs promote chromatin compaction and generally repress transcription, and they also regulate numerous non-histone proteins. They are divided into classes I, II, III (sirtuins), and IV, and HDAC inhibitors are widely studied as tools to reactivate silenced genes and as candidate therapeutic agents in cancer, inflammation, and aging.
description_zh_TW: HDAC 代表組蛋白去乙醯化酶，這是一個酶家族，可去除組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，從而抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的活性。透過組蛋白去乙醯化，HDAC 促進染色質壓縮並通常抑制轉錄，並且它們還調節許多非組蛋白。它們分為 I、II、III（sirtuins）和 IV 類，HDAC 抑制劑作為重新激活沉默基因的工具以及作為癌症、發炎和老化的候選治療劑而被廣泛研究。

label: Sodium Valproate
description: Sodium valproate is an anticonvulsant and mood-stabilizing drug that also acts as a histone deacetylase inhibitor at therapeutic concentrations. By inhibiting class I HDACs, valproate increases histone acetylation and alters the expression of many genes, which contributes to its clinical effects and underlies its use as an experimental epigenetic modulator. Valproate is also used in research to enhance reprogramming, promote differentiation, and study the role of acetylation in gene regulation and aging.
description_zh_TW: 丙戊酸鈉是一種抗驚厥藥和情緒穩定藥，在治療濃度下也可用作組蛋白去乙醯化酶抑制劑。透過抑制 I 類 HDAC，丙戊酸增加組蛋白乙醯化並改變許多基因的表達，這有助於其臨床效果並奠定其作為實驗性表觀遺傳調節劑的基礎。丙戊酸也用於增強重編程、促進分化以及研究乙醯化在基因調控和老化中的作用的研究。

label: Trichostatin A
description: Trichostatin A is a potent, broadly acting histone deacetylase inhibitor used extensively in epigenetics and senescence research. By blocking HDAC enzymes, trichostatin A increases histone acetylation, opening chromatin and reactivating genes silenced by deacetylation across the genome. In senescence studies it serves as a tool compound to probe how the balance between histone acetyltransferase and deacetylase activities influences the senescence phenotype, SASP regulation, and chromatin state. It is one of the most widely used tool compounds for manipulating the acetylome experimentally.
description_zh_TW: Trichostatin A 是一種有效、廣泛作用的組蛋白去乙醯化酶抑制劑，廣泛用於表觀遺傳學和老化研究。透過阻斷 HDAC 酶，曲古抑菌素 A 增加組蛋白乙醯化，打開染色質並重新活化整個基因組中因去乙醯化而沉默的基因。在老化研究中，它作為工具化合物來探討組蛋白乙醯轉移酶和去乙醯化酶活性之間的平衡如何影響老化表型、SASP 調節和染色質狀態。它是用於實驗操縱乙醯基組的最廣泛使用的工具化合物之一。

label: Starvation survival
description: HLH-30 is required for survival during prolonged starvation; hlh-30 mutant animals die prematurely under nutrient-deprived conditions due to their inability to mount sufficient autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization. By activating the clearance and energy-mobilization programs, HLH-30 enables worms to withstand food absence. This essential role mirrors the dependence of mammalian cells on TFEB for stress resilience. The phenotype establishes HLH-30 as a critical effector of adaptive starvation responses.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在長期飢餓期間的存活是必需的；hlh-30 突變動物在營養剝奪條件下過早死亡，因為它們無法啟動足夠的自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員。透過活化清除和能量動員程序，HLH-30 使線蟲能夠承受食物缺失。此必要角色反映了哺乳動物細胞對 TFEB 在壓力韌性上的依賴。該表型確立了 HLH-30 作為適應性飢餓反應的關鍵效應物。

label: Longevity in C. elegans
description: HLH-30 regulates longevity in C. elegans, as its overexpression extends lifespan while loss of hlh-30 shortens it and suppresses the longevity of other mutants. By inducing autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity integrates insulin, mTOR, and dietary signals into a pro-longevity transcriptional program. The worm findings provide a conserved model for how TFEB orthologs promote healthspan in higher organisms.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中調節壽命，因為其過度表現可延長壽命，而 hlh-30 的缺失會縮短壽命並抑制其他突變體的長壽。透過誘發自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性將胰島素、mTOR 和飲食信號整合進促長壽的轉錄程序。線蟲的發現為 TFEB 同源物如何在高等生物中促進健康壽命提供了保守模型。

label: Nucleus during fasting
description: HLH-30 translocates to and accumulates in intestinal nuclei of fasted C. elegans, where it activates the lysosomal, autophagic, and lipolytic transcriptional programs. This nuclear enrichment mirrors the starvation-induced nuclear entry of mammalian TFEB/TFE3 and is essential for the organism's adaptive response to food deprivation. The translocation is opposed by insulin/IGF and CeTOR signaling that retain HLH-30 cytoplasmically when food is available. Its nuclear localization thus serves as a key determinant of fasting-induced longevity.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 轉位至禁食線蟲的腸道細胞核中並在其中累積，於此活化溶酶體、自噬性和脂解性的轉錄程序。此核富集反映了哺乳動物 TFEB/TFE3 在飢餓誘發的核進入，並對生物適應食物剝奪的反應至為必要。此轉位受到胰島素/IGF 和 CeTOR 信號的拮抗，後者在食物可得時將 HLH-30 保留於細胞質。因此其核定位作為禁食誘發長壽的關鍵決定因子。

label: Lysosomal lipase genes
description: HLH-30, the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian TFEB, induces expression of the lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) in response to fasting, promoting mobilization of stored lipids. This transcriptional activation mirrors TFEB's induction of lipolytic and autophagic programs in mammals during nutrient scarcity. The HLH-30–lipase axis provides a molecular explanation for fasting-induced lipophagy and lifespan extension in worms. It demonstrates deep conservation of the MiT/TFE nutrient-response program.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 是哺乳動物 TFEB 在線蟲中的同源物，在回應禁食時誘發溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的表現，促進儲存脂質的動員。此轉錄活化反映了哺乳動物 TFEB 在營養匱乏時對脂解和自噬程序的誘發。HLH-30–脂肪酶軸為禁食誘發的脂噬和線蟲壽命延長提供了分子解釋。它展示了 MiT/TFE 營養反應程序的高度保守性。

label: Melanogenesis
description: Melanogenesis and Tyrosinase are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Melanogenesis and Tyrosinase may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Melanogenesis 和 Tyrosinase 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Melanogenesis 和 Tyrosinase 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Oculocutaneous Albinism
description: Tyrosinase and Oculocutaneous Albinism are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Tyrosinase and Oculocutaneous Albinism may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase 和 Oculocutaneous Albinism 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Tyrosinase 和 Oculocutaneous Albinism 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Tyrosinase-related protein-1
description: Tyrosinase-related protein-1 and Tyrosinase are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Tyrosinase-related protein-1 and Tyrosinase may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase-related protein-1 和 Tyrosinase 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Tyrosinase-related protein-1 和 Tyrosinase 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: SIRT5 pockets B, C and substrate-binding site
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Co-crystallization of suramin with human SIRT5 revealed that suramin binds by occupying the nicotinamide ribose pocket (B-pocket), the nicotinamide pocket (C-pocket), and part of the substrate-binding site. This structural insight explains suramin's broad, high-affinity inhibition of multiple sirtuins and informed the design of more selective derivatives such as NF675. Directionally, suramin is the ligand and the SIRT5 catalytic cleft the receptor. The structure also illustrates general principles governing small-molecule engagement of the sirtuin NAD+/substrate channel.
description_zh_TW: Suramin 與人類 SIRT5 的共晶體結構揭示 Suramin 透過占据尼可醯胺核糖口袋（B 口袋）、尼可醯胺口袋（C 口袋）和部分受質結合位點進行結合。此結構見解解釋了 Suramin 對多種 sirtuin 的廣泛高親和力抑制作用，並為設計更具選擇性的衍生物如 NF675 提供了依據。方向性上 Suramin 是配體，SIRT5 催化溝槽是受體。此結構也闡明了小分子與 sirtuin NAD+/受質通道結合的一般原則。

label: SIRT1-selective inhibitor
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: NF675 is a suramin-derived small molecule that is the most potent and selective compound in its scaffold series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. It was obtained through optimization of the suramin scaffold, which itself is a nanomolar inhibitor of SIRT1/SIRT2. Directionally, NF675's identity as a suramin-derived, SIRT1-selective inhibitor illustrates scaffold engineering for isoform selectivity within the sirtuin inhibitor field. Its modest drug-likeness, stemming from high molecular weight and anionic character, limits therapeutic application despite good potency and selectivity.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是一種 Suramin 衍生的小分子，是其骨架系列中最具活性和選擇性的化合物，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。它透過優化 Suramin 骨架而獲得，Suramin 本身是 SIRT1/SIRT2 的奈摩爾級抑制劑。方向性上 NF675 作為 Suramin 衍生的 SIRT1 選擇性抑制劑的身份說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑領域中針對同工型選擇性的骨架工程。其由於高分子量和陰離子特性導致的中等類藥性限制了治療應用，儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性。

label: SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Suramin is a potent inhibitor of many sirtuins like SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5. The majority of known sirtuin inhibitors exclusively inhibit SIRT1 and/or SIRT2, however some also inhibit SIRT3 and SIRT5 with reduced affinity. Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines, and Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53, with both inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2.
description_zh_TW: 蘇拉明（Suramin）是多種 sirtuins 的強效抑制劑，包括 SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT5。大多數已知的 sirtuin 抑制劑僅抑制 SIRT1 和/或 SIRT2，但也有部分抑制劑以較低親和力抑制 SIRT3 和 SIRT5。Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用，而 Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡，兩者均可抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。

label: non-methylated B12 alternative
description: Adenosylcobalamin is a non-methylated, non-methyl-donating form of vitamin B12, in contrast to methylcobalamin which directly supplies a methyl group to the methylation cycle via methionine synthase. Its primary biological role is as the cofactor for mitochondrial methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, which converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA for energy production. Because it bypasses direct methyl donation, it avoids contributing to the methyl load that can accumulate when COMT activity is genetically slow. It is therefore frequently recommended as a safer B12 source for slow COMT individuals who are sensitive to methylated vitamins and may react with anxiety, irritability, or insomnia.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的非甲基化、非甲基供給形式，與甲鈷胺相反，甲鈷胺透過蛋氨酸合成酶直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基。其主要生物學作用是作為線粒體甲基丙二酰輔酶A變位酶的輔因子，該酶將甲基丙二酰輔酶A轉化為琥珀酰輔酶A以產生能量。因為它繞過了直接的甲基捐贈，所以它避免了 COMT activity 基因緩慢時可能累積的甲基負荷。因此，經常建議將其作為對 methylated vitamins 敏感並可能出現焦慮、煩躁或失眠反應的緩慢 COMT 個體的更安全的 B12 來源。

label: active coenzyme form of B12
description: Adenosylcobalamin is one of two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12 (cobalamin), alongside methylcobalamin, serving as an essential cofactor for mitochondrial enzymes in the methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolic pathways. Unlike methylcobalamin, it does not donate a methyl group directly to the methylation cycle, so it does not contribute to the body's methyl burden. This distinction makes adenosylcobalamin particularly relevant for individuals with slow COMT activity, who may be sensitive to methyl-donating B12 forms.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12（鈷胺素）的兩種活性輔酶形式之一，與甲鈷胺一起，作為蛋氨酸和甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 代謝途徑中線粒體酶的重要輔助因子。與甲鈷胺不同，它不會直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基，因此不會增加人體的甲基負擔。這種區別使得腺苷鈷胺素對於 COMT activity 緩慢的個體特別重要，他們可能對甲基供體 B12 形式敏感。

label: mitochondrial health
description: Adenosylcobalamin supports mitochondrial health by acting as the required cofactor for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, an enzyme in the mitochondrial matrix that converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA within the citric acid cycle. Efficient function of this pathway sustains cellular energy (ATP) production and prevents accumulation of methylmalonic acid. Because mitochondrial dysfunction is linked to numerous age-related and neurological conditions, maintaining adequate adenosylcobalamin status is important for bioenergetic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 透過充當甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 變位酶所需的輔助因子來支持 mitochondrial health，甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 變位酶是線粒體基質中的一種酶，可在檸檬酸循環中將甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 轉化為琥珀酰輔酶 A。此途徑的有效功能可維持細胞能量 (ATP) 的產生並防止甲基丙二酸的累積。由於粒線體功能障礙與許多年齡相關和神經系統疾病有關，因此維持足夠的腺苷鈷胺狀態對於生物能穩態非常重要。

label: active folate form
description: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

label: anxiety in slow COMT
description: Methylfolate can cause anxiety in slow COMT individuals for the same reason it can cause irritability: it raises methyl donor availability that slow COMT genotypes clear and utilize less efficiently, potentially over-methylating mood-relevant pathways. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific, and may be compounded when combined with other methyl donors such as methylB12 or TMG. Clinicians often titrate methylfolate cautiously or choose non-methylated alternatives such as folinic acid in this group. Monitoring mood symptoms during supplementation is advised.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate 可能會導致 anxiety in slow COMT 個體，原因與它可能導致煩躁的原因相同：它提高了 methyl donor 的可用性，從而減緩了 COMT 基因型的清除並降低了效率，可能導致情緒相關通路過度甲基化。此作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性，並且與其他甲基供體（例如甲基B12 或TMG）聯合使用時可能會加劇。臨床醫生經常謹慎滴定甲基葉酸或選擇非甲基化替代品，例如該組中的亞葉酸。建議在補充期間監測情緒症狀。

label: methylation cycle component
description: Methylfolate is a critical component of the methylation cycle, providing the methyl group that methionine synthase transfers to homocysteine to form methionine, the precursor of SAMe. Its availability therefore gates the entire downstream methyl donor supply, including that consumed by COMT for catechol O-methylation. Deficiencies or polymorphisms affecting methylfolate generation constrain COMT activity and can elevate homocysteine. It is the primary folate species linking dietary intake to methylation capacity.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate 是 methylation cycle 的關鍵組件，提供甲基，蛋氨酸合成酶將甲基轉移至高半胱氨酸，形成蛋氨酸（SAMe 的前體）。因此，它的可用性控制了整個下游 methyl donor 的供應，包括 COMT 用於兒茶酚 O-甲基化的消耗。影響甲基葉酸生成的缺陷或多態性會限制 COMT activity 並可能升高同型半胱氨酸。它是將飲食攝取量與甲基化能力聯繫起來的主要 folate 物種。

label: dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT
description: Oleacein is a dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT: its phenolic structure is O-methylated by COMT as a substrate while simultaneously competing for the active site and for SAMe as an inhibitor, reducing clearance of other catechols. This bifunctional interaction means oleacein both feeds and partially blocks the COMT pathway, with the net effect depending on dose and on the individual's COMT genotype. It is a notable example of dietary polyphenols modulating catechol metabolism. Its olive oil source links diet to COMT-related biochemistry.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是 dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT：其酚類結構被 COMT 作為底物 O-甲基化，同時競爭活性位點和 SAMe 作為抑制劑，減少其他兒茶酚的清除。這種雙功能交互作用意味著油酸素既供給又部分阻斷 COMT 途徑，淨效應取決於劑量和個體的 COMT genotype。這是膳食多酚調節兒茶酚代謝的一個顯著例子。其橄欖油來源將飲食與 COMT 相關的生物化學聯繫起來。

label: extra virgin olive oil
description: Oleacein is a phenolic secoiridoid compound found in extra virgin olive oil, where it contributes to the oil's characteristic bitterness and health-promoting profile. As a dietary polyphenol it is metabolized in part by COMT, linking olive oil consumption to COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition. It exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that underlie part of the Mediterranean diet's cardiovascular benefits. Its presence makes olive oil a significant dietary source of COMT-interacting phenolics.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是一種在 extra virgin olive oil 中發現的酚類環烯醚萜化合物，它賦予了油特有的苦味和促進健康的特性。作為一種膳食多酚，它部分由 COMT 代謝，將橄欖油消耗與 COMT 依賴性多酚處置聯繫起來。它所含的抗氧化劑和 anti-inflammatory properties 是地中海飲食對心血管的部分益處的基礎。它的存在使得橄欖油成為 COMT 相互作用酚類物質的重要飲食來源。

label: Apoptosis in cancer cell lines
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Acute overexpression of SIRT6 in cancer cell lines of different histology induces apoptosis, supporting a tumor-suppressive role for this nuclear sirtuin. The pro-apoptotic activity appears linked to SIRT6's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function rather than its deacetylase activity. Directionally, increasing SIRT6 abundance or enzymatic activity triggers cell death in tumor cells. This contrasts with SIRT1's context-dependent duality and stresses that sirtuin outputs in cancer depend on the specific isoform and its dominant catalytic modality.
description_zh_TW: 在不同組織學類型的癌細胞系中急性過量表現 SIRT6 可誘導凋亡，支持此核 sirtuin 具有腫瘤抑制功能。此促凋亡活性似乎與 SIRT6 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能而非去乙醯酶活性相關。方向性上，增加 SIRT6 的豐度或酵素活性會在腫瘤細胞中觸發細胞死亡。這與 SIRT1 因情境而異的雙重性形成對比，強調 sirtuin 在癌症中的輸出取決於特定的同工型及其主要的催化模式。

label: apoptosis in tumor cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Compared to healthy cells, SIRT6 overexpression significantly accelerates apoptosis in tumour cells. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of tumour cell death, preferentially killing cancer cells while sparing healthy cells. This tumour-selective pro-apoptotic activity supports SIRT6 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy against cancers that retain SIRT6 expression.
description_zh_TW: 與健康細胞相比，SIRT6過表達顯著加速腫瘤細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於腫瘤細胞死亡的上游，優先殺傷癌細胞同時保護健康細胞。這種腫瘤選擇性的促凋亡活性支持SIRT6活化作為對抗保留SIRT6表達的癌症的潛在治療策略。

label: diet-induced obesity
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 overexpression protects mice from diet-induced obesity, with increased glucose tolerance and reduced fat accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過表達保護小鼠免受飲食誘導的肥胖，具有增加的葡萄糖耐受性和減少的脂肪積累。

label: TFEB expression
description: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

label: Chemokine
description: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
description_zh_TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

label: CCR6
description: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
description_zh_TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

label: Caspase-11
description: Caspase-11 (mouse) is the noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D, paralleling human caspase-4/5. It is activated by cytosolic LPS and drives SASP establishment in murine senescence models, and it is required for SASP-driven immune clearance of senescent hepatocytes in vivo. The relationship establishes the species-specific executor of the noncanonical pathway in mice. It is a well-supported component of senescence inflammasome biology, with genetic deficiency of the enzyme blunting IL-1alpha processing and downstream secretome output.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-11（小鼠）是切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 的非典型效應 caspase，平行於人類 caspase-4/5。它被胞質 LPS 活化並在小鼠衰老模型中驅動 SASP 建立，且為體內 SASP 驅動的衰老肝細胞免疫清除所需。其在小鼠中與 caspase-5 在人類中的功能對等，使非典型發炎體成為跨物種保守的衰老發炎機制。此切割產生活性 IL-1alpha 與 pyroptotic 孔洞。

label: Immune Complex
description: Inflammasomes are cytosolic supramolecular complexes of the innate immune system that assemble in response to pathogens or sterile danger signals to activate inflammatory caspases. They are not antibodies (immune complexes) but rather multiprotein scaffolds; the original classification here as an immune complex is loose, though inflammasomes are innate immune signaling platforms. They serve as a key intersection between senescence, DAMPs, and inflammation. Their activation links cellular damage to IL-1 family cytokine release.
description_zh_TW: 發炎體是先天免疫系統的胞質超分子複合體，組裝以回應病原體或無菌危險訊號，活化發炎性 caspase。它們不是抗體（免疫複合體）而是多重蛋白支架；此處歸類為免疫複合體鬆散，儘管發炎體是先天免疫訊號平台。它們作為衰老、DAMP 與發炎間的關鍵交會點。其活化將細胞損傷連結到 IL-1 家族細胞激素釋放。

label: MMP-3
description: Matrix metalloproteinase-3 (MMP-3) is a SASP protease associated with extracellular matrix degradation, tissue remodeling, and, in tumor contexts, cancer cell invasion and metastasis. Its secretion reflects the matrix-remodeling arm of the secretome that supports wound healing acutely but pathological tissue breakdown chronically, and MMP-3 can activate other MMPs in a cascade, amplifying remodeling. This protease component distinguishes the SASP from a purely cytokine profile and contributes to fibrosis and basement-membrane disruption in aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: 基質金屬蛋白酶-3（MMP-3）是一種與細胞外基質降解、組織重塑以及腫瘤脈絡中癌細胞侵襲和轉移相關的 SASP 蛋白酶。其分泌反映支持急性傷口癒合但慢性病理性組織崩解的基質重塑臂，且 MMP-3 可在級聯中活化其他 MMP，放大重塑。此蛋白酶組成將 SASP 與純細胞激素輪廓區分，並貢獻老化組織中的纖維化與基底膜破壞。

label: Biological Process
description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

label: METTL3/METTL14
description: The METTL3-METTL14 m6A methyltransferase complex promotes SASP factor expression by installing N6-methyladenosine marks on mRNA that facilitate enhancer-promoter looping and stabilize SASP transcripts. This epitranscriptomic layer adds post-transcriptional control to the secretome, coordinating the sustained expression of multiple SASP genes. The relationship is mechanistically plausible and supported by knockout studies showing reduced SASP, but the field is newer and less consolidated than the NF-kB/mTOR axes, so confidence is moderate.
description_zh_TW: METTL3-METTL14 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體透過在 mRNA 上安裝 N6-甲基腺苷標記，促進 SASP 因子表現，該標記促進增強子—啟動子環化並穩定 SASP 轉錄本。此表觀轉錄層次為分泌組添加轉錄後控制，協調多種 SASP 基因的持續表現。此關係在機制上合理且獲剔除研究（顯示 SASP 降低）支持，但此領域較新、較不如 NF-κB/mTOR 軸整合，故信度中等。

label: Secretory Phenotype
description: The SASP is a hypersecretory state -- a specialized secretory phenotype -- in which senescent cells upregulate and release hundreds of factors including interleukins, chemokines, growth factors, proteases, and extracellular vesicles. This secreted output contrasts with the quiescent, low-turnover secretome of non-senescent cells and is a defining non-cell-autonomous feature of the senescent state. The composition of the SASP is variable, shaped by the senescence inducer, cell type, and tissue context. Its classification as a secretory phenotype emphasizes that senescence exerts its effects largely through communication with the microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: SASP 是一種高分泌狀態——一種特化的分泌表型——衰老細胞在此狀態下上調並釋放數百種因子，包括介白素、趨化因子、生長因子、蛋白酶與細胞外囊泡。此分泌輸出與非衰老細胞靜止、低更新的分泌組形成對比，是衰老狀態定義性的非細胞自主性特徵。SASP 的組成是可變的，受衰老誘發因子、細胞類型與組織脈絡塑造。將其歸類為分泌表型，強調衰老主要透過與微環境的溝通發揮作用。

label: LPS
description: The hexa-acylated lipid A of LPS binds directly to the CARD domain of caspase-4/5/11, inducing their dimerization and activation, the defining trigger of the noncanonical inflammasome. While classically microbial, this mechanism can be engaged in senescence-associated inflammatory contexts. The relationship is the canonical activation mode of the pathway and links Gram-negative sensing to caspase activation. Because the caspases themselves are the sensors, no upstream receptor is required for this pathway.
description_zh_TW: LPS 的六醯化 lipid A 直接結合 caspase-4/5/11 的 CARD 域，誘發其雙聚化與活化，是非典型發炎體的定義性觸發因子。雖典型為微生物性，此機制可在衰老相關發炎脈絡中被啟動。此關係將微生物產物感知連結到內源性發炎，且若胞質 LPS 或 LPS 樣配體在衰老中出現，可能貢獻非典型發炎體活化。它是該途徑的確立啟動機制。

label: N6-methyladenosine
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: METTL3 is the catalytic subunit of the methyltransferase complex that deposits N6-methyladenosine (m6A), the most abundant internal modification of messenger RNA in mammalian cells. Together with the adaptor protein METTL14, METTL3 methylates the N6 position of adenosine in mRNA, and the resulting m6A mark regulates RNA stability, splicing, translation, and export. Beyond its RNA-methylation role, the METTL3-METTL14 complex also facilitates senescence-associated enhancer-promoter contacts and SASP expression in oncogene-induced senescence.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是甲基轉移酶複合物的催化亞基，可沉積 N6-methyladenosine (m6A)，N6-methyladenosine (m6A) 是哺乳動物細胞中最豐富的信使 RNA 內部修飾。 METTL3 與接頭蛋白 METTL14 一起甲基化 mRNA 中腺苷的 N6 位點，產生的 m6A 標記可調節 RNA 穩定性、剪接、翻譯和輸出。除了其 RNA 甲基化作用外，METTL3-METTL14 複合物還促進衰老相關的增強子-啟動子接觸以及癌基因誘導衰老中的 SASP 表達。

label: H2A.J
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: The histone variant H2A.J is enriched at the promoters of SASP genes, where it facilitates changes in chromatin accessibility that induce SASP expression. H2A.J accumulates in human senescent fibroblasts, in aged human skin, and in mouse tissues, particularly in response to persistent DNA damage. This DNA damage-associated incorporation of H2A.J at inflammatory gene loci links the DNA damage response to the activation of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. This enrichment distinguishes H2A.J from canonical histones and marks the switch toward inflammatory gene expression in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: 組蛋白變異體 H2A.J 在 SASP 基因的啟動子處富集，它促進染色質可及性的變化，從而誘導 SASP 表達。 H2A.J 在人類老化成纖維細胞、衰老人類皮膚和小鼠組織中積累，特別是在對持續 DNA 損傷的反應中。這種與 DNA 損傷相關的 H2A.J 在發炎基因位點的摻入將 DNA 損傷反應與老化相關分泌表型的活化聯繫起來。這種富集將 H2A.J 與典型組蛋白區分開來，並標誌著衰老細胞中向發炎 gene expression 的轉變。

label: Acetate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetate is converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2 and is not membrane-permeable acetyl-CoA itself. Acetate supplementation increases global nuclear acetylation including H3K27ac and induces expression of pro-inflammatory genes including IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators p16 and p21. In mitochondria-depleted senescent cells, acetate increases histone acetylation and partially restores a subset of the mitochondrial-dependent SASP programme. However, acetate-induced SASP gene expression is suppressed by the STING inhibitor SN011, showing that chromatin accessibility alone cannot drive SASP transcription without innate immune activation.
description_zh_TW: 乙酸（acetate）在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA），其本身並非可通透細胞膜的乙醯輔酶A。補充乙酸可增加整體細胞核乙醯化（包括 H3K27ac），並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因的表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子 p16 與 p21。在缺乏粒線體的衰老細胞中，乙酸可增加組蛋白乙醯化，並部分恢復依賴粒線體的 SASP 程序中的一部分。然而，乙酸誘導的 SASP 基因表現會被 STING 抑制劑 SN011 所壓制，顯示若無先天免疫活化，僅靠染色質可及性無法驅動 SASP 轉錄。

label: Super-enhancer
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Many SASP-associated genes are linked to super-enhancer-like regions that are particularly sensitive to changes in histone acetylation, and such loci probably require sustained acetyl-CoA availability to maintain high transcriptional output, rendering them especially vulnerable to interventions that limit acetyl-CoA supply. SLC25A1 inhibition reduces chromatin accessibility at these SASP loci both in vitro and in vivo, selectively suppressing inflammatory gene expression. This positions mitochondrial metabolism as an upstream determinant of chromatin accessibility in senescent cells, aligning with previous reports linking citrate metabolism to SASP regulation.
description_zh_TW: 許多與SASP相關的基因與超增強子樣區域相關，這些區域對組蛋白乙酰化變化特別敏感，並且這些位點可能需要持續的乙酰輔酶A可用性來維持高轉錄輸出，使其特別容易受到限制乙酰輔酶A供應的干預措施的影響。SLC25A1抑製在體外和體內都減少了這些SASP位點的染色質可及性，選擇性地抑制炎症基因表達。這將線粒體代謝定位為衰老細胞中染色質可及性的上游決定因素，與先前將枸櫞酸代謝與SASP調節相關聯的報告一致。

label: Apoptotic and autophagic cell death (MCF-7)
description: In MCF-7 breast cancer cells, sirtinol triggers both apoptotic and autophagic programmed cell death, reflecting disrupted survival homeostasis. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of dual cell-death activation. This is attributed to SIRT1/2 inhibition removing anti-apoptotic deacetylation, and it illustrates the pleiotropic anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers. The simultaneous engagement of apoptosis and autophagy suggests that sirtuin inhibition disrupts multiple survival pathways in cancer cells. This dual death response makes sirtinol an informative tool for studying how sirtuins support cancer-cell survival.
description_zh_TW: 在 MCF-7 乳腺癌細胞中，sirtinol 觸發凋亡和自噬兩種程序性細胞死亡，反映了存活恆定性的破壞。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於雙重細胞死亡活化的上游。這歸因於 SIRT1/2 抑制移除了抗凋亡去乙醯化，並闡明了 sirtuin 阻斷劑的多效性抗癌潛力。凋亡和自噬的同時啟動表明 sirtuin 抑制破壞了癌細胞中的多條存活途徑。這種雙重死亡反應使 sirtinol 成為研究 sirtuin 如何支持癌細胞存活的有資訊價值的工具。

label: Senescence-like growth arrest
description: Sirtinol induces senescence-like growth arrest in human lung cancer H1299 cells, consistent with sirtuin inhibition engaging tumor-suppressive programs. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of growth arrest. This phenotype mirrors aspects of SIRT1 loss and suggests that sirtuin blockers can blunt proliferation. The senescence-like arrest likely reflects reactivation of p53 and other tumor suppressors that sirtuins normally restrain. By demonstrating that sirtuin inhibition can induce growth arrest, sirtinol provided early evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers.
description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 在人類肺癌 H1299 細胞中誘導衰老樣生長停滯，與 sirtuin 抑制啟動腫瘤抑制程式一致。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於生長停滯的上游。此表型反映了 SIRT1 缺失的某些方面，表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可以削弱增殖。衰老樣停滯可能反映了 p53 和其他 sirtuin 通常抑制的腫瘤抑制因子的重新活化。透過證明 sirtuin 抑制可以誘導生長停滯，Sirtinol 為 sirtuin 阻斷劑的抗癌潛力提供了早期證據。

label: Breast, lung, prostate and leukemia cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Sirtinol, a hydroxynaphthaldehyde derivative discovered in a phenotypic screen, is active against multiple sirtuin isoforms and has cytotoxic activity against cancer cells of different origins, including breast, lung, prostate, and leukemia cell lines. This broad anticancer activity made sirtinol the founding member of the beta-naphthol inhibitor family and seeded structure-activity programs that produced salermide, cambinol, and splitomicin. Directionally, sirtinol-mediated inhibition of sirtuin activity sits upstream of its cytotoxic effects on malignant cells, though its full target spectrum extends beyond sirtuins.
description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 是一種在表型篩選中發現的羥基萘醛衍生物，對多種 sirtuin 同工型具有活性，並對不同來源的癌細胞具有細胞毒活性，包括乳腺癌、肺癌、前列腺癌和白血病細胞系。這種廣泛的抗癌活性使 Sirtinol 成為 β-萘酚抑制劑家族的創始成員，並啟動了產生 salermide、cambinol 和 splitomicin 的構效關係研究。方向性上 Sirtinol 介導的 sirtuin 活性抑制位於其對惡性細胞細胞毒作用的上游，儘管其完整的作用靶標範圍超越了 sirtuin。

label: N-Formylkynurenine
description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

label: cardiovascular disease in slow COMT
description: Aspirin is effective in preventing cardiovascular disease among individuals with the slow COMT (Met/Met, A/A) genotype, where its antiplatelet and anti-inflammatory actions translate into net cardiovascular protection. Slow COMT activity appears to create a metabolic milieu, involving higher catecholamine tone and distinct folate handling, in which low-dose aspirin reduces thrombotic event risk. This protective association is the inverse of the effect seen in fast COMT individuals, who may experience increased risk or no benefit. The divergence highlights a clear pharmacogenetic pattern and supports genotype-aware approaches to aspirin prophylaxis.
description_zh_TW: Aspirin 可有效預防 COMT（Met/Met，A/A）慢基因型個體的心血管疾病，其抗血小板和抗發炎作用轉化為淨心血管保護。緩慢的 COMT activity 似乎會創造一個代謝環境，涉及更高的兒茶酚胺張力和獨特的 folate 處理，其中低劑量阿斯匹靈可降低血栓事件風險。這種保護性關聯與快速 COMT 個體中觀察到的效果相反，後者可能會經歷風險增加或沒有益處。這種差異凸顯了明確的藥物遺傳學模式，並支持基因型感知的阿斯匹靈預防方法。

label: fast COMT genotype
description: Aspirin may increase cardiovascular disease risk in individuals with the fast COMT (Val/Val, G/G) genotype, reflecting a gene-drug interaction in which rapid COMT-mediated catecholamine clearance changes the vascular response to aspirin. Population studies and prospective cohorts have reported that the cardioprotective benefit of aspirin is absent or reversed in fast metabolizers, whereas slow COMT individuals derive protection. The proposed mechanisms involve genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that alter platelet, endothelial, and redox homeostasis. This directionality makes COMT status a candidate biomarker for personalizing aspirin therapy.
description_zh_TW: Aspirin可能會增加具有快速COMT（Val/Val，G/G）基因型個體的心血管疾病風險，反映了基因-藥物交互作用，其中快速COMT介導的兒茶酚胺清除改變了血管對阿斯匹靈的反應。人群研究和前瞻性隊列報告稱，阿斯匹靈的心臟保護作用在快速代謝者中不存在或逆轉，而慢速 COMT 個體則獲得保護。所提出的機制涉及兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了血小板、內皮和氧化還原穩態。這種方向性使 COMT 狀態成為個人化阿斯匹靈治療的候選生物標記。

label: CVD in fast COMT
description: Aspirin may increase cardiovascular disease risk specifically in individuals carrying the fast COMT (Val/Val, G/G) genotype, a pharmacogenetic interaction identified in prospective studies. The mechanism is thought to involve genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that alter aspirin's effects on vascular homeostasis. This contrasts sharply with slow COMT individuals, in whom aspirin is protective, underscoring the importance of COMT genotyping in cardiovascular prevention strategies.
description_zh_TW: Aspirin 可能會增加心血管疾病的風險，特別是在攜帶快速 COMT（Val/Val，G/G）基因型的個體中，這是前瞻性研究中發現的一種藥物遺傳學交互作用。此機制被認為涉及兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，從而改變阿斯匹靈對血管穩態的影響。這與緩慢的 COMT 個體形成鮮明對比，阿斯匹靈對這些個體具有保護作用，並強調了 COMT 基因分型在心血管預防策略中的重要性。

label: Cancer cells to chemotherapy
description: Cambinol combination with chemotherapeutic agents dramatically sensitizes cancer cells to chemotherapy-induced apoptosis. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of enhanced chemosensitivity. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, it removes survival signals that protect tumor cells from drug-induced death, and this supports sirtuin inhibition as a chemosensitization strategy. The effect is particularly relevant in p53-wild-type tumors, where sirtuin inhibition reactivates p53-dependent apoptosis. Combination regimens of sirtuin inhibitors with conventional chemotherapy are therefore of significant clinical interest.
description_zh_TW: Cambinol 與化療藥物的組合顯著增敏癌細胞對化療誘導的凋亡。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於增強化療敏感性的上游。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，它移除保護腫瘤細胞免於藥物誘導死亡的存活訊號，支持 sirtuin 抑制作為化療增敏策略。此效應在 p53 野生型腫瘤中特別相關，因為 sirtuin 抑制可重新活化 p53 依賴性凋亡。因此 sirtuin 抑制劑與常規化療的組合方案具有重要的臨床意義。

label: Burkitt lymphoma cell lines
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines. Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53. Both Cambinol and Salermide have inhibitory effects on SIRT1 and SIRT2. Directionally, these sirtuin-inhibiting compounds sit upstream of suppressed cancer cell growth, with Cambinol showing particular potency against Burkitt lymphoma among the STIC class of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用。Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡。Cambinol 和 Salermide 均對 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 具有抑制作用。從作用方向而言，這些 sirtuin 抑制化合物位於抑制癌細胞生長的上游，其中 Cambinol 在 STIC 類 sirtuin 抑制劑中對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤表現出特別的效力。

label: Cancer cell migration and invasion
description: In hepatocellular and lung cancer cells, Cambinol impairs migration and invasion in a dose-dependent manner, consistent with sirtuin inhibition reducing metastatic behaviors. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of suppressed motility. This suggests sirtuin blockers may limit metastasis, complementing Cambinol's chemotherapy-sensitizing effects.
