By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, Cambinol disrupts the survival and migration programs that cancer cells depend on. The anti-migratory effect adds a metastatic dimension to the anticancer profile of sirtuin inhibitors, supporting their evaluation as anti-metastatic agents.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞癌和肺癌細胞中，Cambinol 以劑量依賴方式損害遷移和侵襲，與 sirtuin 抑制減少轉移行為一致。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於抑制運動性的上游。這表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可能限制轉移，與 Cambinol 的化療增敏效應互補。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，Cambinol 破壞癌細胞依賴的存活和遷移程式。抗遷移效應為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌特徵增添了轉移維度，支持其作為抗轉移藥物的評估。

label: Cancer cell lines (MOLT4, MDA-MB-231, RKO)
description: Salermide induces robust apoptosis in leukemia (MOLT4), breast (MDA-MB-231), and colon (RKO) cancer cells, validating broad antitumor activity. Directionally, Salermide treatment sits upstream of cancer-cell death. This is consistent with SIRT1/2 inhibition removing survival signaling, and it supports sirtuin blockers as anticancer agents. The activity across diverse cancer cell lines indicates that SIRT1/2 inhibition engages a general pro-apoptotic program rather than a tumor-type-specific mechanism. These results provided key evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 在白血病（MOLT4）、乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）和結腸癌（RKO）細胞中誘導顯著凋亡，驗證了廣泛的抗腫瘤活性。在方向性上，Salermide 治療位於癌細胞死亡的上游。這與 SIRT1/2 抑制移除存活訊號一致，支持 sirtuin 阻斷劑作為抗癌藥物。在多種癌細胞系中的活性表明 SIRT1/2 抑制啟動的是一般性的促凋亡程式而非腫瘤類型特異性的機制。這些結果為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌潛力提供了關鍵證據。

label: Proapoptotic genes (via H4K16ac)
description: Salermide inhibits SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of H4K16, leading to epigenetic reactivation of proapoptotic genes aberrantly repressed in cancer cells. Directionally, Salermide promotes H4K16 hyperacetylation, which drives apoptosis gene expression. This removes a chromatin-based survival brake and is a mechanistic rationale for sirtuin-inhibitor cancer therapy. By restoring H4K16ac at the promoters of pro-apoptotic genes, Salermide reverses the epigenetic silencing imposed by SIRT1. This illustrates how sirtuin inhibitors can act as epigenetic modulators to restore tumor-suppressive transcription.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 抑制 SIRT1 介導的 H4K16 去乙醯化，導致在癌細胞中異常被抑制的促凋亡基因的表觀遺傳重新活化。在方向性上，Salermide 促進 H4K16 超乙醯化，驅動凋亡基因表達。這移除了基於染色質的存活制動器，是 sirtuin 抑制劑癌症治療的機制性理由。透過在促凋亡基因啟動子上恢復 H4K16ac，Salermide 逆轉了 SIRT1 施加的表觀遺傳沉默。這說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑如何作為表觀遺傳調節因子來恢復腫瘤抑制性轉錄。

label: Colorectal cancer stem cells
description: Salermide inhibits colorectal carcinoma cancer-stem-cell self-renewal and reduces tumorigenesis, targeting the resilient stem-cell fraction. Directionally, Salermide sits upstream of stem-cell suppression. This is important because cancer stem cells drive relapse and resistance, and extending sirtuin-inhibitor effects to the tumor-initiation compartment has therapeutic significance. By suppressing self-renewal, Salermide reduces the population of cells capable of regenerating tumors. These findings suggest that sirtuin inhibitors may be effective against the most refractory cancer cell populations.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 抑制結腸直腸癌癌幹細胞的自我更新並減少腫瘤發生，靶向頑固的幹細胞群體。在方向性上，Salermide 位於抑制幹細胞的上游。這很重要，因為癌幹細胞驅動復發和抗藥性，將 sirtuin 抑制劑的效應延伸到腫瘤起始區室具有治療意義。透過抑制自我更新，Salermide 減少能夠再生腫瘤的細胞群。這些發現表明 sirtuin 抑制劑可能對最頑固的癌細胞群體有效。

label: Lipid profile (raises HDL, reduces LDL oxidation)
description: The Mediterranean Diet raises HDL while reducing LDL oxidation through its polyphenol-rich components, improving the overall lipid profile. Directionally, the diet sits upstream of favorable lipid changes. This contributes to its cardiovascular protection, and resveratrol and other polyphenols are putative SIRT1-engaging contributors. By combining healthy fats with antioxidant polyphenols, the diet improves both the quantity and quality of circulating lipoproteins. These lipid effects are part of the broader cardiovascular benefit demonstrated in clinical trials of the Mediterranean diet.
description_zh_TW: 地中海飲食透過其富含多酚的成分提高 HDL 同時減少 LDL 氧化，改善整體血脂特徵。在方向性上，飲食位於有利脂質變化的上游。這有助於其心血管保護作用，resveratrol 和其他多酚是假定的 SIRT1 介入貢獻者。透過結合健康脂肪和抗氧化多酚，飲食同時改善了循環脂蛋白的數量和品質。這些脂質效應是地中海飲食臨床試驗中展示的更廣泛心血管益處的一部分。

label: SIRT1 (via resveratrol)
description: The Mediterranean Diet's resveratrol content is proposed to activate SIRT1, linking the dietary pattern to longevity pathways. Directionally, diet-derived resveratrol sits upstream of SIRT1 activation. This is one of several polyphenol-mediated mechanisms of the diet, though human causality is inferential rather than proven. The Mediterranean Diet also provides other polyphenols and healthy fats that may act through SIRT1 and AMPK. This dietary association has motivated research into how whole-food polyphenol patterns, rather than isolated compounds, influence sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 地中海飲食中的 resveratrol 含量被提出可以活化 SIRT1，將飲食模式與長壽途徑聯繫起來。在方向性上，飲食來源的 resveratrol 位於 SIRT1 活化的上游。這是該飲食的多種多酚介導機制之一，但人體因果關係是推斷性的而非已證實的。地中海飲食還提供其他多酚和健康脂肪，可能透過 SIRT1 和 AMPK 發揮作用。此飲食關聯推動了全食物多酚模式（而非單獨化合物）如何影響 sirtuin 生物學的研究。

label: Cardiovascular Disease risk
description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

label: TLR2/6
description: CD36 receptor acts as a co-receptor for TLR2/6, enabling recognition of oxidized LDL, amyloid-beta, and microbial products to trigger sterile and innate inflammatory signaling. This bridges lipid sensing to innate immunity. The directionality is co-receptor to inflammasome and NF-kappaB activation. A caveat is that CD36 is not the sole TLR2/6 partner, and its contribution varies by ligand and cell type. This cooperation allows CD36 to bridge lipid sensing and innate immunity, promoting inflammatory responses to oxidized self-ligands.
description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 作為 TLR2/6 的共同受體，能夠辨識 oxidized LDL、β 澱粉樣蛋白和微生物產物，從而觸發無菌和先天發炎訊號傳導。這將脂質感測與先天免疫聯繫起來。方向性是發炎小體和 NF-κB 活化的共同受體。需要注意的是，CD36 並不是唯一的 TLR2/6 夥伴，其貢獻因配體和細胞類型而異。這種合作使得 CD36 能夠橋接脂質感應和先天免疫，促進對氧化自身配體的發炎反應。

label: Thrombospondin-1
description: CD36 receptor binds thrombospondin-1, and this interaction activates Fyn kinase and p38 MAPK signaling that influences cell adhesion, survival, and inflammation. Thrombospondin-1 thus acts as a CD36 ligand that shapes macrophage behavior. The directionality is ligand binding to intracellular signaling. A caveat is that thrombospondin-1 has many other receptors (e.g., integrins, CD47), so CD36 is one node in a broader network. This signaling can influence macrophage phagocytosis, angiogenesis, and platelet function, expanding CD36's role beyond lipid uptake.
description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 結合 thrombospondin-1，此交互作用會活化 Fyn 激酶和 p38 MAPK 訊號傳導，進而影響細胞黏附、存活和發炎。因此，Thrombospondin-1 作為塑造巨噬細胞行為的 CD36 配體。方向性是配體與細胞內訊號傳導的結合。需要注意的是，thrombospondin-1 有許多其他受體（例如整合素、CD47），因此 CD36 是更廣泛網路中的節點。這種訊號傳導可以影響巨噬細胞的吞噬作用、血管生成和血小板功能，從而將 CD36 的作用擴展到脂質攝取之外。

label: Oxidized LDL
description: CD36 receptor mediates uptake of oxidized LDL as the principal scavenger receptor on macrophages, delivering oxLDL-derived lipid to form foam cells. This non-downregulated pathway drives cholesterol accumulation in the artery wall. The directionality is receptor to pathological lipid internalization. A caveat is that CD36 also handles fatty acids and other ligands, and other scavenger receptors (SR-A, LOX-1) contribute to oxLDL uptake. CD36 also recognizes oxidized phospholipids on oxLDL and, in combination with TLR signaling, links lipid uptake to sterile inflammation.
description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 介導 oxidized LDL 作為巨噬細胞上主要清道夫受體的攝取，遞送 oxLDL 衍生的脂質以形成泡沫細胞。這種非下調途徑驅動 cholesterol 在動脈壁積聚。方向性是病理性脂質內化的受體。需要注意的是，CD36 也處理脂肪酸和其他配體，而其他清道夫受體（SR-A、LOX-1）有助於 oxLDL 的攝取。 CD36 也能辨識 oxLDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，並與 TLR 訊號傳導結合，將脂質攝取與無菌發炎聯繫起來。

label: Damaged peroxisomes
description: Selective autophagy targets damaged peroxisomes for degradation through a process termed pexophagy, in which ubiquitin tagging of peroxisomal proteins and recruitment of ESCRT (endosomal sorting complex required for transport) machinery mark the organelle for autophagic engulfment. This cargo-specific pathway contrasts with bulk autophagy by requiring receptor proteins that bridge the peroxisome to the autophagosomal membrane. Pexophagy protects cells from the oxidative and metabolic damage caused by defective peroxisomes. Its failure leads to accumulation of aberrant organelles and disease.
description_zh_TW: 選擇性自噬透過稱為 pexophagy 的過程，標靶受損過氧化體進行降解，其中過氧化體蛋白的泛素標記和 ESCRT（運輸所需內體分選複合物）機制的招募，將該胞器標定為自噬吞噬。此貨物特異性途徑不同於整體自噬之處，在於它需要受體蛋白將過氧化體橋接到自噬體膜。Pexophagy 保護細胞免於缺陷過氧化體造成的氧化和代謝損傷。其失敗導致異常胞器與疾病的累積。

label: Very Long Chain Fatty Acids
description: Peroxisomes are the primary site where very long chain fatty acids are shortened into shorter-chain products such as acetyl-CoA that can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation. Impaired peroxisomal beta-oxidation causes toxic VLCFA accumulation, the hallmark of Zellweger syndrome and adrenoleukodystrophy.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome 是極長鏈脂肪酸進行縮短代謝的主要場所，產物如 acetyl-CoA 可進入粒線體完成氧化。過氧化物體 beta-oxidation 功能受損會導致有毒的 VLCFA 累積，這是 Zellweger syndrome 與 adrenoleukodystrophy 的標誌性特徵。

label: premature ageing
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: Global SIRT7 depletion contributes to premature ageing, especially in the backbone, white adipose tissue, and the heart.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 的全身性缺乏促成早衰，尤其是在脊柱、白色脂肪組織和心臟中。

label: DNA repair and chromatin compaction
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 depletion decreases DNA repair and compaction of chromatin, rendering cells more susceptible to genotoxic stressors. SIRT7 is a histone desuccinylase that functionally links to chromatin compaction and genome stability. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of reduced genomic stability and increased sensitivity to DNA damage, making SIRT7 important for protecting cells against genotoxic stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7耗竭降低DNA修復和染色質壓縮，使細胞更容易受到基因毒性壓力源的影響。SIRT7是一種組蛋白去琥珀醯化酶，在功能上與染色質壓縮和基因組穩定性相關。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於基因組穩定性降低和DNA損傷敏感性增加的上游，使SIRT7對保護細胞免受基因毒性壓力至關重要。

label: p38/MAPK signaling activation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT7 depletion inhibits tumor growth by activating p38/MAPK signaling in breast cancer. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of p38/MAPK pathway activation, which suppresses tumor-cell expansion. Because SIRT7 normally restrains this growth-limiting signaling, its depletion unleashes p38/MAPK activity and curbs tumor growth. This positions SIRT7 as a tumor-promoting factor in breast cancer and identifies the p38/MAPK pathway as a downstream mediator.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7耗竭透過活化p38/MAPK訊號通路在乳腺癌中抑制腫瘤生長。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於p38/MAPK通路活化的上游，後者抑制腫瘤細胞擴增。因為SIRT7通常限制此生長限制性訊號，其耗竭釋放p38/MAPK活性並抑制腫瘤生長。這將SIRT7定位為乳腺癌中的促腫瘤因子，並將p38/MAPK通路確定為下游介導因子。

label: Potassium ferricyanide
description: Adrenochrome has been commercially prepared by oxidizing adrenaline or its salts with potassium ferricyanide in an aqueous medium. This process is uneconomical because of the large quantities of potassium ferricyanide needed, the ensuing effluent disposal problems, and variability in product quality. The patent presents a bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process as a superior alternative that precludes these problems and yields less-colored carbazochrome and adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine products.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅的商業製備一直是於水相介質中以鐵氰化鉀氧化腎上腺素或其鹽類。此製程不具經濟效益，因為需要大量鐵氰化鉀、隨之產生廢液處理問題，且產品品質不穩定。該專利提出一種鉍催化過硫酸鹽製程作為更優的替代方案，可避免這些問題，並產生色澤較淺的carbazochrome和腎上腺紅單胺基胍產物。

label: Ammonium Persulfate
description: Ammonium persulfate is one of the suitable persulfate oxidizing agents for converting adrenaline into adrenochrome, together with potassium persulfate and sodium persulfate. Sodium and ammonium persulfates are preferred over potassium persulfate for their good solubility in water. In the examples, ammonium persulfate (about 0.42 mole) is used with a sodium hydrogencarbonate buffer and a bismuth salt catalyst at 0 to 5 degrees C to produce adrenochrome in maximum yield within about 30 to 45 minutes.
description_zh_TW: 過硫酸銨是將腎上腺素轉化為腎上腺紅的適用過硫酸鹽氧化劑之一，與過硫酸鉀和過硫酸鈉並用。過硫酸鈉和過硫酸銨因在水中溶解度良好而優於過硫酸鉀。在實施例中，過硫酸銨（約0.42莫耳）與碳酸氫鈉緩衝液及鉍鹽催化劑在0至5°C下使用，於約30至45分鐘內以最大產率生產腎上腺紅。

label: Peroxisomes
description: Catalase is localized predominantly in peroxisomes, organelles that host numerous H2O2-generating oxidases involved in lipid beta-oxidation and purine catabolism. Concentrating catalase here minimizes leakage of peroxide into the cytosol and nucleus. The directionality reflects compartmentalization of both source and sink of H2O2. A caveat is that a minority of catalase activity also exists in cytosol and mitochondria in some tissues, providing additional but lesser protection. This compartmentalization is functionally important: peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids generates substantial H2O2, and catalase prevents that peroxide from spilling into the cytosol.
description_zh_TW: Catalase 主要位於 peroxisomes 細胞器中，該細胞器含有大量參與脂質 β 氧化和嘌呤分解代謝的產生 H2O2 的氧化酶。在此濃縮 catalase 可最大程度地減少過氧化物洩漏到細胞質和細胞核。方向性反映了 H2O2 源和彙的劃分。需要注意的是，少數 catalase 活性也存在於某些組織的細胞質和 mitochondria 中，提供額外但較少的保護。這種區室化在功能上很重要：極長鏈脂肪酸的過氧化物酶體 β 氧化會產生大量 H2O2，而 catalase 可以防止過氧化物溢出到細胞質中。

label: Chromaffin cells
description: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome. This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants. Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues.
description_zh_TW: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome。This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants。Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues。

label: Schiff base
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: During the second phase of the Maillard reaction, the initially reversible Schiff base undergoes a chemical rearrangement over a period of days to form Amadori products, also known as early glycation products. Amadori products are more stable than the Schiff base but the reaction remains reversible; hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized Amadori product and serves as an indicator of blood glucose management. If Amadori products accumulate, they undergo further oxidations, reductions, and hydrations over weeks or months to form irreversibly crosslinked proteins and ultimately advanced glycation end products.
description_zh_TW: 在Maillard reaction的second phase，最初reversible的Schiff base在days期間undergoes a chemical rearrangement，形成Amadori products，亦稱early glycation products。Amadori products比Schiff base更stable但reaction remains reversible；hemoglobin A1c是最widely recognized Amadori product，並serves as an indicator of blood glucose management。若Amadori products accumulate，它們會在weeks或months內undergo further oxidations、reductions與hydrations，形成irreversibly crosslinked proteins，ultimately advanced glycation end products。

label: EDTA
description: EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) is a chelating agent that binds transition metal ions such as iron and copper, making them inert and drastically slowing the autoxidation of epinephrine. Because these metals catalyze electron transfer from the catechol ring to oxygen, their removal suppresses the formation of the o-quinone intermediate that leads to adrenochrome. The strategy of metal chelation is therefore a key chemical defense against the oxidative conversion of adrenaline into its reactive oxidation product. EDTA exemplifies the broader class of chelating agents used to stabilize catecholamines in pharmaceutical and analytical settings, and it highlights the general principle that transition metal availability controls the rate at which the adrenochrome pathway can proceed in solution.
description_zh_TW: EDTA（乙二胺四乙酸）是一種螯合劑，可結合鐵、銅等過渡金屬離子，使其失去活性並大幅減緩 epinephrine 的自氧化。由於這些金屬催化電子從兒茶酚環轉移至氧氣，移除它們會抑制導致 adrenochrome 的鄰苯醌中間體的形成。因此，金屬螯合策略是對抗 adrenaline 氧化轉化為其反應性氧化產物的一項關鍵化學防線。EDTA 是藥用與分析環境中用於穩定兒茶酚胺的更廣泛螯合劑類的典型代表，並凸顯了過渡金屬可得性控制 adrenochrome 途徑在溶液中進行的速率這一普遍原則。

label: Acidic pH
description: Epinephrine is most stable in an acidic environment, which is why pharmaceutical adrenaline used in emergency injectors is stored in slightly acidic solution. In acidic solutions the hydroxyl groups on the catechol ring are protonated, making it much harder for oxygen to steal electrons and thereby greatly slowing the oxidation that initiates the adrenochrome pathway. pH is described as the most important factor controlling the cyclization reaction because the reaction depends on chemical oxidation and is highly sensitive to environment. This pH dependence explains both the formulation chemistry of epinephrine products and the broader principle that tissue acid-base status may modulate how readily catecholamines undergo oxidative transformation in vivo, with more alkaline conditions favoring oxidation to quinones and downstream adrenochrome formation.
description_zh_TW: Epinephrine 在酸性環境中最為穩定，這也是為什麼急救注射器中使用的藥用 adrenaline 儲存於微酸性溶液中。在酸性溶液中，兒茶酚環上的羥基被質子化，使氧氣更難奪取電子，從而大幅減緩啟動 adrenochrome 途徑的氧化。pH 值被描述為控制環化反應最重要的因素，因為反應依賴化學氧化且對環境高度敏感。這種 pH 依賴性同時解釋了 epinephrine 產品的配方化學，以及更廣泛的原則：組織酸鹼狀態可能調節兒茶酚胺在體內發生氧化轉化的容易程度，鹼性越強的條件越有利於氧化成醌及下游 adrenochrome 的形成。

label: Selenium
description: Glutathione peroxidase requires selenium in the form of a catalytic selenocysteine residue at its active site, which is essential for the redox chemistry of peroxide reduction. Dietary selenium deficiency lowers GPx activity and leaves cells more vulnerable to oxidative injury. The directionality is nutrient to enzyme function. A caveat is that excess selenium is toxic and does not further increase activity, so there is a narrow optimal range for antioxidant benefit. Selenocysteine is incorporated into GPx during translation at a recoded UGA codon, and selenium status tracks circulating GPx activity closely, making the enzyme a sensitive functional marker of selenium nutrition.
description_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 需要 selenium 在其活性位點以催化硒半胱氨酸殘基的形式存在，這對於過氧化物還原的氧化還原化學至關重要。飲食中的 selenium deficiency 會降低 GPx 活性，使細胞更容易受到氧化損傷。方向性是營養物質對酵素功能的影響。需要注意的是，過量的 selenium 是有毒的，並且不會進一步增加活性，因此抗氧化功效的最佳範圍很窄。硒代半胱氨酸在翻譯過程中在重新編碼的 UGA 密碼子處摻入 GPx，並且 selenium 狀態密切追蹤循環 GPx 活性，使該酶成為 selenium 營養的敏感功能標記。

label: Hemoglobin A1c
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized early glycation product, an Amadori product formed when glucose attaches non-enzymatically to the amino terminus of hemoglobin in red blood cells. It is used clinically as an indicator of blood glucose management in people with diabetes because its level reflects average glycemia over the preceding weeks. As an Amadori product, hemoglobin A1c is a reversible early intermediate on the pathway to irreversible advanced glycation end products. Its clinical utility demonstrates that even early, reversible glycation products are valuable biomarkers of glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 糖化血色素 A1c（Hemoglobin A1c）是最廣為人知的早期糖化產物，是一種當葡萄糖非酵素性地附著於紅血球中血紅素的胺基端時所形成的阿馬多里產物（Amadori product）。它在臨床上用作糖尿病患者血糖控制的指標，因為其濃度反映前幾週的平均血糖狀態。作為一種阿馬多里產物，糖化血色素 A1c 是通往不可逆晚期糖化終產物路徑上的一個可逆早期中間產物。其臨床效用證明，即使是早期、可逆的糖化產物也是糖化負擔的有價值生物標記。

label: Signaling Molecules
description: Hydrogen peroxide acts as a signaling molecule, functioning as a second messenger in insulin signaling, growth-factor pathways, and immune responses. Its relatively long half-life and membrane permeability allow it to diffuse and oxidize specific targets reversibly. The directionality is H2O2 from enzyme or leak to signal propagation. A caveat is that the same molecule is toxic at higher concentrations, so concentration and compartmentalization determine whether H2O2 signals or damages. Reversible oxidation of target cysteines, such as those in PTP1B and PTEN, allows H2O2 to propagate kinase-dependent responses.
description_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 作為訊號分子，在胰島素訊號、生長因子途徑和免疫反應中充當第二信使。其相對較長的半衰期和膜滲透性使其能夠可逆地擴散和氧化特定標靶。方向性是 H2O2 從酵素或洩漏到訊號傳播。需要注意的是，相同的分子在較高濃度下是有毒的，因此濃度和區室化決定了 H2O2 是否發出訊號或造成損害。目標半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B 和 PTEN 中的半胱氨酸）的可逆氧化使 H2O2 能夠傳播激酶依賴性反應。

label: Cysteine Thiols
description: Hydrogen peroxide oxidizes cysteine thiols, transducing signals through reversible oxidation to sulfenic acid, disulfide, or higher oxides that alter protein activity. This post-translational modification is a core mechanism by which oxidants regulate phosphatases, kinases, and transcription factors. The directionality is oxidant to thiol modification to functional change. A caveat is that excessive or irreversible over-oxidation (sulfinic/sulfonic acid) leads to loss of function and damage rather than signaling.
description_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 氧化 cysteine thiols，透過可逆氧化將訊號轉化成次磺酸、二硫化物或改變蛋白質活性的高級氧化物。這種翻譯後修飾是氧化劑調節磷酸酶、激酶和轉錄因子的核心機制。方向性是氧化劑到硫醇修飾到功能變化。需要注意的是，過度或不可逆的過度氧化（亞磺酸/磺酸）會導致功能喪失和損傷，而不是訊號傳導。

label: Liver microsomes
description: Liver microsomes are subcellular fractions of hepatic endoplasmic reticulum enriched in oxidative enzymes. In the presence of NADPH and oxygen, hepatic microsomal enzymes can oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, and the rate is modulated by high oxygen tension or inhibitors such as cyanide. This demonstrates that hepatic microsomal oxidases contribute to adrenaline oxidation alongside the well-known neutrophil and myocardial routes. The microsomal pathway represents an enzymatic or semi-enzymatic route of catecholamine oxidation that may be more relevant when oxidative stress or drug-induced enzyme activity is elevated, though it remains a minor pathway relative to COMT- and MAO-mediated metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 肝微粒體是富含氧化酶的肝內質網次細胞分馏物。在 NADPH 與氧氣存在下，肝微粒體酶可將 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome，且其速率受高氧張力或氰化物等抑制劑調節。這證明肝微粒體氧化酶與眾所周知的中性球與心肌途徑並行，共同促成 adrenaline 氧化。微粒體途徑代表一種兒茶酚胺氧化的酶性或半酶性途徑，在氧化壓力或藥物誘導酶活性升高時可能更為相關，儘管相對於 COMT 與 MAO 介導的代謝，它仍是次要途徑。

label: Metanephrine
description: Metanephrine is the principal COMT-derived metabolite of epinephrine, formed when catechol-O-methyltransferase methylates one of the catechol hydroxyl groups of adrenaline using S-adenosylmethionine as the methyl donor. Together with MAO-mediated oxidative deamination, this conversion is the primary route of adrenaline breakdown in the body. Because COMT and MAO clear adrenaline rapidly, the alternative oxidative pathway that yields adrenochrome is normally a minor side route. Metanephrine measurements are also clinically useful as markers of catecholamine production, and elevated levels reflect increased release of epinephrine from the adrenal medulla.
description_zh_TW: Metanephrine 是 epinephrine 主要的 COMT 衍生代謝物，由 catechol-O-methyltransferase 使用 S-adenosylmethionine 作為甲基供體甲基化 adrenaline 的其中一個兒茶酚羥基而形成。與 MAO 介導的氧化脫胺一起，此轉化是體內 adrenaline 分解的主要途徑。由於 COMT 與 MAO 迅速清除 adrenaline，產生 adrenochrome 的替代氧化途徑通常為次要旁路。Metanephrine 的測量在臨床上也作為兒茶酚胺生成的標記有用，其濃度升高反映腎上腺髓質釋出更多 epinephrine。

label: LDL
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) and its product hypochlorous acid oxidize low-density lipoprotein (LDL) into more atherogenic forms, and they also generate dysfunctional HDL. These oxidative modifications of lipoproteins link MPO to atherosclerosis, endothelial dysfunction (via nitric oxide consumption), and plaque instability. Elevated MPO levels and activity are associated with increased oxidative stress and cardiovascular risk, making MPO both a biomarker and a mediator of cardiovascular disease and chronic inflammatory conditions.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）及其product hypochlorous acid oxidize low-density lipoprotein（LDL）into more atherogenic forms，並generate dysfunctional HDL。這些oxidative modifications of lipoproteins將MPO與atherosclerosis、endothelial dysfunction（via nitric oxide consumption）及plaque instability聯繫起來。Elevated MPO levels與activity與increased oxidative stress及cardiovascular risk相關，making MPO both a biomarker與a mediator of cardiovascular disease與chronic inflammatory conditions。

label: neutrophil azurophilic granules
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) is a heme-containing enzyme stored primarily in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils, and to a lesser extent in monocytes and macrophages. It plays a central role in the oxidative burst during innate immune responses, producing hypochlorous acid and other oxidants that kill pathogens in phagosomes. On release during inflammation, MPO can also oxidize host biomolecules and catecholamines such as epinephrine, and its products contribute to both antimicrobial defense and, in excess, to tissue damage and cardiovascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）是一種主要儲存於neutrophils azurophilic granules中、較少量存在於monocytes與macrophages的heme-containing enzyme。它在innate immune responses的oxidative burst中扮演central role，產生hypochlorous acid及其他oxidants以kill pathogens in phagosomes。在inflammation期間released時，MPO亦能oxidize host biomolecules及如epinephrine等catecholamines，其products既contribute to antimicrobial defense，在excess時也會導致tissue damage與cardiovascular pathology。

label: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases
description: Protein tyrosine phosphatases are inactivated by hydrogen peroxide because their catalytic cysteines (e.g., PTP1B Cys-215) are oxidized to sulfenic acid, blocking substrate dephosphorylation. This shifts the phosphorylation balance toward active kinase signaling, notably in insulin and growth-factor pathways. The directionality is H2O2 to reversible PTP inhibition to enhanced phosphorylation. A caveat is that sustained oxidation can progress to irreversible inactivation and that some phosphatases are less redox-sensitive, adding specificity.
description_zh_TW: Protein tyrosine phosphatases 被 hydrogen peroxide 滅活，因為它們的催化半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B Cys-215）被氧化為次磺酸，從而阻止底物去磷酸化。這將磷酸化平衡轉向活性激酶訊號傳導，特別是在胰島素和生長因子途徑中。方向性是 H2O2 到可逆 PTP 抑製到增強磷酸化。需要注意的是，持續氧化可能會發展為不可逆的失活，某些磷酸酶對氧化還原較不敏感，從而增加了特異性。

label: Selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions
description: Silver ion is reported to disrupt selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions by inhibiting glutathione peroxidase, a selenium-dependent enzyme. Because selenium is a cofactor in antioxidant redox systems, silver's interference with selenoenzymes tilts cellular redox balance toward oxidation. This mechanism helps explain how silver, despite being relatively inert as a bulk metal, exerts biological effects through disruption of thiol redox circuits in both microbial and mammalian cells.
description_zh_TW: 報導稱銀離子通過抑制穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶（一種硒依賴性酶）來干擾硒催化的硫氫基氧化還原反應。由於硒是抗氧化氧化還原系統中的輔因子，銀對硒酶的干擾使細胞氧化還原平衡向氧化傾斜。此機制有助於解釋銀如何作為塊狀金屬相對惰性，卻通過干擾微生物和哺乳動物細胞中的硫醇氧化還原電路發揮生物效應。

label: Sodium Metabisulfite
description: Sodium metabisulfite, a sulfite antioxidant, is a common stabilizer added to epinephrine formulations to prevent oxidative degradation. It protects epinephrine against autoxidation driven by oxygen, light, heat, and higher pH, though it has limitations: sulfites can undergo synergistic degradation with adrenochrome under light, and trace metal ions catalyze epinephrine oxidation. Newer formulations explore sulfite-free options such as cysteine or thioglycerol, while chelating agents reduce metal-catalyzed oxidation. Epinephrine is a vital medication used for anaphylaxis and cardiac arrest, so maintaining its stability is clinically important.
description_zh_TW: Sodium metabisulfite，一種 sulfite antioxidant，是 common stabilizer added to epinephrine formulations 以 prevent oxidative degradation。它 protects epinephrine against autoxidation driven by oxygen, light, heat, and higher pH，though it has limitations: sulfites can undergo synergistic degradation with adrenochrome under light，and trace metal ions catalyze epinephrine oxidation。Newer formulations explore sulfite-free options such as cysteine or thioglycerol，while chelating agents reduce metal-catalyzed oxidation。Epinephrine is a vital medication used for anaphylaxis and cardiac arrest，so maintaining its stability is clinically important。

label: dopaminergic neurotransmission
description: Modafinil increases dopaminergic neurotransmission primarily by inhibiting the dopamine transporter (DAT), thereby elevating extracellular dopamine in the prefrontal cortex and striatum. It may also affect norepinephrine and orexin systems, contributing to its wakefulness-promoting effects. By raising dopamine tone, it interacts with the COMT-set baseline that differs by genotype, with fast COMT individuals showing greater improvement. It is approved for narcolepsy and used off-label for cognitive enhancement.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 主要透過抑制多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 來增加 dopaminergic neurotransmission，從而提高前額葉皮質和紋狀體中的細胞外多巴胺。它還可能影響 norepinephrine 和食慾素系統，從而有助於其促進覺醒的作用。透過提高多巴胺張力，它與因基因型而異的 COMT 設定基線相互作用，快速的 COMT 個體表現出更大的改善。它被批准用於 narcolepsy 並用於標籤外認知增強。

label: narcolepsy
description: Modafinil is a wakefulness-promoting agent approved for narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea-related sleepiness, and shift-work sleep disorder, acting via dopamine transporter inhibition and orexin system modulation. It improves daytime alertness and reduces excessive sleepiness with a lower abuse liability than classical psychostimulants such as amphetamines. Its efficacy provides the clinical anchor for its off-label cognitive and nootropic uses. It is a key tool in sleep medicine and in performance-enhancement contexts.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 是一種覺醒促進劑，被批准用於治療 narcolepsy、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症相關的嗜睡和輪班工作睡眠障礙，透過多巴胺轉運蛋白抑制和食慾素系統調節發揮作用。它可以提高白天的警覺性並減少過度嗜睡，並且比安非他明等經典精神興奮劑的濫用可能性更低。其功效為其標籤外認知和 nootropic 用途提供了臨床依據。它是睡眠醫學和提高表現的關鍵工具。

label: nootropic
description: Modafinil is widely used off-label as a nootropic to enhance alertness, attention, and executive function in healthy individuals, capitalizing on its dopaminergic and wake-promoting actions. Its cognitive-enhancing effects are modest and, as with therapeutic use, modulated by COMT genotype, with fast genotypes showing greater benefit. Off-label use is common despite indications limited to narcolepsy and related sleep disorders. Its effects illustrate the intersection of pharmacology, genetics, and cognitive enhancement.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 與 nootropic 一樣被廣泛用於標籤外，以增強健康個體的警覺性和注意力，而 executive function 則利用其多巴胺能和促進清醒的作用。其認知增強作用不大，且與治療用途一樣，由 COMT genotype 調節，快速基因型顯示出更大的益處。儘管適應症僅限於 narcolepsy 和相關睡眠障礙，但超說明書使用很常見。其作用體現了藥理學、遺傳學和認知增強的交叉作用。

label: ELK1
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

label: SIRT7 at target gene promoters
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The ETS-family transcription factor ELK4 interacts with SIRT7 and stabilizes the deacetylase at target gene promoters, allowing SIRT7 to deacetylate histone H3 at lysine 18 and repress tumor-suppressor genes. This tethering is required to maintain cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, ELK4-bound promoter occupancy precedes SIRT7-dependent H3K18 deacetylation. SIRT7 depletion accordingly reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, highlighting the ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 axis as an oncogenic regulatory circuit.
description_zh_TW: ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 SIRT7 能去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。這種錨定對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等癌症特徵是必需的。方向性上 ELK4 結合的啟動子占據先於 SIRT7 依賴的 H3K18 去乙醯化。SIRT7 的耗竭相應地降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，凸顯 ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 軸線作為致癌性調控迴路的重要性。

label: Fluorescent substrate artifacts
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: A matter of controversy is that sirtuin activation by resveratrol and the SRT compounds could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, raising the possibility of assay artifacts. Alternative explanations invoke indirect activation: resveratrol activates SIRT1 in vivo through its effect on cAMP signaling, specifically the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway, and other STACs may act similarly given their analogous metabolic effects. Directionally, the claimed direct SIRT1 activation by STACs is questioned, and their in vivo benefits may be mediated by other pathways. This controversy shaped the rigorous characterization of STAC chemistry and calls for non-fluorescent assay confirmation.
description_zh_TW: 一個爭議問題是 resveratrol 和 SRT 化合物對 sirtuin 的活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，引發了試驗假象的可能性。替代解釋涉及間接活化：resveratrol 透過其對 cAMP 訊號的影響（特別是 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）在體內活化 SIRT1，而其他 STAC 由於相似的代謝效果可能以類似方式作用。方向性上 STAC 所聲稱的直接 SIRT1 活化受到質疑，其體內益處可能由其他途徑介導。此爭議塑造了對 STAC 化學的嚴謹表徵，並要求非螢光試驗確認。

label: SIRT1 KM for substrates
description: Sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) such as resveratrol lower the Km of SIRT1 for its peptide and NAD+ substrates, amplifying deacetylation efficiency. Directionally, STAC binding sits upstream of enhanced catalytic rate. This allosteric effect is the defining action of a STAC, and it underlies the metabolic and longevity benefits attributed to these molecules. By increasing substrate affinity, STACs allow SIRT1 to deacetylate targets even at low NAD+ concentrations. This mechanism distinguishes true STACs from indirect NAD+-raising compounds, and it is central to STAC pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC）如 resveratrol 降低 SIRT1 對其肽和 NAD+ 底物的 Km 值，放大去乙醯化效率。在方向性上，STAC 結合位於增強催化速率的上游。這種變構效應是 STAC 的定義性作用，構成了歸因於這些分子的代謝和長壽益處的基礎。透過增加底物親和力，STAC 使 SIRT1 即使在低 NAD+ 濃度下也能去乙醯化靶標。此機制區分了真正的 STAC 與間接提高 NAD+ 的化合物，是 STAC 藥理學的核心。

label: K-type allosteric activation (lowers Km)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: STACs (sirtuin-activating compounds) activate sirtuins through a K-type allosteric mechanism that lowers the Michaelis constant (Km) for both NAD+ and the acetylated substrate peptide, raising catalytic efficiency without changing Vmax. This is the canonical mechanism encoded for the dozen chemical classes of STACs, distinct from the NAD+-boosting strategy (NMN/NR/CD38 inhibition) that restores co-substrate availability.
description_zh_TW: STACs（sirtuin 活化化合物）透過 K 型別構機制活化 sirtuins，降低 NAD+ 與乙醯化受質胜肽的米氏常數（Km），在不改變 Vmax 的情況下提升催化效率。這是一打化學類別 STACs 的典型機制，不同於 NAD+ 提升策略（NMN/NR/CD38 抑制）——後者是恢復輔受質的可及性。

label: methyl trap
description: Hydroxocobalamin avoids the methyl trap, the sequestration of folate as 5-methyl-THF when methionine synthase cannot remethylate homocysteine, because as a non-methylated B12 precursor it does not directly add methyl groups and supports conversion to active B12 cofactors as needed. It is converted intracellularly to methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin according to demand, providing flexible B12 repletion. This mitigates the mood swings sometimes attributed to direct methylcobalamin loading in sensitive individuals. It thus supports both methylation and mitochondrial pathways without forcing methyl donation.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 避免了 methyl trap，即當甲硫氨酸合成酶無法再甲基化同型半胱氨酸時，folate 被封存為 5-甲基-THF，因為作為非甲基化 B12 前體，它不會直接添加 methyl groups，並支持根據需要轉換為活性 B12 輔因子。它根據需要在細胞內轉化為甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素，提供靈活的 B12 補充。這可以減輕敏感個體有時因直接服用甲鈷胺而引起的情緒波動。因此，它支持甲基化和粒線體途徑，而不強迫甲基捐贈。

label: non-methylated B12 form for slow COMT
description: Hydroxocobalamin is a non-methylated B12 form recommended for slow COMT individuals because it does not impose an immediate methyl load the way methylcobalamin does. By serving as a convertible precursor rather than a direct methyl donor, it allows physiological regulation of methylcobalamin generation according to cellular need. This reduces the risk of methyl-related mood sensitivity such as irritability or anxiety in slow COMT genotypes. It remains fully capable of supporting methylation once converted, but in a titrated manner.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是一種非甲基化 B12 形式，推薦用於慢速 COMT 個體，因為它不會像甲鈷胺那樣立即施加甲基負荷。透過充當可轉換的前體而不是直接的 methyl donor，它可以根據細胞需求對甲鈷胺生成進行生理調節。這降低了甲基相關情緒敏感性的風險，例如易怒或 anxiety in slow COMT 基因型。一旦轉化，它仍然完全能夠支持甲基化，但以滴定的方式。

label: precursor to active B12 forms
description: Hydroxocobalamin is a precursor to the two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12, methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, being intracellularly reduced and alkylated to whichever coenzyme is required. This makes it a versatile B12 source that supports both the methylation cycle, via methylcobalamin for methionine synthase, and mitochondrial energy metabolism, via adenosylcobalamin for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Its precursor status distinguishes it from the directly active methyl-donating form, allowing physiological regulation of coenzyme production. This flexibility underlies its clinical use in B12 repletion.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是兩種活性輔酶形式維生素 B12（甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素）的前體，在細胞內還原並烷基化為所需的輔酶。這使其成為多功能 B12 來源，可透過甲硫胺酸合成酶的甲基鈷胺素支持 methylation cycle，並透過甲基丙二酸單醯輔酶 A 變位酶的腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。其前驅狀態使其有別於直接活性的甲基供體形式，從而可以對輔酶產生進行生理調節。這種靈活性是其在補充 B12 方面的臨床應用的基礎。

label: Fructosamine
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) is an intracellular enzyme that initiates protein deglycation by phosphorylating fructosamine, the Amadori residues on glycated proteins, converting them into fructosamine-3-phosphate. This phosphorylated compound is highly unstable and spontaneously decomposes, regenerating the original, undamaged amino acid and releasing 3-deoxyglucosone, which is then neutralized by detoxifying enzymes. By repairing early glycation intermediates before they progress to irreversible AGEs, FN3K provides the repair arm of the enzymatic defense against AGE accumulation, complementary to prevention by dicarbonyl detoxification.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶（Fructosamine-3-kinase, FN3K）是一種細胞內酵素，透過磷酸化果糖胺（即糖化蛋白上的阿馬多里殘基）來啟動蛋白質去糖化，將其轉化為果糖胺-3-磷酸（fructosamine-3-phosphate）。此磷酸化化合物高度不穩定並自發分解，再生原始的未受損胺基酸並釋出 3-deoxyglucosone，隨後被解毒酵素中和。透過在不可逆 AGE 形成之前修復早期糖化中間產物，FN3K 提供了對抗 AGE 堆積之酵素防禦的修復臂，補充二羰基解毒的預防作用。

label: 3-deoxyglucosone
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) phosphorylates Amadori (fructosamine) residues on glycated proteins to form fructosamine-3-phosphate, a highly unstable compound that spontaneously decomposes. The decomposition regenerates the original amino acid, repairing the glycated protein, and releases 3-deoxyglucosone, a reactive dicarbonyl that is then neutralized by detoxifying enzymes such as the glyoxalase system. FN3K therefore reverses early-stage glycation but generates a dicarbonyl byproduct that must be cleared, illustrating how the prevention and repair arms of AGE defense work together to limit the accumulation of advanced glycation end products.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶（FN3K）磷酸化糖化蛋白上的阿馬多里（果糖胺）殘基以形成果糖胺-3-磷酸，這是一種高度不穩定、會自發分解的化合物。分解再生原始的胺基酸、修復糖化蛋白，並釋出 3-deoxyglucosone——一種隨後被乙二醛酶系統等解毒酵素中和的反應性二羰基物。因此，FN3K 逆轉早期階段的糖化，但產生必須被清除的二羰基副產物，說明了 AGE 防禦的預防臂與修復臂如何協同運作以限制晚期糖化終產物的堆積。

label: ABCD1
description: Mutations in ABCD1, encoding a peroxisomal ATP-binding cassette transporter for very-long-chain fatty acids (VLCFAs), cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (ALD). Impaired ABCD1 disrupts VLCFA import into peroxisomes for beta-oxidation, leading to toxic accumulation of VLCFAs in adrenal cortex and central nervous system white matter. The resulting demyelination and adrenal insufficiency define the clinical syndrome. The disorder illustrates how peroxisomal transport defects produce severe neurodegeneration and underscores the importance of peroxisomal lipid homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: ABCD1 的突變編碼一種用於極長鏈脂肪酸（VLCFA）的過氧化體 ATP 結合匣轉運蛋白，導致 X 連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症（ALD）。ABCD1 受損破壞了 VLCFA 輸入過氧化體進行 β 氧化的過程，導致 VLCFA 在腎上腺皮質和中樞神經系統白質中毒性累積。由此產生的脫髓鞘和腎上腺功能不全定義了臨床症候群。此障礙說明了過氧化體運輸缺陷如何產生嚴重的神經退化，並強調了過氧化體脂質恆定性的重要性。

label: ABCD1 mutation
description: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
description_zh_TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

label: Abram Hoffer
description: Abram Hoffer, together with Humphry Osmond, proposed the adrenochrome hypothesis of schizophrenia in the 1950s. They suggested that adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, might be a psychotomimetic (hallucinogenic) agent formed endogenously, and they hypothesized that an imbalance in the oxidation of epinephrine into adrenochrome could contribute to the etiology of schizophrenia. While the hypothesis triggered extensive research into catecholamine metabolism and how catecholamine metabolites interact with neurological receptors, it was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia in later decades.
description_zh_TW: Abram Hoffer 與 Humphry Osmond 在 1950s 提出了 adrenochrome hypothesis of schizophrenia。They suggested that adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, might be a psychotomimetic (hallucinogenic) agent formed endogenously, and they hypothesized that an imbalance in the oxidation of epinephrine into adrenochrome could contribute to the etiology of schizophrenia。While the hypothesis triggered extensive research into catecholamine metabolism and how catecholamine metabolites interact with neurological receptors, it was largely superseded by the dopamine hypothesis of schizophrenia in later decades。

label: Schizophrenia
description: The adrenochrome hypothesis is a largely discredited theory from the 1950s, associated with researchers such as Abram Hoffer and Humphry Osmond, proposing that the abnormal oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome produces hallucinogenic or psychotogenic compounds that cause schizophrenia. The hypothesis proposed that adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine, could be a psychotomimetic molecule. Subsequent research did not support a causal role for adrenochrome in schizophrenia, and the hypothesis is now viewed as historically significant but not mainstream. It contributed to the cultural fascination with adrenochrome, though the compound has no proven psychoactive or clinical use.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome hypothesis 是 1950 年代一個大致已被否定的理論，與 Abram Hoffer 和 Humphry Osmond 等研究者相關，主張 adrenaline 異常氧化成 adrenochrome 會產生致幻或致精神病的化合物，導致 schizophrenia。該假說主張，adrenochrome 作為 epinephrine 的氧化產物，可能是一種 psychotomimetic 分子。後續研究並未支持 adrenochrome 在 schizophrenia 中的因果角色，此假說現在被視為具有歷史意義但非主流。它助長了對 adrenochrome 的文化迷戀，儘管該化合物並無證實的 psychoactive 或臨床用途。

label: mood side effects in slow COMT
description: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) can cause mood side effects, such as anxiety, irritability, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it is a direct methyl donor that adds to an already slowly processed methyl burden. The excess methyl groups can shift neurotransmitter and epigenetic methylation beyond the optimal range, producing emotional dysregulation. Slower COMT individuals are therefore often advised to use non-methylated B12 forms such as hydroxocobalamin or adenosylcobalamin. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) 可能會在緩慢的 COMT 個體中引起情緒副作用，例如焦慮、易怒或過度刺激，因為它是直接的 methyl donor，會增加已經緩慢處理的甲基負擔。過量的 methyl groups 可以使神經傳導物質和表觀遺傳甲基化超出最佳範圍，從而產生情緒失調。因此，速度較慢的 COMT 個體通常被建議使用非甲基化 B12 形式，例如羥鈷胺或腺苷鈷胺。其作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。

label: active B12 form
description: Methylcobalamin is an active coenzyme form of vitamin B12 that serves directly as a methyl donor, functioning as the cofactor for methionine synthase in homocysteine remethylation to methionine. By supplying methyl groups it supports SAMe generation and the methylation cycle, positioning it upstream of COMT's methyl donor supply. Its methyl-donating nature distinguishes it from adenosylcobalamin, which supports mitochondrial energy metabolism instead. It is a common supplement, though its methyl load requires caution in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的活性輔酶形式，直接充當 methyl donor，在同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸過程中充當蛋氨酸合成酶的輔因子。透過供應 methyl groups，它支援 SAMe 世代和 methylation cycle，將其定位在 COMT 的 methyl donor 供應的上游。其提供甲基的性質使其與腺苷鈷胺素不同，腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。它是一種常見的補充劑，但其甲基負荷對於緩慢的 COMT 個體需要謹慎。

label: Sodium hydrogencarbonate
description: The aqueous reaction medium for adrenochrome synthesis is maintained at a pH from 4 to 8, preferably with a buffer such as sodium hydrogencarbonate, sodium dihydrogenphosphate, disodium hydrogenphosphate, potassium acetate, or sodium acetate, with sodium hydrogencarbonate being preferred. The buffer is generally used in an amount of 4 to 7 moles, preferably 5 to 6 moles, per mole of adrenaline. Maintaining this pH range supports the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline catalyzed by water-soluble bismuth salts.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅合成的水相反應介質維持在pH 4至8，較佳地使用如碳酸氫鈉、磷酸二氫鈉、磷酸氫二鈉、醋酸鉀或醋酸鈉等緩衝液，其中以碳酸氫鈉為優選。緩衝液通常以每莫耳腎上腺素4至7莫耳、較佳5至6莫耳的量使用。維持此pH範圍有助於水溶性鉍鹽催化的腎上腺素過硫酸鹽氧化。

label: Bismuth
description: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
description_zh_TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

label: α-synuclein-mediated toxicity
description: AGK2-mediated SIRT2 inhibition prevents deacetylation of α-tubulin and microtubule elements, suppressing aggregation and protecting dopaminergic neuron viability in Parkinson's models. Directionally, AGK2/SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of neuronal rescue. This targets the microtubule instability underlying synuclein toxicity, and it is a leading SIRT2-inhibition neurodegenerative strategy. By maintaining the acetylated, stable state of tubulin, AGK2 helps neurons withstand α-synuclein aggregates. These results provided some of the strongest evidence that SIRT2 inhibition, rather than activation, is neuroprotective.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 介導的 SIRT2 抑制防止 α-微管蛋白和微管元件的去乙醯化，抑制聚集並在帕金森氏症模型中保護多巴胺能神經元活性。在方向性上，AGK2/SIRT2 抑制位於神經元拯救的上游。這靶向突觸核蛋白毒性底層的微管不穩定性，是領先的 SIRT2 抑制神經退行性策略。透過維護微管蛋白的乙醯化穩定狀態，AGK2 幫助神經元抵抗 α-突觸核蛋白聚集。這些結果提供了最強的證據之一，表明 SIRT2 抑制（而非活化）具有神經保護作用。

label: Catalase downregulation
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Catalase downregulation contributes to cancer because reduced H2O2 clearance permits sustained oxidative stress that can drive DNA damage, genomic instability, and altered redox signaling favoring proliferation. Catalase is frequently downregulated in breast, prostate, and hepatocellular carcinomas relative to normal tissue. The directionality is loss-of-defense promoting tumorigenic oxidative damage. A caveat is that many tumors also exploit moderate ROS for survival signaling, so catalase levels represent a context-dependent balance rather than a simple tumor suppressor.
description_zh_TW: Catalase downregulation 有助於 cancer，因為減少的 H2O2 清除允許持續的 oxidative stress，從而驅動 DNA damage、基因組不穩定性和有利於增殖的氧化還原訊號傳導改變。相對於正常組織，Catalase 在乳癌、prostate 和肝細胞癌中經常下調。方向性是防禦喪失促進致瘤性氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多腫瘤也利用適度的 ROS 來發出生存訊號，因此 catalase 水平代表了情境依賴性平衡，而不是簡單的腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Elevated 8-oxodG
description: Elevated 8-oxodG is associated with cancer, being increased in lung, breast, bladder, and colorectal cancers where it marks heightened oxidative DNA damage and genomic instability. Persistent oxidative lesions increase mutation burden that can drive oncogenesis. The directionality is oxidative damage to cancer risk or marker. A caveat is that elevated 8-oxodG may be a consequence of the tumor's metabolic and inflammatory state as much as a cause. Urinary and tissue 8-oxodG are frequently elevated in cancer patients and have been proposed as markers of exposure and disease burden.
description_zh_TW: Elevated 8-oxodG 與 cancer 相關，在肺、乳腺、膀胱和結直腸 cancer 中增加，標誌著氧化 DNA damage 和基因組不穩定性的增強。持續的氧化損傷會增加突變負擔，從而促進腫瘤發生。方向性是對cancer風險或標記的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，elevated 8-oxodG 可能是腫瘤代謝和發炎狀態的結果，也可能是原因。 cancer 患者的尿液和組織中 8-oxodG 經常升高，並已被提議作為暴露和疾病負擔的標記。

label: PARP inhibitors
description: BRCA is targeted by PARP inhibitors. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. PARP inhibitors block base-excision repair and are synthetically lethal with homologous-recombination defects such as BRCA mutation. The directionality runs from PARP inhibitors toward BRCA, so PARP inhibitors is the active agent and BRCA the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: BRCA 是 PARP inhibitors 的目標。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。 PARP inhibitors 阻斷鹼基切除修復，並且由於同源重組缺陷（例如 BRCA 突變）而具有綜合致死性。方向性從 PARP inhibitors 朝向 BRCA，因此 PARP inhibitors 是活性劑，BRCA 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: JAK2
description: Cancer is driven by JAK2. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. JAK2 is a cytokine-receptor-associated tyrosine kinase that phosphorylates STATs and is constitutively active in several myeloproliferative neoplasms. The directionality runs from JAK2 toward Cancer, so JAK2 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由JAK2 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 JAK2 是一種細胞激素受體相關酪胺酸激酶，可磷酸化 STAT，並在多種骨髓增殖性腫瘤中持續活躍。方向性從 JAK2 向 Cancer，因此 JAK2 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors
description: Immune Checkpoint is targeted by Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Immune checkpoint inhibitors are antibodies that release the brakes on T cells by blocking PD-1/PD-L1 or CTLA-4 interactions. The directionality runs from Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors toward Immune Checkpoint, so Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 是 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 的目標。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是透過阻斷 PD-1/PD-L1 或 CTLA-4 交互作用來釋放 T 細胞煞車作用的抗體。方向性從 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 向 Immune Checkpoint 延伸，因此 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Oncogene
description: KRAS is a type of Oncogene. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. An oncogene is a gain-of-function version of a normal growth-promoting gene whose aberrant activity drives neoplastic transformation. The directionality runs from Oncogene toward KRAS, so Oncogene is the active agent and KRAS the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: KRAS 是 Oncogene 的一種。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。癌基因是正常生長促進基因的功能獲得版本，其異常活性可驅動腫瘤轉化。方向性從 Oncogene 向 KRAS，因此 Oncogene 是活性劑，KRAS 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Sotorasib
description: KRAS is targeted by Sotorasib. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. Sotorasib is a covalent inhibitor of the KRAS G12C mutant that has demonstrated clinical efficacy in previously refractory lung adenocarcinoma. The directionality runs from Sotorasib toward KRAS, so Sotorasib is the active agent and KRAS the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: KRAS 是 Sotorasib 的目標。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。 Sotorasib 是 KRAS G12C 突變體的共價抑制劑，已證明對既往難治性肺腺癌具有臨牀療效。方向性從 Sotorasib 朝向 KRAS，因此 Sotorasib 是活性劑，KRAS 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Ki-67
description: Ki-67 is expressed in all active phases of the cell cycle and absent in quiescent cells, making it a robust immunohistochemical readout of proliferation. A high Ki-67 labeling index correlates with aggressive biology and, in some tumors, informs adjuvant therapy decisions. The relationship is directional as a biomarker: proliferation evidences the tumor's growth fraction rather than causing it. It is particularly integrated into grading of breast and neuroendocrine neoplasms.
description_zh_TW: Ki-67 在細胞週期的所有活躍階段表達，但在靜止細胞中不存在，使其成為增殖的可靠免疫組織化學讀數。高 Ki-67 標記指數與侵襲性生物學相關，並且在某些腫瘤中可以為輔助治療決策提供資訊。作為生物標記，這種關係是有方向性的：增殖證明瞭腫瘤的生長分數，而不是導致腫瘤生長的原因。它特別被納入乳腺和神經內分泌腫瘤的分級。

label: erlotinib
description: Lung Cancer is treated by erlotinib. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Erlotinib is a first-generation EGFR tyrosine-kinase inhibitor used in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer. The directionality runs from erlotinib toward Lung Cancer, so erlotinib is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 用 erlotinib 處理。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。厄洛替尼是第一代EGFR酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，用於EGFR突變的非小細胞Lung Cancer。方向性從 erlotinib 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 erlotinib 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: triple-negative breast cancer
description: PD-L1 is expressed in triple-negative breast cancer. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. Triple-negative breast cancer lacks estrogen-, progesterone-, and HER2-receptors, limiting therapy to chemotherapy and emerging immunotherapy. The directionality runs from triple-negative breast cancer toward PD-L1, so triple-negative breast cancer is the active agent and PD-L1 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: PD-L1用triple-negative breast cancer表示。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。 ﹣ 缺乏雌激素、黃體素和HER2受體，限制了化療和新興免疫療法的治療。方向性從 triple-negative breast cancer 向 PD-L1 延伸，因此 triple-negative breast cancer 是活性劑，PD-L1 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

label: Cell Membrane
description: melittin disrupts Cell Membrane. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The cell membrane is the lipid bilayer whose integrity and receptor composition govern signaling, transport, and survival of tumor cells. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon Cell Membrane rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: melittin 擾亂 Cell Membrane。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 Cell Membrane 是脂質雙層，其完整性和受體組成控制腫瘤細胞的訊號傳導、運輸和存活。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 Cell Membrane 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Akt inhibits autophagy
description: Akt phosphorylates and inhibits the FOXO1/FOXO3 transcription factors, which normally promote autophagy and stress-resistance gene expression, thereby indirectly suppressing autophagy downstream of insulin/PI3K signaling. The reciprocal interaction reflects the broader antagonism between growth-factor-driven anabolism (via Akt-mTOR) and the autophagy-promoting FOXO program. When Akt is inactive during fasting, FOXO factors are de-repressed and contribute to autophagic and longevity pathways. This axis embeds autophagy control within the insulin-signaling network that also regulates mTORC1.
description_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化並抑制 FOXO1/FOXO3 轉錄因子，後者通常促進自噬和壓力抵抗基因表現，從而在胰島素/PI3K 信號下游間接抑制自噬。此相互關係反映了生長因子驅動的合成代謝（經由 Akt-mTOR）與促自噬 FOXO 程序之間更廣泛的拮抗。當禁食期間 Akt 失活時，FOXO 因子被解除抑制並貢獻於自噬和長壽途徑。此軸將自噬控制嵌入同時調節 mTORC1 的胰島素信號網絡中。

label: SIRT6 deficiency (macrophages)
description: SIRT6 deficiency in macrophages increases acetylation and stability of FoxO1, leading to sustained FoxO1 protein and an inflammatory state. Directionally, SIRT6 loss leads to hyperacetylated, stabilized FoxO1. Because SIRT6 normally deacetylates FoxO1, its absence prolongs FoxO1 signaling and promotes inflammatory gene expression in macrophages. This reveals a macrophage-intrinsic mechanism linking SIRT6 to inflammation resolution, and it is relevant to atherosclerosis, where macrophage inflammation drives plaque progression. SIRT6's control of FoxO1 stability adds to its chromatin-based regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 巨噬細胞中 SIRT6 的缺乏增加 FoxO1 的乙醯化和穩定性，導致持續的 FoxO1 蛋白和發炎狀態。在方向性上，SIRT6 的缺失導致超乙醯化的、穩定的 FoxO1。由於 SIRT6 通常去乙醯化 FoxO1，其缺失延長 FoxO1 信號並促進巨噬細胞中的發炎基因表達。這揭示了一種巨噬細胞固有機制，將 SIRT6 與發炎消退聯繫起來，與動脈粥樣硬化相關（其中巨噬細胞發炎驅動斑塊進展）。SIRT6 對 FoxO1 穩定性的控制增加了其基於染色質的發炎基因調節。

label: Aldehyde Dehydrogenases
description: Aldehyde dehydrogenases (ALDHs), together with aldo-keto reductases, help neutralize reactive aldehydes and dicarbonyls such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal by oxidizing them into less toxic carboxylic acids. This prevents these highly reactive species from participating in glycation cascades that form advanced glycation end products. ALDH activity therefore contributes to the body's first line of enzymatic defense against dicarbonyl stress, operating alongside the glyoxalase system and PARK7. Reduced ALDH function would be expected to increase the pool of reactive dicarbonyls available to damage proteins, promoting AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 醛脫氫酶（ALDHs）與醛酮還原酶一起，透過將 3-deoxyglucosone 與甲基乙二醛等反應性醛與二羰基物氧化為較低毒性的羧酸，協助中和它們。這防止了這些高度反應性物種參與形成晚期糖化終產物的糖化級聯。因此，ALDH 活性有助於身體對抗二羰基壓力的第一道酵素防線，與乙二醛酶系統及 PARK7 並行運作。ALDH 功能降低預期會增加可用以損害蛋白質的反應性二羰基庫，促進 AGE 堆積。

label: Aldo-Keto Reductases
description: Aldo-keto reductases (AKRs) and aldehyde dehydrogenases (ALDHs) are enzyme families that assist in reducing or oxidizing reactive aldehydes and dicarbonyls, such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal, into less toxic alcohols or carboxylic acids. By converting these reactive species into less harmful products, AKRs prevent them from participating in glycation cascades that form advanced glycation end products. This enzymatic detoxification is one of the three lines of defense against AGE accumulation, operating alongside the glyoxalase system and PARK7. Impaired AKR or ALDH function would be expected to increase dicarbonyl burden and accelerate protein glycation.
description_zh_TW: 醛酮還原酶（Aldo-keto reductases, AKRs）與醛脫氫酶（aldehyde dehydrogenases, ALDHs）是協助將反應性醛與二羰基物（如 3-deoxyglucosone 與甲基乙二醛）還原或氧化為較低毒性的醇或羧酸的酵素家族。透過將這些反應性物種轉化為較無害的產物，AKR 防止它們參與形成晚期糖化終產物的糖化級聯。這種酵素解毒是對抗 AGE 堆積的三道防線之一，與乙二醛酶系統及 PARK7 並行運作。AKR 或 ALDH 功能受損預期會增加二羰基負擔並加速蛋白質糖化。

label: obesity-associated metabolic derangement
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 overexpression protects against obesity-associated metabolic derangement via deacetylation of metabolic transcription factors.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過表達透過去乙醯化代謝轉錄因子來保護免受肥胖相關的代謝紊亂。

label: α-synuclein aggregates (Parkinson's disease)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 overexpression reduces α-synuclein aggregates, supporting a role in Parkinson's protection (via FOXO/autophagy pathways).
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過表達減少 α-synuclein 聚集體，支持其在帕金森氏症保護中的作用（透過 FOXO/自噬通路）。

label: MIP-2
description: MIP-2 (CXCL2) is a CXC chemokine recruiting neutrophils via CXCR2. SIRT3 activation consistently correlates with reduced MIP-2 expression alongside TNF-alpha and IL-6, and diminished polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration in preclinical models, via NF-kappaB suppression.
description_zh_TW: MIP-2（CXCL2）是一種透過 CXCR2 招募嗜中性球的 CXC 趨化因子。SIRT3 活化與 TNF-alpha 和 IL-6 一起與 MIP-2 表現減少一致相關，以及臨床前模型中多形核白血球浸潤的減少，透過 NF-kappaB 抑制實現。

label: ALS motor neuron metabolic abnormalities
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT3 activation prevents amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons from developing metabolic abnormalities. ALS motor neurons exhibit hallmark metabolic defects including decreased mitochondrial respiration and increased glycolysis, which arise from systemic NAD+ depletion. SIRT3 activation and/or NAD+ supplementation has been discovered as a treatment for disease phenotypes in both sporadic and familial ALS, restoring normal mitochondrial metabolism and rescuing motor neuron viability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3活化防止肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症（ALS）運動神經元出現代謝異常。ALS運動神經元表現出標誌性的代謝缺陷，包括粒線體呼吸降低和糖解作用增加，這些源於全身性NAD+耗竭。SIRT3活化和/或NAD+補充已被發現可治療散發性和家族性ALS的疾病表型，恢復正常的粒線體代謝並挽救運動神經元存活能力。

label: MTHFR
description: Folinic acid (5-formyltetrahydrofolate) bypasses the MTHFR enzyme because it enters folate metabolism downstream of the MTHFR-catalyzed reduction step, requiring conversion by other enzymes to 5-methyl-THF without direct MTHFR dependence. This makes it useful for individuals with MTHFR variants who cannot efficiently generate methylfolate from folic acid or 5,10-methylene-THF. It provides methyl groups for the cycle without relying on the impaired enzymatic step. It is a common alternative in personalized methylation support protocols.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid（5-甲醯四氫葉酸）繞過 MTHFR 酶，因為它進入 MTHFR 催化還原步驟下游的 folate 代謝，需要其他酶轉化為 5-甲基-THF，而不直接依賴 MTHFR。這使得它對於患有 MTHFR variants 且無法有效地從葉酸或 5,10-亞甲基-THF 生成甲基葉酸的個體非常有用。它為循環提供 methyl groups，而不依賴受損的酶促步驟。它是個人化甲基化支持方案中的常見替代方案。

label: alternative to methylfolate
description: Folinic acid is an alternative to methylfolate, particularly for slow COMT individuals, because it delivers folate cofactors without directly adding the methyl burden that methylfolate contributes to the methylation cycle. It supports nucleotide synthesis and, indirectly, methylation without acutely raising SAMe as aggressively as methyl donors do. This makes it a gentler option in methyl-sensitive genotypes, where methylfolate can provoke irritability or anxiety. It provides a route to one-carbon support that is better tolerated in this population.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 是 alternative to methylfolate，特別是對於慢速 COMT 個體，因為它提供 folate 輔因子，而不直接添加甲基葉酸對 methylation cycle 貢獻的甲基負擔。它支持核苷酸合成，並間接支持甲基化，而不會像甲基供體那樣急劇升高 SAMe。這使得它成為甲基敏感基因型的更溫和的選擇，因為甲基葉酸會引起煩躁或焦慮。它提供了一種在該人群中更容易耐受的單碳支持途徑。

label: SIRT1 activity in triple-negative breast cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: AMPK activation reduces the expression of the oncogenic protein metadherin through enhanced SIRT1 activity, acting independently of GSK-3β in triple-negative breast cancer. Directionally, AMPK activation sits upstream of SIRT1-driven repression of metadherin. Because metadherin promotes cancer progression, metastasis, and chemoresistance, its downregulation via the AMPK-SIRT1 axis represents a tumor-suppressive mechanism in triple-negative breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: AMPK活化透過增強SIRT1活性來降低致癌蛋白metadherin的表達，在三陰性乳腺癌中不依賴GSK-3β。方向上，AMPK活化位於SIRT1驅動的metadherin抑制的上游。由於metadherin促進癌症進展、轉移和化療耐藥性，其透過AMPK-SIRT1軸的下調代表了三陰性乳腺癌中的一種腫瘤抑制機制。

label: Peroxisome Biogenesis
description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
description_zh_TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

label: TRAF6
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: The ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis drives ASAP signaling: ATM activates TRAF6, which undergoes auto-ubiquitination and recruits TAK1 to propagate stress and inflammatory signals. TAK1 in turn activates p38 MAPK and NF-kB downstream, linking DNA damage sensing to SASP transcription. This axis is a conserved scaffold connecting genotoxic stress to senescence inflammation and operates upstream of the established SASP regulatory network. The ATM-dependent TRAF6 activation illustrates how a DNA-damage kinase directly engages innate immune signaling machinery to initiate the senescent inflammatory program.
description_zh_TW: ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸驅動 ASAP 訊號：ATM 活化 TRAF6，TRAF6 經歷自動泛素化並招募 TAK1 以傳播壓力與發炎訊號。TAK1 反過來活化 p38 MAPK 與下游 NF-κB，將 DNA 損傷感知連結到 SASP 轉錄。此軸是連接基因毒性壓力到衰老發炎的保守支架，並作用於已建立 SASP 調節網絡上游。ATM 依賴的 TRAF6 活化說明 DNA 損傷激酶如何直接參與先天免疫訊號機器以啟動衰老發炎程序。

label: Ca2+ from lysosomes
description: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
description_zh_TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

label: Lysosomal Ca2+ efflux
description: TRPML1 is the principal lysosomal Ca2+ release channel, activated by PI(3,5)P2 and other cues to efflux Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol. The released Ca2+ activates calcineurin, driving TFEB/TFE3 nuclear translocation and thereby coupling ion flux to transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis. TRPML1 also participates in lysosomal trafficking and autophagosome-lysosome fusion. Loss of TRPML1 causes mucolipidosis type IV, a lysosomal storage disorder, confirming its essential role in degradative homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: TRPML1 是主要的溶酶體 Ca2+ 釋放通道，由 PI(3,5)P2 及其他線索活化，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔流出至細胞質。釋出的 Ca2+ 活化 calcineurin，驅動 TFEB/TFE3 核轉運，從而將離子流與溶酶體生物發生的轉錄活化耦合起來。TRPML1 亦參與溶酶體運輸以及自噬體—溶酶體融合。TRPML1 的缺失導致黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV），一種溶酶體儲存障礙，確認了其在降解恆定性中的必要角色。

label: Toluidine Blue O
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Toluidine blue O (TB), the 3,7-dimethyl analog of methylene blue, is the most potent of the tested phenothiazine derivatives, with EC50s of 1.75 nM for viability, 0.11 nM for ROS reduction, and 1.54 nM for preserving mitochondrial membrane potential in the HT-22 glutamate assay. Like MB, TB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction in the complex I-III assay with NADH as electron donor, enhanced cellular oxygen consumption, and decreased lactate production, sharing MB's alternative electron-transfer-carrier function but with greater potency.
description_zh_TW: 甲苯胺藍 O（TB）是甲烯藍的 3,7-二甲基類似物，是已測試的吩噻嗪衍生物中最有效的，在 HT-22 谷氨酸測定中，其 EC50 分別為 viability 1.75 nM、ROS 減少 0.11 nM、保護線粒體膜電位 1.54 nM。與 MB 一樣，TB 在以 NADH 為電子供體的 complex I-III 測定中顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，增強了細胞氧消耗，降低了乳酸產生，共享 MB 的替代電子轉載體功能但效力更強。

label: COMT at high levels
description: Rutin can inhibit COMT at high supplemental levels because, as a quercetin glycoside containing a catechol moiety, it competes for the enzyme's active site and for SAMe when present in sufficient concentration. At typical dietary intake inhibition is negligible, but concentrated extracts may affect catechol clearance and metabolism. Its catechol nature determines this dose-dependent interaction, which is most relevant in slow COMT individuals. After deglycosylation, its quercetin aglycone mediates the interaction.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 可以在高補充水平下抑制 COMT，因為作為含有兒茶酚部分的槲皮素糖苷，當存在足夠濃度時，它會競爭酶的活性位點和 SAMe。在典型的飲食攝取量下，抑製作用可以忽略不計，但濃縮萃取物可能會影響兒茶酚的清除和代謝。其茶酚性質決定了這種劑量依賴性相互作用，這在緩慢的 COMT 個體中最為相關。去糖基化後，其槲皮素苷元介導相互作用。

label: glycoside of quercetin
description: Rutin is a glycoside of quercetin, formed by rutinose, a disaccharide, attached to the quercetin aglycone, which modifies its solubility, absorption, and bioavailability in the gut. After deglycosylation, the quercetin backbone, a catechol flavonoid, is metabolized partly by COMT, linking rutin intake to COMT-dependent disposition. This structural relationship explains rutin's COMT-interacting potential once converted to quercetin. Found in buckwheat, apples, and citrus, it is a common dietary flavonoid glycoside.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 是 glycoside of quercetin，由芸香糖（一种二糖）形成，附着在槲皮素苷元上，改变其在肠道中的溶解度、吸收和生物利用度。去糖基化后，槲皮素骨架（catechol flavonoid）部分被 COMT 代谢，将芦丁摄入与 COMT 依赖性处置联系起来。這種結構關係解釋了蘆丁在轉化為槲皮素後具有 COMT 相互作用潛力。它存在於蕎麥、蘋果和柑橘中，是一種常見的膳食黃酮苷。

label: Redox-Active Metals
description: Amyloid-beta binds redox-active metals (Cu2+ and Fe3+), forming complexes that generate superoxide and H2O2 via Fenton-like chemistry at the metal site. This positions Abeta as a localized source of ROS in the Alzheimer brain. The directionality is metal binding to radical generation. A caveat is that metal-free Abeta aggregation also drives pathology, so redox activity is one of several toxic functions. Abeta is proposed to act as a redox-active metal chaperone, and metal chelators have been tested as candidate therapies to limit this pro-oxidant activity.
description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白與 redox-active metals（Cu2+ 和 Fe3+）結合，形成複合物，透過金屬位點上的類芬頓化學反應生成超氧化物和 H2O2。這使得 Abeta 成為阿茲海默症大腦中 ROS 的局部來源。方向性是金属与自由基生成的结合。需要注意的是，不含金屬的 Abeta 聚集也會引發病理學，因此氧化還原活性是多種毒性功能之一。 Abeta 被提议充当氧化还原活性金属伴侣，金属螯合剂已作为限制这种促氧化活性的候选疗法进行了测试。

label: Mitochondrial Complex IV
description: Amyloid-beta impairs mitochondrial Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) after accumulating in mitochondria, depressing respiration and increasing electron leak. This links protein misfolding to bioenergetic failure and ROS. The directionality is Abeta mitochondrial localization to respiratory inhibition. A caveat is that Complex IV inhibition can be both a cause and consequence of oxidative damage in a feed-forward loop. The resulting energetic deficit may precede overt neurodegeneration and contributes to synaptic failure in Alzheimer's disease.
description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白在 mitochondria 中累積後會損害 mitochondrial Complex IV（細胞色素 C 氧化酶），抑制呼吸並增加電子洩漏。這將蛋白質錯誤折疊與生物能量衰竭和 ROS 聯繫起來。方向性是Abeta mitochondria1定位於呼吸抑制。需要注意的是，複合物 IV 抑制既可能是前饋迴路中氧化損傷的原因，也可能是其結果。由此產生的能量缺乏可能先於明顯的 neurodegeneration 發生，並導致阿茲海默症的突觸衰竭。

label: Circulation
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。

label: Plasma AGEs
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Uribarri and colleagues estimated dietary AGE intake from three-day food records in 90 healthy subjects using a database of the AGE content of foods and found a significant correlation between ingested AGEs and plasma levels; a subgroup exposed to dietary restriction of AGEs showed decreased plasma levels as well. Similar results were reported in patients with diabetes and renal failure. These findings support the view that the intake of dietary AGEs is an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and that reducing dietary AGE intake lowers circulating AGE concentrations even in healthy individuals.
description_zh_TW: Uribarri 及其同事利用食物 AGE 含量資料庫，從 90 名健康受試者的三日飲食記錄估計飲食 AGE 攝取量，發現攝入 AGE 與血漿濃度之間有顯著相關；一組接受飲食 AGE 限制的亞組也顯示血漿濃度下降。糖尿病與腎衰竭患者中也報告了類似結果。這些發現支持飲食 AGE 攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且減少飲食 AGE 攝取可降低循環 AGE 濃度，即使在健康個體中亦然。

label: Anti-androgen
description: Enzalutamide is a nonsteroidal anti-androgen used in endocrine therapy of prostate cancer.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 是一種非甾體抗雄激素，用於前列腺癌的內分泌治療。

label: TLR4
description: Extracellular disulfide-HMGB1 signals through TLR4 on antigen-presenting cells to drive inflammatory and antitumor immune responses.
description_zh_TW: 細胞外二硫鍵-HMGB1 通過抗原呈遞細胞上的 TLR4 發出信號，驅動炎症和抗腫瘤免疫反應。

label: Damage-associated molecular pattern
description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

label: Immunogenic cell death
description: HMGB1 release is a hallmark DAMP of immunogenic cell death, necessary for anticancer immune priming.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 釋放是免疫原性細胞死亡的標誌性 DAMP，對抗癌免疫 priming 必不可少。

label: IL-22
description: Interleukin 22, an IL-10 gene family member produced by T helper 17 cells and innate lymphoid cell subsets, signals through the IL-22 receptor on the surface of thymic epithelial cells and promotes the proliferation and survival of thymocytes. Dudakov et al. showed that IL-22 administration to wild-type mice after total body irradiation significantly increases thymic cellularity, including both developing thymocytes and TEC subsets, and that immune recovery in irradiated IL-22-deficient mice is impaired.
description_zh_TW: 介白素 22（Interleukin 22）是 IL-10 基因家族成員，由 T 輔助 17 細胞與先天淋巴樣細胞亞群產生，透過胸腺上皮細胞表面的 IL-22 受體傳遞訊號，促進胸腺細胞的增生與存活。Dudakov 等人顯示，在全身照射後對野生型小鼠施用 IL-22 可顯著增加胸腺細胞數量，包括發育中的胸腺細胞與 TEC 亞群，而 IL-22 缺陷小鼠在照射後的免疫恢復則受損。

label: Keratinocyte Growth Factor
description: Keratinocyte growth factor (KGF, FGF7) signaling through FGFR2IIIb is critical for fetal thymus organogenesis and linked to proliferation and differentiation of fetal and postnatal thymic epithelial cells. KGF administration is well-documented to increase thymus size, TEC differentiation, and thymocyte production in aged animals. Min and colleagues showed that a single course of KGF treatment increases thymic cellularity in aged mice, maintained for two months, with restoration of cortical and medullary compartments, increased naive CD4 T cell output, and increased humoral responses to a T-dependent antigen.
description_zh_TW: 角質細胞生長因子（KGF，FGF7）透過 FGFR2IIIb 的訊息傳導對胎兒胸腺器官發生至關重要，並與胎兒及出生後胸腺上皮細胞的增生與分化有關。有充分文獻記載 KGF 施用可增加年老動物的胸腺大小、TEC 分化與胸腺細胞生成。Min 及其同事顯示，單一療程的 KGF 治療可增加老年小鼠的胸腺細胞數量，並維持兩個月，同時恢復皮質與髓質區室、增加初始 CD4 T 細胞輸出，並增加對 T 依賴性抗原的體液免疫反應。

label: LHRH
description: Luteinizing hormone releasing hormone (LHRH) analogues achieve pharmacological sex steroid ablation and are a clinically tolerable alternative to surgical castration. Agents such as Lupron (leuprolide) act on the pituitary gland, desensitizing LHRH receptors and thereby decreasing luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone, leading to reduced estrogen and testosterone production. Human studies with LHRH analogues have resulted in increased thymic weight and reversal of age-related thymic structural defects.
description_zh_TW: 黃體生成激素釋放激素（LHRH）類似物可達成藥理性性類固醇消融，是外科去勢的臨床上可耐受之替代方案。諸如 Lupron（leuprolide）等藥物作用於腦下垂體，使 LHRH 受體去敏感化，從而減少黃體生成激素與濾泡刺激激素，導致雌激素與睪固酮生成減少。使用 LHRH 類似物的人類研究已導致胸腺重量增加及年齡相關胸腺結構缺陷的逆轉。

label: sjTREC
description: Single joint T cell receptor excision circle (sjTREC) analysis is a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis. Using sjTREC, researchers reported a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan, and a significant decrease of sjTREC per milligram of mouse thymus tissue with increasing age in BALB/c mice (6-90 weeks), demonstrating gradual decrease in thymopoiesis with age similar to humans.
