The sjTREC assay was also used to show that ghrelin administration to aged mice increases the number of recent thymic emigrants exported to the periphery. It is thus a quantitative readout of thymic output used across species.
description_zh_TW: 單關節T細胞受體刪除環（sjTREC）分析是活性胸腺生成的分子標誌物。使用sjTREC，研究人員報告了在80年人類壽命中循環初始T細胞穩步下降三個數量級，以及在BALB/c小鼠（6-90週）中隨著年齡增長，每毫克小鼠胸腺組織的sjTREC顯著減少，證明了與人類相似的隨著年齡增長胸腺生成逐漸減少。sjTREC測定也被用於證明ghrelin給藥老年小鼠增加了最近輸出到外周的胸腺遷出細胞的數量。因此，它是跨物種使用的胸腺輸出的定量讀數。

label: Necrosulfonamide
description: Necrosulfonamide blocks the necroptotic executor MLKL, preventing its pore formation and membrane rupture in human cells. Notably, the same compound also functions as an inhibitor of gasdermin D — the pyroptotic pore-former — so necrosulfonamide dually suppresses the two lytic, DAMP-releasing death modalities. This dual activity makes it a useful tool for dissecting necroptosis-pyroptosis crosstalk, and highlights that MLKL and GSDMD pores share pharmacological vulnerability despite being activated by different cascades.
description_zh_TW: Necrosulfonamide 會阻斷程序性壞死的執行者 MLKL，在人類細胞中防止其形成孔道與膜破裂。值得注意的是，同一化合物也是 gasdermin D——焦亡的成孔蛋白——的抑制劑，因此 necrosulfonamide 可同時抑制兩種裂解性、釋放 DAMP 的死亡模式。這種雙重活性使其成為剖析程序性壞死與焦亡交互作用的实用工具，也突顯 MLKL 與 GSDMD 孔道雖由不同級聯活化，卻共享藥理脆弱性。

label: RIPK3
description: RIPK3 phosphorylates MLKL on its activation loop (human Thr357/Ser358), exposing the N-terminal four-helix bundle that executes necroptosis. This phosphorylation is the final licensure step of the necrosome cascade: without it MLKL stays monomeric and inert. Phosphorylated MLKL then oligomerizes and traffics to the plasma membrane, where its four-helix bundles form cation channels. MLKL is a pseudokinase — it binds ATP but does not hydrolyze it — so its function is structural membrane disruption rather than signaling.
description_zh_TW: RIPK3 會將 MLKL 的活化環（人類 Thr357/Ser358）磷酸化，暴露出執行程序性壞死的 N 端四螺旋束。此磷酸化是 necrosome 級聯的最終許可步驟：缺少它時 MLKL 保持單體且不活化。磷酸化的 MLKL 隨後寡聚化並轉位至細胞膜，其四螺旋束在此形成陽離子通道。MLKL 是一種偽激酶——會結合 ATP 但不水解——因此其功能是結構性的膜破壞而非訊號傳遞。

label: double-strand breaks in NHEJ
description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

label: Werner Syndrome
description: Werner syndrome is a progeroid disorder caused by mutations in the WRN gene, which encodes a protein with both helicase and exonuclease activities essential for DNA repair and genome stability. The WRN protein functions in pathways including homologous recombination, base excision repair, and resolution of replication stress, and its loss leads to accelerated genomic instability and premature aging. Werner syndrome patients prematurely develop age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, diabetes, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: Werner 症候群是一種由 WRN 基因突變引起的早衰症，該基因編碼的蛋白質具有解旋酶和核酸外切酶活性，對於 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性至關重要。 WRN 蛋白在同源重組、鹼基切除修復和複製壓力解決等途徑中發揮作用，其缺失會導致基因組不穩定加速和過早老化。沃納症候群患者過早地患有與年齡相關的疾病，如動脈粥狀硬化、糖尿病和癌症。

label: γ-H2A.X
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: gamma-H2A.X, the phosphorylated form of the histone variant H2A.X at serine 139, serves as a beacon that recruits DNA repair proteins to sites of double-strand DNA breaks. Phosphorylation of H2A.X spreads over large chromatin domains around the break, providing a platform for the assembly of DNA repair complexes and the amplification of damage signaling. Beyond its role in repair, gamma-H2A.X induces p53 expression and activates senescence signaling, and it accumulates with aging as a result of persistent DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: γ-H2A.X 是組蛋白變體 H2A.X 在絲氨酸 139 的磷酸化形式，可作為將 DNA 修復蛋白招募到雙股 DNA 斷裂位點的信標。 H2A.X 的磷酸化遍布斷裂周圍的大染色質結構域，為 DNA 修復複合物的組裝和損傷訊號的放大提供了平台。除了修復作用之外，gamma-H2A.X 還誘導 p53 表達並激活衰老信號傳導，並且由於持續的 DNA 損傷，它會隨著衰老而累積。

label: Flushing
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day, and several preclinical studies have confirmed that both NA and nicotinamide (NAM) can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NA shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels and is used to treat dyslipidemia, but this flushing side effect limits its tolerability. In contrast, nicotinamide riboside (NR) elevates NAD+ levels without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, and was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects.
description_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關，且數項臨床前研究已確認 NA 與 nicotinamide（NAM）皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。NA 展現降低血脂水平的效果並被用於治療血脂異常，但此潮紅副作用限制了其耐受性。相對地，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）提升 NAD+ 水平而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），並在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用。

label: Dyslipidemia
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels, and it is used to treat dyslipidemia, although it is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day. In contrast, nicotinamide (NAM) does not affect lipid blood levels, yet it can exhibit sirtuin-inhibiting effects at higher doses, while nicotinamide riboside (NR) does not cause flushing because it does not activate GPR109A. The distinct physiological responses of the NAD+ precursors NA, NAM, and NR, despite all three raising NAD+ and NADP+ levels, are important for selecting the appropriate precursor for specific therapeutic indications.
description_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）展現降低血脂水平的效果，並被用於治療血脂異常，儘管其在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關。相對地，nicotinamide（NAM）不影響血脂水平，但其在較高劑量下可展現抑制 sirtuin 的效果，而 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）因不活化 GPR109A 而不會造成潮紅。NAD+ 前驅物 NA、NAM 與 NR 儘管三者皆提升 NAD+ 與 NADP+ 水平，其截然不同的生理反應對於選擇適當前驅物以用於特定治療適應症相當重要。

label: Endosymbiosis
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondria arose through the endosymbiosis of an alpha-proteobacterium with an ancestral eukaryotic cell, an event that occurred approximately two billion years ago. During evolution, most of the bacterial genes were transferred to the host nuclear genome, and mitochondria retained only a small genome encoding a handful of respiratory chain subunits, rRNAs, and tRNAs. This evolutionary origin explains mitochondria's double membrane structure, their own circular mitochondrial DNA, and the presence of a mitochondrial targeting sequence on most nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins that directs their import. The endosymbiotic origin also underlies the ability of mitochondria to fuse and divide like their bacterial ancestors.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 通過內共生 alpha-proteobacterium 與 ancestral eukaryotic cell 而產生，此事件發生在大約二十億年前。在 evolution 期間，大部分細菌基因轉移到宿主 nuclear genome，mitochondria 僅保留一個 small genome，編碼少數 respiratory chain subunits、rRNAs 和 tRNAs。這種 evolutionary origin 解釋了 mitochondria 的 double membrane structure、其 own circular mitochondrial DNA，以及大多數 nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins 上存在 mitochondrial targeting sequence，指導其 import。內共生起源也奠定了 mitochondria 像其細菌祖先一樣融合和分裂的能力。

label: Lactylation
description: Lysine lactylation is a lactate-derived post-translational modification coupling metabolic state to protein function. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation, promoting ferroptosis and accelerating nucleus pulposus cell decline in intervertebral disc degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 離胺酸乳醯化是一種乳酸衍生的翻譯後修飾，將代謝狀態與蛋白功能偶聯。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化，促進椎間盤退化中髓核細胞的鐵死亡和功能衰退。

label: Nucleus Pulposus
description: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 髓核細胞在椎間盤退化中衰退，在氧化壓力下被 SIRT3 敲減加劇。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，加速 NPC 功能衰退；SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度。

label: Mus musculus
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: P66shc knockout mice live about 30% longer than wild-type controls and show enhanced resistance to oxidative stress and age-related pathologies, indicating P66shc is a negative regulator of longevity. Directionally, loss of P66shc extends lifespan. This makes P66shc an attractive node, with SIRT1 as an upstream suppressor, for longevity interventions.
description_zh_TW: P66shc 基因敲除小鼠比野生型對照多活約 30%，並表現出對氧化壓力和年齡相關病變的增強抵抗力，表明 P66shc 是壽命的負向調節因子。方向性上 P66shc 的缺失延長壽命。這使 P66shc 成為一個有吸引力的節點，以 SIRT1 作為上游抑制因子，用於長壽介入措施。

label: LINE-1 expression (HGPS fibroblasts)
description: Fucoidan-FV (50-100 μg/mL) reduces LINE-1 ORF1p and ORF2p protein levels in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria (HGPS) patient-derived fibroblasts, indicating suppressed retrotransposition. Directionally, fucoidan/SIRT6 sits upstream of LINE-1 silencing. This addresses a progeria-associated chromatin defect and supports SIRT6's role in repetitive-element control. By restoring SIRT6-mediated silencing of LINE-1 elements, fucoidan mitigates a key feature of progeria biology, and AAV-mediated centenarian-SIRT6 delivery produces a similar reduction. These findings link fucoidan and SIRT6 to the maintenance of genome integrity in premature-aging syndromes.
description_zh_TW: Fucoidan-FV（50-100 μg/mL）在 Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症（HGPS）患者來源的成纖維細胞中降低 LINE-1 ORF1p 和 ORF2p 蛋白水平，表明逆轉座被抑制。在方向性上，fucoidan/SIRT6 位於 LINE-1 沉默的上游。這解決了早衰症相關的染色質缺陷，並支持 SIRT6 在重複元件控制中的角色。透過恢復 SIRT6 介導的 LINE-1 元件沉默，fucoidan 緩解了早衰症生物學的一個關鍵特徵，而 AAV 介導的百歲人瑞 SIRT6 遞送產生了類似的降低。這些發現將 fucoidan 和 SIRT6 與早衰症候群中基因組完整性的維護聯繫起來。

label: Healthspan and lifespan (aged mice)
description: SIRT6-activating fucoidan extends healthspan and lifespan in aged wild-type mice, confirming in vivo geroprotection. Directionally, fucoidan sits upstream of improved survival and function. This mirrors the longevity association of centenarian SIRT6 variants and positions fucoidan as a natural SIRT6-targeted intervention. The benefit in naturally aged mice suggests that SIRT6 activation can counteract age-related decline even when initiated late in life. Fucoidan's dual activation of SIRT6 protein and ADP-ribosyltransferase activity is thought to mediate its healthspan effects.
description_zh_TW: 活化 SIRT6 的 fucoidan 延長老年野生型小鼠的健康壽命和壽命，確認了體內抗衰老保護。在方向性上，fucoidan 位於改善存活和功能的上游。這反映了百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體的長壽關聯，將 fucoidan 定位為天然的 SIRT6 靶向干預措施。在自然衰老小鼠中的益處表明，即使在生命後期才開始 SIRT6 活化也能對抗年齡相關退化。Fucoidan 對 SIRT6 蛋白和 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性的雙重活化被認為是其健康壽命效應的介導機制。

label: memory consolidation
description: The hippocampus is critically involved in memory consolidation, the process by which newly acquired information is stabilized into long-term storage via hippocampal-neocortical dialogue and synaptic plasticity. COMT expressed in the hippocampus modulates the catecholamine tone that supports this plasticity, linking the enzyme to memory processes beyond the prefrontal cortex. Hippocampal integrity is therefore sensitive to COMT-dependent dopaminergic and noradrenergic signaling, and its dysfunction is central to amnesia and age-related cognitive decline. The region's plasticity mechanisms are fundamental to learning.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體在 memory consolidation 中發揮至關重要的作用，memory consolidation 是新獲得的資訊透過海馬體新皮質對話和 synaptic plasticity 穩定並長期儲存的過程。海馬體中表達的 COMT 調節支持這種可塑性的兒茶酚胺基調，將該酶與前額葉皮質以外的記憶過程聯繫起來。因此，海馬完整性對 COMT 依賴性多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能訊號傳導敏感，其功能障礙是健忘症和年齡相關認知能力下降的核心。該區域的可塑性機制是學習的基礎。

label: spatial navigation
description: The hippocampus is involved in spatial navigation, functioning as a core component of the brain's allocentric mapping system via place cells and grid-cell inputs that encode location, direction, and trajectory. Dopamine and norepinephrine, modulated by hippocampal COMT, influence the precision of spatial memory and navigation. Damage to the hippocampus produces profound deficits in navigation and episodic memory, as seen in lesions and neurodegenerative disease. Its role in forming cognitive maps is among its best-established functions.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體參與 spatial navigation，透過編碼位置、方向和軌跡的位置細胞和網格細胞輸入，作為 brain 異中心映射系統的核心組件發揮作用。 Dopamine和norepinephrine受海馬COMT調製，影響空間記憶和導航的精確度。海馬體的損傷會導致導航和情景記憶的嚴重缺陷，如在病變和神經退化性疾病中所見。它在形成認知地圖方面的作用是其最完善的功能之一。

label: Ischemic preconditioning cardioprotection
description: In ischemic-preconditioning models, Splitomicin reverses protective lysine deacetylation and abolishes preconditioning-induced cardioprotection. Directionally, Splitomicin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of lost cardiac protection. This indicates that sirtuin deacetylase activity is required for ischemic tolerance, and it argues that sirtuin activation, not inhibition, protects the heart. The cardioprotective effect of preconditioning is thought to involve SIRT1-dependent stress adaptation, and its loss upon sirtuin inhibition confirms this mechanism. These findings support the development of sirtuin activators for ischemic heart disease.
description_zh_TW: 在缺血預適應模型中，Splitomicin 逆轉保護性的賴氨酸去乙醯化並廢除預適應誘導的心臟保護。在方向性上，Splitomicin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於心臟保護喪失的上游。這表明 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性是缺血耐受所必需的，並主張 sirtuin 活化（而非抑制）才能保護心臟。預適應的心臟保護效應被認為涉及 SIRT1 依賴性的壓力適應，其在 sirtuin 抑制後的喪失確認了此機制。這些發現支持開發用於缺血性心臟病的 sirtuin 活化劑。

label: Sir2 in S. cerevisiae (weakly inhibits human SIRT1)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Splitomicin inhibits Sir2 in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, but showed weaker inhibition on human SIRT1. Yeast Sir2 and human SIRT2 are inhibited by sirtinol. Directionally, these small-molecule sirtuin inhibitors (STICs) sit upstream of reduced sirtuin catalytic activity, with species- and isoform-selective potencies. Sirtuin inhibitors have also been considered for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, in addition to cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Splitomicin 抑制釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中的 Sir2，但對人類 SIRT1 的抑制作用較弱。酵母 Sir2 和人類 SIRT2 均可被 sirtinol 抑制。從作用方向而言，這些小分子 sirtuin 抑制劑（STICs）位於降低 sirtuin 催化活性的上游，具有物種和亞型選擇性效能。除了癌症治療之外，sirtuin 抑制劑也被考慮用於帕金森氏症的治療。

label: LIPL-1
description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

label: LIPL-3
description: LIPL-3 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that, like LIPL-1, co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2 and contributes to intralysosomal lipid hydrolysis. It is transcriptionally induced by HLH-30 under fasting conditions, enabling the breakdown of lipid droplets delivered via lipophagy. Together with other lipl family members, LIPL-3 is required for efficient energy mobilization during starvation. Its lysosomal localization anchors it within the autophagy-lysosomal degradative system.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-3 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，如同 LIPL-1，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，並有助於溶酶體內的脂質水解。它在禁食條件下受 HLH-30 轉錄誘發，使得經由脂噬遞送的脂滴得以分解。與其他 lipl 家族成員一起，LIPL-3 是飢餓期間有效能量動員所必需的。其溶酶體定位將它錨定於自噬—溶酶體降解系統中。

label: Glutaminolysis
description: SIRT5 enhances glutaminolysis in colorectal cancer in a deglutarylation-dependent manner to drive colorectal carcinogenesis, and it deacetylates lactate dehydrogenase B to induce hyperactive autophagy and tumorigenesis. SIRT5 overexpression is associated with poor prognosis in CRC, contrasting with protective SIRT6.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 以去戊二醯化依賴的方式增強大腸癌中的麩醯胺分解，驅動大腸癌發生，且去乙醯化 lactate dehydrogenase B 以誘發過度活化的自噬與腫瘤發生。SIRT5 過度表現與 CRC 不良預後相關，與保護性 SIRT6 形成對比。

label: H2O2-induced cell death in cardiomyocytes
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: A finding suggests that in cardiomyocytes, SIRT5 is a key moderator in cell death induced by H2O2. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the cardiomyocyte response to oxidative stress, dampening or modulating hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death. This places SIRT5 in the cardiac stress response network and suggests that modulating SIRT5 activity could influence oxidative injury in the heart.
description_zh_TW: 一項發現表明，在心肌細胞中，SIRT5是H2O2誘導的細胞死亡的關鍵調節因子。方向上，SIRT5位於心肌細胞對氧化壓力反應的上游，抑制或調節過氧化氫誘導的細胞死亡。這將SIRT5置於心臟壓力反應網路中，並表明調節SIRT5活性可能影響心臟的氧化損傷。

label: HCC growth and metastasis via glycolysis reprogramming
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Activation of mitochondrial SIRT5 promotes the growth and metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma cells via glucose metabolism reprogramming from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the glycolytic switch that fuels liver cancer progression. By favoring glycolysis, SIRT5 supplies the biosynthetic and bioenergetic demands of rapidly growing HCC cells, supporting tumor aggressiveness. This oncogenic role is opposed by SIRT5's bile-acid-metabolism-mediated suppression of HCC, underscoring the dual, context-dependent functions of SIRT5 in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體SIRT5的活化透過從氧化磷酸化到糖解作用的葡萄糖代謝重編程促進肝細胞癌細胞的生長和轉移。方向上，SIRT5位於驅動肝癌進展的糖解轉換的上游。透過有利於糖解作用，SIRT5為快速生長的HCC細胞提供生物合成和生物能量需求，支持腫瘤的侵襲性。此致癌角色與SIRT5透過膽汁酸代謝介導的HCC抑制相對抗，突顯了SIRT5在肝癌中的雙重、環境依賴性功能。

label: cellular energy metabolism and AMPK activity under energy stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: As a result of energy stress, SIRT5 modulates cellular energy metabolism and AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of metabolic adaptation and AMPK activation during energy deprivation. By influencing energy metabolism and engaging AMPK signalling, SIRT5 helps cells maintain energy homeostasis under stress conditions, linking mitochondrial deacylation to the cellular energy sensing network.
description_zh_TW: 作為能量壓力的結果，SIRT5調節細胞能量代謝和AMP活化蛋白激酶活性。方向上，SIRT5位於能量剝奪期間代謝適應和AMPK活化的上游。透過影響能量代謝並參與AMPK訊號，SIRT5幫助細胞在壓力條件下維持能量恆定，將粒線體去醯基化與細胞能量感知網路聯繫起來。

label: FOXO3a in lung epithelial cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In lung epithelial cells, SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of Forkhead protein FOXO3a inhibits apoptosis induced by cigarette smoke extract. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of FOXO3a deacetylation and reduced apoptosis under cigarette smoke stress. By dampening FOXO3a-driven pro-apoptotic signalling, SIRT5 helps lung epithelial cells survive the toxic effects of cigarette smoke, with potential relevance to smoking-related lung pathology.
description_zh_TW: 在肺上皮細胞中，SIRT5介導的Foxhead蛋白FOXO3a的去乙醯化抑制香菸煙霧提取物誘導的凋亡。方向上，SIRT5位於香菸煙霧壓力下FOXO3a去乙醯化和凋亡減少的上游。透過抑制FOXO3a驅動的促凋亡訊號，SIRT5幫助肺上皮細胞在香菸煙霧的毒性作用下存活，可能與吸煙相關的肺部病理相關。

label: IDH2 (via desuccinylation)
description: SIRT5 activates IDH2 through desuccinylation, enhancing its NADPH-producing activity and thereby supporting glutathione reduction and ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of IDH2-dependent redox buffering. This complements SOD1 activation in antioxidant defense, and it shows SIRT5's desuccinylation broadly strengthens reductive capacity. By boosting NADPH production, SIRT5 ensures sufficient reducing equivalents for glutathione and thioredoxin systems. This regulation links SIRT5 to both energy metabolism and redox homeostasis, particularly during fasting when oxidative stress rises.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化 IDH2，增強其 NADPH 產生活性，從而支持穀胱甘肽還原和 ROS 清除。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於 IDH2 依賴性紅氧緩衝的上游。這與 SOD1 活化在抗氧化防禦中互補，並表明 SIRT5 的去琥珀醯化廣泛增強還原能力。透過增強 NADPH 產生，SIRT5 確保穀胱甘肽和硫氧還蛋白系統有足夠的還原當量。此調控將 SIRT5 與能量代謝和紅氧恆定性聯繫起來，特別是在禁食期間氧化壓力升高時。

label: VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD, ECHA (fatty acid oxidation)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT5 activates multiple fatty acid beta-oxidation enzymes through desuccinylation, including very-long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (MCAD), and the alpha subunit of enoyl-CoA hydratase (ECHA). Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatic activation of these enzymes sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. Deficiency of SIRT5 compromises fatty acid metabolism, leading to acylcarnitine accumulation and decreased ATP production.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過去琥珀醯化作用活化多種脂肪酸β-氧化酶，包括極長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（VLCAD）、長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）、中鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（MCAD）和烯醯CoA水合酶的α亞基（ECHA）。方向上，SIRT5對這些酶的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。SIRT5的缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝，導致醯基肉鹼積累和ATP產量減少。

label: SOD1 (via desuccinylation)
description: SIRT5 activates superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) through desuccinylation, enhancing NADPH production and glutathione recycling for ROS detoxification. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates SOD1. This bolsters cytosolic antioxidant capacity, and it extends SIRT5's protective actions beyond the mitochondria's own enzymes. By promoting NADPH generation and glutathione recycling, SOD1 activation supports the detoxification of superoxide and the maintenance of redox balance. This antioxidant function complements SIRT5's metabolic roles and contributes to cellular protection against oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化超氧化物歧化酶 1（SOD1），增強 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收以進行 ROS 解毒。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 SOD1。這增強了細胞質抗氧化能力，並將 SIRT5 的保護作用延伸到粒線體自身酶之外。透過促進 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收，SOD1 活化支持超氧陰離子的解毒和紅氧平衡的維護。這種抗氧化功能與 SIRT5 的代謝角色互補，並有助於細胞對抗氧化壓力的保護。

label: Nrf2/HO-1-mediated ROS suppression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 can promote cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner via regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of reduced ROS, diminished DNA damage, and enhanced survival of ovarian cancer cells treated with cisplatin. By activating Nrf2/HO-1-dependent antioxidant defense, SIRT5 protects ovarian cancer cells from platinum-induced damage, contributing to chemoresistance. This contrasts with SIRT2, whose overexpression enhances cisplatin sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5可以透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷來促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於接受順鉑治療的卵巢癌細胞中ROS降低、DNA損傷減少和存活增強的上游。透過活化Nrf2/HO-1依賴性抗氧化防禦，SIRT5保護卵巢癌細胞免受鉑誘導的損傷，促成化療耐藥性。這與過表達增強耐藥卵巢癌細胞順鉑敏感性的SIRT2形成對比。

label: CPS1 (Carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 1)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 deacetylates (and desuccinylates) carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS1), the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification; SIRT5-KO mice show elevated blood ammonia under fasting (Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378).
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去乙醯化（並去琥珀酰化）氨甲醯磷酸合成酶 1（CPS1）——尿素循環的限速酶——增強氨解毒；SIRT5-KO 小鼠在禁食時顯示血氨升高（Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378）。

label: IDH2 and SDHA (TCA cycle)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates TCA-cycle enzymes IDH2 and SDHA, tuning their activity and coordinating mitochondrial energy metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically modulates TCA flux. This helps match oxidation to demand during fasting or stress, and it reinforces SIRT5's role as a central mitochondrial metabolic regulator. By adjusting the activity of key TCA-cycle enzymes, SIRT5 balances carbon entry, ATP production, and the supply of reducing equivalents. This regulation supports the metabolic flexibility that allows cells to adapt fuel utilization to nutrient availability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化 TCA 循環酶 IDH2 和 SDHA，調節其活性並協調粒線體能量代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式調節 TCA 通量。這有助於在禁食或壓力期間使氧化與需求匹配，並強化 SIRT5 作為核心粒線體代謝調節因子的角色。透過調整關鍵 TCA 循環酶的活性，SIRT5 平衡碳的進入、ATP 產生和還原當量的供應。此調控支持使細胞能根據營養可用性調整燃料利用的代謝靈活性。

label: urea cycle
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates CPS1, the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification during fasting; SIRT5-knockout mice show elevated blood ammonia under nitrogen load.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀酰化並活化 CPS1——尿素循環的限速酶——增強禁食期間的氨解毒；SIRT5 敲除小鼠在氮負荷下顯示血氨升高。

label: HMGCS2 (ketogenesis)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates HMGCS2 (3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2), the rate-limiting enzyme of ketone-body synthesis, supporting energy production during fasting. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates HMGCS2. This promotes ketogenesis when carbohydrate is scarce, and it is a fasting-adaptive function of SIRT5. By enabling ketone-body production from acetyl-CoA, SIRT5 supports the brain and other tissues during prolonged fasting. This regulation complements SIRT5's activation of urea-cycle and fatty-acid-oxidation enzymes, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化 HMGCS2（3-羥基-3-甲基戊二醯-CoA 合酶 2）——酮體合成的限速酶——在禁食期間支持能量產生。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 HMGCS2。這在碳水化合物稀缺時促進酮體生成，是 SIRT5 的禁食適應性功能。透過使酮體能從乙醯-CoA 產生，SIRT5 在長期禁食期間支持大腦和其他組織。此調控與 SIRT5 對尿素循環和脂肪酸氧化酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為分解代謝的協調者。

label: CPS1 (carbamoyl phosphate synthase 1)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates carbamoyl phosphate synthase 1 (CPS1), the rate-limiting enzyme of the urea cycle, enhancing ammonia detoxification into urea. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates CPS1. This is especially important during fasting or high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared, and SIRT5-deficient mice show elevated ammonia under such conditions. It exemplifies SIRT5's role as a regulator of mitochondrial acyl-metabolism and nitrogen homeostasis, and complements its activation of HMGCS2, fatty-acid oxidation enzymes, and TCA-cycle dehydrogenases, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic flux during nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 1（CPS1），這是尿素循環的限速酶，增強氨解毒為尿素。在方向性上，SIRT5 在酶學上活化 CPS1。這在禁食或高蛋白負荷期間（需要清除氮時）尤為重要，SIRT5 缺乏的小鼠在這種條件下顯示升高的氨。它例示了 SIRT5 作為粒線體醯基代謝和氮穩態調節者的角色，並與其對 HMGCS2、脂肪酸氧化酶和 TCA 循環脫氫酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為營養匱乏期間分解代謝通量的協調者。

label: LCAD and ACADS (fatty acid β-oxidation)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates multiple fatty-acid β-oxidation enzymes including LCAD and ACADS, coordinating mitochondrial lipid catabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates these acyl-CoA dehydrogenases. This supports energy harvest from fat, and it exemplifies SIRT5's broad desuccinylase control of metabolism. By activating the enzymes of β-oxidation, SIRT5 promotes the use of fatty acids as fuel, particularly during fasting. This catabolic role aligns SIRT5 with SIRT3 in supporting lipid oxidation, in contrast to SIRT4's inhibition of the same pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化多種脂肪酸 β-氧化酶，包括 LCAD 和 ACADS，協調粒線體脂質分解代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化這些醯基-CoA 脫氫酶。這支持從脂肪獲取能量，並體現了 SIRT5 對代謝的廣泛去琥醯化酶控制。透過活化 β-氧化酶，SIRT5 促進脂肪酸作為燃料的使用，特別是在禁食期間。這種分解代謝角色使 SIRT5 與 SIRT3 在支持脂質氧化方面一致，與 SIRT4 對相同途徑的抑制形成對比。

label: SOD1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1), increasing its activity and thereby enhancing cytosolic antioxidant defense. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates SOD1. This extends sirtuin control of antioxidant enzymes beyond SIRT3's activation of mitochondrial MnSOD/IDH2.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯基化超氧化物歧化酶 1（SOD1），增加其活性，從而增強細胞質抗氧化防禦。方向性上 SIRT5 以酵素方式活化 SIRT1。這將 sirtuin 對抗氧化酵素的控制從 SIRT3 對粒線體 MnSOD/IDH2 的活化延伸到更廣泛的範圍。

label: GLS (glutaminase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 inhibits glutaminase (GLS) via desuccinylation, suppressing glutaminolysis in cancer metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化抑制穀氨醯胺酶（GLS），抑制癌症代謝中的穀氨醯胺分解。

label: Preadipocyte differentiation
description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation and lipid deposition by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of suppressed adipogenesis. This keeps progenitors from becoming lipid-laden fat cells and positions mitochondrial SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat accumulation. The AMPK arm likely raises NAD+ and reinforces catabolic metabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the mitogenic signaling required for adipocyte maturation. SIRT5's anti-adipogenic function is consistent with the sirtuin family's general opposition to lipid storage and its promotion of oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 通過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 信號通路來抑制前脂肪細胞分化和脂質沉積。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於被抑制的脂肪生成的上游。這防止前體細胞成為富含脂質的脂肪細胞，將粒線體 SIRT5 定位為脂肪累積的負調節因子。AMPK 分支可能提高 NAD+ 並強化分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的促有絲分裂信號。SIRT5 的抗脂肪生成功能與 sirtuin 家族對脂質儲存的一般反對和對氧化代謝的促進一致。

label: AMPK (preadipocyte differentiation)
description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling, analogous to its broader adipogenesis-blocking role. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of AMPK activation in adipogenic progenitors. Activated AMPK shifts cells away from lipogenesis and toward catabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the proliferative signals needed for adipocyte maturation. It reaffirms SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat formation, and it is consistent with the general anti-adipogenic theme across sirtuins. By restraining adipocyte differentiation, SIRT5 contributes to the maintenance of metabolic flexibility and the prevention of excessive fat accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 訊號來抑制前脂肪細胞分化，類似於其更廣泛的脂肪生成阻斷角色。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於脂肪生成前體細胞中 AMPK 活化的上游。活化的 AMPK 使細胞從脂肪生成轉向分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的增殖訊號。它再次確認 SIRT5 作為脂肪形成的負調節因子，與 sirtuin 整體的抗脂肪生成主題一致。透過抑制脂肪細胞分化，SIRT5 有助於維護代謝靈活性和預防過度脂肪積累。

label: breast tumor, HCC, and NSCLC cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is important in the growth of breast tumour cells, hepatocellular carcinoma, and human non-small cell lung cancer tissues. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of tumour growth in these cancer types, and its overexpression indicates a poor prognosis in human non-small cell lung cancer. SIRT5 thereby acts as a tumour-promoting factor in breast cancer, HCC, and lung cancer, making it a candidate therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在乳腺腫瘤細胞、肝細胞癌和人類非小細胞肺癌組織的生長中很重要。方向上，SIRT5位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤生長的上游，其過表達在人類非小細胞肺癌中預示不良預後。因此SIRT5在乳腺癌、HCC和肺癌中作為促腫瘤因子，使其成為候選治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class III (prokaryotic origin)
description: SIRT5 is the sole mammalian member of phylogenetic Class III, a group distributed widely across prokaryotes, marking it as one of the most ancient mammalian sirtuins. Directionally, this is an evolutionary classification. Its prokaryotic origin aligns with SIRT5's fundamental mitochondrial metabolic functions, and this situates SIRT5 at the root of sirtuin biology. Because Class III sirtuins predate the eukaryotic sirtuins, SIRT5's desuccinylase activity may represent an ancestral enzymatic function retained through evolution. SIRT5's phylogenetic position helps explain its resistance to nicotinamide inhibition and its distinct substrate preferences.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 是系統發育 III 類唯一的哺乳動物成員，該類群廣泛分布於原核生物中，標誌著它是最古老的哺乳動物 sirtuin 之一。在方向性上，這是演化分類。其原核生物起源與 SIRT5 基本的粒線體代謝功能一致，並將 SIRT5 置於 sirtuin 生物學的根源。由於 III 類 sirtuin 先於真核 sirtuin，SIRT5 的去琥珀醯酶活性可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶功能。SIRT5 的系統發育位置有助於解釋其對菸鹼醯胺抑制的抗性和其獨特的底物偏好。

label: SHMT2 desuccinylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is upregulated during cellular transformation and is involved in cancer and its proliferation by desuccinylating serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2). Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SHMT2 sits upstream of enhanced one-carbon metabolism and cancer cell proliferation. By activating SHMT2, SIRT5 supports the biosynthetic demands of proliferating cancer cells, contributing to tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在細胞轉化期間上調，並透過去琥珀醯化絲氨酸羥甲基轉移酶2（SHMT2）參與癌症及其增殖。方向上，SIRT5對SHMT2的去琥珀醯化位於一碳代謝增強和癌細胞增殖的上游。透過活化SHMT2，SIRT5支持增殖癌細胞的生物合成需求，促成腫瘤發生。

label: ammonia detoxification
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 mediates ammonia detoxification by activating CPS1 in the urea cycle, converting ammonia to urea; this is critical during fasting and high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過在尿素循環中活化 CPS1 來調介氨解毒，將氨轉化為尿素；這在禁食和高蛋白負荷期間至關重要，因為此時必須清除氮。

label: intracellular signaling
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 participates in intracellular signaling by deacylating metabolic enzymes and transcription-linked targets (e.g., FOXO3a, SOD1) and by modulating AMPK, linking mitochondrial acylation state to cellular signaling and redox responses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去酰基化代謝酶和轉錄相關靶點（例如 FOXO3a、SOD1）以及調節 AMPK 來參與細胞內信號傳導，將粒線體酰化狀態與細胞信號和氧化還原反應聯繫起來。

label: bile acid metabolism orchestration
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 prevents tumor immune evasion and suppresses the development of hepatocellular carcinoma by orchestrating bile acid metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of anti-tumor immunity and restrained HCC growth. By shaping the bile acid milieu, SIRT5 influences the immune microenvironment of the liver tumor, reducing the ability of HCC to evade immune destruction. This tumor-suppressive metabolic function contrasts with SIRT5's glycolysis-reprogramming role that can promote HCC growth, reflecting SIRT5's context-dependent effects in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過協調膽汁酸代謝來預防腫瘤免疫逃逸並抑制肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT5位於抗腫瘤免疫和HCC生長抑制的上游。透過塑造膽汁酸環境，SIRT5影響肝腫瘤的免疫微環境，降低HCC逃避免疫破壞的能力。此腫瘤抑制性代謝功能與SIRT5促進HCC生長的糖解重編程角色形成對比，反映了SIRT5在肝癌中的環境依賴性效果。

label: Nrf2/HO-1 pathway (ovarian cancer)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 promotes cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner through regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of Nrf2-mediated chemoresistance. By activating this antioxidant program, SIRT5 helps cancer cells neutralize the reactive oxygen species that contribute to cisplatin-induced DNA damage. This reduces the genotoxic burden of the drug and blunts its cytotoxicity, allowing tumor cells to survive treatment. Inhibiting SIRT5, therefore, could re-sensitize ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin by dismantling their antioxidant defenses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷，從而促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於Nrf2介導的化療耐藥性的上游。透過活化此抗氧化程序，SIRT5幫助癌細胞中和促成順鉑誘導的DNA損傷的活性氧。這降低了藥物的基因毒性負荷並削弱其細胞毒性，使腫瘤細胞能够在治療中存活。因此抑制SIRT5可能透過瓦解其抗氧化防禦來使卵巢癌細胞對順鉑重新敏感。

label: ATP synthesis regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 supports ATP synthesis by desuccinylating electron-transport and TCA-cycle enzymes, maintaining mitochondrial function; its loss compromises energy production under metabolic stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化電子傳輸和 TCA 循環酶來支持 ATP 合成，維持粒線體功能；其缺失在代謝壓力下損害能量產生。

label: LDHB
description: SIRT5-induced deacetylation of lactate dehydrogenase B (LDHB) triggers hyperactivation of autophagy, a process implicated in tumorigenesis. Directionally, SIRT5 modifies LDHB, which promotes autophagic hyperactivation. This connects mitochondrial acyl-metabolism control to lysosomal clearance, and the net effect can be context-dependent in cancer biology, supporting tumor-cell fitness under stress in some settings while potentially contributing to cell death in others. SIRT5's regulation of LDHB, a key enzyme of lactate metabolism, links metabolic enzymes to the autophagic program and illustrates the broad substrate repertoire of the desuccinylase.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 誘導的乳酸脫氫酶 B（LDHB）去乙醯化觸發自噬過度活化，此過程與腫瘤發生有關。在方向性上，SIRT5 修飾 LDHB，進而促進自噬過度活化。這將粒線體醯基代謝控制與溶酶體清除聯繫起來，淨效應可能因癌症生物學的情境而異，在某些情況下支持腫瘤細胞在壓力下的適應性，而在其他情況下可能促進細胞死亡。SIRT5 對乳酸代謝關鍵酶 LDHB 的調控將代謝酶與自噬程式聯繫起來，並展現了去琥珀醯酶的廣泛底物譜。

label: LMO2 deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Inhibition of SIRT2 suppresses the in vitro growth and in vivo engraftment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells through diminished deacetylation of LIM domain only 2 (LMO2). Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of LMO2-dependent leukemia suppression. LMO2 is a key oncogenic transcription factor in T-ALL, and its activity depends on deacetylation by SIRT2. Blocking SIRT2 reduces LMO2 function, impairing both the expansion of leukemic cells in culture and their ability to engraft in vivo. This identifies SIRT2 inhibition as a promising approach for T-ALL therapy, targeting a central oncogenic driver in this disease.
description_zh_TW: 抑制SIRT2透過減少LIM domain only 2（LMO2）的去乙醯化來抑制T細胞急性淋巴性白血病細胞的體外生長和體內植入。方向上，SIRT2抑制位於LMO2依賴性白血病抑制的上游。LMO2是T-ALL中的關鍵致癌轉錄因子，其活性依賴SIRT2的去乙醯化。阻斷SIRT2降低LMO2功能，損害白血病細胞在培養中的擴增和在體內的植入能力。這將SIRT2抑制確定為T-ALL治療的有前景方法，靶向此疾病中的核心致癌驅動因子。

label: Resistance to microtubule inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 inhibition or downregulation appears counterproductive in certain cancer contexts, particularly when combined with microtubule inhibitors, because loss of SIRT2 prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and makes cancer cells resistant to these agents. The enzyme normally helps cells exit mitosis cleanly; without it, cells linger in a prolonged arrested state that selects for survival. Directionally, low SIRT2 activity sits upstream of this resistance phenotype. This caveat limits the general anticancer rationale for SIRT2 inhibition and argues for careful context- and regimen-specific use.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制或下調在某些癌症情境中看似適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合併使用時，因為 SIRT2 的缺失延長了慢性有絲分裂停滯，使癌細胞對這些藥物產生抗性。該酵素正常情況下幫助細胞順利退出有絲分裂；沒有它時，細胞會停留在延長的停滯狀態中，有利於存活。方向性上低 SIRT2 活性位於此抗性表型的上游。這一注意事項限制了 SIRT2 抑制的通用抗癌依據，並主張在使用時需謹慎考慮具體情境和治療方案。

label: NAD+ Metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SARS-CoV-2 infected cell lines of a ferret and lungs of deceased patients showed disturbed NAD+ metabolism and gene expression with respect to synthesis and utilization of NAD+. During infection, the expression of the NMRK1 pathway was upregulated together with the concentrative nucleoside transporter CNT3, indicating a higher capacity for NR conversion to NAD+ and NADP+, while the expression of NNMT (nicotinamide N-methyltransferase) was decreased, suggesting promotion of the NAM salvage pathway.
description_zh_TW: 雪貂的 SARS-CoV-2 感染細胞株與死亡患者的肺臟顯示出 NAD+ 代謝以及 NAD+ 合成與利用相關基因表現的紊亂。在感染期間，NMRK1 路徑的表現與濃縮型核苷轉運蛋白 CNT3 一同上調，顯示 NR 轉化為 NAD+ 與 NADP+ 的能力提升，而 NNMT（nicotinamide N-methyltransferase，菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶）的表現降低，暗示 NAM 回收路徑受到促進。

label: Lymphopenia
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SARS-CoV-2 infection triggers a maladaptive immune response, notably an exaggerated proinflammatory response leading to a cytokine storm in lung tissue, and lymphopenia with a drastic decline of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells. Upon activation of the adaptive immune response, the overexpression of CD38 in both CD4+ and CD8+ lymphocytes further exaggerates NAD+ depletion, leading to increased production and release of proinflammatory cytokines, reactive oxygen species, and macrophage infiltration. Drastic NAD+ depletion impairs sirtuin function, and replenishment of NAD+ body content could restore energy levels and impaired sirtuin function, possibly rebalancing the maladaptive immune response to
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 感染觸發適應不良的免疫反應，特別是誇大的促發炎反應導致肺組織中的細胞激素風暴，以及淋巴球減少伴隨 CD4+ 與 CD8+ T 細胞的急劇下降。在適應性免疫反應活化後，CD38 在 CD4+ 與 CD8+ 淋巴球中的過度表現進一步加劇 NAD+ 耗竭，導致促發炎性細胞激素、活性氧與巨噬細胞浸潤的產生與釋放增加。急劇的 NAD+ 耗竭損害 sirtuin 功能，而補充體內 NAD+ 含量可恢復能量水平與受損的 sirtuin 功能，可能重新平衡此適應不良免疫反應至

label: Rag proteins
description: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation, positioning mTORC1 for activation; amino-acid starvation inactivates Rags and disperses mTORC1, de-repressing autophagy. The Rags therefore act as amino-acid sensors that bridge nutrient availability to mTORC1 spatial activation. Their regulation by the Ragulator and GAPs (e.g., GATOR complexes) is central to nutrient signaling.
description_zh_TW: Rag GTPases（RagA/B 和 RagC/D）作為異二聚體發揮功能，結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重新定位至活化劑 Rheb 所在的溶酶體表面。胺基酸充足有利於活化的 Rag 構象，將 mTORC1 定位以進行活化；胺基酸飢餓則使 Rags 失活並分散 mTORC1，解除對自噬的抑制。因此 Rags 作為胺基酸感測器，將營養可得性橋接到 mTORC1 的空間活化。它們受 Ragulator 和 GAPs（例如 GATOR 複合物）調節，是營養信號的核心。

label: Ragulator
description: The Ragulator is a multiprotein scaffold anchored at the lysosomal membrane that interacts with Rag GTPases to recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acids. By tethering the Rag-mTORC1 complex at the lysosome, Ragulator enables amino-acid sensing to converge with Rheb-mediated activation. Loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. The complex is therefore the lynchpin coupling lysosomal amino-acid detection to mTORC1 and autophagy control.
description_zh_TW: Ragulator 是錨定於溶酶體膜上的多蛋白支架，與 Rag GTPases 交互作用，以回應胺基酸將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體表面。透過將 Rag-mTORC1 複合物栓繫於溶酶體，Ragulator 使得胺基酸感知能與 Rheb 介導的活化匯聚。Ragulator 的缺失會破壞依賴營養的 mTORC1 信號並解除對自噬的抑制。因此該複合物是將溶酶體胺基酸偵測連結至 mTORC1 與自噬控制的關鍵樞紐。

label: OAADPr (2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose)
description: During the sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation of a lysine, NAD+ is cleaved between its nicotinamide and ADP-ribose moieties, and the acetyl group is transferred to the ADP-ribose to generate 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose (OAADPr) plus free nicotinamide. OAADPr is a stoichiometric by-product, released in equimolar amounts with the deacetylated substrate on every catalytic cycle. This molecule is not merely waste: it binds and activates the TRPM2 cation channel, linking sirtuin activity to calcium signaling and cellular stress responses. A caveat is that OAADPr accumulation can itself feed back on cellular metabolism, and its levels reflect the integrated deacetylase flux of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 在 sirtuin 催化的離胺酸去乙醯化過程中，NAD+ 在菸鹼醯胺和 ADP-核糖基團之間被裂解，乙醯基被轉移到 ADP-核糖上，生成 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose（OAADPr）和游離的菸鹼醯胺。OAADPr 是化學計量的副產物，在每個催化週期中以等摩爾量與去乙醯化的受質一起釋放。這個分子不僅僅是廢物：它能結合並活化 TRPM2 陽離子通道，將 sirtuin 活性與鈣離子訊號傳導和細胞壓力反應聯繫起來。需要注意的是，OAADPr 的積累本身可以反饋影響細胞代謝，其水平反映了細胞整體的去乙醯酶通量。

label: NAM (nicotinamide) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation couples the cleavage of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues. Each round of deacetylation converts one molecule of NAD+ into nicotinamide (NAM) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. NAM then acts as an end-product inhibitor of sirtuins by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to the NAD+ site, thereby blocking further NAD+ hydrolysis. This product-based feedback links cellular NAD+ status and NAM levels directly to sirtuin enzymatic output.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin催化的去乙醯化反應將NAD+的裂解與賴氨酸殘基上乙醯基的移除耦合。每輪去乙醯化將一分子NAD+轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM）和O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。NAM隨後作為sirtuin的末端產物抑制劑，結合到與NAD+位點相鄰的保守口袋，從而阻斷進一步的NAD+水解。這種基於產物的反饋直接將細胞NAD+狀態和NAM水平與sirtuin酵素輸出聯繫起來。

label: p53 (via hyperacetylation)
description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

label: Xenograft models
description: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6 significantly delay tumor growth in human cancer mouse xenografts at single-digit micromolar concentrations. Directionally, Tenovin treatment sits upstream of reduced tumor growth. This effect is attributed to p53 reactivation and sirtuin inhibition, and it validates sirtuin inhibition as an anticancer strategy in p53-wild-type tumors. The xenograft data demonstrate that sirtuin inhibitors can exert anti-tumor efficacy in vivo, complementing the extensive in vitro evidence. These results support the continued development of sirtuin inhibitors for oncology, particularly in combination with DNA-damaging agents.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin-1 和 Tenovin-6 在個位數微摩爾濃度下顯著延緩人腫瘤小鼠異種移植模型中的腫瘤生長。在方向性上，Tenovin 治療位於減少腫瘤生長的上游。此效應歸因於 p53 重新活化和 sirtuin 抑制，驗證了 sirtuin 抑制作為 p53 野生型腫瘤抗癌策略。異種移植數據表明 sirtuin 抑制劑可以在體內發揮抗腫瘤療效，與大量體外證據互補。這些結果支持繼續開發用於腫瘤學的 sirtuin 抑制劑，特別是與 DNA 損傷藥物的組合使用。

label: Pathological fibrosis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: TGF-β1 activates SMAD3-dependent transcription of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1, ACTA2, and TIMP1, driving collagen deposition and tissue scarring in multiple organs. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of fibrogenesis. This makes TGF-β1 a central target in fibrosis therapeutics, and sirtuins that inhibit SMAD3 signaling, such as SIRT6 and SIRT7, are antifibrotic. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic organ injury, understanding the TGF-β1/SMAD3 axis is central to developing treatments for heart, lung, kidney, and liver fibrosis. Sirtuin activation is emerging as one such strategy.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β1 活化 SMAD3 依賴性的促纖維化基因轉錄，包括 COL1A1、COL3A1、FN1、ACTA2 和 TIMP1，驅動多個器官的膠原沉積和組織疤痕形成。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於纖維化生成的上游。這使 TGF-β1 成為纖維化治療的核心靶標，而抑制 SMAD3 訊號的 sirtuin（如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7）具有抗纖維化作用。由於纖維化是慢性器官損傷的共同最終通路，理解 TGF-β1/SMAD3 軸線對開發心臟、肺、腎臟和肝臟纖維化的治療至關重要。Sirtuin 活化正成為此類策略之一。

label: PEX gene mutations
description: Zellweger syndrome, the most severe form of the Zellweger spectrum of peroxisome biogenesis disorders, is caused by mutations in PEX genes required for peroxisome assembly and matrix protein import. Affected individuals lack functional peroxisomes, leading to accumulation of very-long-chain fatty acids, bile acid intermediates, and pipecolic acid, with profound neurologic, hepatic, and skeletal abnormalities. The spectrum's severity correlates with the degree of residual peroxisomal function. These disorders highlight the non-redundant essentiality of peroxisomes in human development.
description_zh_TW: Zellweger 症候群是 Zellweger 譜系過氧化體生物發生障礙中最嚴重的形式，由組裝過氧化體和基質蛋白輸入所需的 PEX 基因突變所引起。患者缺乏功能性過氧化體，導致極長鏈脂肪酸、膽汁酸中間物和哌可酸（pipecolic acid）累積，伴隨嚴重的神經、肝臟和骨骼異常。此譜系的嚴重程度與殘餘過氧化體功能程度相關。這些障礙凸顯了過氧化體在人類發育中非冗余的必要性。

label: PEX1 mutation
description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

label: 14-3-3 protein
description: Once TFEB is phosphorylated at serine 211 by mTORC1, 14-3-3 proteins bind the phosphorylated motif and mask the transcription factor's nuclear localization signal. This cytosolic sequestration prevents TFEB from accessing CLEAR elements in the nucleus, thereby suppressing expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The 14-3-3 interaction thereby converts a single phosphorylation event into a durable spatial exclusion of TFEB. Disruption of this complex is a key step in starvation- and drug-induced TFEB activation.
description_zh_TW: 一旦 TFEB 被 mTORC1 在 serine 211 磷酸化，14-3-3 蛋白即結合該磷酸化基序並遮蔽轉錄因子的核定位信號。這種細胞質隔離阻止 TFEB 接近核內的 CLEAR 元件，從而抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現。14-3-3 的交互作用因此將單一磷酸化事件轉化為對 TFEB 的持久空間排除。此複合體的破壞是飢餓和藥物誘導 TFEB 活化中的關鍵步驟。

label: TFEB in cytosol
description: Once TFEB is phosphorylated at serine 211 by mTORC1, 14-3-3 proteins bind the phosphorylated motif and mask the transcription factor's nuclear localization signal. This cytosolic sequestration prevents TFEB from accessing CLEAR elements in the nucleus, thereby suppressing expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The 14-3-3 interaction thereby converts a single phosphorylation event into a durable spatial exclusion of TFEB. Disruption of this complex is a key step in starvation- and drug-induced TFEB activation.
description_zh_TW: 一旦 TFEB 被 mTORC1 在 serine 211 磷酸化，14-3-3 蛋白即結合該磷酸化基序並遮蔽轉錄因子的核定位信號。這種細胞質隔離阻止 TFEB 接近核內的 CLEAR 元件，從而抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現。14-3-3 的交互作用因此將單一磷酸化事件轉化為對 TFEB 的持久空間排除。此複合體的破壞是飢餓和藥物誘導 TFEB 活化中的關鍵步驟。

label: 20% of human cancers
description: The human SIRT3 gene is deleted in up to 20% of all human cancers analyzed overall, and in up to 40% of breast and ovarian cancers. This frequent deletion establishes SIRT3 as a tumor suppressor that acts through reactive oxygen species suppression and metabolic regulation. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of increased tumorigenesis susceptibility. By removing mitochondrial antioxidant protection, deletion of SIRT3 raises oxidative stress that can drive oncogenic signaling and genomic damage. The high deletion frequency, especially in breast and ovarian cancer, suggests SIRT3 status is an important determinant of cancer risk and may have prognostic value.
description_zh_TW: 人類SIRT3基因在所分析的所有人類癌症中高達20%被刪除，在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中高達40%被刪除。這種高頻率的刪除確立了SIRT3作為透過活性氧抑制和代謝調節發揮作用的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT3缺失位於腫瘤發生易感性增加的上游。透過移除粒線體抗氧化保護，SIRT3的刪除增加了可驅動致癌訊號和基因組損傷的氧化壓力。高頻率的刪除，特別是在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中，表明SIRT3狀態是癌症風險的重要決定因素，可能具有預後價值。

label: G6PD deficiency
description: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes. Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis. In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen.
description_zh_TW: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes。Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis。In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen。

label: Methemoglobin Reductase
description: Methylene blue, at low doses, serves as a cofactor that enhances the activity of the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, allowing it to reduce methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin. This mechanism is the basis for methylene blue's role as the first-line treatment for symptomatic methemoglobinemia. Because it relies on NADPH generated by the pentose phosphate pathway, methylene blue can be ineffective or dangerous in G6PD-deficient patients, where NADPH production is impaired and the drug instead risks precipitating hemolysis.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue, at low doses, serves as a cofactor that enhances the activity of the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, allowing it to reduce methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin。This mechanism is the basis for methylene blue's role as the first-line treatment for symptomatic methemoglobinemia。Because it relies on NADPH generated by the pentose phosphate pathway, methylene blue can be ineffective or dangerous in G6PD-deficient patients, where NADPH production is impaired and the drug instead risks precipitating hemolysis。

label: Depression
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: A 2015 randomized controlled trial found that low-dose methylene blue reduced anxiety and depression scores compared to placebo in a clinical population, providing the cleanest human evidence for mood benefits. The mood-relevant dose range in research is 0.5-2 mg, which provides enough MAOI activity for mild anxiolytic and mood-stabilizing effects. Because methylene blue's mood effects come primarily from its monoamine oxidase inhibition - increasing synaptic serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine - it carries the same drug-interaction risks as prescription MAOIs, and combining it with any serotonergic medication can potentially trigger serotonin syndrome, making physician supervision essential.
description_zh_TW: 2015 年一項隨機對照試驗發現，低劑量亞甲基藍在臨床人群中可降低焦慮和抑鬱分數，與安慰劑相比，提供了最乾淨的人類情緒益處證據。研究中與情緒相關的劑量範圍為 0.5-2 mg，提供足夠的 MAOI 活性以產生輕度抗焦慮和情緒穩定效果。由於亞甲基藍的情緒效果主要來自其單胺氧化酶抑制作用——增加突觸中的血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素——它與處方 MAOIs 具有相同的藥物交互作用風險，與任何血清素能藥物結合可能引發血清素症候群，因此需要醫師監督。

label: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain
description: At the cellular level, methylene blue can bypass dysfunctional components of the mitochondrial electron transport chain by shuttling electrons from NADH, in the presence of Complex I, and donating them directly to cytochrome c, effectively bypassing complexes I through III. This alternative electron transfer pathway enhances mitochondrial respiration, increases oxygen consumption, reduces mitochondrial superoxide production, and mitigates oxidative stress. These mechanisms underlie the neuroprotective effects of methylene blue in conditions such as Alzheimer disease, Parkinson disease, traumatic brain injury, and ischemic stroke.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞水平，methylene blue可以通過在複合物I存在下從NADH穿梭電子，並直接將其捐贈給細胞色素c，有效地繞過複合物I至III，從而繞過粒線體電子傳遞鏈中功能障礙的組件。這種替代電子轉運路徑增強粒線體呼吸，增加氧氣消耗，減少粒線體超氧化物產生，並減輕氧化應激。這些機制是methylene blue在阿茲海默病、帕金森病、創傷性腦缺血和缺血性中風等疾病中發揮神經保護作用的基礎。

label: Chlorpromazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Chlorpromazine, a phenothiazine carrying an amine side chain on its 10-nitrogen, was the only compound among those tested that failed to protect HT-22 cells in the rotenone neurotoxicity model. The 10-N substitution causes a roughly 1000-fold loss of potency relative to methylene blue in glutamate, IAA, and rotenone assays, and abolishes the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt, oxygen consumption enhancement, and glycolysis suppression. In the lysate oxidation assay chlorpromazine increased DCF fluorescence with or without mitochondria and NADH, behaving as a pro-oxidant and explaining its weak neuroprotection.
description_zh_TW: 氯丙嗪（chlorpromazine）是在其10-氮上帶有胺側鏈的吩噻嗪（phenothiazine），是受測化合物中唯一無法在魚藤酮（rotenone）神經毒性模型中保護HT-22細胞的化合物。與亞甲藍（methylene blue）相比，10-N取代在麩胺酸（glutamate）、IAA與魚藤酮試驗中造成約1000倍的效力損失，並消除複合體I至細胞色素c的電子分流、耗氧量增強與糖解抑制。在裂解液氧化試驗中，氯丙嗪在有或無粒線體與NADH的情況下皆增加DCF螢光，表現出促氧化劑（pro-oxidant）行為，這解釋了其微弱的神經保護作用。

label: Serotonin Syndrome
description: Combining methylene blue with serotonergic medications can potentially trigger serotonin syndrome, the most serious safety concern associated with the compound. Because methylene blue is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, stacking it with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs can increase serotonin to dangerous levels. This is a documented, case-report-level interaction, not a theoretical risk - if a person is on antidepressants, a physician must be involved before taking even a single milligram of methylene blue. The risk rises significantly at higher doses (above 7-10 mg) and with any concurrent serotonergic medication, making serotonin interaction screening an essential part of any protocol.
description_zh_TW: 將亞甲基藍與血清素能藥物結合可能引發血清素症候群，這是與該化合物相關的最嚴重安全問題。由於亞甲基藍是單胺氧化酶抑制劑，與 SSRI、SNRI、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物疊加可能將血清素提升至危險水平。這是 documented、case-report 級別的交互作用，而非理論風險——如果一個人正在服用抗抑鬱藥，醫師必須參與後才能服用 even a single milligram 的亞甲基藍。風險在 higher doses（7-10 mg 以上）和任何 concurrent 血清素能藥物時顯著上升，使得血清素交互作用篩查成為任何方案的 essential 部分。

label: Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase
description: Due to the risk of hemolysis and worsening anemia, methylene blue is contraindicated in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency. The hemolysis associated with methylene blue is mechanistically linked to its oxidative properties that overwhelm erythrocyte antioxidant defenses, and G6PD-deficient individuals have impaired NADPH generation that limits glutathione regeneration, rendering red blood cells unable to counteract oxidative stress and predisposing to rapid hemolysis. Methylene blue is also contraindicated in individuals with a known history of anaphylaxis or severe hypersensitivity to methylene blue or related thiazine dye products.
description_zh_TW: 由於溶血和貧血惡化的風險，methylene blue在葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶缺乏症患者中是禁忌的。與methylene blue相關的溶血在機制上與其氧化特性有關，這些特性壓倒紅血球的抗氧化防禦，而G6PD缺乏個體的NADPH生成受損，限制了谷胱甘肽再生，使紅血球無法對抗氧化應激，易於快速溶血。Methylene blue在已知有對methylene blue或相關噻嗪染料產品過敏或嚴重超敏反應病史的個體中也是禁忌的。

label: Mitochondrial Superoxide
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) attenuates mitochondrial superoxide production by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III, preventing electron backflow and premature electron leak to oxygen at these upstream sites. In HT-22 hippocampal neurons challenged with glutamate, MB dose-dependently suppressed the rise in mitochondrial ROS (EC50 ~20.37 nM), as measured by H2DCFDA, flow cytometry, and fluorescent microscopy. The reduced form leuco-MB can also directly scavenge superoxide and recycle back to oxidized MB, making MB a regenerable, mitochondria-specific antioxidant.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 通過作為替代電子傳遞載體，繞過複合體 I-III，減少線粒體超氧化物的產生，防止電子回流和提前洩漏到這些上游位點的氧氣。在 HT-22 海馬神經元中挑戰穀氨酸，MB 以劑量依賴方式抑制線粒體 ROS 的上升（EC50 ~20.37 nM），通過 H2DCFDA、流式細胞術和螢光顯微鏡測量。還原型 leuco-MB 也能直接清除超氧化物並回收為氧化型 MB，使 MB 成為可再生的、線粒體特異性抗氧化劑。

label: NADH
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) functions as an alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer carrier. It accepts electrons from NADH, likely via mitochondrial complex I, and is reduced to the leuco form (leuco-MB). It then donates those electrons onward to cytochrome c, bypassing the intermediate electron-transport chain complexes. This NADH-dependent reduction is what makes MB's mitochondrial antioxidant activity mitochondria-specific: in cell-free assays MB only reduces oxidative stress when both NADH and mitochondrial lysate are present, whereas classical chain-breaking antioxidants act independently of the electron transport chain.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)作為粒線體電子轉運的替代載體發揮作用。它從NADH接受電子，可能通過粒線體複合物I，並還原為無色形式（leuco-MB）。然後它將這些電子傳遞給細胞色素c，繞過中間的電子傳遞鏈複合物。這種NADH依賴性還原使得MB的粒線體抗氧化活性具有粒線體特異性：在無細胞測定中，只有當NADH和粒線體裂解液同時存在時，MB才能減少氧化應激，而經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑則獨立於電子傳遞鏈發揮作用。

label: LeucoMB
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is reduced to its colorless leuco form, leuco-MB, upon accepting electrons from NADH via mitochondrial complex I. In this reduced state leuco-MB functions as a direct free-radical scavenger, capable of neutralizing superoxide generated by inhibition of the electron transport chain, and it then recycles back to the oxidized form of MB. This reduction-oxidation cycle makes MB a regenerable, mitochondria-specific antioxidant, distinct from one-use chain-breaking antioxidants. The requirement for NADH and mitochondria distinguishes MB's antioxidant action from that of simpler phenothiazine derivatives.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在通過粒線體複合物I從NADH接受電子後還原為其無色的leuco形式，leuco-MB。在這種還原狀態下，leuco-MB作為直接的自由基清除劑發揮作用，能夠中和由電子傳遞鏈抑制產生的超氧化物，然後它循環回MB的氧化形式。這種還原-氧化循環使MB成為一種可再生的、粒線體特異性的抗氧化劑，與一次性鏈斷裂抗氧化劑不同。對NADH和粒線體的要求將MB的抗氧化作用與更簡單的吩噻嗪衍生物區分開來。

label: Phenothiazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is the first lead chemical structure of the phenothiazine class, the parent heterocyclic scaffold from which many other drugs derive. Structure-activity analysis showed that MB's distinctive neuroprotective and bioenergetic phenotype requires two structural features of the phenothiazine nucleus: a free (unsubstituted) 10-nitrogen and the position-5 sulfur of the thiazine ring. Adding an amine side chain to the 10-nitrogen (as in chlorpromazine or promethazine) produced roughly a 1000-fold loss of potency and abolished the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)是吩噻嗪類的第一個先導化學結構，是許多其他藥物衍生的母體雜環骨架。結構-活性分析表明，MB獨特的神經保護和生物能量表型需要吩噻嗪核的兩個結構特徵：游離（未取代的）10-氮和噻嗪環的5位硫。將胺側鏈添加到10-氮（如chlorpromazine或promethazine中）導致效力損失約1000倍，並廢除了複合物I到細胞色素c的電子分流。

label: Iodoacetic Acid
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) protects HT-22 cells against iodoacetic acid (IAA)-induced neurotoxicity. IAA is a toxic acetate derivative that inhibits glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate dehydrogenase and disrupts disulfide bonds, causing increased ROS and lipid peroxidation. MB increased cell viability against IAA at concentrations of 100 nM and 1 uM (though it lost protection at 10 uM), and all MB-related compounds tested were efficacious in this assay. MB's protection in the IAA model, together with the glutamate and rotenone models, demonstrates broad efficacy against mitochondrial and oxidative insults.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 可保護 HT-22 細胞免受碘乙酸 (IAA) 誘導的神經毒性。IAA 是一種有毒的醋酸鹽衍生物，可抑制甘油醛 3-磷酸脫氫酶並破壞二硫鍵，導致 ROS 和脂質過氧化增加。MB 在 100 nM 和 1 uM 濃度下可提高細胞對 IAA 的存活率（但在 10 uM 時失去保護作用），且所有測試的 MB 相關化合物在此檢測中均有效。MB 在 IAA 模型中的保護作用，加上穀氨酸和魚藤酮模型，證明其對線粒體和氧化損傷具有廣泛功效。

label: Glucose Oxidase
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) provides no protection against direct extracellular oxidative stress generated by glucose oxidase, which produces hydrogen peroxide in the culture medium. In HT-22 cells, glucose oxidase induced 80% cell death within 3 hours that was not attenuated by MB at any concentration tested, whereas the conventional antioxidant pyruvate (4 mM) provided robust protection. This distinguishes MB from classical chain-breaking antioxidants: MB acts upstream on mitochondrial electron flow rather than as a direct scavenger of extracellular hydrogen peroxide.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)對葡萄糖氧化酶產生的直接細胞外氧化應激沒有提供保護作用，葡萄糖氧化酶在培養基中產生過氧化氫。在HT-22細胞中，葡萄糖氧化酶在3小時內誘導80%的細胞死亡，這在任何測試濃度下都沒有被MB減弱，而傳統抗氧化劑丙酮酸（4 mM）提供了強大的保護作用。這將MB與經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑區分開來：MB在粒線體電子流的上游起作用，而不是作為細胞外過氧化氫的直接清除劑。

label: Glutamate
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) provides potent neuroprotection against glutamate-induced oxidative toxicity in HT-22 hippocampal neurons, a model in which glutamate blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter and depletes cellular glutathione. MB was protective in both MTT and Calcein AM viability assays with an EC50 of 17.81 nM and without altering total glutathione levels. This protection correlated with attenuation of glutamate-induced ROS production and mitochondrial membrane potential depolarization, establishing MB's action as upstream of ROS generation rather than as a direct antioxidant.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在HT-22海馬神經元中提供對谷氨酸誘導的氧化毒性的強大神經保護作用，這是一種谷氨酸阻斷胱氨酸/谷氨酸反向轉運蛋白並耗盡細胞谷胱甘肽的模型。MB在MTT和Calcein AM活力測定中具有保護作用，EC50為17.81 nM，並且不改變總谷胱甘肽水平。這種保護作用與谷氨酸誘導的ROS產生和粒線體膜電位去極化的減弱相關，確立了MB的作用是在ROS產生的上游而不是作為直接抗氧化劑。

label: Complex III
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue can bypass dysfunctional Complex III in the mitochondrial electron transport chain, rerouting electron flow to maintain ATP production when normal respiratory chain pathways are impaired. Together with its ability to bypass Complex I, this makes methylene blue a molecular shunt that sustains oxidative phosphorylation and ATP output in compromised mitochondria. This effect is demonstrated in cellular and animal studies at sub-1 mg/kg doses (roughly 1-4 mg per dose in adults). The mitochondrial longevity data are largely from cells and mice, so human translation is not guaranteed, and most mechanistic evidence remains preclinical.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue可以繞過粒線體電子傳遞鏈中功能障礙的複合物III，在正常呼吸鏈路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP產生。與其繞過複合物I的能力結合，這使得methylene blue成為一種分子分流器，在受損的粒線體中維持氧化磷酸化和ATP輸出。這種效果在細胞和動物研究中以低於1 mg/kg的劑量（成人大約每次1-4毫克）得到證實。粒線體長壽數據主要來自細胞和小鼠，因此不能保證在人體中的轉化，大多數機制證據仍處於臨床前階段。

label: Dose-dependent Toxicity
description: Methylene blue demonstrates clear dose-dependent toxicity thresholds. At single doses of 3 mg/kg or more, hypotension, wheezing, and reduced oxygenation have been reported. Cumulative doses of 7 mg/kg or more can cause significant toxicity including nausea, vomiting, precordial pain, dyspnea, tachypnea, chest tightness, tachycardia, apprehension, tremor, mydriasis, abdominal pain, dizziness, paresthesia, headache, confusion, and mild methemoglobinemia up to 7 percent, with effects lasting 2 to 12 hours. Severe overdosage with a single dose of 20 mg/kg or more has caused severe intravascular hemolysis, hyperbilirubinemia, and death, and there is no specific antidote.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue顯示出明確的劑量依賴性毒性閾值。在單劑量3 mg/kg或更高時，已報告低血壓、喘鳴和氧合減少。累積劑量7 mg/kg或更高可能引起顯著毒性，包括毒性，包括噁心、嘔吐、心前區疼痛、呼吸困難、呼吸急促、胸緊、心動過速、焦慮、震顫、瞳孔散大、腹痛、頭暈、感覺異常、頭痛、意識模糊和輕度methemoglobinemia（高達7%），效果持續2至12小時。單劑量20 mg/kg或更嚴重的過量已導致嚴重的血管內溶血、高膽紅素血癥和死亡，並且沒有特異性解毒劑。

label: Intraoperative Staining
description: Methylene blue has several well-established off-label applications, including intraoperative staining to enhance visualization of structures such as the ureters, parathyroid glands, and sentinel lymph nodes during surgery, including sentinel lymph node mapping in breast cancer and other malignancies. For intraoperative lymph node mapping, 1 to 5 mL of 1 percent methylene blue is injected peritumorally, subareolarly, or pericervically depending on tumor type and anatomical site, and the dye migrates through lymphatic channels to allow visual identification of sentinel lymph nodes to guide surgical staging and resection.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue有幾個well-established的非標籤應用，包括術中染色以增強手術期間結構的可視化，如輸尿管、甲狀旁腺和前哨淋巴結，包括乳腺癌和其他惡性腫瘤中的前哨淋巴結定位。對於術中淋巴結定位，根據腫瘤類型和解剖部位，將1至5毫升1%的methylene blue注入瘤周、乳暈下或宮頸周圍，染料通過淋巴通道遷移，以實現前哨淋巴結的視覺識別，從而指導手術分期和切除。

label: Serotonin
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue increases synaptic serotonin by inhibiting monoamine oxidase enzymes, which normally break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine. Inhibiting these enzymes means more of these neurotransmitters remain in the synapse, which is how antidepressants like phenelzine work. This mechanism provides methylene blue's mild mood-lifting and anxiolytic effects at 0.5-2 mg doses, but it is also the source of its most serious safety concern: combining methylene blue with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome - a documented case-report-level interaction requiring physician involvement.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過抑制單胺氧化酶酶來增加突觸血清素，這些酶通常分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素。抑制這些酶意味著更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中，這就是phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用方式。這種機制在0.5-2毫克劑量下提供methylene blue的輕度情緒提升和抗焦慮作用，但這也是其最嚴重安全問題的來源：將methylene blue與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群——這是一種已記錄的病例報告級別的相互作用，需要醫師參與。

label: Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue interacts dangerously with SSRIs and other serotonergic medications. As a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, methylene blue raises synaptic serotonin, and combining it with SSRIs (or SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs) can increase serotonin to dangerous levels, potentially causing serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern, and the article is emphatic that anyone on an antidepressant or serotonergic drug should not self-dose with methylene blue. If a person is on such medications, physician involvement is required before any dose, and the serotonin interaction screening is cited as a key reason to pursue a supervised protocol.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue與SSRIs和其他血清素能藥物危險地相互作用。作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑，methylene blue提高突觸血清素，將其與SSRIs（或SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物）結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，可能導致血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，文章強調任何服用抗抑鬱藥或血清素能藥物的人都不應自行服用methylene blue。如果一個人正在服用此類藥物，在任何劑量之前都需要醫師參與，並且血清素相互作用篩查被引用為追求監督方案的關鍵原因。

label: Vasoplegic Shock
description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label as adjunctive therapy for refractory vasoplegic shock, including septic and anaphylactic shock, to increase systemic vascular resistance in cases refractory to standard vasopressors, particularly in the setting of cardiac surgery such as coronary artery bypass grafting. It is commonly administered as a single intravenous bolus of 2 mg/kg over 20 to 30 minutes, with some protocols incorporating a bolus followed by continuous infusion. Evidence supporting routine preoperative or postoperative prophylactic use to reduce mortality remains limited, and this practice is not considered standard of care.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療 refractory 血管舒張性休克，包括敗血性和過敏性休克，以增加系統性血管阻力，適用於對標準血管加壓素 refractory 的病例，特別是在心臟手術如冠狀動脈繞道移植術中。通常以 2 mg/kg 劑量靜脈注射推注，持續 20 至 30 分鐘，有些方案包括推注後持續輸注。支持常規術前或術後預防性使用以降低死亡率的證據仍然有限，此實踐不被視為 standard of care。

label: Ifosfamide-induced Encephalopathy
description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label for the treatment of ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, the neurotoxicity associated with ifosfamide administration. For this indication, methylene blue is typically administered intravenously at a dosage of 50 mg every 4 hours until symptom resolution. This regimen is supported by case series and institutional experience, though dosing is individualized based on clinical response, with symptom resolution often occurring within 10 minutes to 24 hours.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療異環磷醯胺誘導的腦病變，即與異環磷醯胺給藥相關的神經毒性。對於此適應症，亞甲基藍通常以 50 mg 劑量靜脈注射，每 4 小時一次，直至症狀緩解。此方案由案例系列和機構經驗支持，但劑量根據臨床反應個體化，症狀緩解通常在 10 分鐘至 24 小時內發生。

label: Antimalarial Agent
description: Methylene blue was historically used as an antimalarial agent, though it is no longer considered standard therapy due to resistance and the availability of more effective agents. Its redox properties, which enable the restoration of functional hemoglobin and enhanced oxygen delivery, are the basis of its well-established FDA-approved role in toxicologic emergencies. Beyond this, the review catalogs off-label uses including intraoperative staining, ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, refractory vasoplegic shock, neuroprotection, psychiatric disorders, cyanide poisoning adjunct, and proposed anti-inflammatory use in COVID-19 and ARDS.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue在歷史上曾用作抗瘧疾藥物，但由於耐藥性和更有效藥物的可用性，它不再被認為是標準治療。其氧化還原特性使得功能性血紅蛋白恢復和增強氧氣輸送成為可能，這是在毒理學緊急情況中其well-established的FDA批准角色的基礎。除此之外，該綜述還列出了非標籤用途，包括術中染色、ifosfamide誘導的腦病變、難治性血管痙攣性休克、神經保護、精神疾病、氰化物中毒輔助治療，以及在COVID-19和ARDS中提出的抗炎用途。

label: Neutral Red
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Neutral red (NR), a phenazine formed by substituting nitrogen for the position-5 sulfur of the phenothiazine nucleus, retained the ability to increase cellular oxygen consumption (OCR) in Seahorse assays, similar to methylene blue and toluidine blue O, and these three compounds share similar negative redox potentials. However, NR had markedly weaker neuroprotective potency than MB in the glutamate, rotenone, and IAA assays and does not function as an alternative electron-transfer carrier in mitochondria, indicating that oxygen-consumption enhancement alone does not confer neuroprotection and that electron-shunt activity is the key protective feature.
description_zh_TW: 中性紅（NR）是一種由苯噻嗪核第5位硫被氮取代形成的吩嗪，在Seahorse分析中保留了增加細胞氧消耗率（OCR）的能力，類似於亞甲藍和甲苯胺藍O，這三種化合物具有相似的負氧化還原電位。然而，在麩氨酸、rotenone和IAA分析中，NR的神經保護效力明顯弱於MB，且不作為粒線體中的替代電子轉運載體發揮作用，表明僅增強氧消耗並不能賦予神經保護作用，而電子分流活性是關鍵的保護特徵。

label: Photobiomodulation
description: Photobiomodulation, applied as daily morning sunlight or targeted red and near-infrared light therapy, directly stimulates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) in the mitochondria, enhancing ATP production. It is listed among the light, temperature, and environmental exposures that act as mitohormetic stressors. Cold exposure similarly activates brown adipose tissue and induces uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) leading to increased mitochondrial density, while sauna heat exposure induces heat shock proteins that repair misfolded proteins and support mitochondrial function.
description_zh_TW: 光生物調節，作為每日早晨陽光或靶向紅光和近紅外光療法施用，直接刺激粒線體中的細胞色素c氧化酶（複合物IV），增強ATP產生。它被列為作為線粒體興奮壓力源的光、溫度和環境暴露之一。冷暴露同樣激活棕色脂肪組織並誘導解偶聯蛋白1（UCP1），導致粒線體密度增加，而桑拿熱暴露誘導熱休克蛋白，修復錯誤折疊的蛋白質並支持粒線體功能。

label: Pulse Oximetry
description: The presence of methylene blue in the bloodstream can cause pulse oximetry to significantly underestimate true oxygen saturation by interfering with the device's measurement wavelengths. During and shortly after methylene blue infusion, arterial blood gas analysis with direct measurement of oxygen saturation (SaO2) should be used instead of pulse oximetry to accurately assess oxygenation. Methylene blue is also excreted in the urine and, because of its blue coloration, may interfere with urinalysis methods relying on colorimetric indicators such as dipstick testing for leukocyte esterase, potentially resulting in false-negative or uninterpretable results.
description_zh_TW: 血液中methylene blue的存在可能導致脈搏血氧儀通過干擾設備的測量波長而顯著低估真正的氧飽和度。在methylene blue輸注期間和之後不久，應使用直接測量氧飽和度（SaO2）的動脈血氣分析而不是脈搏血氧儀來準確評估氧合。Methylene blue也會在尿液中排泄，並且由於其藍色著色，可能干擾依賴比色指標的尿液分析方法，如白細胞酯酶的試紙檢測，可能導致假陰性或無法解釋的結果。

label: 20S Proteasome
description: Carbonylated proteins are degraded by the 20S proteasome, which recognizes their unfolded, oxidized structure and degrades them independently of ubiquitin. This removes damaged proteins before they aggregate or lose function. The directionality is oxidized protein to proteasomal clearance. A caveat is that severe oxidation can form cross-links that resist degradation and instead promote aggregates, especially in aging and neurodegeneration. Because 20S degradation is ATP- and ubiquitin-independent, it provides a rapid, energy-sparing route for clearing mildly oxidized proteins.
description_zh_TW: Carbonylated proteins 被 20S proteasome 降解，20S proteasome 識別其未折疊的氧化結構並獨立於泛素進行降解。這可以在損壞的 proteins 聚集或失去功能之前將其刪除。方向性是氧化蛋白到蛋白酶體清除。需要注意的是，嚴重氧化會形成 cross 連接，從而抵抗降解並促進聚集，特別是在 aging 和 neurodegeneration 中。由於 20S 降解不依賴 ATP 和泛素，因此它提供了一個快速、節能的途徑來清除輕度氧化的 proteins。

description: Ubiquitous overexpression of the Drosophila Sir2 ortholog (dSir2) extends female lifespan by about 29%, with a more modest or absent effect in males. The sexually dimorphic response reflects differences in nutrient sensing and reproductive physiology between the sexes, and it mirrors the pattern seen in worm and yeast models. Directionally, increased dSir2 acts upstream to produce the longevity phenotype, consistent with a conserved sirtuin-caloric-restriction axis. As in C. elegans and S. cerevisiae, the effect depends on genetic background, dietary conditions, and the level of expression achieved.
description_zh_TW: 果蠅 Sir2 直系同源物（dSir2）的全表達過量表達可延長雌性壽命約 29%，對雄性則效果較為溫和或無效。這種性別二態性反應反映了兩性之間營養感知和生殖生理學的差異，並且與線蟲和酵母模型中看到的模式相呼應。在方向性上，dSir2 增加在上游作用產生長壽表型，與保守的 sirtuin-熱量限制軸一致。與在 C. elegans 和 S. cerevisiae 中一樣，該效應取決於遺傳背景、飲食條件和所達到的表達水平。

description: Integration of an extra SIR2 copy in yeast increases replicative lifespan by up to about 30%, implicating Sir2 dosage directly in longevity. The mechanism involves reinforced silencing at rDNA repeats, which reduces spurious recombination and the accumulation of extrachromosomal rDNA circles that drive aging. This is a gain-of-function, directional relationship: more Sir2 yields longer lifespan, though the effect saturates and very high doses can be detrimental. The finding established the foundational idea that boosting sirtuin activity can extend lifespan in a simple eukaryote.
description_zh_TW: 在酵母中整合額外的 SIR2 拷貝可使複製性壽命延長約 30%，直接將 Sir2 劑量與長壽聯繫起來。其機制涉及加強 rDNA 重複序列的沉默，減少異常重複組合和推動衰老的染色體外 rDNA 環的累積。這是一種功能增強的、方向性的關係：更多的 Sir2 產生更長的壽命，但這種效應會飽和，過高劑量可能有害。這一發現確立了增強 sirtuin 活性可以在簡單真核生物中延長壽命的基本理念。

label: 350 to 450 mg per 100g
description: Black elderberries provide roughly 350-450 mg cyanidin-3-glucoside per 100 g of fresh fruit, with about 70-85 g reaching a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, berry content sits upstream of anthocyanin intake. Cyanidin is a powerful natural SIRT6 activator, and this positions elderberry as a dietary SIRT6-modulating food. The high anthocyanin content makes elderberry one of the richest natural sources of cyanidin, and its traditional use for immune support is consistent with the bioactivity of these compounds. Understanding the dose achievable from food is essential for interpreting dietary studies.
description_zh_TW: 黑接骨木莓每 100 克新鮮果實含有約 350-450 mg 花青素-3-葡萄糖苷，約 70-85 克即可達到 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，莓果含量位於花青素攝入量的上游。花青素是強效的天然 SIRT6 活化劑，這使接骨木莓成為飲食中的 SIRT6 調節食物。高花青素含量使接骨木莓成為花青素最豐富的天然來源之一，其傳統用於免疫支持與這些化合物的生物活性一致。理解從食物可達的劑量對於詮釋飲食研究至關重要。
