label: 35% of cancer cell lines
description: A survey of approximately one thousand human cancer cell lines revealed that the SIRT6 locus was deleted in 35% of the samples. This high deletion frequency supports SIRT6's role as a tumor suppressor that acts through repression of HIF-1alpha and c-MYC and suppression of glycolytic metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of enhanced oncogenic metabolism and tumor growth. Without SIRT6, the brakes on aerobic glycolysis and proliferation are released, promoting the metabolic phenotype that sustains cancer. The prevalence of SIRT6 deletion across diverse cancer cell lines underscores its broad importance in restraining malignancy.
description_zh_TW: 對約一千種人類癌症細胞系的調查顯示，SIRT6基因座在35%的樣本中被刪除。這種高頻率的刪除支持SIRT6作為透過抑制HIF-1alpha和c-MYC以及抑制糖解代謝重編程來發揮作用的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於致癌代謝增強和腫瘤生長的上游。沒有SIRT6，對有氧糖解和增殖的制動被釋放，促進維持癌症的代謝表型。SIRT6刪除在不同癌症細胞系中的普遍性突顯了其在抑制惡性腫瘤方面的廣泛重要性。

label: 40% of methyl groups
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Creatine synthesis consumes approximately 40% of the body's methyl groups because the biosynthesis of creatine from glycine and arginine requires three S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methylation steps. This large demand makes creatine biosynthesis a dominant sink for the methyl pool, rivaling other methylation needs such as DNA, protein, and catechol methylation. Supplementing preformed creatine can therefore spare methyl groups for COMT and other methyltransferases by reducing endogenous synthesis demand. This metabolic arithmetic is why creatine supplementation is recommended in methyl-cycle support strategies.
description_zh_TW: Creatine synthesis 消耗體內 methyl groups 的大約 40%，因為從甘胺酸和精胺酸生物合成肌酸需要三個 S-adenosylmethionine 依賴性甲基化步驟。這種巨大的需求使得肌酸生物合成成為甲基池的主要匯，與其他甲基化需求（例如 DNA、蛋白質和兒茶酚甲基化）相提並論。因此，補充預製肌酸可以透過減少內源合成需求，為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶節省 methyl groups。這種代謝算術就是為什麼在甲基循環支持策略中推薦補充肌酸的原因。

label: Creatine synthesis
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Creatine synthesis consumes approximately 40% of the body's methyl groups because the biosynthesis of creatine from glycine and arginine requires three S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methylation steps. This large demand makes creatine biosynthesis a dominant sink for the methyl pool, rivaling other methylation needs such as DNA, protein, and catechol methylation. Supplementing preformed creatine can therefore spare methyl groups for COMT and other methyltransferases by reducing endogenous synthesis demand. This metabolic arithmetic is why creatine supplementation is recommended in methyl-cycle support strategies.
description_zh_TW: Creatine synthesis 消耗體內 methyl groups 的大約 40%，因為從甘胺酸和精胺酸生物合成肌酸需要三個 S-adenosylmethionine 依賴性甲基化步驟。這種巨大的需求使得肌酸生物合成成為甲基池的主要匯，與其他甲基化需求（例如 DNA、蛋白質和兒茶酚甲基化）相提並論。因此，補充預製肌酸可以透過減少內源合成需求，為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶節省 methyl groups。這種代謝算術就是為什麼在甲基循環支持策略中推薦補充肌酸的原因。

description: A chromosomal duplication that increases sir-2.1 dosage in C. elegans extends lifespan by up to approximately 50%, paralleling the yeast finding in a multicellular organism. The longevity effect depends on intact insulin/IGF-1-like signaling, because sir-2.1 acts downstream of the DAF-2 pathway to promote stress resistance. The relationship is directional: elevated sir-2.1 produces the lifespan gain. A key caveat is that the requirement for DAF-16 (FOXO) ties sirtuin longevity to the conserved FOXO transcription-factor network.
description_zh_TW: 在秀丽隱桿線蟲（C. elegans）中，增加 sir-2.1 劑量的染色體複製可延長壽命約 50%，在多細胞生物中與酵母的發現相呼應。這種長壽效應依賴於完整的胰島素/IGF-1 類似信號通路，因為 sir-2.1 在 DAF-2 通路下游作用以促進壓力抗性。其方向性為：sir-2.1 升高產生壽命延長。一個關鍵的注意事項是，對 DAF-16（FOXO）的需求將 sirtuin 長壽與保守的 FOXO 轉錄因子網絡聯繫起來。

label: 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation
description: MTH1 prevents 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation by hydrolyzing the oxidized nucleotide triphosphate to 8-oxo-dGMP, sanitizing the dNTP pool before DNA polymerase can insert it. This provides a front-line defense that complements OGG1's post-replicative repair. The directionality is sanitization to mutation prevention. A caveat is that MTH1 knockout is tolerated in many contexts because backup repair exists, though cancer cells can become dependent on it (synthetic lethal vulnerability). Because DNA polymerases preferentially misinsert the oxidized nucleotide opposite adenine, MTH1 action is essential for maintaining replication fidelity in oxidatively stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: MTH1 透過將氧化的核苷酸三磷酸水解為 8-oxo-dGMP 來防止 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation，在 DNA 聚合酶插入之前對 dNTP 池進行消毒。這提供了前線防禦，補充了OGG1的複製後修復。方向性是淨化到突變預防。需要注意的是，由於存在備份修復，MTH1 敲除在許多情況下都是可以容忍的，儘管 cancer 細胞可能會依賴它（合成致命漏洞）。由於 DNA 聚合酶優先錯誤地將氧化核苷酸插入腺嘌呤對面，因此 MTH1 作用對於維持氧化壓力細胞中的複製保真度至關重要。

label: AAV-CentSIRT6
description: AAV-mediated delivery of centenarian SIRT6 reduces LINE-1 ORF1p and ORF2p protein levels in HGPS patient-derived fibroblasts, validating the variant's silencing function in progeria. Directionally, CentSIRT6 expression sits upstream of LINE-1 reduction. This is a proof-of-concept gene-therapy approach to laminopathy, and it extends the SIRT6/LINE-1 axis to a treatable model. By restoring SIRT6 function in progeria cells through gene delivery, the approach reproduces the LINE-1-suppressing effect of the centenarian variant. These results support the feasibility of SIRT6-based gene therapy for progeroid syndromes.
description_zh_TW: AAV 介導的百歲人瑞 SIRT6 遞送在 HGPS 患者來源的成纖維細胞中降低 LINE-1 ORF1p 和 ORF2p 蛋白水平，驗證了該變異體在早衰症中的沉默功能。在方向性上，CentSIRT6 表達位於 LINE-1 減少的上游。這是針對核纖層蛋白病的概念驗證基因治療方法，並將 SIRT6/LINE-1 軸線延伸到可治療的模型。透過基因遞送恢復早衰症細胞中的 SIRT6 功能，該方法重現了百歲人瑞變異體的 LINE-1 抑制效應。這些結果支持基於 SIRT6 的基因治療用於早衰症候群的可行性。

label: ABCA1 mutations
description: ABCA1 mutations cause Tangier disease, a rare disorder in which loss-of-function ABCA1 alleles lead to extremely low HDL and accumulation of cholesteryl esters in macrophages and other tissues. The defect blocks cholesterol efflux, producing enlarged orange tonsils and neuropathy. The directionality is transporter loss to lipid accumulation. A caveat is that incomplete versus complete loss of function yields a spectrum of severity, and modifier genes influence phenotype. Heterozygotes show intermediate HDL reduction, illustrating a gene-dosage effect and the clinical spectrum between Tangier disease and familial HDL deficiency.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 mutations 導致 Tangier disease，這是一種罕見的疾病，其中 ABCA1 等位基因功能喪失導致 HDL 極低以及巨噬細胞和其他組織中膽固醇酯的累積。此缺陷阻礙了 cholesterol 的流出，導致橙色扁桃體增大和神經病變。方向性是轉運蛋白損失導致脂質累積。需要注意的是，不完全與完全功能喪失會產生一系列嚴重程度，且修飾基因會影響表型。雜合子表現出中等程度的 HDL 降低，說明了基因劑量效應以及 Tangier disease 和家族性 HDL 缺乏症之間的臨床光譜。

label: NLRP3 inflammasome assembly
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: ROS trigger NLRP3 inflammasome assembly by promoting the conformational changes and ASC speck formation needed for caspase-1 activation. Mitochondrial ROS and oxidized mitochondrial DNA are particularly implicated as upstream signals. The directionality is oxidant to inflammasome activation. A caveat is that NLRP3 is also activated by non-ROS stimuli (ATP, nigericin, crystals), so ROS is a common but not exclusive trigger. ROS derived from both NOX enzymes and mitochondria converge on NLRP3, linking metabolic and inflammatory stress to IL-1beta production.
description_zh_TW: ROS 透過促進 caspase-1 活化所需的構象變化和 ASC 斑點形成來觸發 NLRP3 inflammasome assembly。 Mitochondrial ROS 和氧化的 mitochondrial DNA 作為上游訊號尤其受到牽連。方向性是發炎小體活化的氧化劑。需要注意的是，NLRP3 也會被非 ROS 刺激（ATP、尼日利亞黴素、晶體）激活，因此 ROS 是一種常見但非排他性的觸發器。源自 NOX 酶的 ROS 和 mitochondria 匯聚於 NLRP3，將代謝和發炎壓力與 IL-1beta 的產生連結起來。

label: E-cadherin
description: SIRT4 upregulates E-cadherin in colorectal cancer while suppressing proliferation, migration, and invasion via glutamine-metabolism inhibition. SIRT4 also increases sensitivity to 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle, cementing its tumor-suppressive role in CRC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 在大腸癌中上調 E-cadherin，同時透過抑制麩醯胺代謝抑制增生、遷移與侵犯。SIRT4 亦透過抑制細胞週期增加對 5-fluorouracil 的敏感性，鞏固其在 CRC 中的腫瘤抑制角色。

label: insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: As an outcome of cellular stresses, SIRT4 controls PTEN stability via the insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE). Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of PTEN protein abundance through IDE-mediated degradation. Because PTEN is a key tumour suppressor and negative regulator of PI3K/Akt signalling, SIRT4-dependent control of PTEN stability links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to oncogenic signalling under stress conditions.
description_zh_TW: 作為細胞壓力的結果，SIRT4透過胰島素降解酶（IDE）控制PTEN的穩定性。方向上，SIRT4透過IDE介導的降解位於PTEN蛋白豐度的上游。由於PTEN是關鍵的腫瘤抑制因子和PI3K/Akt訊號的負向調節因子，SIRT4依賴性的PTEN穩定性控制將粒線體sirtuin活性與壓力條件下的致癌訊號聯繫起來。

label: hepatocellular carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Expression of SIRT4 is considerably downregulated in hepatocellular carcinoma tumour tissues and in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Lower expression of SIRT4 promotes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma development. Directionally, loss of SIRT4 sits upstream of tumorigenic progression in these cancers, and its reduced expression is associated with poorer outcomes, supporting SIRT4 as a biomarker and tumor suppressor in HCC and esophageal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4的表達在肝細胞癌腫瘤組織和食道鱗狀細胞癌中顯著下調。SIRT4的較低表達促進食道鱗狀細胞癌和肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT4缺失位於這些癌症中腫瘤發生進展的上游，其降低的表達與較差的預後相關，支持SIRT4作為HCC和食道癌中的生物標誌物和腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Malonyl-CoA decarboxylase
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。

label: endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT4 inhibits inflammation in endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and in osteoarthritis. SIRT4 suppresses the inflammatory response and oxidative stress in osteoarthritis. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of dampened inflammatory signalling in vascular endothelium and joint tissue. By restraining inflammation and oxidative stress, SIRT4 exerts protective effects in osteoarthritis and may help preserve endothelial function.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT4抑制臍靜脈內皮細胞和骨關節炎中的發炎。SIRT4在骨關節炎中抑制發炎反應和氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT4位於血管內皮和關節組織中發炎訊號減弱的上游。透過抑制發炎和氧化壓力，SIRT4在骨關節炎中發揮保護作用，可能有助於維持內皮功能。

label: PDH (Pyruvate Dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 (as a lipoamidase) inhibits the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, modulating glucose-derived acetyl-CoA entry into the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4（作為硫辛酰胺酶）抑制丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體，調節葡萄糖衍生的乙醯輔酶 A 進入 TCA 循環。

label: Tumour suppressor (glutamine metabolism)
description: SIRT4 acts as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting GDH and restricting glutamine-derived anaplerosis into the TCA cycle, starving cancer cells of carbon for proliferation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed glutamine metabolism. This limits the glutamine addiction of tumors, which rely on glutamine for both energy and biosynthesis, and it is a context where SIRT4 opposes rather than promotes growth. By restraining glutamine utilization, SIRT4 reduces the metabolic support for rapid proliferation, and its loss in some cancers relieves this brake. SIRT4's tumor-suppressive role is thus tied to its regulation of mitochondrial metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 並限制穀氨醯胺衍生的回補作用進入 TCA 循環來發揮腫瘤抑制因子的作用，使癌細胞缺乏增殖所需的碳源。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於抑制穀氨醯胺代謝的上游。這限制了腫瘤對穀氨醯胺的成癮性——腫瘤依賴穀氨醯胺同時提供能量和生物合成原料——在這個情境下 SIRT4 對抗而非促進生長。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用，SIRT4 減少了快速增殖的代謝支持，其在某些癌症中的缺失解除了此制動。SIRT4 的腫瘤抑制角色因此與其對粒線體代謝的調控相關。

label: AMPK retrograde signaling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) to mediate retrograde signalling. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cellular energy sensing and mitochondrial-to-nuclear communication. By modulating ATP levels and engaging AMPK-mediated retrograde signalling, SIRT4 helps the cell adapt its nuclear gene expression to mitochondrial metabolic status under conditions of energy stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4控制ATP恆定並使用AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）來介導逆行訊號。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞能量感知和粒線體到核通訊的上游。透過調節ATP水平並參與AMPK介導的逆行訊號，SIRT4幫助細胞在能量壓力條件下根據粒線體代謝狀態調整其核基因表達。

label: ATP homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMPK-mediated retrograde signaling to couple mitochondrial metabolic status to nuclear gene expression under energy stress, influencing cellular fuel choice and bioenergetic balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 控制 ATP 恆定，並利用 AMPK 介導的逆行信號將粒線體代謝狀態與能量壓力下的核基因表達耦合，影響細胞燃料選擇和生物能量平衡。

label: breast cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 enhances the tamoxifen sensitivity of breast cancer cells by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restored endocrine responsiveness in breast cancer. By suppressing STAT3 signaling, SIRT4 makes breast cancer cells more vulnerable to tamoxifen, in contrast to SIRT3 overexpression, which reduces tamoxifen sensitivity. This positions SIRT4 as a potential enhancer of anti-estrogen therapy efficacy in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制STAT3訊號通路增強乳腺癌細胞的Tamoxifen敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於乳腺癌中內分泌反應性恢復的上游。透過抑制STAT3訊號，SIRT4使乳腺癌細胞更容易受到Tamoxifen的影響，與降低Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT3過表達形成對比。這將SIRT4定位為乳腺癌中抗雌激素療法效果的潛在增強因子。

label: SIRT1 (via glutamine metabolism)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 exerts tumor-suppressive activity in breast cancer by negatively regulating expression of SIRT1, and this suppression occurs through repression of glutamine metabolism. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced SIRT1 expression via metabolic regulation. This reveals cross-talk between mitochondrial and nuclear sirtuin proteins in cancer progression, where mitochondrial SIRT4 restrains nuclear SIRT1-dependent growth programs. By limiting glutamine utilization and, consequently, SIRT1 levels, SIRT4 curbs the metabolic and survival advantages that SIRT1 confers on tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝在乳腺癌中發揮腫瘤抑制活性，負向調節SIRT1的表達。方向上，SIRT4透過代謝調節位於SIRT1表達降低的上游。這揭示了粒線體和核sirtuin蛋白在癌症進展中的交互作用，其中粒線體SIRT4抑制核SIRT1依賴性的生長程序。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用以及隨之而來的SIRT1水平，SIRT4抑制了SIRT1賦予腫瘤細胞的代謝和存活優勢。

label: 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 increases the sensitivity of colorectal cancer cells to the chemotherapeutic drug 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest, which primes CRC cells for 5-fluorouracil-induced killing. By restraining proliferation, SIRT4 enhances the cytotoxic effect of the drug, suggesting that SIRT4 expression status could predict or improve responses to 5-fluorouracil-based therapy in colorectal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制細胞週期來增加大腸直腸癌細胞對化療藥物5-氟尿嘧啶的敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯的上游，使CRC細胞為5-氟尿嘧啶誘導的殺傷做好準備。透過抑制增殖，SIRT4增強了藥物的細胞毒作用，表明SIRT4表達狀態可能預測或改善大腸直腸癌中5-氟尿嘧啶基治療的反應。

label: Glutamate dehydrogenase
description: SIRT4 inhibits glutamate dehydrogenase by mono-ADP-ribosylation, reducing conversion of glutamate to α-ketoglutarate and limiting anaplerotic carbon entry into the TCA cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 enzymatically suppresses GDH activity within mitochondria. This restrains amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion and mitochondrial ATP generation, marking SIRT4 as a metabolic brake in the organelle. Because SIRT4 also inhibits MTPα, glutamine metabolism, and PPARα signaling, it broadly opposes the oxidative, catabolic programs that SIRT3 promotes, and the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance is emerging as an important determinant of mitochondrial health and metabolic resilience.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 通過單 ADP-核糖基化抑制穀氨酸脫氫酶，減少穀氨酸轉化為 α-酮戊二酸，限制回補性碳源進入 TCA 循環。在方向性上，SIRT4 在酶學上抑制粒線體內的 GDH 活性。這限制了胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌和粒線體 ATP 產生，將 SIRT4 標記為該細胞器中的代謝制動器。由於 SIRT4 也抑制 MTPα、穀氨酰胺代謝和 PPARα 信號，它廣泛對抗 SIRT3 促進的氧化、分解代謝程序，拮抗性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡正在成為粒線體健康和代謝韌性的重要決定因素。

label: NSCLC, colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 is an effective tumour suppressor in non-small cell lung cancer cells, human colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restrained tumour growth across multiple cancer types, in part by inhibiting glutamine metabolism and modulating mitochondrial dynamics. Low SIRT4 expression thereby permits tumorigenic behaviour, and SIRT4 represents a prognostic and therapeutic target in these cancers.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在非小細胞肺癌細胞、人類大腸直腸癌、神經母細胞瘤和胃癌中是有效的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT4位於多種癌症類型中腫瘤生長抑制的上游，部分透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝和調節粒線體動力學。因此低SIRT4表達允許致瘤行為，SIRT4在這些癌症中代表了預後和治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class II (evolutionarily ancient)
description: SIRT4 is classified in phylogenetic Class II, which includes sirtuins from bacteria, insects, nematodes, mould, and protozoa—among the most ancient sirtuin lineages. Directionally, this is an evolutionary placement rather than a causal pathway. This antiquity implies conserved mitochondrial metabolic roles, and it situates SIRT4 early in sirtuin evolution. Because Class II sirtuins predate the divergence of major eukaryotic lineages, SIRT4's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function likely represents an ancestral enzymatic activity. Understanding SIRT4's phylogenetic position helps contextualize its metabolic-brake functions relative to the more derived deacetylases.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被分類為系統發育 II 類，包括來自細菌、昆蟲、線蟲、黴菌和原生動物的 sirtuin——是最古老的 sirtuin 譜系之一。在方向性上，這是演化定位而非因果途徑。這種古老性暗示保守的粒線體代謝角色，並將 SIRT4 置於 sirtuin 演化的早期。由於 II 類 sirtuin 先於主要真核生物譜系的分化，SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶活性。理解 SIRT4 的系統發育位置有助於將其代謝制動功能置於更衍生的去乙醯酶的背景中。

label: tumor suppressor (downregulated in cancers)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 is described as tumor suppressor (downregulated in cancers); it is a tumor suppressor downregulated in multiple cancers (Wu et al., 2022).
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被描述為腫瘤抑制因子（在癌症中下調）；它是在多種癌症中下調的腫瘤抑制因子（Wu et al., 2022）。

label: mitotic cell division regulation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 plays a crucial role in mitotic cell division regulation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of proper cell cycle progression and mitotic fidelity. In addition to its roles in glutamine metabolism and tumor suppression, SIRT4 contributes to the orderly execution of mitosis, extending the functional repertoire of this mitochondrial sirtuin beyond metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在有絲分裂細胞分裂調節中發揮關鍵作用。方向上，SIRT4位於正常的細胞週期進展和有絲分裂保真度的上游。除了其在穀氨醯胺代謝和腫瘤抑制中的角色外，SIRT4還有助於有絲分裂的有序執行，將此粒線體sirtuin的功能譜擴展到代謝之外。

label: E-cadherin promotion
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 suppresses epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by promoting expression of the epithelial marker E-cadherin in gastric cancer cells. This maintains an epithelial phenotype and inhibits cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of maintained epithelial phenotype and suppressed metastasis. By preventing the loss of E-cadherin that characterizes EMT, SIRT4 blocks a key step in the acquisition of invasive and migratory behavior. This supports SIRT4's role as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer, where its downregulation may allow tumors to progress toward metastatic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過促進上皮標記E-cadherin在胃癌細胞中的表達來抑制上皮-間質轉化（EMT）。這維持了上皮表型並抑制癌細胞增殖、遷移和侵襲。方向上，SIRT4位於上皮表型維持和轉移抑制的上游。透過阻止EMT特徵性的E-cadherin喪失，SIRT4阻斷了獲得侵襲和遷移行為的關鍵步驟。這支持SIRT4作為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其下調可能使腫瘤向轉移性疾病進展。

label: MTPα (fatty acid oxidation)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake that conserves lipids when nutrients are abundant. The inhibition of MTPα and of PPARα signaling shifts metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward lipid storage. SIRT4's opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為在營養豐富時保存脂質的粒線體合成代謝制動器。對 MTPα 和 PPARα 訊號的抑制使代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向脂質儲存。SIRT4 對氧化代謝的對抗是拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: MTPα (mitochondrial trifunctional protein α)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake. By inhibiting MTPα, SIRT4 conserves fatty acids for storage when nutrients are abundant. This opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance that determines mitochondrial metabolic state.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為粒線體合成代謝制動器。透過抑制 MTPα，SIRT4 在營養豐富時保存脂肪酸以供儲存。這種對氧化代謝的對抗是決定粒線體代謝狀態的拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: p16 and p21
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 upregulates expression of the cell-cycle inhibitor genes p16 and p21, while suppressing CyclinB1/Cdc2 and Cdc25c, and this cell-cycle blockade induces apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction. By enforcing these checkpoints, SIRT4 functions as a tumor suppressor in liver cancer, limiting proliferation and promoting death of transformed cells. The coordinated upregulation of p16 and p21 with suppression of cell-cycle drivers reflects SIRT4's broad influence on the machinery that governs entry into mitosis. This supports interest in SIRT4 as a therapeutic target for hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4上調細胞週期抑制因子p16和p21的表達，同時抑制CyclinB1/Cdc2和Cdc25c，這種細胞週期阻斷誘導肝細胞癌細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯和凋亡誘導的上游。透過強制執行這些檢查點，SIRT4在肝癌中作為腫瘤抑制因子發揮作用，限制增殖並促進轉化細胞的死亡。p16和p21的協調上調與細胞週期驅動因子的抑制反映了SIRT4對控制有絲分裂進入機制的廣泛影響。這支持了SIRT4作為肝細胞癌治療靶點的興趣。

label: TFEB at K91/K103/K116/K430
description: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) acetylates TFEB at multiple lysines (K91, K103, K116, K430), an enzymatic activity that, in this context, promotes TFEB nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These acetylations counteract repressive deacetylation cycles and enhance TFEB's ability to engage CLEAR elements, thereby boosting autophagy-lysosomal transcription. The observation that ACAT1-mediated acetylation can be activatory contrasts with the repressive acetylation by GCN5 at other sites. The net effect depends on the specific lysine and cellular context, underscoring the complexity of TFEB acetylation.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶 A 乙醯轉移酶 1（ACAT1）在多個離胺酸（K91、K103、K116、K430）乙醯化 TFEB，在此脈絡下此酵素活性促進 TFEB 核轉運和 DNA 結合。這些乙醯化對抗抑制性的去乙醯化循環，並增強 TFEB 接合 CLEAR 元件的能力，從而提升自噬—溶酶體轉錄。ACAT1 介導的乙醯化可為活化性的此一觀察，與 GCN5 在其他位點的抑制性乙醯化形成對比。淨效應取決於特定離胺酸和細胞背景，凸顯了 TFEB 乙醯化的複雜性。

label: Acatalasemia
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Catalase deficiency causes acatalasemia (Takahara's disease), a rare autosomal recessive disorder in which near-absent catalase activity leads to oral mucosal ulcers and periodontal destruction from accumulated H2O2. The pathology arises because bacterial metabolism in the mouth produces H2O2 that cannot be degraded, fostering gangrene-prone infections. The directionality is enzyme loss to local oxidative injury. A caveat is that many acatalasemic individuals are surprisingly asymptomatic, indicating redundancy from other peroxide-removing systems.
description_zh_TW: Catalase deficiency 會導致 acatalasemia（高原氏症），這是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，幾乎不存在 catalase 活性，導致口腔黏膜潰瘍和累積的 H2O2 造成牙周破壞。這種病理現象的產生是因為口腔中的細菌代謝產生無法降解的 H2O2，促進壞疽感染。方向性是酵素損失導致局部氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多 acatalasemic 個體出乎意料地沒有症狀，這表明其他過氧化物去除系統存在冗餘。

source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md

label: Acetylated alpha-tubulin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The cell-based ELISA-type assay, adapted from histone acetyltransferase inhibitor assays, confirms SIRT2 inhibitors such as 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones: cells seeded in 96-well plates are treated with compounds, fixed, permeabilized, and probed with antibody against acetylated alpha-tubulin, with fluorescence measured after enhancement solution addition. This format is well suited for high-throughput screenings. Directionally, the acetylated tubulin signal directly reflects SIRT2 deacetylase inhibition in cells. It complements Western blot with quantitative, plate-based throughput.
description_zh_TW: 基於細胞的 ELISA 型測定改編自組蛋白乙醯轉移酶抑制劑測定，用於確認 SIRT2 抑制劑如 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮：將細胞接種於 96 孔板中，經化合物處理、固定、透化後，使用抗乙醯化 α-tubulin 的抗體探測，在加入增強溶液後測量螢光。此格式非常適合高通量篩選。方向性上乙醯化 tubulin 訊號直接反映細胞中的 SIRT2 去乙醯酶抑制。它以定量、微孔板兼容的通量補充了西方墨點法。

label: Acetylated p53, histone 3 and gamma-tubulin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Western blot is the most commonly used cell-based analysis to evaluate sirtuin inhibition: cells are exposed to putative inhibitors, lysed, and probed with antibodies against acetylated lysine on known sirtuin substrates, typically p53, histone 3, or gamma-tubulin. Increased acetylation indicates reduced sirtuin activity. Directionally, the acetylation state of these substrates reports the functional outcome of inhibitor treatment in intact cells. Because it measures endogenous substrates rather than artificial fluorophores, it is a key confirmatory readout after fluorescent screening.
description_zh_TW: 西方墨點法是最常用的基於細胞的分析方法，用於評估 sirtuin 抑制：將細胞暴露於推定的抑制劑後裂解，並使用抗已知 sirtuin 受質上乙醯化離胺酸的抗體進行探測，通常為 p53、組蛋白 H3 或 γ-tubulin。乙醯化增加表示 sirtuin 活性降低。方向性上這些受質的乙醯化狀態報告了抑制劑在完整細胞中的功能結果。由於其測量的是內源性受質而非人工螢光基團，它是螢光篩選後的關鍵確認性讀取。

label: Vitamin B3
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: High efficiency of vitamin B3 (niacin or nicotinamide) in preventing lung tissue damage was confirmed in several animal models with bleomycin- and LPS-induced lung injury, and considering this strong lung-protective effect, vitamin B3 has been proposed as an early treatment-supporting agent against COVID-19, which otherwise causes a maladaptive hyperinflammatory response with a cytokine storm in lung tissue. Nicotinamide riboside (NR), as a vitamin B3 derivative, is therefore considered a potential therapeutic or supporting agent to reduce hyperinflammation and regenerate damaged lung tissue during SARS-CoV-2 infection, where excess leucocyte infiltration causes extensive tissue damage
description_zh_TW: 維生素 B3（niacin 或 nicotinamide）在預防肺組織損傷方面的高效性已在數種 bleomycin（博萊黴素）與 LPS 誘發肺損傷的動物模型中獲得證實，且考量到此強效的肺保護效果，維生素 B3 已被提議作為對抗 COVID-19 的早期治療支援劑，否則 COVID-19 會在肺組織中引發伴隨細胞激素風暴的適應不良過度發炎反應。因此，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）作為維生素 B3 的衍生物，被視為在 SARS-CoV-2 感染期間減少過度發炎並再生受損肺組織的潛在治療或支援劑，在此感染中過量的白血球浸潤造成廣泛的組織損傷。

label: Adenine, nicotinamide-ribose and nicotinamide pockets
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The sirtuin NAD+ binding site is divisible into an adenine binding pocket (pocket A), a nicotinamide ribose pocket (pocket B), and a nicotinamide binding pocket (pocket C), formed by the large Rossmann domain and the cofactor binding loop. NAD+ enters a non-productive conformation outside the C pocket until an acetyl-lysine substrate is present, at which point a productive arrangement engages the C pocket. Directionally, this topology defines how inhibitors such as nicotinamide (pocket C) and suramin (pockets B, C, and substrate site) act, and frames structure-based design of sirtuin modulators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin NAD+ 結合位點可分為腺嘌呤結合口袋（口袋 A）、尼可醯胺核糖口袋（口袋 B）和尼可醯胺結合口袋（口袋 C），由大型 Rossmann 結構域和輔因子結合環形成。在沒有乙醯-離胺酸受質存在時，NAD+ 以非生產性構象進入 C 口袋以外的區域；當受質存在時，產生性構象才會與 C 口袋結合。方向性上此拓撲結構定義了抑制劑如尼可醯胺（口袋 C）和 Suramin（口袋 B、C 和受質位點）的作用方式，並為 sirtuin 調節劑的結構導向設計提供了框架。

label: Sirtuin NAD+ binding site
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

NAD+ enters a non-productive conformation outside the C pocket until an acetyl-lysine substrate is present, at which point a productive arrangement engages the C pocket. Directionally, this topology defines how inhibitors such as nicotinamide (pocket C) and suramin (pockets B, C, and substrate site) act, and frames structure-based design of sirtuin modulators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin NAD+ 結合位點可分為腺嘌呤結合口袋（口袋 A）、尼可醯胺核糖口袋（口袋 B）和尼可醯胺結合口袋（口袋 C），由大型 Rossmann 結構域和輔因子結合環形成。在沒有乙醯-離胺酸受質存在時，NAD+ 以非生產性構象進入 C 口袋以外的區域；當受質存在時，產生性構象才會與 C 口袋結合。方向性上此拓撲結構定義了抑制劑如尼可醯胺（口袋 C）和 Suramin（口袋 B、C 和受質位點）的作用方式，並為 sirtuin 調節劑的結構導向設計提供了框架。

label: Adenosine-binding site with SIRT2
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site with sirtuins such as SIRT2, an overlap exploited by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins as a drug-discovery strategy. This shared adenosine pocket allows scaffolds like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 to engage both families, inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range while retaining kinase activity. Directionally, the enzyme superfamily of Kinase proteins and sirtuin deacetylases both rely on an adenosine-binding pocket, explaining the cross-reactivity between kinase-inhibitor scaffolds and sirtuins. This structural convergence frames interpretation of kinase-inhibitor effects in sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶與 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點，這種重疊被利用來篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 的活性，作為一種藥物發現策略。這種共享的腺嘌呤口袋允許如雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 等骨架與兩個家族結合，在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的同時保留激酶活性。方向性上激酶蛋白的酶超家族和 sirtuin 去乙醯酶都依賴腺嘌呤結合口袋，解釋了激酶抑制劑骨架和 sirtuin 之間的交叉反應性。這種結構上的匯聚為詮釋激酶抑制劑在 sirtuin 生物學中的效應提供了框架。

label: ADP-Ribose
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: The ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3 reverses the antiviral effect of PARPs, which is required for inhibition of viral replication during infection, and the activity of nsp3 is itself required for SARS-CoV-2 virulence. By removing mono-ADP-ribose (MARylation) marks deposited on viral proteins by IFN-induced PARP activation, nsp3 counteracts the host's antiviral ADP-ribosylation response. These events occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through nicotinamide riboside and nicotinamide kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2.
description_zh_TW: 病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 逆轉了 PARPs 的抗病毒效果，而後者為感染期間抑制病毒複製所必需，且 nsp3 的活性本身為 SARS-CoV-2 毒力所必需。透過移除由 IFN 誘發的 PARP 活化沉積在病毒蛋白上的 mono-ADP-ribose（MARylation，單-ADP-核糖）標記，nsp3 抵銷了宿主的抗病毒 ADP-ribosylation（ADP-核糖基化）反應。這些事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 nicotinamide riboside 與 nicotinamide 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能，以支援對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫。

label: AGE burden
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: A diet restricting advanced glycation end products can effectively reduce the AGE burden in the human body. In renal failure patients, a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction in blood CML levels, while an AGE-rich diet increased CML by 29%. Because significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins, dietary intake is an important exogenous source of glycotoxins. Restricting dietary AGEs is therefore proposed as an effective way to reduce circulating AGE levels and protect against AGE-related organ dysfunction and tissue aging.
description_zh_TW: 限制晚期糖化終產物（advanced glycation end products，AGE）的飲食能有效降低人體內的 AGE 負擔。在腎衰竭患者中，低 AGE 飲食使血液 CML 濃度下降 34%，而富含 AGE 的飲食則使 CML 上升 29%。由於糖類與蛋白質共同烹煮時會產生大量 AGE，飲食攝取是 glycotoxins 的重要外源性來源。因此，限制飲食中的 AGE 被視為降低循環 AGE 濃度、防護 AGE 相關器官功能障礙與組織老化的有效方式。

label: Age-related Hearing Loss
description: AHL is the most prevalent auditory impairment in older adults, tightly correlated with cumulative oxidative stress. Caloric restriction alleviates AHL by reducing oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice; SIRT3-driven IDH2/NADPH activity preserves cochlear hair cells.
description_zh_TW: AHL 是老年人中最普遍的聽覺障礙，與累積性氧化壓力密切相關。熱量限制透過減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷緩解 AHL，但此保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除；SIRT3 驅動的 IDH2/NADPH 活性維護耳蝸毛細胞。

label: SIRT3-dependent CR protection

Caloric restriction alleviates AHL by reducing oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice; SIRT3-driven IDH2/NADPH activity preserves cochlear hair cells.

label: Beclin 1
description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

label: K-RAS
description: In K-RAS mutated cancers, hyperactive ERK1/2 phosphorylates and inactivates PTPN5, locking BAK in its inactive phosphorylated state and providing resistance to apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 在 K-RAS 突變的癌症中，過度活化的 ERK1/2 磷酸化並使 PTPN5 失活，將 BAK 鎖定於其不活化的磷酸化狀態，從而產生對凋亡的抗性。

label: PLK3
description: PLK3 phosphorylates BCL-XL at Ser49, causing cell cycle G2 arrest in lymphoma cells.
description_zh_TW: PLK3 在 Ser49 磷酸化 BCL-XL，在淋巴瘤細胞中造成細胞週期 G2 停滯。

label: PTPN5
description: PTPN5 (STEP), along with PTPN2 and PTPN23, dephosphorylates BAK at Tyr108, licensing it for mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: PTPN5（STEP）與 PTPN2、PTPN23 一起，在 Tyr108 去磷酸化 BAK，使其獲得粒線體外膜通透化與凋亡的許可。

label: Pin1
description: Pin1 binding to phosphorylated BAX (Thr167) catalyzes a conformational change that locks Bax in an inactive state, preventing mitochondrial translocation and MOMP.
description_zh_TW: Pin1 與磷酸化的 BAX（Thr167）結合，催化構形變化，將 Bax 鎖定於不活化狀態，阻止粒線體轉位與 MOMP。

label: Thrombocytopenia
description: ABT-263 causes Thrombocytopenia. ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor to ABT-737 whose Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia. Thrombocytopenia is an abnormally low platelet count that, when caused by Bcl-xL inhibition, reflects the dependence of platelets on that survival protein. The relationship is directional, with ABT-263 acting as the operative agent upon Thrombocytopenia rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 導致Thrombocytopenia。 ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物利用型後繼者，其 Bcl-xL 抑製作用會導致標靶血小板減少症。 Thrombocytopenia 是異常低的血小板計數，當由 Bcl-xL 抑制引起時，反映了血小板對此存活蛋白的依賴性。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-263 充當 Thrombocytopenia 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore
description: Activated BAX (with BAK) drives opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, causing cytochrome c to diffuse into the cytosol where it nucleates the apoptosome with Apaf-1 and caspase-9. BH3-only activators (Bid, Bim, PUMA) can directly engage BAX/BAK, while sensitizers (Bad, Noxa, Bik) displace the anti-apoptotic Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Mcl-1 restraint. The pore event is the point of no return separating transcriptional death decisions from caspase execution.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 BAX（與 BAK）會驅動粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟，使 cytochrome c 擴散進入細胞質，並與 Apaf-1 及 Caspase-9 組裝凋亡體。BH3-only 活化因子（Bid、Bim、PUMA）可直接結合 BAX/BAK，而敏化因子（Bad、Noxa、Bik）則置換抗凋亡的 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 與 Mcl-1。孔道開啟是區分轉錄層面死亡決定與 caspase 執行的不可逆節點。

label: aging results from progressive loss of epigenetic information
community_name: aging results from progressive loss of epigenetic information
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。

label: AGO2
description: AGO2 (Argonaute 2) is the catalytic core of RISC executing microRNA-guided silencing. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway; SIRT3 loss breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression.
description_zh_TW: AGO2（Argonaute 2）是 RISC 的催化核心，執行 microRNA 引導的基因沉默。在糖尿病心肌病變中，SIRT3 活化透過調節 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力；SIRT3 缺失打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展。

label: microRNA silencing
description: AGO2 (Argonaute 2) is the catalytic core of RISC executing microRNA-guided silencing. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway; SIRT3 loss breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression.

label: Alpha-tocopherol
description: Alpha-tocopherol is the primary, most biologically active form of vitamin E retained and utilized by the human body, owing to its selective binding by the hepatic alpha-tocopherol transfer protein while other tocopherols are preferentially metabolized and excreted. It functions as a lipid-soluble chain-breaking antioxidant protecting polyunsaturated fatty acids in cell membranes, and it also modulates cell signaling and immune function. Its metabolism involves catecholic intermediates that are substrates for COMT. Its cancer-prevention outcomes with supplementation differ by COMT genotype, protective in slow and potentially harmful in fast COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-tocopherol 是人體保留和利用的維生素 E 的主要、最俱生物活性的形式，因為它與肝臟 α-生育酚轉移蛋白選擇性結合，而其他生育酚則優先代謝和排泄。它作為脂溶性斷鍊抗氧化劑，保護細胞膜中的多元不飽和脂肪酸，也調節細胞訊號傳導和免疫功能。其代謝涉及作為 COMT 底物的兒茶酚中間體。 COMT genotype 的補充劑預防癌症的效果有所不同，對緩慢的 COMT 個體具有保護作用，但對快速的 COMT 個體可能有害。

label: Alu element transcripts
description: Alu elements are short interspersed nuclear elements that, when derepressed, produce transcripts that contribute to genomic instability. In aging and stressed cells, loss of epigenetic silencing permits Alu transcription, and the resulting double-stranded RNA and retrotransposition intermediates challenge genome integrity by promoting insertions and activating innate immune DNA and RNA sensing pathways. Aberrant Alu activity is therefore both a consequence and a driver of the accumulating genomic instability recognized as a hallmark of aging.
description_zh_TW: Alu 元件是短散佈的核元件，當去抑制時，會產生導致基因組不穩定的轉錄物。在老化和壓力的細胞中，表觀遺傳沉默的喪失允許 Alu 轉錄，由此產生的雙股 RNA 和逆轉錄轉座中間體透過促進插入和激活先天免疫 DNA 和 RNA 感測途徑來挑戰基因組完整性。因此，異常的 Alu 活性既是基因組不穩定性累積的結果，也是其驅動因素，而基因組不穩定性被認為是老化的標誌。

label: Amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion
description: By inhibiting GDH, SIRT4 blunts the ability of amino acids such as leucine to stimulate insulin release from pancreatic β-cells, because less α-ketoglutarate is generated to elevate ATP and trigger secretion. The relationship is directional: SIRT4-mediated GDH inhibition reduces amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion, restraining the nutrient-dependent arm of insulin release. This positions SIRT4 as a physiological negative regulator of nutrient-stimulated insulin secretion, complementary to SIRT1's positive effects on glucose-stimulated secretion.
description_zh_TW: 通過抑制 GDH，SIRT4 削弱胺基酸（如白胺酸）刺激胰腺 β 細胞釋放胰島素的能力，因為產生的 α-酮戊二酸減少，無法提升 ATP 並觸發分泌。其方向性為：SIRT4 介導的 GDH 抑制減少胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌，限制胰島素釋放的營養物依賴性分支。這使 SIRT4 成為營養物刺激胰島素分泌的生理性負調節因子，與 SIRT1 對葡萄糖刺激分泌的正向效應互補。

label: AMPK/SIRT3 hormetic axis
description: Stanniocalcin-1 is a glycoprotein hormone orchestrating a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis. It inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway, ameliorating renal injury in diabetic murine models.
description_zh_TW: Stanniocalcin-1 是一種編排激效性 AMPK/SIRT3 軸線的糖蛋白激素，以減輕氧化壓力和凋亡。它透過 AMPK/SIRT3 途徑抑制 BNIP3 表現，改善糖尿病小鼠模型中的腎損傷。

label: Antagonistic Pleiotropy
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
description_zh_TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。

label: RCM (Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers)
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

label: Anti-hypertensive effects
description: SIRT1-mediated downregulation of AT1R expression produces antihypertensive effects; in vivo, resveratrol-driven SIRT1 elevation reduces angiotensin-II-induced hypertension. Directionally, SIRT1-mediated AT1R suppression sits upstream of lower blood pressure. This couples SIRT1 activation to vascular tone control, since reduced AT1R diminishes angiotensin-II-driven vasoconstriction and sodium retention. It is a mechanistic basis for resveratrol's antihypertensive actions, and it parallels the therapeutic strategy of AT1R blockade used clinically. By targeting the same receptor the drugs block, SIRT1 provides an endogenous route to restrain the renin-angiotensin system.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 表達下調產生降血壓效應；在體內，resveratrol 驅動的 SIRT1 上調減少血管張力素 II 誘導的高血壓。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 抑制位於降低血壓的上游。這將 SIRT1 活化與血管張力控制偶聯，因為減少的 AT1R 減弱血管張力素 II 驅動的血管收縮和鈉滯留。這是 resveratrol 降血壓作用的機制性基礎，與臨床使用的 AT1R 阻斷治療策略相似。透過靶向與藥物阻斷的相同受體，SIRT1 提供了抑制腎素-血管張力素系統的內源性途徑。

label: Anti-TNF therapy
description: Anti-TNF therapy reduces oxidative stress markers by breaking the TNF-alpha to ROS feed-forward loop, lowering serum MDA and raising glutathione in treated patients. This reflects successful suppression of inflammasome and NOX-driven oxidants. The directionality is TNF blockade to lowered oxidant burden. A caveat is that the magnitude of biomarker change varies among patients and that anti-TNF also has immunosuppressive trade-offs. These biomarker improvements parallel clinical response and support the idea that TNF blockade restores redox balance in chronic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Anti-TNF therapy 透過打破 TNF-alpha 至 ROS 前饋循環來降低 oxidative stress markers，降低治療患者的血清 MDA 並提高 glutathione。這反映了發炎體和氮氧化物驅動的氧化劑的成功抑制。方向性是 TNF 阻斷以降低氧化劑負荷。需要注意的是，生物標記變化的程度因患者而異，且抗 TNF 藥物也具有免疫抑制權衡。這些生物標記的改善與臨床反應平行，並支持 TNF 阻斷可恢復慢性發炎中氧化還原平衡的觀點。

label: TFEB at S401
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: In contrast to its S211 effect, p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB at serine 401 in a manner that promotes nuclear translocation in specific cell types such as monocytes. This site-specific divergence illustrates that p38 can either retain or activate TFEB depending on cell context and the constellation of concurrent modifications. Such opposing outcomes highlight the combinatorial code by which multiple phosphorylations determine TFEB localization. The monocyte-specific response implicates TFEB in immune cell activation and inflammatory programs.
description_zh_TW: 相對於其 S211 效應，p38 MAPK 以促進核轉運的方式於 serine 401 磷酸化 TFEB，此作用發生在特定細胞類型如單核細胞中。這種位點特異性分歧說明 p38 可根據細胞背景和同時存在的修飾組合，保留或活化 TFEB。這種相反結果凸顯了多種磷酸化決定 TFEB 定位的組合密碼。單核細胞特異性反應將 TFEB 牽涉進免疫細胞活化和發炎程序。

label: TFEB for CLEAR element
description: The oncogenic transcription factor MYC competes with TFEB for binding to CLEAR elements in the promoters of lysosomal and autophagy genes. By occupying these sites, MYC represses the TFEB-driven transcriptional program while simultaneously driving its own proliferative gene network. This competitive binding creates a molecular antagonism between growth-promoting and degradative transcriptional programs. The interplay explains how MYC-high tumors suppress autophagy-lysosomal capacity even as they increase metabolic demand.
description_zh_TW: 致癌轉錄因子 MYC 與 TFEB 競爭結合溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件。透過佔據這些位點，MYC 抑制 TFEB 驅動的轉錄程序，同時驅動其自身的增生基因網絡。這種競爭性結合在促生長和降解的轉錄程序之間創造了分子拮抗。此交互作用解釋了 MYC 高表現的腫瘤如何抑制自噬—溶酶體能力，即使它們增加了代謝需求。

label: SASP Enhancers
description: H3K27ac marks senescence-activated super-enhancers that drive SASP expression, identifying the enhancer landscape licensed during the senescent response. These acetylated, transcriptionally active enhancers recruit BRD4 and transcription factors such as AP-1 and NF-kB to SASP loci, enabling robust and sustained secretome transcription. The mark thus charts the chromatin basis of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype and distinguishes active SASP enhancers from repressed loci. Targeting these enhancers with BET inhibitors such as JQ1 suppresses SASP expression, revealing the enhancer landscape as a therapeutic vulnerability in senescence.
description_zh_TW: H3K27ac 標記驅動 SASP 表現的衰老活化超級增強子，辨識衰老反應中許可的增強子景觀。這些乙醯化、轉錄活化的增強子招募 BRD4 與 AP-1、NF-κB 等轉錄因子至 SASP 基因座，促成強健且持續的分泌組轉錄。此標記因此描繪衰老相關分泌表型的染色質基礎，並區分活化的 SASP 增強子與受抑制基因座。以 BET 抑制劑如 JQ1 標靶這些增強子抑制 SASP 表現，揭示增強子景觀作為衰老中治療脆弱性。

label: Glucocorticoids
description: NF-kB is inhibited by glucocorticoids, which block the pro-inflammatory SASP by impairing IL-1a-mediated NF-kB activity. Glucocorticoids repress NF-kB transactivation by recruiting co-repressors and interfering with its interaction with coactivators, reducing SASP cytokine output. This explains their classic anti-inflammatory action in senescence contexts and their historical use in treating inflammatory conditions. The inhibition is well established pharmacologically, though chronic use carries significant side effects.
description_zh_TW: NF-κB 被糖皮質類固醇抑制，糖皮質類固醇透過損害 IL-1α 介導的 NF-κB 活性阻斷促發炎性 SASP。糖皮質類固醇經由招募協同抑制因子並干擾其與協同活化因子的交互作用，抑制 NF-κB 轉活化，降低 SASP 細胞激素輸出。這解釋其在衰老脈絡中的典型抗發炎作用，及其在治療發炎疾病的歷史用途。此抑制在藥理上確立牢固，儘管慢性使用帶有顯著副作用。

label: SB203580
description: p38 MAPK is inhibited by SB203580, a classical pyridinyl imidazole inhibitor that suppresses p38alpha and p38beta and thereby reduces the SASP from fibroblasts of older donors. By blocking p38, SB203580 lowers NF-kB activation and SASP transcript stabilization, demonstrating the kinase's central role in the secretome. This provides a tool compound that validates p38 as a senomorphic target in cellular models. The inhibition is specific and well characterized, though clinical senomorphic use remains investigational.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 被 SB203580 抑制，SB203580 是一種抑制 p38alpha 與 p38beta 的經典吡啶基咪唑抑制劑，從而減少年長捐贈者纖維母細胞的 SASP。透過阻斷 p38，SB203580 降低 NF-κB 活化與 SASP 轉錄本穩定，證明該激酶在分泌組中的中心角色。這提供一種工具化合物，驗證 p38 在細胞模型中作為 senomorphic 標靶。此抑制為特異且良好表徵，儘管臨床 senomorphic 使用仍屬探索中。

label: A20
description: A20 terminates NF-kappaB signaling by removing K63-linked ubiquitin chains from RIP1 and TRAF6, thereby shutting down IKK activation and the downstream cascade. As a feedback inhibitor, A20 limits excessive inflammation and tissue damage. The directionality is deubiquitination to signal termination. A caveat is that A20 mutations or insufficiency are linked to chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, showing its role is non-redundant in some tissues. Mice lacking A20 in specific tissues develop severe spontaneous inflammation, confirming its role as an essential inflammatory brake.
description_zh_TW: A20 透過從 RIP1 和 TRAF6 中移除 K63 連接的泛素鏈來終止 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導，從而關閉 IKK 活化和下游級聯。作為反饋抑制劑，A20 可以限制過度發炎和組織損傷。方向性是去泛素化到訊號終止。需要注意的是，A20 突變或不足與慢性發炎和自體免疫疾病有關，這表明​​它的作用在某些組織中是非冗餘的。特定組織中缺乏 A20 的小鼠會出現嚴重的自發性炎症，證實了其作為重要發炎制動劑的作用。

label: Bortezomib
description: Bortezomib blocks NF-kappaB by inhibiting the proteasome, preventing degradation of IkappaB and thus trapping NF-kappaB in the cytoplasm. This therapeutic strategy exploits the dependence of many cancers on NF-kappaB survival signaling. The directionality is proteasome inhibition to transcriptional blockade. A caveat is that bortezomib also inhibits degradation of many other proteins, causing toxicity such as peripheral neuropathy. The drug is used in multiple myeloma and mantle-cell lymphoma, where its NF-kappaB blockade and proteotoxic stress together induce myeloma cell death.
description_zh_TW: Bortezomib 透過抑制蛋白酶體來阻斷 NF-kappaB，防止 IkappaB 降解，從而將 NF-kappaB 捕獲在細胞質中。這種治療策略利用了許多 cancer 對 NF-kappaB 生存訊號的依賴。方向性是蛋白酶體抑制轉錄阻斷。需要注意的是，bortezomib 也會抑制許多其他 proteins 的降解，進而導致周邊神經病變等毒性。該藥物用於治療多發性骨髓瘤和套細胞淋巴瘤，其 NF-kappaB 阻斷和蛋白毒性壓力共同誘導骨髓瘤細胞死亡。

label: Antioxidant Gene Program
description: NF-kappaB upregulates an antioxidant gene program as a negative feedback that limits TNF-alpha-induced tissue damage, inducing enzymes such as MnSOD, ferritin, and heme oxygenase. This self-limiting loop tempers the oxidative consequences of inflammatory signaling. The directionality is NF-kappaB to adaptive antioxidant transcription. A caveat is that the same factor also drives pro-oxidant enzymes (NOX, iNOS), so the net redox outcome depends on stimulus and cell type. This protective arm tempers the tissue damage caused by TNF and other inflammatory mediators.
description_zh_TW: NF-kappaB 上調 antioxidant gene program 作為負回饋，限制 TNF-alpha 誘導的組織損傷，誘導 MnSOD、ferritin 和血紅素加氧酶等酵素。這種自我限制循環可以緩和發炎訊號傳導的氧化後果。方向性是 NF-kappaB 到適應性抗氧化轉錄。需要注意的是，同一因素也會驅動促氧化酶（NOX、iNOS），因此淨氧化還原結果取決於刺激和細胞類型。這個保護臂可以緩和 TNF 和其他發炎介質造成的組織損傷。

label: S-Nitrosylation
description: S-nitrosylation inhibits NF-kappaB when NO-derived S-nitrosothiols modify key cysteines (p50 Cys-62 and RelA Cys-38), disrupting DNA binding and transcriptional activity. This provides a redox-based brake on inflammatory signaling. The directionality is NO-mediated modification to transcriptional repression. A caveat is that the effect is reversible and concentration-dependent, and high NO can also paradoxically promote NF-kappaB under some conditions. This mechanism contributes to NO's ability to restrain inflammatory gene expression and may explain some anti-inflammatory actions of nitrosating agents.
description_zh_TW: 當 NO 衍生的 S-nitrosothiols 修飾關鍵半胱氨酸（p50 Cys-62 和 RelA Cys-38）時，S-nitrosylation 會抑制 NF-kappaB，從而破壞 DNA 結合和轉錄活性。这提供了基于氧化还原的炎症信号传导制动。方向性是 NO 介導的轉錄抑制修飾。需要注意的是，该效应是可逆的且依赖于浓度，并且在某些条件下，高 NO 也会相反地促进 NF-κB。这种机制有助于 NO 抑制 inflammatory gene expression 的能力，并可能解释 nitrosating 药物的一些抗炎作用。

label: CXCL5
description: AP-1 transactivates CXCL5 (a SASP chemokine), which feeds inflammaging. Caloric restriction suppresses inflammaging and activates autophagy via mTOR/AMPK.
description_zh_TW: AP-1 轉活化 CXCL5（一種 SASP 趨化因子），促成發炎性老化（inflammaging）。熱量限制可抑制發炎性老化，並透過 mTOR/AMPK 活化自噬。

label: TAK1
description: TAK1, a key cytoplasmic kinase in modulation of the SASP, is rapidly phosphorylated upon genotoxic stress and functionally participates in the transition of the acute stress-associated phenotype (ASAP) towards the SASP through dual feedforward mechanisms. Phosphorylation and activation of p38 MAPK occurs downstream of TAK1, followed by engagement of the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway that supports the chronic secretory phenotype. Apigenin does not block ATM or TAK1 phosphorylation but abrogates the sequential molecular events downstream, acting through the HSPA8 hub to dampen p38 MAPK and downstream PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement.
description_zh_TW: TAK1，調節SASP的關鍵細胞質激酶，在基因毒性應激後快速磷酸化，並通過雙重前饋機制功能性參與急性應激相關表型（ASAP）向SASP的轉變。p38 MAPK的磷酸化和激活發生在TAK1下游，隨後是PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路的參與，該通路支持慢性分泌表型。芹菜素不阻斷ATM或TAK1磷酸化，但廢除了下游的順序分子事件，通過HSPA8樞紐作用來抑制p38 MAPK和下游PI3K/Akt/mTOR的參與。

label: MEF2D (at Lys424)
description: HDAC4 possesses SUMO E3 ligase activity and sumoylates MEF2D at Lys424, locking it into an inactive, transcription-repressing state. Directionally, HDAC4 sits upstream of MEF2D inactivation. This regulates muscle-gene expression independently of sirtuins, and it is included as a parallel chromatin regulatory mechanism contextualizing SIRT1's muscle actions. By sumoylating MEF2D, HDAC4 represses its transcriptional activity and the muscle genes it controls. This regulation is distinct from the acetylation-deacetylation balance that sirtuins influence, illustrating the diversity of muscle-gene control.
description_zh_TW: HDAC4 具有 SUMO E3 連接酶活性，在 Lys424 位點 SUMO 化 MEF2D，將其鎖定在不活化的轉錄抑制狀態。在方向性上，HDAC4 位於 MEF2D 失活的上游。這獨立於 sirtuin 調控肌肉基因表達，被納入作為將 SIRT1 肌肉作用置於背景中的平行染色質調控機制。透過 SUMO 化 MEF2D，HDAC4 抑制其轉錄活性和它所控制的肌肉基因。此調控不同於 sirtuin 影響的乙醯化-去乙醯化平衡，說明了肌肉基因控制的多樣性。

label: SIRT7-kidney-specific knockout
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Kidney-specific SIRT7 knockout mice show diminished inflammation with reduced TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 and suppressed nuclear NF-κB p65 accumulation, indicating SIRT7 normally promotes renal NF-κB activation. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to less nuclear p65 and lower inflammation. This is somewhat counterintuitive given SIRT7's anti-inflammatory action in other contexts, underscoring the cell-type and context dependence of sirtuin function. It suggests SIRT7 can be pro-inflammatory in specific renal settings, and highlights that the same sirtuin can promote or suppress NF-κB signaling depending on the tissue environment, kinase signaling, and the balance of its interacting partners.
description_zh_TW: 腎臟特異性 SIRT7 敲除小鼠顯示發炎減輕，TNF-α、IL-1β 和 IL-6 減少，核 NF-κB p65 累積被抑制，表明 SIRT7 通常促進腎臟 NF-κB 活化。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致較少的核 p65 和較低的發炎。鑑於 SIRT7 在其他情境下的抗發炎作用，這有些違反直覺，強調了 sirtuin 功能的細胞類型和情境依賴性。它提示 SIRT7 在特定腎臟環境中可以是促發炎的，並強調同一 sirtuin 可以根據組織環境、激酶信號和其相互作用夥伴的平衡來促進或抑制 NF-κB 信號。

label: Caspase-3 (at Ser150)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates caspase-3 at Ser150, suppressing its proteolytic activity; this inhibition is reversed by the phosphatase PP2A. Directionally, p38 sits upstream of caspase-3 inhibition. This provides a survival signal that tempers apoptosis under certain stresses, and it shows that stress kinases can directly restrain executioner caspases. By phosphorylating pro-caspase-3, p38 reduces the pool available for proteolytic activation, blunting the death response. This regulatory layer illustrates how the balance between kinases and phosphatases determines the threshold for apoptotic commitment under stress.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在 Ser150 位點磷酸化 caspase-3，抑制其蛋白水解活性；此抑制可被磷酸酶 PP2A 逆轉。在方向性上，p38 位於 caspase-3 抑制的上游。這在某些壓力下提供生存訊號以調節凋亡，並表明壓力激酶可以直接抑制效應型 caspase。透過磷酸化前 caspase-3，p38 減少可用於蛋白水解活化的池，削弱死亡反應。這一調控層說明了激酶和磷酸酶之間的平衡如何決定壓力下的凋亡承諾閾值。

label: IKKalpha
description: IKKα (IKK1, CHUK) functions in two NF-κB modes: within the IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO heterocomplex it contributes to IκBα phosphorylation and canonical NF-κB activation downstream of TNFα, IL-1, LPS, and DNA damage; released from NEMO it forms homodimers that — driven by NIK — phosphorylate p100 into p52, driving non-canonical NF-κB (RelB:p52) signaling for lymphoid development and B-cell survival. IKKα also has nuclear, NF-κB-independent roles such as histone H3 Ser10 phosphorylation in mitosis.
description_zh_TW: IKKα（IKK1，CHUK）在兩種 NF-κB 模式中運作：在 IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO 異源複合體中，它參與 IκBα 的磷酸化與 TNFα、IL-1、LPS 及 DNA 損傷下游的典型 NF-κB 活化；脫離 NEMO 後，它形成同源二聚體，在 NIK 驅動下將 p100 磷酸化為 p52，推動非典型 NF-κB（RelB:p52）訊號以支配淋巴器官發育與 B 細胞存活。IKKα 另有獨立於 NF-κB 的細胞核角色，例如有絲分裂中組蛋白 H3 Ser10 的磷酸化。

label: necrosome
description: TNF-α binding to TNFR1 assembles complex I (RIPK1, TRADD, TRAF2, LUBAC, cIAP1, CYLD, NEMO). When NF-κB activation is suppressed, RIPK1 deubiquitinates and assembles complex IIa (ripoptosome) with FADD, TRADD, and pro-caspase-8 for apoptosis; with cIAP1 inhibited, complex IIb forms. Only when caspase-8 is absent or inhibited does RIPK1 recruit RIPK3 and MLKL into the necrosome — making TNF signaling a three-way fate decision in which the necrosome is the final, caspase-suppressed branch.
description_zh_TW: TNF-α 與 TNFR1 結合會組裝 complex I（RIPK1、TRADD、TRAF2、LUBAC、cIAP1、CYLD、NEMO）。當 NF-κB 活化受抑制時，RIPK1 去泛素化並與 FADD、TRADD 及 pro-Caspase-8 組裝出 complex IIa（ripoptosome）以進行細胞凋亡；當 cIAP1 受抑制時則形成 complex IIb。只有當 caspase-8 缺席或受抑制時，RIPK1 才會招募 RIPK3 與 MLKL 組成 necrosome——使 TNF 訊號成為三向的命運決定，而 necrosome 是 caspase 受壓制後的最終分支。

label: AP-1 complex
description: FOS (c-Fos) is an immediate-early bZIP transcription factor that heterodimerizes with JUN family members to form AP-1 complexes regulating proliferation, inflammation, and matrix remodeling genes. SIRT3 attenuates fibrosis in cardiomyocytes by inhibiting FOS/AP-1 (and STAT3/NFATc2) signaling, restraining pathological cardiac remodeling.
description_zh_TW: FOS（c-Fos）是一種即早 bZIP 轉錄因子，與 JUN 家族成員異二聚體化形成 AP-1 複合物，調節增殖、發炎和基質重塑基因。SIRT3 透過抑制 FOS/AP-1（和 STAT3/NFATc2）訊號在心肌細胞中減輕纖維化，抑制病理性心臟重塑。

label: as regulated by KLF10
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT6 by the tumor suppressor KLF10 activity influences glycolysis, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, and distant metastasis of pancreatic cancer cells. Directionally, KLF10-driven SIRT6 upregulation sits upstream of altered metabolic and invasive behaviors in pancreatic cancer. By modulating glycolysis and EMT, SIRT6 shapes the aggressiveness and metastatic capacity of pancreatic cancer cells, indicating that the KLF10-SIRT6 axis may serve as a therapeutic or prognostic target in pancreatic cancer.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抑制因子KLF10活性上調的SIRT6影響胰腺癌細胞的糖解作用、上皮-間質轉化和遠端轉移。方向上，KLF10驅動的SIRT6上調位於胰腺癌中代謝和侵襲行為改變的上游。透過調節糖解作用和EMT，SIRT6塑造胰腺癌細胞的侵襲性和轉移能力，表明KLF10-SIRT6軸可能作為胰腺癌中的治療或預後靶點。

label: aspirin cardiovascular response
description: COMT genotype determines the cardiovascular response to aspirin: slow (Met/Met) individuals gain protection against cardiovascular disease, whereas fast (Val/Val) individuals may see increased risk or no benefit. This pharmacogenetic effect arises from genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's actions on platelets, vascular endothelium, and redox balance. Stratifying aspirin therapy by COMT status could improve risk-benefit profiling in primary and secondary cardiovascular prevention. The finding exemplifies how a common polymorphism can gate a widely used drug's efficacy.
description_zh_TW: COMT genotype 決定了阿斯匹靈的心血管反應：慢速 (Met/Met) 個體獲得預防心血管疾病的保護，而快速 (Val/Val) 個體可能會看到風險增加或沒有益處。這種藥物基因效應源自於兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了阿斯匹靈對血小板、血管內皮和氧化還原平衡的作用。以 COMT 狀態對阿斯匹靈治療進行分層可以改善第一級和第二級心血管預防的風險效益分析。這項發現例證了常見的多態性如何控制廣泛使用的藥物的功效。

label: Glutathione Depletion
description: Asthma is associated with glutathione depletion, as the GSH/GSSG ratio is markedly decreased in asthmatic airways, weakening local antioxidant defense. This sensitizes the airway to oxidant triggers and allergen-induced inflammation. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that glutathione changes vary by asthma phenotype and severity, and some patients show different redox patterns. Replenishing airway GSH with N-acetylcysteine has been explored as an adjunctive strategy to restore antioxidant capacity in asthmatic airways.
description_zh_TW: Asthma 與 glutathione depletion 相關，因為 asthmatic 氣道中的 GSH/GSSG 比率顯著降低，削弱了局部抗氧化防禦。這會使氣道對氧化劑觸發物和過敏原引起的發炎變得敏感。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，glutathione 的變化因 asthma 表型和嚴重程度而異，並且一些患者表現出不同的氧化還原模式。人們已經探索以 N-乙醯半胱氨酸補充氣道 GSH 作為恢復 asthmatic 氣道抗氧化能力的輔助策略。

label: S130 enhances CR effect
source_file: _document_ - The Beneficial and Adverse Effects of Autophagic Response to Caloric Restriction and Fasting.md
description: The small-molecule ATG4B inhibitor S130 blocks the cysteine protease required for LC3 processing and autophagosome maturation; when combined with caloric restriction, this inhibition shifts the balance toward apoptotic death in colorectal cancer cells. By preventing autophagic protection of tumor cells while CR imposes metabolic stress, S130 sensitizes malignancy to cell death. The synergy illustrates a therapeutic strategy of pairing CR or CR-mimetics with targeted autophagy inhibition in cancer. The approach exploits the reliance of some tumors on basal autophagy for survival.
description_zh_TW: 小分子 ATG4B 抑制劑 S130 阻斷 LC3 處理和自噬體成熟所需的半胱氨酸蛋白酶；當與熱量限制結合時，此抑制在大腸癌細胞中將平衡推向凋亡性死亡。透過防止腫瘤細胞的自噬保護，同時熱量限制施加代謝壓力，S130 使惡性腫瘤對細胞死亡敏感化。此協同作用說明了一種將熱量限制或熱量限制擬似物與標靶性自噬抑制配對用於癌症的治療策略。此方法利用了某些腫瘤對基礎自噬存活的依賴。

label: ATG4B inhibiting autophagy
source_file: _document_ - The Beneficial and Adverse Effects of Autophagic Response to Caloric Restriction and Fasting.md
description: The acetyltransferase p300 acetylates ATG4B, an modification that inhibits its proteolytic activity required for LC3 lipidation and autophagosome formation, thereby restraining autophagy under normal conditions. This acetylation-dependent repression adds a transcriptional coactivator-derived control layer to core autophagy machinery beyond the well-studied phosphorylation circuits. Relief of p300-mediated acetylation during stress can de-repress ATG4B and facilitate autophagic flux. The finding situates autophagy regulation within the broader acetylome governed by p300/CBP.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯轉移酶 p300 乙醯化 ATG4B，此修飾抑制其為 LC3 脂化和自噬體形成所需的蛋白水解活性，從而在正常條件下約束自噬。此依賴乙醯化的抑制在眾所周知的磷酸化電路之外，為核心自噬機械增添了源自轉錄共活化因子的控制層次。在壓力期間 p300 媒介乙醯化的解除可解除 ATG4B 的抑制並促進自噬流。此發現將自噬調節置於 p300/CBP 所統轄的更廣泛乙醯體中。

label: Aurora Kinase
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Disruption of SIRT2 in the mouse raises the levels of the mitotic regulators Aurora-A and Aurora-B, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death. Because SIRT2 is a tubulin deacetylase and a guardian of mitotic fidelity, its loss impairs the control that normally keeps Aurora kinase abundance in check during division. The directionality is that SIRT2 sits upstream: reduced SIRT2 permits Aurora kinase accumulation, which then destabilizes mitosis. This pathway connects sirtuin biology to chromosome segregation and genomic instability in tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠中破壞 SIRT2 會提高有絲分裂調節因子 Aurora-A 和 Aurora-B 的水平，導致非整倍體和有絲分裂細胞死亡。由於 SIRT2 是微管蛋白去乙醯酶且是有絲分裂精準度的守護者，其缺失損害了正常情況下在細胞分裂期間控制 Aurora 激酶豐度的機制。方向性上 SIRT2 位於上游：SIRT2 減少允許 Aurora 激酶累積，進而使有絲分裂不穩定。此途徑將 sirtuin 生物學與染色體分離和基因組不穩定性在腫瘤發生中的作用聯繫起來。

label: Autophagic Lysosome Reformation
description: Autophagic lysosome reformation (ALR) is the process by which spent autolysosomes tubulate and bud off new lysosomes to restore the lysosomal pool after autophagy. ALR requires the coordinated actions of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2), clathrin, and adaptor proteins AP2 and AP4 to drive membrane scission and vesicle formation. This reformation step is essential to prevent lysosomal depletion during sustained autophagy. Defects in ALR cause accumulation of enlarged autolysosomes and impaired degradative capacity.
description_zh_TW: 自噬性溶酶體重組（ALR）是耗損的自體溶酶體經由小管形成並出芽產生新溶酶體，以在自噬後恢復溶酶體庫的過程。ALR 需要磷脂醯肌醇 4,5-二磷酸（PI(4,5)P2）、clathrin 以及接頭蛋白 AP2 與 AP4 的協調作用，以驅動膜分裂和囊泡形成。此重組步驟對防止持續自噬期間溶酶體耗竭至為必要。ALR 的缺陷導致腫大的自體溶酶體累積以及降解能力受損。

label: Axonal/Wallerian degeneration (via SIRT1)
description: Nmnat, the NAD+-biosynthetic enzyme, protects axons from Wallerian degeneration largely by raising NAD+ and thereby activating SIRT1, which supports axonal survival after injury. The protection is upstream of SIRT1-dependent maintenance of mitochondrial and chromatin function in neurons, preserving axon integrity when the soma is damaged. Directionally, Nmnat increases NAD+, which activates SIRT1 to provide axonal protection. This established a key NAD+/sirtuin axis in neuronal resilience, informed subsequent studies of SARM1-mediated NAD+ depletion in axonal degeneration, and helped motivate the use of NAD+ precursors such as NMN and NR to protect neurons.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物合成酶 Nmnat 主要通過提高 NAD+ 並從而活化 SIRT1 來保護軸突免於 Wallerian 變性，SIRT1 支持損傷後的軸突存活。這種保護位於 SIRT1 依賴性維持神經元粒線體和染色質功能的上游，在胞體受損時保留軸突完整性。在方向性上，Nmnat 增加 NAD+，進而活化 SIRT1 以提供軸突保護。這確立了神經元韌性中一個關鍵的 NAD+/sirtuin 軸，為後續 SARM1 介導的軸突變性中 NAD+ 耗竭的研究提供了資訊，並推動了使用 NAD+ 前體（如 NMN 和 NR）來保護神經元的研究。

label: Nmnat (NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme)
