label: Systolic Blood Pressure
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation reduces systolic blood pressure (SBP) and aortic stiffness, two clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function and health. These effects may occur through nuclear and cytosolic SIRT1 activation, since NAD+ is an obligate substrate for the deacetylase SIRT1, which has been implicated in the maintenance of healthy vascular function, including endothelium-dependent vascular relaxation. In mouse models, NR-induced reduction of SBP and aortic stiffness was documented alongside improved NAD+ homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充可降低收縮壓（SBP）與主動脈僵硬程度，這兩者是心血管功能與健康的臨床重要風險指標。這些效應可能經由核內與胞質中的 SIRT1 活化而發生，因為 NAD+ 是去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的必需受質，而 SIRT1 已被認為參與維持健康的血管功能，包括內皮依賴性血管舒張。在小鼠模型中，NR 誘發的 SBP 與主動脈僵硬程度降低，伴隨 NAD+ 恆定性的改善而被記錄下來。

label: Bovine Milk
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was first discovered in milk and, until recently, had only been measured there. Bovine milk contains the highest NR content among milk sources at 0.5-3.6 uM, while human milk is the richest source of nicotinamide mononucleotide at 2.1-9.8 uM. NR and NMN are also determined in different species of milk and beer. The niacin quantified by microbiological assay (AOAC Method 944.13) actually includes NR and NMN, because hot acid or alkaline extraction hydrolyzes these molecules into nicotinic acid, meaning NR and NMN contribute to the measured niacin content of milk and other foods.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）最早在牛奶中被發現，且直到最近都只在那裡被測得。牛乳在乳源中 NR 含量最高，達 0.5-3.6 uM，而人乳是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。NR 和 NMN 也在不同物種的乳汁與啤酒中被測定。以微生物分析法（AOAC Method 944.13）定量出的菸鹼酸實際上包含 NR 和 NMN，因為熱酸或鹼性萃取會將這些分子水解為菸鹼酸，意味著 NR 和 NMN 貢獻了牛奶與其他食物中測得的菸鹼酸含量。

label: Macrophage Infiltration
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Preclinical studies have reported that nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces macrophage infiltration in damaged muscles and attenuates plasma TNF-alpha in models of fatty liver disease. These anti-inflammatory effects contribute to the improvement of metabolism and the decrease in chronic inflammation, a hallmark of aging, that underlie the life-prolonging benefits attributed to NR supplementation. Macrophage infiltration into injured tissue promotes inflammation and fibrosis, and its reduction by NR supports the management of muscular dystrophy and age-related tissue degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 臨床前研究報導，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）減少受損肌肉中的巨噬細胞浸潤，並在脂肪肝疾病模型中減弱血漿 TNF-alpha。這些抗發炎效果有助於代謝改善與慢性發炎（老化的標記）的降低，而後者構成了歸因於 NR 補充的延壽益處的基礎。巨噬細胞浸潤受傷組織會促進發炎與纖維化，而 NR 對其的減少支持了肌肉營養不良與年齡相關組織退化的管理。

label: SIRT1 (via Hes1 deacetylation)
description: SIRT1 directly regulates BDNF transcription by deacetylating and repressing Hes1, a transcriptional repressor of BDNF, thereby relieving inhibition and promoting neuronal survival. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylates Hes1, which induces BDNF. This links sirtuin activity to neurotrophic support, and it is a mechanism for SIRT1's neuroprotective and cognitive benefits. By removing the Hes1 brake on the BDNF promoter, SIRT1 increases BDNF expression in the brain. This regulation is engaged by caloric restriction and exercise, both of which elevate BDNF through SIRT1-dependent pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並抑制 Hes1——一種 BDNF 的轉錄抑制因子——直接調控 BDNF 轉錄，從而解除抑制並促進神經元存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 去乙醯化 Hes1，後者誘導 BDNF。這將 sirtuin 活性與神經營養支持聯繫起來，是 SIRT1 神經保護和認知益處的機制。透過移除 Hes1 對 BDNF 啟動子的制動，SIRT1 增加大腦中的 BDNF 表達。此調控在限制熱量和運動中被啟動，兩者都透過 SIRT1 依賴性途徑提高 BDNF。

label: COVID-19 lymphocyte homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: The unbalanced p53/SIRT1 axis may impact lymphocyte homeostasis in COVID-19 patients. COVID-19 is characterized by increased p53 transcription in circulating lymphocytes and a persistently activated form of p53, possibly due to low SIRT1 levels. Directionally, low SIRT1 and elevated p53 activity sit upstream of disturbed lymphocyte homeostasis. Because SIRT1 normally deacetylates p53 and restrains its pro-apoptotic activity, its deficiency could leave lymphocytes vulnerable to p53-driven apoptosis and contribute to the lymphopenia seen in severe disease. Increased SIRT1 expression might therefore help alleviate COVID-19 pathogenesis by restoring the balance of this axis.
description_zh_TW: 失衡的p53/SIRT1軸可能影響COVID-19患者的淋巴細胞恆定。COVID-19的特徵是循環淋巴細胞中p53轉錄增加和p53持續活化形式，可能源於低SIRT1水平。方向上，低SIRT1和升高的p53活性位於淋巴細胞恆定受擾的上游。因為SIRT1通常去乙醯化p53並抑制其促凋亡活性，其缺乏可能使淋巴細胞容易受到p53驅動的凋亡，並促成重症中可見的淋巴細胞減少症。因此增加SIRT1表達可能透過恢復此軸的平衡來幫助緩解COVID-19的發病機制。

label: CRC radioresistance via β-catenin
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: FoxQ1-mediated SIRT1 upregulation augments the expression and nuclear translocation of β-catenin and benefits CRC-related intestinal pathological bacteria, thereby enhancing the radioresistance of colorectal cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 upregulation sits upstream of β-catenin-driven survival and radiation resistance in CRC. By promoting β-catenin signaling, SIRT1 helps colorectal cancer cells survive ionizing radiation, which has implications for combining SIRT1 inhibition with radiotherapy to improve treatment outcomes.
description_zh_TW: FoxQ1介導的SIRT1上調增強了β-catenin的表達和核轉位，並有利於CRC相關的腸道致病菌，從而增強大腸直腸癌細胞的放射抗性。方向上，SIRT1上調位於CRC中β-catenin驅動的存活和輻射抗性的上游。透過促進β-catenin訊號，SIRT1幫助大腸直腸癌細胞在電離輻射中存活，這對於將SIRT1抑制與放療結合以改善治療結果具有意義。

label: DAF-16 (FOXO)
description: The lifespan extension produced by sir-2.1 overexpression in C. elegans is strictly dependent on the forkhead transcription factor DAF-16, the worm FOXO ortholog. DAF-16 is the downstream effector that induces stress-resistance and xenobiotic-detoxification genes once sir-2.1 releases it from repression. Mechanistically, sir-2.1 deacetylates and cooperates with DAF-16 to drive the longevity transcriptional program. Thus the directionality is sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → lifespan, and removing DAF-16 abolishes the benefit.

label: sir-2.1 lifespan extension
description: The lifespan extension produced by sir-2.1 overexpression in C. elegans is strictly dependent on the forkhead transcription factor DAF-16, the worm FOXO ortholog. DAF-16 is the downstream effector that induces stress-resistance and xenobiotic-detoxification genes once sir-2.1 releases it from repression. Mechanistically, sir-2.1 deacetylates and cooperates with DAF-16 to drive the longevity transcriptional program. Thus the directionality is sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → lifespan, and removing DAF-16 abolishes the benefit.

label: DAF-2
description: DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor ortholog, partially regulates MXL-3 expression such that impaired insulin signaling leads to modest repression of mxl-3 transcription. This places MXL-3 downstream of the insulin-signaling axis that broadly controls metabolism and longevity in worms. The partial effect indicates that additional nutrient and developmental inputs also govern mxl-3, consistent with its role as a multifactorial repressor. The linkage reinforces the canonical insulin→autophagy/lipid regulatory cascade.
description_zh_TW: DAF-2 是線蟲的胰島素/IGF-1 受體同源物，部分調節 MXL-3 表現，使得胰島素信號受損會導致 mxl-3 轉錄的適度抑制。這將 MXL-3 置於廣泛控制線蟲代謝和長壽的胰島素信號軸下游。此部分效應表明額外的營養和發育輸入也控制 mxl-3，與其作為多因子抑制因子的角色一致。此連結強化了典型的胰島素→自噬/脂質調節級聯。

label: Deptor
description: Deptor is an endogenous inhibitor that binds both mTORC1 and mTORC2, suppressing the catalytic activity of each complex. By dampening both arms of mTOR signaling, Deptor broadly restrains anabolic growth, survival, and autophagy suppression. Its expression is itself feedback-regulated by mTORC1/mTORC2 activity, forming part of a homeostatic loop. Reduced Deptor levels in certain cancers correlate with hyperactive mTOR signaling, highlighting its tumor-suppressive potential.
description_zh_TW: Deptor 是一種內生抑制劑，結合 mTORC1 和 mTORC2 兩者，抑制各複合物的催化活性。透過阻尼 mTOR 信號的兩條臂，Deptor 廣泛地約束合成代謝生長、存活和自噬抑制。其表現本身受 mTORC1/mTORC2 活性回饋調節，構成恆定性迴圈的一部分。某些癌症中 Deptor 水平降低與過度活化的 mTOR 信號相關，凸顯了其腫瘤抑制潛力。

label: Diabetic Cardiomyopathy
description: SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress in DCM primarily through the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway. SIRT3 downregulation breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression; melatonin protects via Mst1 inhibition and SIRT3 upregulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化主要透過 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並在 DCM 中抑制氧化壓力。SIRT3 下調打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展；melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 和上調 SIRT3 發揮保護作用。

label: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera)
description: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) activates the NRF2 pathway in MS therapy by modifying KEAP1 cysteines, inducing HO-1, NQO1, and GPx to bolster antioxidant defense in glia and neurons. This is a registered disease-modifying treatment for relapsing MS. The directionality is fumarate to NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. A caveat is that dimethyl fumarate also shifts lymphocyte subsets and can cause flushing and GI effects, so NRF2 activation is one of several mechanisms. Clinical trials show reduced relapses and disability progression, though the precise contribution of NRF2 versus other fumarate actions remains debated.
description_zh_TW: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸活化 NRF2 pathway in MS therapy，誘導 HO-1、NQO1 和 GPx，以增強神經膠質和神經元的抗氧化防禦。這是一種針對復發性多發性硬化症的註冊疾病緩解治療方法。方向性為富馬酸鹽至 NRF2 依賴性細胞保護。需要注意的是，富馬酸二甲酯也會改變淋巴細胞亞群，並可能引起潮紅和胃腸道效應，因此 NRF2 活化是多種機制之一。臨床試驗顯示，儘管 NRF2 與其他富馬酸鹽藥物相比，其確切貢獻仍有爭議，但復發和殘疾進展有所減少。

label: Dopachrome tautomerase
description: Dopachrome tautomerase and Tyrosinase-related protein-2 are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Dopachrome tautomerase and Tyrosinase-related protein-2 may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase 和 Tyrosinase-related protein-2 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Dopachrome tautomerase 和 Tyrosinase-related protein-2 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: drug response
description: SNPs can predict individual drug response by altering the structure or expression of drug-metabolizing enzymes, transporters, or drug targets, as exemplified by COMT Val158Met predicting aspirin and modafinil responses. Pharmacogenetic testing leverages such variants to personalize dosing and choice of therapy, improving efficacy and reducing adverse effects. The predictive power varies with the size and direction of each variant's effect and with gene-environment interactions. This approach is central to precision medicine.
description_zh_TW: SNPs 可以透過改變藥物代謝酶、轉運蛋白或藥物標靶的結構或表現來預測個別 drug response，例如 COMT Val158Met 預測阿斯匹靈和莫達非尼反應。藥物基因學測試利用這些變異來個人化劑量和治療選擇，提高療效並減少不良反應。預測能力隨每個變異效應的大小和方向以及基因-環境交互作用而變化。這種方法是精準醫學的核心。

label: endothelial cell senescence
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Downregulation of SIRT1 was found to be important in the senescence of different types of endothelial cells. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of cellular senescence in the vascular endothelium. Because SIRT1 normally promotes stress resistance and genomic stability, its decline in endothelial cells is linked to the senescent phenotype. This positions SIRT1 as a potential target for preserving endothelial function and preventing vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1的下調在不同類型內皮細胞的衰老中被發現具有重要意義。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於血管內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT1通常促進壓力抗性和基因組穩定性，其在內皮細胞中的下降與衰老表型相關。這將SIRT1確定為維持內皮功能和預防血管老化的潛在靶點。

label: Pro-oxidants
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Flavonoids can act as pro-oxidants at high concentrations because, in the presence of transition metals, they undergo autoxidation that generates semiquinone radicals and subsequently superoxide and H2O2. This biphasic behavior underlies their hormetic profile. The directionality is high-dose flavonoid to radical generation. A caveat is that pro-oxidant effects are favored by metal abundance and high dose, whereas low doses are generally antioxidant. This pro-oxidant behavior is implicated in their anticancer effects, where selective ROS generation can drive apoptosis in malignant cells.
description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 在高濃度下可以充當 pro-oxidants，因為在過渡金屬存在的情況下，它們會發生 autoxidation，生成半醌自由基，隨後生成超氧化物和 H2O2。这种双相行为是其毒物兴奋效应的基础。方向性是大剂量黄酮类物质向自由基生成。需要注意的是，金属丰度和高剂量有利于促氧化作用，而低剂量通常具有抗氧化作用。这种促氧化行为与它们的抗 cancer 作用有关，其中选择性 ROS 生成可以在恶性细胞中驱动 apoptosis。

label: protein function
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Glycation is a spontaneous non-enzymatic reaction of reducing sugars with free amino groups of proteins, DNA, and lipids that leads to loss of protein function and impaired elasticity of tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons. The process is highly accelerated in the presence of hyperglycemia and tissue oxidative stress, implicating it in diabetic complications and aging. Intracellular AGE modification of signaling molecules can impair cellular functions and gene expression, and glycation of antioxidant enzymes such as catalase, glutathione peroxidase, and glutathione reductase reduces their activity, further increasing cellular oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Glycation 是 reducing sugars 與蛋白質、DNA 和脂質的游離 amino groups 自發性非酵素反應，會導致蛋白質功能喪失以及 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等組織彈性受損。此過程在 hyperglycemia 與組織 oxidative stress 存在下大幅加速，使其涉及 diabetic complications 與 aging。細胞內 signaling molecules 的 intracellular AGE modification 會損害細胞功能與 gene expression，而 catalase、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione reductase 等 antioxidant enzymes 的 glycation 會降低其活性，進一步增加細胞 oxidative stress。

label: neuroprotective properties
description: Luteolin has neuroprotective properties, including suppression of neuroinflammation, reduction of oxidative stress, and modulation of microglial activation, which may protect neurons in models of neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation. These effects are mediated through pathways such as Nrf2 and NF-kappaB rather than through COMT. Its catechol structure, however, means high doses can interact with COMT as both substrate and competitive inhibitor. It is studied for potential benefit in cognitive decline and brain injury.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 neuroprotective properties，包括抑制神經發炎、減少氧化壓力和調節小膠質細胞活化，這可能會保護神經退化性和神經發炎模型中的神經元。這些作用是透過 Nrf2 和 NF-kappaB 等途徑介導的，而不是透過 COMT 介導的。然而，其茶酚結構意味著高劑量可以與作為底物和競爭性抑制劑的 COMT 相互作用。研究了它對認知能力下降和 brain 損傷的潛在益處。

label: EGCG bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Quercetin enhances EGCG bioavailability by inhibiting the metabolism and efflux of EGCG, increasing the proportion of the parent catechin available in its bioactive form. As a catechol flavonoid itself, quercetin may also compete for COMT, further slowing EGCG O-methylation and extending its exposure. The quercetin-EGCG combination is therefore studied for synergistic polyphenol effects on metabolism and oxidative stress. This interaction illustrates how co-ingested flavonoids modulate each other's pharmacokinetics.
description_zh_TW: Quercetin 透過抑制 EGCG 的代謝和流出來增強 EGCG bioavailability，從而增加母體兒茶素以其生物活性形式提供的比例。作為 catechol flavonoid 本身，槲皮素也可能與 COMT 競爭，進一步減緩 EGCG O-甲基化並延長其暴露時間。因此，研究了槲皮素-EGCG 組合對代謝和氧化壓力的協同多酚效應。這種相互作用說明了共同攝取的黃酮類化合物如何調節彼此的藥物動力學。

label: Geraldol
description: Fisetin is metabolized by COMT to geraldol (3'-O-methylfisetin). This metabolic activation is concentration-dependent and consumes SAMe, generating SAH.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 被 COMT 代謝為 geraldol（3'-O-methylfisetin）。此代謝活化呈濃度依賴，並消耗 SAMe，生成 SAH。

label: Senolytic Agent
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin belongs to the pharmacological class of senolytics, agents that selectively kill senescent cells. Senolytics, exemplified by fisetin and dasatinib plus quercetin, exploit the reliance of senescent cells on anti-apoptotic survival networks. Fisetin's senolytic profile was identified in screening studies and validated in mouse models where it cleared senescent cells in adipose tissue, bone marrow, and other organs and extended healthspan. Because senescent cell accumulation drives tissue dysfunction and age-related disease, fisetin is now being evaluated in human trials, and its classification as a senolytic frames the therapeutic rationale for improving its bioavailability.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin屬於senolytic（衰老細胞清除劑）藥理學類別，即選擇性殺死衰老細胞的藥物。以fisetin及dasatinib加quercetin為代表的senolytic，利用衰老細胞對抗凋亡存活網絡的依賴。Fisetin的senolytic特性在篩選研究中被識別，並在小鼠模型中獲得驗證：它清除脂肪組織、骨髓及其他器官中的衰老細胞，並延長健康壽命。由於衰老細胞累積驅動組織功能失調與年齡相關疾病，fisetin目前正在人體試驗中評估，而其作為senolytic的分類也為改善其生體可用率的治療學理提供框架。

label: Neuroprotective Activity
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin exerts neuroprotective effects that are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and direct signaling actions in neurons. It protects cultured neurons from oxidative and excitotoxic insults, and in animal models of ischemia and Parkinson's disease it reduces neuronal loss and improves motor function. Fisetin also acts as a cognitive enhancer, improving learning and memory in healthy rodents through modulation of ERK-CREB signaling and by promoting synaptic plasticity, and it has been proposed as a candidate for Alzheimer's disease based on its ability to reduce beta-amyloid aggregation and tau pathology. These effects motivate delivery strategies aimed at improving brain exposure.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin發揮的神經保護效應歸因於其在神經元中的抗氧化、抗發炎與直接訊號傳導作用。它能保護培養神經元免受氧化與興奮性毒性傷害，且在缺血與帕金森氏症動物模型中減少神經元損失並改善運動功能。Fisetin也作為認知增強劑，透過調節ERK-CREB訊號並促進突觸可塑性，改善健康囓齒類的學習與記憶；基於其減少β-類澱粉蛋白聚集與tau病理的能力，也被提出作為阿茲海默症的候選藥物。這些效應推動了旨在提高腦部暴露量的給藥策略。

label: Low Water Solubility
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin has extremely low water solubility, reported in the range of a few micrograms per milliliter, which classifies it as a Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS) class II or IV drug. The low solubility, combined with poor permeability in some assessments and extensive intestinal and hepatic first-pass metabolism, results in low and erratic oral bioavailability. Because dissolution is the rate-limiting step for oral absorption, much of the formulation research described in the review aims to increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility of fisetin, using approaches such as solid dispersions, cyclodextrin inclusion complexes, and nanocrystals.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin的水溶性極低，報告值約為每毫升數微克，使其被歸類為生物藥劑學分類系統（BCS）第II類或第IV類藥物。低溶解度加上部分評估中較差的通透性，以及廣泛的腸道與肝臟首次通過代謝，導致低且不穩定的口服生體可用率。由於溶離是口服吸收的速率決定步驟，該綜述所述的大部分配方研究旨在提高fisetin的溶離速率與表觀溶解度，使用固體分散、環糊精包合物與奈米晶體等方法。

label: Anti-diabetic Activity
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin improves glucose homeostasis in experimental diabetes by enhancing insulin sensitivity and reducing hepatic glucose output. In diabetic rodents it lowers fasting blood glucose and glycated hemoglobin, reduces insulin resistance, and protects pancreatic beta cells, in part through its antioxidant activity and activation of AMPK signaling in liver and muscle. The review notes these metabolic benefits depend on adequate systemic exposure, which the oral delivery of unformulated fisetin may not achieve, further emphasizing the need for bioavailability-improving formulations to realize its therapeutic potential in humans.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin透過提高胰島素敏感性與減少肝臟葡萄糖輸出，改善實驗性糖尿病的葡萄糖恆定。在糖尿病囓齒類中，它降低空腹血糖與糖化血色素、減少胰島素阻抗，並保護胰臟β細胞，部分透過其抗氧化活性與活化肝臟及肌肉中的AMPK訊號。該綜述指出，這些代謝益處取決於足夠的全身暴露量，而未經配方處理的fisetin口服給藥可能無法達成，進一步強調需要能改善生體可用率的配方，才能實現其於人體的治療潛力。

label: Anti-oxidative Activity
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin is a potent antioxidant that scavenges reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species and stimulates endogenous antioxidant defenses including Nrf2-dependent expression of heme oxygenase-1, catalase, and superoxide dismutase. Its multiple hydroxyl groups allow it to donate electrons to quench free radicals and chelate metal ions that catalyze oxidative damage. The anti-oxidative action of fisetin underpins its protective effects in neuronal, cardiac, hepatic, and renal models of oxidative stress, and is considered a core mechanism shared with other polyphenols in its protective pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin是一種強效抗氧化劑，可清除活性氧物種（ROS）與活性氮物種，並刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，包括Nrf2依賴性的血基質氧化酶-1（heme oxygenase-1）、過氧化氫酶與超氧化物歧化酶表現。其多個羥基使其能捐贈電子以淬滅自由基，並螯合催化氧化損傷的金屬離子。fisetin的抗氧化作用是其於神經、心臟、肝臟與腎臟氧化壓力模型中保護效應的基礎，並被認為是其保護性藥理學中與其他多酚類共有的核心機制。

label: Senolytic Activity
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin is among the most extensively studied naturally occurring senolytics. It selectively eliminates senescent cells by inhibiting key pro-survival pathways, including the PI3K/Akt and Bcl-xL pathways that senescent cells depend on to resist apoptosis. In aged mice, a short course of oral fisetin reduced senescent cell burden in multiple tissues, extended healthspan and median lifespan, and alleviated age-related dysfunction. This senolytic activity distinguishes fisetin from many flavonoids and has driven its evaluation in human clinical trials for osteoarthritis, frailty, and other age-related conditions, though pharmacokinetic limitations remain a central obstacle.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin是研究最廣泛的天然衰老細胞清除劑（senolytic）之一。它透過抑制衰老細胞賴以抵抗凋亡的關鍵促存活途徑（包括PI3K/Akt與Bcl-xL途徑），選擇性地清除衰老細胞。在老年小鼠中，短期口服fisetin可降低多種組織中的衰老細胞負擔、延長健康壽命（healthspan）與中位壽命，並緩解年齡相關的功能失調。此senolytic活性使fisetin有別於許多黃酮類化合物，並驅動其進入針對骨關節炎、衰弱及其他年齡相關疾病的人類臨床試驗，儘管藥代動力學限制仍是核心障礙。

label: Limited Oral Absorption
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin is incompletely and variably absorbed after oral administration due to its low water solubility and rapid first-pass metabolism by intestinal and hepatic conjugating enzymes. Bioavailability studies report low and highly variable plasma fisetin concentrations after oral dosing, with most of the absorbed compound present as glucuronide and sulfate conjugates rather than the parent aglycone. The review identifies this limited oral absorption as the principal barrier to clinical translation of fisetin's broad preclinical pharmacology, and the majority of the formulation strategies it discusses are specifically aimed at increasing the fraction of the orally administered dose that reaches the systemic circulation unchanged.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin口服給藥後的吸收不完全且變異大，原因在於其低水溶性，以及腸道與肝臟接合酶快速的首次通過代謝。生體可用率研究報告指出，口服給藥後血漿fisetin濃度低且高度變異，大部分被吸收的化合物以葡萄糖醛酸（glucuronide）與硫酸（sulfate）接合物形式存在，而非母體苷元（aglycone）。該綜述將此有限的口服吸收認定為fisetin廣泛臨床前藥理學轉譯的主要障礙，而其討論的大部分配方策略均專門針對提高口服劑量中未經改變即到達全身循環的比例。

label: Anti-cancer Activity
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin shows broad anti-cancer activity against cell lines derived from lung, colon, breast, prostate, liver, melanoma, bladder, and leukemia. It inhibits cancer cell proliferation by arresting the cell cycle at G1 or G2/M phase, induces apoptosis through the intrinsic mitochondrial pathway with activation of caspases and modulation of Bcl-2 family proteins, and suppresses invasion and metastasis by inhibiting matrix metalloproteinases and epithelial-mesenchymal transition. Fisetin also sensitizes tumor cells to conventional chemotherapeutics. Its anti-cancer efficacy in animal models, however, has been limited by the low concentrations achieved after oral dosing.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin對源自肺、結腸、乳、前列腺、肝、黑色素瘤、膀胱與白血病的細胞株展現廣泛的抗癌活性。它透過將細胞週期阻斷於G1或G2/M期來抑制癌細胞增殖，經由內在粒線體途徑誘發凋亡（伴隨caspase活化與Bcl-2家族蛋白調節），並透過抑制基質金屬蛋白酶與上皮-間質轉換來抑制侵襲與轉移。Fisetin也會使腫瘤細胞對傳統化療藥物敏感化。然而，其動物模型中的抗癌效力受到口服給藥後僅達低濃度所限制。

label: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Once absorbed, fisetin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases (UGTs) and sulfotransferases in the intestinal epithelium and liver, producing fisetin glucuronide and fisetin sulfate metabolites that circulate in the plasma. Because these conjugates have reduced biological activity and are rapidly excreted via bile and urine, the parent aglycone fisetin reaches only low concentrations in tissues. The extent of this phase II metabolism is a primary cause of fisetin's poor oral bioavailability and short plasma half-life, and it is one reason most preclinical efficacy studies have used intraperitoneal injection rather than oral dosing.
description_zh_TW: 一旦被吸收，fisetin會被腸道上皮與肝臟中的UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶（UGT）與磺基轉移酶廣泛接合，產生在血漿中循環的fisetin葡萄糖醛酸與fisetin硫酸代謝物。由於這些接合物生物活性降低，且會經由膽汁與尿液迅速排泄，母體苷元fisetin在組織中僅達到低濃度。此第二相反應的程度是fisetin口服生體可用率差與血漿半衰期短的主要原因，也是多數臨床前療效研究採用腹腔注射而非口服給藥的原因之一。

label: PI3K/Akt pathway
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan.md
description: Senescent cells resist apoptosis by upregulating Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs). Like Quercetin, Fisetin targets SCAP members including the PI3K/Akt pro-survival axis, inducing selective death of some senescent cell types — e.g., caspase3/7-mediated apoptosis in senescent HUVECs.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞透過上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs）抵抗凋亡。Fisetin 如同 Quercetin，會攻擊包括 PI3K/Akt 存活軸在內的 SCAP 成員，選擇性地殺死部分衰老細胞類型——例如在衰老的 HUVECs 中誘發 caspase3/7 介導的細胞凋亡。

label: Endothelial nitric oxide bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 plays a pivotal role in maintaining endothelial cell function by preserving mitochondrial integrity via the SIRT3/ATG5 axis, thereby reducing ROS levels and sustaining nitric oxide bioavailability. Directionally, the axis sits upstream of maintained endothelial NO signaling. Conversely, absence of SIRT3 in EC-specific knockout models leads to exaggerated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and endothelial dysfunction, fostering a pro-inflammatory, pro-atherogenic phenotype.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 SIRT3/ATG5 軸保持粒線體完整性，從而降低 ROS 水平並維持一氧化氮生物利用度，從而在維持內皮細胞功能中發揮關鍵作用。從方向上看，該軸位於維持的內皮 NO 訊號傳導的上游。相反，EC特異性敲除模型中SIRT3的缺失會導致NLRP3發炎小體過度活化和內皮功能障礙，進而形成促發炎、促動脈粥狀硬化的表型。

label: SIRT3/ATG5 axis
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

label: endothelial senescence via oxidative stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Research has shown that senescence of endothelial cells is induced by oxidative stress due to SIRT6 downregulation. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of oxidative stress-driven endothelial senescence. Because SIRT6 normally supports antioxidant defences and DNA repair, its decline leaves endothelial cells vulnerable to oxidative damage and the senescent phenotype, linking SIRT6 to vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: 研究表明，由於SIRT6下調導致的氧化壓力誘導了內皮細胞的衰老。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於氧化壓力驅動的內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT6通常支持抗氧化防禦和DNA修復，其下降使內皮細胞容易受到氧化損傷和衰老表型的影響，將SIRT6與血管老化聯繫起來。

label: SIRT6 downregulation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

label: Energy homeostasis and autophagy
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 and AMPK form a reciprocal regulatory loop in which each can activate the other, jointly promoting energy homeostasis and autophagic flux. Directionally, the interaction is bidirectional: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates LKB1 and PGC-1α while AMPK phosphorylates and activates SIRT1. This creates a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit, and it is a central node integrating nutrient sensing and clearance. By activating each other, SIRT1 and AMPK amplify catabolic and protective programs, including mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy. This loop is a key target for interventions that aim to restore metabolic health in aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 和 AMPK 形成雙向調控迴路，兩者可以互相活化，共同促進能量恆定性和自噬通量。在方向性上，此相互作用是雙向的：SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 LKB1 和 PGC-1α，而 AMPK 磷酸化並活化 SIRT1。這創造了一個自強化的代謝迴路，是整合營養感知和清除的核心節點。透過互相活化，SIRT1 和 AMPK 放大分解代謝和保護程式，包括粒線體生物合成和自噬。此迴路是旨在恢復衰老代謝健康的干預措施的關鍵靶標。

label: Enzyme-coupled nicotinamide assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The enzyme-coupled assay for nicotinamide detection measures sirtuin activity continuously by coupling nicotinamidase (which hydrolyzes nicotinamide to nicotinic acid and ammonia) to glutamate dehydrogenase, which converts ammonia, alpha-ketoglutarate, and NAD(P)H to glutamate and NAD(P)+, quantified spectrophotometrically at 340 nm. It was developed in 2009 and, while not used yet on the scale of large screenings, could be adapted to a high-throughput format. Directionally, a continuous enzyme-coupled readout avoids the artifacts associated with fluorescent and end-point assays.
description_zh_TW: 用於尼可醯胺偵測的酵素偶聯測定透過將尼可醯胺酶（水解尼可醯胺為尼可酸和氨）與穀氨酸脫氫酶偶聯來連續測量 sirtuin 活性，後者將氨、α-酮戊二酸和 NAD(P)H 轉化為穀氨酸和 NAD(P)+，在 340 nm 處進行分光光度法定量。它於 2009 年開發，儘管尚未大規模應用於大型篩選，但可以改編為高通量格式。方向性上連續的酵素偶聯讀取避免了與螢光和終點測定相關的假象。

label: Eosinophil Peroxidase
description: Eosinophil peroxidase produces hypobromous acid (HOBr) by using bromide and H2O2 to generate the brominating oxidant in eosinophilic inflammation such as allergic asthma. HOBr is the eosinophil analog of neutrophil HOCl. The directionality is EPO catalysis to HOBr formation. A caveat is that HOBr is less studied than HOCl, and bromination biomarkers are less established, though it is similarly reactive toward proteins. Bromotyrosine adducts are elevated in allergic airway disease and serve as specific markers of eosinophil-mediated oxidant damage.
description_zh_TW: 在過敏性asthma等嗜酸性粒細胞發炎中，Eosinophil peroxidase透過使用溴化物和H2O2生成溴化氧化劑來產生hypobromous acid(HOBr)。 HOBr 是中性粒細胞 HOCl 的嗜酸性粒細胞類似物。方向性是 EPO 催化 HOBr 形成。需要注意的是，雖然 HOBr 對 proteins 具有類似的反應性，但與 HOCl 相比，對 HOBr 的研究較少，並且溴化生物標誌物的建立也較少。 Bromotyrosine 加合物在過敏性氣道疾病中升高，並作為嗜酸性粒細胞介導的氧化損傷的特異性標記。

label: Erastin
description: Erastin, the prototype class-I ferroptosis inducer, blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter system xc- (SLC7A11), depleting intracellular cysteine and thereby glutathione. Without GSH, GPX4 cannot reduce lipid peroxides, and iron-driven Fenton chemistry plus LOX-mediated oxidation accumulate lethal lipid peroxides. Erastin additionally induces ER stress that activates the CHOP-PUMA axis, recruiting apoptosis on top of ferroptosis — a combined-death approach relevant to cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Erastin 是第一類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型，會阻斷胱胺酸/麩胺酸反向轉運蛋白 system xc-（SLC7A11），耗竭細胞內胱胺酸進而耗盡麩胱甘肽。缺乏 GSH 時，GPX4 無法還原脂質過氧化物，鐵驅動的 Fenton 化學與 LOX 介導的氧化便累積致命的脂質過氧化物。Erastin 還會誘導內質網壓力、活化 CHOP-PUMA 軸線，在鐵死亡之上疊加細胞凋亡——這是與癌症治療相關的複合死亡策略。

label: SLC7A11
description: Erastin, the prototype class-I ferroptosis inducer, blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter system xc- (SLC7A11), depleting intracellular cysteine and thereby glutathione. Without GSH, GPX4 cannot reduce lipid peroxides, and iron-driven Fenton chemistry plus LOX-mediated oxidation accumulate lethal lipid peroxides. Erastin additionally induces ER stress that activates the CHOP-PUMA axis, recruiting apoptosis on top of ferroptosis — a combined-death approach relevant to cancer therapy.

label: ETS
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ETS is a large family of eukaryotic transcription factors sharing a conserved winged helix-turn-helix DNA-binding ETS domain that recognizes purine-rich GGAA/T core motifs and regulates proliferation, differentiation, and oncogenesis. The ETS-family member ELK4 plays a central role in sirtuin biology by stabilizing SIRT7 at target gene promoters, enabling H3K18 deacetylation and repression of tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, the ETS family provides the DNA-binding and promoter-targeting mechanisms that members such as ELK4 use to recruit chromatin-modifying enzymes such as SIRT7.
description_zh_TW: ETS 是一個大型真核轉錄因子家族，共享一個保守的翼狀螺旋-轉-螺旋 DNA 結合 ETS 結構域，識別富含嘌呤的 GGAA/T 核心基序並調節增殖、分化和腫瘤發生。ETS 家族成員 ELK4 在 sirtuin 生物學中扮演核心角色，透過將 SIRT7 穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 H3K18 去乙醯化和腫瘤抑制基因的抑制成為可能。方向性上 ETS 家族提供了 DNA 結合和啟動子靶向機制，使 ELK4 等成員能招募 SIRT7 等染色質修飾酶。

source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

label: ETS1
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

label: SIRT3 via H3K27 crotonylation
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

label: HDAC inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: EX-527, the most potent and selective SIRT1 inhibitor identified from a large high-throughput screen, inhibits SIRT1 at nanomolar concentrations with remarkable selectivity over SIRT2 and SIRT3 and good pharmacokinetic properties. Its anticancer activity as a single agent is weak, but it cooperates with HDAC inhibitors to induce apoptosis in leukemia cells. Directionally, EX-527-mediated SIRT1 blockade combined with broad HDAC inhibition produces a synergistic lethal effect. This positions EX-527 as the standard pharmacological SIRT1 inhibitor and a component of combination anticancer strategies.
description_zh_TW: EX-527 是從大規模高通量篩選中鑑定出的最強效和最具選擇性的 SIRT1 抑制劑，在奈摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT1，對 SIRT2 和 SIRT3 具有顯著的選擇性，且具有良好的藥代動力學特性。其作為單一藥物的抗癌活性較弱，但與 HDAC 抑制劑協同誘導白血病細胞凋亡。方向性上 EX-527 介導的 SIRT1 阻斷與廣泛的 HDAC 抑制結合產生協同致死效果。這使 EX-527 成為標準的藥理學 SIRT1 抑制劑和聯合抗癌策略的組成部分。

label: Excess Post-Exercise Oxygen Consumption
description: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
description_zh_TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

label: MTHFR function
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Creatine supports MTHFR function indirectly by lowering the methyl-group demand of endogenous creatine synthesis, which consumes a substantial share of the body's methyl budget, thereby easing reliance on folate-dependent remethylation. For slow MTHFR variants that generate methylfolate less efficiently, supplemental creatine can reduce the metabolic pressure on an already constrained methylation cycle and help preserve SAMe availability. The benefit is supportive rather than direct enzymatic rescue, but it relieves a major competing methyl sink. This makes creatine a useful adjunct in methylation-support protocols.
description_zh_TW: Creatine 透過降低內源性肌酸合成的甲基需求（消耗人體甲基預算的很大一部分）來間接支持 MTHFR function，從而減輕對 folate 依賴性再甲基化的依賴。對於緩慢生成甲基葉酸效率較低的 MTHFR variants，補充肌酸可以降低已經受限的 methylation cycle 的代謝壓力，並有助於維持 SAMe 的可用性。其好處是支持性的，而不是直接的酶救援，但它緩解了主要的競爭性甲基匯。這使得肌酸成為甲基化支持方案中有用的輔助劑。

label: Skeletal Muscle
description: Approximately 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, where it exists partly as free creatine and partly as creatine phosphate. The muscle creatine pool is maintained by both endogenous synthesis and dietary intake, and it is depleted by high-intensity activity and resynthesized during recovery. Muscle total creatine concentrations can be increased by supplementation, typically by 10-20 percent, and this elevated store extends the time for which high-intensity exercise can be sustained. The predominance of skeletal muscle as a creatine depot explains why most creatine research has focused on muscle function, strength, and performance.
description_zh_TW: 人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中一部分以游離肌酸形式存在，一部分以磷酸肌酸形式存在。肌肉肌酸池由內源性合成與飲食攝取共同維持，會因高強度活動而耗竭，並在恢復期間重新合成。補充可使肌肉總肌酸濃度增加，通常為 10–20%，而提高的儲備可延長高強度運動得以持續的時間。骨骼肌作為肌酸儲存庫的主導地位，說明了為何大多數肌酸研究都聚焦於肌肉功能、肌力與運動表現。

label: Cancer Metabolism
description: Creatine and the creatine kinase system are increasingly studied in the context of cancer metabolism. Some cancer types, particularly those with a poor prognosis, upregulate creatine kinase isoenzymes, and creatine metabolism has been reported to support the growth and invasiveness of certain tumors, whereas in other contexts creatine appears to restrain tumor growth, possibly through effects on energy homeostasis and AMPK. The trace explicitly notes that creatine's relationship to cancer is context-dependent and that current evidence is insufficient to recommend creatine as an anti-cancer intervention, underscoring the need for direct experimental studies.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸與肌酸激酶系統在癌症代謝的脈絡中日益受到研究。某些癌症類型，尤其是預後不佳者，會上調肌酸激酶同功酶，且據報導肌酸代謝可支持某些腫瘤的生長與侵襲性；而在其他情境中，肌酸似乎能抑制腫瘤生長，可能透過對能量恆定與 AMPK 的影響。該追蹤明確指出，肌酸與癌症的關係取決於情境，且目前的證據不足以推薦肌酸作為抗癌介入措施，並強調需要直接的實驗研究。

label: Methylglyoxal (MG)
description: Creatine augments the anticancer efficacy of the metabolite methylglyoxal (MG). Creatine content and energy availability are low in several types of malignant cells and in the T cells that mediate immune responses against cancer, and the creatine transporter SLC6A8 is markedly increased in tumor-infiltrating immune cells. Patra et al. reported that MG efficacy is significantly augmented in the presence of creatine, and combined administration of creatine, methylglyoxal, and ascorbic acid provided greater efficacy and eliminated visible signs of tumor growth. Creatine and creatine kinase, very low in sarcoma tissue, were significantly elevated with concomitant regression of tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸可增強代謝物甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal，MG）的抗癌療效。多種惡性細胞以及介導抗癌免疫反應的T細胞中，肌酸含量與能量可用性均偏低；而腫瘤浸潤免疫細胞中的肌酸轉運蛋白SLC6A8則顯著增加。Patra等人報告，在肌酸存在下MG的療效顯著增強；合併投予肌酸、甲基乙二醛與抗壞血酸（ascorbic acid）可提供更大的療效，並消除可見的腫瘤生長跡象。肉瘤組織中原本極低的肌酸與肌酸激酶顯著升高，伴隨腫瘤細胞的消退。

label: Toll-like Receptor
description: Creatine down-regulates the expression of toll-like receptors, including TLR-2, TLR-3, TLR-4, and TLR-7, in a mouse macrophage cell line (RAW 254.7). This downregulation could reduce the ability to sense some infections in immunocompromised individuals, but TLR-4 downregulation may also alter Parkinson's disease pathology and inhibit neuronal death as the disease progresses. Creatine's influence on toll-like receptors is one component of its broader immunomodulatory effects, which also include altering cytokine production, possibly through the NF-kB signaling pathway, thereby affecting cytokines, receptors, and growth factors that shape immune responses and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸會在小鼠巨噬細胞株（RAW 254.7）中下調toll-like受體的表現，包括TLR-2、TLR-3、TLR-4與TLR-7。此下調可能降低免疫功能低下個體感知某些感染的能力，但TLR-4的下調也可能改變帕金森氏症的病程，並在疾病進展過程中抑制神經元死亡。肌酸對toll-like受體的影響是其更廣泛免疫調節效應的組成部分之一；這些效應還包括改變細胞激素的產生（可能經由NF-kB訊息傳導途徑），從而影響塑造免疫反應與發炎的細胞激素、受體與生長因子。

label: Pro-inflammatory Cytokines
description: Creatine has immunomodulatory effects that include reducing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-6 and other inflammatory markers like TNF-alpha and PGE2. A creatine-induced reduction of these inflammatory mediators may help explain some of the neuroprotective benefits observed in patients with central nervous system diseases and the attenuation of inflammatory and muscle damage markers after intense exercise. Creatine also down-regulates expression of toll-like receptors (TLR-2, TLR-3, TLR-4, TLR-7) in a mouse macrophage cell line and may influence cytokines through the NF-kB signaling pathway, with potential consequences for immune response and, notably, for TLR-4-mediated pathology in Parkinson's disease progression.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸具有免疫調節作用，包括降低 IL-6 等促發炎細胞激素，以及 TNF-alpha 與 PGE2 等其他發炎指標。肌酸引起的這些發炎介質降低，可能有助於解釋在中樞神經系統疾病患者身上觀察到的部分神經保護效益，以及劇烈運動後發炎與肌肉損傷指標的減弱。肌酸也會在小鼠巨噬細胞株中下調類鐸受體（TLR-2、TLR-3、TLR-4、TLR-7）的表現，並可能透過 NF-kB 訊息傳導途徑影響細胞激素，對免疫反應具有潛在影響，尤其是對帕金森氏症病程中 TLR-4 媒介的病理機制。

label: Arginine
description: Creatine is a naturally occurring nitrogen-containing compound synthesized endogenously in the body. The first step of its biosynthesis condenses arginine and glycine into guanidinoacetate (GAA), a reaction catalyzed by arginine glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT), which is expressed in the kidney, pancreas, liver, and certain brain regions. Endogenous synthesis supplies roughly half of the daily creatine requirement; the remainder must come from the diet, primarily red meat and fish, or from supplements. Deficiencies in the enzymes of this pathway (AGAT, GAMT) or the creatine transporter produce creatine synthesis deficiency syndromes marked by low brain creatine and neurodevelopmental impairment.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸是一種天然存在的含氮化合物，在體內內源性合成。其生合成的第一步將精胺酸與甘胺酸縮合為胍基乙酸（GAA），此反應由精胺酸甘胺酸脒基轉移酶（AGAT）催化，該酶在腎臟、胰臟、肝臟及某些腦區表現。內源性合成供應每日肌酸需求約一半；其餘部分必須來自飲食（主要是紅肉與魚類）或補充品。此途徑的酶（AGAT、GAMT）或肌酸轉運蛋白缺乏，會導致肌酸合成缺乏症候群，其特徵為腦部肌酸偏低與神經發育受損。

label: Nutraceuticals
description: Creatine is a naturally occurring nitrogen-containing compound that is synthesized endogenously in the liver, kidney, and pancreas and is also obtained from dietary sources, particularly red meat and fish. Around 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, approximately one-third of it in the phosphorylated form creatine phosphate. In the muscle it is converted to creatine phosphate, which donates its high-energy phosphate group to regenerate ATP from ADP, supporting short-duration, high-intensity exercise. Because of its role in ATP regeneration, creatine is one of the most widely used sports supplements and is increasingly examined for additional therapeutic effects, including possible anti-cancer properties.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸是一種天然存在的含氮化合物，在體內由肝臟、腎臟與胰臟內源性合成，也可從飲食來源獲得，尤其是紅肉與魚類。人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中約三分之一以磷酸化形式（磷酸肌酸）存在。在肌肉中，肌酸被轉化為磷酸肌酸，後者提供其高能磷酸基團，從 ADP 再生 ATP，以支持短時間、高強度的運動。由於其在 ATP 再生中的角色，肌酸是最廣泛使用的運動補充品之一，並日益被研究是否具有額外的治療效應，包括可能的抗癌特性。

label: Amino Acids
description: Creatine is synthesized endogenously from the amino acids arginine, glycine, and methionine in a two-step pathway. The first step, catalyzed by arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT), takes place primarily in the kidney and pancreas and produces guanidinoacetate; the second step, catalyzed by guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase (GAMT), transfers a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to guanidinoacetate in the liver, producing creatine. This biosynthetic origin connects creatine metabolism to the methylation cycle and one-carbon metabolism, a connection relevant to hypotheses linking creatine status to epigenetic regulation and cancer risk.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸由胺基酸精胺酸、甘胺酸與甲硫胺酸經由兩步驟途徑內源性合成。第一步由精胺酸：甘胺酸脒基轉移酶（AGAT）催化，主要發生在腎臟與胰臟，產生胍基乙酸；第二步由胍基乙酸 N-甲基轉移酶（GAMT）催化，在肝臟中將 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸的甲基轉移至胍基乙酸，產生肌酸。這種生合成來源將肌酸代謝與甲基化循環及一碳代謝連結起來，此關聯與將肌酸狀態連結至表觀遺傳調控與癌症風險的假說相關。

label: Dietary Supplement
description: Creatine monohydrate is among the most extensively studied dietary supplements and is generally regarded as safe when used at recommended doses over periods of many years. Long-term supplementation studies report no consistent adverse effects on renal, hepatic, or cardiovascular function in healthy individuals, and creatine is approved for use by many sports organizations. Common minor side effects include water retention and occasional gastrointestinal discomfort. This favorable safety profile is noted in the trace as relevant to the potential evaluation of creatine as an adjunct in oncology settings, where tolerability is a central concern.
description_zh_TW: 一水肌酸是研究最廣泛的膳食補充品之一，在建議劑量下長期使用多年，一般被認為是安全的。長期補充研究報告指出，健康個體的腎臟、肝臟或心血管功能並未出現一致的不良影響，且肌酸已獲許多運動組織核准使用。常見的輕微副作用包括水分滯留與偶發的腸胃不適。該追蹤指出，這種良好的安全性資料與肌酸在腫瘤科情境中作為輔助治療的潛在評估相關，因為耐受性是其中的核心考量。

label: ADP
description: Creatine provides the immediate phosphate group needed to recycle ADP back into ATP, the cellular energy currency, keeping cellular energy pools saturated and reducing metabolic stress, which protects HRV from plunging during hard training. It is recommended daily at 3-5 grams, ideally post-workout or with the largest carbohydrate meal, because creatine uptake is enhanced by insulin. Pairing creatine with carbohydrates and protein helps drive it into muscle and brain cells more efficiently, with consistency mattering more than exact timing.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸提供將 ADP 回收為 ATP（細胞的能量貨幣）所需的即時磷酸基團，使細胞能量池保持飽和並降低代謝壓力，從而保護 HRV 在艱苦訓練期間不致驟降。建議每日攝取 3–5 公克，理想上在訓練後或搭配最大的一餐碳水化合物，因為胰島素可增強肌酸攝取。將肌酸與碳水化合物和蛋白質搭配，有助於更有效地將其送入肌肉與腦細胞，而持續性比精確的時機更重要。

label: Homocysteine
description: Creatine supplementation has been reported to lower plasma homocysteine, an effect that may reduce cardiovascular disease risk. Because homocysteine is methylated back to methionine by enzymes that require the same methyl-donor pool (S-adenosyl methionine) used for creatine synthesis, supplying exogenous creatine spares methyl groups that would otherwise be consumed in endogenous creatine formation, thereby lowering homocysteine production. Studies in individuals adhering to vegan diets (who tend to have elevated homocysteine) reported that creatine supplementation reduced homocysteine levels and improved systemic microvascular endothelial function, supporting creatine's role in cardiovascular health beyond its direct effects on muscle bioenergetics.
description_zh_TW: 據報導，肌酸補充可降低血漿同半胱胺酸（homocysteine），此效果可能降低心血管疾病風險。由於同半胱胺酸需由酵素甲基化轉回甲硫胺酸（methionine），而這些酵素所需的甲基供體池（S-腺苷甲硫胺酸）與肌酸合成所用者相同，補充外源性肌酸可節省否則將消耗於內源性肌酸形成的甲基，從而降低同半胱胺酸的產生。針對遵循純素飲食（其同半胱胺酸往往較高）之個體的研究報告指出，肌酸補充可降低同半胱胺酸濃度並改善全身微血管內皮功能，支持肌酸在肌肉生物能量學直接效應之外對心血管健康的貢獻。

label: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI)
description: Creatine supplementation has shown neuroprotective potential in traumatic brain injury. In animal models, providing creatine in the diet for 5 days prior to TBI decreased cortical brain damage by 36% in rats and 50% in mice, an effect attributed to improved energy availability in the injured brain. Creatine also reduces the severity of mild concussions and ischemic brain damage and improves learning and memory during recovery in neonatal mice. While these preclinical studies cannot be replicated in humans, they support the contention that creatine supplementation may reduce the severity of TBI and serve as an adjunctive strategy in individuals at risk of head injury, complementing its established role in muscle and rehabilitation settings.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸在創傷性腦損傷中已顯示出神經保護潛力。在動物模型中，於 TBI 前以飲食提供肌酸 5 天，可使大鼠的皮質腦損傷減少 36%、小鼠減少 50%，此效應歸因於受損腦部能量可用性的改善。肌酸也能減輕輕度腦震盪與缺血性腦損傷的嚴重程度，並改善新生小鼠恢復期間的學習與記憶。雖然這些臨床前研究無法在人體中複製，但它們支持肌酸補充可能減輕 TBI 嚴重程度、並作為頭部損傷高風險個體的輔助策略之論點，補足其在肌肉與復健領域中已確立的角色。

label: Muscle Mass
description: Creatine supplementation increases muscle creatine and phosphocreatine stores and, particularly when combined with resistance training, promotes gains in lean tissue mass and strength. Randomized trials in older adults show greater gains in muscle mass and isometric strength with creatine plus heavy resistance training compared to training alone, and meta-analyses confirm larger gains in muscle mass and upper-body strength in older individuals supplementing creatine during resistance exercise. Creatine also decreases protein breakdown and can preserve muscle mass during energy-restricted weight loss, making it a broadly useful strategy for maintaining muscle across the lifespan and in clinical rehabilitation populations.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸可增加肌肉肌酸與磷酸肌酸儲備，尤其是與阻力訓練結合時，能促進去脂組織質量與肌力的增長。在老年人中的隨機試驗顯示，與單獨訓練相比，肌酸加上重度阻力訓練可帶來更大的肌肉質量與等長肌力增長，統合分析也證實，在阻力運動期間補充肌酸的老年人，其肌肉質量與上半身肌力增長更大。肌酸還能減少蛋白質分解，並在限制能量的減重過程中保留肌肉質量，使其成為在整個生命歷程及臨床復健族群中維持肌肉的廣泛實用策略。

label: GLUT4
description: Creatine supplementation influences glucose handling in skeletal muscle, in part by upregulating the GLUT4 glucose transporter. Creatine prevents declines in GLUT4 during immobilization and increases GLUT4 by about 40% during rehabilitation after atrophy, and co-ingestion with carbohydrate and protein enhances creatine uptake and muscle glycogen. In type 2 diabetic patients, 12 weeks of creatine supplementation during training improved glucose tolerance, increased GLUT4 translocation, and significantly reduced HbA1c, with changes in AMPK signaling related to GLUT4 translocation and HbA1c. These findings indicate creatine enhances glucose uptake and supports glucose management, especially when combined with exercise.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸會影響骨骼肌的葡萄糖處理，部分機制是透過上調 GLUT4 葡萄糖轉運蛋白。肌酸可防止固定不動期間 GLUT4 的下降，並在萎縮後的復健期間使 GLUT4 增加約 40%，而與碳水化合物和蛋白質併服可增強肌酸攝取與肌肉肝醣。在第二型糖尿病患者中，訓練期間補充肌酸 12 週可改善葡萄糖耐受度、增加 GLUT4 轉位，並顯著降低 HbA1c，其中 AMPK 訊息傳導的變化與 GLUT4 轉位及 HbA1c 相關。這些發現顯示肌酸能增強葡萄糖攝取並支持血糖管理，尤其是與運動結合時。

label: Exercise Performance
description: Creatine supplementation is one of the most effective and best-documented ergogenic aids for improving performance in high-intensity, short-duration activities. By increasing muscle phosphocreatine stores, creatine enhances the capacity to regenerate ATP during repeated bouts of maximal exercise, increasing power output, strength gains during resistance training, and work performed in repeated sprint protocols. Meta-analyses consistently show moderate improvements in measures such as maximal strength, sprint performance, and lean body mass, with benefit most pronounced in activities relying on the phosphocreatine energy system. These well-established performance effects are the context in which the trace asks whether creatine also influences cancer outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸是改善高強度、短時間運動表現最有效且文獻記載最完整的增能劑之一。透過增加肌肉磷酸肌酸儲備，肌酸可提升反覆最大強度運動期間再生 ATP 的能力，進而增加功率輸出、阻力訓練中的肌力增長，以及反覆衝刺訓練中的做功量。統合分析一致顯示，肌酸在最大肌力、衝刺表現與去脂體重等指標上帶來中等程度的改善，其效益在依賴磷酸肌酸能量系統的活動中最為顯著。這些確立已久的表現效益，正是該追蹤探討肌酸是否也影響癌症結果的背景脈絡。

label: Red Meat
description: Dietary creatine is obtained almost exclusively from animal-derived foods, with red meat and fish being the richest sources. Cooking does not destroy creatine, and an omnivorous diet typically supplies one to two grams of creatine per day, which complements the roughly one gram synthesized endogenously per day. Vegetarians have lower muscle creatine stores and show larger increases in response to supplementation than meat-eaters, reflecting the lower baseline intake. This dietary origin is relevant to epidemiologic questions about meat consumption and cancer risk, because creatine is often discussed alongside other meat-derived compounds when considering diet-cancer associations.
description_zh_TW: 飲食中的肌酸幾乎完全來自動物性食物，其中紅肉與魚類是最豐富的來源。烹調不會破壞肌酸，雜食性飲食每天通常可提供一至兩公克肌酸，補足體內每天約一公克的內源性合成量。素食者的肌肉肌酸儲備較低，且對補充的反應比肉食者更明顯，反映出其較低的基線攝取量。這種飲食來源與肉類攝取和癌症風險的流行病學問題相關，因為在考量飲食與癌症的關聯時，肌酸常與其他肉類來源化合物一起被討論。

label: Tumorigenesis
description: Emerging evidence reviewed in the source trace suggests creatine may exert direct anti-cancer effects, inhibiting tumorigenesis rather than only supporting athletic performance. Mechanistic studies indicate that creatine supplementation can raise cellular phosphocreatine and creatine kinase activity, and the resulting change in the cellular energy state, together with creatine-mediated effects on AMPK and anabolic signaling, may suppress cancer cell proliferation and transformation. Because cancer cells depend on high glycolytic flux and altered energy metabolism, interventions that perturb the creatine-phosphocreatine system are hypothesized to restrain tumor growth, although the trace stresses that much of this evidence is preliminary and requires confirmation in well-powered clinical studies.
description_zh_TW: 來源追蹤所回顧的新興證據顯示，肌酸可能發揮直接的抗癌作用，抑制腫瘤發生而不僅是支持運動表現。機制研究指出，補充肌酸可提高細胞磷酸肌酸與肌酸激酶活性，而隨之而來的細胞能量狀態改變，加上肌酸對 AMPK 與合成代謝訊號的影響，可能抑制癌細胞增殖與轉化。由於癌細胞依賴高糖解通量與改變的能量代謝，擾動肌酸—磷酸肌酸系統的介入措施被假設可抑制腫瘤生長，不過該追蹤強調，這些證據大多仍屬初步，需要在檢定力充足的臨床研究中加以證實。

label: Creatine Synthesis Deficiency
description: High-dose, long-term creatine supplementation is a nutritional strategy for creatine synthesis deficiencies caused by mutations in AGAT, GAMT, or the creatine transporter (SLC6A8), which reduce endogenous creatine synthesis or cellular uptake and result in low brain creatine and phosphocreatine. Supplementation at 0.3-0.8 g/kg/day increases brain creatine and PCr levels and improves or stabilizes clinical symptoms including intellectual disability, epilepsy, and movement disorders. Patients with GAMT or AGAT deficiency treated early (e.g., starting at four months of age) can experience normal psychomotor development, and such therapy is well tolerated and may also benefit ornithine aminotransferase deficiency causing gyrate atrophy.
description_zh_TW: 高劑量、長期的肌酸補充是針對 AGAT、GAMT 或肌酸轉運蛋白（SLC6A8）突變所致肌酸合成缺乏症的營養策略，這些突變會降低內源性肌酸合成或細胞攝取，導致腦部肌酸與磷酸肌酸偏低。以每日 0.3–0.8 公克/公斤補充可提高腦部肌酸與 PCr 濃度，並改善或穩定臨床症狀，包括智能障礙、癲癇與動作障礙。早期治療（例如從四個月大開始）的 GAMT 或 AGAT 缺乏症患者可獲得正常的心理動作發展，此療法耐受性良好，且可能對導致迴旋狀萎縮的鳥胺酸胺基轉移酶缺乏症也有益。

label: Spinal Cord Injury (SCI)
description: Preclinical studies suggest creatine supplementation can reduce the severity of spinal cord injury. Rats fed creatine before and after moderate spinal cord contusion developed less scar tissue and performed better on locomotor function tests than controls, and rats fed a 2% creatine diet before and after injury experienced less loss of gray matter. In humans with cervical spinal cord injury, creatine supplementation enhanced aerobic exercise capacity, ventilatory anaerobic threshold, and, combined with vitamin D and resistance training, improved arm muscle area, strength, and functional capacity. These findings support creatine as an adjunct that may reduce injury severity and enhance rehabilitation outcomes after spinal cord injury.
description_zh_TW: 臨床前研究顯示，補充肌酸可減輕脊髓損傷的嚴重程度。在中度脊髓挫傷前後餵食肌酸的大鼠，其疤痕組織較少，且在運動功能測試中的表現優於對照組；在損傷前後餵食 2% 肌酸飲食的大鼠，其灰質流失較少。在頸椎脊髓損傷的人類患者中，補充肌酸可增強有氧運動能力與換氣無氧閾值，而與維生素 D 及阻力訓練結合時，可改善手臂肌肉面積、肌力與功能能力。這些發現支持肌酸作為可能減輕損傷嚴重程度並增進脊髓損傷後復健成果的輔助措施。

label: Creatine Kinase
description: The biological actions of creatine are mediated by the creatine kinase enzyme family, which catalyzes the reversible phosphorylation of creatine by ATP. Tissue-specific creatine kinase isoforms are expressed in muscle, brain, and other tissues, and the enzyme couples the phosphocreatine pool to cellular ATP demand. In tissues with high and fluctuating energy requirements, the creatine kinase reaction buffers ATP levels and transports high-energy phosphate between sites of production and consumption. Because creatine kinase is also expressed in several tumors, the enzyme is a candidate interface through which creatine supplementation could influence cancer cell energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸的生物作用由肌酸激酶酶家族所媒介，該家族催化 ATP 對肌酸的可逆磷酸化。組織特異性的肌酸激酶異構型在肌肉、腦部及其他組織中表現，該酶將磷酸肌酸池與細胞 ATP 需求偶聯。在能量需求高且波動的組織中，肌酸激酶反應可緩衝 ATP 濃度，並在高能磷酸的產生與消耗位置之間進行運輸。由於肌酸激酶也在多種腫瘤中表現，該酶是肌酸補充可能影響癌細胞能量代謝的候選介面。

label: Creatine Phosphate
description: Within cells, creatine is phosphorylated by the enzyme creatine kinase to form creatine phosphate (phosphocreatine), which serves as a rapidly mobilizable reserve of high-energy phosphate. The reaction creatine plus ATP yields creatine phosphate plus ADP, and the reverse reaction regenerates ATP during bursts of high energy demand, such as muscle contraction. The phosphocreatine pool is the immediate energy buffer that sustains ATP levels for the first several seconds of maximal effort, before glycolysis and oxidative metabolism fully contribute. This conversion of creatine to creatine phosphate is the mechanistic heart of the creatine-phosphocreatine energy system.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞內，肌酸由肌酸激酶磷酸化形成磷酸肌酸（phosphocreatine），作為可快速動用的高能磷酸儲備。肌酸加 ATP 的反應產生磷酸肌酸加 ADP，而逆反應則在肌肉收縮等高能量需求爆發期間再生 ATP。磷酸肌酸池是即時的能量緩衝，在糖解作用與氧化代謝完全投入之前，於最大努力的頭幾秒內維持 ATP 濃度。肌酸轉化為磷酸肌酸的過程，正是肌酸—磷酸肌酸能量系統的機制核心。

label: Creatine Supplementation
description: Oral creatine monohydrate — typically 3-5 g/day maintenance or 20 g/day loading — raises total muscle and brain creatine stores by roughly 20-40%, enlarging the phosphocreatine buffer that the creatine phosphate shuttle uses to spatially buffer ATP. The largest responses occur in individuals with low baseline stores (vegetarians, low meat intake), and the ergogenic and neuroprotective effects follow from the widened energy buffer rather than from any direct receptor action.
description_zh_TW: 口服肌酸單水合物——通常每日 3-5 克維持劑量或每日 20 克負荷期——可使肌肉與腦部的總肌酸儲量提升約 20-40%，擴大肌酸磷酸穿梭用以空間性緩衝 ATP 的磷肌酸緩衝庫。基線儲量較低者（素食者、少肉飲食）反應最大，而其增補運動表現與神經保護的效應正是來自加寬的能量緩衝，而非任何直接的受體作用。

label: Extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy
description: SIRT7-deficient mice show extensive myocardial fibrosis, high basal apoptosis, and cardiomyopathy, reflecting SIRT7's role in maintaining cardiac homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to fibrotic cardiomyopathy. This contrasts with contexts where SIRT7 promotes fibrosis under stress, indicating that SIRT7 is overall required for myocardial integrity. The phenotype likely reflects SIRT7's contributions to ribosome biogenesis, mitochondrial function, and transcriptional regulation in cardiomyocytes, and it is consistent with SIRT7's deacetylation of GATA4 in stress-induced hypertrophy. SIRT7 thus has both protective and pathological cardiac roles depending on context.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 缺陷小鼠顯示廣泛的心肌纖維化、高基礎凋亡率和心肌病變，反映了 SIRT7 在維護心臟恆定性中的角色。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致纖維化性心肌病變。這與 SIRT7 在壓力下促進纖維化的情況形成對比，表明 SIRT7 整體上是心肌完整性所必需的。此表型可能反映了 SIRT7 對核糖體生物合成、粒線體功能和心肌細胞轉錄調控的貢獻，並與 SIRT7 在壓力誘導肥大中對 GATA4 的去乙醯化一致。因此，SIRT7 根據情境具有保護性和病理性心臟角色。

label: Ferric Iron
description: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is an autosomal dominant condition caused by mutations in globin genes (alpha, beta, or gamma chains) that stabilize the ferric (Fe3+) state of heme iron. Patients with hemoglobin M disease often have lifelong cyanosis but are otherwise asymptomatic or mildly affected, because the stabilized ferric methemoglobin cannot carry oxygen yet the body compensates. This congenital cause of methemoglobinemia is distinct from the enzyme-deficiency form arising from cytochrome b5 reductase mutations, and both congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia.

label: FGF21 signaling
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Restoring SIRT3 expression via lifestyle interventions or fibroblast growth factor-21 (FGF21) signaling improves mitochondrial integrity and myocardial function in diabetes. Directionally, FGF21 sits upstream of recovered SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control. This points to metabolic reprogramming as a promising avenue for diabetic patients, coupling endocrine FGF21 biology to the mitochondrial deacetylase axis.
description_zh_TW: 透過生活方式介入或纖維母細胞生長因子 21 (FGF21) 訊號恢復 SIRT3 表現可改善糖尿病患者的粒線體完整性和心肌功能。從方向上看，FGF21 位於恢復的 SIRT3 依賴性粒線體品質控制的上游。這表明代謝重編程對於糖尿病患者來說是一條有前途的途徑，將內分泌 FGF21 生物學與粒線體去乙醯化酶軸結合起來。

label: Fisetin Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. These systems increase fisetin's dissolution rate, protect it from degradation and first-pass conjugation, and can enable sustained release and improved tissue targeting, including brain delivery. Studies summarized in the review report several-fold increases in fisetin peak plasma concentration and area under the curve for nanoformulations compared with free fisetin suspension, and enhanced efficacy in tumor and neuroprotection models, although clinical data remain limited.
description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的奈米製劑，包括聚合物奈米粒子、脂質奈米粒子、奈米乳液和奈米晶體，已被開發以克服其溶解度差和口服生物利用度低的問題。這些系統提高非瑟酮的溶解速率，保護其免受降解和首過結合，並可實現持續釋放和改善組織靶向，包括腦部遞送。綜述中總結的研究報告顯示，與游離非瑟酮懸浮液相比，奈米製劑的非瑟酮峰濃度和曲線下麵積增加數倍，並在腫瘤和神經保護模型中增強療效，但臨床數據仍然有限。

label: Nano-formulation
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. label: Fisetin Dissolution
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Solid dispersions of fisetin are prepared by dispersing the drug in a hydrophilic polymer matrix such as polyvinylpyrrolidone or hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, converting crystalline fisetin into an amorphous form that dissolves much faster. The review describes how fisetin solid dispersions markedly increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility relative to the free drug, leading to improved oral absorption and higher plasma concentrations in pharmacokinetic studies. Because dissolution is the limiting step in fisetin absorption, solid dispersion technology is one of the most straightforward and widely explored macro- to micro-scale strategies for improving its bioavailability.
description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的固體分散體通過將藥物分散在親水性聚合物基質（如聚乙烯吡咯烷酮或羥丙甲纖維素）中製備，將結晶非瑟酮轉化為溶解快得多的無定形形式。該綜述描述了非瑟酮固體分散體如何與游離藥物相比顯著增加溶出速率和表觀溶解度，從而在藥物動力學研究中改善口服吸收和更高的血漿濃度。由於溶出是非瑟酮吸收的限速步驟，固體分散體技術是改善其生物利用度的最直接和最廣泛探索的宏觀到微觀策略。

label: muscle protein degradation
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The FoxO (forkhead box O) family is a group of transcription factors involved in regulating the synthesis and degradation of muscle proteins. Under catabolic conditions, nuclear FoxO drives expression of atrophy-related genes and activates specific protein degradation pathways that break down muscle proteins. Urolithin A suppresses FoxO activation, primarily by inhibiting its nuclear activity and reducing its regulation of these degradation pathways, thereby attenuating muscle protein degradation and helping to preserve muscle mass.
description_zh_TW: FoxO (forkhead box O) 家族是一群參與調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解的轉錄因子。在分解代謝條件下，核內 FoxO 驅動萎縮相關基因的表現，並活化分解肌肉蛋白的特定蛋白降解路徑。Urolithin A 抑制 FoxO 活化，主要是透過抑制其核活性並降低其對這些降解路徑的調節，從而減緩肌肉蛋白降解並有助於保留肌肉量。

label: French Paradox
description: The French paradox describes lower cardiovascular-disease incidence in some French populations despite high-fat diets, often attributed in part to moderate wine and resveratrol consumption. Directionally, moderate wine intake sits upstream of reduced CVD in this epidemiological observation. Causality is debated, with diet and lifestyle confounders complicating the interpretation, and the wine matrix and polyphenol content may contribute. Resveratrol's vascular actions provide a plausible, but not proven, mechanism, and the concept has driven considerable research into wine polyphenols, sirtuins, and cardiovascular health.
description_zh_TW: 法國悖論描述了某些法國人群中儘管高脂飲食但心血管疾病發生率較低的現象，部分歸因於適度的葡萄酒和 resveratrol 消費。在方向性上，適度的葡萄酒攝入在此流行病學觀察中位於降低心血管疾病的上游。因果關係存在爭議，飲食和生活方式混雜因素使解釋複雜化，葡萄酒基質和多酚含量可能有所貢獻。resveratrol 的血管作用提供了一個合理的但尚未被證實的機制，此概念已推動了大量關於葡萄酒多酚、sirtuin 和心血管健康的研究。

label: Fructose
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: An additional well-studied mechanism of AGE formation is the polyol pathway, in which glucose is converted to sorbitol by the enzyme aldose reductase and then to fructose by the action of sorbitol dehydrogenase. Because fructose is a more reactive reducing sugar than glucose, its production feeds additional glycation reactions. This pathway becomes especially active under hyperglycemic conditions, linking poorly controlled diabetes with accelerated accumulation of advanced glycation end products. The polyol pathway therefore represents a non-Maillard route through which elevated glucose contributes to protein glycation and the tissue damage seen in diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: An additional well-studied mechanism of AGE formation是polyol pathway，其中glucose經由enzyme aldose reductase轉化為sorbitol，再經sorbitol dehydrogenase作用轉化為fructose。由於fructose是比glucose更reactive的reducing sugar，其production feeds additional glycation reactions。此pathway在hyperglycemic conditions下especially active，linking poorly controlled diabetes與accelerated accumulation of advanced glycation end products。因此，polyol pathway represents a non-Maillard route，經由它elevated glucose contributes to protein glycation與diabetic complications中所見的tissue damage。

label: GADD45 expression
description: FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 enhances expression of GADD45 and suppresses caspase-3/7 activity, promoting DNA repair over apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT1 activates FOXO4, which induces GADD45. This biases cells toward damage repair rather than death, and it is a further example of SIRT1 steering stress responses toward survival and genome maintenance. By inducing GADD45, FOXO4 supports nucleotide-excision repair and cell-cycle arrest, giving cells time to repair damage. This survival-oriented program is central to SIRT1's cytoprotective functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1對FOXO4的去乙醯化增強了GADD45的表達並抑制caspase-3/7活性，促進DNA修復而非細胞凋亡。方向上，SIRT1活化FOXO4，後者誘導GADD45。這使細胞傾向於損傷修復而非死亡，是SIRT1將壓力反應引導至存活和基因組維護的又一例證。透過誘導GADD45，FOXO4支持核苷酸切除修復和細胞週期停滯，為細胞提供修復損傷的時間。這種以存活為導向的程序是SIRT1細胞保護功能的核心。

label: gastric cancer progression via STAT3/MMP-13
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 depletion promotes gastric cancer progression through activation of the STAT3/MMP-13 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of STAT3- and MMP-13-driven tumor progression in gastric cancer. Because SIRT1 normally restrains this pathway, its depletion unleashes STAT3 activation and MMP-13 expression, accelerating GC growth and invasion. This positions SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer and identifies STAT3/MMP-13 signaling as a downstream mediator of SIRT1's protective effect.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1的耗竭透過活化STAT3/MMP-13訊號通路促進胃癌的進展。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於胃癌中STAT3和MMP-13驅動的腫瘤進展的上游。因為SIRT1通常抑制此通路，其耗竭釋放STAT3活化和MMP-13表達，加速胃癌生長和侵襲。這將SIRT1定位為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，並將STAT3/MMP-13訊號確定為SIRT1保護效果的下游介導因子。

source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
