label: Lysosomal Exocytosis
description: Lysosomal Exocytosis and TFEB are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Lysosomal Exocytosis and TFEB may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Lysosomal Exocytosis 和 TFEB 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Lysosomal Exocytosis 和 TFEB 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Eltrombopag
description: Eltrombopag (EO), a small-molecule thrombopoietin receptor agonist, was identified as the first direct inhibitor of TFEB, disrupting TFEB-DNA interactions at CLEAR elements. By preventing TFEB from binding its target promoters, EO blocks transcriptional activation of the autophagy-lysosomal network. This tool compound has enabled dissection of TFEB-dependent versus independent autophagy and has therapeutic implications where TFEB hyperactivation is pathogenic. Its discovery established pharmacological feasibility of directly targeting the MiT/TFE family.
description_zh_TW: Eltrombopag（EO）是一種小分子 thrombopoietin 受體促效劑，被鑑定為第一個 TFEB 的直接抑制劑，破壞 TFEB 在 CLEAR 元件處的 TFEB-DNA 交互作用。透過阻止 TFEB 結合其標的啟動子，EO 阻斷自噬—溶酶體網絡的轉錄活化。此工具化合物使得剖析 TFEB 依賴與非依賴的自噬成為可能，並在 TFEB 過度活化為致病性的情況下具有治療意義。其發現確立了直接標靶 MiT/TFE 家族的藥理可行性。

label: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome
description: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé (BHD) syndrome, caused by Folliculin (FLCN) mutations, TFEB becomes hyperactivated and drives a renal cystic and tumor-prone phenotype. Loss of FLCN dysregulates mTOR and related signaling such that TFEB-mediated lysosomal and proliferative programs are inappropriately engaged in renal epithelial cells. This pathogenic role contrasts with TFEB's generally protective function in neurodegeneration and aging. The BHD example demonstrates that excessive or context-inappropriate TFEB activation can be deleterious.
description_zh_TW: 在由 Folliculin（FLCN）突變引起的 Birt-Hogg-Dubé（BHD）症候群中，TFEB 變得過度活化並驅動腎囊性和易長腫瘤的表型。FLCN 的缺失失調 mTOR 和相關信號，使得 TFEB 介導的溶酶體和增生程序在腎上皮細胞中不當地被啟動。此致病角色與 TFEB 在神經退化和老化中普遍保護性功能形成對比。BHD 例子證明了過度或背景不當的 TFEB 活化可能是有害的。

label: MALAT1 in renal carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: In a subset of translocation renal cell carcinomas (t(6;11) RCC), the TFEB gene is fused with the long non-coding RNA locus MALAT1, producing a MALAT1-TFEB fusion that drives overexpression of intact TFEB. The fusion places TFEB under the strong promoter activity of MALAT1, leading to constitutive activation of the lysosomal-autophagic and proliferative programs. This genetic rearrangement defines a distinct clinicopathologic entity of RCC with characteristic biphasic histology. The finding established TFEB as an oncogene when deregulated by chromosomal translocation.
description_zh_TW: 在一部分轉位性腎細胞癌（t(6;11) RCC）中，TFEB 基因與長鏈非編碼 RNA 基因座 MALAT1 融合，產生 MALAT1-TFEB 融合體，驅動完整 TFEB 的過度表現。此融合將 TFEB 置於 MALAT1 強啟動子活性之下，導致溶酶體—自噬性和增生性程序的組成型活化。此基因重排定義了一種具有特徵性雙相組織學的獨特 RCC 臨床病理實體。此發現確立了 TFEB 在因染色體轉位而失調時是一種致癌基因。

label: Oxidation at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: Oxidation of TFEB at cysteine 212—for example by reactive oxygen species or oxidants—impairs mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at adjacent regulatory sites and thereby enhances TFEB activity. This redox-sensitive control links cellular oxidative status directly to activation of the lysosomal-autophagy program, functioning as a stress sensor. By relieving kinase repression under oxidative conditions, TFEB oxidation promotes clearance of damaged components that generate ROS. The C212 modification exemplifies how cysteine-based redox switches integrate stress signaling with degradative transcription.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的氧化——例如由活性氧物種或氧化劑引起——損害 mTORC1 介導的鄰近調節位點磷酸化，從而增強 TFEB 活性。這種對氧化還原敏感的控製將細胞氧化狀態直接連結到溶酶體—自噬程序的活化，作為一種壓力感測器。透過在氧化條件下解除激酶抑制，TFEB 氧化促進清除會產生 ROS 的受損組分。C212 修飾舉例說明了基於半胱胺酸的氧化還原方程序如何將壓力信號與降解轉錄整合。

label: PDCD4
description: Programmed cell death protein 4 (PDCD4) suppresses TFEB translation by binding eukaryotic initiation factor 4A (eIF4A) and inhibiting the RNA helicase activity required for ribosome scanning of the TFEB mRNA. This translational blockade limits TFEB protein synthesis independently of its transcriptional or degradative regulation. PDCD4 thereby acts as a brake on the autophagy-lysosomal program at the level of protein synthesis. Its own downregulation in cancer may contribute to the elevated TFEB activity observed in some malignancies.
description_zh_TW: 細胞程序性死亡蛋白 4（PDCD4）透過結合真核起始因子 4A（eIF4A）並抑制 TFEB mRNA 核糖體掃描所需的 RNA 解旋酶活性，抑制 TFEB 轉錄。此轉錄阻斷獨立於其轉錄或降解調節而限制 TFEB 蛋白合成。PDCD4 因此在蛋白質合成層次上充當自噬—溶酶體程序的制動。其在癌症中的自身下調可能促成某些惡性腫瘤中觀察到的 TFEB 活性升高。

label: S-sulfhydration at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: S-sulfhydration of TFEB at cysteine 212, catalyzed by the cystathionine gamma-lyase (CTH)-derived hydrogen sulfide (H2S) system, promotes its nuclear translocation and activation. This post-translational modification, distinct from oxidation, converts C212 into a persulfide that alters TFEB interactions and favors a transcriptionally active state. The regulation ties sulfur metabolism and H2S signaling to the autophagy-lysosomal network, with implications for cardiovascular and neurodegenerative protection. It represents a gasotransmitter-based mechanism controlling cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的 S-硫化（S-sulfhydration），由 cystathionine gamma-lyase（CTH）衍生的硫化氫（H2S）系統催化，促進其核轉運和活化。此轉譯後修飾不同於氧化，將 C212 轉化為過硫化物，改變 TFEB 交互作用並有利於轉錄活化狀態。此調節將硫代謝和 H2S 信號聯繫到自噬—溶酶體網絡，對心血管和神經退化保護具有意義。它代表了一種控制細胞清除的氣體傳遞分子（gasotransmitter）基礎機制。

label: PGC1-alpha
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB and the mitochondrial biogenesis coactivator PGC-1α form a positive feedback loop: PGC-1α modulates mitophagy by regulating TFEB expression, while TFEB induces PGC-1α transcription, reinforcing mitochondrial turnover and biogenesis. This reciprocal regulation couples lysosomal-autophagic clearance with mitochondrial network expansion under stress. The loop ensures coordinated enhancement of both degradative and biosynthetic mitochondrial programs. Its disruption impairs metabolic adaptation and is relevant to aging and myopathy.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 與粒線體生物發生共活化因子 PGC-1α 形成正向回饋環：PGC-1α 透過調節 TFEB 表現來調控粒線體自噬，而 TFEB 誘發 PGC-1α 轉錄，強化粒線體週轉與生物發生。此相互調節在壓力下將溶酶體—自噬性清除與粒線體網絡擴張耦合起來。此迴圈確保降解性和合成性粒線體程序的協調增強。其失調損害代謝適應，並與老化和肌病相關。

label: MiT/TFE family
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors, which also includes TFE3, MITF, and TFEC. Members of this family share conserved DNA-binding and dimerization domains and regulate overlapping sets of lysosomal and autophagic target genes. The family's defining feature is responsiveness to nutrient and stress signals that control nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. TFEB and TFE3 are the principal mediators of the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation (CLEAR) network.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFE 家族的基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，該家族也包括 TFE3、MITF 和 TFEC。此家族成員共享保守的 DNA 結合和二聚化結構域，並調節重疊的一組溶酶體和自噬標的基因的轉錄。該家族的定義特徵是對控制核質穿梭的營養和壓力信號的反應性。TFEB 和 TFE3 是協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）網絡的主要介導者。

label: CLEAR Element
description: TFEB binds to Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation (CLEAR) elements—a conserved 10-base-pair motif (GTCACGTGAC) present in the promoters of numerous lysosomal and autophagy genes. Through this binding, TFEB drives the coordinated transcriptional upregulation of the entire autophagy-lysosomal network. CLEAR-mediated regulation allows cells to mount a unified response that expands degradative capacity in tandem with autophagic initiation. The CLEAR network is the molecular basis for TFEB's role as a master regulator of cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 結合至協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）元件——存在於眾多溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的保守 10 個鹼基對基序（GTCACGTGAC）。透過此結合，TFEB 驅動整個自噬—溶酶體網絡的協調轉錄上調。CLEAR 介導的調節使細胞能夠啟動統一的反應，在自噬起始的同時擴展降解能力。CLEAR 網絡是 TFEB 作為細胞清除主調控因子角色的分子的基礎。

label: Autophagy-lysosomal pathway
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway, coordinating the expression of genes required for autophagosome formation, cargo recognition, lysosomal biogenesis, and substrate degradation. Its activation simultaneously boosts both the supply of autophagosomes and the degradative capacity of lysosomes, ensuring coherent flux rather than unbalanced initiation. TFEB thereby couples the two halves of autophagy—sequestration and degradation—into a single coordinated program. Dysregulation of this axis contributes to lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 是自噬—溶酶體途徑的主轉錄調控因子，協調自噬體形成、貨物辨識、溶酶體生物發生和受質降解所需基因的表現。其活化同時提升自噬體的供應和溶酶體的降解能力，確保協調的流而非不平衡的起始。TFEB 因此將自噬的兩半——隔離和降解——耦合為單一協調程序。此軸的失調促成溶酶體儲存障礙、神經退化和癌症。

label: Mitochondrial stress
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is activated in response to mitochondrial stress, a process requiring mitophagy machinery including PINK1, Parkin, Atg9A, and Atg5 to signal and enable TFEB nuclear translocation. As damaged mitochondria are selected for autophagic removal, TFEB coordinates a compensatory lysosomal and autophagic response that restores organelle quality. This coupling ensures that mitochondrial turnover is matched by degradative capacity. The axis links mitochondrial quality control to the broader autophagy-lysosomal network and to metabolic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在回應粒線體壓力時被活化，此過程需要包括 PINK1、Parkin、Atg9A 和 Atg5 在內的粒線體自噬機械來傳遞信號並促成 TFEB 核轉位。當受損粒線體被選擇進行自噬移除時，TFEB 協調一個代償性的溶酶體和自噬反應，以恢復胞器品質。此耦合確保粒線體週轉由降解能力所匹配。該軸將粒線體品質控制連結到更廣泛的自噬—溶酶體網絡以及代謝恆定性。

label: Immune response
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB regulates innate and adaptive immune responses, becoming activated during dendritic cell maturation to enhance antigen processing and presentation via expanded lysosomal and MHC-related machinery. By boosting degradative capacity, TFEB improves the efficiency of antigen degradation and epitope loading, strengthening T cell priming. TFEB activity also influences macrophage polarization and immune cell metabolism. These roles position the autophagy-lysosomal master regulator as an important modulator of immunity.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 調節先天和適應性免疫反應，在樹突細胞成熟過程中被活化，透過擴增的溶酶體和 MHC 相關機械來增強抗原處理與呈現。透過提升降解能力，TFEB 改善了抗原降解和表位加載的效率，強化了 T 細胞啟動。TFEB 活性也影響巨噬細胞極化和免疫細胞代謝。這些角色將自噬—溶酶體主調節者定位為免疫的重要調節者。

label: Lipid catabolism
description: TFEB regulates lipid catabolism by upregulating genes involved in fatty acid import, beta-oxidation, lysosomal acid lipase (LAL)-mediated lipophagy, and the transcriptional coactivators PGC-1α and PPAR-α. Through these targets, TFEB coordinates the mobilization and oxidation of stored lipids during fasting and stress. This lipid-catabolic program complements TFEB's role in protein and organelle turnover, rendering it a comprehensive metabolic regulator. Enhanced TFEB activity improves lipid handling and protects against hepatic steatosis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過上調參與脂肪酸輸入、β 氧化、溶酶體酸性脂肪酶（LAL）介導的脂噬，以及轉錄共活化因子 PGC-1α 和 PPAR-α 的基因，來調節脂質分解代謝。透過這些標的，TFEB 在禁食和壓力期間協調儲存脂質的動員和氧化。此脂質分解代謝程序補充了 TFEB 在蛋白質和胞器週轉中的角色，使它成為全面的代謝調節者。增強的 TFEB 活性改善脂質處理並保護對抗肝臟脂肪變性。

label: K316
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB undergoes SUMOylation at lysine 316, a small ubiquitin-like modifier conjugation that attenuates its transcriptional activity. SUMOylation typically modulates protein-protein interactions and subnuclear compartmentalization, and at K316 it dampens TFEB-driven expression of lysosomal genes. This modification adds another layer to the post-translational code governing TFEB, acting in opposition to activatory marks such as deacetylation. The reversibility of SUMOylation by SENPs allows dynamic tuning of the degradative program.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 lysine 316 發生 SUMOylation，這是一種削弱其轉錄活性的小型泛素樣修飾物共軛。SUMOylation 通常調節蛋白質—蛋白質交互作用和亞核區室化，在 K316 處它抑制 TFEB 驅動的溶酶體基因表現。此修飾為控制 TFEB 的轉譯後密碼增添了另一層次，作用與去乙醯化等活化標記相反。SUMOylation 可被 SENPs 逆轉，允許對降解程序進行動態微調。

label: TNKS1
description: Tankyrase 1 (TNKS1) poly-ADP-ribosylates (PARsylates) TFEB, a modification that promotes its nuclear translocation and activation of target genes. PARsylation addsADP-ribose polymers that alter TFEB interactions and trafficking, providing a non-phosphorylation route to TFEB activation. This modification broadens the enzymatic toolkit—alongside kinases, phosphatases, acetylases, and ubiquitin ligases—that regulates the autophagy-lysosomal master switch. The TNKS1-TFEB relationship suggests potential crosstalk with Wnt/β-catenin and other PARsylation-dependent pathways.
description_zh_TW: Tankyrase 1（TNKS1）對 TFEB 進行聚 ADP-核糖基化（PARsylation），此修飾促進其核轉運和標的基因的活化。PARsylation 添加 ADP-核糖聚合物，改變 TFEB 交互作用和運輸，提供一條非磷酸化的 TFEB 活化路線。此修飾拓寬了調節自噬—溶酶體主開關的酵素工具箱——與激酶、磷酸酶、乙醯酶和泛素連接酶並列。TNKS1-TFEB 關係暗示了與 Wnt/β-catenin 和其他依賴 PARsylation 途徑的潛在串擾。

label: Celastrol
description: Celastrol activates TFEB via inhibiting mTORC1, reducing insoluble phosphorylated Tau aggregates and improving memory deficiency in Alzheimer's disease models.
description_zh_TW: Celastrol 透過抑制 mTORC1 活化 TFEB，減少不溶性磷酸化 Tau 聚集體，並改善阿茲海默症模型中的記憶缺陷。

label: Trehalose
description: Trehalose activates TFEB via inhibiting Akt, increasing clearance of proteolipid aggregates in Batten disease and reducing cardiac hypertrophy/fibrosis in chronic MI models.
description_zh_TW: Trehalose 透過抑制 Akt 活化 TFEB，增加 Batten 疾病中蛋白脂質聚集體的清除，並降低慢性 MI 模型中的心臟肥大／纖維化。

label: Rag GTPases
description: TFEB binds Rag GTPases as part of the amino acid-sensing machinery at the lysosomal surface, and this interaction is modulated by post-translational modification: oxidation of cysteine 212 inhibits TFEB's binding to Rag GTPases (PMID 31826695). The Rag GTPase complex is central to nutrient sensing, recruiting mTORC1 and its substrate machinery to the lysosome when amino acids are abundant, and TFEB's association with this complex links TFEB localization to nutrient availability. Oxidation at C212, by disrupting this binding, represents a redox-responsive mechanism that influences TFEB's cellular localization and activity, coupling oxidative stress to the regulation of the autophagy-lysosome pathway.
description_zh_TW: TFEB作為溶酶體表面氨基酸感應機制的一部分與Rag GTPases結合，並且這種相互作用受翻譯後修飾調節：半胱氨酸212的氧化抑製TFEB與Rag GTPases的結合（PMID 31826695）。Rag GTPase复合物是營養感應的核心，當氨基酸充足時將mTORC1及其底物機制招募到溶酶體，TFEB與該复合物的關聯將TFEB定位與營養可用性聯繫起來。C212處的氧化通過破壞這種結合，代表了一種氧化還原響應機制，影響TFEB的細胞定位和活性，將氧化應激與自噬-溶酶體途徑的調節聯繫起來。

label: Cytosol
description: TFEB is retained in the cytosol when it is phosphorylated at cytoplasmic-retention sites. Phosphorylation of S211 by mTORC1 or p38 MAPK, of S142 by mTORC1 or ERK2, of S122 by mTORC1, of S467 by Akt, and of S3 by MAP4K3 all promote cytoplasmic retention of TFEB, keeping the transcription factor away from its nuclear target genes. This phosphorylation-dependent cytosolic sequestration is the primary mechanism by which nutrient-rich and growth-factor-rich conditions suppress the lysosomal and autophagic transcriptional program. Dephosphorylation of these sites by calcineurin or PP2A relieves the retention and permits TFEB to translocate to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在胞質保留位點被磷酸化時被保留在細胞質中。mTORC1 或 p38 MAPK 對 S211 的磷酸化、mTORC1 或 ERK2 對 S142 的磷酸化、mTORC1 對 S122 的磷酸化、Akt 對 S467 的磷酸化，以及 MAP4K3 對 S3 的磷酸化，均促進 TFEB 的胞質保留，使轉錄因子遠離其核靶基因。這種依賴磷酸化的胞質隔離是營養豐富和生長因子豐富條件抑制溶酶體和自噬轉錄程序的主要機制。鈣調磷酸酶或 PP2A 對這些位點的去磷酸化解除保留，允許 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

label: calcineurin
description: Calcineurin dephosphorylates TFEB at S211 and S142, promoting nuclear translocation of the transcription factor (PMID 26043755). This dephosphorylation reverses the cytoplasmic-retention effect imposed by mTORC1 (S211) and ERK2/mTORC1 (S142) phosphorylation, allowing TFEB to enter the nucleus and activate lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes. Calcineurin is a calcium/calmodulin-dependent phosphatase, so this pathway couples calcium signaling to the TFEB-mediated cellular clearance program. It forms the dephosphorylation arm of TFEB regulation alongside PP2A, providing a calcium-sensitive route to activate the autophagy-lysosome pathway under stress conditions.
description_zh_TW: 鈣調磷酸酶在 S211 和 S142 上去磷酸化 TFEB，促進該轉錄因子的核轉位（PMID 26043755）。此去磷酸化逆轉 mTORC1（S211）和 ERK2/mTORC1（S142）磷酸化所施加的胞質保留效應，使 TFEB 能進入細胞核並啟動溶酶體生物發生和自噬基因。鈣調磷酸酶是一種鈣/鈣調蛋白依賴性磷酸酶，因此此通路將鈣信號與 TFEB 介導的細胞清除程序耦合。它與 PP2A 共同構成 TFEB 調節的去磷酸化臂，在壓力條件下提供一條鈣敏感的通路來啟動自噬-溶酶體通路。

label: Autophagosome-lysosome fusion
description: TFEB is a master transcription factor for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy that plays a critical role in autophagosome-lysosome fusion and clearance of cargo. Directionally, TFEB sits upstream of autophagic-lysosomal execution. Because SIRT2 stabilizes TFEB mRNA and SIRT1 deacetylates TFEB to promote its nuclear translocation, sirtuins influence TFEB function through multiple mechanisms. This links sirtuins to the terminal degradative step of autophagy, and TFEB's transcriptional program, known as CLEAR, coordinates the lysosomal and autophagic machinery that clears damaged proteins and organelles during stress.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 是溶酶體生物合成和自噬的主控轉錄因子，在自噬溶酶體融合和清除負載物中扮演關鍵角色。在方向性上，TFEB 位於自噬溶酶體執行步驟的上游。由於 SIRT2 穩定 TFEB mRNA，而 SIRT1 去乙醯化 TFEB 以促進其核轉位，sirtuin 透過多種機制影響 TFEB 功能。這將 sirtuin 與自噬的終末降解步驟聯繫起來，而 TFEB 的轉錄程式——稱為 CLEAR——協調溶酶體和自噬機制，以在壓力期間清除受損蛋白質和細胞器。

label: TFEB at K274/K279
description: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
description_zh_TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

label: Gender-specific tumorigenesis
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2-deficient mice develop gender-specific tumors, with females acquiring mammary tumors and males developing hepatocellular carcinoma, matching the mitotic instability produced by elevated Aurora-A/Aurora-B. Consistent with a tumor-suppressor role, human breast cancers and hepatocellular carcinomas often show reduced SIRT2 relative to normal tissue. The relationship is directional: loss of SIRT2 predisposes to these malignancies, whereas SIRT2 expression restrains them. This positions SIRT2 among the sirtuins that act as tumor suppressors in genetic mouse models.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 缺陷小鼠發展出性別特異性的腫瘤，雌性獲得多發性乳腺腫瘤，雄性則發展為肝細胞癌，這與 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 升高所產生的有絲分裂不穩定性相符。與腫瘤抑制角色一致的是，人類乳癌和肝細胞癌相較於正常組織常表現出 SIRT2 降低。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 的缺失促使這些惡性腫瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的表現則抑制它們。這將 SIRT2 定位為在基因工程小鼠模型中具有腫瘤抑制功能的 sirtuin 之一。

label: SIRT2-deficient mice
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2-deficient mice develop gender-specific tumors, with females acquiring mammary tumors and males developing hepatocellular carcinoma, matching the mitotic instability produced by elevated Aurora-A/Aurora-B. label: Glioblastoma growth
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of p21-activated kinase 1 (PAK1) at lysine 420 hinders autophagy and glioblastoma growth, establishing SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in this context. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic inhibition of PAK1 sits upstream of suppressed glioblastoma progression. By restraining PAK1 activity, SIRT1 limits the autophagy that glioblastoma cells rely on to survive under metabolic stress. This impairs tumor growth and positions SIRT1 as a brake on an aggressive brain malignancy. The finding illustrates that the same sirtuin can exert opposite effects in different cancers, and it suggests SIRT1 activation as a therapeutic direction for glioblastoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1介導的p21活化激酶1（PAK1）第420位賴氨酸去乙醯化阻碍自噬和膠質母細胞瘤生長，確立SIRT1在此環境中作為腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT1對PAK1的酵素抑制位於膠質母細胞瘤進展抑制的上游。透過限制PAK1活性，SIRT1限制了膠質母細胞瘤細胞在代謝壓力下存活所依賴的自噬。這損害了腫瘤生長，並將SIRT1定位為對侵略性腦部惡性腫瘤的制動器。此發現說明了同一sirtuin可以在不同癌症中產生相反效果，並建議SIRT1活化作為膠質母細胞瘤的治療方向。

label: SIRT1-mediated PAK1 deacetylation at K420
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

label: glioma sensitivity to temozolomide via ROS
community_name: glioma sensitivity to temozolomide via ROS
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 inhibition increases the sensitivity of glioma cells to temozolomide through facilitation of intracellular reactive oxygen species generation. Directionally, SIRT1 inhibition sits upstream of elevated ROS and enhanced drug-induced cell death in glioma. By blocking SIRT1's protective anti-oxidant activity, glioma cells accumulate ROS that sensitize them to temozolomide, the standard chemotherapy for glioblastoma. Combining SIRT1 inhibition with temozolomide may therefore improve treatment efficacy in malignant glioma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1抑制透過促進細胞內活性氧的產生來增加膠質瘤細胞對替莫唑胺的敏感性。方向上，SIRT1抑制位於膠質瘤中ROS升高和藥物誘導的細胞死亡增強的上游。透過阻斷SIRT1的保護性抗氧化活性，膠質瘤細胞積累ROS，使其對替莫唑胺（膠質母細胞瘤的標準化療藥物）敏感。因此將SIRT1抑制與替莫唑胺結合可能改善惡性膠質瘤的治療效果。

label: SIRT1 inhibition
community_name: glioma sensitivity to temozolomide via ROS
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

Directionally, SIRT1 inhibition sits upstream of elevated ROS and enhanced drug-induced cell death in glioma. By blocking SIRT1's protective anti-oxidant activity, glioma cells accumulate ROS that sensitize them to temozolomide, the standard chemotherapy for glioblastoma. Combining SIRT1 inhibition with temozolomide may therefore improve treatment efficacy in malignant glioma.

label: GLO1
description: GLO1 (glyoxalase I) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the glyoxalase system. It catalyzes the conversion of hemithioacetals, formed spontaneously from methylglyoxal and glutathione, into S-D-lactoylglutathione. Because methylglyoxal is one of the most reactive dicarbonyl precursors of advanced glycation end products, GLO1 activity is critical for preventing dicarbonyl stress from damaging proteins. Enhancing or maintaining GLO1 function is considered a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation and for protecting against age-related pathologies in which glycation plays a role.
description_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase I）是乙二醛酶系統的速率限制酶。它催化由甲基乙二醛與麩胱甘肽（glutathione）自發形成的半硫縮醛（hemithioacetals）轉化為 S-D-lactoylglutathione。由於甲基乙二醛是晚期糖化終產物最具反應性的二羰基前驅物之一，GLO1 活性對於防止二羰基壓力損害蛋白質至關重要。增強或維持 GLO1 功能被視為減少內生性 AGE 堆積與保護對抗涉及糖化的年齡相關病理的主要標的。

label: Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion
description: Repression of UCP2 by SIRT1 preserves mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis in pancreatic β-cells, which raises the ATP/ADP ratio and closes KATP channels to trigger insulin release. Mice overexpressing SIRT1 in β-cells show enhanced glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, while SIRT1 loss elevates UCP2 and impairs the response. Directionally, SIRT1-mediated UCP2 downregulation leads to stronger insulin secretion. This links SIRT1 to improved glucose homeostasis and protection against diabetes, and it is consistent with the observation that caloric restriction, which raises SIRT1, preserves β-cell function and insulin sensitivity in aging organisms.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對 UCP2 的抑制維持了胰腺 β 細胞的粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成，從而提高 ATP/ADP 比值並關閉 KATP 通道以觸發胰島素釋放。在 β 細胞中過量表達 SIRT1 的小鼠表現出增強的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，而 SIRT1 的缺失升高 UCP2 並損害此反應。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 UCP2 下調導致更強的胰島素分泌。這將 SIRT1 與改善的葡萄糖穩態和對糖尿病的保護聯繫起來，與熱量限制（提高 SIRT1）在衰老機體中保留 β 細胞功能和胰島素敏感性的觀察一致。

label: Glycated proteins
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。

label: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells
community_name: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT3 in breast cancer cells suppresses glycolysis and proliferation, offering a metabolic pathway for tumour suppression. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced glycolytic metabolism and growth in breast cancer cells. By suppressing glycolysis, SIRT3 limits the Warburg-like metabolic program that supports breast cancer proliferation, identifying SIRT3 activation as a potential tumour-suppressive strategy in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在乳腺癌細胞中的上調可抑制糖酵解和細胞增殖，為腫瘤抑制提供了一條代謝途徑。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 位於降低乳腺癌細胞糖酵解代謝和生長的上游。透過抑制糖酵解，SIRT3 限制了支持乳腺癌增殖的類沃伯格（Warburg）代謝程序，從而確立 SIRT3 活化作為乳腺癌中潛在的腫瘤抑制策略。

label: GOT1 acetylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 expression is directly correlated with favorable prognosis in pancreatic cancer, as SIRT5 loss promotes glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 1 acetylation, thus promoting cell proliferation by enhancing glutamine and glutathione metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of GOT1 deacetylation that restrains pancreatic cancer growth. When SIRT5 is lost, GOT1 acetylation rises, boosting glutamine and glutathione metabolism to drive proliferation. This identifies SIRT5 as a tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer whose levels could inform prognosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5表達與胰腺癌的良好預後直接相關，因為SIRT5缺失促進穀草轉氨酶1（GOT1）乙醯化，從而透過增強穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝促進細胞增殖。方向上，SIRT5位於抑制胰腺癌生長的GOT1去乙醯化的上游。當SIRT5缺失時，GOT1乙醯化升高，促進穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝以驅動增殖。這將SIRT5確定為胰腺癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其水平可能為預後提供資訊。

label: GRP75
description: GRP75 (mortalin/HSPA9) links the ER IP3R to the mitochondrial VDAC1 channel at mitochondria-associated ER membranes, gating calcium transfer. SIRT3 overexpression inhibits the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, reducing MAM formation and protecting hippocampal neurons from hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial calcium overload and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: GRP75（mortalin/HSPA9）在粒線體相關內質網膜上將內質網 IP3R 與粒線體 VDAC1 通道連接，調控鈣離子傳遞。SIRT3 的過量表現抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物，減少 MAM 形成，保護海馬神經元免受高血糖誘導的粒線體鈣超載和凋亡。

label: VDAC1 and IP3R at MAMs

label: Lipofuscin
description: Lipofuscin and Aging are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Lipofuscin and Aging may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Lipofuscin 和 Aging 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Lipofuscin 和 Aging 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Autophagic flux
description: Autophagic flux—the complete rate of cargo delivery to and degradation within lysosomes—declines progressively with age in many tissues. This decline stems from impaired initiation, reduced lysosomal proteolytic capacity, and accumulated lipofuscin that compromises lysosomal function, producing a state of proteostatic insufficiency. The resulting accumulation of damaged organelles and protein aggregates contributes centrally to the aging phenotype and to age-related diseases such as neurodegeneration and sarcopenia. Restoration of autophagic flux is therefore a major hypothesized mechanism through which longevity interventions exert their benefits.
description_zh_TW: 自噬流——即貨物遞送至溶酶體及在溶酶體內降解的完整速率——在許多組織中隨年齡漸進下降。此下降源於起始受損、溶酶體蛋白水解能力降低，以及累積的脂褐質損害溶酶體功能，產生蛋白質穩態不足的狀態。由此導致的受損胞器和蛋白聚集物累積，對老化表型和神經退化、肌肉減少症等與年齡相關疾病有核心貢獻。因此，恢復自噬流是長壽介入發揮其益處的一個主要假設機制。

label: Intestinal nuclei during fasting
description: During fasting, MXL-3::GFP signal disappears from intestinal nuclei within about two hours, indicating that the repressor exits the nucleus and ceases to suppress its target genes. This delocalization is a rapid, nutrient-responsive event that permits de-repression of lysosomal lipase and autophagy genes. The nuclear export of MXL-3 complements the concurrent nuclear accumulation of HLH-30, creating a switch from storage to mobilization. The observation provides direct in vivo evidence for dynamic regulation of the lipid-degradation program.
description_zh_TW: 在禁食期間，MXL-3::GFP 訊號在大約兩小時內從腸道細胞核消失，表明該抑制因子離開細胞核並停止抑制其標的基因。此去定位是一個快速的、對營養有反應的事件，它允許溶酶體脂肪酶和自噬基因的解除抑制。MXL-3 的核輸出補充了同時發生的 HLH-30 核累積，創造出從儲存到動員的開關。此觀察為脂質降解程序的動態調節提供了直接的活體證據。

label: Lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1,2,3,5)
description: In C. elegans, the MAX-like transcription factor MXL-3 represses transcription of lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) when food is abundant, limiting lipid mobilization. This repression maintains lipid storage under fed conditions and is relieved during fasting, allowing lipolysis. MXL-3 thus acts as a nutritional gatekeeper of lysosomal lipid catabolism, analogous to MYC's repression of lysosomal programs in mammals. Its activity positions lipid degradation within the broader nutrient-responsive regulatory network.
description_zh_TW: 在線蟲 C. elegans 中，MAX 樣轉錄因子 MXL-3 在食物充裕時抑制溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的轉錄，限制脂質動員。此抑制在進食條件下維持脂質儲存，並在禁食期間解除，允許脂解作用。因此 MXL-3 作為溶酶體脂質分解代謝的營養閘門，類似於 MYC 在哺乳動物中對溶酶體程序的抑制。其活性將脂質降解定位於更廣泛的營養反應性調節網絡中。

label: MAX
description: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

label: Senescent Cell Accumulation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial dysfunction in cellular senescence a bridge to neurodegenerative disease.md
description: Aging causes senescent-cell accumulation as telomere shortening, cumulative DNA damage, and stem-cell stress increase senescent-cell formation, while declining immune clearance reduces their removal. The burden rises across multiple tissues, often described as exponential with age, and is a cardinal hallmark linking cellular senescence to organismal aging. The causal direction is reinforced by experiments showing that clearing these cells alleviates age-related dysfunction. Senescent-cell accumulation is therefore both a marker and a driver of the aging process.
description_zh_TW: 老化造成衰老細胞累積，因端粒縮短、累積 DNA 損傷與幹細胞壓力增加衰老細胞形成，而下降的免疫清除減少其移除。此負擔在多種組織上升，常被描述為隨年齡指數增加，且是連結細胞衰老與個體老化的關鍵特徵。因果方向被清除這些細胞可緩解年齡相關功能障礙的實驗強化。衰老細胞累積因此既是老化過程的標記也是驅動者。

label: Dicer
description: Dicer is an RNase III enzyme that processes microRNA precursors into mature, functional miRNAs. After the nuclear processing of pri-miRNA to pre-miRNA by Drosha and export to the cytoplasm, Dicer cleaves the pre-miRNA duplex to produce the mature 18 to 22 nucleotide miRNA. The mature miRNA then binds complementary sequences in target mRNAs, typically in the 3' untranslated region, to repress their expression; Dicer levels decline with age, contributing to reduced miRNA production in aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: Dicer 是一種 RNase III 酶，可將 microRNA 前體加工成成熟的功能性 miRNA。在 Drosha 將 pri-miRNA 核加工為 pre-miRNA 並輸出到細胞質後，Dicer 裂解 pre-miRNA 雙股體，產生成熟的 18 至 22 核苷酸 miRNA。然後，成熟的 miRNA 結合目標 mRNA 中的互補序列（通常在 3' 非翻譯區），以抑制其表達； Dicer 水平隨著年齡的增長而下降，導致衰老組織中 miRNA 的產生減少。

label: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression
description: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression extends lifespan, as demonstrated by MCAT (mitochondrial catalase transgenic) mice showing roughly 20 percent increased median lifespan and delayed age-related pathology. By concentrating catalase in the mitochondrial matrix, H2O2 from Complex I or III leak is removed before it propagates damage. The directionality is targeted detoxification promoting longevity. A caveat is that lifespan extension is modest and tissue-specific, and overexpression does not abolish all aging phenotypes, indicating multiple parallel aging mechanisms.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression延長了壽命，正如MCAT（mitochondria1catalase轉基因）小鼠所證明的那樣，其顯示中位壽命延長了約20％並延遲了與年齡相關的病理。透過將catalase濃縮在mitochondria1基質中，來自複合物I或III洩漏的H 2 O 2 在其傳播損害之前被除去。方向性是針對性排毒延年益壽。需要注意的是，壽命延長是適度的且具有組織特異性，且過度表現並不能消除所有 aging 表型，表明存在多個並行的 aging 機制。

label: Nucleosome Remodeling
description: Nucleosome remodeling capacity decreases with age, accompanied by the loss of core histones and nucleosome occupancy. In aging yeast, nucleosome occupancy decreases by up to 50 percent and half the core histone proteins are lost, and similar chromatin decompaction occurs in worms and human cells. Reduced histone abundance and nucleosome loss decompact chromatin, increasing DNA accessibility and transcriptional noise while contributing to genomic instability in aging cells. These findings support the view that chromatin decompaction is a fundamental driver of age-related dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Nucleosome 重塑能力隨著年齡的增長而降低，伴隨著核心組蛋白和核小體佔據的損失。在老化的酵母菌中，核小體佔有率下降高達 50%，一半的核心組蛋白流失，蠕蟲和人類細胞中也會發生類似的染色質解壓縮。組蛋白豐度的減少和核小體的流失會使染色質解壓縮，增加 DNA 的可及性和轉錄噪音，同時導致老化細胞的基因組不穩定。這些發現支持這樣的觀點：染色質解壓縮是與年齡相關的功能障礙的根本驅動因素。

label: Autonomic Nervous System
description: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
description_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

label: Parasympathetic Nervous System
description: The parasympathetic nervous system is the rest, digest, and repair branch of the autonomic nervous system, controlled heavily by the vagus nerve. When active, it signals the body to calm down, digest food, and repair cells, allowing for more fluctuation between heartbeats and thereby raising HRV. A high HRV indicates strong vagal tone, meaning the parasympathetic system can quickly hit the brakes on stress. HRV reflects the tug-of-war between the sympathetic and parasympathetic systems, and recovery after stressors allows the parasympathetic branch to rebound and push HRV back to or above baseline.
description_zh_TW: 副交感神經系統是自主神經系統的休息、消化和修復分支，主要受迷走神經控制。活躍時，它向身體發出信號以平靜下來、消化食物和修復細胞，允許心跳之間有更多波動，從而提高心率變異性（HRV）。高HRV表示迷走神經張力強，意味著副交感系統能快速對壓力踩剎車。HRV反映了交感和副交感系統之間的拉鋸戰，壓力後的恢復允許副交感分支反彈並將HRV推回或高於基線。

label: Sympathetic Nervous System
description: The sympathetic nervous system is the fight, flight, or freeze branch of the autonomic nervous system. It releases adrenaline and cortisol to prepare the body for action during events such as a HIIT workout, cold plunge, or fasting. When the SNS is active, it forces the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, thereby lowering HRV. Chronic sympathetic dominance keeps the system stuck in the on position, producing a chronically depressed HRV that signals under-recovery and overtraining rather than adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 交感神經系統是自主神經系統的戰鬥、逃跑或凍結分支。它釋放腎上腺素和皮質醇，使身體在HIIT鍛煉、冷水浸泡或禁食等事件期間準備行動。當SNS活躍時，它迫使心臟跳動更快、更規律，從而降低HRV。慢性交感神經主導地位使系統卡在開啟位置，產生慢性抑鬱的HRV，表示恢復不足和過度訓練而非適應。

label: Declining SIRT3 and rising SIRT4
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Aging is associated with declining SIRT3 activity and rising SIRT4, which narrows the hormetic window and increases vulnerability to mitochondrial stressors. Directionally, aging sits upstream of the altered ratio. This shift favors oxidant stress and metabolic inflexibility, and restoring the ratio, for example via caloric restriction or NAD+ precursors, is a proposed anti-aging strategy. By reducing the protective SIRT3/SIRT4 balance, aging impairs mitochondrial quality control and stress adaptation. This association links mitochondrial sirtuin biology to the functional decline of aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: 衰老與 SIRT3 活性下降和 SIRT4 上升相關，這縮窄了激效窗口並增加對粒線體壓力源的脆弱性。在方向性上，衰老位於改變比率的上游。這種變化有利於氧化壓力和代謝不靈活性，恢復比率（例如透過限制熱量或 NAD+ 前驅物）是一種擬議的抗衰老策略。透過降低保護性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡，衰老損害粒線體品質控制和壓力適應。此關聯將粒線體 sirtuin 生物學與衰老組織的功能退化聯繫起來。

label: HAF-1
description: HAF-1 is an inner mitochondrial membrane ABC-transporter family protein in C. elegans that exports matrix-derived peptides into the cytosol to signal mitochondrial stress. Proteins degraded by matrix proteases generate peptides that exit the mitochondria through HAF-1 (analogous to the yeast Mdl1 transporter), and this peptide release triggers a nuclear transcriptional response involving the ubiquitin-like protein UBL-5, the homeobox transcription factor DVE-1, and ATFS-1. The mechanism is reminiscent of peptide-based quorum sensing in gram-positive bacteria, where peptides exported via ABC transporters activate two-component histidine kinase sensors.
description_zh_TW: HAF-1 是線蟲（C. elegans）粒線體內膜上的 ABC 轉運蛋白家族蛋白，負責將基質來源的胜肽輸出至細胞質，以傳遞粒線體壓力訊號。經基質蛋白酶降解的蛋白質會產生胜肽，透過 HAF-1 離開粒線體（類似酵母菌的 Mdl1 轉運蛋白），此胜肽釋放會觸發涉及類泛素蛋白 UBL-5、同源框轉錄因子 DVE-1 及 ATFS-1 的核轉錄反應。此機制令人聯想到革蘭氏陽性菌中基於胜肽的群體感應，細菌透過 ABC 轉運蛋白輸出的胜肽會活化雙組分組織胺酸激酶感測器。

label: Hair Cells
description: Cochlear hair cells are mechanosensory receptors that cannot regenerate once lost. Under caloric restriction, SIRT3-driven IDH2 activation boosts mitochondrial NADPH and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity — protection completely lost in SIRT3-deficient mice.
description_zh_TW: 耳蝸毛細胞是機械感測受體，一旦喪失無法再生。在熱量限制下，SIRT3 驅動的 IDH2 活化促進粒線體 NADPH 和活性氧清除，維護耳蝸毛細胞完整性——這種保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中完全喪失。

source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

label: Hepatic steatosis (fatty liver)
description: Through the AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway, resveratrol reduces hepatic steatosis in diet-induced obesity models by enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial function while limiting lipogenesis. Directionally, SIRT1 activation sits upstream of reduced liver fat accumulation. This demonstrates a translational metabolic benefit of sirtuin activation and is consistent with SIRT1s repression of lipogenic transcription factors such as SREBP-1c and PPAR-γ in the liver. By both increasing lipid catabolism and suppressing de novo lipogenesis, the pathway corrects the imbalance that drives non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
description_zh_TW: 通過 AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α 通路，白藜蘆醇在飲食誘導肥胖模型中通過增強脂肪酸氧化和粒線體功能同時限制脂肪生成來減少肝脂肪變性。在方向性上，SIRT1 活化位於減少肝臟脂肪堆積的上游。這展示了 sirtuin 活化的轉化代謝益處，與 SIRT1 在肝臟中抑制 SREBP-1c 和 PPAR-γ 等脂肪生成轉錄因子一致。通過同時增加脂質分解代謝並抑制新生脂肪合成，該通路糾正了驅動非酒精性脂肪肝病的不平衡。

label: HIC1
description: HIC1 (hypermethylated in cancer 1) is a tumor suppressor that binds the SIRT1 promoter via its POZ domain and directly represses SIRT1 transcription. Because p53 transactivates HIC1, a negative feedback loop exists: p53 induces HIC1, which then restrains SIRT1, preventing excessive p53 deacetylation and preserving p53 tumor-suppressive capacity. The directionality is HIC1 → SIRT1 repression, upstream of SIRT1's inhibition of p53. Disruption of this loop in cancer can unleash SIRT1 to silence p53.
description_zh_TW: HIC1（hypermethylated in cancer 1）是一種腫瘤抑制因子，通過其 POZ 結構域結合 SIRT1 啟動子並直接抑制 SIRT1 轉錄。由於 p53 反式活化 HIC1，存在一個負回饋迴路：p53 誘導 HIC1，HIC1 反過來限制 SIRT1，防止過度的 p53 去乙醯化並維持 p53 的腫瘤抑制能力。其方向性為 HIC1 → SIRT1 抑制，位於 SIRT1 對 p53 的抑制上游。此迴路在癌症中的中斷可以釋放 SIRT1 來沉默 p53。

label: High dietary AGE intake
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Sebekova and colleagues found that long-term consumption of advanced glycation end products in rats leads to a dose-dependent increase in proteinuria that over time could induce renal damage. High long-term consumption of AGEs has also been associated with higher levels of fasting glucose, insulin, and serum AGEs, as well as increased AGE localization and RAGE staining in the ovarian tissue of rats. These results show that chronic dietary AGE excess can reproduce in animals some of the renal and metabolic features seen in aging and diabetes, supporting the toxicity of a high-AGE diet.
description_zh_TW: Sebekova 及其同事發現，大鼠長期攝取晚期糖化終產物會導致蛋白尿呈劑量依賴性增加，隨時間可能誘發腎損傷。長期高量攝取 AGE 也與較高的空腹血糖、胰島素與血清 AGE 濃度，以及大鼠卵巢組織中 AGE 定位與 RAGE 染色增加有關。這些結果顯示，慢性飲食性 AGE 過量能在動物中重現老化與糖尿病中見到的部分腎臟與代謝特徵，支持高 AGE 飲食的毒性。

label: HIV-1 viral transcription
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Because deacetylated Tat is a more potent transactivator, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation at Lys50 boosts HIV-1 transcription from the proviral LTR. The relationship is directional: SIRT1 acts on Tat to amplify viral gene expression and reactivate latent proviruses. This positions host SIRT1 as a cofactor that HIV exploits, a caveat to the generally beneficial reputation of SIRT1 activation. Targeting this interaction is of interest for antiviral strategies, particularly for the shock-and-kill approach to HIV latency, where compounds that modulate the SIRT1–Tat axis could either silence or purge the latent reservoir depending on the therapeutic goal.
description_zh_TW: 由於去乙醯化的 Tat 是更強的轉錄活化因子，SIRT1 介導的 Lys50 去乙醯化增強了 HIV-1 從前病毒 LTR 的轉錄。其方向性為：SIRT1 作用於 Tat 以放大病毒基因表達並重新活化潛伏的前病毒。這將宿主 SIRT1 定位為 HIV 利用的輔因子，是 SIRT1 活化普遍有益聲譽的一個注意事項。靶向此相互作用對抗病毒策略具有意義，特別是針對 HIV 潜伏的「震驚與清除」方法，調節 SIRT1–Tat 軸的化合物可以根據治療目標沉默或清除潛伏儲存庫。

label: hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in HCC
community_name: hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in HCC
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 and SIRT6 deacetylate the RNA-binding protein hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in hepatocellular carcinoma. Directionally, SIRT1 and SIRT6 sit upstream of hnRNP A1 deacetylation, which curtails glycolytic gene expression and tumor growth. By restraining the glycolytic program through hnRNP A1, these nuclear sirtuins act as metabolic tumor suppressors in HCC, opposing the aerobic glycolysis that supports cancer cell proliferation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1和SIRT6去乙醯化RNA結合蛋白hnRNP A1以抑制肝細胞癌中的糖解作用和生長。方向上，SIRT1和SIRT6位於hnRNP A1去乙醯化的上游，後者限制糖解基因表達和腫瘤生長。透過透過hnRNP A1抑制糖解程序，這些核sirtuin在HCC中作為代謝腫瘤抑制因子，對抗支持癌細胞增殖的有氧糖解。

label: Homogeneous fluorescent deacetylase assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The homogeneous fluorescent deacetylase assay, which uses the fluorescent acetyl-lysine substrate ZMAL and NAD+ followed by trypsin treatment to release the AMC fluorophore, was used to screen several compound families as sirtuin inhibitors, including adenosine mimetics, inhibitors of kinases or phosphatases, suramin analogs, splitomicin derivatives, thiobarbiturates, and 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones. Directionally, the assay's ZMAL-ZML trypsin-coupled readout provides a plate-compatible screen for sirtuin inhibition. Its utility explains the breadth of scaffolds identified across independent discovery programs.
description_zh_TW: 均質螢光去乙醯酶測定使用螢光乙醯-離胺酸受質 ZMAL 和 NAD+，隨後經胰蛋白酶處理釋放 AMC 螢光基團，被用於篩選多個化合物家族作為 sirtuin 抑制劑，包括腺嘌呤類似物、激酶或磷酸酶抑制劑、Suramin 類似物、splitomicin 衍生物、硫代巴比妥酸鹽和 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮。方向性上該測定的 ZMAL-ZML 胰蛋白酶偶聯讀取提供了適用於微孔板的 sirtuin 抑制篩選方法。其實用性解釋了在獨立發現計畫中鑑定出多種骨架結構的廣度。

label: HP1alpha (to LINE-1 heterochromatin)
description: SIRT6-mediated mono-ADP-ribosylation of KAP1 recruits HP1α to package LINE-1 retrotransposons into heterochromatin, silencing their expression. Directionally, SIRT6/KAP1 sits upstream of HP1α tethering. This protects genome stability by containing mobile elements, and it explains how SIRT6 loss derepresses LINE-1. By maintaining heterochromatic silencing of retrotransposons, SIRT6 prevents the insertional mutations and genomic instability caused by active LINE-1 elements. The KAP1-HP1α axis is thus a critical effector of SIRT6's genome-protective function, and its disruption contributes to the instability seen in SIRT6-deficient cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 介導的 KAP1 單 ADP-核糖基化招募 HP1α 將 LINE-1 逆轉座子包裝成異染色質，沉默其表達。在方向性上，SIRT6/KAP1 位於 HP1α 拴繫的上游。這透過限制可動元件保護基因組穩定性，並解釋了 SIRT6 缺失如何解除 LINE-1 的抑制。透過維護逆轉座子的異染色質沉默，SIRT6 防止了活性 LINE-1 元件引起的插入突變和基因組不穩定性。KAP1-HP1α 軸線因此是 SIRT6 基因組保護功能的關鍵效應器，其破壞導致 SIRT6 缺陷細胞中所見的不穩定性。

label: Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype
description: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the ensemble of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and matrix-remodeling enzymes secreted by senescent cells. Accumulation of senescent cells with age creates a chronic, low-grade inflammatory milieu that drives inflammaging—the sterile inflammation implicated in nearly all age-related diseases. SASP factors recruit immune cells, promote fibrosis, and induce paracrine senescence in neighboring cells, establishing feed-forward tissue deterioration. Targeting senescent cells or their SASP is a major therapeutic avenue to reduce inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子和基質重塑酵素之集合。衰老細胞隨年齡累積，創造出慢性、低度的發炎環境，驅動 inflammaging——一種與幾乎所有與年齡相關疾病有關的無菌性發炎。SASP 因子招募免疫細胞、促進纖維化，並誘發鄰近細胞的旁分泌性衰老，建立前饋式的組織惡化。標靶衰老細胞或其 SASP 是減少 inflammaging 的一個主要治療途徑。

label: IFITM3
description: IFITM3 is enriched in exosomes released from senescent cells and mediates paracrine senescence by transmitting senescence signals to recipient cells. As an exosomal cargo, it represents a vesicle-based, rather than soluble-factor, route of spread, and its inclusion highlights that paracrine senescence is not solely cytokine-driven. Exosomes allow protected, concentrated delivery of signals to recipient cells, and they can be detected in the circulation as potential biomarkers of senescence burden. The mechanism adds a non-classical communication modality to the SASP paradigm.
description_zh_TW: IFITM3 在衰老細胞釋放的胞外囊泡中富集，並透過將衰老訊號傳遞至受體細胞介導旁分泌衰老。作為胞外體貨物，它代表一種基於囊泡而非可溶因子的擴散途徑，其納入凸顯旁分泌衰老不只由細胞激素驅動。胞外體允許受保護、濃縮的訊號遞送至受體細胞，且可在循環中作為衰老負擔的潛在生物標記被偵測。此機制為 SASP 範式增添非典型溝通方式。

label: Notch
description: Notch signaling is essential for establishing paracrine senescence and, paradoxically, weakens the secondary SASP in receiving cells. Notch integrates cues from the SASP to reinforce arrest in neighbors while modulating their secretory output, indicating that paracrine senescence is an active, regulated program rather than passive factor exposure. The distinct outcomes -- establishing arrest versus dampening the SASP -- reflect context-dependent Notch outputs in recipient cells. This dual role positions Notch as a key integrator of the spread and modulation of senescence.
description_zh_TW: Notch 訊號對建立旁分泌衰老至為必要，且矛盾地削弱受體細胞的次級 SASP。Notch 整合來自 SASP 的線索以強化鄰近細胞的停滯，同時調節其分泌輸出，顯示旁分泌衰老是一主動、受調節的程序而非被動因子暴露。此不同結果——建立停滯 vs 減弱 SASP——反映受體細胞中依脈絡而定的 Notch 輸出。此雙重角色將 Notch 定位為衰老擴散與調節的關鍵整合者。

label: Diabetic Kidney Disease
description: Senolytic therapy (D+Q) has been tested in a pilot study for diabetic kidney disease (NCT02848131), based on evidence that senescent cells and their SASP drive renal fibrosis and dysfunction in diabetes through chronic inflammation and matrix remodeling. The trial assessed feasibility, safety, and biomarkers of renal senescence, and early data showing reduced senescent-cell burden informed the potential of senolytics in metabolic kidney disease. Clinical confidence remains preliminary pending larger, powered trials, but D+Q is among the few regimens with human feasibility data in this indication.
description_zh_TW: Senolytic 療法（D+Q）已在糖尿病腎病的試驗性研究（NCT02848131）中測試，依據為衰老細胞及其 SASP 透過慢性發炎與基質重塑驅動糖尿病中的腎纖維化與功能障礙的證據。該試驗評估可行性、安全性與腎衰老的生物標記，早期顯示衰老細胞負擔降低的資料說明了 senolytics 在代謝性腎病中的潛力。臨床信度仍屬初步，有待更大、具統計檢力的試驗，但 D+Q 是在此適應症中少數具人體可行性資料的方案。

label: CDKN2A
description: The CDKN2A locus encoding p16INK4a is derepressed in OIS via loss of PRC1/2-mediated H3K27me3 repression, allowing p16 accumulation that enforces durable arrest. This epigenetic switch is a hallmark of the p53-independent senescence phase and locks cells into an Rb-dependent G1 block. The relationship couples oncogene signaling to stable CDK-inhibitor expression and is a well-characterized epigenetic event in OIS. It explains how senescence is maintained even when p53 is compromised, providing a second, independent barrier against escape.
description_zh_TW: 編碼 p16INK4a 的 CDKN2A 基因座在 OIS 中經由喪失 PRC1/2 介導的 H3K27me3 抑制而解抑制，允許 p16 累積以強制持久停滯。此表觀遺傳開關是 p53 獨立衰老階段的標記，並將細胞鎖入不可逆生長停止。其解抑制標記從急性壓力反應到穩定衰老表型的轉變，且與 p53 臂並行提供冗餘。它是 OIS 持久性的表觀遺傳基礎。

label: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: Senolytic therapy (D+Q) has been tested for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) in a pilot clinical trial (NCT02874989), where it improved physical function. The rationale is that senescent-cell accumulation and SASP-driven fibrosis, particularly TGFb- and MMP-mediated matrix deposition, contribute to IPF pathogenesis. The results support further evaluation of senolytics in fibrotic lung disease and helped establish the feasibility of senolytic dosing in humans. IPF remains among the most advanced clinical indications for senolytic therapy, and the study catalyzed additional trials in kidney disease, osteoarthritis, and frailty.
description_zh_TW: Senolytic 療法已在試驗性臨床試驗中用於特發性肺纖維化（IPF）（NCT02874989），改善身體功能。其依據為衰老細胞累積與 SASP 驅動的纖維化（特別是 TGFb 與 MMP 介導的基質沉積）促成 IPF 致病機制。結果支持在纖維化肺病中進一步評估 senolytics，並協助確立 senolytic 人體劑量的可行性。IPF 仍是 senolytic 療法最先進的臨床適應症之一，且該研究催化了腎病、骨關節炎與衰弱的額外試驗。

label: Senolytic Drugs
description: Senolytic drugs are agents designed to selectively eliminate senescent cells, the damaged cells that accumulate with age and drive age-related pathology through their pro-inflammatory secretome. Because senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis, senolytics typically target the anti-apoptotic pathways that keep them alive, such as the BCL-2 family members, enabling their clearance while sparing proliferating healthy cells. Clearing senescent cells in animal models delays the onset of age-related diseases, and several senolytics are now being tested in human clinical trials.
description_zh_TW: 老化藥物是一種旨在選擇性消除衰老細胞的藥物，衰老細胞是隨著年齡的增長而積累的受損細胞，並通過促炎分泌組驅動與年齡相關的病理。由於衰老細胞對細胞凋亡具有抵抗力，因此 senolytics 通常針對使它們保持活力的抗細胞凋亡途徑（例如 BCL-2 家族成員），從而在不傷害增殖的健康細胞的同時清除它們。在動物模型中清除衰老細胞可以延緩與年齡相關的疾病的發生，並且有幾種衰老藥物目前正在人體臨床試驗中進行測試。

label: BRAF
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: BRAF, particularly the oncogenic BRAF V600E mutant, induces oncogene-induced senescence when expressed at high levels in normal cells. Hyperactive BRAF signaling drives aberrant proliferation and DNA damage, which activates the DNA damage response and p53, triggering a permanent growth arrest that protects against malignant transformation. Cells in BRAF-induced senescence display the full senescence phenotype, including senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and the SASP, making this a key experimental model.
description_zh_TW: BRAF，特別是致癌 BRAF V600E 突變體，當在正常細胞中高水平表達時，會誘導癌基因誘導的衰老。過度活躍的 BRAF 訊號傳導會驅動異常增殖和 DNA 損傷，進而活化 DNA 損傷反應和 p53，引發永久性生長停滯，從而防止惡性轉化。 BRAF 誘導的衰老細胞表現出完整的衰老表型，包括衰老相關的異染色質灶和 SASP，使其成為關鍵的實驗模型。

label: Melanoma
description: Oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) is the permanent cell-cycle arrest triggered in cells carrying BRAF/RAS/MYC mutations. The benign melanocytic nevus (mole) is the in-vivo embodiment of OIS and prevents melanoma; bypass of OIS via p53/PTEN loss or TERT activation is required for malignancy. Capped, arrested growth is therefore tumor-suppressive.
description_zh_TW: 致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS）是在帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 突變的細胞中觸發的永久性細胞週期停滯。良性黑色素細胞痣（痣）是 OIS 的體內體現，並防止黑色素瘤；經由 p53/PTEN 缺失或 TERT 活化繞過 OIS 是惡性化所必需的。受封頂、停滯的生長因此是腫瘤抑制性的。

label: Dasatinib plus Quercetin
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan.md
description: The combination of Dasatinib and Quercetin (D+Q) was the first rationally identified senolytic, targeting SCAPs such as Bcl-2 family members and PI3K-delta. Intermittent D+Q treatment improves frailty, osteoporosis, cardiovascular function, and pulmonary fibrosis in aged or progeroid mice, motivating the search for more potent single-agent flavonoids like Fisetin.
description_zh_TW: Dasatinib 與 Quercetin 的合併使用（D+Q）是首個以假說驅動方式發現的 senolytic，可攻擊 Bcl-2 家族成員及 PI3K-delta 等 SCAPs。間歇性 D+Q 治療能改善年老或早衰小鼠的衰弱、骨質疏鬆、心血管功能與肺纖維化，也因此促成尋找如 Fisetin 這類更強效單一成分類黃酮的研究。

label: hPEPT1
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Pyrraline is an advanced glycation end product that is absorbed by the peptide transporter hPEPT1, according to the first study addressing the absorption mechanism of individual AGEs. In a bioavailability study, pretzel sticks were found to be a rich source of pyrraline and pentosidine; after ingestion of these foods, urinary excretion of pyrraline and pentosidine increased, with recovery in urine of about 50% for pyrraline and 60% for pentosidine. Although the metabolic fate of these compounds is unknown, their absorption via peptide transporters such as hPEPT1 explains how dietary AGEs enter the circulation.
description_zh_TW: Pyrraline 是一種晚期糖化終產物，根據首項探討個別 AGE 吸收機制的研究，它經由胜肽轉運蛋白 hPEPT1 被吸收。在一項生物可利用性研究中，發現椒鹽捲餅棒（pretzel sticks）是 pyrraline 與 pentosidine 的豐富來源；攝取這些食物後，尿液中 pyrraline 與 pentosidine 的排泄增加，尿中回收率約為 pyrraline 50%、pentosidine 60%。儘管這些化合物的代謝命運未知，它們經由如 hPEPT1 等胜肽轉運蛋白的吸收解釋了飲食性 AGE 如何進入循環。

label: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome
description: Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome is a rare premature aging disorder caused by mutations in the LMNA gene, which encodes lamin A. A silent point mutation (c.1824C>T) activates a cryptic splice site that produces progerin, a permanently farnesylated, toxic form of lamin A that accumulates at the nuclear membrane. Progerin causes nuclear blebbing, loss of heterochromatin, genomic instability, and premature senescence, producing the accelerated aging features of the disease. The disease demonstrates how defective nuclear envelope proteins disrupt chromatin organization and accelerate aging.
description_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症是一種罕見的過早老化疾病，由編碼核纖層蛋白 A 的 LMNA 基因突變引起。沉默點突變 (c.1824C>T) 會活化一個神秘的剪接位點，產生早老素，這是核纖層蛋白 A 的一種永久法呢基化的有毒形式，在核膜上積聚。早老蛋白會導致核起泡、異染色質流失、基因組不穩定和過早衰老，從而產生該疾病的加速衰老特徵。這種疾病顯示了有缺陷的核膜蛋白如何破壞染色質組織並加速老化。

label: Hyperactivation of autophagy
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Deacetylation of LDHB by SIRT5 hyperactivates autophagy, accelerating cellular self-digestion and influencing tumor cell survival and metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5-mediated LDHB deacetylation sits upstream of autophagic hyperactivation. This can support tumor-cell fitness under stress by recycling nutrients, but it may also provoke cell-death programs when excessive. It exemplifies SIRT5's role at the autophagy-metabolism interface, where the same enzyme coordinates both fuel utilization and the clearance of cellular components. Understanding this axis is relevant to cancer therapy, where modulating autophagy can either sensitize or protect tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化使自噬過度活化，加速細胞自我消化並影響腫瘤細胞的存活和代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化位於自噬過度活化的上游。這可以透過回收營養物質在壓力下支持腫瘤細胞的適應性，但當過度活化時也可能引發細胞死亡程式。這體現了 SIRT5 在自噬—代謝交界處的角色，同一種酶同時協調燃料利用和細胞組件的清除。理解這一軸線與癌症治療相關，因為調控自噬可以增敏或保護腫瘤細胞。

description_zh_TW: SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化使自噬過度活化，加速細胞自我消化並影響腫瘤細胞的存活和代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化位於自噬過度活化的上游。這可以透過回收營養物質在壓力下支持腫瘤細胞的適應性，但當過度活化時也可能引發細胞死亡程式。這體現了 SIRT5 在自噬—代謝交界處的角色，同一種酶同時協調燃料利用和細胞組件的清除。理解這一軸線與癌症治療相關，因為調控自噬可以增敏或保護腫瘤細胞。

label: Hypoxia-reoxygenation
description: Hypoxia-reoxygenation produces a ROS burst in rheumatoid arthritis synovium analogous to ischemia-reperfusion, as restored oxygen fuels mitochondrial and enzymatic ROS after hypoxic epochs. This oxidant surge perpetuates synovial inflammation and joint damage. The directionality is reoxygenation to ROS burst in joint tissue. A caveat is that RA synovium is also hypoxic because of high metabolic and infiltrating-cell demand, so the cycle is sustained rather than episodic. This mechanism may explain the vulnerability of the inflamed joint to intermittent blood flow and oxidative injury.
description_zh_TW: Hypoxia-reoxygenation 在類風濕性關節炎滑膜中產生 ROS 爆發，類似於缺血再灌注，因為缺氧時期後恢復的氧氣為 mitochondria1 和酶促 ROS 提供燃料。這種氧化劑激增會導致滑膜發炎和關節損傷持續存在。方向性是關節組織中ROS爆發的再氧合。需要注意的是，由於高代謝和浸潤細胞的需求，RA 滑膜也會缺氧，因此循環是持續的而不是間歇性的。這種機制可以解釋發炎關節對間歇性血流和氧化損傷的脆弱性。

label: I-PpoI
description: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
description_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

label: insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 and its activators prevent/reverse insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes by enhancing deacetylation of metabolic regulators (e.g., PGC-1α, FOXO; Rodgers 2005 PMID 15931387).
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 及其活化劑透過增強代謝調節因子（例如 PGC-1α、FOXO）的去乙醯化來預防/逆轉胰島素抵抗和第二型糖尿病（Rodgers 2005 PMID 15931387）。

source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

label: insulin sensitivity / glucose intolerance
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 knockout mice are resistant to glucose intolerance and show improved insulin sensitivity on a high-fat diet.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 敲除小鼠對葡萄糖不耐受具有抵抗力，並在高脂飲食上顯示改善的胰島素敏感性。

label: SIRT7 knockout
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 knockout mice are resistant to glucose intolerance and show improved insulin sensitivity on a high-fat diet.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 敲除小鼠對葡萄糖不耐受具有抵抗力，並在高脂飲食上顯示改善的胰島素敏感性。

label: mitochondrial bioenergetics
description: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models, opposing the calcific phenotype driven by mitochondrial dysfunction in advanced chronic kidney disease.
description_zh_TW: Intermedin（腎上腺髓質素 2）在血管鈣化模型中透過 AMPK/SIRT3 介導的嵴重塑增強粒線體生物能容量，對抗進階慢性腎臟病中粒線體功能障礙驅動的鈣化表型。

label: Intestinal Absorption
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Orlistat, a lipase inhibitor, reduced serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal in 21 women with polycystic ovary disease compared with 15 women without PCOS, by decreasing AGE absorption. A six-month study evaluating the effect of calorie restriction and orlistat found serum AGE reductions in both PCOS and obese groups, independent of changes in body mass index. By interfering with lipid absorption, orlistat also reduces the absorption of fat-associated dietary AGEs, since foods rich in protein and fat have the highest AGE content. Orlistat therefore illustrates how modulating intestinal absorption can lower postprandial glycation load.
description_zh_TW: Orlistat 是一種脂解酶抑制劑（lipase inhibitor），在 21 名多囊性卵巢疾病女性與 15 名無 PCOS 女性相比，於高 AGE 餐後降低了血清 AGE，方式是減少 AGE 吸收。一項評估熱量限制與 orlistat 效果為期六個月的研究發現，PCOS 與肥胖組的血清 AGE 均下降，且獨立於身體質量指數的變化。透過干擾脂質吸收，orlistat 也減少與脂肪相關的飲食性 AGE 吸收，因為富含蛋白質與脂肪的食物 AGE 含量最高。因此，orlistat 說明了調節腸道吸收如何能降低餐後糖化負載。

label: Orlistat
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md

label: intracellular cAMP
description: Inhibiting PDE4 prevents cAMP degradation, so intracellular cAMP accumulates after resveratrol exposure. Directionally, PDE4 inhibition leads to elevated cAMP. Elevated cAMP then activates the exchange protein Epac1, propagating a calcium and AMPK signal that ultimately boosts NAD+ and SIRT1. This pathway explains how resveratrol can activate SIRT1 even through non-allosteric means, and it connects resveratrol's pharmacology to the broader cAMP signaling network. Because PDE4 is a validated therapeutic target, this arm also links resveratrol's metabolic and anti-inflammatory effects to a well-characterized drug target.
description_zh_TW: 抑制 PDE4 阻止 cAMP 降解，因此在白藜蘆醇暴露後細胞內 cAMP 累積。在方向性上，PDE4 抑制導致 cAMP 升高。升高的 cAMP 然後活化交換蛋白 Epac1，傳播鈣離子和 AMPK 信號，最終提升 NAD+ 和 SIRT1。此通路解釋了白藜蘆醇如何能通過非變構方式活化 SIRT1，將白藜蘆醇的藥理學與更廣泛的 cAMP 信號網絡聯繫起來。由於 PDE4 是一個已驗證的治療靶點，這個臂也將白藜蘆醇的代謝和抗發炎效應與一個特徵明確的藥物靶點聯繫起來。

label: PDE4 inhibition (resveratrol)
description: Inhibiting PDE4 prevents cAMP degradation, so intracellular cAMP accumulates after resveratrol exposure. Directionally, PDE4 inhibition leads to elevated cAMP.
