label: GKRP
description: SIRT2 promotes glucose-dependent hepatic glucose uptake by deacetylating GKRP at K126, and its downregulation ameliorates reduced Akt activity while increasing insulin-stimulated glucose uptake in insulin-resistant neuro-2a cells. SIRT1 overexpression improves insulin sensitivity, but hepatic SIRT1 knockdown prevents fasting hyperglycemia by increasing hepatic insulin responsiveness, illustrating SIRT1's dual role in diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過在 K126 去乙醯化 GKRP 促進葡萄糖依賴的肝臟葡萄糖攝取，且其下調改善降低的 Akt 活性，同時在胰島素抗性 neuro-2a 細胞中增加胰島素刺激的葡萄糖攝取。SIRT1 過度表現改善胰島素敏感性，但肝 SIRT1 敲低透過增加肝臟胰島素反應性防止空腹高血糖，體現 SIRT1 在糖尿病中的雙重角色。

label: Phosphoglycerate Mutase
description: SIRT2 promotes tumor glycolysis in some settings by deacetylating phosphoglycerate mutase at Lys100, channeling carbon into NADPH production and accelerating tumor growth in lung cancer. This illustrates SIRT2's context-dependent, often harmful, metabolic face versus the protective SIRT1/3/6 axis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在某些情境下透過在 Lys100 去乙醯化 phosphoglycerate mutase 促進腫瘤糖解，將碳引導至 NADPH 生成並加速肺癌中的腫瘤生長。這體現 SIRT2 相對於保護性 SIRT1/3/6 軸、常為有害的、情境依賴的代謝面貌。

label: AKR1C1
description: SIRT2 suppresses NSCLC migration by deacetylating AKR1C1 and inhibiting STAT3. In a counteracting oncogenic axis SIRT2 deacetylates phosphoglycerate mutase at K100 to generate NADPH and accelerate tumor growth, giving SIRT2 a context-dependent dual role in lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 AKR1C1 並抑制 STAT3 抑制 NSCLC 遷移。在一條相抗的致癌軸中，SIRT2 在 K100 去乙醯化 phosphoglycerate mutase 以生成 NADPH 並加速腫瘤生長，賦予 SIRT2 在肺癌中情境依賴的雙重角色。

label: AC93253
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: AC93253 is a small molecule that inhibits SIRT2 at micromolar concentrations. In leukemia cells, SIRT2 inhibition with AC93253 is accompanied by Akt acetylation, de-phosphorylation, and consequent inhibition, producing antileukemia effects. The directionality is that AC93253 blocks SIRT2, which then removes deacetylation-based control over Akt, shifting it toward an inactive state. This positions AC93253 as both a research tool for SIRT2 biology and an anticancer lead, and connects sirtuin inhibition to PI3K/Akt pathway suppression.
description_zh_TW: AC93253 是一種在微摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT2 的小分子。在白血病細胞中，AC93253 伴隨 Akt 乙醯化、去磷酸化及隨後的抑制，產生抗白血病效果。方向性上 AC93253 阻斷 SIRT2，進而去除對 Akt 的去乙醯化控制，使其轉向非活化狀態。這使 AC93253 既作為 SIRT2 生物學的研究工具，也作為抗癌先導化合物，並將 sirtuin 抑制與 PI3K/Akt 途徑抑制聯繫起來。

label: BubR1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: BubR1, a spindle-assembly-checkpoint protein, is stabilized by SIRT2 deacetylation at Lys668 (SIRT2 knockdown accelerates BubR1 degradation); SIRT2 overexpression increases BubR1 levels and delays aging phenotypes in progeroid mice, so BubR1 is functionally a positive downstream effector of the SIRT2 pathway (North et al., 2014, Cell, PMID 24825348).
description_zh_TW: BubR1 是一種紡錘體組裝檢查點蛋白，透過 SIRT2 在 Lys668 的去乙醯化而被穩定（SIRT2 下調加速 BubR1 降解）；SIRT2 過表達增加 BubR1 水平並延遲早衰小鼠的衰老表型，因此 BubR1 功能上是 SIRT2 通路的正向下游效應因子（North et al., 2014, Cell, PMID 24825348）。

label: induced pluripotency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: By targeting glycolytic enzymes, SIRT2 controls metabolic reprogramming during induced pluripotency. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of the metabolic switch from oxidative to glycolytic metabolism that accompanies reprogramming of somatic cells toward pluripotency. This metabolic control is essential for the establishment and function of primed human pluripotent stem cells, linking sirtuin activity to cell fate determination and stem cell biology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過靶向糖解酶來控制誘導多能性期間的代謝重編程。方向上，SIRT2位於伴隨體細胞向多能性重編程的從氧化代謝到糖解代謝的代謝轉換的上游。這種代謝控制對於已啟動的人類多能幹細胞的建立和功能至關重要，將sirtuin活性與細胞命運決定和幹細胞生物學聯繫起來。

label: TGF-β1-induced fibroblast activation
description: Genetic knockdown and chemical inhibition of SIRT2 attenuate TGF-β1-induced fibroblast activation and MDM2 expression, reducing fibrogenic responses. Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition leads to less TGF-β1 fibroblast activation. This is unusual because it implies SIRT2 can promote, rather than suppress, fibrosis in this context, unlike the antifibrotic SIRT1, SIRT3, and SIRT6. It underscores the context-dependence of sirtuin-fibrosis relationships and suggests that SIRT2 inhibition might be antifibrotic in specific settings. The MDM2 connection links SIRT2 to p53 regulation during fibroblast activation, adding mechanistic depth to the observation.
description_zh_TW: 基因敲低和化學抑制 SIRT2 減弱 TGF-β1 誘導的纖維母細胞活化和 MDM2 表達，減少纖維化反應。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制導致較少的 TGF-β1 纖維母細胞活化。這是不尋常的，因為它暗示 SIRT2 在此情境下可以促進而非抑制纖維化，不同於抗纖維化的 SIRT1、SIRT3 和 SIRT6。它強調了 sirtuin-纖維化關係的情境依賴性，並提示 SIRT2 抑制可能在特定環境中具有抗纖維化作用。MDM2 的聯繫將 SIRT2 與纖維母細胞活化期間的 p53 調節聯繫起來，為觀察結果增加了機制深度。

label: Slug (EMT transcription factor)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: In basal-like breast cancer, SIRT2 maintains the protein stability of Slug, an epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) transcription factor, through deacetylation. Stabilized Slug contributes to the robust tumorigenic activity of basal-like breast cancer, along with its enhanced invasive and metastatic capabilities. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Slug-dependent EMT and tumor progression. By protecting Slug from degradation, SIRT2 sustains the mesenchymal program that drives invasion and metastasis in this aggressive breast cancer subtype.
description_zh_TW: 在基底樣乳腺癌中，SIRT2透過去乙醯化維持Slug（一種上皮-間質轉化EMT轉錄因子）的蛋白穩定性。穩定化的Slug與其增強的侵襲和轉移能力一起，促進了基底樣乳腺癌的強大致瘤活性。方向上，SIRT2位於Slug依賴性EMT和腫瘤進展的上游。透過保護Slug免受降解，SIRT2維持了驅動此侵襲性乳腺癌亞型侵襲和轉移的間質程序。

label: IDH1 (repressing CRC migration)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: In human colorectal cancer, SIRT2-dependent deacetylation of the metabolic enzyme IDH1 represses cancer cell migration and invasion both in vitro and in vivo. This regulation of IDH1 influences cellular metabolism and inhibits the formation of liver metastases. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of IDH1 sits upstream of suppressed colorectal cancer metastasis. By modulating IDH1 and the metabolic state of the tumor cell, SIRT2 limits the invasive capacity that drives metastatic spread. This positions SIRT2 as a suppressor of colorectal cancer progression and indicates that preserving SIRT2 activity, or mimicking its effects, could restrain metastasis in this malignancy.
description_zh_TW: 在人類大腸直腸癌中，SIRT2依賴性的代謝酶IDH1去乙醯化在體外和體內抑制癌細胞遷移和侵襲。此IDH1的調節影響細胞代謝並抑制肝臟轉移瘤的形成。方向上，SIRT2對IDH1的酵素修飾位於大腸直腸癌轉移抑制的上游。透過調節IDH1和腫瘤細胞的代謝狀態，SIRT2限制了驅動轉移性擴散的侵襲能力。這將SIRT2定位為大腸直腸癌進展的抑制因子，並表明維持SIRT2活性或模擬其效果可能限制此惡性腫瘤的轉移。

label: cisplatin-resistant ovarian cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Overexpression of SIRT2 significantly enhances the sensitivity of cisplatin-resistant counterpart ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of restored platinum sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells. By increasing the vulnerability of these cells to cisplatin, SIRT2 may help overcome platinum resistance, a major obstacle in ovarian cancer treatment. This suggests that strategies to augment SIRT2 activity could improve the efficacy of cisplatin-based therapy in resistant disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2的過表達顯著增強順鉑耐藥性對應卵巢癌細胞對順鉑的敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於耐藥卵巢癌細胞中鉑敏感性恢復的上游。透過增加這些細胞對順鉑的脆弱性，SIRT2可能有助於克服鉑耐藥性，這是卵巢癌治療中的主要障礙。這表明增強SIRT2活性的策略可能提高耐藥性疾病中順鉑基治療的效果。

label: G6PD
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 activates G6PD via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 G6PD（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: PEPCK (gluconeogenesis)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 activates PEPCK (gluconeogenesis) via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 PEPCK（糖質新生）（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: PEPCK
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 activates PEPCK via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 PEPCK（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: NFATc2
description: SIRT2 binds and deacetylates the nuclear factor of activated T-cell c2 (NFATc2) transcription factor, regulating its transcriptional activity in immune and cardiovascular contexts. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatically tunes NFATc2. Because NFATc2 drives interleukin and hypertrophic gene programs, its deacetylation influences inflammation and cardiac remodeling. This links SIRT2 to calcineurin/NFAT signaling, a central pathway in T-cell activation and pathological cardiac growth. By modulating NFATc2, SIRT2 can shape both immune responses and cardiac stress adaptation, illustrating how a cytosolic sirtuin regulates a key inducible transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 結合並去乙醯化活化 T 細胞核因子 c2（NFATc2）轉錄因子，調節其在免疫和心血管背景下的轉錄活性。在方向性上，SIRT2 在酶學上調節 NFATc2。由於 NFATc2 驅動白介素和肥大基因程序，其去乙醯化影響發炎和心臟重塑。這將 SIRT2 與鈣調磷酸酶/NFAT 信號（T 細胞活化和病理性心臟生長的中心通路）聯繫起來。通過調節 NFATc2，SIRT2 可以塑造免疫反應和心臟壓力適應，說明一種細胞質 sirtuin 如何調節一個關鍵的可誘導轉錄因子。

label: acute promyelocytic leukaemia
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT2 could be a promising drug target for acute promyelocytic leukaemia therapy. Directionally, SIRT2 activity sits upstream of leukaemia cell survival and differentiation programs. Pharmacological modulation of SIRT2 is therefore being explored as a therapeutic strategy in this haematological malignancy, potentially by restoring differentiation or promoting death of leukaemic blasts.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2可能是急性前骨髓性白血病治療的一個有前景的藥物靶點。方向上，SIRT2活性位於白血病細胞存活和分化程序的上游。因此SIRT2的藥理學調節正在被探索為此血液惡性腫瘤的治療策略，可能是透過恢復分化或促進白血病母細胞的死亡。

label: FOXOs
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates FOXO1 and FOXO3a, promoting their nuclear accumulation and target-gene activation (e.g., stress resistance, gluconeogenesis, and cell survival) in a manner analogous to SIRT1-FOXO coupling, making FOXOs downstream effectors and listed positive regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 FOXO1 和 FOXO3a，促進它們的核積累和靶基因活化（例如抗壓、糖質新生和細胞存活），類似於 SIRT1-FOXO 的耦合方式，使 FOXOs 成為 SIRT2 通路的下游效應因子和被列出的正向調節因子（Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387）。

label: PPP
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates G6PD in the pentose phosphate pathway (PPP) at Lys403, activating it to promote NADPH production and antioxidant defense; the PPP thus serves as a downstream effector of SIRT2 and is listed among its positive pathway regulators (Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在磷酸戊糖途徑（PPP）中去乙醯化 G6PD 的 Lys403，活化它以促進 NADPH 產生和抗氧化防禦；因此 PPP 作為 SIRT2 的下游效應因子被列為其正向通路調節因子（Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394）。

label: AKR1C1 (inhibiting STAT3 transactivation)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates aldo-keto reductase family 1 member C1 (AKR1C1), and this modification inhibits transactivation of STAT3 target genes, suppressing migration of non-small-cell lung cancer cells both in vitro and in xenograft models. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of AKR1C1 sits upstream of reduced STAT3-driven metastasis. By restraining STAT3 transcriptional activity, SIRT2 limits the invasive and migratory phenotype that contributes to lung cancer progression. This tumor-suppressive axis contrasts with SIRT2's pro-tumorigenic stabilization of Myc in other settings, reinforcing the context-dependence of sirtuin biology in oncology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2去乙醯化醛酮還原酶家族1成員C1（AKR1C1），此修飾抑制STAT3靶基因的轉活化，在體外和異種移植模型中抑制非小細胞肺癌細胞的遷移。方向上，SIRT2對AKR1C1的酵素修飾位於STAT3驅動的轉移減少的上游。透過抑制STAT3轉錄活性，SIRT2限制了促進肺癌進展的侵襲和遷移表型。此腫瘤抑制軸與SIRT2在其他環境中對Myc的促腫瘤穩定化形成對比，強化了sirtuin生物學在腫瘤學中的環境依賴性。

label: H4K16ac
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates histone H4 Lys16 during the G2/M transition, promoting mitotic chromatin condensation (Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期間去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 Lys16，促進有絲分裂染色質凝縮（Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462）。

label: phosphoglycerate mutase (K100)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates the K100 residue of the glycolytic enzyme phosphoglycerate mutase and facilitates its activation, which results in enhanced NADPH production and accelerated tumor growth in non-small-cell lung cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of phosphoglycerate mutase sits upstream of increased glycolytic flux and anabolic support for tumor growth. This oncogenic action of SIRT2 in lung cancer contrasts with its tumor-suppressive deacetylation of AKR1C1 in the same disease, illustrating the context dependence of SIRT2's cancer-related functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2去乙醯化糖解酶磷酸甘油酸變位酶的K100殘基並促進其活化，導致NADPH產生增加和非小細胞肺癌細胞中腫瘤生長加速。方向上，SIRT2對磷酸甘油酸變位酶的酵素修飾位於糖解通量增加和腫瘤生長合成代謝支持的上游。SIRT2在肺癌中的此致癌作用與其在同一疾病中對AKR1C1的腫瘤抑制性去乙醯化形成對比，說明了SIRT2癌症相關功能的環境依賴性。

label: transcription factor deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates transcription factors including NF-kB/p65, p53, FOXO1, and FOXO3a, generally restraining their pro-inflammatory/apoptotic output while shaping metabolic and stress programs; this cytoplasmic transcription-factor control complements SIRT2's tubulin and mitotic functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化包括 NF-kB/p65、p53、FOXO1 和 FOXO3a 在內的轉錄因子，通常抑制其促發炎/凋亡輸出，同時塑造代謝和壓力反應程序；這種細胞質轉錄因子的控制補充了 SIRT2 的 tubulin 和有絲分裂功能。

label: Th2 responses and macrophage polarization
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 enhances allergic asthmatic inflammation by upregulating T-helper type 2 responses and macrophage polarization. Pharmacologic ablation of SIRT2 attenuates, while genetic SIRT2 overexpression exaggerates, the allergic asthmatic phenotype. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Th2-driven allergic inflammation. By promoting the type 2 immune response characteristic of asthma, SIRT2 amplifies airway inflammation and the associated pathology. This makes SIRT2 inhibition a candidate therapeutic approach for allergic asthma, since reducing SIRT2 activity could dampen Th2 responses and macrophage-mediated inflammation, providing a potential strategy to modulate the severity of the disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過上調T輔助細胞第2型反應和巨噬細胞極化來增強過敏性氣喘發炎。藥理學消除SIRT2可減輕，而基因SIRT2過表達則加重過敏性氣喘表型。方向上，SIRT2位於Th2驅動的過敏性發炎的上游。透過促進氣喘特徵性的第2型免疫反應，SIRT2放大氣道發炎和相關病理。這使SIRT2抑制成為過敏性氣喘的候選治療方法，因為降低SIRT2活性可能抑制Th2反應和巨噬細胞介導的發炎，提供調節疾病嚴重程度的潛在策略。

label: N-Myc and c-Myc
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 enhances the protein stability of the oncogenic transcription factors N-Myc and c-Myc, promoting cancer cell proliferation. This represents an oncogenic function of SIRT2 that is distinct from its tumor-suppressive roles in other cellular contexts. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Myc stabilization and enhanced proliferation. By protecting these potent oncogenes from degradation, SIRT2 can support the growth of Myc-driven tumors, complicating the simple view of sirtuins as universal tumor suppressors.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2增強致癌轉錄因子N-Myc和c-Myc的蛋白穩定性，促進癌細胞增殖。這代表了SIRT2的一個致癌功能，與其在其他細胞環境中的腫瘤抑制作用不同。方向上，SIRT2位於Myc穩定化和增殖增強的上游。透過保護這些強效癌基因免受降解，SIRT2可以支持Myc驅動的腫瘤生長，使sirtuin作為普遍腫瘤抑制因子的簡單觀點變得複雜。

label: Cervical cancer progression
description: SIRT2 expression is decreased in cervical cancer tissue versus adjacent normal tissue, and higher SIRT2 predicts favorable survival, indicating it suppresses cervical cancer progression. Directionally, SIRT2 loss is associated with, and putatively enables, tumor advancement. Its deacetylase actions on metabolic and mitotic substrates likely enforce differentiation and genome stability, restraining the aggressive features of cervical cancer. This adds to the context-dependent tumor-suppressor face of SIRT2, which can also promote tumors by stabilizing oncogenes such as c-Myc in other settings, underscoring the tissue- and context-specificity of SIRT2's role in cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在宮頸癌組織中與鄰近正常組織相比表達降低，較高的 SIRT2 預測良好的生存率，表明其抑制宮頸癌進展。在方向性上，SIRT2 的缺失與腫瘤進展相關，並推定為促進因素。其對代謝和有絲分裂受質的去乙醯酶作用可能實施分化和基因組穩定性，限制宮頸癌的侵襲性特徵。這增加了 SIRT2 情境依賴性腫瘤抑制的一面，SIRT2 也可以通過在其他情況下穩定 c-Myc 等癌基因來促進腫瘤，突顯 SIRT6 在癌症中作用的組織和情境特異性。

label: BubR1 progeroid mice
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 extends lifespan in BubR1 progeroid mice, as reported in the longevity/aging literature, supporting a role in cell-cycle and proteostatic regulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 BubR1 早衰小鼠中延長壽命，這在長壽/衰老文獻中已有報導，支持其在細胞週期和蛋白質恆定調節中的角色。

label: oxidative damage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT2 has a role in neurodegeneration and protects neural cells from oxidative damage caused by ageing and disease. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of neuronal resilience against oxidative stress. Although SIRT2 is overexpressed in neurodegenerative disorders such as Parkinson's disease, its ability to shield neurons from oxidative injury suggests a protective function in specific contexts, and SIRT2 remains a candidate target for neuroprotective strategies.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2在神經退行性疾病中具有作用，並保護神經細胞免受衰老和疾病引起的氧化損傷。方向上，SIRT2位於神經元對氧化壓力的韌性的上游。儘管SIRT2在帕金森氏症等神經退行性疾病中過表達，但它保護神經元免受氧化損傷的能力表明在特定環境中的保護功能，SIRT2仍然是神經保護策略的候選靶點。

label: anti-inflammatory
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 has an anti-inflammatory role in myeloid and joint cells by deacetylating NF-kB/p65, reducing cytokines and ameliorating arthritis, though it promotes Th2 responses in allergic asthma; this context-dependence reflects SIRT2's diverse substrates and its differential expression across immune cell types.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在髓系和關節細胞中具有抗發炎作用，透過去乙醯化 NF-kB/p65 減少細胞因子並改善關節炎，但在過敏性氣喘中促進 Th2 反應；這種環境依賴性反映了 SIRT2 多樣化的底物及其在不同免疫細胞類型中的差異表達。

label: HOXA10 (homeobox transcription factor)
description: SIRT2 interacts with HOXA10, a conserved homeobox transcription factor critical for embryonic cell-type determination and adult tissue homeostasis, including reproductive and hematopoietic development. The interaction suggests SIRT2 influences HOXA10-dependent transcriptional programs, though the precise deacetylation outcome is less well characterized than for other SIRT2 substrates. Directionally, SIRT2 engages HOXA10 as a partner and potential substrate. This connection links SIRT2 to developmental regulation and possibly to differentiation defects in disease, and is consistent with SIRT2's broader roles in controlling transcription-factor activity and cell-fate decisions across tissues.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 與 HOXA10 相互作用，HOXA10 是一種保守的同源框轉錄因子，對胚胎細胞類型決定和成人組織穩態（包括生殖和造血發育）至關重要。這種相互作用表明 SIRT2 影響 HOXA10 依賴性的轉錄程序，儘管其確切的去乙醯化結果不如其他 SIRT2 受質那樣有充分描述。在方向性上，SIRT2 與 HOXA10 作為夥伴和潛在受質相互作用。這種聯繫將 SIRT2 與發育調節以及可能的疾病分化缺陷聯繫起來，與 SIRT2 在控制跨組織轉錄因子活性和細胞命運決定方面的更廣泛作用一致。

label: Cell cycle regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 is a cytoplasmic/mitotic deacetylase that regulates cytokinesis and the G2/M transition, supporting genomic stability and mitotic fidelity; age-related SIRT2 decline impairs these cell-cycle checkpoints (source review; North & Verdin review of SIRT2 mitotic roles).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是一種細胞質/有絲分裂去乙醯酶，調節細胞質分裂和 G2/M 轉換，支持基因組穩定性和有絲分裂忠實度；與年齡相關的 SIRT2 下降損害這些細胞週期檢查點（文獻綜述；North & Verdin 關於 SIRT2 有絲分裂角色的綜述）。

label: Oligodendrocytes and Schwann cells
description: SIRT2 is expressed in oligodendrocytes and Schwann cells, the myelin-forming glia of the CNS and PNS respectively, where it deacetylates α-tubulin and regulates microtubule stability. Its presence in myelinating cells ties SIRT2 to axonal support, myelin integrity, and the cytoskeletal dynamics required for glial process extension. Directionally, SIRT2 acts within glia to control cytoskeletal organization. Dysregulation of SIRT2 is implicated in demyelinating and neurodegenerative conditions, and because α-tubulin acetylation is protective in axons, the balance of SIRT2 activity in myelinating glia is thought to influence both myelination and axonal health.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在寡突膠質細胞和雪旺細胞（分別為中樞和周圍神經系統的髓鞘形成膠質細胞）中表達，在此處去乙醯化 α-tubulin 並調節微管穩定性。其在髓鞘形成細胞中的存在將 SIRT2 與軸突支持、髓鞘完整性和膠質突起延伸所需的細胞骨架動態聯繫起來。在方向性上，SIRT2 在膠質細胞內控制細胞骨架組織。SIRT2 的失調與脫髓鞘和神經退行性疾病有關，且由於 α-tubulin 乙醯化在軸突中具有保護作用，髓鞘形成膠質中 SIRT2 活性的平衡被認為影響髓鞘形成和軸突健康。

label: Kinase-inhibitor scaffolds
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 is inhibited by kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against the enzyme on the rationale that sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. The bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range, alongside the general Kinase enzyme family that shares the adenosine pocket. Directionally, the shared adenosine-binding site of SIRT2 and protein kinases underlies this cross-inhibition. Because these scaffolds retain kinase activity, their cellular effects reflect a combination of kinase and sirtuin blockade.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 被激酶抑制劑骨架抑制，這些骨架透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對該酵素的活性而被鑑定，其原理是 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性，與共享腺嘌呤口袋的激酶酶家族並列。方向性上 SIRT2 和蛋白激酶共享的腺嘌呤結合位點奠定了這種交叉抑制的基礎。由於這些骨架保留了激酶活性，其細胞效應反映了激酶和 sirtuin 阻斷的組合。

label: tubulin deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 is the first identified tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule stability and dynamics; this underlies SIRT2's mitotic roles and explains why SIRT2 inhibitors, by preserving tubulin acetylation, protect neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's disease models.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是第一個被發現的 tubulin 去乙醯酶，它移除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基團以調節微管穩定性和動態性；這構成了 SIRT2 有絲分裂功能的基礎，也解釋了為什麼 SIRT2 抑制劑透過保留 tubulin 乙醯化，在帕金森氏症和亨廷頓氏症模型中保護神經元。

label: Tubulin deacetylase
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 is the predominantly cytoplasmic sirtuin that functions as a tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule dynamics and mitotic fidelity. Because it deacetylates tubulin and other mitotic regulators, SIRT2 loss impairs the control that normally keeps Aurora-A and Aurora-B in check during division, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death. Directionally, SIRT2's tubulin deacetylase activity is an upstream determinant of normal chromosome segregation, linking sirtuin biology to mitotic stability and tumor suppression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是主要位於細胞質的 sirtuin，作為微管蛋白去乙醯酶功能，去除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基以調節微管動態和有絲分裂精準度。由於其去乙醯化 tubulin 和其他有絲分裂調節因子，SIRT2 缺失損害了正常情況下在細胞分裂期間控制 Aurora-A 和 Aurora-B 的機制，導致非整倍體和有絲分裂細胞死亡。方向性上 SIRT2 的微管蛋白去乙醯酶活性是正常染色體分離的上游決定因素，將 sirtuin 生物學與有絲分裂穩定性和腫瘤抑制聯繫起來。

label: cell-cycle control
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 peaks at the G2/M transition and deacetylates H4K16, alpha-tubulin, and mitotic regulators, promoting chromatin condensation and mitotic fidelity; its loss raises Aurora-A/B and causes aneuploidy, linking SIRT2 to cell-cycle control and genomic stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期達到高峰，並去乙醯化 H4K16、α-tubulin 和有絲分裂調節因子，促進染色質凝縮和有絲分裂忠實度；其缺失會增加 Aurora-A/B 水平並導致非整倍體，將 SIRT2 與細胞週期控制和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: HNF4α
description: SIRT2 prevents liver steatosis and lipid metabolic disorders by deacetylating hepatocyte nuclear factor 4α (HNF4α), a master regulator of hepatic lipid and drug-metabolizing genes. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatically activates HNF4α. This maintains lipid homeostasis and protects against fatty liver, with SIRT2 knockdown promoting steatosis and lipid accumulation. It adds a hepatic metabolic function to SIRT2's repertoire, complementing its roles in mitosis and cytoskeletal regulation. The HNF4α connection also links SIRT2 to bile-acid and xenobiotic metabolism, broadening the metabolic consequences of SIRT2 activity in the liver.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 通過去乙醯化肝細胞核因子 4α（HNF4α）——肝臟脂質和藥物代謝基因的主要調節因子——來預防肝脂肪變性和脂質代謝障礙。在方向性上，SIRT2 在酶學上活化 HNF4α。這維持脂質穩態並保護對抗脂肪肝，SIRT2 敲低促進脂肪變性和脂質堆積。這為 SIRT2 的能力增加了肝臟代謝功能，與其在有絲分裂和細胞骨架調節中的作用互補。HNF4α 的聯繫也將 SIRT2 與膽汁酸和外源物質代謝聯繫起來，擴展了肝臟中 SIRT2 活性的代謝後果。

label: BRCA1 deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 promotes BRCA1-BARD1 heterodimerization through deacetylation of BRCA1, facilitating assembly of the repair complex required for homologous recombination. This supports genome maintenance and tumor suppression by enabling high-fidelity repair of DNA double-strand breaks. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic licensing of BRCA1 sits upstream of repair complex formation. By promoting homologous recombination, SIRT2 helps cells repair potentially oncogenic DNA damage accurately rather than through error-prone pathways. This links SIRT2 to DNA repair fidelity and explains part of its tumor-suppressive activity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過去乙醯化BRCA1促進BRCA1-BARD1異源二聚化，促進同源重組所需的修復複合物組裝。這透過實現DNA雙鏈斷裂的高保真修復來支持基因組維護和腫瘤抑制。方向上，SIRT2對BRCA1的酵素許可位於修復複合物形成的上游。透過促進同源重組，SIRT2幫助細胞準確修復潛在致癌的DNA損傷，而非透過易錯途徑。這將SIRT2與DNA修復保真度聯繫起來，並解釋了其部分腫瘤抑制活性。

label: endometrial cancer stemness and chemoresistance via MEK/ERK
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 promotes cell stemness and activates the MEK/ERK signaling pathway while repressing chemosensitivity in endometrial cancer. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of stem-like phenotypes and MEK/ERK-dependent survival in endometrial cancer cells. By enhancing stemness and ERK signaling, SIRT2 supports tumor self-renewal and reduces responsiveness to chemotherapy. This makes SIRT2 inhibition a potential strategy to sensitize endometrial cancer to treatment.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2促進細胞幹性並活化MEK/ERK訊號通路，同時抑制子宮內膜癌的化療敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於子宮內膜癌細胞中幹細胞樣表型和MEK/ERK依賴性存活的上游。透過增強幹性和ERK訊號，SIRT2支持腫瘤自我更新並降低對化療的反應性。這使SIRT2抑制成為使子宮內膜癌對治療敏感的潛在策略。

label: HIF-1 activity
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT2 regulates HIF-1 activity, which is important for tumour hypoxia responses. HIF-1 protein stability and transcriptional activity are both negatively influenced by SIRT2, with SIRT2-mediated deacetylation necessary for HIF-1α destabilisation and the tumour cell hypoxia response. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of reduced HIF-1α abundance and activity, thereby restraining hypoxia-driven transcriptional programs in tumour cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2調節HIF-1活性，這對腫瘤缺氧反應很重要。HIF-1蛋白穩定性和轉錄活性都受到SIRT2的負向影響，SIRT2介導的去乙醯化對於HIF-1α不穩定化和腫瘤細胞缺氧反應是必要的。方向上，SIRT2位於HIF-1α豐度和活性降低的上游，從而抑制腫瘤細胞中的缺氧驅動的轉錄程序。

label: Glioma tumour formation
description: SIRT2 resides in a genomic region frequently deleted in human gliomas, and re-expression of SIRT2 markedly reduces colony formation by glioma cells, indicating tumor-suppressor function. Its activity deacetylates substrates such as α-tubulin and HNF4α that govern mitotic fidelity and metabolism, helping to preserve genomic stability during division. Directionally, SIRT2 loss permits gliomagenesis while SIRT2 restoration suppresses it. A caveat is that SIRT2 can act as either a tumor suppressor or a promoter depending on tissue and context—stabilizing oncogenes like c-Myc in some settings—so its role in cancer is highly context-dependent and cell-type-specific.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 位於人類膠質瘤中頻繁缺失的基因組區域，SIRT2 的重新表達顯著減少膠質瘤細胞的集落形成，表明其具有腫瘤抑制功能。其活性去乙醯化 α-tubulin 和 HNF4α 等受質，調節有絲分裂忠實度和代謝，有助於在細胞分裂期間維持基因組穩定性。在方向性上，SIRT2 的缺失允許膠質瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的恢復則抑制它。需要注意的是，SIRT2 可以根據組織和情境充當腫瘤抑制因子或促進因子——在某些情況下穩定 c-Myc 等癌基因——因此其在癌症中的作用高度取決於情境和細胞類型。

label: FoxO1 deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT2 suppresses adipocyte differentiation through deacetylation of the transcription factor FoxO1, which reinforces FoxO1-mediated repression of PPARgamma. Consistent with this, reduced SIRT1 and SIRT2 expression in visceral adipose stem cells from obese individuals correlates with enhanced adipogenic capacity and visceral fat expansion. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of FoxO1-dependent anti-adipogenic programs. By keeping FoxO1 active in repressing PPARgamma, SIRT2 restrains the conversion of precursor cells into mature adipocytes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過去乙醯化轉錄因子FoxO1來抑制脂肪細胞分化，這加強了FoxO1對PPARgamma的抑制。與此一致，肥胖者內臟脂肪幹細胞中SIRT1和SIRT2表達的降低與脂肪生成能力的增強和內臟脂肪擴張相關。方向上，SIRT2位於FoxO1依賴性抗脂肪生成程序的上游。透過保持FoxO1在抑制PPARgamma方面的活性，SIRT2限制了前體細胞向成熟脂肪細胞的轉化。

label: SirReal2
description: SirReal2 is a potent SIRT2 inhibitor, with an IC50 of 0.14 μM and minimal effects on SIRT1 and SIRT3, exploiting a SIRT2-specific binding pocket. Directionally, SirReal2 blocks SIRT2 deacetylase activity. It is a key chemical probe for SIRT2 biology in neurodegeneration and cancer, and its selectivity makes it valuable for isolating SIRT2-specific effects from the broader sirtuin family. Because SIRT2 inhibition protects neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's models, SirReal2's selectivity positions it as a candidate scaffold for therapeutic development in neurodegenerative disease.
description_zh_TW: SirReal2 是一種強效的 SIRT2 抑制劑，IC50 為 0.14 μM，對 SIRT1 和 SIRT3 影響極小，利用 SIRT2 特異性結合口袋。在方向性上，SirReal2 阻斷 SIRT2 去乙醯酶活性。它是神經退行性疾病和癌症中 SIRT2 生物學的關鍵化學探針，其選擇性使其在區分 SIRT2 特異性效應與更廣泛 sirtuin 家族時具有價值。由於 SIRT2 抑制在帕金森症和亨丁頓症模型中保護神經元，SirReal2 的選擇性使其定位為神經退行性疾病治療開發的候選骨架。

label: NSCLC cell lines and metastatic melanoma
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The level of SIRT2 is upregulated in non-small cell lung cancer cell lines and in metastatic human melanoma tissues compared to healthy cells and tissues. Directionally, SIRT2 expression is increased in these aggressive cancer contexts. In metastatic melanoma, SIRT2 levels are increased compared to tumours of early stage, suggesting involvement of SIRT2 in the advancement of metastatic disease. SIRT2 therefore represents a potential biomarker and drug target in NSCLC and metastatic melanoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2在非小細胞肺癌細胞系和轉移性人類黑色素瘤組織中與健康細胞和組織相比表現為上調。方向上，SIRT2表達在這些侵襲性癌症環境中增加。在轉移性黑色素瘤中，SIRT2水平與早期腫瘤相比增加，表明SIRT2參與了轉移性疾病的進展。因此SIRT2在NSCLC和轉移性黑色素瘤中代表了潛在的生物標誌物和藥物靶點。

label: CDC14B
description: The phosphatase CDC14B dephosphorylates SIRT2, triggering its ubiquitination and 26S proteasomal degradation, which promotes exit from mitosis. Directionally, CDC14B sits upstream of SIRT2 destabilization. This couples SIRT2 turnover to cell-cycle progression, and it ensures SIRT2 levels fall as cells complete division. By dephosphorylating SIRT2 at mitotic exit, CDC14B inactivates and degrades the enzyme that was active during G2/M. This regulatory circuit links SIRT2 abundance to the cell cycle and explains the oscillation of SIRT2 levels during division.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸酶 CDC14B 去磷酸化 SIRT2，觸發其泛素化和 26S 蛋白酶體降解，促進有絲分裂退出。在方向性上，CDC14B 位於 SIRT6 不穩定化的上游。這將 SIRT6 周轉與細胞週期進程偶聯，並確保 SIRT6 水平在細胞完成分裂時下降。透過在有絲分裂退出時去磷酸化 SIRT6，CDC14B 使在 G2/M 期間活化的酶失活並降解。此調控迴路將 SIRT6 豐度與細胞週期聯繫起來，並解釋了 SIRT6 水平在分裂過程中的振盪。

label: Hematopoietic stem cells
description: Leukemic clones derive from transformed hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells.
description_zh_TW: 白血病克隆源自於轉化的造血幹細胞或祖細胞。

label: Temozolomide
description: MGMT expression confers temozolomide resistance in a subset of GBM.
description_zh_TW: MGMT 表達在部分 GBM 中賦予 temozolomide 抗藥性。

label: Pyruvate Kinase M2
description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Pyruvate Kinase M2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Pyruvate kinase M2 is the embryonic/warburg isoform that diverts glycolytic flux toward biosynthetic precursors rather than efficient ATP production. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 Pyruvate Kinase M2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Pyruvate Kinase M2 是胚胎/warburg 亞型，它將糖解通量轉向生物合成前體而不是有效的 ATP 生產。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: Antiangiogenic therapy
description: RCC is treated with VEGF-pathway inhibitors (e.g., sunitinib) and mTOR inhibitors; chemotherapy is largely ineffective.
description_zh_TW: RCC 使用 VEGF 途徑抑制劑（例如 sunitinib）和 mTOR 抑制劑治療；化療基本上無效。

label: Microtubule inhibitors
description: Tubulin is the target of microtubule-interfering agents including benzimidazoles, taxanes and vinca alkaloids.
description_zh_TW: 微管蛋白是微管干擾藥物的靶標，包括苯並咪唑、紫杉烷和長春花生物鹼。

label: Irisin
description: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

label: SIRT3 for osteoprotection
description: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

label: Irisin via SIRT3
description: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease of tooth-supporting tissues driven by dysbiotic biofilm and host responses, with diabetes as a major risk modifier. In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin's SIRT3-dependent osteoprotection prevents alveolar bone resorption, identifying SIRT3 as a host-modulatory target.
description_zh_TW: 牙周炎是由失調的生物膜和宿主反應驅動的牙齒支持組織慢性發炎疾病，糖尿病是主要的風險修飾因子。在糖尿病牙周炎模型中，Irisin 的 SIRT3 依賴性骨保護防止牙槽骨吸收，將 SIRT3 識別為宿主調節靶標。

label: Periodontitis
description: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease of tooth-supporting tissues driven by dysbiotic biofilm and host responses, with diabetes as a major risk modifier. In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin's SIRT3-dependent osteoprotection prevents alveolar bone resorption, identifying SIRT3 as a host-modulatory target.
description_zh_TW: 牙周炎是由失調的生物膜和宿主反應驅動的牙齒支持組織慢性發炎疾病，糖尿病是主要的風險修飾因子。在糖尿病牙周炎模型中，Irisin 的 SIRT3 依賴性骨保護防止牙槽骨吸收，將 SIRT3 識別為宿主調節靶標。

label: Keshan disease
description: Selenium deficiency causes Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy found in selenium-poor regions, driven by insufficient cardiac glutathione peroxidase activity and consequent oxidant damage to myocardium. Affected hearts show necrosis and fibrosis with reduced antiviral and antioxidant defenses. The directionality is nutrient lack to enzyme failure to tissue injury. A caveat is that coxsackievirus infection interacts with the deficiency, so Keshan disease is not purely a selenium-deficiency disorder.
description_zh_TW: Selenium deficiency 會導致 Keshan disease，這是一種在 selenium 貧乏地區發現的地方性心肌病變，其原因是心臟 glutathione peroxidase 活性不足以及隨之而來的心肌氧化損傷。受影響的心臟顯示 necrosis 和 fibrosis 的抗病毒和抗氧化防禦能力降低。方向性是營養缺乏、酵素衰竭、組織損傷。需要注意的是，柯薩奇病毒感染與缺乏症相互作用，因此 Keshan disease 並不純粹是 selenium 缺乏症。

label: Selenium deficiency
description: Selenium deficiency causes Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy found in selenium-poor regions, driven by insufficient cardiac glutathione peroxidase activity and consequent oxidant damage to myocardium. Affected hearts show necrosis and fibrosis with reduced antiviral and antioxidant defenses. The directionality is nutrient lack to enzyme failure to tissue injury. A caveat is that coxsackievirus infection interacts with the deficiency, so Keshan disease is not purely a selenium-deficiency disorder.

label: Lipophagy
description: Lipophagy—the selective autophagic degradation of lipid droplets—is conserved across metazoans, as shown by the fact that inactivation of the autophagy genes lgg-1 and lgg-2 in C. elegans leads to increased fat accumulation. By delivering lipid droplets to lysosomes for lipase-mediated hydrolysis, lipophagy mobilizes stored energy during fasting. The conservation from worms to mammals indicates an ancient and essential role for autophagy in lipid homeostasis. Defective lipophagy contributes to hepatic steatosis and metabolic disease in higher organisms.
description_zh_TW: 脂噬——脂滴的選擇性自噬降解——在後生動物中保守，這由線蟲中自噬基因 lgg-1 和 lgg-2 的失活導致脂肪累積增加一事所證明。透過將脂滴遞送至溶酶體進行脂肪酶介導的水解，脂噬在禁食期間動員儲存的能量。從線蟲到哺乳動物的保守性表明，自噬在脂質恆定性中具有古老且必要的角色。缺陷的脂噬在高等生物中促成肝臟脂肪變性和代謝疾病。

label: Metazoans

The conservation from worms to mammals indicates an ancient and essential role for autophagy in lipid homeostasis. Defective lipophagy contributes to hepatic steatosis and metabolic disease in higher organisms.

label: SIRT3 via Nrf2
description: Liquiritigenin is a licorice-derived flavanone that induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models, mitigating oxidative stress injury and cell death.
description_zh_TW: Liquiritigenin 是源自甘草的黃烷酮，誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡，減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡。

label: LKB1 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Germline loss-of-function mutations in STK11 (LKB1) cause Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, characterized by hamartomatous polyps and elevated cancer risk. Directionally, LKB1 deficiency sits upstream of this cancer predisposition. This highlights LKB1 as a critical tumor suppressor and metabolic regulator, and its connection to AMPK and sirtuin axes explains the metabolic features of the syndrome. Because LKB1 loss compromises AMPK activation, cells fail to properly sense energy stress, promoting growth and genomic instability. The syndrome illustrates the clinical importance of the LKB1-AMPK-sirtuin network.
description_zh_TW: STK11（LKB1）的生殖系功能缺失突變導致 Peutz-Jeghers 綜合症，其特徵為錯構瘤性息肉和癌症風險增加。在方向性上，LKB1 缺陷位於此癌症易感性的上游。這突顯了 LKB1 作為關鍵腫瘤抑制因子和代謝調節因子的地位，其與 AMPK 和 sirtuin 軸線的聯繫解釋了該綜合症的代謝特徵。由於 LKB1 的缺失損害 AMPK 活化，細胞無法正確感知能量壓力，促進生長和基因組不穩定。該綜合症說明了 LKB1-AMPK-sirtuin 網絡的臨床重要性。

description: Serum SIRT3 distinguishes lung cancer patients from healthy individuals with an area under the curve of 0.918, an optimal cutoff value of 3.12, a sensitivity of 86.4%, and a specificity of 94%. Directionally, serum SIRT3 levels serve as a diagnostic biomarker for lung cancer. The high accuracy of SIRT3 in discriminating cancer patients supports its use as a blood-based marker for lung cancer screening or early detection, complementing SIRT expression differences observed between tumor and non-tumor lung tissue.
description_zh_TW: 血清SIRT3以0.918的曲線下面積、3.12的最佳截斷值、86.4%的靈敏度和94%的特異度區分肺癌患者與健康個體。方向上，血清SIRT3水平作為肺癌的診斷生物標誌物。SIRT3在區分癌症患者方面的高準確度支持其作為肺癌篩檢或早期偵測的血液標誌物的用途，補充了在腫瘤和非腫瘤肺組織之間觀察到的SIRT表達差異。

label: Lysosomal and autophagy genes
description: ZKSCAN3 is a zinc-finger transcription factor that represses the expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes, acting in opposition to TFEB/TFE3. Under basal conditions it limits autophagic and lysosomal capacity, and its inhibition or loss enhances cellular clearance. ZKSCAN3 thereby functions as a transcriptional brake on the degradative network, complementary to the post-translational repression by mTORC1. Targeting ZKSCAN3 has been proposed as a strategy to boost autophagy in disease.
description_zh_TW: ZKSCAN3 是一種鋅指轉錄因子，抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現，作用與 TFEB/TFE3 相反。在基礎條件下它限制自噬和溶酶體能力，其抑制或缺失則增強細胞清除。因此 ZKSCAN3 作為降解網絡的轉錄性制動，補充了 mTORC1 的轉譯後抑制。標靶 ZKSCAN3 已被提議作為在疾病中提升自噬的策略。

label: Male longevity beyond 90 years
description: A polymorphism in an intron-5 enhancer of the SIRT3 gene is associated with exceptional longevity, specifically survival beyond 90 years in men. The variant is thought to alter SIRT3 expression or regulation, conferring enhanced mitochondrial stress resistance and antioxidant capacity. Directionally, the genetic variation is associated with, and putatively causal of, prolonged lifespan. As a correlation it supports—but does not prove—that higher SIRT3 activity promotes human longevity, and it is consistent with separate findings linking SIRT3 single-nucleotide polymorphisms to longevity in other cohorts, including the TRELONG study, reinforcing SIRT3 as a candidate human longevity gene.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 基因內含子 5 增強子中的一個多態性與非凡長壽相關，具體為男性存活超過 90 年。該變異被認為改變 SIRT3 的表達或調節，賦予增強的粒線體壓力抗性和抗氧化能力。在方向性上，這種遺傳變異與延長的壽命相關，並推定為因果關係。作為相關性，它支持但並未證明更高的 SIRT3 活性促進人類長壽，與其他研究組（包括 TRELONG 研究）將 SIRT3 單核苷酸多態性與長壽聯繫起來的發現一致，強化了 SIRT3 作為人類長壽候選基因的地位。

label: Manganese
description: Manganese and Manganism are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Manganese and Manganism may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Manganese 和 Manganism 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Manganese 和 Manganism 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Th17 inflammatory profile
source_file: _document_ - Autophagy takes it all – autophagy inducers target immune aging.md
description: Metformin reverses the pro-inflammatory Th17 CD4+ T cell profile toward a more juvenile, balanced phenotype, an effect attributed to enhancement of autophagic flux within lymphocytes. By activating AMPK and inducing autophagy, metformin reduces the mitochondrial and metabolic perturbations that favor pathogenic Th17 differentiation. This phenotypic rebalancing may contribute to the drug's anti-inflammatory and immune-modulatory benefits beyond glycemic control. The observation links metformin's autophagy-inducing capacity to attenuation of age- and inflammation-associated T cell skewing.
description_zh_TW: Metformin 將促發炎的 Th17 CD4+ T 細胞譜系逆轉為更年輕、平衡的表型，此效應歸因於淋巴細胞內自噬流的增強。透過活化 AMPK 和誘導自噬，metformin 減少有利於致病性 Th17 分化的粒線體和代謝擾動。這種表型再平衡可能有助於該藥物超越血糖控制之外的抗發炎和免疫調節益處。此觀察將 metformin 誘導自噬的能力與減緩年齡和發炎相關的 T 細胞偏移聯繫起來。

label: Intracellular and extracellular signals
description: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway integrates a wide array of intracellular and extracellular cues—including growth factors, insulin, amino acids, oxygen, and energy status—to coordinate cell growth, metabolism, proliferation, and survival. Through its two complexes, mTORC1 and mTORC2, it translates these inputs into decisions about biosynthesis versus catabolism, notably by inhibiting autophagy when resources are abundant. This central integrator role makes mTOR a nodal control point for physiology and a target for cancer, aging, and metabolic disease. Its dysregulation is implicated in nearly every major chronic disease.
description_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素機械性標靶（mTOR）途徑整合了廣泛的細胞內與細胞外線索——包括生長因子、胰島素、胺基酸、氧氣和能量狀態——以協調細胞生長、代謝、增殖與存活。透過其兩個複合物 mTORC1 和 mTORC2，它將這些輸入轉化為關於生物合成與分解代謝的決策，特別是在資源充裕時抑制自噬。這種核心整合者角色使 mTOR 成為生理學的節點控制點，以及癌症、老化和代謝疾病的標靶。其失調與幾乎每一種主要慢性疾病都有關聯。

label: Low-level oxidative stress
description: Low-level oxidative stress activates mitohormesis, a beneficial adaptive response in which transient ROS upregulate DNA repair, antioxidant defenses, and autophagy to improve resilience. This explains the paradoxical benefits of mild mitochondrial stress. The directionality is mild oxidant to adaptive reprogramming. A caveat is that the benefit is strictly dose-dependent; higher oxidative stress overwhelms the response and becomes damaging, the classic hormetic inverted-U. Exercise, caloric restriction, and some phytochemicals harness mitohormesis to improve metabolic and neurological health.
description_zh_TW: Low-level oxidative stress 活化 mitohormesis，這是一種有益的適應性反應，其中短暫的 ROS 上調 DNA 修復、抗氧化防禦和自噬，以提高恢復能力。這解釋了輕度 mitochondria1 壓力的矛盾好處。方向性是適應性重編程的溫和氧化劑。需要注意的是，其益處嚴格依賴劑量。更高的 oxidative stress 壓倒了反應並成為 damaging，經典的毒效劑倒 U 型。運動、熱量限制和一些植物化學物質利用 mitohormesis 來改善代謝和神經系統健康。

label: Endogenous Antioxidant Upregulation
description: Exogenous antioxidants prevent the upregulation of endogenous defense enzymes (SOD, GPx) that exercise normally induces via NRF2. The Ristow 2009 study showed antioxidant-supplemented subjects failed to upregulate endogenous SOD/GPx and lost the insulin-sensitizing benefit of exercise.
description_zh_TW: 外源性抗氧化劑防止運動通常經由 NRF2 誘發的內生防禦酵素（SOD、GPx）上調。Ristow 2009 研究顯示補充抗氧化劑的受試者未能上調內生 SOD/GPx，並喪失運動的胰島素增敏益處。

label: Hyperfunction Theory of Aging
description: The hyperfunction theory of aging holds that aging is the quasi-programmed continuation of developmental growth signaling; mTOR is the engine of aging and Rapamycin extends lifespan by suppressing mTOR. This frames the key distinction that arrested growth (OIS) is protective while ongoing, unopposed growth signaling is pathogenic.
description_zh_TW: 老化的功能亢進理論主張，老化是發育生長訊號的準程式化延續；mTOR 是老化的引擎，而 Rapamycin 透過抑制 mTOR 延長壽命。這框定了關鍵區分：停滯的生長（OIS）具保護性，而持續、無對抗的生長訊號具致病性。

label: Integrated Stress Response
description: A major advance in mitohormesis research was the discovery that diverse mitochondrial stressors activate the ISR. The pathway is initiated when mitochondrial stress activates the OMA1 protease, which cleaves DELE1 to generate a cytosolic fragment (DELE1-S) that binds and activates HRI, one of the four eIF2alpha kinases. HRI then phosphorylates the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha, reducing global protein synthesis while allowing preferential translation of ATF4. This mitochondrial-ISR connection establishes a defined signaling axis by which mild mitochondrial dysfunction produces a protective transcriptional and metabolic response characteristic of mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應研究的一個重大進展是發現多種粒線體壓力源會活化整合壓力反應（ISR）。該途徑在粒線體壓力活化 OMA1 蛋白酶時啟動，OMA1 切割 DELE1 產生細胞質片段（DELE1-S），後者結合並活化 HRI（四個 eIF2alpha 激酶之一）。HRI 隨後磷酸化翻譯起始因子 eIF2alpha，減少整體蛋白質合成，同時允許 ATF4 的優先翻譯。這種粒線體-ISR 連結建立了一個明確的訊號軸，透過該軸，輕度粒線體功能障礙產生具有粒線體促效應特徵的保護性轉錄和代謝反應。

label: MTHFD2
description: Analysis of mice expressing a mutant mitochondrial helicase Twinkle, which develop progressive respiratory chain dysfunction and COX-deficient fibers in skeletal muscle, revealed coordinated induction of metabolic genes including MTHFD2, a mitochondrial one-carbon enzyme highly expressed during development and in tumors but normally low in adult tissues. This induction depended on a conserved amino acid response element (AARE) in the proximal promoter that binds C/EBP and ATF family transcription factors. MTHFD2 induction links mitochondrial dysfunction to serine-driven one-carbon and folate metabolism supporting purine and thymidine synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 對表達突變粒線體解旋酶 Twinkle 的小鼠的分析（這些小鼠會發展出進行性呼吸鏈功能障礙和骨骼肌中 COX 缺陷的纖維）顯示，包括 MTHFD2 在內的代謝基因被協調誘導，MTHFD2 是一種粒線體一碳酶，在發育和腫瘤中高表達，但在成人組織中通常低表達。這種誘導依賴於啟動子近端中保守的胺基酸反應元件（AARE），AARE 結合 C/EBP 和 ATF 家族轉錄因子。MTHFD2 誘導將粒線體功能障礙與絲氨酸驅動的一碳和葉酸代謝相連結，支持嘌呤和胸苷的合成。

label: Pathogen Infection
description: Bacteria secrete a wide array of diffusible proteinaceous toxins to fend off competing bacterial species, and a survey of over 500 bacterial species suggests a significant fraction secrete factors that influence host mitochondrial function. In organisms such as C. elegans, this mitochondrial dysfunction is sensed at least in part by the UPRmt, which activates a stress-induced pathway necessary for host defense. Widely used antibiotics like tetracyclines impose a low level of mitochondrial stress on eukaryotic cells, suggesting that hormetic mitochondrial stress responses can be employed for therapeutic benefit in pathogen challenge.
description_zh_TW: 細菌分泌各種各樣的可擴散蛋白質毒素來抵禦競爭的細菌物種，對超過 500 種細菌物種的調查表明，很大一部分分泌影響宿主粒線體功能的因子。在 C. elegans 等生物體中，這種粒線體功能障礙至少部分由 UPRmt 感知，UPRmt 活化宿主防禦所必需的壓力誘導途徑。廣泛使用的抗生素如四環素類對真核細胞施加低水平的粒線體壓力，表明促效應粒線體壓力反應可用於病原體挑戰中的治療益處。

label: GDF15
description: GDF15, a member of the transforming growth factor beta superfamily, was identified as a mammalian mitokine using mice with skeletal muscle-specific deficiency of Crif1, a mitoribosomal subunit protein, and confirmed through muscle-specific expression of uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1). In both cases mitochondrial perturbation in skeletal muscle raised circulating GDF15, which triggered metabolic alterations in distal tissues including regulation of body fat mass and reversal of hepatic steatosis. GDF15 secretion is downstream of the ISR, and metformin-induced weight loss in patients is dependent on a several-fold rise in serum GDF15.
description_zh_TW: GDF15 是轉化生長因子 beta 超家族的成員，透過使用具有骨骼肌特異性 Crif1（粒線體核糖體亞基蛋白）缺陷的小鼠，被確認為哺乳動物粒線體因子，並透過肌肉特異性 uncoupling protein 1（UCP1）的表達得到證實。在這兩種情況下，骨骼肌中的粒線體擾動都提高了循環 GDF15，觸發遠端組織的代謝改變，包括調節體脂量和逆轉肝脂肪變性。GDF15 分泌在 ISR 的下游，而 metformin 誘導的患者體重減輕依賴於血清 GDF15 的數倍升高。

label: HSF1
description: In yeast, accumulation of mitochondrial precursor proteins in the cytosol initially triggers activation of the transcription factor HSF1, an ancient regulator of chaperone expression. HSF1 subsequently activates RPN4, a short-lived protein that directly interacts with the proteasome and regulates expression of multiple proteasomal subunits, as well as the transcription factor PDR3. This mitoprotein-induced stress response increases cytosolic chaperone activity, augments the ubiquitin-proteasome system, and clears proteins clogging the mitochondrial translocase, while OXPHOS machinery repression occurs independently of the HSF1-RPN4-PDR3 axis.
description_zh_TW: 在酵母中，粒線體前體蛋白在細胞質中的積累最初觸發轉錄因子 HSF1 的活化，HSF1 是分子伴護表達的古老調節因子。HSF1 隨後活化 RPN4，RPN4 是一種短壽命蛋白，直接與蛋白酶體相互作用並調節多個蛋白酶體亞基的表達，以及轉錄因子 PDR3。這種粒線體蛋白誘導的壓力反應增加細胞質分子伴護活性，增強泛素-蛋白酶體系統，並清除阻塞粒線體轉位酶的蛋白質，而 OXPHOS 機制的抑制獨立於 HSF1-RPN4-PDR3 軸發生。

label: Respiratory Chain Complex I
description: Metformin is believed to exert its anti-diabetic effects through inhibition of complex I of the mitochondrial respiratory chain, a mild perturbation of mitochondrial function that may generate a hormetic (mitohormetic) signal. In mice and lower organisms, metformin treatment induces increased oxidant defenses and extends lifespan, suggesting that gentle inhibition of mitochondrial function can trigger beneficial adaptive stress responses. This positions metformin as a potential prototype for drugs that exploit mitohormesis to treat age-related disease.
description_zh_TW: Metformin被認為通過抑制粒線體呼吸鏈的複合物I來發揮其抗糖尿病作用，這是對粒線體功能的輕微干擾，可能產生hormetic（mitohormetic）信號。在小鼠和低等生物中，metformin治療誘導氧化防禦增加並延長壽命，表明輕度抑制粒線體功能可以觸發有益的適應性壓力反應。這使得metformin成為利用mitohormesis治療與年齡相關疾病的藥物潛在原型。

label: Methionine Restriction
description: Methionine restriction extends lifespan in many species and, when initiated early or late in life, reduces body weight, increases lean mass, improves mitochondrial function and lipid metabolism, and reduces frailty in rodents. The metabolic response is partially dependent on FGF21 and also inhibits mTORC1. Methionine is the precursor of S-adenosyl-L-methionine, the universal methyl donor, so methionine deprivation may act through changes in histone methylation due to decreased methyl-donor availability. In humans, sulfur amino acid restriction increased FGF21, reduced leptin, and reduced body weight, and strict vegan diets reduce blood methionine and improve glucose homeostasis. Most methionine restriction studies require cysteine depletion for the metabolic benefits to manifest.
description_zh_TW: Methionine限制延長許多物種的壽命，無論是在生命早期還是晚期開始，都能減輕體重、增加瘦肉量、改善粒線體功能和脂質代謝，並減少囓齒類動物的虛弱。這種代謝反應部分依賴於FGF21，並且也抑制mTORC1。Methionine是S-adenosyl-L-methionine的前體，後者是通用的甲基供體，因此methionine缺乏可能通過甲基供體可用性減少導致的組蛋白甲基化變化來发挥作用。在人類中，硫氨基酸限制增加了FGF21，減少了瘦素，並減輕了體重，而嚴格的純素飲食降低了血液甲基丙氨酸並改善了葡萄糖穩態。大多數methionine限制研究需要半胱氨酸耗竭才能顯現代謝益處。

label: Redox Homeostasis
description: Perturbation of mitochondrial function can trigger cellular responses that seek to restore cellular metabolism, cytosolic proteostasis, and redox homeostasis, and in some cases these responses persist even after the stress is relieved, leaving the cell or tissue in a less vulnerable state. Mitochondrial ROS production, in addition to the ISR and ATF4, provides further signals in yeast, where oxidation of cysteine thiols and methionine residues in translation machinery proteins initiates phase separation of critical regulatory proteins to attenuate global protein synthesis, and cells sense extracellular matrix stiffness through a mitochondrial ROS and HSF1-dependent response that ultimately restores redox homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體功能的擾動可觸發尋求恢復細胞代謝、細胞質蛋白質體恆定性和氧化還原恆定性的細胞反應，在某些情況下，這些反應即使在壓力解除後仍然持續，使細胞或組織處於較不易受損的狀態。除了 ISR 和 ATF4 外，粒線體 ROS 產生在酵母中提供了進一步的訊號，其中翻譯機器蛋白中半胱氨酸硫醇和甲硫氨酸殘基的氧化，啟動關鍵調節蛋白的相分離，以減弱整體蛋白質合成，細胞透過粒線體 ROS 和 HSF1 依賴性反應感知細胞外基質 stiffness，最終恢復氧化還原恆定性。

label: Mitochondrial protein import
description: The emerging theme from many studies is that protein import or processing is used as a readout of mitochondrial health and a signal to induce a hormetic response. Nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins enter through the TOM complex aided by cytosolic chaperones including HSP70 and HSP90, and impaired import can trigger quality control pathways such as mitoTAD, mitoCPR, and mitoRQC that extract, ubiquitinate, and degrade stalled precursor proteins via the proteasome, in a process coordinated by transcription factors HSF1, RPN4, and PDR3 in yeast. In mammals, defects in mitochondrial protein import can produce both protein and metabolic disruption, for instance non-imported citrate synthase functioning in the cytosol.
description_zh_TW: 許多研究的新興主題是，蛋白質輸入或加工被用作粒線體健康的讀數和誘導促效應反應的訊號。核編碼的粒線體蛋白透過 TOM 複合體進入，輔以包括 HSP70 和 HSP90 在內的細胞質分子伴護，受損的輸入可觸發品質控制途徑如 mitoTAD、mitoCPR 和 mitoRQC，這些途徑提取、泛素化並透過蛋白酶體降解停滯的前體蛋白，此過程在酵母中由轉錄因子 HSF1、RPN4 和 PDR3 協調。在哺乳動物中，粒線體蛋白輸入的缺陷可同時產生蛋白質和代謝紊亂，例如未輸入的檸檬酸合酶在細胞質中發揮功能。

label: MAP4K3
description: MAP4K3 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 3, an N-terminal modification that primes TFEB for subsequent phosphorylation at S211 by mTORC1. This hierarchical phosphorylation reveals that TFEB regulation involves ordered, multi-site modification in which upstream kinases license downstream ones. By enabling the mTORC1 repressive mark, MAP4K3 integrates amino-acid and growth-factor inputs into TFEB control. The finding adds a further layer of complexity to the kinase network governing lysosomal gene transcription.
description_zh_TW: MAP4K3 於 serine 3 磷酸化 TFEB，這是一種使 TFEB 為後續 mTORC1 在 S211 的磷酸化做準備的 N 端修飾。這種階層性磷酸化顯示 TFEB 調節涉及有序的多位點修飾，其中上游激酶許可下游激酶。透過啟用 mTORC1 抑制性標記，MAP4K3 將胺基酸和生長因子輸入整合進 TFEB 控制中。此發現為控制溶酶體基因轉錄的激酶網絡增添了進一步的複雜層次。

label: Matrine
description: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.
description_zh_TW: Matrine 是來自苦參的喹諾里西啶生物鹼。它透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，並透過 SIRT3/AMPK 途徑賦予心血管益處，維護心肌細胞存活率並限制細胞死亡。

label: UUO-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis
description: The SIRT6 activator MDL-800 mitigates unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO)-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis, validating SIRT6 activation therapeutically. Directionally, MDL-800 activates SIRT6, which protects the kidney. This complements other evidence that SIRT6 restrains TGF-β/Smad3 fibrogenesis and NF-κB-mediated inflammation. It supports SIRT6 as a target for chronic kidney disease, where tubulointerstitial fibrosis determines outcome. The efficacy of a pharmacologic SIRT6 activator in a standard fibrosis model provides important proof-of-concept for SIRT6-based therapies in renal and fibrotic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 活化因子 MDL-800 減輕單側輸尿管阻塞（UUO）誘導的腎小管間質發炎和纖維化，在治療上驗證了 SIRT6 活化。在方向性上，MDL-800 活化 SIRT6，SIRT6 保護腎臟。這與 SIRT6 限制 TGF-β/Smad3 纖維化和 NF-κB 介導發炎的其他證據互補。它支持 SIRT6 作為慢性腎病的靶點，在該疾病中小管間質纖維化決定預後。藥理性 SIRT6 活化因子在標準纖維化模型中的療效為基於 SIRT6 的腎臟和纖維化疾病療法提供了重要的概念驗證。

label: Melatonin in DCM
description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

label: PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis
description: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

label: Methionine sulfoxide reductases
description: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
description_zh_TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

label: methylation efficiency
description: MTHFD1 mutations can impact methylation efficiency similarly to MTHFR variants by limiting the flux of folate derivatives needed to generate 5-methyl-THF and SAMe, the methyl donor for COMT. Although less studied than MTHFR, loss-of-function changes in MTHFD1 can raise homocysteine and reduce methyl donor capacity, constraining catechol O-methylation. The effect indirectly burdens COMT by limiting its SAMe supply and can compound with other one-carbon pathway variants. MTHFD1 is therefore relevant to methylation-focused genetics and personalized medicine.
description_zh_TW: 與 MTHFR variants 類似，MTHFD1 mutations 可以透過限制生成 5-甲基-THF 和 SAMe（COMT 的 methyl donor）所需的 folate 衍生物的通量來影響 methylation efficiency。儘管比 MTHFR 研究較少，但 MTHFD1 的功能喪失變化可以提高同型半胱氨酸並降低 methyl donor 的容量，從而限制兒茶酚 O-甲基化。此效應透過限制 SAMe 的供應而間接加重 COMT 的負擔，並且可以與其他單碳途徑變體複合。因此，MTHFD1 與以甲基化為中心的遺傳學和個人化醫療相關。

label: MHY2245
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: MHY2245, a new SIRT1 inhibitor, exerts antitumor activity against ovarian cancer cells by blocking the pyruvate kinase M2/mTOR pathway. Directionally, MHY2245 sits upstream of suppressed PKM2/mTOR signaling and reduced ovarian cancer cell survival. By inhibiting SIRT1 and consequently the PKM2/mTOR pathway, MHY2245 curbs tumor-cell metabolism and growth. This supports SIRT1 inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in ovarian cancer, where SIRT1 inhibition of HMGB1 also suppresses metastasis and angiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: MHY2245是一種新型SIRT1抑制劑，透過阻斷丙酮酸激酶M2/mTOR通路對卵巢癌細胞發揮抗腫瘤活性。方向上，MHY2245位於PKM2/mTOR訊號抑制和卵巢癌細胞存活降低的上游。透過抑制SIRT1及隨後的PKM2/mTOR通路，MHY2245限制腫瘤細胞的代謝和生長。這支持SIRT1抑制作為卵巢癌的治療策略，其中SIRT1對HMGB1的抑制也抑制了轉移和血管新生。

label: Microfluidic mobility shift assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The microfluidic mobility shift assay separates SIRT1 substrate and product peptides by differences in electrophoretic mobility caused by charge and mass changes upon lysine deacetylation, quantitating fluorescence of both peaks. The assay effectively separates neutral-acetylated substrate peptides from deacetylated products bearing an additional positive charge. Although it could support high-throughput screening, it is more suitable for hit confirmation and mechanistic studies. Directionally, it provides a label-based yet artifact-minimized readout of SIRT1 activity distinct from fluorophore-release assays.
description_zh_TW: 微流體遷移率位移測定透過離胺酸去乙醯化引起的電荷和質量變化所導致的電泳遷移率差異來分離 SIRT1 受質和產物胜肽，量化兩個峰的螢光。該測定有效地將中性乙醯化受質胜肽與帶有額外正電荷的去乙醯化產物分開。儘管它可用於高通量篩選，但更適合用於命中確認和機制研究。方向性上它提供了一種基於標記但假象最小化的 SIRT1 活性讀取方式，與螢光基團釋放測定不同。

label: Mitosis (G2/M phase)
description: SIRT2 protein levels rise dramatically as cells enter mitosis, and the enzyme is hyperphosphorylated at the G2/M boundary, timing its activity to chromosome condensation and division. This cell-cycle coupling links SIRT2 to proper mitotic progression and genomic stability, with the enzyme regulating both tubulin dynamics and chromatin state during division. Directionally, the G2/M transition drives SIRT2 upregulation and activation, and at mitotic exit the phosphatase CDC14B dephosphorylates SIRT2 to trigger its degradation. Loss or dysregulation of this mitotic peak is associated with aneuploidy, mitotic defects, and, in some cancers, genomic instability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 蛋白水平在細胞進入有絲分裂時急劇上升，該酶在 G2/M 邊界處被超磷酸化，將其活性時間定在染色體凝縮和分裂時。這種細胞週期偶聯將 SIRT2 與正確的有絲分裂進展和基因組穩定性聯繫起來，該酶在分裂期間同時調節微管動態和染色質狀態。在方向性上，G2/M 轉變驅動 SIRT2 上調和活化，在有絲分裂退出時磷酸酶 CDC14B 去磷酸化 SIRT2 以觸發其降解。此有絲分裂高峰的缺失或失調與非整倍性、有絲分裂缺陷以及某些癌症中的基因組不穩定性相關。

label: G→T transversions
description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine causes G to T transversions because the oxidized base pairs promiscuously with adenine during replication, so a G:C pair becomes an A:T pair after a round of replication and repair. These transversions are signature mutations in many cancers. The directionality is miscoding lesion to mutagenic outcome. A caveat is that accurate repair by OGG1 before replication averts most mutations, so only unrepaired lesions are mutagenic. G to T transversions are among the most frequent mutations found in oncogenes and tumor suppressors in human cancers, underscoring the relevance of this lesion.
description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 會導致 G 到 T 顛換，因為複製過程中氧化鹼基與腺嘌呤混雜配對，因此 G:C 對經過一輪複製和修復後變成 A:T 對。這些顛換是許多 cancer 的特徵突變。方向性是將病變錯誤編碼為誘變結果。需要注意的是，複製前透過 OGG1 進行的精確修復可以避免大多數突變，因此只有未修復的損傷才具有突變性。 G 至 T 顛換是人類 cancer 癌基因和腫瘤抑制基因中最常見的突變之一，強調了這種病變的相關性。

label: F2-Isoprostanes
description: F2-isoprostanes are the gold-standard biomarker for oxidative stress, formed non-enzymatically by free-radical peroxidation of arachidonic acid into prostaglandin-like compounds. They are measured in urine and plasma and are remarkably stable. The directionality is lipid peroxidation to isoprostane formation. A caveat is that isoprostanes can also arise from cyclooxygenase-independent enzymatic routes in rare cases, and levels are influenced by diet and renal function. Their measurement has become the reference standard for evaluating antioxidant efficacy in human intervention trials.
description_zh_TW: F2-isoprostanes 是 oxidative stress 的黃金標準生物標記物，由花生四烯酸自由基過氧化成 prostaglandin 樣化合物，以非酵素方式形成。它們在尿液和血漿中進行測量，並且非常穩定。方向性是lipid peroxidation至isoprostane形成。需要注意的是，在極少數情況下，isoprostanes 也可能由不依賴環氧合酶的酵素途徑產生，且其水平受到飲食和腎功能的影響。他們的測量結果已成為評估人類幹預試驗中抗氧化功效的參考標準。

label: NQO1
description: NQO1 (NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1, also called DT-diaphorase) performs a safe two-electron reduction of quinones to stable hydroquinones, bypassing the dangerous semiquinone intermediate. Healthy cells use this enzyme, together with GSTM2, to defend against aminochrome-induced toxicity. Because two-electron reduction prevents formation of reactive semiquinone radicals, NQO1 is a critical gatekeeper determining whether a quinone such as adrenochrome becomes a benign hydroquinone or a source of oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: NQO1（NAD(P)H:醌氧化還原酶1，也稱DT-心肌黃酶）執行對醌的安全雙電子還原為穩定的氫醌，繞過危險的半醌中間體。健康細胞使用此酶，連同GSTM2，來防禦氨基色素誘導的毒性。由於雙電子還原防止活性半醌自由基的形成，NQO1是決定醌如腎上腺素色素成為良性氫醌還是氧化應激來源的關鍵守門員。

label: OGG1
description: OGG1 repairs 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine as a bifunctional DNA glycosylase that excises the damaged base and cleaves the backbone, initiating base-excision repair that liberates free 8-oxodG. This prevents the lesion from mispairing with adenine during replication. The directionality is lesion to repair pathway. A caveat is that OGG1's role in processing 8-oxodG is most critical in nuclear DNA, while mitochondrial isoforms handle mtDNA damage with somewhat different kinetics. OGG1 also releases the free 8-oxodG into urine, which is why urinary levels of the lesion report both damage and active repair.
description_zh_TW: OGG1 作為雙功能 DNA 糖基化酶修復 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine，切除受損鹼基並切割主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復，釋放遊離 8-oxodG。這可以防止複製過程中病變與腺嘌呤錯配。方向性是損傷修復途徑。需要注意的是，OGG1 在核子 DNA 中處理 8-oxodG 的作用最為關鍵，而 mitochondria1 亞型以有些不同的動力學處理 mtDNA damage。 OGG1 也將遊離的 8-oxodG 釋放到尿液中，這就是為什麼病變的尿液水平報告損傷和主動修復的原因。

label: Oligodendrocytes
description: Oligodendrocytes are vulnerable to oxidative stress because they contain high iron, relatively low glutathione, and high ATP demand to support myelination, making them sensitive to ROS. Their damage contributes to demyelination in MS and other disorders. The directionality is oxidant burden to oligodendrocyte injury. A caveat is that oxidative vulnerability interacts with metabolic, inflammatory, and energetic stresses, so it is a contributor rather than the sole determinant of oligodendrocyte loss.
description_zh_TW: Oligodendrocytes 容易受到 oxidative stress 的影響，因為它們含有較高的 iron、相對較低的 glutathione，以及支持髓鞘形成的高 ATP 需求，使它們對 ROS 敏感。它們的損害會導致多發性硬化症和其他疾病的脫髓鞘。方向性是少突膠質細胞損傷的氧化負擔。需要注意的是，氧化脆弱性與代謝、發炎和能量壓力相互作用，因此它是少突膠質細胞損失的因素，而不是唯一的決定因素。

label: GSK-3beta
description: Oxidative stress activates GSK-3beta among other kinases, and the resulting hyperphosphorylation of tau promotes its dissociation from microtubules and aggregation. GSK-3beta is normally restrained by Akt but is released under oxidative and inflammatory conditions. The directionality is oxidant to kinase activation to tau modification. A caveat is that GSK-3beta has many substrates beyond tau, and its activity is regulated by phosphorylation independent of ROS. Because GSK-3beta is a central node in tau pathology, redox-driven kinase activation is considered an early event in Alzheimer's disease progression.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 活化其他激酶中的 GSK-3beta，由此產生的 tau 過度磷酸化促進其從微管解離和聚集。 GSK-3beta 通常受 Akt 抑制，但在氧化和發炎條件下釋放。方向性是氧化劑對激酶活化對tau修飾。需要注意的是，GSK-3beta 除了 tau 之外還有許多底物，且其活性受到磷酸化的調節，與 ROS 無關。由於 GSK-3beta 是 tau 病理學的中心節點，氧化還原驅動的激酶活化被認為是阿茲海默症進展的早期事件。

label: NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription
description: Oxidative stress activates NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription, as ROS activate the transcription factor to bind kappaB response elements in the VCAM-1 promoter. Elevated VCAM-1 then promotes leukocyte adhesion to endothelium. The directionality is oxidant to NF-kappaB to adhesion-molecule expression. A caveat is that many cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta) also induce VCAM-1, so ROS is one of several upstream activators. VCAM-1 upregulation is a key early step in atherogenesis, and its redox-sensitive induction links oxidative stress to leukocyte infiltration.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 活化 NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription，因為 ROS 活化轉錄因子以結合 VCAM-1 啟動子中的 kappaB 反應元件。升高的 VCAM-1 會促進白血球與內皮細胞的黏附。 NF-κB 的方向性對黏附分子的表達具有氧化作用。需要注意的是，許多細胞激素（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta）也會誘導 VCAM-1，因此 ROS 是幾個上游活化劑之一。 VCAM-1 上調是動脈粥狀硬化形成的關鍵早期步驟，其氧化還原敏感誘導將 oxidative stress 與白血球浸潤聯繫起來。

label: Asthma severity
description: Oxidative stress correlates with asthma severity, with greater oxidant burden tracking with worse symptoms and higher exacerbation frequency. Biomarkers of lipid and protein oxidation rise during acute attacks. The directionality is oxidant load to clinical severity. A caveat is that correlation does not establish direction; severe asthma may also generate more ROS via eosinophil and NOX activity. These observations support the use of redox biomarkers in monitoring asthma control and evaluating antioxidant-based therapies.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 與 asthma severity 相關，氧化負荷追蹤更大，症狀更嚴重，惡化頻率更高。在急性發作期間，脂質和蛋白質氧化的生物標記會升高。方向性是氧化負荷與臨床嚴重程度的關係。需要注意的是，相關性並不能確定方向；嚴重的asthma也可能透過嗜酸性粒細胞和NOX活性產生更多的ROS。這些觀察結果支持使用氧化還原生物標記物來監測 asthma 控制和評估基於抗氧化劑的療法。

label: Redox Imbalance
description: Oxidative stress is a redox imbalance in which reactive oxygen (and nitrogen) species production exceeds the capacity to detoxify them or repair the resulting damage. This definition frames oxidative stress as a dynamic disequilibrium rather than a single molecule. The directionality is imbalance between oxidants and defenses. A caveat is that transient oxidative shifts are physiological signaling events, so 'stress' specifically denotes sustained or excessive imbalance. This framing emphasizes that redox biology is bidirectional and that the severity of stress is determined by the balance of generation, defense, and repair.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 是一種 redox imbalance，其中活性氧（和氮）物質的產生超過了其解毒或修復所造成損害的能力。這個定義將 oxidative stress 視為動態不平衡而不是單一分子。方向性是氧化劑和防禦之間的不平衡。需要注意的是，短暫的氧化轉變是生理訊號事件，因此「壓力」特別指持續或過度的不平衡。這個框架強調氧化還原生物學是雙向的，壓力的嚴重程度由生成、防禦和修復的平衡決定。

label: Protein Citrullination
description: Oxidative stress promotes protein citrullination by increasing intracellular calcium, which activates peptidylarginine deiminase (PAD) enzymes that convert arginine to citrulline. Citrullinated proteins become autoantigens in rheumatoid arthritis. The directionality is oxidant to calcium influx to PAD activation. A caveat is that PAD enzymes are also regulated by other factors (pH, NO), so ROS is a contributor rather than the only trigger of citrullination. Citrullinated peptides are recognized by anti-citrullinated protein antibodies, a hallmark of rheumatoid arthritis, linking oxidative stress to autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 透過增加細胞內鈣來促進 protein citrullination，從而活化肽基精氨酸脫亞胺酶 (PAD)，將精氨酸轉化為瓜氨酸。瓜氨酸 proteins 成為類風濕性關節炎的自身抗原。方向性是氧化劑鈣流入 PAD 活化。需要注意的是，PAD 酶也受到其他因素（pH、NO）的調節，因此 ROS 是瓜氨酸化的一個貢獻者，而不是唯一的觸發因素。瓜氨酸肽可被抗瓜氨酸蛋白抗體識別，這是類風濕性關節炎的標誌，將 oxidative stress 與自體免疫聯繫起來。

label: Polyunsaturated fatty acids
description: Polyunsaturated fatty acids are susceptible to oxidative stress because their bis-allylic methylene groups have relatively weak C-H bonds that are easily abstracted by radicals, seeding lipid peroxidation. The more double bonds, the higher the peroxidation index. The directionality is PUFA structure to peroxidation propensity. A caveat is that some PUFAs (e.g., omega-3) are beneficial despite higher oxidizability, as their oxidation products can be anti-inflammatory, so susceptibility is not uniformly harmful.
description_zh_TW: Polyunsaturated fatty acids 很容易受到 oxidative stress 的影響，因為它們的雙烯丙基亞甲基具有相對較弱的 C-H 鍵，很容易被自由基奪去，形成 lipid peroxidation。雙鍵越多，過氧化指數越高。方向性是PUFA結構對過氧化傾向的影響。需要注意的是，一些多元不飽和脂肪酸（例如 omega-3）儘管氧化性較高，但仍然有益，因為它們的氧化產物具有抗發炎作用，因此易感性並不都是有害的。

label: Electron Transport Chain
description: Silver nanoparticles are believed to disrupt the mitochondrial respiratory chain, causing oxidative stress, reduced ATP synthesis, and DNA damage. The mitochondrial electron transport chain is the major source of cellular energy, and its disruption collapses oxidative phosphorylation and elevates reactive oxygen production. This nanoparticle-specific toxicity is attributed to sustained release of silver ions and direct interaction with respiratory complexes, distinguishing it from the bulk-metal effects of larger silver particles.
description_zh_TW: 相信銀奈米粒子會干擾粒線體呼吸鏈，導致氧化應激、ATP合成減少和DNA損傷。粒線體電子傳遞鏈是細胞能量的主要來源，其干擾會使氧化磷酸化崩潰並增加活性氧產生。此奈米粒子特異性毒性歸因於銀離子的持續釋放和與呼吸複合物的直接相互作用，區別於較大銀粒子的塊狀金屬效應。

label: MPC
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) links glycolysis-derived pyruvate to the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and its expression increases across multiple senescence models including irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative senescence. Pharmacological inhibition of MPC with UK5099 reduces TCA cycle intermediates and increases lactate levels, consistent with impaired mitochondrial pyruvate import, and suppresses SASP gene expression and secretion without affecting cell cycle arrest. CRISPR-Cas9-mediated deletion of MPC1 similarly reduces SASP factors such as IL6 and IL8, identifying pyruvate import as the entry node of the mitochondrial metabolic axis controlling the SASP.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體丙酮酸載體（MPC）將糖酵解產生的丙酮酸連結至三羧酸循環，其表達在多種衰老模型中增加，包括輻射誘導、doxorubicin誘導和複製性衰老。用UK5099對MPC進行藥理學抑制可降低三羧酸循環中間體並增加乳酸水平，符合粒線體丙酮酸輸入受損的特徵，並抑制SASP基因表達和分泌，而不影響細胞週期停滯。CRISPR-Cas9介導的MPC1缺失同樣減少SASP因子如IL6和IL8，確認丙酮酸輸入是控制SASP的粒線體代謝軸的進入節點。

source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

label: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
community_name: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Mice lacking PGC-1α are markedly more sensitive to neuronal loss induced by MPTP, a dopaminergic toxin, and kainic acid, an excitotoxin, revealing PGC-1αs role in neuronal stress resistance. Because SIRT1 activates PGC-1α by deacetylation, this sensitivity indirectly implicates the SIRT1/PGC-1α axis in neuroprotection. Directionally, PGC-1α deficiency heightens vulnerability to these insults, while its activation confers resistance. Since PGC-1α drives mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant gene expression, protecting neurons through this axis is a proposed strategy against Parkinsons disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
description_zh_TW: 缺乏 PGC-1α 的小鼠對 MPTP（多巴胺能毒素）和 kainic acid（興奮性毒素）誘導的神經元損失明顯更敏感，揭示了 PGC-1α 在神經元壓力抗性中的作用。由於 SIRT1 通過去乙醯化活化 PGC-1α，這種敏感性間接將 SIRT1/PGC-1α 軸與神經保護聯繫起來。在方向性上，PGC-1α 缺乏增加了對這些損傷的脆弱性，而其活化賦予抗性。由於 PGC-1α 驅動粒線體生物合成和抗氧化基因表達，通過此軸保護神經元是針對帕金森症和其他神經退行性疾病的擬議策略。

label: PGC-1α knockout mice
community_name: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

label: mTORC1 under hypoxia
description: REDD1 (regulated in development and DNA damage responses 1) inhibits mTORC1 specifically under hypoxia by binding and releasing TSC2 from inhibitory 14-3-3 association, thereby activating the TSC GAP complex. This allows Rheb to be converted to its inactive GDP form and mTORC1 to be suppressed, conserving energy when oxygen is limiting. REDD1 thus provides a hypoxia-responsive brake that engages autophagy and limits anabolic consumption. Its induction is transcriptionally controlled by HIF-1α, integrating oxygen sensing with mTORC1 regulation.
description_zh_TW: REDD1（發育與 DNA 損傷反應中受調節者 1）在缺氧條件下特異性地抑制 mTORC1，透過結合並將 TSC2 從抑制性的 14-3-3 聯合中釋放出來，從而活化 TSC GAP 複合物。這使得 Rheb 被轉化為其失活的 GDP 形式，mTORC1 被抑制，以在氧氣受限時節省能量。因此 REDD1 提供了一個對缺氧有反應的制動，啟動自噬並限制合成代謝消耗。它的誘發受 HIF-1α 轉錄控制，將氧氣感知與 mTORC1 調節整合起來。

label: Myocardial infarction
description: Oxidase activity was found in the serum of patients following myocardial infarction, a finding that may be of importance in assessing the clinical and pathogenic significance of oxygen radicals in heart disease. Because stimulated neutrophils produce oxygen radicals and infiltrate the infarcted myocardium, the appearance of oxidase activity in the circulation after infarction reflects the systemic oxidative stress associated with cardiac damage. This serum marker complements the detection of a compound with the same HPLC retention time as adrenochrome in biological fluid rich in neutrophils, supporting the possibility that the adrenochrome pathway operates in vivo. Serum oxidase measurement is therefore proposed as a clinically accessible readout for the oxidant-driven conversion of adrenaline to cardiotoxic products in the setting of myocardial infarction.
description_zh_TW: 在心肌梗塞患者的血清中發現氧化酶活性，此發現對於評估氧自由基在心臟疾病中的臨床及發病意義可能具有重要性。由於受刺激的中性白血球會產生氧自由並浸潤梗塞的心肌，梗塞後血液中出現氧化酶活性反映了與心臟損傷相關的全身性氧化壓力。此血清標記物與在富含中性白血球的生物液體中，偵測到具有與adrenochrome相同HPLC保留時間之化合物的結果相互補充，支持adrenochrome代謝途徑在體內運作的可能性。因此，建議將血清氧化酶測量作為一種臨床上可取得的指標，用以反映心肌梗塞情境下，腎上腺素在氧化劑驅動下轉化為心臟毒性產物的程度。

label: PCAF/GCN5
description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

label: NAD+ bioluminescence assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The NAD+ bioluminescence assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying remaining NAD+ after a deacetylation reaction, coupling NAD+ consumption to bacterial luciferase-catalyzed oxidation of decanal via a NAD+/NADH reduction step. It uses a label-free peptide substrate and is applicable to sirtuins with any peptide substrate. Directionally, NAD+ depletion tracks sirtuin catalytic turnover. Its label-free nature and high amenability to high-throughput screening make it a useful complement to fluorescent substrate-based assays, whose artifacts affect STAC measurements.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物發光測定透過量化去乙醯化反應後剩餘的 NAD+ 來測量 sirtuin 活性，將 NAD+ 消耗與細菌螢光素酶催化的癸醛氧化偶聯，透過 NAD+/NADH 還原步驟。它使用無標記的胜肽受質，適用於任何胜肽受質的 sirtuin。方向性上 NAD+ 耗竭追蹤 sirtuin 催化轉化。其無標記特性和高通量篩選的良好適應性使其成為螢光受質基測定的有用補充，後者的假象影響了 STAC 測量。
