Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of epigenetic aging. This argues that aging can arise from information loss rather than just genetic damage, and it is a cornerstone experiment for the Information Theory of Aging. Because the phenotype occurs without mutations, it is attributed to loss of epigenetic information during repair. These results reframe aging as a software problem and motivate NAD+/sirtuin-based interventions.
description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中雙鏈斷裂的誘導及隨後的修復產生加速的表觀遺傳衰老和生理退化，不伴隨突變，支持 RCM 假說。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於表觀遺傳衰老的上游。這主張衰老可以源於資訊喪失而非僅僅基因損傷，是衰老資訊理論的基礎實驗。由於表型在沒有突變的情況下發生，被歸因於修復期間表觀遺傳資訊的喪失。這些結果將衰老重新定義為軟體問題，並推動基於 NAD+/sirtuin 的干預措施。

label: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals
description: Sinclair co-founded Sirtris Pharmaceuticals (later acquired by GlaxoSmithKline) to develop STACs such as SRT1720 and SRT2104 as therapeutics. Directionally, the academic discovery was translated into a company. This drove clinical translation of sirtuin activators, and it illustrates the bench-to-bedside path of sirtuin research. By commercializing STACs, Sirtris aimed to develop drugs that reproduce the metabolic benefits of caloric restriction. Although clinical outcomes were mixed, the company's formation validated sirtuins as a druggable target class and stimulated industrial interest in longevity biology.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 共同創辦了 Sirtris Pharmaceuticals（後被葛蘭素史克收購）以開發 SRT1720 和 SRT2104 等 STAC 作為治療藥物。在方向性上，學術發現被轉化為一家公司。這推動了 sirtuin 活化劑的臨床轉化，並說明了 sirtuin 研究從實驗室到床邊的路徑。透過商業化 STAC，Sirtris 旨在開發再現限制熱量代謝益處的藥物。儘管臨床結果不一，該公司的成立驗證了 sirtuin 作為可藥靶標類別的地位，並刺激了工業界對長壽生物學的興趣。

label: I-PpoI endonuclease
description: The ICE (Induced Changes in Epigenetics) Mouse uses inducible I-PpoI expression to introduce targeted double-strand breaks that are repaired without introducing mutations. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of controlled double-strand-break formation. This lets researchers trigger DNA damage alone, isolating epigenetic from mutational effects, and it is the experimental engine of the RCM model. By using sequence-specific breaks that are repaired faithfully, the ICE Mouse creates pure DNA-repair events. This design is central to testing whether DNA damage drives aging through epigenetic information loss.
description_zh_TW: ICE（表觀遺傳誘導變化）小鼠使用誘導型 I-PpoI 表達引入靶向的雙鏈斷裂，這些斷裂在不引入突變的情況下被修復。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於受控雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。這讓研究人員僅觸發 DNA 損傷，將表觀遺傳與突變效應分離，是 RCM 模型的實驗引擎。透過使用被忠實修復的序列特異性斷裂，ICE 小鼠創造純粹的 DNA 修復事件。此設計對於測試 DNA 損傷是否透過表觀遺傳資訊喪失驅動衰老至關重要。

label: ICE Mouse model
description: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

label: PEX genes
description: Aberrant DNA methylation has been observed around PEX genes, ABCD1, and AMPK regulatory genes in peroxisomal disorder cells, suggesting epigenetic silencing downstream of primary genetic defects can further impair peroxisome biogenesis. DNMT inhibitors and HDAC inhibitors are being explored as potential epigenetic therapies, though causation versus correlation remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 在過氧化物體疾病細胞中，已觀察到 PEX 基因、ABCD1 及 AMPK 調控基因周圍出現異常 DNA 甲基化，顯示初級基因缺陷下游的表觀遺傳沉默可能進一步削弱過氧化物體生成。DNMT 抑制劑與 HDAC 抑制劑正被探索為潛在表觀遺傳療法，惟因果關係仍未釐清。

label: Reprogramming
description: Reprogramming — from Yamanaka-factor iPSC generation to cyclic partial reprogramming in vivo — is the only intervention shown to reverse DNA methylation age while restoring chromatin organization, mitochondrial function, and senescence burden toward youthful states. Partial reprogramming interrupts the process early enough to erase epigenetic marks without losing cell identity, making the epigenetic clock both the readout and the target. This is also the strongest causal evidence that aging is substantially information loss rather than damage accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 重編程——從 Yamanaka 因子的 iPSC 生成到體內的週期性部分重編程——是目前唯一被證明可逆轉 DNA 甲基化年齡的介入方式，同時使染色質組織、粒線體功能與老化負擔朝年輕狀態恢復。部分重編程會在足夠早期的階段中止，以在不喪失細胞身份的前提下抹除表觀遺傳標記，使表觀遺傳時鐘既是測量指標也是作用標的。這也是「老化主要是資訊丟失而非損傷累積」這一論點最強的因果證據。

label: Low pH
description: Acidic conditions strongly slow or prevent the cyclization step of adrenochrome formation, because at low pH the side-chain amine of the oxidized epinephrine intermediate is protonated and reduced in nucleophilicity, so it cannot easily attack the quinone ring. In highly acidic solutions the open-chain quinone form is favored and more stable, while neutral-to-alkaline pH accelerates cyclization and oxidation. This pH dependence explains why pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions are kept acidic (pH 3-5) with antioxidants to minimize oxidation and adrenochrome formation, and it is the most important factor in controlling the reaction rate.
description_zh_TW: 酸性條件會強烈減緩或阻止 adrenochrome 形成的 cyclization 步驟，因為在低 pH 下，氧化 epinephrine 中間產物的 side-chain amine 會被質子化且 nucleophilicity 降低，因此無法輕易攻擊 quinone ring。在強酸性溶液中，open-chain quinone 形式較受青睞且更穩定，而中性至鹼性 pH 則加速 cyclization 與氧化。這種 pH dependence 解釋了為何藥用 epinephrine 溶液需保持酸性（pH 3-5）並添加 antioxidants，以最小化氧化與 adrenochrome 形成，且這是控制反應速率最重要的因素。

label: Adrenaline catabolism
description: Adrenaline catabolism in the presence of stimulated neutrophils is driven largely by the ROS these cells release. Studies from the 1980s showed that this ROS-mediated oxidation is the major catabolic pathway for adrenaline in neutrophils, accounting for over 80% of oxidation at low micromolar adrenaline concentrations, compared with the usual COMT/MAO pathways. Stimulated neutrophils (e.g., with latex beads or chemotactic peptides such as fMLP) rapidly oxidize adrenaline to adrenochrome, and cell-free medium from activated neutrophils retains this oxidizing ability, indicating that released factors drive the conversion.
description_zh_TW: Adrenaline catabolism in the presence of stimulated neutrophils is driven largely by the ROS these cells release。Studies from the 1980s showed that this ROS-mediated oxidation is the major catabolic pathway for adrenaline in neutrophils, accounting for over 80% of oxidation at low micromolar adrenaline concentrations, compared with the usual COMT/MAO pathways。Stimulated neutrophils (e.g., with latex beads or chemotactic peptides such as fMLP) rapidly oxidize adrenaline to adrenochrome, and cell-free medium from activated neutrophils retains this oxidizing ability, indicating that released factors drive the conversion。

label: Bisulfite
description: Bisulfite (sodium bisulfite or metabisulfite) is a reducing agent added to pharmaceutical epinephrine injections to prevent oxidation of the catechol and thereby inhibit adrenochrome formation. By scavenging oxygen and reactive oxygen species and reducing oxidized intermediates, bisulfite keeps adrenaline solutions stable and usable for extended periods, preventing the pink-to-red discoloration that signals adrenochrome accumulation. This practical application reflects the general principle that the epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation can be slowed by antioxidants, acidic pH, low temperature, and protection from light. Without such stabilizers, adrenaline auto-oxidizes visibly within days to weeks.
description_zh_TW: Bisulfite（sodium bisulfite 或 metabisulfite）是一種 reducing agent，添加於藥用 epinephrine 注射劑中，以防止 catechol 氧化從而抑制 adrenochrome 形成。透過清除氧氣與 reactive oxygen species 並還原氧化的中間產物，bisulfite 使 adrenaline 溶液保持穩定且可長期使用，防止標示 adrenochrome 堆積的粉紅至紅色變色。此實際應用反映了一般原則：epinephrine-to-adrenochrome 氧化可透過 antioxidants、酸性 pH、低溫與避光而減緩。若無此類 stabilizers，adrenaline 會在數天至數週內明顯 auto-oxidizes。

label: benzene ring with two hydroxyl groups
description: Catechols contain a benzene ring bearing two adjacent (ortho) hydroxyl groups, a structural motif that is both chemically reactive and the specific recognition site for COMT. This vicinal diol is methylated at the meta position by COMT using SAMe, yielding O-methylated metabolites that are less reactive and more readily excreted. The presence of this group defines whether a molecule, endogenous or xenobiotic, is a COMT substrate or, at high concentrations, a competitive inhibitor. The motif also renders catechols prone to oxidation, linking them to reactive quinone chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Catechols 含有一個帶有兩個相鄰（鄰位）羥基的苯環，這是一種具有化學反應性的結構基序，也是 COMT 的特異性識別位點。這種鄰位二醇被 COMT 使用 SAMe 在間位甲基化，產生反應性較低且更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。該基團的存在決定了分子（內源性或外源性）是 COMT 底物還是高濃度的競爭性抑制劑。該基序也使兒茶酚易於氧化，將它們與反應性醌化學聯繫起來。

label: Airway Inflammation
description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
description_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

label: Estrogen metabolites
description: Estrogen metabolites, such as 2-hydroxyestrone and 4-hydroxyestrone, are catechols because they retain a catechol ring formed during hydroxylation, making them substrates for COMT. COMT O-methylates these metabolites into less genotoxic methoxyestrogens, a protective detoxification step that reduces exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones. Slow COMT can therefore slow the clearance of catecholestrogens, with implications for hormone-related cancer risk. This connection links COMT genotype to estrogen metabolism and cancer susceptibility hypotheses.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen metabolites，如 2-羥基雌酮和 4-羥基雌酮，是兒茶酚，因為它們保留了羥基化過程中形成的兒茶酚環，使其成為 COMT 的底物。 COMT 將這些代謝物 O-甲基化成遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素，這是一種保護性解毒步驟，可減少活性兒茶酚醌的暴露。因此，緩慢的 COMT 可以減緩兒茶酚雌激素的清除，進而影響荷爾蒙相關的癌症風險。這種關聯將 COMT genotype 與雌激素代謝和癌症易感性假設聯繫起來。

label: Myocardium
description: Neutrophils are white blood cells that produce oxygen radicals when stimulated and that infiltrate the myocardium following infarction or inflammation. Their infiltration brings the oxidant-generating machinery of these cells directly into heart tissue, creating local conditions under which adrenaline can be oxidized through the adrenochrome pathway. This is significant because the resulting oxidation products, adrenochrome and adrenolutin, have been implicated in cardiotoxicity, including cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction. The presence of neutrophils in the damaged heart therefore provides a mechanistic link between inflammation, oxidative stress, and catecholamine oxidation, supporting the hypothesis that the adrenochrome pathway contributes to stress-induced heart disease and offering a rationale for measuring oxidase activity in serum after myocardial infarction.
description_zh_TW: 中性粒細胞是白血球的一種，在受到刺激時會產生氧自由基，並在梗塞或發炎後浸潤心肌。它們的浸潤將這些細胞的氧化物生成機制直接帶入心臟組織，創造出腎上腺素可透過腎上腺素紅途徑被氧化的局部條件。這一點很重要，因為所產生的氧化產物——腎上腺素紅與腎上腺素黃素——已被認為與心臟毒性有關，包括細胞壞死、心律不整和冠狀動脈收縮。因此，中性粒細胞在受損心臟中的存在，提供了發炎、氧化壓力與兒茶酚胺氧化之間的機制性連結，支持腎上腺素紅途徑導致壓力性心臟病的假說，並為心肌梗塞後測量血清氧化酶活性提供了理論依據。

label: Allopurinol
description: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase, as allopurinol and its active metabolite oxypurinol competitively bind the molybdenum center and block purine oxidation. Clinically this lowers uric acid and also curbs XO-derived superoxide. The directionality is competitive inhibition to reduced urate and ROS. A caveat is that allopurinol inhibits the dehydrogenase and oxidase forms differently and can cause hypersensitivity in some patients, notably those with HLA-B*58:01. Beyond gout, allopurinol has been studied for cardiovascular protection, chronic kidney disease progression, and prevention of tumor lysis syndrome.
description_zh_TW: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidase，因为 allopurinol 及其活性代谢物奥昔嘌呤醇竞争性结合钼中心并阻止嘌呤氧化。临床上，这会降低 uric acid 并抑制 XO 衍生的超氧化物。方向性是对还原尿酸盐和ROS的竞争性抑制。需要注意的是，allopurinol 以不同的方式抑制脫氫酶和氧化酶的形成，並可能在某些患者中引起過敏，尤其是 HLA-B*58:01 患者。除了痛风之外，allopurinol 还被研究用于心血管保护、慢性肾病进展和预防肿瘤溶解综合征。

label: Arginase
description: Arginase competes with NOS for L-arginine, hydrolyzing arginine to ornithine and urea and thereby lowering substrate available for NO synthesis. In vascular and immune contexts this shifts the arginine pool away from NO toward polyamine and proline synthesis. The directionality is metabolic competition to reduced NO. A caveat is that arginase and NOS also compete for the same intracellular compartment, so local colocalization strongly influences the outcome. Arginase is induced by inflammatory cytokines and oxidants, so vascular arginase upregulation is a recognized mechanism of endothelial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Arginase 與 NOS 競爭 L-arginine，將精氨酸水解為鳥氨酸和尿素，從而降低可用於 NO 合成的底物。在血管和免疫環境中，這會將精胺酸池從一氧化氮轉向多胺和脯胺酸合成。方向性是代謝競爭以減少NO。需要注意的是，arginase 和 NOS 也會競爭相同的細胞內區室，因此局部共定位會強烈影響結果。 Arginase 是由發炎細胞因子和氧化劑誘導的，因此血管 arginase 上調是 endothelial dysfunction 的公認機制。

label: Febuxostat
description: Febuxostat inhibits xanthine oxidase as a non-purine, selective inhibitor that blocks both the oxidized and reduced forms of the enzyme. Compared with allopurinol it achieves more complete suppression of urate production. The directionality is enzyme inhibition to lower urate and less XO-derived ROS. A caveat is that febuxostat carries cardiovascular black-box warnings in some populations and, like allopurinol, does not address pre-existing urate crystal deposits immediately. Febuxostat is primarily metabolized by the liver, allowing use in some renally impaired patients, although cardiovascular safety warnings limit broad adoption.
description_zh_TW: Febuxostat 作為一種非嘌呤選擇性抑制劑抑制 xanthine oxidase，可阻斷此酵素的氧化形式和還原形式。與allopurinol相比，實現了更徹底的尿酸鹽生成抑制。方向性是酵素抑制，以降低尿酸和減少 XO 衍生的 ROS。需要注意的是，febuxostat 在某些人群中帶有心血管黑盒警告，並且與 allopurinol 一樣，不能立即解決預先存在的尿酸鹽晶體沉積物。 Febuxostat 主要由肝臟代謝，允許在一些腎功能不全的患者中使用，儘管心血管安全警告限制了廣泛採用。

label: Aconitase
description: Peroxynitrite inactivates aconitase by disrupting its [4Fe-4S] cluster, impairing the TCA-cycle enzyme and diverting citrate metabolism. This links nitrative stress to mitochondrial metabolic dysfunction. The directionality is cluster destruction to enzyme inactivation. A caveat is that aconitase is also sensitive to superoxide and other oxidants, so its inhibition is not uniquely peroxynitrite-driven. Because aconitase also acts as iron regulatory protein 1 when its cluster is lost, oxidative inactivation links metabolic and iron-regulatory responses.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過破壞 aconitase 的 [4Fe-4S] 簇、損害 TCA 循環酶並轉移檸檬酸代謝來滅活 aconitase。這將 nitrative stress 與 mitochondria1 代謝功能障礙聯繫起來。方向性是簇破壞到酵素失活。需要注意的是，aconitase 也對超氧化物和其他氧化劑敏感，因此它的抑製作用並不是 peroxynitrite 獨有的。由於 aconitase 在其簇丟失時也充當 iron 調節蛋白 1，因此氧化失活將代謝和 iron 調節反應聯繫起來。

label: Tau protein
description: Peroxynitrite nitrates tau protein at tyrosine residues, impairing tau-microtubule interaction and enhancing formation of paired helical filaments. Nitration adds to the spectrum of oxidative modifications that destabilize tau. The directionality is nitrative modification to tau dysfunction. A caveat is that tau is targeted by many oxidative and kinase modifications, so nitration is one of several converging insults. Elevated nitrotyrosine is detected on tau in neurofibrillary tangles, supporting nitration as a contributor to tau pathology in vivo.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 在 tyrosine 殘基處硝酸鹽 tau protein，損害 tau-微管相互作用並增強成對螺旋絲的形成。硝化增加了氧化修飾的範圍，從而破壞了 tau 的穩定性。方向性是tau功能障礙的硝基修飾。需要注意的是，tau 是許多氧化和激酶修飾的目標，因此硝化是幾種聚合損傷之一。在神經纖維纏結中的 tau 上檢測到升高的硝基rosine，支持硝化是體內 tau 病理學的貢獻者。

label: Tetrahydrobiopterin
description: Peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, depriving eNOS of its essential cofactor and thereby promoting eNOS uncoupling and superoxide production. This establishes a feed-forward loop of vascular oxidative stress. The directionality is nitration of cofactor to enzyme dysfunction. A caveat is that BH4 can be regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase, partially buffering peroxynitrite-driven loss. Restoring BH4 by supplementation or by dihydrofolate reductase-dependent recycling re-couples eNOS and improves endothelial function in experimental studies.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 將 tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) 氧化為 BH2，剝奪 eNOS 的必需輔助因子，進而促進 eNOS 解偶聯和超氧化物產生。這就建立了血管oxidative stress的前饋迴路。方向性是輔因子硝化導致酵素功能障礙。需要注意的是，BH4 可以透過二氫葉酸還原酶再生，部分緩衝 peroxynitrite 驅動的損失。在實驗研究中，透過補充或二氫葉酸還原酶依賴性回收來恢復 BH4 可重新偶聯 eNOS 並改善內皮功能。

label: Uncoupled eNOS
description: Uncoupled eNOS produces superoxide radicals when BH4 or L-arginine becomes limiting, causing the enzyme to redirect electron flow from NO synthesis to oxygen reduction. This converts the principal vascular protective enzyme into a ROS source. The directionality is cofactor deficiency to superoxide generation. A caveat is that partial uncoupling may still yield some NO, and the transition is graded rather than binary. This uncoupling is a central mechanism of endothelial dysfunction in hypertension, diabetes, and atherosclerosis, and therapies that restore BH4 or arginine aim to re-couple the enzyme.
description_zh_TW: 當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，Uncoupled eNOS 會產生 superoxide radicals，導致酵素將電子流從 NO 合成重新導向到氧還原。這將主要的血管保護酶轉化為 ROS 源。方向性是超氧化物生成的輔因子缺乏。需要注意的是，部分解耦仍可能產生一些 NO，而且轉變是分級的而不是二元的。這種解偶聯是 endothelial dysfunction 在高血壓、糖尿病和 atherosclerosis 中的核心機制，恢復 BH4 或精氨酸的療法旨在重新偶聯該酶。

label: Hypotension
description: Massive nitric oxide release during septic shock, anaphylaxis, or post-cardiopulmonary bypass vasoplegia causes excessive vasodilation and life-threateningly low blood pressure (hypotension). NO overproduction is driven largely by the inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) enzyme during the inflammatory response. Therapeutic strategies target this cascade at different levels: aminoguanidine inhibits iNOS to block NO synthesis upstream, while methylene blue inhibits soluble guanylyl cyclase to block NO signaling downstream and restore blood pressure when vasopressors fail.
description_zh_TW: 在敗血症性休克、過敏反應或心肺分流術後血管麻痺期間，大量一氧化氮釋放導致過度血管舒張和危及生命的低血壓（低血壓）。NO過度產生主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）在炎症反應期間驅動。治療策略在不同層面靶向此級聯：氨基胍抑制iNOS以在上游阻斷NO合成，而亞甲藍抑制可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶以在下游阻斷NO信號並在血管加壓素失效時恢復血壓。

label: Vascular Dementia
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Accumulation of advanced glycation end products in aging persons is associated not only with diabetes complications but also with chronic diseases including vascular dementia. Bar and colleagues demonstrated differential increases of AGE products in Alzheimer's dementia and vascular dementia compared with controls. Because vascular dementia is driven by cerebrovascular dysfunction and impaired perfusion, the ability of AGEs to stiffen vessels, drive endothelial dysfunction, and promote inflammation offers a plausible mechanistic link. These findings place glycation among the modifiable biochemical processes associated with cognitive decline in the elderly.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products在aging persons中的accumulation不僅與diabetes complications有關，也與包括vascular dementia在內的chronic diseases相關。Bar及其colleagues demonstrated differential increases of AGE products in Alzheimer's dementia與vascular dementia compared with controls。由於vascular dementia是由cerebrovascular dysfunction與impaired perfusion所driven，AGEs使vessels stiffen、drive endothelial dysfunction並promote inflammation的能力，提供了一個plausible mechanistic link。這些findings place glycation among the modifiable biochemical processes associated with cognitive decline in the elderly。

label: Maillard Reaction
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) are a heterogeneous, complex group of compounds formed mainly via the Maillard reaction, in which a reducing sugar reacts non-enzymatically with amino groups in proteins, lipids, or DNA. The Maillard reaction has long been exploited by the food industry for the color and taste it imparts, but its products have gained attention in biomedicine because AGEs are associated with chronic diseases of aging such as diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular disease, and Alzheimer's disease. AGEs form in three phases, and the final brownish, often fluorescent products are very stable and accumulate in tissues, where they interfere with protein function.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products（AGEs）是一群heterogeneous、complex的compounds，主要經由Maillard reaction形成，其中a reducing sugar與proteins、lipids或DNA中的amino groups進行non-enzymatic reaction。Maillard reaction長期以來被food industry利用以imparts color與taste，但其products在biomedicine中受到attention，因為AGEs與diabetes mellitus、cardiovascular disease及Alzheimer's disease等aging chronic diseases相關。AGEs form in three phases，最終的brownish、often fluorescent products非常stable並accumulate in tissues，干擾protein function。

label: ECM
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix (ECM), such as in collagen and elastic fibers, and cross-link with ECM components. This accumulation and cross-linking cause a decrease in connective tissue elasticity, alter ECM structure and function, and impair vascular function, facilitating plaque formation and basement membrane hyperplasia. AGE accumulation in the ECM is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated signaling. ECM glycation is strongly implicated in arterial stiffening, skin aging, and age-related stiffness of tendons and cartilage.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM，如 collagen 與 elastic fibers）內，並與 ECM components 交聯。此 accumulation 與 cross-linking 導致 connective tissue 彈性下降、改變 ECM structure 與 function，並損害 vascular function，促進 plaque formation 與 basement membrane hyperplasia。ECM 中的 AGE accumulation 是 AGEs 促成 aging 的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated signaling。ECM glycation 與 arterial stiffening、skin aging 以及 tendons 與 cartilage 的年齡相關 stiffness 密切相關。

label: Elastin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix and cross-link elastic fibers as well as collagen. This cross-linking of extracellular proteins reduces the elasticity of connective tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons, affecting especially vascular function. Glycated modifications alter the balance between ECM synthesis and degradation, accelerating skin aging and increasing skin stiffness. AGE-elastin cross-linking is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs injure tissues, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM）內，並使 elastic fibers 與 collagen 交聯。這種 extracellular proteins 的交聯降低了 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等結締組織的彈性，尤其影響 vascular function。Glycated modifications 改變 ECM synthesis 與 degradation 之間的平衡，加速 skin aging 並增加皮膚僵硬。AGE-elastin cross-linking 是 AGEs 傷害組織的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling。

label: glycated serum albumin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Epicatechin, a flavanol, demonstrates potent AGE-breaking properties in vitro and in vivo. It destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin in vitro and decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. Mechanistically, side chains attached to the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures are susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and because C6 and C8 on the A-ring of epicatechin are nucleophilic, epicatechin can attack and destroy AGE cross-links. These findings position epicatechin as a naturally occurring AGE breaker with potential for preventing AGE-mediated tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種 flavanol，在體外與體內展現 potent AGE-breaking properties。它在體外 destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin，並降低了注射 exogenous AGE 的 rats retinal tissues 中的 AGE accumulation。在機制上，連接於 AGE structures pyrrole ring carbons 上的 side chains 易受 nucleophilic attack，而由於 epicatechin A-ring 上的 C6 與 C8 具有 nucleophilic，epicatechin 可 attack 並 destroy AGE cross-links。這些 findings 將 epicatechin 定位為一種 naturally occurring AGE breaker，具有預防 AGE-mediated tissue damage 的潛力。

label: Matrix Metalloproteinases
description: In the extracellular matrix, matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) such as MMP-1 and MMP-2 are involved in remodeling collagen and elastin that have been stiffened by glycation. Because AGE crosslinks make these long-lived structural proteins resistant to normal turnover, MMP-mediated remodeling helps manage matrix that has accumulated glycation damage, though MMP activity can become dysregulated under high-AGE conditions. MMPs thereby act as a degradative countermeasure to AGE-induced matrix stiffening, balancing crosslink formation and matrix turnover in vascular and connective tissue, although excessive or dysregulated MMP activity contributes to matrix destruction.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞外基質中，基質金屬蛋白酶（MMPs），如 MMP-1 與 MMP-2，參與重塑因糖化而變僵硬的膠原蛋白與彈力蛋白。由於 AGE 交聯使這些長壽結構蛋白對正常更新產生抗性，MMP 介導的重塑有助於處理已累積糖化損傷的基質，儘管在高 AGE 條件下 MMP 活性可能失調。因此，MMPs 作為對抗 AGE 誘發基質僵硬的降解性對策，在血管與結締組織中平衡交聯形成與基質更新，儘管過度或失調的 MMP 活性會導致基質破壞。

label: AGER1
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Several enzymes, including glyoxalase I, glyoxalase II, and carbonyl reductase, together with the receptor AGER1, have been shown to be part of a detoxification and counterregulation system against the prooxidant effects of glycation. AGER1 helps oppose the pro-inflammatory actions of advanced glycation end products, functioning as an endogenous check on AGE-mediated signaling. With aging and in some pathological conditions, there is an imbalance in this steady state, due to increased endogenous production or increased exogenous intake combined with lower renal AGE clearance, leading to the AGE accumulation observed in older populations.
description_zh_TW: 數種酵素，包括 glyoxalase I、glyoxalase II 與 carbonyl reductase，以及受體 AGER1，已被證實是對抗糖化促氧化效應之解毒與反向調節系統的一部分。AGER1 有助於對抗晚期糖化終產物的促發炎作用，作為 AGE 介導訊號的內生性制衡。隨著老化與在某些病理狀況下，此恆定狀態出現失衡，起因於內生性產生增加或外源性攝取增加，加上腎臟 AGE 清除率下降，導致在老年族群中觀察到的 AGE 堆積。

label: HemF-like
description: Through functional metagenomics, researchers identified soil bacteria enzymes capable of utilizing synthetic glucosepane as a nutrient source, including the biocatalysts HemF-like (coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like), BluB-like (5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase-like), and QueE-like (7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase-like). Remarkably, the human homolog of HemF, alongside homologous bacterial proteins found in the human microbiome, was shown to catalyze the cleavage of glucosepane in vitro, releasing citrulline as a byproduct. These glucosepane-cleaving enzymes represent a promising frontier for therapeutic interventions against age-related vascular stiffness and diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 透過功能性元基因體學，研究人員鑑定出能夠以合成 glucosepane 作為營養來源的土壤細菌酶，包括生物催化劑 HemF-like（coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like）、BluB-like（5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase-like）與 QueE-like（7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase-like）。值得注意的是，HemF 的人類同源蛋白，連同在人類微生物群中發現的同源細菌蛋白，被證實能在體外催化 glucosepane 的裂解，釋出瓜胺酸作為副產物。這些可裂解 glucosepane 的酶代表了對抗年齡相關血管僵硬與糖尿病併發症療法介入的極具前景的前沿。

label: Glomerular Filtration Rate
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Vlassara and colleagues studied 325 healthy participants and 66 participants with kidney disease and found that serum CML and methylglyoxal were higher in the older participants, and that serum CML correlated negatively with estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) and positively with age. Because declining kidney function reduces AGE clearance, the inverse relationship between CML and eGFR indicates that the kidney is central to regulating circulating AGE levels. This correlation supports the view that age-related decline in renal function contributes to the progressive accumulation of advanced glycation end products in the elderly.
description_zh_TW: Vlassara 及其同事研究 325 名健康參與者與 66 名腎臟病患者，發現年長參與者的血清 CML 與甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）較高，且血清 CML 與估計腎小球過濾率（eGFR）呈負相關、與年齡呈正相關。由於腎功能下降會減少 AGE 清除，CML 與 eGFR 之間的反向關係顯示腎臟是調節循環 AGE 濃度的核心。此相關性支持年齡相關腎功能下降促成老年族群晚期糖化終產物漸進堆積的觀點。

label: cADP-Ribose
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: CD38 is the primary NADase in mammals, an ectoenzyme that uses NAD+ to produce and hydrolyze cADP-ribose, a Ca2+-mobilizing second messenger. Because CD38 also degrades the NAD+ intermediates nicotinamide riboside (NR) and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), its activity further decreases the content of NAD+. CD38 content increases with age, contributing to the age-related decline in NAD+ and mitochondrial dysfunction. In CD38-deficient mice, NAD+ levels remain high, preserving mitochondrial respiration and metabolic function with age, and pharmacological inhibition of CD38 can increase NAD+ levels and improve glucose and lipid metabolism.
description_zh_TW: CD38 是哺乳動物中主要的 NADase，為一種胞外酶，利用 NAD+ 產生並水解 cADP-ribose，後者是一種可動員 Ca2+ 的第二信使。由於 CD38 也會降解 NAD+ 中間代謝物 nicotinamide riboside（NR）與 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN），其活性進一步降低 NAD+ 含量。CD38 含量隨年齡增加而上升，促成與年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降與粒線體功能障礙。在 CD38 缺陷小鼠中，NAD+ 水平維持高值，隨年齡保留粒線體呼吸與代謝功能，而 CD38 的藥理抑制可提升 NAD+ 水平並改善葡萄糖與脂質代謝。

label: Viral Translation
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
description_zh_TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。

label: Purine Nucleoside Phosphorylase
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (NP) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which can then be converted back to NAD+ via NMN through the NAMPT and NMNAT enzymes. This NP-mediated cleavage is believed to be the variable step that degrades NR to NAM in the gut, potentially explaining the low and interindividually variable oral bioavailability of NR. NAM is the most common NAD+ precursor in mammals, and when administered at higher doses it can exert sirtuin-inhibiting effects. The balance between the direct NMRK pathway and this NP/NAMPT route determines how efficiently supplemented NR is converted to NAD+ in different tissues.
description_zh_TW: 嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（NP）將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），後者隨後可透過 NMN 經由 NAMPT 與 NMNAT 酵素轉回 NAD+。此種由 NP 介導的裂解被認為是在腸道中將 NR 降解為 NAM 的變異步驟，可能解釋了 NR 口服生體可用率偏低且在個體間存在差異的現象。NAM 是哺乳動物中最常見的 NAD+ 前體，當以較高劑量投予時，可產生抑制 sirtuin 的效應。直接 NMRK 路徑與此 NP/NAMPT 途徑之間的平衡，決定了補充的 NR 在不同組織中轉化為 NAD+ 的效率。

label: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain is a viral protein that hydrolyses the ADP-ribose (ADPR) units added by PARPs to proteins and nucleic acids, thereby inhibiting the protective antiviral effect of PARPs and facilitating viral replication and virulence. Because PARPs require NAD+ to ADP-ribosylate viral transcripts, this counteraction leads to excessive PARP activation and NAD+ consumption during infection, dysregulating the NAD+ metabolome. Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors may therefore restore PARP antiviral function and support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2, connecting NAD+ metabolism directly to COVID-19 severity and immune defense.
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain 是一種病毒蛋白，可水解 PARPs 加到蛋白質與核酸上的 ADP-核糖（ADPR）單元，從而抑制 PARPs 的保護性抗病毒效應並促進病毒複製與毒力。由於 PARPs 需要 NAD+ 來對病毒轉錄本進行 ADP-核糖基化，此對抗作用導致感染期間過度的 PARP 活化與 NAD+ 消耗，使 NAD+ 代謝組失調。因此，以前驅物恢復 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARP 抗病毒功能並支持對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫，將 NAD+ 代謝直接連結到 COVID-19 嚴重程度與免疫防禦。

label: CD4+ T Cells
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Upon activation of the adaptive immune response, the overexpression of CD38 in both CD4+ and CD8+ lymphocytes further exaggerates NAD+ depletion, leading to increased production and release of proinflammatory cytokines, reactive oxygen species, and macrophage infiltration. Drastic NAD+ depletion impairs the function of sirtuins, the regulators of cell death and viability, and loss of sirtuin function along with increased oxidative damage and an overall energy decrease culminates in cell death. Replenishment of NAD+ body content could restore energy levels and impaired sirtuin function and possibly rebalance the maladaptive immune response to SARS-CoV-2 infection, which causes
description_zh_TW: 在適應性免疫反應活化後，CD38 在 CD4+ 與 CD8+ 淋巴球中的過度表現進一步加劇 NAD+ 耗竭，導致促發炎性細胞激素、活性氧與巨噬細胞浸潤的產生與釋放增加。急劇的 NAD+ 耗竭損害 sirtuins（細胞死亡與存活的調節者）的功能，而 sirtuin 功能的喪失連同氧化損傷增加與整體能量下降，最終導致細胞死亡。補充體內 NAD+ 含量可恢復能量水平與受損的 sirtuin 功能，並可能重新平衡對 SARS-CoV-2 感染的適應不良免疫反應，此感染導致

label: NAD+ in tumor microenvironment
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins (overview, CD38 KO risks, cancer therapies).md
description: CD38 enzymatic activity depletes NAD+ in the tumor microenvironment and generates adenosine, suppressing anti-tumor T-cell and NK-cell responses. Directionally, CD38 sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and immunosuppression. This links CD38 to cancer immune evasion, and anti-CD38 antibodies both target myeloma and reshape the tumor microenvironment. By consuming NAD+ and producing immunosuppressive adenosine, CD38 on tumor and immune cells dampens anti-tumor immunity. This dual role makes CD38 both a therapeutic target and a mechanism of immune escape in cancer.
description_zh_TW: CD38 酶活性在腫瘤微環境中耗竭 NAD+ 並產生腺苷，抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞和 NK 細胞反應。在方向性上，CD38 位於 NAD+ 耗竭和免疫抑制的上游。這將 CD38 與癌症免疫逃逸聯繫起來，抗 CD38 抗體既能靶向骨髓瘤也能重塑腫瘤微環境。透過消耗 NAD+ 和產生免疫抑制性腺苷，腫瘤和免疫細胞上的 CD38 削弱抗腫瘤免疫。這種雙重角色使 CD38 成為癌症中的治療靶標和免疫逃逸機制。

label: Aging (depleting NAD+)
description: CD38, the major NADase in many mouse tissues, increases with age and depletes cellular NAD+ pools, thereby compromising sirtuin function. Mice lacking CD38 show elevated NAD+ levels and increased SIRT1 activity, coupled with protection from diet-induced obesity. Directionally, age-related CD38 upregulation sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and reduced sirtuin activity. Because sirtuins depend on NAD+ as a co-substrate, the rising NAD+ consumption by CD38 during aging starves sirtuin enzymes of their fuel. This makes CD38 a key target for NAD+-restoring interventions, and CD38 inhibition is being explored as a way to preserve NAD+ and support sirtuin function during aging.
description_zh_TW: CD38是許多小鼠組織中的主要NADase，隨年齡增長而增加並耗竭細胞NAD+池，從而損害sirtuin功能。缺乏CD38的小鼠表現出升高的NAD+水平和增加的SIRT1活性，並對飲食誘導的肥胖具有保護作用。方向上，與年齡相關的CD38上調位於NAD+耗竭和sirtuin活性降低的上游。因為sirtuin依賴NAD+作為共同底物，CD38在老化過程中NAD+消耗的增加使sirtuin酶缺乏燃料。這使CD38成為NAD+恢復介入的關鍵靶點，CD38抑制正在被探索為在老化過程中保存NAD+和支持sirtuin功能的方法。

label: Multiple myeloma
description: Daratumumab is a frontline anti-CD38 antibody therapy for multiple myeloma, where CD38 is highly expressed on malignant plasma cells. Its clinical efficacy stems from direct and immune-mediated elimination of these cells, including complement-dependent cytotoxicity, antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity, and antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis. Directionally, daratumumab sits upstream of myeloma cell clearance. Beyond oncology, its CD38 inhibition has the secondary effect of sparing NAD+ pools that sirtuins depend on, and it depletes CD38+ regulatory immune cells, reshaping the tumor microenvironment to restore anti-tumor T-cell and NK-cell responses.
description_zh_TW: Daratumumab 是多發性骨髓瘤的一線抗 CD38 抗體療法，其中 CD38 在惡性漿細胞上高度表達。其臨床療效源於直接和免疫介導的這些細胞的消除，包括補體依賴性細胞毒性、抗體依賴性細胞毒性和抗體依賴性細胞吞噬作用。在方向性上，Daratumumab 位於骨髓瘤細胞清除的上游。除了腫瘤學之外，其 CD38 抑制的次級效應是節省 sirtuin 依賴的 NAD+ 池，並耗竭 CD38+ 調節性免疫細胞，重塑腫瘤微環境以恢復抗腫瘤 T 細胞和 NK 細胞反應。

label: Isatuximab
description: Isatuximab (Sarclisa) is an IgG1 anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody, approved around 2020-2021, that binds a different CD38 epitope than daratumumab. It mediates direct apoptosis and immune effector functions such as antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and phagocytosis against CD38+ multiple myeloma cells. Directionally, the antibody engages CD38 to kill tumor cells. Like daratumumab, it also lowers CD38 ectoenzyme activity, indirectly preserving NAD+ for sirtuins. Isatuximab is used in combination regimens for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, and its anti-CD38 activity both depletes malignant plasma cells and reshapes the tumor microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: Isatuximab（Sarclisa）是一種 IgG1 抗 CD38 單克隆抗體，約在 2020-2021 年獲批，結合與 daratumumab 不同的 CD38 表位。它介導直接凋亡和免疫效應功能（如抗體依賴性細胞毒性和吞噬作用），對抗 CD38+ 多發性骨髓瘤細胞。在方向性上，抗體結合 CD38 以殺死腫瘤細胞。與 daratumumab 一樣，它也降低 CD38 外酶活性，間接保留 sirtuin 所需的 NAD+。Isatuximab 用於復發/難治性多發性骨髓瘤的聯合方案，其抗 CD38 活性既耗竭惡性漿細胞又重塑腫瘤微環境。

label: Myeloid Differentiation
description: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

label: MHC Class Ib
description: HLA-E is a non-classical (class Ib) major histocompatibility complex molecule with limited polymorphism, presenting a restricted set of peptides, often leader peptides derived from other MHC class I molecules, to innate lymphoid receptors. Its classification distinguishes it from classical MHC class Ia molecules and underpins its specialized ligand-receptor interactions with NKG2A/CD94. In senescence, HLA-E upregulation becomes a mechanism of immune evasion that protects arrested cells from cytotoxic lymphocytes. The class Ib identity enables the checkpoint-like function central to its role in senescence surveillance.
description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是一種低多態性的非典型（class Ib）主要組織相容性複合體分子，呈現一組受限的肽，常為來自其他 MHC class I 分子的導肽，給先天淋巴受體。其分類區分它與典型 MHC class Ia 分子，並支撐其與 NKG2A/CD94 的特化配體—受體交互作用。在衰老中，HLA-E 上升成為保護停滯細胞對抗細胞毒性淋巴球的免疫逃脫機制。此 class Ib 身分啟用對其在衰老監視中角色至為核心的檢查點樣功能。

label: NKG2A
description: HLA-E is the ligand for the inhibitory receptor NKG2A/CD94 heterodimer expressed on NK cells and CD8+ T cells. This binding delivers a cognate inhibitory signal upon engagement, dampening the cytotoxic activity of the receptor-bearing lymphocyte. The interaction is a canonical innate immune checkpoint, analogous to PD-1/PD-L1 but restricted to the NKG2A-CD94 axis. In senescence, HLA-E-NKG2A engagement becomes a route by which arrested cells dampen their own immune clearance, contributing to their persistence.
description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是表達於 NK 細胞與 CD8+ T 細胞的抑制性受體 NKG2A/CD94 異二聚體的配體。此結合在參與時傳遞同源抑制訊號，減弱攜帶受體的淋巴球的細胞毒性活性。此交互作用是典型的先天免疫檢查點，類似 PD-1/PD-L1 但限於 NKG2A-CD94 軸。在衰老中，HLA-E-NKG2A 參與成為停滯細胞減弱其自身免疫清除的途徑，貢獻其持續。

label: CD8 T Cells
description: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 engagement on CD8+ T cells suppresses their cytotoxic killing, extending the immune-evasive effect beyond NK cells to the adaptive compartment. This allows HLA-E-upregulated senescent and malignant cells to evade cytotoxic T lymphocytes, contributing to failed clearance and persistence. The suppression reinforces the dual innate and adaptive immune evasion conferred by HLA-E and mirrors the checkpoint biology exploited by tumors. Pharmacological blockade of the interaction is being explored as a strategy to restore CD8+ T-cell responses.
description_zh_TW: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 在 CD8+ T 細胞上的參與抑制其細胞毒性殺死，將免疫逃脫效應從 NK 細胞擴展到適應區室。這允許 HLA-E 上升的衰老與惡性細胞逃避免疫毒性 T 淋巴球，貢獻失敗清除與持續。此抑制強化 HLA-E 賦予的雙重先天與適應免疫逃脫，並反映腫瘤利用的檢查點生物學。藥理阻斷此交互作用正被探索作為恢復 CD8+ T 細胞反應的策略。

label: Stemness
description: IL-6 is a central driver of in vivo reprogramming toward pluripotency and stemness via JAK/STAT3 signaling, promoting a dedifferentiated, stem-like state in recipient cells. This underlies both wound-healing plasticity and, pathologically, cancer stemness, with STAT3 transcriptionally sustaining stemness factors such as OCT4, NANOG, and SOX2. The relationship links a core SASP cytokine to cell-fate reprogramming and is supported by reprogramming and cancer-stemness studies. Blocking IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling can interrupt this reprogramming.
description_zh_TW: IL-6 是透過 JAK/STAT3 訊號驅動體內朝多能性與幹性重編程的核心驅動者，在受體細胞中促進去分化、類幹細胞狀態。這構成傷口癒合可塑性，以及病理上、由 STAT3 轉錄持續幹性基因的癌症幹性。在衰老中，SASP 的 IL-6 可重編程鄰近細胞朝向幹樣身分，有助組織修復但也可能助長腫瘤幹性。它是 SASP—幹性軸的主要效應器。

label: Immature Myeloid Cell
description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are a heterogeneous population of immature myeloid cells with potent immunosuppressive activity, expanded under pathological stress including cancer and chronic inflammation. Their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state rather than a single lineage, with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets recognized. In senescence contexts, MDSCs are recruited by SASP factors and blunt anti-tumor and anti-senescence immunity, shifting the immune balance away from clearance. They represent a key immunosuppressive cell type bridging aging, inflammation, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: MDSCs（骨髓源性抑制細胞）是一群異質、未成熟骨髓細胞，在發炎與癌症中擴張並具免疫抑制功能。其歸類為未成熟骨髓細胞將其定位於骨髓生成與免疫調節的交會點，且其在衰老中重要性上升。在衰老脈絡中，MDSC 累積貢獻免疫抑制與監視受損。其未成熟本質使其對發炎細胞激素與趨化因子高度反應，成為衰老相關免疫逃脫的關鍵角色。

label: Serum Cholesterol
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at pharmacological doses reduces serum cholesterol levels in humans, but its clinical use is limited by a side effect of skin flushing accompanied by an unpleasant warmth sensation and often itching. Niacin, together with tryptophan and nicotinamide, is one of the classic NAD+ biosynthesis precursors historically used to prevent and treat pellagra, a disease characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia. Tryptophan alone is not sufficient to sustain cellular NAD+ levels because it participates in other metabolic pathways such as serotonin, melatonin, and picolinic acid synthesis, making nicotinic acid an important dietary NAD+ precursor with distinct pharmacological actions.
description_zh_TW: Nicotinic acid (niacin) 在藥理劑量下可降低人類的血清膽固醇水平，但其臨床使用受限於皮膚潮紅的副作用，伴隨令人不適的溫熱感，且常伴隨搔癢。Niacin 與 tryptophan 及 nicotinamide 同為歷來用於預防和治療 pellagra 的經典 NAD+ 生合成前驅物，該疾病以皮膚炎、腹瀉和癡呆為特徵。單靠 tryptophan 不足以維持細胞內 NAD+ 水平，因為它參與其他代謝途徑，如 serotonin、melatonin 和 picolinic acid 的合成，使得 nicotinic acid 成為一種具有獨特藥理作用的重要膳食 NAD+ 前驅物。

label: MEK
description: ERK1_2 is activated by MEK. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. MEK1/2 are the dual-specificity kinases immediately upstream of ERK that integrate RAS-RAF signals into proliferative output. The directionality runs from MEK toward ERK1_2, so MEK is the active agent and ERK1_2 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ERK1_2 由 MEK 活化。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。 MEK1/2 是緊鄰ERK上游的雙特異性激酶，可將 RAS-RAF 訊號整合到增殖輸出。方向性從 MEK 朝向 ERK1_2，因此 MEK 是主動主體，ERK1_2 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
description: VEGF is targeted by Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. Tyrosine-kinase inhibitors block receptor or cytoplasmic kinases and include the anti-VEGF and anti-EGFR agents used in solid tumors. The directionality runs from Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors toward VEGF, so Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors is the active agent and VEGF the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: VEGF 的目標是 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。酪胺酸激酶抑制劑阻斷受體或細胞質激酶，包括用於實體腫瘤的抗-和抗-藥物。方向性從 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors 向 VEGF，因此 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors 是活性劑，VEGF 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Anti-CD38 mAbs
description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibodies eliminate CD38+ Tregs and MDSCs and reduce adenosine-mediated immunosuppression, restoring T- and NK-cell function in the tumor microenvironment. Directionally, anti-CD38 therapy sits upstream of tumor-microenvironment reprogramming. This is both an anticancer action and a means to spare NAD+ for sirtuins, and it illustrates the dual therapeutic logic of CD38 targeting. By depleting immunosuppressive cells and reducing adenosine, these antibodies restore effector immune responses. The resulting reshaping of the tumor microenvironment contributes to the efficacy of anti-CD38 antibodies in multiple myeloma and other cancers.
description_zh_TW: 抗 CD38 單克隆抗體消除 CD38+ 調節性 T 細胞和 MDSC，並減少腺苷介導的免疫抑制，恢復腫瘤微環境中 T 細胞和 NK 細胞的功能。在方向性上，抗 CD38 治療位於腫瘤微環境重編程的上游。這既是抗癌作用也是為 sirtuin 節省 NAD+ 的手段，說明了 CD38 靶向的雙重治療邏輯。透過清除免疫抑制細胞和減少腺苷，這些抗體恢復效應免疫反應。由此產生的腫瘤微環境重塑有助於抗 CD38 抗體在多發性骨髓瘤和其他癌症中的療效。

label: antioxidant enzyme expression
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Moderate physical exercise induces the expression of antioxidant enzymes, leading to the reduction of oxidative stress. Exercise effectively inhibits ROS generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes, and because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is attributed mainly to exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Physical exercise also decreases oxidative stress in rodent models and is reported to improve systemic antioxidant activity in humans. These antioxidant effects link exercise to reduced AGE accumulation and healthier aging.
description_zh_TW: 適度的身體運動會誘導抗氧化酵素的表現，進而降低氧化壓力。運動能有效抑制 ROS 的生成並提升抗氧化酵素的活性，而由於蛋白質糖化反應是由 ROS 驅動並加速的，規律運動對 AGE 形成的抑制主要歸因於運動相關的抗氧化活性。身體運動也能降低囓齒類動物模式中的氧化壓力，且據報導能改善人類的全身性抗氧化活性。這些抗氧化效應將運動與減少的 AGE 堆積及更健康的老化連結起來。

label: Appetite
description: An important conclusion of the Speakman review is that exercise does not reliably increase appetite, and that in many individuals appetite is suppressed both during and for a period after exercise, an effect that can persist for up to 24 hours in some protocols. This is counter to the common belief that increased exercise necessarily drives increased food intake. When exercise does raise energy intake, the increase is generally smaller than the energy cost of the exercise, so a net negative energy balance is usually achieved. These findings support the view that exercise contributes to weight control by raising expenditure without a fully compensatory increase in intake.
description_zh_TW: Speakman綜述的一項重要結論是，運動並不會可靠地增加食慾，而且在許多個體中，食慾在運動期間及運動後一段時間內受到抑制，在某些實驗方案中此效應可持續長達24小時。這與「增加運動必然驅動更多食物攝取」的常見信念相反。當運動確實提高能量攝取時，其增加量通常小於運動的能量成本，因此通常可達到淨負能量平衡。這些發現支持以下觀點：運動透過提高消耗、而無完全補償性的攝取增加，來促進體重控制。

label: Athletes
description: Athletes in heavy training display elevated resting metabolic rates compared with untrained individuals, largely because their higher fat free mass increases the metabolic load of lean tissues. Speakman notes that RMR measured in endurance athletes can be elevated by about 5-10 percent beyond the prediction for their body composition alone, an effect attributed to increased protein turnover, elevated sympathetic tone, and continued recovery processes in muscle. However, the review stresses that the majority of the difference in total daily energy expenditure between athletes and non-athletes arises from the energy cost of training itself, not from chronic elevation of RMR.
description_zh_TW: 進行高強度訓練的運動員與未訓練者相比表現出更高的靜息代謝率，主要是因為他們較高的去脂體重增加了瘦組織的代謝負擔。Speakman指出，在耐力運動員中測量的RMR可能比僅根據其身體成分預測的值高出約5-10%，這一效應歸因於蛋白質周轉增加、交感神經張力升高和肌肉中持續的恢復過程。然而，該綜述強調，運動員和非運動員之間每日總能量消耗的大部分差異來自訓練本身的能量成本，而不是來自RMR的長期升高。

label: Daily Energy Expenditure
description: Physical activity and exercise are the components of daily energy expenditure that are most amenable to voluntary modification, in contrast to resting metabolic rate and thermic effect of food which are largely fixed by body size and composition. Speakman reviews doubly labelled water studies of total daily energy expenditure in adults to argue that although activity levels vary widely between individuals, the day-to-day variability of total daily energy expenditure is surprisingly small, around 2-3 percent. This suggests energy intake is tightly matched to expenditure over the long term, and that exercise-induced elevations in expenditure are generally not fully compensated by reductions elsewhere in the daily energy budget.
description_zh_TW: 體力活動和運動是每日能量支出中最容易自願修改的成分，而靜息代謝率和食物熱效應 largely 由身體大小和成分固定。Speakman回顧了成人每日總能量支出的雙標記水研究，認為儘管活動水平因人而異，但每日總能量支出的每日變異性驚人地小，約2-3%。這表明能量攝入在長期內與支出緊密匹配，且運動引起的支出增加通常不會完全被日常能量預算中其他地方的減少所補償。

label: Thyroid Hormones
description: Resting metabolic rate is modulated by thyroid hormones, which set the metabolic tone of the body by regulating mitochondrial oxygen consumption and cellular sodium-potassium ATPase activity in most tissues. Speakman reviews that both hypothyroid and hyperthyroid states shift RMR substantially, and that within the normal range thyroid status contributes to inter-individual variability in resting metabolic rate. However, training-induced changes in RMR are generally not mediated by changes in thyroid hormone levels, and short-term exercise does not consistently alter circulating thyroid hormone concentrations, indicating that the post-exercise RMR elevation is driven by other factors.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率受甲狀腺激素調節，甲狀腺激素通過調節大多數組織中的線粒體氧氣消耗和細胞鈉-鉀ATP酶活性來設定身體的代謝基調。Speakman回顧指出，甲狀腺功能減退和甲狀腺功能亢進狀態都會顯著改變RMR，並且在正常範圍內，甲狀腺狀態有助於靜息代謝率的個體間變異性。然而，訓練引起的RMR變化通常不是由甲狀腺激素水平的變化介導的，短期運動不會一致地改變循環甲狀腺激素濃度，表明運動後RMR升高是由其他因素驅動的。

label: Doubly Labelled Water
description: The doubly labelled water (DLW) technique is the gold-standard method for measuring total daily energy expenditure and the physical activity component of the energy budget in free-living humans. Subjects drink water labeled with the stable isotopes deuterium and oxygen-18; carbon dioxide production is calculated from the differential loss rates of the two isotopes, and energy expenditure is derived using standard equations. In the studies reviewed by Speakman, DLW has been used to quantify total daily energy expenditure (TEE) over 7-14 day periods, showing that within-individual day-to-day variability of TEE is small even when physical activity varies.
description_zh_TW: 雙標記水（DLW）技術是測量自由生活人類每日總能量支出和能量預算中體力活動成分的黃金標準方法。受試者飲用含有穩定同位素氘和氧-18標記的水；二氧化碳產生量根據兩種同位素的差異損失率計算，能量支出使用標準方程式得出。在Speakman回顧的研究中，DLW被用於量化7-14天期間的每日總能量支出（TEE），顯示即使體力活動變化，個體內每日TEE變異性也很小。

label: Sedentary Behaviour
description: Total physical activity during the day can be limited by sedentary behaviour, and in some doubly labelled water studies the elevated energy expenditure from a structured exercise session was partly offset by a reduction in non-exercise physical activity elsewhere in the day. Speakman notes that the extent of this compensation varies between individuals, so the net effect of a training program on total daily energy expenditure is the sum of the exercise cost, the excess post-exercise oxygen consumption, and any changes in spontaneous activity and appetite. This interaction helps explain why measured increases in total daily energy expenditure with training are often smaller than the energy cost of the training sessions themselves.
description_zh_TW: 白天的總體力活動可能因久坐行為而受限，在一些雙標記水研究中，結構化運動課程增加的能量消耗部分被一天中其他時間非運動體力活動的減少所抵消。Speakman指出這種補償程度因人而異，因此訓練課程對每日總能量支出的淨效應是運動成本、運動後過量氧消耗以及自發活動和食慾變化的總和。這種相互作用有助於解釋為什麼訓練期間測量的每日總能量支出增加通常小於訓練課程本身的能量成本。

label: UCP3
description: Uncoupling protein 3 (UCP3) is expressed primarily in skeletal muscle and is a candidate mediator of the proton leak that contributes to resting metabolic rate and exercise-related energy expenditure. Speakman cites evidence that UCP3 mRNA is elevated after exercise and that its expression, together with UCP2, may account for a fraction of the exercise-induced rise in metabolic rate. The functional importance of UCP3 in mediating proton leak remains debated, because knockout studies in mice do not show gross changes in resting metabolic rate, but its induction by training and by lipids keeps it a focus for understanding inter-individual differences in energy expenditure.
description_zh_TW: 解偶聯蛋白 3（UCP3）主要在骨骼肌中表達，是貢獻於靜息代謝率和運動相關能量消耗的質子洩漏的候選介導因子。Speakman 引用了 UCP3 mRNA 在運動後升高的證據，以及其表達與 UCP2 一起可能解釋運動誘導代謝率上升的一部分。UCP3 在介導質子洩漏中的功能重要性仍有爭議，因為小鼠基因敲除研究未顯示靜息代謝率的顯著變化，但其被訓練和脂質誘導的特性使其成為理解個體間能量消耗差異的焦點。

label: Fat Free Mass
description: Across and within individuals, resting metabolic rate (RMR) is most strongly predicted by fat free mass (FFM), which typically accounts for roughly 60-80 percent of the variance in RMR. Larger organs such as liver, brain, heart, and kidneys are metabolically expensive, so differences in lean mass drive most of the between-individual variation in RMR. Within a single individual, day-to-day variability of RMR is small, and the residual variability not explained by FFM includes fat mass, age, thyroid status, and ambient temperature. Because lean tissue is the primary metabolic driver, changes in muscle mass through training can modestly raise RMR.
description_zh_TW: 在個體之間和內部，靜息代謝率（RMR）最強烈地由去脂體重（FFM）預測，FFM通常佔RMR變異的大約60-80%。較大的器官如肝臟、大腦、心臟和腎臟在代謝上成本高昂，因此瘦體重的差異驅動了個體之間RMR的大部分變化。在單個個體內部，RMR的日常變異性很小，FFM未解釋的殘餘變異性包括脂肪質量、年齡、甲狀腺狀態和環境溫度。由於瘦組織是主要的代謝驅動因素，通過訓練改變肌肉質量可以適度提高RMR。

label: BDNF and NAD+ levels
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Exercise raises both BDNF and NAD+ levels, and SIRT1 may mediate exercise-induced BDNF upregulation in the hippocampus. Directionally, exercise sits upstream of BDNF and NAD+ elevation. Higher NAD+ fuels SIRT1, which then supports BDNF, and this provides a mechanistic bridge between physical activity, sirtuins, and brain health. By raising NAD+, exercise engages the sirtuin pathway that promotes BDNF expression and mitochondrial function. This axis is central to the well-established cognitive benefits of exercise and to the geroscience concept of exercise as medicine.
description_zh_TW: 運動同時提高 BDNF 和 NAD+ 水平，SIRT1 可能中介運動誘導的海馬 BDNF 上調。在方向性上，運動位於 BDNF 和 NAD+ 提升的上游。較高的 NAD+ 為 SIRT1 提供燃料，後者隨後支持 BDNF，這提供了身體活動、sirtuin 和大腦健康之間的機制橋樑。透過提高 NAD+，運動啟動促進 BDNF 表達和粒線體功能的 sirtuin 途徑。此軸線是運動公認的認知益處和老年科學中運動即藥物概念的核心。

label: CDK5
description: CDK5 phosphorylates NOXA at Ser13, causing inactivation in metabolically regulated T-cell leukemia cells.
description_zh_TW: CDK5 在 Ser13 磷酸化 NOXA，在代謝調節的 T 細胞白血病細胞中造成不活化。

label: CDK1
description: CDK1/CYCLIN B1 phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308, suppressing caspase activity and suppressing mitotic cell death.
description_zh_TW: CDK1/CYCLIN B1 在 Ser308 磷酸化 Caspase-2，抑制 caspase 活性並抑制有絲分裂細胞死亡。

label: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Tenovins (tenovin-1 and tenovin-6) are sirtuin inhibitors that block SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation of p53, leading to p53 hyperacetylation and activation. Their strong anticancer activity is associated with this p53 activation, which reinstates tumor-suppressive transcription in cancer cells. Directionally, tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation and tumor suppression, a property shared with HDAC inhibitors and other p53-releasing strategies. Tenovins illustrate the direct link between sirtuin inhibition, p53 acetylation state, and cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin（tenovin-1 和 tenovin-6）是 sirtuin 抑制劑，阻斷 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的 p53 去乙醯化，導致 p53 超乙醯化和活化。其強效抗癌活性與此 p53 活化相關，在癌細胞中恢復腫瘤抑制性轉錄。方向性上 tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化和腫瘤抑制的上游，此特性與 HDAC 抑制劑和其他 p53 釋放策略共享。Tenovin 展示了 sirtuin 抑制、p53 乙醯化狀態和癌症治療之間的直接聯繫。

label: HIC1 transcription
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: p53 directly activates transcription of HIC1, a tumor suppressor that in turn represses the SIRT1 promoter, forming a negative feedback loop that restrains SIRT1 abundance. This loop ensures that p53 activity is not indefinitely suppressed by SIRT1-mediated deacetylation, because sustained p53 signaling drives HIC1 to limit SIRT1 expression. Directionally, p53 is the transcription factor and HIC1 the induced target gene, with SIRT1 sitting downstream of both. The biological significance is genome protection: by inducing HIC1, p53 prevents SIRT1 from over-deacetylating and silencing p53 itself, preserving the capacity for apoptosis and senescence in response to damage.
description_zh_TW: p53 直接活化 HIC1 的轉錄，HIC1 是一種腫瘤抑制因子，反過來抑制 SIRT1 啟動子，形成一個負回饋迴路以限制 SIRT1 的表達量。這個迴路確保 p53 活性不會被 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化無限期抑制，因為持續的 p53 信號驅動 HIC1 來限制 SIRT1 表達。在方向性上，p53 是轉錄因子，HIC1 是被誘導的靶基因，而 SIRT1 位於兩者的下游。其生物學意義在於基因組保護：通過誘導 HIC1，p53 防止 SIRT1 過度去乙醯化和沉默 p53 本身，維持對損傷的凋亡和衰老反應能力。

label: CaMKII
description: CaMKII phosphorylates caspase-2 on Ser135 — distinct from the Ser164 site regulated by CaMKII in the metabolic context — rendering the apical caspase inactive. This phosphorylation is itself shielded by 14-3-3ζ binding, and the shield's integrity depends on the acetylation state of 14-3-3ζ, which SIRT1 controls. The system layers a phospho-switch (CaMKII/Ser135) on top of an acetyl-switch (SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49), so nutrient-driven PPP flux ultimately decides whether caspase-2 stays suppressed.
description_zh_TW: CaMKII 會將 caspase-2 的 Ser135 磷酸化——與其在代謝脈絡中調控的 Ser164 位點不同——使頂端 caspase 處於不活化狀態。此磷酸化本身又被 14-3-3ζ 的結合所保護，而保護罩的完整性取決於 SIRT1 所控制的 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化狀態。整個系統在乙醯開關（SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49）之上再疊加磷酸開關（CaMKII/Ser135），因此養分驅動的 PPP 通量最終決定 caspase-2 是否維持被抑制。

label: Chemotherapy sensitivity
description: Caloric restriction increases the sensitivity of tumor cells to chemotherapy by creating a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while cancer cells remain vulnerable. CR additionally stimulates CD8+ T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity and enhances apoptotic priming of malignant cells. The improved therapeutic index allows lower effective doses and reduced toxicity. These effects position CR and its mimetics as adjuncts to conventional cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制透過創造差異性壓力抵抗來增加腫瘤細胞對化療的敏感性：正常細胞進入保護性、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而癌細胞仍保持脆弱。熱量限制還刺激 CD8+ T 細胞介導的抗腫瘤免疫，並增強惡性細胞的凋亡啟動。改善的治療指數允許更低的有效劑量和減少的毒性。這些效應將熱量限制及其擬似物定位為常規癌症治療的輔助手段。

label: Caloric Restriction Mimetics
description: Caloric restriction mimetics are pharmacological agents that reproduce the metabolic and autophagic benefits of caloric restriction without sustained food reduction. Representatives such as 2-deoxyglucose, metformin, and spermidine activate AMPK and/or inhibit mTORC1, recapitulating the low-energy signaling state that drives autophagy. By mimicking nutrient scarcity at the signaling level, these compounds induce lysosomal and autophagic gene programs similar to those engaged during DR. They are attractive translationally because they avoid the practical and compliance limitations of long-term dietary restriction in humans.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制擬似物是能再現熱量限制的代謝和自噬益處而無需持續減少食物的藥理劑。代表物如2-deoxyglucose、metformin和spermidine活化AMPK和／或抑制mTORC1，重現驅動自噬的低能量訊號狀態。透過在訊號層面模擬營養匱乏，這些化合物誘導與DR期間相似的溶酶體和自噬基因程序。它們在轉譯上具吸引力，因為它們避免了人類長期飲食限制的實際和依從性限制。

label: Adaptive autophagy
description: Moderate caloric restriction induces adaptive autophagy—a beneficial, hormetic form of the pathway that enhances cellular clearance and resilience without causing damage. This adaptive response, driven by AMPK activation and mTORC1 inhibition, contributes substantially to the lifespan and healthspan extension observed with CR. Unlike pathological autophagy, adaptive autophagy is precisely regulated and supports rather than threatens cell survival. It represents the mechanistic core of CR's pro-longevity effects.
description_zh_TW: 適度的熱量限制誘發適應性自噬——一種有益的、激效型（hormetic）的途徑形式，在不造成損傷的情況下增強細胞清除和韌性。此由 AMPK 活化和 mTORC1 抑制驅動的適應性反應，對熱量限制所觀察到的壽命和健康壽命延長貢獻良多。不同於病理性自噬，適應性自噬受到精確調節，支持而非威脅細胞存活。它代表了熱量限制促長壽效應的機制核心。

label: Excessive autophagy
description: Prolonged or severe caloric restriction can drive excessive autophagy that crosses into autophagic cell death, particularly when degradative flux outpaces biosynthetic capacity. This maladaptive extreme underscores the biphasic, hormetic nature of autophagy, where too little or too much is detrimental. The balance between adaptive and excessive autophagy determines whether CR is protective or harmful. Understanding this threshold is important for safely translating CR-mimetic strategies.
description_zh_TW: 長期或嚴重的熱量限制可能驅動過度的自噬，跨越到自噬性細胞死亡，特別是當降解流超越合成能力時。此適應不良的極端凸顯了自噬的雙相、激效型本質，即過少或過多都有害。適應性與過度自噬之間的平衡決定了熱量限制是有保護性還是有害。理解此閾值對於安全轉譯熱量限制擬似策略至為重要。

label: Polycomb Group Proteins
description: Polycomb group proteins are a primary target of epigenetic drift, as genes marked by Polycomb repressive complexes are especially vulnerable to age-associated methylation changes. The H3K27me3 mark deposited by Polycomb complexes and associated CpG methylation tend to be gained during aging, altering the expression of developmental and differentiation genes. This drift at Polycomb targets contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity that characterizes aging. Preventing such drift at Polycomb targets is a goal of epigenetic rejuvenation approaches.
description_zh_TW: Polycomb 族蛋白是表觀遺傳漂變的主要目標，因為 Polycomb 抑制複合物標記的基因特別容易受到與年齡相關的甲基化變化的影響。 Polycomb 複合物沉積的 H3K27me3 標記和相關的 CpG 甲基化往往在老化過程中獲得，從而改變發育和分化基因的表達。 Polycomb 標靶的這種漂移導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失，而這正是衰老的特徵。防止多梳目標的這種漂移是表觀遺傳復興方法的目標。

label: Global Hypomethylation
description: The best-characterized signature of epigenetic drift is global hypomethylation of repetitive elements and gene bodies coupled with site-specific hypermethylation of gene promoters. This age-related divergence of methylation patterns erodes the stability of the epigenome and contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity. Because drift accumulates with time and is modified by environment, lifestyle, and interventions such as caloric restriction, it underlies both biological aging and the age-associated increase in disease risk.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳漂變的最佳特徵是重複元件和基因體的整體低甲基化以及基因啟動子的位點特異性高甲基化。這種與年齡相關的甲基化模式的差異會侵蝕表觀基因組的穩定性，並導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失。由於漂移會隨著時間的推移而累積，並會受到環境、生活方式和熱量限制等乾預措施的改變，因此它是生物老化和與年齡相關的疾病風險增加的基礎。

label: BDNF (via SIRT1/FoxO)
description: Caloric restriction and intermittent fasting elevate BDNF through SIRT1/FoxO-dependent pathways, contributing to cognitive resilience against aging. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of BDNF elevation via SIRT1/FoxO. This neuroprotective adaptation complements CR's systemic benefits, and it motivates CR and fasting for brain health. By raising BDNF through sirtuin-dependent mechanisms, caloric restriction supports synaptic plasticity, neurogenesis, and neuronal survival. These effects contribute to the protection of cognitive function during aging.
description_zh_TW: 限制熱量和間歇性禁食透過 SIRT1/FoxO 依賴性途徑提高 BDNF，有助於對抗衰老的認知韌性。在方向性上，限制熱量位於透過 SIRT1/FoxO 提升 BDNF 的上游。這種神經保護適應與限制熱量的全身益處互補，並推動限制熱量和禁食對大腦健康的益處。透過透過 sirtuin 依賴性機制提高 BDNF，限制熱量支持突觸可塑性、神經新生和神經元存活。這些效應有助於在衰老過程中保護認知功能。

label: NAD+/nicotinamide ratio (brain)
description: Caloric restriction elevates the brain NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, which both supplies more co-substrate for sirtuins and relieves nicotinamide-mediated feedback inhibition of SIRT1. The resulting gain in sirtuin activity supports neuronal stress resistance, mitochondrial function, and suppression of neuroinflammatory signaling. The relationship is directional: CR shifts the ratio upward, which then potentiates sirtuin-dependent protective programs. This mechanism is frequently invoked to explain CR's protective effects against age-related cognitive decline and neurodegenerative pathology.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高大腦的 NAD+/菸鹼醯胺比值，這既為 sirtuin 提供了更多共同受質，又解除了菸鹼醯胺介導的 SIRT1 回饋抑制。由此產生的 sirtuin 活性增強支持神經元的壓力抗性、粒線體功能和抑制神經發炎信號。這種關係是方向性的：CR 使比值上升，然後增強 sirtuin 依賴性的保護程序。這種機制經常被用來解釋 CR 對抗年齡相關認知退化和神經退行性病變的保護效應。

label: SIRT3 (and downregulates SIRT4)
description: Caloric restriction upregulates SIRT3 and downregulates SIRT4, shifting the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio toward a protective, oxidative-phosphorylation-promoting state. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of the ratio shift. This counters the age-related pattern of declining SIRT3 and rising SIRT4, and it is a core mechanism of CR's metabolic benefits. By biasing the balance toward SIRT3, caloric restriction promotes mitochondrial oxidation, antioxidant defense, and metabolic flexibility. This ratio shift is a key molecular readout of the beneficial effects of dietary restriction.
description_zh_TW: 限制熱量上調 SIRT3 並下調 SIRT4，將 SIRT3/SIRT4 比率推向保護性的、促氧化磷酸化狀態。在方向性上，限制熱量位於比率變化的上游。這對抗了衰老相關的 SIRT3 下降和 SIRT4 上升模式，是限制熱量代謝益處的核心機制。透過使平衡傾向 SIRT3，限制熱量促進粒線體氧化、抗氧化防禦和代謝靈活性。這種比率變化是飲食限制有益效應的關鍵分子讀數。

label: Drosophila melanogaster
description: Dietary restriction in Drosophila extends lifespan and, as in yeast, this benefit requires the dSir2 (Sir2) gene, indicating evolutionary conservation of the sirtuin-mediated CR pathway. The effect is thought to operate through improved protein homeostasis, stress resistance, and metabolic efficiency rather than simple calorie shortage. Directionally, reduced nutrient signaling upstream engages dSir2 to produce the longevity phenotype. Caveats include that the magnitude and requirement vary with sex, genetic background, and the precise restriction paradigm used.
description_zh_TW: 在果蠅中，飲食限制延長壽命，且與酵母中一樣，這種益處需要 dSir2（Sir2）基因，表明 sirtuin 介導的 CR 通路具有演化保守性。該效應被認為是通過改善蛋白質穩態、壓力抗性和代謝效率，而非簡單的熱量不足來運作。在方向性上，減少的營養信號在上游啟動 dSir2，從而產生長壽表型。需要注意的是，該效應的強度和需求因性別、遺傳背景和所使用的具體限制方案而異。

label: β-amyloid neuropathology (Alzheimer's mouse model)
description: In mouse models engineered to develop Alzheimer's-like pathology, caloric restriction prevents accumulation of β-amyloid neuropathology, an effect consistent with SIRT1-driven reductions in neuroinflammation and oxidative stress. CR also preserves cognitive function and synaptic integrity in these models. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of reduced amyloid burden. This supports the hypothesis that CR protects the brain through sirtuin-mediated resilience, and is consistent with SIRT1's promotion of the non-amyloidogenic α-secretase ADAM10. Human translation remains uncertain, but the findings motivate lifestyle interventions and NAD+-boosting strategies in neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: 在被設計發展出阿茲海默症樣病變的小鼠模型中，熱量限制防止 β-amyloid 神經病理學的累積，這種效應與 SIRT1 驅動的神經發炎和氧化壓力減少一致。CR 還在這些模型中保留認知功能和突觸完整性。在方向性上，熱量限制位於減少澱粉樣蛋白負擔的上游。這支持了 CR 通過 sirtuin 介導的韌性保護大腦的假說，與 SIRT1 促進非澱粉樣生成的 α-分泌酶 ADAM10 一致。人類轉化仍然不確定，但這些發現為神經退行性疾病中的生活方式干預和 NAD+ 提升策略提供了動力。

label: SIRT1 expression
description: In rodents, caloric restriction raises SIRT1 levels in multiple tissues, and this elevation is linked to reduced inflammatory and oxidative responses. Higher SIRT1 expression translates into enhanced deacetylation of targets such as NF-κB, FOXO, and PGC-1α, promoting stress resistance and metabolic health. The directionality is that CR is the upstream stimulus and increased SIRT1 abundance/activity the downstream mediator. This adaptation is considered a key explanation for the anti-aging and disease-protective effects of CR in mammals.
description_zh_TW: 在齧齒動物中，熱量限制在多個組織中提高 SIRT1 水平，這種升高與減少的發炎和氧化反應相關。更高的 SIRT1 表達轉化為對 NF-κB、FOXO 和 PGC-1α 等靶標的增強去乙醯化，促進壓力抗性和代謝健康。其方向性為 CR 是上游刺激，SIRT1 表達量/活性增加是下游介導因子。這種適應被認為是 CR 在哺乳動物中抗衰老和疾病保護效應的關鍵解釋。

label: Butyrate
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid produced by gut bacteria such as Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, Eubacterium rectale, and Roseburia, reduces adiposity by inhibiting intestinal cholesterol biosynthesis and promoting beneficial metabolic effects including insulin secretion, insulin sensitivity, and energy expenditure. Butyrate can also increase satiety and gut motility by upregulating the expression of peptide YY and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1). In studies where NR supplementation enriched butyrate-producing Firmicutes, these metabolic benefits contributed to protection against high-fat diet-induced weight gain, and fecal transfer reproduced the effect, underscoring butyrate as a key mediator of microbiota-driven metabolic health.
description_zh_TW: 丁酸是一種由腸道細菌如 Faecalibacterium prausnitzii、Eubacterium rectale 和 Roseburia 產生的短鏈脂肪酸，透過抑制腸道膽固醇生合成並促進包括胰島素分泌、胰島素敏感性與能量消耗在內的有益代謝效應來減少肥胖。丁酸也能透過上調 peptide YY 與類升糖素胜肽-1（GLP-1）的表現來增加飽足感與腸道蠕動。在 NR 補充富集產丁酸 Firmicutes 的研究中，這些代謝益處有助於防護高脂飲食誘發的體重增加，且糞便移植重現了此效應，凸顯丁酸作為微生物群驅動代謝健康的關鍵介導者。

label: Environment
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic alterations—The silent indicator for early aging and age‐associated health‐risks.md
description: Unlike the largely static genome, the epigenome is dynamic and responsive to diet, stress, exercise, toxins, and social environment. Environmental signals modify DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNA expression, shaping gene expression over the lifespan and influencing the pace of biological aging. This responsiveness links lifestyle and environmental exposures to long-term health outcomes and provides a mechanistic basis for the effects of behavior and environment on aging.
description_zh_TW: 與基本上靜態的基因組不同，表觀基因組是動態的，並對飲食、壓力、運動、毒素和社會環境做出反應。環境訊號會改變 DNA 甲基化、組蛋白修飾和非編碼 RNA 表達，在整個生命週期中塑造 gene expression 並影響生物老化的速度。這種反應性將生活方式和環境暴露與長期健康結果聯繫起來，並為行為和環境對老化的影響提供了機制基礎。

label: Thermogenesis
description: FGF21 induces thermogenesis and promotes energy expenditure through UCP1-dependent mechanisms. FGF21 promotes thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue, with protein restriction stimulating WAT beiging via FGF21 action in the brain through sympathetic signaling, and PR similarly increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue via an FGF21-dependent mechanism. These effects drive the increased energy expenditure observed with protein restriction and contribute to its metabolic benefits including reduced body weight and adiposity despite increased food intake. FGF21 also regulates lipid homeostasis, reducing circulating triglycerides, and mediates PR effects on senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue.
description_zh_TW: FGF21透過UCP1依賴性機制誘發產熱並促進能量消耗。FGF21促進白色脂肪組織的產熱性米色化（beiging），而蛋白質限制會經由腦中FGF21的作用、透過交感神經訊號刺激WAT米色化；PR同樣透過FGF21依賴性機制增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱。這些效應驅動了蛋白質限制所觀察到的能量消耗增加，並促成其代謝益處，包括在食物攝取增加的情況下仍降低體重與脂肪量。FGF21也調節脂質恆定、降低循環三酸甘油酯，並中介PR對白色脂肪組織中衰老與發炎的效應。

label: Glucose Homeostasis
description: Protein restriction improves glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity in both rodents and humans. In young and aged rodents, PR reduces body weight and fat mass, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose handling even when initiated late in life. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and lower hemoglobin A1C and kidney disease outcomes in diabetic patients. BCAA restriction similarly improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis in humans, and methionine restriction improves glucose homeostasis in humans on strict vegan diets. These metabolic benefits contrast with high-protein diets associated with increased diabetes risk.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改善囓齒動物和人類的葡萄糖恆定性和胰島素敏感性。在年輕和年老的囓齒動物中，PR減少體重和脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖處理，即使在生命晚期開始。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性，並降低糖尿病患者的血紅素A1C和腎臟疾病結果。BCAA限制同樣改善人類的胰島素敏感性和葡萄糖/胰島素恆定性，甲硫氨酸限制改善嚴格素食者的人類葡萄糖恆定性。這些代謝益處與與糖尿病風險增加相關的高蛋白飲食形成對比。

label: Citrate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: SLC25A1, the mitochondrial citrate carrier, exports citrate from the mitochondrial matrix to the cytosol, where it can be converted to acetyl-CoA. SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels in multiple senescence contexts, and this citrate export sustains the nucleocytosolic acetyl-CoA pool required for histone acetylation. Genetic ablation of SLC25A1 does not alter CDK inhibitor expression or cell cycle arrest but markedly reduces SASP gene expression, and inhibition with the third-generation inhibitor CTPI2 selectively suppresses SASP-associated inflammation without clearing senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A1，線粒體枸櫞酸載體，將枸櫞酸從線粒體基質輸出到細胞質，在那裡可以轉化為乙酰輔酶A。SLC25A1表達在多種衰老背景下在mRNA和蛋白質水平上都顯著增加，這種枸櫞酸輸出維持組蛋白乙酰化所需的核質乙酰輔酶A池。SLC25A1的基因消融不改變CDK抑製劑表達或細胞週期停滯，但顯著減少SASP基因表達，使用第三代抑製劑CTPI2的抑製選擇性地抑制SASP相關炎症而不清除衰老細胞。

label: SIRT1 allele variants
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Several single-nucleotide polymorphisms in the human SIRT1 gene are significantly associated with systemic energy expenditure in Finnish cohorts, suggesting that SIRT1 variation influences metabolic rate. These variants may alter SIRT1 expression or activity, shifting how individuals burn fuel at rest and during activity. Directionally, genetic SIRT1 variation is linked to an energy-expenditure phenotype. As with most genetic-association findings, effect sizes are modest and context-dependent, and replication in other populations is needed.
description_zh_TW: 人類 SIRT1 基因中的幾個單核苷酸多態性與芬蘭研究組的全身能量消耗顯著相關，表明 SIRT1 變異影響代謝率。這些變異可能改變 SIRT1 的表達或活性，改變個體在靜息和活動狀態下的燃料燃燒方式。在方向性上，遺傳性 SIRT1 變異與能量消耗表型相關。與大多數遺傳關聯研究一樣，效應量 modest 且取決於情境，需要在其他人群中進行複製驗證。

label: 7-Ketocholesterol
description: 7-ketocholesterol induces apoptosis through ROS-dependent mitochondrial permeabilization and activation of caspase-3, contributing to death of macrophage foam cells in plaques. As a major oxysterol in oxidized LDL, it is implicated in plaque necrosis. The directionality is oxysterol to programmed cell death. A caveat is that 7-ketocholesterol effects are concentration-dependent and can also trigger inflammatory and autophagic responses before death. Plasma and lesion 7-KC levels correlate with plaque vulnerability, and its toxicity to vascular cells is a recognized contributor to plaque necrosis.
description_zh_TW: 7-ketocholesterol透過ROS依賴性mitochondria1透化和caspase-3的活化誘導apoptosis，導致斑塊中巨噬細胞泡沫細胞死亡。作為 oxidized LDL 中的主要氧甾醇，它與噬菌斑 necrosis 有關。方向性是氧甾醇到程序性細胞死亡。需要注意的是，7-ketocholesterol 的作用具有濃度依賴性，也可能在死亡前引發發炎和自噬反應。血漿和病變 7-KC 水平與斑塊脆弱性相關，其對血管細胞的毒性是斑塊 necQrosis 的公認貢獻者。

label: PAK2
description: PAK2 directly binds and phosphorylates Caspase-7 at Ser30, Thr173, and Ser239, neutralizing its effector function and promoting survival in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: PAK2 直接結合並在 Ser30、Thr173 與 Ser239 磷酸化 Caspase-7，中和其效應器功能並在乳癌中促進存活。

label: RSK
description: RSK phosphorylates APAF-1 at Ser268, causing inhibition in prostate cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: RSK 在 Ser268 磷酸化 APAF-1，在攝護腺癌細胞中造成抑制。

label: TBK1
description: TBK1 and IKKε phosphorylate XIAP at Ser430 within its RING finger domain, triggering Lys48-linked autoubiquitination and proteasomal degradation, sensitizing cells to apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: TBK1 與 IKKε 在 XIAP 的 RING 指狀結構域內的 Ser430 磷酸化，觸發 Lys48 連結的自身泛素化與蛋白酶體降解，使細胞對凋亡敏感。

label: c-ABL
description: c-ABL phosphorylates Caspase-9 at Tyr153, promoting caspase activation and DNA damage-induced apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: c-ABL 在 Tyr153 磷酸化 Caspase-9，促進 caspase 活化與 DNA 損傷誘發的凋亡。

label: ICAD
description: Caspase-3 cleaves ICAD. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. ICAD is the inhibitor of caspase-activated DNase that, upon caspase-3 cleavage, releases CAD to fragment nuclear DNA. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon ICAD rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 分裂 ICAD。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 ICAD 是 caspase 活化的 DNase 抑制劑，在 caspase-3 裂解時，釋放 CAD 以片段化核 DNA。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 ICAD 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: PKCδ
description: Caspase-3 is enhanced by PKCδ. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. PKCδ is a protein kinase C isoform that can both enhance caspase-3 activity and, in some contexts, promote apoptotic signaling. The directionality runs from PKCδ toward Caspase-3, so PKCδ is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 被 PKCδ 增強。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 PKCδ 是一種蛋白激酶 C 同工型，既可以增強 caspase-3 活性，也可以在某些情況下促進細胞凋亡訊號傳導。方向性從 PKCδ 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 PKCδ 是主動主體，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: LYN
description: Caspase-8 is inhibited by LYN. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. LYN is a Src-family kinase that, like SRC and FYN, can phosphorylate and inactivate caspase-8 to promote cell survival. The directionality runs from LYN toward Caspase-8, so LYN is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect.
