This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-8 被 LYN 抑制。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。 LYN 是一種 Src 家族激酶，與 SRC 和 FYN 一樣，可以磷酸化 caspase-8 並使其失去活性，以促進細胞存活。方向性從 LYN 向 Caspase-8，因此 LYN 是活性劑，Caspase-8 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: PKCζ
description: Caspase-9 is inhibited by PKCζ. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. PKCzeta is an atypical protein kinase C isoform that can phosphorylate and inhibit caspase-9 to blunt apoptosis. The directionality runs from PKCζ toward Caspase-9, so PKCζ is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-9 被 PKCζ 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 PKCzeta 是一種非典型蛋白激酶 C 同工型，可磷酸化並抑制 caspase-9 以抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 PKCζ 向 Caspase-9，因此 PKCζ 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: DR4
description: DISC is formed by DR4. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. DR4 (TRAIL-R1) is a death receptor that binds TRAIL and nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis. The directionality runs from DR4 toward DISC, so DR4 is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: DISC 由 DR4 組成。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 DR4 (TRAIL-R1) 是一種死亡受體，可結合 TRAIL 並使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性細胞凋亡。方向性從 DR4 向 DISC，因此 DR4 是活性劑，DISC 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: DR5
description: DISC is formed by DR5. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. DR5 (TRAIL-R2) is a death receptor that binds TRAIL and nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis, often more prominently than DR4. The directionality runs from DR5 toward DISC, so DR5 is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: DISC由DR5組成。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 DR5 (TRAIL-R2) 是一種死亡受體，它與 TRAIL 結合並使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，通常比 DR4 更顯著。方向性從 DR5 朝向 DISC，因此 DR5 是活性劑，DISC 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: Fas
description: DISC is formed by Fas. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. Fas (CD95) is a death receptor whose ligation by FasL initiates the extrinsic apoptotic pathway through DISC assembly. The directionality runs from Fas toward DISC, so Fas is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: DISC 由 Fas 組成。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 Fas (CD95) 是一種死亡受體，其與 FasL 的連接可透過 DISC 組裝啟動外源性凋亡路徑。方向性從 Fas 向 DISC，因此 Fas 是活性劑，DISC 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: FADD
description: DISC uses FADD. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. FADD is the core death-adaptor protein of the DISC that bridges death receptors to procaspase-8 via its death domain and DED. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon FADD rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: DISC 使用 FADD。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 FADD is the core death-adaptor protein of the DISC that bridges death receptors to procaspase-8 via its death domain and DED. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon FADD rather than than reverse.這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標誌物機會具有重要意義。

label: miR-24
description: XIAP is downregulated by miR-24. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. miR-24 is a microRNA that targets several anti-apoptotic and cell-cycle mRNAs, including XIAP, to lower the death threshold. The directionality runs from miR-24 toward XIAP, so miR-24 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: XIAP 被 miR-24 下調。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 miR-24 是一種 microRNA，可針對多種抗凋亡和細胞週期 mRNA（包括 XIAP），以降低死亡閾值。方向性從 miR-24 向 XIAP，因此 miR-24 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: miR-7
description: XIAP is downregulated by miR-7. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. miR-7 is a microRNA with tumor-suppressive roles that downregulates survival proteins such as XIAP and EGFR signaling. The directionality runs from miR-7 toward XIAP, so miR-7 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: XIAP 被 miR-7 下調。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 miR-7 是一種具有腫瘤抑製作用的 microRNA，可下調 XIAP 和 EGFR 訊號等存活蛋白。方向性從 miR-7 朝向 XIAP，因此 miR-7 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of p53
description: By deacetylating p53, SIRT1 lowers p53's transcriptional activation of BH3-only proteins and other apoptotic effectors, suppressing programmed cell death after oxidative or genotoxic stress. This creates a survival bias that helps cells tolerate damage but can also protect incipient cancer cells from elimination. The directionality is that SIRT1 activity on p53 is upstream of reduced apoptosis. A caveat is that chronic suppression of p53-dependent apoptosis is a double-edged sword: protective in normal tissue but potentially tumor-promoting.
description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 p53，SIRT1 降低 p53 對 BH3-only 蛋白和其他凋亡效應因子的轉錄活化，在氧化或基因毒性壓力後抑制程序性細胞死亡。這創造了一種存活偏向，幫助細胞耐受損傷，但也可能保護早期癌細胞免於被清除。其方向性為 SIRT1 對 p53 的活性在減少凋亡的上游。需要注意的是，長期抑制 p53 依賴性凋亡是一把雙刃劍：在正常組織中具有保護作用，但可能促進腫瘤。

label: TRIAD
description: TRIAD (Test of Rapamycin In Aging Dogs) is a parallel-group, double-masked, randomized, placebo-controlled trial testing rapamycin's effect on lifespan and healthspan in companion dogs.
description_zh_TW: TRIAD（Test of Rapamycin In Aging Dogs）是一項平行分組、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照的試驗，測試 rapamycin 對伴侶犬壽命與健康壽命的影響。

label: Hyperlipidemia
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Chronic rapamycin or everolimus use is associated with elevated cholesterol and triglyceride levels (hyperlipidemia), alongside mucosal ulcers, impaired wound healing, delayed tissue repair, and increased infection risk. These metabolic disturbances were common in the EXIST-3 trial and other cohorts, along with stomatitis, infections, and cytopenias. The mechanisms are attributed to both mTORC1 inhibition and unintended mTORC2 suppression, which induces insulin resistance.
description_zh_TW: 慢性rapamycin或everolimus使用與膽固醇和甘油三酯水平升高（高脂血症）相關，並伴有黏膜潰瘍、傷口癒合受損、組織修復延遲和感染風險增加。這些代謝紊亂在EXIST-3試驗和其他隊列中很常見，並伴有口腔炎、感染和血細胞減少症。機制歸因於mTORC1抑制和意外mTORC2抑制，後者誘發胰島素阻抗。

label: Glucose Intolerance
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Chronic rapamycin treatment is associated with metabolic disturbances including glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia in both mice and humans administered rapamycin for prevention of immunosenescence. Mechanistically these effects are attributed not only to mTORC1 inhibition but also to unintended suppression of mTORC2, which induces insulin resistance - a mechanistic trade-off between metabolic side effects and longevity benefits. Houde et al. showed chronic rapamycin causes glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia by upregulating hepatic gluconeogenesis and impairing lipid deposition in adipose tissue.
description_zh_TW: 慢性rapamycin治療與代謝紊亂相關，包括在rapamycin給藥以預防免疫老化的兩者小鼠和人類中的葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。從機制上講，這些效應不僅歸因於mTORC1抑制，還歸因於意外抑制mTORC2，這會誘發胰島素阻抗——這是代謝副作用和壽命益處之間的機制權衡。Houde等人顯示慢性rapamycin透過上調肝臟糖質新生和損害脂肪組織中的脂質沉積來引起葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。

label: Cardiovascular System
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: In a study of 24 middle-aged companion dogs, echocardiography showed improvements in both diastolic and systolic measures of age-related cardiac function (E/A ratio, fractional shortening, and ejection fraction) in dogs treated with rapamycin. Rapamycin also stimulates the breakdown of damaged cytoplasmic elements, reduces oxidative stress, and supports tissue regeneration in cardiac tissue, and induces production of growth factors IGF1 and VEGF while reducing IL-1beta and TNF-alpha to support cardiac regeneration after infarction. Cardiovascular diseases are the main cause of death in the elderly, making mTOR inhibitors a promising direction for cardioprotective research.
description_zh_TW: 在一項24隻中年伴侶犬的研究中，心臟超音波顯示rapamycin治療的犬隻在年齡相關心臟功能的舒張和收縮指標（E/A比、短縮分數和射血分數）方面有所改善。Rapamycin還刺激受損細胞質成分的分解，減少氧化壓力，並支持心臟組織的組織再生，並誘導生長因子IGF1和VEGF的產生，同時減少IL-1beta和TNF-alpha以支持梗塞後的心臟再生。心血管疾病是老年人的主要死因，使得mTOR抑制劑成為心臟保護研究的一個有前途的方向。

label: CYP3A4
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Rapamycin and its analogs are metabolized by the cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP3A4 and are therefore sensitive to pharmacokinetic drug interactions. Cannabidiol (CBD) is a potent CYP3A inhibitor that increases circulating levels of mTOR inhibitors, raising the risk of toxicity - a clinically relevant interaction given the widespread use of CBD and other cannabis products. This has been documented in patients with tuberous sclerosis complex (cannabidiol elevates mechanistic target of rapamycin inhibitor levels) and in a phase 1 healthy volunteer trial of coadministered everolimus and CBD.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin及其類似物通過細胞色素P450酶CYP3A4代謝，因此對藥物動力學相互作用敏感。大麻二酚（CBD）是一種強效CYP3A抑製劑，可增加mTOR抑製劑的循環水平，從而增加毒性風險——考慮到CBD和其他大麻產品的廣泛使用，這是一個臨床相關的相互作用。這在結節性硬化症患者（大麻二酚升高rapamycin抑製劑水平）和everolimus與CBD共同給藥的1期健康誌願者試驗中已有記錄。

label: Rapalogs
description: Rapamycin is a natural anti-fungal antibiotic produced by soil bacteria of Eastern Island whose patent has expired, and pharmacological companies have developed other rapalogs such as everolimus. The term rapalogs encompasses rapamycin, everolimus and any other analogs, and at equipotent doses rapamycin and everolimus exert almost identical therapeutic and adverse effects, although everolimus is weaker and has a shorter half-life. All current rapalogs exhibit the same side effects as rapamycin and everolimus, and their real side effects are mTORC1-dependent.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin是一種由東方島土壤細菌產生的天然抗真菌抗生素，其專利已過期，藥理學公司已開發出其他rapalog，如everolimus。術語rapalog包括rapamycin、everolimus和任何其他類似物，在等效劑量下，rapamycin和everolimus幾乎產生相同的治療和不良反應，盡管everolimus作用較弱且半衰期較短。所有目前的rapalog都表現出與rapamycin和everolimus相同的副作用，且其真正的副作用是mTORC1依賴性的。

label: mTORopathies
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: The success of rapamycin in mTORopathy models stems from clearly defined molecular etiology and robust biomarkers: highly penetrant mutations driving mTOR hyperactivation render the pathway an actionable target. In TSC and GATOR1-related models such as Nprl3 knockout mice, rapamycin prevented seizures, reduced mortality, and rescued neuropathology, including when delivered in utero or postnatally. Everolimus is used as precision therapy in GATOR1-related epilepsies.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin在mTOR病模型中的成功源於明確的分子病因學和強大的生物標誌物：驅動mTOR過度激活的高外顯率突變使該通路成為可操作的靶點。在TSC和GATOR1相關模型（如Nprl3敲除小鼠）中，rapamycin預防了癲癇、降低了死亡率並挽救了神經病理學，包括在子宮內或出生後給藥時。Everolimus被用作GATOR1相關癲癇的精準治療。

label: Stomatitis
description: While aspirin may cause gastric ulceration and bleeding, rapamycin may cause stomatitis and mucositis, ulceration of the mucous membranes of the mouth and digestive tract, when used at high doses or chronically. A rare side effect of rapamycin is noninfectious interstitial pneumonitis, and by inhibiting neutrophil function rapamycin may increase the severity of bacterial infections. These side effects require rapamycin's discontinuation, but for anti-aging purposes rapamycin may be used intermittently (e.g., once a week) or at low daily doses and can be discontinued if any unpleasant effects occur.
description_zh_TW: 雖然aspirin可能導致胃潰瘍和出血，rapamycin在高劑量或長期使用時可能導致口腔炎和黏膜炎，口腔和消化道黏膜的潰瘍。rapamycin的一個罕見副作用是非感染性間質性肺炎，透過抑制中性粒細胞功能，rapamycin可能增加細菌感染的嚴重性。這些副作用需要停止rapamycin，但為了抗老化目的，rapamycin可以間歇性使用（例如，每週一次）或低劑量每日使用，如果發生任何不適效應可以停止。

label: Heterochromatin Decompaction
description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: HERV
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Human endogenous retroviruses activate the cGAS-STING pathway when their expression is derepressed during aging and senescence. Age-related loss of DNA methylation and heterochromatin permits HERV transcription, and the resulting HERV RNA is reverse transcribed into cDNA that is sensed by cGAS, triggering STING-dependent upregulation of type I interferons and SASP factors. HERV-driven innate immune signaling contributes to inflammaging and the paracrine spread of senescence. Suppressing HERV expression or reverse transcription therefore reduces this senescence-driving inflammatory signal.
description_zh_TW: 當人類內源性逆轉錄病毒的表達在老化和老化過程中被抑制時，它們會活化 cGAS-STING 路徑。與年齡相關的 DNA 甲基化和異染色質缺失允許 HERV 轉錄，並且所得的 HERV RNA 被逆轉錄為 cGAS 感知的 cDNA，觸發 I 型乾擾素和 SASP 因子的 STING 依賴性上調。 HERV 驅動的先天免疫訊號傳導有助於發炎和老化的旁分泌擴散。因此，抑制 HERV 表達或逆轉錄可以減少這種老化驅動的發炎訊號。

label: NRTI
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, developed as antiretroviral drugs for HIV, also inhibit LINE-1 retrotransposition. NRTIs act as chain-terminating nucleoside analogs that are incorporated into nascent DNA by reverse transcriptase, halting the synthesis of the L1 cDNA copies that would otherwise be generated from L1 RNA in the cytoplasm. By blocking LINE-1 reverse transcription, NRTIs reduce the cGAS-STING-dependent inflammation and SASP that arise from retrotransposon derepression during aging, and they are being explored as anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: 核苷逆轉錄酶抑制劑是作為 HIV 抗逆轉錄病毒藥物而開發的，也能抑制 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座。 NRTI 充當鏈終止核苷類似物，透過逆轉錄酶將其摻入新生 DNA 中，從而停止 L1 cDNA 副本的合成，否則這些副本將由細胞質中的 L1 RNA 產生。透過阻斷 LINE-1 逆轉錄，NRTI 可以減少 cGAS-STING 依賴性發炎和老化過程中逆轉錄轉座子去抑制引起的 SASP，並且它們正在被探索作為抗衰老幹預措施。

label: MOTS-c
description: MOTS-c is a 16 amino acid peptide encoded by the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene, and is one of eight mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs) described to date along with humanin and small humanin-like peptides 1-6 (SHLPs 1-6). It is an exercise-induced factor that increases insulin sensitivity and visceral fat accumulation, with circulating levels rising acutely with exercise. The peptide has also been observed to translocate to the nucleus during energetic stress, suggesting both cell-autonomous and non-cell-autonomous functions.
description_zh_TW: MOTS-c是由粒線體12S rRNA基因編碼的16胺基酸肽，是迄今描述的八種粒線體衍生肽（MDPs）之一，與humanin和小型humanin類似肽1-6（SHLPs 1-6）並列。它是一種運動誘導因子，可增加胰島素敏感性和內臟脂肪堆積，其循環水平在運動後急性升高。該肽還被觀察到在能量應激時易位至細胞核，提示其具有細胞自主和非細胞自主功能。

label: Yeast
description: Overexpression of the sirtuin Sir2 extends lifespan in budding yeast by suppressing the formation of toxic extrachromosomal rDNA circles. Sir2 maintains silencing at the rDNA locus, and its activity prevents the homologous recombination events that generate these circles during aging. This early discovery established sirtuins as longevity regulators and motivated extensive study of their mammalian homologs, particularly SIRT1, in aging and age-related disease, including the search for small-molecule sirtuin activators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin Sir2 的過度表現可透過抑制有毒染色體外 rDNA 環的形成來延長芽殖酵母的壽命。 Sir2 在 rDNA 基因座上保持沉默，其活性可防止在老化過程中產生這些環的同源重組事件。這項早期發現確立了去乙醯化酶作為長壽調節劑的地位，並推動了對其哺乳動物同源物（特別是 SIRT1）在衰老和年齡相關疾病中的廣泛研究，包括尋找小分子去乙醯化酶激活劑。

label: Amurensin G
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Amurensin G is a resveratrol tetramer natural product reported among compounds that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations and endowed with anticancer activity. It belongs to a series that includes aristoforin, polyphenols, and tanikolide identified through general screens of structurally diverse natural products. Directionally, amurensin G suppresses sirtuin deacetylase activity. Its isoform selectivity and mechanism are incompletely characterized, and its anticancer effect may involve both sirtuin inhibition and additional natural-product bioactivities.
description_zh_TW: Amurensin G 是一種白藜蘆醇四聚體天然產物，據報導屬於在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的化合物，並具有抗癌活性。它屬於包括 aristoforin、多酚類和 tanikolide 在內的系列，透過對結構多樣化天然產物的廣泛篩選而鑑定。方向性上 amurensin G 抑制 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。其同工型選擇性和作用機制尚未完全表徵，其抗癌效果可能同時涉及 sirtuin 抑制和天然產物的其他生物活性。

label: Aristoforin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Aristoforin is one of several natural products reported to inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations, alongside amurensin G, polyphenols, and tanikolide. These compounds expand the chemical diversity of sirtuin inhibitors beyond synthetic scaffolds. Directionally, aristoforin blocks sirtuin deacetylase activity at micromolar potency. As with many natural-product sirtuin modulators, target selectivity, mechanism, and additional cellular targets are less characterized than for synthetic inhibitors, so the anticancer contributions of sirtuin inhibition versus other effects remain to be disentangled.
description_zh_TW: Aristoforin 是多種據報導在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的天然產物之一，與 amurensin G、多酚類和 tanikolide 並列。這些化合物擴展了 sirtuin 抑制劑超越合成骨架的化學多樣性。方向性上 aristoforin 以微摩爾活性阻斷 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。與許多天然產物 sirtuin 調節劑一樣，其靶標選擇性、作用機制和額外的細胞靶標不如合成抑制劑那樣被充分表徵，因此 sirtuin 抑制與其他效應的抗癌貢獻仍有待釐清。

label: Mono-ADP-ribosyl transferases
description: Beyond deacetylation, several sirtuins catalyze mono-ADP-ribosylation, transferring the ADP-ribose moiety of NAD+ onto target proteins without removing an acetyl group. SIRT4 and SIRT6 prominently display this mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity, with SIRT6 using it to recruit heterochromatin proteins such as KAP1/HP1α. The directionality is that NAD+ is the donor and the target lysine (or other residue) is the acceptor, producing a mono-ADP-ribosylated product rather than free OAADPr. Biologically, ADP-ribosylation allows sirtuins to regulate processes—such as DNA repair and LINE-1 repression—distinct from their deacetylase functions.
description_zh_TW: 除了去乙醯化作用外，多種 sirtuin 還能催化單 ADP-核糖基化，將 NAD+ 的 ADP-核糖基團轉移到目標蛋白上，而不移除乙醯基。SIRT4 和 SIRT6 顯著表現出這種單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性，其中 SIRT6 利用該活性招募異染色質蛋白如 KAP1/HP1α。其方向性為 NAD+ 作為供體，目標離胺酸（或其他殘基）作為受體，產生單 ADP-核糖基化的產物而非游離的 OAADPr。在生物學上，ADP-核糖基化允許 sirtuin 調節 DNA 修復和 LINE-1 抑制等過程，這些功能與其去乙醯酶功能不同。

label: mTOR signaling
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Nutrient abundance activates the mTOR pathway, which promotes anabolic processes such as protein synthesis and lipid accumulation while suppressing autophagy. Sirtuins counterbalance this anabolic state by favoring catabolic pathways that restore metabolic equilibrium. Directionally, sirtuins and mTOR act as opposed nutrient-sensing axes. This opposition is most evident during caloric restriction or fasting, when falling nutrient signals dampen mTOR while NAD+-sensitive sirtuins drive fatty-acid oxidation, mitochondrial maintenance, and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 營養豐富活化mTOR通路，促進蛋白質合成和脂質積累等合成代謝過程，同時抑制自噬。Sirtuin透過有利於恢復代謝平衡的分解代謝途徑來平衡此合成代謝狀態。方向上，sirtuin和mTOR作為對立的營養感知軸。這種對抗在熱量限制或禁食時最為明顯，此時營養訊號下降抑制mTOR，而NAD+敏感的sirtuin驅動脂肪酸氧化、粒線體維護和自噬。

label: PARP1 and PARP2
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: PARP1 and PARP2 are major NAD+-consuming enzymes whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ pools and compromise sirtuin function, creating competition for the same limited co-substrate. Directionally, PARP activity sits upstream of NAD+ consumption and reduced sirtuin availability. This competition is especially relevant during DNA damage, when PARP activation surges and rapidly consumes NAD+ to synthesize ADP-ribose polymers. Because both PARPs and sirtuins are essential for genome maintenance and stress responses, their shared dependence on NAD+ creates an intrinsic trade-off.
description_zh_TW: PARP1和PARP2是主要的NAD+消耗酶，其活性可以耗竭細胞NAD+池並損害sirtuin功能，造成對相同有限共同底物的競爭。方向上，PARP活性位於NAD+消耗和sirtuin可用性降低的上游。這種競爭在DNA損傷期間尤為重要，因為PARP活化急劇上升並迅速消耗NAD+以合成ADP-核糖聚合物。由於PARP和sirtuin都對基因組維護和壓力反應至關重要，它們對NAD+的共同依賴造成了一種內在的權衡。

label: Adenosine-binding site with kinases
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Sirtuins and protein kinases both contain an adenosine-binding pocket in their catalytic machinery, an overlap that allowed screening of known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2. This shared scaffold led to the discovery that bisindolylmaleimides such as Ro31-8220 and indolinones such as GW5074 inhibit SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. Directionally, the shared adenosine site is the molecular basis for cross-inhibition between kinase inhibitors and sirtuins, but it also means these compounds retain kinase activity, complicating the attribution of cellular effects to sirtuin inhibition alone.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 和蛋白激酶在其催化機制中都包含一個腺嘌呤結合口袋，這種重疊使得已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的篩選成為可能。這種共享的骨架結構導致發現雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺如 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮如 GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。方向性上共享的腺嘌呤位點是激酶抑制劑和 sirtuin 之間交叉抑制的分子基礎，但也意味著這些化合物保留了激酶活性，使將細胞效應歸因於單純 sirtuin 抑制變得複雜。

label: Deacetylases
description: Sirtuins are class III histone deacetylases whose catalytic mechanism absolutely requires NAD+ as a co-substrate, coupling deacetylation to the cellular redox and energy state. Each turnover hydrolyzes one NAD+ molecule into nicotinamide and 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose while removing an acetyl group from a lysine residue on the target protein. This strict NAD+ dependence means sirtuin activity rises when the NAD+/NADH ratio is high, as occurs during caloric restriction, exercise, or fasting, and falls when NAD+ is depleted. A caveat is that this dependency creates competition with other NAD+-consuming enzymes such as CD38 and PARPs for the same limited co-substrate pool.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 是第三類組蛋白去乙醯酶，其催化機制絕對需要 NAD+ 作為共同受質，將去乙醯化反應與細胞氧化還原狀態和能量狀態偶聯。每次催化週期水解一分子 NAD+，產生菸鹼醯胺和 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose，同時從目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基上移除一個乙醯基。這種嚴格的 NAD+ 依賴性意味著當 NAD+/NADH 比值升高時——例如在熱量限制、運動或禁食期間——sirtuin 活性會上升，而當 NAD+ 被消耗殆盡時則會下降。需要注意的是，這種依賴性使其與其他 NAD+ 消耗酶（如 CD38 和 PARP）競爭相同的有限共同受質庫。

label: Tanikolide
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Tanikolide is a natural product reported to inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations, grouped with aristoforin, amurensin G, and polyphenols as structurally diverse natural sirtuin inhibitors. Directionally, tanikolide blocks sirtuin deacetylase activity at micromolar potency. As with companion natural products, its selectivity and the biological significance of its sirtuin inhibition relative to other targets remain less well studied than for synthetic inhibitors such as EX-527 and the tenovins.
description_zh_TW: Tanikolide 是一種據報導在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的天然產物，與 aristoforin、amurensin G 和多酚類一起被歸類為結構多樣化的天然 sirtuin 抑制劑。方向性上 tanikolide 以微摩爾活性阻斷 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。與伴隨的天然產物一樣，其選擇性及 sirtuin 抑制相對於其他靶標的生物學意義，仍不如合成抑制劑如 EX-527 和 tenovin 被研究得充分。

label: Rossmann fold domain
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The conserved catalytic core of sirtuins features a large Rossmann fold domain typical of NAD+ binding proteins, together with a small zinc-binding domain and flexible loops that bring the two domains together around an extended cleft for cofactor and substrate. The Rossmann domain contains six parallel beta-strands and a Gly-X-Gly phosphate-binding motif. Directionally, this architecture is intrinsic to the sirtuin family and explains their strict NAD+ dependence. Understanding the structure underscores why NAD+ analogs and pocket C binders act as sirtuin modulators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 的保守催化核心具有大型 Rossmann 摺疊結構域，這是 NAD+ 結合蛋白的典型特徵，還有一個小型鋅結合結構域和柔性環，將兩個結構域圍繞在一個延伸的溝槽周圍以容納輔因子和受質。Rossmann 結構域包含六條平行 beta 鏈和一個 Gly-X-Gly 磷酸鹽結合基序。方向性上這種架構是 sirtuin 家族固有的，解釋了其嚴格的 NAD+ 依賴性。理解此結構凸顯了為何 NAD+ 類似物和口袋 C 結合分子可作為 sirtuin 調節劑。

label: Curcumin
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: The review highlights natural compounds, especially curcumin, as candidates to activate or otherwise regulate sirtuins, positioning them as low-toxicity anti-ageing interventions. Directionally, curcumin is upstream as a putative sirtuin modulator. A caveat is that the review frames this as a hope/area of active research rather than established clinical efficacy, and sirtuin activation by curcumin remains less mechanistically defined than for resveratrol.
description_zh_TW: 該綜述強調天然化合物，特別是 Curcumin，作為活化或以其他方式調節 sirtuin 的候選物，將其定位為低毒性的抗老化介入措施。方向性上 Curcumin 作為推定的 sirtuin 調節劑位於上游。需要注意的是該綜述將此定位為希望/積極研究的領域而非已確立的臨床療效，且 Curcumin 對 sirtuin 的活化在機制上的定義不如 resveratrol 明確。

label: NAD+-dependent enzyme
description: The sirtuin family comprises seven mammalian members (SIRT1–SIRT7) plus the ancestral yeast Sir2, all sharing an NAD+-dependent catalytic core that performs deacetylation and ADP-ribosylation. They differ in subcellular localization—nuclear (SIRT1, SIRT6, SIRT7), cytoplasmic (SIRT2), and mitochondrial (SIRT3, SIRT4, SIRT5)—which dictates their substrate portfolios. The directionality is that NAD+ is the obligate co-substrate for every family member. This unifying dependence ties sirtuin activity to the cellular energy and redox state.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 家族包含七個哺乳動物成員（SIRT1–SIRT7）加上祖先型酵母 Sir2，均共享一個 NAD+ 依賴性催化核心，執行去乙醯化和 ADP-核糖基化。它們在次細胞定位上有所不同——核內（SIRT1、SIRT6、SIRT7）、細胞質（SIRT2）和粒線體（SIRT3、SIRT4、SIRT5）——這決定了它們的受質譜。其方向性為 NAD+ 是每個家族成員的必需共同受質。這種統一的依賴性將 sirtuin 活性與細胞能量和氧化還原狀態聯繫起來。

label: five classes (I-IV and U)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The sirtuin family has been classified into five distinct classes (I-IV and U) based on a phylogenetic study of sirtuins from a wide range of prokaryotes and eukaryotes. SIR-2.1, Drosophila melanogaster Sir2 (D.mel1), Hst1, and SIRT1 all belong to subclass Ia. Subclass Ib includes Hst2, D.mel2, and various fungi and protozoa sirtuins along with SIRT2 and SIRT3. SIRT4 and SIRT5 belong to classes II and III, respectively. SIRT6 and SIRT7 belong to Class IV, which includes only eukaryotic sirtuins. Sir2 homologues from bacteria with undifferentiated motifs constitute class U.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin家族根據對廣泛原核和真核生物sirtuin的系統發育研究被分為五個不同的類別（I-IV和U）。SIR-2.1、黑腹果蠅Sir2（D.mel1）、Hst1和SIRT1都屬於Ia亞類。Ib亞類包括Hst2、D.mel2以及各種真菌和原生動物sirtuin，連同SIRT2和SIRT3。SIRT4和SIRT5分別屬於第II和第III類。SIRT6和SIRT7屬於第IV類，僅包括真核sirtuin。具有未分化基序的細菌Sir2同源物構成U類。

label: NAD+ Depletion
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAD+ depletion was observed during the aging process in multiple animals, including humans, and is considered the major risk factor for Alzheimer's disease (AD). Neurodegenerative disorders such as AD are associated with DNA damage and oxidative stress, which accumulate with age and lead to impaired mitochondrial function, while excitotoxicity-driven axonal degeneration causes strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. When administered in AD mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) displays beneficial effects on both oxidative stress and DNA repair by increasing NAD+ levels, and it improves pTau, amyloid-beta, neurogenesis, neuroinflammation, hippocampal synaptic plasticity, and cognition.
description_zh_TW: 在多種動物（包括人類）的老化過程中觀察到 NAD+ 耗竭，且被視為阿茲海默症（AD）的主要風險因子。諸如 AD 之類的神經退化性疾病與 DNA 損傷和氧化壓力相關，這些隨年齡累積並導致粒線體功能受損，而興奮毒性驅動的軸突退化則在神經元中造成強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。在 AD 小鼠模型中給予 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）時，NR 透過提升 NAD+ 水平對氧化壓力與 DNA 修復均展現有益效果，並改善 pTau、amyloid-beta（類澱粉乙型）、神經生成、神經發炎、海馬突觸可塑性與認知功能。

label: Chronic granulomatous disease
description: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
description_zh_TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

label: IGFBP3
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: A second group cloned humanin using a yeast two-hybrid screen as a partner of IGFBP3, and demonstrated that humanin binds to IGFBP3 with high affinity and specificity. IGFBP3 regulates IGF bioactivity and also induces apoptosis and inhibits cell growth independently of IGFs, and humanin protects against IGFBP3-induced apoptosis. Humanin does not interfere with IGF-I/IGFBP-3 binding but appears to bind to the heparin-binding domain of IGFBP-3, and a single amino acid substitution of alanine for phenylalanine at position 6 (F6AHN) abrogates IGFBP-3 binding.
description_zh_TW: 第二個團隊以酵母雙雜交篩選將 humanin 選殖為 IGFBP3 的結合夥伴，並證明 humanin 以高親和力與特異性結合 IGFBP3。IGFBP3 調節 IGF 的生物活性，也獨立於 IGF 誘導凋亡並抑制細胞生長；而 humanin 可保護細胞免受 IGFBP3 誘導的凋亡。Humanin 不干擾 IGF-I/IGFBP-3 的結合，但似乎結合 IGFBP-3 的肝素結合域；第 6 位置苯丙胺酸取代為丙胺酸的單一胺基酸置換（F6AHN）會消除 IGFBP-3 的結合。

label: FPRL1
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: FPRL1, a seven-transmembrane G-protein-coupled receptor, was the first humanin receptor to be described. Humanin acts as an agonist for FPRL1 by inducing Ca2+ mobilization and rapid activation of ERK1/2 signaling, a commonly induced downstream pathway of G-protein-coupled receptors. In neuroblasts, both the 42-aa form of beta-amyloid peptide and humanin activate FPRL1, but only Abeta42 is cytotoxic, and this cytotoxicity is reversed by humanin, suggesting that the neuroprotective effects of humanin might be accomplished by competitively binding to FPRL1, which may contribute to its cytoprotective aspects.
description_zh_TW: FPRL1 是七次跨膜 G 蛋白偶聯受體，為第一個被描述的 humanin 受體。Humanin 作為 FPRL1 的促效劑，誘導 Ca2+ 動員及 ERK1/2 訊號的快速活化，此為 G 蛋白偶聯受體常見誘發的下游路徑。在神經母細胞中，42 個胺基酸形式的 β-類澱粉胜肽與 humanin 都會活化 FPRL1，但只有 Aβ42 具細胞毒性，且此毒性可被 humanin 逆轉，顯示 humanin 的神經保護作用可能是透過競爭性結合 FPRL1 達成，這可能構成其細胞保護特性的一部分。

label: Pancreatic Beta Cells
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin improves glucose tolerance and delays the onset of diabetes in NOD mice, a model of type 1 diabetes involving progressive accumulation of lymphocytes within the pancreatic islets of Langerhans. In NOD mouse pancreata, humanin treatment dramatically suppressed inflammation and lymphocyte infiltration. Furthermore, humanin decreases serum starvation- and cytokine-induced apoptosis in the pancreatic beta-cell line NIT-1, protecting against the IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IFN-gamma released by T cells and activated macrophages, in an ERK- and STAT3-dependent manner, suggesting it may be a therapeutic target for type 1 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 改善 NOD 小鼠的葡萄糖耐受性並延遲糖尿病的發生；NOD 小鼠是第 1 型糖尿病模型，其特徵為淋巴球在胰臟蘭氏小島內逐漸累積。在 NOD 小鼠胰臟中，humanin 治療顯著抑制發炎與淋巴球浸潤。此外，humanin 降低胰臟 beta 細胞株 NIT-1 中血清剝奪與細胞激素誘導的細胞凋亡，以 ERK 與 STAT3 依賴的方式保護細胞免受 T 細胞與活化巨噬細胞釋放的 IL-1beta、TNF-alpha 與 IFN-gamma 傷害，顯示它可能是第 1 型糖尿病的治療標靶。

label: Neuron
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin's cytoprotective effects were first tested and confirmed in vitro against mutant forms of APP and presenilin 1 and 2 which cause familial AD. F11 neuronal cells were challenged by transfecting APP or PS1/2 cDNA or treating with Abeta1-43, and humanin effectively protected neuronal cells from these FAD-related toxicities as shown by trypan blue exclusion and WST-8 assays. Humanin also protects against Abeta25-35 cell death and behavioral deficits, scopolamine-induced memory loss, H2O2-induced cell death in cortical neurons, serum starvation-induced apoptosis, and CoCl2-induced apoptosis in retinal ganglion cells.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 的細胞保護作用首次在體外針對導致家族性 AD 的 APP 與 presenilin 1 和 2 突變形式進行測試並獲得證實。F11 神經元細胞透過轉染 APP 或 PS1/2 cDNA 或處理 Abeta1-43 進行挑戰，humanin 有效保護神經元細胞免受這些 FAD 相關毒性傷害，如台盼藍排除法與 WST-8 分析所示。Humanin 也保護免受 Abeta25-35 誘導的細胞死亡與行為缺陷、東莨菪鹼誘導的記憶喪失、皮質神經元中 H2O2 誘導的細胞死亡、血清剝奪誘導的細胞凋亡，以及視網膜神經節細胞中 CoCl2 誘導的細胞凋亡。

label: Distal Tissues
description: Mitokines are soluble factors released by stressed mitochondria that communicate mitochondrial stress status to distal tissues, enabling cell-non-autonomous regulation of stress responses and lifespan. In C. elegans, knockdown of the cytochrome c oxidase component cco-1 in the brain activates the UPRmt response in the intestine and extends lifespan, implying that stressed mitochondria in the nervous system release signals that modulate stress defenses elsewhere in the soma. This allows mitochondria in one tissue to act as sensors of overall metabolic status for the entire organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體因子是由受壓粒線體釋放的可溶性因子，將粒線體壓力狀態傳遞給遠端組織，實現壓力反應和壽命的細胞非自主性調節。在 C. elegans 中，腦中細胞色素 c 氧化酶成分 cco-1 的敲低會在腸道活化 UPRmt 反應並延長壽命，暗示神經系統中受壓粒線體釋放的訊號在其他體細胞部位調節壓力防禦。這使得一個組織中的粒線體能夠作為整個生物體整體代謝狀態的感測器。

label: Cells
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: The humanin peptide sequence has been proposed to contain a pseudo-signal peptide, and when transfected into neuronal cells humanin is detected in the culture medium, indicating a secretory capacity that is blocked by inhibition of ER-golgi transport processes. Humanin is secreted from cells and found in circulation (plasma) as well as bound to cellular membranes, and its actions are thought to be mediated by specific receptors. This endocrine mode of action distinguishes humanin from other stress-induced mitochondrial retrograde signals, which are cell-autonomous, and supports its role as a non-autonomous signaling factor.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 胜肽序列被提出含有一個偽訊息胜肽，當轉染進入神經元細胞後，humanin 可在培養基中偵測到，顯示其具有分泌能力，而此能力會被 ER-高基氏體運輸過程的抑制所阻斷。Humanin 從細胞分泌並存在於循環（血漿）中，也結合於細胞膜上，其作用被認為是由特定受體所媒介。這種內分泌作用模式使 humanin 有別於其他由壓力誘導、細胞自主性的粒線體逆向訊號，並支持其作為非自主性訊號因子的角色。

label: TFEB at S466/S467/S469
description: AMPK phosphorylates TFEB on a cluster of serine residues (S466, S467, S469) located in its C-terminal regulatory region in response to energy stress. These phosphorylations enhance TFEB transcriptional activity and promote its nuclear accumulation, synergizing with the relief of mTORC1 repression. The modification thereby directly couples low cellular energy status to activation of the autophagy-lysosomal transcriptional program. This AMPK-TFEB axis provides a transcription-level reinforcement of the rapid post-translational induction of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: AMPK 在能量壓力下，於其 C 端調節區的絲胺酸殘基簇（S466、S467、S469）磷酸化 TFEB。這些磷酸化增強 TFEB 轉錄活性並促進其核累積，與 mTORC1 抑制的解除產生協同。此修飾因此直接將低細胞能量狀態耦合到自噬—溶酶體轉錄程序的活化。此 AMPK-TFEB 軸提供了對自噬快速轉譯後誘導的轉錄層次強化。

label: anti-inflammatory effects
description: Berberine exerts potent anti-inflammatory effects through multiple molecular pathways, including inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, downregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and IL-6, and activation of AMPK that improves metabolic and inflammatory status. These actions contribute to its benefits in metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, and gastrointestinal inflammation, and extend to modulation of the gut microbiota. Because its anti-inflammatory activity is independent of the methylation cycle, it does not add methyl burden or inhibit COMT. This makes it a versatile and relatively safe adjunct in inflammation management.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 透過多種分子途徑發揮有效的 anti-inflammatory effects 作用，包括抑制 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導、下調促發炎細胞因子（如 TNF-α 和 IL-6）以及活化 AMPK，進而改善代謝和發炎狀態。這些作用有助於其治療代謝症候群、胰島素抗性、2 型糖尿病和胃腸道炎症，並延伸至腸道微生物群的調節。由於其抗發炎活性獨立於 methylation cycle，因此不會增加甲基負荷或抑制 COMT。這使其成為發炎管理中多功能且相對安全的輔助手段。

label: CD36 expression
description: CD36 expression is induced by PPARgamma, which transcriptionally upregulates the receptor in macrophages, creating a feed-forward loop that amplifies oxLDL scavenging. ROS can further enhance this PPARgamma-dependent induction. The directionality is nuclear receptor to receptor upregulation. A caveat is that excessive CD36 induction promotes foam-cell formation, so the loop is maladaptive under chronic lipid stress. The PPARgamma-CD36 axis is also central to adipocyte lipid storage and to foam-cell pathology in atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: CD36 expression 是由 PPARgamma 誘導的，PPARgamma 會在轉錄上上調巨噬細胞中的受體，形成一個放大 oxLDL 清除的前饋環。 ROS 可以進一步增強這種 PPARgamma 依賴性誘導。方向性是核受體到受體的上調。需要注意的是，過度的 CD36 誘導會促進泡沫細胞的形成，因此循環在慢性脂質壓力下會出現適應不良。 PPARgamma-CD36 軸對於 atherosclerosis 中的脂肪細胞脂質儲存和泡沫細胞病理學也至關重要。

label: Nitrated lipids
description: Nitrated lipids activate PPARgamma, as electrophilic nitrated fatty acids such as nitrolinoleic acid act as ligands that promote the receptor's transcriptional program. This redirects metabolism and induces anti-inflammatory and antioxidant genes. The directionality is lipid nitration product to nuclear receptor activation. A caveat is that nitrated lipids can also signal through PPARalpha and other targets, so PPARgamma is a major but not exclusive node. This pathway represents a feedback mechanism in which nitrative stress generates endogenous ligands that dampen inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Nitrated lipids 活化 PPARgamma，因為硝基亞麻油酸等親電子硝化脂肪酸充當配體，促進受體的轉錄程序。這會改變新陳代謝並誘導抗炎和抗氧化基因。方向性是脂質硝化產物對核受體的活化。需要注意的是，nitrated lipids 還可以透過 PPARalpha 和其他目標發出訊號，因此 PPARgamma 是一個主要但不是唯一的節點。該通路代表了一種反饋機制，其中 nitrative stress 生成抑制發炎的內源性配體。

label: Thr172
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: LKB1 is the primary upstream kinase phosphorylating AMPK at Thr172 in the activation loop, increasing AMPK activity over a hundred-fold. Directionally, LKB1 sits upstream of AMPK activation. This couples energy sensing to metabolic reprogramming, since activated AMPK promotes catabolism and inhibits anabolism. Sirtuins feed into this node via LKB1 deacetylation and AMPK-dependent NAD+ elevation, creating a self-reinforcing circuit. The LKB1-AMPK pathway is a central regulator of cellular energy homeostasis, and its dysregulation contributes to metabolic disease and cancer.
description_zh_TW: LKB1 是磷酸化 AMPK 啟動迴路中 Thr172 位點的主要上游激酶，將 AMPK 活性提高百倍以上。在方向性上，LKB1 位於 AMPK 活化的上游。這將能量感知與代謝重編程偶聯，因為活化的 AMPK 促進分解代謝並抑制合成代謝。Sirtuin 透過 LKB1 去乙醯化和 AMPK 依賴性的 NAD+ 提升回饋到此節點，創造自強化的迴路。LKB1-AMPK 途徑是細胞能量恆定性的核心調節因子，其失調導致代謝疾病和癌症。

label: STRAD and MO25 for activity
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: LKB1 requires binding to STRAD and MO25 to exit the nucleus and gain full kinase activity; without this scaffold it remains inactive. Directionally, STRAD and MO25 sit upstream of LKB1 activation. This gating is essential for LKB1's role as the master upstream AMPK kinase, and SIRT1 and AMPK deacetylate and phosphorylate LKB1 to modulate its localization. The STRAD/MO25 scaffold both stabilizes LKB1 and directs it to the cytoplasm where it can activate AMPK. Mutations in LKB1, as in Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, disrupt this pathway and predispose to cancer.
description_zh_TW: LKB1 需要與 STRAD 和 MO25 結合才能離開細胞核並獲得完整的激酶活性；沒有這個支架它保持不活化。在方向性上，STRAD 和 MO25 位於 LKB1 活化的上游。這種門控機制對 LKB1 作為核心上游 AMPK 激酶的角色至關重要，SIRT1 和 AMPK 去乙醯化和磷酸化 LKB1 以調控其定位。STRAD/MO25 支架既穩定 LKB1 又將其導向細胞質，在那裡它可以活化 AMPK。LKB1 的突變，如 Peutz-Jeghers 綜合症，會破壞此途徑並增加癌症易感性。

label: SIRT1 (Ser27, Thr344)
description: Under low-energy conditions, AMPK directly phosphorylates SIRT1 at Ser27 and Thr344, enhancing its deacetylase activity and coupling energy deficit to sirtuin function. Directionally, AMPK sits upstream of SIRT1 activation. This closes the reciprocal loop with SIRT1, and it ensures sirtuin responses track cellular AMP/ATP state. By phosphorylating SIRT1, AMPK links the energy-sensing kinase network to sirtuin-dependent gene regulation. This mechanism explains how fasting, exercise, and caloric restriction, which activate AMPK, also engage SIRT1-dependent programs.
description_zh_TW: 在低能量狀態下，AMPK直接在Ser27和Thr344位點磷酸化SIRT1，增強其去乙醯酶活性，並將能量不足與sirtuin功能耦合起來。方向上，AMPK位於SIRT1活化的上游。這關閉了與SIRT1的雙向迴路，並確保sirtuin的反應追蹤細胞的AMP/ATP狀態。透過磷酸化SIRT1，AMPK將能量感知激酶網路與sirtuin依賴性基因調節聯繫起來。此機制解釋了為何禁食、運動和熱量限制（這些都能活化AMPK）也能啟動SIRT1依賴性的程序。

label: Vine Tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata)
description: Vine tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata) leaves contain 20-30% dihydromyricetin (DHM) by weight, so 1-1.5 g of dry leaf suffices for roughly a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, the botanical source sits upstream of DHM availability. DHM is a potent SIRT3 and AMPK activator, and this makes vine tea a practical natural source of the compound. The high DHM content distinguishes vine tea from most other botanical sources and supports its traditional use as a metabolic tonic. This abundance is a key practical advantage for studying and using DHM clinically.
description_zh_TW: 藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）葉片含有 20-30% 的二氫楊梅素（DHM），因此 1-1.5 克乾葉即可提供約 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，植物來源位於 DHM 可用性的上游。DHM 是強效的 SIRT3 和 AMPK 活化劑，使藤茶成為該化合物的實用天然來源。高 DHM 含量使藤茶有別於大多數其他植物來源，並支持其作為代謝滋補品的傳統用途。這種豐度是研究和臨床使用 DHM 的關鍵實際優勢。

label: Atrogin-1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Atrogin-1 and MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) are pivotal molecules involved in muscle protein synthesis and degradation, functioning as muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligases that drive protein breakdown during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing atrophy signaling, attenuating protein degradation, and preserving muscle mass.
description_zh_TW: Atrogin-1 與 MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) 是參與肌肉蛋白合成與降解的關鍵分子，作為肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，在萎縮期間驅動蛋白分解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而降低萎縮訊號、減緩蛋白降解，並保留肌肉量。

label: muscle fatigue
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Existing evidence suggests that urolithin A may have a positive role in improving endurance and delaying muscle fatigue, both of which are intricately linked to mitochondrial function. By enhancing mitochondrial activity and ATP synthesis, urolithin A provides sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise, and its anti-inflammatory properties alleviate tissue damage and muscle soreness caused by inflammation. Most studies have been conducted in vitro or on animals, so more human studies are needed to validate these effects.
description_zh_TW: 現有證據顯示 urolithin A 可能在改善耐力與延遲肌肉疲勞方面具有正面作用，兩者皆與粒線體功能密切相關。透過增強粒線體活性與 ATP 合成，urolithin A 在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持，且其抗發炎特性可減輕由發炎引起的組織損傷與肌肉痠痛。大多數研究為體外或動物實驗，因此需要更多人體研究來驗證這些效應。

label: Muscle Atrophy
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: In pathological conditions characterized by muscle atrophy, such as certain neuromuscular diseases or extended periods of immobility, urolithin A may offer potential benefits. It can stimulate muscle protein synthesis while inhibiting protein degradation pathways, including FoxO signaling, the ubiquitin-proteasome system, and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, helping to preserve muscle mass and mitigate muscle wasting. Human clinical validation of these anti-atrophic effects remains limited, but the mechanistic evidence is supportive.
description_zh_TW: 在以肌肉萎縮為特徵的病理狀態下，如某些神經肌肉疾病或長期不活動，urolithin A 可能提供潛在益處。它可刺激肌肉蛋白合成，同時抑制蛋白降解路徑，包括 FoxO 訊號、泛素-蛋白酶體系統，以及 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，有助於保留肌肉量並減輕肌肉消耗。這些抗萎縮效應的人體臨床驗證仍有限，但機制證據具支持性。

label: MuRF1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase that, together with Atrogin-1, marks muscle proteins for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing muscle protein degradation and supporting the maintenance of muscle mass under catabolic conditions. Suppressing this E3 ligase reduces ubiquitination of muscle proteins and complements urolithin A's anabolic effects on protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) 是一種肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，與 Atrogin-1 共同在萎縮期間標記肌肉蛋白以供泛素-蛋白酶體降解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而減少肌肉蛋白降解，並在分解代謝條件下支持肌肉量的維持。抑制此 E3 連接酶可減少肌肉蛋白的泛素化，並補足 urolithin A 對蛋白質合成的合成代謝效應。

label: Pomegranate
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Pomegranate is cited as one of the primary and richest dietary sources of urolithin A. Pomegranate peel and seeds contain abundant polyphenolic compounds, including ellagitannins that are metabolized by the gut microbiota into urolithin A. Consequently, consuming pomegranate supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A, and pomegranate consumption is a standard dietary route to increase systemic urolithin A exposure alongside other sources such as walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry.
description_zh_TW: 石榴被引述為 urolithin A 的主要且最豐富的膳食來源之一。石榴皮與籽含有豐富的多酚類化合物，包括被腸道菌叢代謝為 urolithin A 的 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）。因此，食用石榴提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成，且食用石榴是增加全身性 urolithin A 暴露的標準膳食途徑，與核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓等其他來源並列。

label: TLR3/TRIF signaling
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling, reducing inflammation and enhancing antioxidant defense. TLR3/TRIF is an upstream innate immune signaling route whose inactivation dampens downstream NF-κB activation and the production of inflammatory mediators. This mechanism contributes to urolithin A's anti-inflammatory activity in settings such as poly(I:C)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and supports its role in muscle recovery and protection from inflammation-induced damage.
description_zh_TW: 文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸，從而減少發炎並增強抗氧化防禦。TLR3/TRIF 是一條上游先天免疫訊號路線，其失活會抑制下游 NF-κB 活化與發炎介質的產生。此機制有助於 urolithin A 在如 poly(I:C) 刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞等情境中的抗發炎活性，並支持其在肌肉恢復與免受發炎誘發損傷中的角色。

label: Urolithins
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A (UA) is a naturally occurring compound classified within the urolithins, a family of gut-microbiota-derived metabolites that form when dietary polyphenols are processed in the gastrointestinal tract. The review describes urolithins as compounds present in pomegranates and certain other fruits and nuts such as strawberries, walnut kernels, and peanuts, with ellagitannins serving as their precursors. As a member of this family, Urolithin A has attracted considerable research attention due to its pharmacological effects, encompassing anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, and anti-aging properties, and it is a primary focus of research into muscle health and performance.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A（UA）是一種天然存在的化合物，歸類於 urolithins（尿石素）家族，這是一類當膳食多酚在胃腸道中被處理時所形成的腸道菌叢衍生代謝物。該綜述將 urolithins 描述為存在於石榴與某些其他水果和堅果（如草莓、核桃仁與花生）中的化合物，以 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）作為其前驅物。作為此家族的一員，Urolithin A 因其藥理作用（涵蓋抗發炎、抗氧化、抗腫瘤與抗衰老特性）而吸引了相當多的研究關注，且它是肌肉健康與表現研究的主要焦點。

label: Kidney
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A and its metabolites can be excreted from the body through the kidneys and intestines. Renal function can influence the rate of urolithin A elimination, since a portion of the compound and its conjugated forms is cleared in the urine, while additional urolithin A is further metabolized into other compounds within the intestines before being eliminated through feces. Renal function, intestinal permeability, and individual characteristics are therefore among the physiological factors that shape the bioavailability, metabolism, and distribution of urolithin A.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 及其代謝物可經由腎臟與腸道排出體外。腎功能會影響 urolithin A 的排除速率，因為部分化合物及其結合形式經尿液清除，而另有部分 urolithin A 在腸道內進一步代謝為其他化合物後再經糞便排出。因此，腎功能、腸道通透性與個體特徵，是形塑 urolithin A 生體可用率、代謝與分布的生理因素之一。

label: ATP synthesis
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A can promote the formation and enhanced function of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, thereby improving the synthesis rate of ATP in muscle cells. ATP is the primary energy molecule for muscle cells and is crucial for muscle contraction and exercise performance. By promoting mitochondrial function and muscle energy metabolism, urolithin A increases the energy supply to muscle cells, improving endurance, strength, and recovery, and providing sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可促進粒線體呼吸鏈複合體的形成與功能增強，從而改善肌肉細胞中 ATP 的合成速率。ATP 是肌肉細胞的主要能量分子，對肌肉收縮與運動表現至關重要。透過促進粒線體功能與肌肉能量代謝，urolithin A 增加對肌肉細胞的能量供應，改善耐力、力量與恢復，並在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持。

label: CDK
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A can regulate the cell cycle by inhibiting the activity of cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) and reducing the expression of cell cycle proteins such as cyclin D1, leading to cell cycle arrest in the G1 phase. It also increases the levels of cell cycle inhibitory proteins such as p21 and p27. This cell-cycle control, achieved through modulation of CDK activity and cyclin expression, contributes to urolithin A's reported antiproliferative activity and to its effects on cell cycle-related protein kinase complexes.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可透過抑制 cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) 的活性並降低如 cyclin D1 等細胞週期蛋白的表現，來調節細胞週期，導致 G1 期細胞週期停滯。它亦提升如 p21 與 p27 等細胞週期抑制蛋白的水平。此透過調控 CDK 活性與 cyclin 表現而達成的細胞週期控制，有助於 urolithin A 被報導的抗增殖活性，以及其對細胞週期相關蛋白激酶複合體的效應。

label: Bax/Bcl-2 ratio
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A induces apoptosis by increasing the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, which results in the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, release of cytochrome c, and activation of the cascade of caspases, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. Modulation of the pro-apoptotic to anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family ratio is a classical intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptosis trigger. It represents one of the several mechanisms through which urolithin A promotes programmed cell death, in addition to its activation of JNK and p38 MAPK signaling.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 透過提升 Bax/Bcl-2 比值誘導凋亡，此比值升高導致粒線體膜電位喪失、cytochrome c 釋出，以及 caspase 級聯反應活化，最終導致細胞凋亡。調節促凋亡與抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族比值，是經典的內在（粒線體）凋亡觸發因子。這代表了 urolithin A 促進程序性細胞死亡的數種機制之一，此外還包括其對 JNK 與 p38 MAPK 訊號的活化。

label: Ellagitannins
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A is a natural metabolite derived from ellagitannins, polyphenolic precursors found in pomegranate, walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry. During digestion, microbial enzymes in the colon convert ellagitannins through stepwise enzymatic and metabolic reactions to yield urolithin A. Because ellagitannin intake is a precondition for urolithin A formation, dietary consumption of ellagitannin-rich foods supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A and increasing its systemic availability.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是一種源自 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）的天然代謝物，後者為存在於石榴、核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓中的多酚類前驅物。在消化期間，結腸中的微生物酵素透過逐步的酵素與代謝反應將 ellagitannins 轉化以產生 urolithin A。由於 ellagitannin 攝取是 urolithin A 形成的先決條件，飲食攝取富含 ellagitannin 的食物提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成並增加其全身性可用性。

label: Muscle Hypertrophy
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A may have a positive impact on muscle hypertrophy and maintenance of muscle mass through multiple pathways, including promotion of muscle cell repair and growth, enhancement of mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, and regulation of protein synthesis and degradation processes. It can increase the cross-sectional area of muscle fibers, muscle protein content, and muscle strength, thus promoting muscle hypertrophy. Current research is still limited and mostly conducted in vitro or in animal experiments, so human studies are needed.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑對肌肉肥大與肌肉量維持產生正面影響，包括促進肌肉細胞修復與生長、增強粒線體功能與能量代謝，以及調節蛋白質合成與降解過程。它可增加肌纖維橫截面積、肌肉蛋白含量與肌肉力量，從而促進肌肉肥大。目前研究仍有限且多為體外或動物實驗，因此需要人體研究。

label: Coenzyme
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is an essential coenzyme that plays central roles in cellular oxidation-reduction reactions, including most catabolic and anabolic processes such as glycolysis, fatty acid beta-oxidation, the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and the synthesis of fatty acids, cholesterol, and steroids. Beyond its redox function, NAD+ is consumed by enzymes including sirtuins, poly-ADP-ribose polymerases (PARPs), CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes, and mono-ADP-ribose transferases, whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ content.
description_zh_TW: NAD+（nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide）是一種必需的輔酶，在細胞氧化還原反應中扮演核心角色，包括大多數分解代謝與合成代謝過程，如 glycolysis、fatty acid beta-oxidation、tricarboxylic acid cycle，以及脂肪酸、膽固醇與類固醇的合成。除了其氧化還原功能外，NAD+ 會被包括 sirtuins、poly-ADP-ribose polymerases（PARPs）、CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes，以及 mono-ADP-ribose transferases 在內的酵素所消耗，這些酵素的活性可能耗竭細胞內的 NAD+ 含量。

label: NMNAT
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NMNAT (NMN/NaMN adenylyltransferases) catalyzes the final biosynthetic step in which nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is converted to the essential coenzyme NAD+. This step is shared by the salvage pathways from both nicotinamide riboside (NR) and nicotinamide (NAM): NR is first phosphorylated to NMN by NMRK1/NMRK2, while NAM is converted to NMN by NAMPT. NAD+ is required for glycolysis, fatty acid oxidation, and the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and it serves as the substrate for NAD+-consuming enzymes such as sirtuins and PARPs. Elevating NAD+ through precursor supplementation underlies the beneficial metabolic, cardiovascular, and neuroprotective effects attributed to NR.
description_zh_TW: NMNAT（NMN/NaMN adenylyltransferases）催化最後一個生物合成步驟，在此步驟中菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）被轉化為必需輔酶 NAD+。此步驟為來自菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）與菸鹼醯胺（NAM）兩者的補救途徑所共有：NR 先由 NMRK1/NMRK2 磷酸化為 NMN，而 NAM 則由 NAMPT 轉化為 NMN。NAD+ 為糖解作用、脂肪酸氧化與三羧酸循環所必需，並作為 NAD+ 消耗酶（如 sirtuins 與 PARPs）的受質。透過前驅物補充提升 NAD+，是歸因於 NR 的有益代謝、心血管與神經保護作用的基礎。

label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction-Associated Senescence
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: A reduced NAD+/NADH ratio triggers mitochondrial dysfunction-associated senescence (MiDAS) via AMPK-p53 signaling, coupled to a distinct secretory phenotype with an attenuated IL-1-dependent inflammatory arm of the SASP. MiDAS represents the specific senescence program in which NAD+ depletion and redox collapse, rather than DNA damage, enforce the senescence state. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells and melanocyte stem cells, this NAD+-driven senescence causes loss of quiescence and diminished regenerative capacity.
description_zh_TW: A reduced NAD+/NADH ratio triggers mitochondrial dysfunction-associated senescence (MiDAS) via AMPK-p53 signaling，coupled to a distinct secretory phenotype with an attenuated IL-1-dependent inflammatory arm of the SASP。MiDAS represents the specific senescence program in which NAD+ depletion and redox collapse, rather than DNA damage, enforce the senescence state。In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells and melanocyte stem cells, this NAD+-driven senescence causes loss of quiescence and diminished regenerative capacity。

label: Quinolinic Acid
description: The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+. Because the pathway accounts for approximately 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production, its flux through IDO1 and TDO substantially shapes systemic NAD+ levels and neuroactive metabolite balance. KP dysregulation is implicated in neurodegeneration, depression, chronic inflammation, and infections (e.g., HIV modulates IDO1), in part because of the neuroactive and excitotoxic properties of kynurenine and quinolinic acid. This links IDO1 activity to both metabolic and neurological outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸途徑產生包括犬尿烯酸、3-羥基犬尿胺酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素與 NAD+ 前驅物）以及最終 NAD+ 在內的多種代謝物。由於該途徑佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解，其經由 IDO1 與 TDO 的流量大幅塑造全身 NAD+ 濃度與神經活性代謝物平衡。KP 失調被認為與神經退化、憂鬱症、慢性發炎及感染（例如 HIV 調節 IDO1）有關，部分原因是犬尿胺酸與喹啉酸的神經活性與興奮毒性特性。這將 IDO1 活性同時連結至代謝與神經學結果。

label: Misfolded Proteins
description: The mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) is activated by the accumulation of misfolded proteins within the mitochondrial matrix, analogous to the classic ER stress response. Expression of a misfolding-prone mutant of the matrix protein ornithine transcarbamylase induces a nuclear transcriptional response that upregulates mitochondrial-specific chaperones. In C. elegans, activation of UPRmt requires the transcription factor ATFS-1, and matrix-derived peptides exported through the ABC transporter HAF-1 signal mitochondrial stress to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）由粒線體基質中折疊錯誤蛋白的積累所活化，類似於經典的內質網壓力反應。基質蛋白鳥氨酸氨甲醯基轉移酶的易折疊突變體的表達，會誘導核轉錄反應，上調粒線體特異性分子伴護。在 C. elegans 中，UPRmt 的活化需要轉錄因子 ATFS-1，而基質衍生的肽段透過 ABC 轉運蛋白 HAF-1 輸出，將粒線體壓力訊號傳遞到細胞核。

label: NAMPT upregulation
description: NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme in the NAD+ salvage pathway, so its upregulation raises cellular NAD+ levels and fuels sirtuin activity. Directionally, NAMPT increase leads to NAD+ increase, which enhances sirtuin function. This is the terminal step of resveratrol's indirect activation cascade and a central control point for NAD+ homeostasis more broadly. Preserving NAD+ via NAMPT induction, or by inhibiting NAD+ consumers such as CD38 and PARPs, is a common theme across sirtuin-activating strategies, and it reflects the fact that cellular NAD+ availability, rather than sirtuin protein abundance alone, often limits sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ 回收代謝通路中的限速酶，因此其上調提高細胞 NAD+ 水平並為 sirtuin 活性提供燃料。在方向性上，NAMPT 增加導致 NAD+ 增加，進而增強 sirtuin 功能。這是白藜蘆醇間接活化級聯的終端步驟，也是更廣泛的 NAD+ 穩態的中心控制點。通過 NAMPT 誘導或抑制 CD38 和 PARP 等 NAD+ 消耗者來保留 NAD+，是 sirtuin 活化策略中的共同主題，反映了細胞 NAD+ 可用性（而非僅 sirtuin 蛋白表達量）通常限制 sirtuin 活性的事實。

label: Oxygen
description: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state. In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal. When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues. This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state。In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal。When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues。This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia。

label: Oxygen-dissociation curve
description: Methemoglobin, the ferric form of hemoglobin, not only fails to carry oxygen itself but also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin in the tetramer. This left shift increases hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen and impairs oxygen release to tissues, creating a functional anemia even when total hemoglobin levels are normal or near-normal. When methemoglobin levels rise substantially, the resulting impairment of oxygen delivery causes tissue hypoxia, and symptoms progress from cyanosis to headaches, confusion, arrhythmias, and eventually coma as the percentage of methemoglobin increases.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin, the ferric form of hemoglobin, not only fails to carry oxygen itself but also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin in the tetramer。This left shift increases hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen and impairs oxygen release to tissues, creating a functional anemia even when total hemoglobin levels are normal or near-normal。When methemoglobin levels rise substantially, the resulting impairment of oxygen delivery causes tissue hypoxia, and symptoms progress from cyanosis to headaches, confusion, arrhythmias, and eventually coma as the percentage of methemoglobin increases。

label: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase
description: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase, is the primary enzyme that converts methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin by reducing ferric heme iron to the ferrous state. It keeps steady-state methemoglobin levels below 1-2% in healthy individuals despite the spontaneous oxidation of hemoglobin. Deficiency of this enzyme, due to autosomal recessive mutations, is the most common congenital cause of methemoglobinemia, with Type 1 affecting only erythrocytes and causing cyanosis while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems.
description_zh_TW: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase, is the primary enzyme that converts methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin by reducing ferric heme iron to the ferrous state。It keeps steady-state methemoglobin levels below 1-2% in healthy individuals despite the spontaneous oxidation of hemoglobin。Deficiency of this enzyme, due to autosomal recessive mutations, is the most common congenital cause of methemoglobinemia, with Type 1 affecting only erythrocytes and causing cyanosis while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems。

label: Oxyhemoglobin
description: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin, a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-). These radicals, along with hydrogen peroxide, can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production. Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state, and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen. This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions.
description_zh_TW: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin，a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-)。These radicals，along with hydrogen peroxide，can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome，a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production。Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state，and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen。This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions。

label: Zone 2 Cardio
description: Zone 2 cardio performed 3 to 4 times per week for 45-60 minutes builds the aerobic base, increases mitochondrial volume, and improves fat oxidation efficiency, and is the recommended low-intensity alternative when HRV is significantly below baseline and heavy stressors must be skipped. It is positioned as the aerobic foundation of the training protocol, complementing HIIT and sprint interval training done 1-2 times per week that generate the acute ROS spike and lactate accumulation to trigger PGC-1alpha, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 每週進行 3-4 次、每次 45-60 分鐘的 Zone 2 有氧運動可建立有氧基礎、增加線粒體體積並改善脂肪氧化效率，是當 HRV 顯著低於基線且必須跳過高強度壓力時推薦的低強度替代方案。它被定位為訓練方案的有氧基礎，與每週 1-2 次的 HIIT 和衝刺間歇訓練互補，後者產生急性 ROS 峰值和乳酸積累以觸發 PGC-1alpha——線粒體生物發生的主調控因子。

label: Resveratrol (high-calorie diet mice)
description: In mice on a high-calorie diet, resveratrol increases mitochondrial number and function, an effect accompanied by elevated SIRT1 and PGC-1α activity. This shift counters diet-induced metabolic dysfunction by improving oxidative capacity, increasing endurance, and protecting against the metabolic consequences of overnutrition. Directionally, resveratrol activates SIRT1/PGC-1α to drive mitochondrial biogenesis. The finding, from Baur and Sinclair's 2006 study in Cell, helped popularize resveratrol as a caloric-restriction mimetic against diet-induced obesity and demonstrated that a small molecule could reproduce key metabolic benefits of dietary restriction in mammals.
description_zh_TW: 在高熱量飲食小鼠中，白藜蘆醇增加粒線體數量和功能，這種效應伴隨著 SIRT1 和 PGC-1α 活性的升高。這種轉變通過提高氧化能力、增加耐力和保護對抗過度營養的代謝後果來對抗飲食誘導的代謝功能障礙。在方向性上，白藜蘆醇活化 SIRT1/PGC-1α 以驅動粒線體生物合成。這一發現來自 Baur 和 Sinclair 2006 年在 Cell 上的研究，幫助推廣白藜蘆醇作為熱量限制模擬物對抗飲食誘導的肥胖，並證明小分子可以在哺乳動物中重現飲食限制的關鍵代謝益處。

label: Adenosine Kinase
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase in a recently discovered novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH (the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside) through the NMNH intermediate, providing a NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase. NRH is more stable than nicotinamide riboside (NR), which degrades to nicotinamide in the blood, and NRH increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR. Endogenous NRH was detected in the liver of mouse models, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
description_zh_TW: adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）在近期發現的從 NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑中作為 NRH 激酶，提供了 NRH 誘發 NAD+ 增加的 NMRK 非依賴性路徑。NRH 比 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）更穩定，後者在血液中降解為 nicotinamide，且 NRH 以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+。小鼠模型肝臟中偵測到內源性 NRH，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

label: NMNH
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NMNH (dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide) is the reduced form of nicotinamide mononucleotide and has been shown to promote NAD+ synthesis. Together with NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, NMNH adds to the set of NAD+ precursors available for cellular salvage and NAD+ replenishment. These reduced precursors demonstrate that the NAD+ metabolic cycle is more flexible than initially recognized, providing alternative routes to boost NAD+ levels beyond the classic precursors tryptophan, nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, NMN, and NR, and supporting efforts to develop effective strategies for preventing NAD+ decline in aging and disease.
description_zh_TW: NMNH（二氫菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸）是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸的還原形式，已被證實能促進 NAD+ 生合成。與 NRH（菸鹼醯胺核糖的還原形式）一起，NMNH 加入了可供細胞回收與 NAD+ 補充的 NAD+ 前驅物組合。這些還原型前驅物顯示 NAD+ 代謝循環比最初所認知的更具彈性，提供了超越經典前驅物色胺酸、菸鹼醯胺、菸鹼酸、NMN 和 NR 之外提升 NAD+ 水平的替代途徑，並支持開發有效策略以預防老化與疾病中的 NAD+ 衰退。

label: Creatine Kinase (CK)
description: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This provides a rapid means of replenishing depleted ATP during high-energy-demand states such as intense exercise or conditions where energy production is impaired (ischemia, hypoxia) or insufficient due to increased demand (mental fatigue, disease states). Cytosolic, glycolytic, and mitochondrial CK isoforms cooperate to buffer ATP/ADP ratios and shuttle high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to sites of ATP consumption.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸激酶（CK）是肌酸/磷酸肌酸能量系統核心的酶。它催化磷酸基團在肌酸與 ADP 之間的可逆轉移，利用磷酸肌酸分解所釋放的自由能（約 10.3 千卡），從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這提供了在高能量需求狀態下快速補充耗竭 ATP 的手段，例如劇烈運動，或能量產生受損（缺血、缺氧）或因需求增加而不足（精神疲勞、疾病狀態）的情況。細胞質、糖解與粒線體 CK 異構型協同作用，以緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值，並將高能磷酸從粒線體穿梭至 ATP 消耗的位置。

label: AMPK (activated)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Activated AMPK increases expression of NAMPT, the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway that converts nicotinamide to NMN. Directionally, AMPK sits upstream of NAMPT induction. More NAMPT elevates intracellular NAD+, the obligate co-substrate for sirtuins, and the AMPK-to-NAMPT-to-NAD+ axis is a major indirect route by which resveratrol, exercise, and caloric restriction activate SIRT1. Because NAMPT is rate-limiting, its induction is a decisive step in raising NAD+ availability, and AMPK and SIRT1 also induce each other, creating a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit that sustains NAD+-dependent processes.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 AMPK 增加 NAMPT 的表達，NAMPT 是 NAD+ 回收代謝通路的限速酶，將菸鹼醯胺轉化為 NMN。在方向性上，AMPK 位於 NAMPT 誘導的上游。更多的 NAMPT 提高細胞內 NAD+——sirtuin 的必需共同受質，AMPK-NAMPT-NAD+ 軸是白藜蘆醇、運動和熱量限制活化 SIRT1 的主要間接途徑。由於 NAMPT 是限速酶，其誘導是提高 NAD+ 可用性的決定性步驟，且 AMPK 和 SIRT1 也相互誘導，形成一個自我強化的代謝電路，維持 NAD+ 依賴性過程。

label: NNMT
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT) methylates nicotinamide to 1-methylnicotinamide, diverting this precursor away from the NAMPT-dependent salvage pathway. By withdrawing nicotinamide from NAD+ regeneration, NNMT activity limits NAD+ biosynthesis and indirectly modulates the activity of NAD+-dependent sirtuins. Directionally, NNMT sits upstream of reduced NAD+ availability. This makes NNMT a metabolic competitor with the salvage pathway, and elevated NNMT in obesity and certain cancers contributes to NAD+ depletion and metabolic dysfunction. Modulating NNMT is therefore of interest as a strategy to preserve NAD+ pools and support sirtuin activity in disease states.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺N-甲基轉移酶（NNMT）將菸鹼醯胺甲基化為1-甲基菸鹼醯胺，將此前體從NAMPT依賴性的補救合成途徑中分流。透過將菸鹼醯胺從NAD+再生中撤出，NNMT活性限制了NAD+生物合成並間接調節NAD+依賴性sirtuin的活性。方向上，NNMT位於NAD+可用性降低的上游。這使NNMT成為補救合成途徑的代謝競爭者，肥胖和某些癌症中NNMT的升高導致NAD+耗竭和代謝功能障礙。因此調節NNMT作為保存NAD+池和支持疾病狀態下sirtuin活性的策略受到關注。

label: Free Iron
description: Ferritin sequesters free iron by storing up to roughly 4,500 Fe3+ atoms per molecule in a mineral core, keeping redox-active iron away from peroxide and the Fenton reaction. This buffering is a front-line antioxidant defense. The directionality is iron chelation to suppressed radical formation. A caveat is that ferritin can be released or degraded during inflammation and hemorrhage, liberating iron that then becomes pro-oxidant. Iron released from ferritin by ferritinophagy or by reduction is what fuels ferroptosis, so ferritin level is a determinant of ferroptosis sensitivity.
description_zh_TW: Ferritin 透過在礦物核心中每個分子儲存約 4,500 個 Fe3+ 原子來隔離 free iron，使具有氧化還原活性的 iron 遠離過氧化物和 Fenton reaction。這種緩衝是一種前線抗氧化防禦。方向性是iron螯合以抑制自由基的形成。需要注意的是，ferritin 在發炎和出血期間可能會釋放或降解，釋放出 iron，然後變成促氧化劑。透過ferritin自噬或還原從ferritin釋放的Iron是ferroptosis的燃料，因此ferritin水平是ferroptosis敏感性的決定因素。

label: Antioxidant Response
description: NRF2 is the master regulator of the antioxidant response, inducing more than 200 cytoprotective genes including those for glutathione synthesis, thioredoxin, heme oxygenase, and drug detoxification. It integrates signals from KEAP1, redox status, and electrophiles. The directionality is NRF2 activation to coordinated defense transcription. A caveat is that excessive or chronic NRF2 activation can support tumor cell survival, so its regulation is finely balanced. The NRF2-KEAP1 system is druggable, and activators such as dimethyl fumarate and sulforaphane are used or investigated in inflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases.
description_zh_TW: NRF2 是 antioxidant response 的主調節因子，誘導 200 多個細胞保護基因，包括用於 glutathione 合成、硫氧還蛋白、血紅素加氧酶和藥物解毒的基因。它整合了來自 KEAP1、氧化還原狀態和親電子試劑的訊號。方向性是NRF2活化以協調防禦轉錄。需要注意的是，過度或慢性 NRF2 活化可以支持腫瘤細胞存活，因此其調節是精細平衡的。 NRF2-KEAP1 系統是可藥物化的，富馬酸二甲酯和蘿蔔硫素等活化劑在發炎和 neurodegenerative diseases 中使用或研究。

label: Glutathione S-Transferase
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: NRF2, acting through the Antioxidant Response Element, upregulates the expression of glutathione S-transferases (GSTs), which are pivotal detoxifying enzymes intricately related to antioxidant capacity. This transcriptional program, stimulated in the setting of urolithin A treatment, enhances cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control. GSTs are therefore downstream effectors of NRF2 signaling that help protect cells against oxidative and electrophilic stress and that support the removal and turnover of damaged mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: NRF2 透過 Antioxidant Response Element 作用，上調 glutathione S-transferases (GSTs) 的表現，而 GSTs 是與抗氧化能力密切相關的關鍵解毒酶。此轉錄程序在 urolithin A 處理下被刺激，進而增強細胞自噬與粒線體品質控制。因此，GSTs 是 NRF2 訊號的下游效應分子，協助保護細胞對抗氧化與親電子壓力，並支持受損粒線體的移除與更新。

label: Antioxidant Response Element
description: Nrf2 is the transcription factor that, upon release from Keap1, translocates to the nucleus and upregulates antioxidant response element (ARE) genes encoding detoxifying and antioxidant enzymes. In the senomorphic hypothesis, aminochrome-mediated Keap1 modification activates this Nrf2/ARE program. Because active Nrf2 signaling mutually antagonizes NF-κB and directly represses pro-inflammatory cytokine transcription, Nrf2 activation is proposed to enforce a quiescent, non-secretory phenotype in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: Nrf2是從Keap1釋放後轉位至細胞核並上調編碼解毒和抗氧化酶的抗氧化反應元件（ARE）基因的轉錄因子。在衰老模仿假說中，氨基色素介導的Keap1修改激活此Nrf2/ARE程序。由於活性Nrf2信號相互拮抗NF-κB並直接抑制促炎細胞因子轉錄，Nrf2激活被提出在衰老細胞中強制執行靜止、非分泌表型。

label: Glycolic acid
description: PARK7 (DJ-1) detoxifies the reactive dicarbonyl species glyoxal and methylglyoxal in a glutathione-independent manner, converting glyoxal into glycolic acid and methylglyoxal into L-lactate. This stereospecific conversion removes dicarbonyls before they can form irreversible AGE crosslinks on protein residues. Because glyoxal is a major product of glucose and lipid oxidation, PARK7-dependent conversion of glyoxal to glycolic acid is an important route for limiting dicarbonyl stress. Loss of PARK7 activity is associated with tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs and, in humans, is linked to early-onset Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）以不依賴麩胱甘肽的方式解毒反應性二羰基物種乙二醛與甲基乙二醛，將乙二醛轉化為乙醇酸、將甲基乙二醛轉化為 L-乳酸。這種立體特異性轉化在這些二羰基物形成蛋白質殘基上不可逆的 AGE 交聯之前將其移除。由於乙二醛是葡萄糖與脂質氧化的主要產物，PARK7 依賴的乙二醛轉乙醇酸途徑是限制二羰基壓力的重要路線。PARK7 活性缺失與組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積有關，且在人類中與早發性帕金森氏症（Parkinson's disease）相關。

label: Glyoxalase System
