description: The glyoxalase system, composed of GLO1 and GLO2, is the primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. Methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone are highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, and if left unchecked they form irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. The glyoxalase system neutralizes these precursors, and maintaining GLO1 activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation. Dysfunction of this system is therefore linked to increased dicarbonyl stress and accelerated protein glycation, with consequences for aging, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 由 GLO1 與 GLO2 組成的乙二醛酶系統（glyoxalase system）是對抗二羰基壓力的主要防禦系統。甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）、乙二醛（glyoxal）與 3-deoxyglucosone 是糖解與脂質過氧化過程中產生的高度反應性二羰基中間產物，若不加控制，它們會在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。乙二醛酶系統中和這些前驅物，而維持 GLO1 活性是減少內生性 AGE 堆積的主要標的。因此，此系統的功能障礙與二羰基壓力增加及蛋白質糖化加速有關，對老化、糖尿病與心血管疾病產生影響。

label: Sulforaphane
description: Sulforaphane, found abundantly in broccoli sprouts, is highlighted as a potent activator of NRF2 and an upregulator of Phase II detoxification enzymes. NRF2 is one of the key stress-response pathways activated by the acute ROS pulse that defines mitohormesis, alongside AMPK, PGC-1alpha, and SIRT1. Cruciferous vegetables are therefore recommended in the dietary protocol as polyphenol-rich xenohormetins and NRF2 activators that support the hormetic response.
description_zh_TW: 蘿蔔硫素，在西蘭花芽中大量發現，被強調為NRF2的強效激活劑和II期解毒酶的上調劑。NRF2是定義mitohormesis的急性ROS脈衝激活的關鍵應激反應通路之一，與AMPK、PGC-1α和SIRT1並列。因此，十字花科蔬菜在飲食方案中被推薦為富含多酚的xenohormetins和NRF2激活劑，支持hormetic反應。

label: ML385
description: ML385 binds the NRF2 bZIP domain, blocking its heterodimerization with small Maf proteins and preventing ARE-driven antioxidant transcription. Directionally, ML385 sits upstream of NRF2 inhibition. Because SIRT1 activates NRF2, ML385 can be used to disrupt that axis experimentally, and it is a tool to dissect NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. By preventing NRF2 from binding antioxidant-response elements, ML385 reduces the expression of the protective enzyme battery. Its selectivity for NRF2 over other bZIP factors makes it a valuable pharmacological probe in oxidative-stress research.
description_zh_TW: ML385 結合 NRF2 bZIP 域，阻斷其與小 Maf 蛋白的異源二聚化並阻止 ARE 驅動的抗氧化轉錄。在方向性上，ML385 位於 NRF2 抑制的上游。由於 SIRT1 活化 NRF2，ML385 可用於實驗性地破壞該軸線，是剖析 NRF2 依賴性細胞保護的工具。透過阻止 NRF2 結合抗氧化反應元件，ML385 減少保護性酶組的表達。其對 NRF2 相較於其他 bZIP 因子的選擇性使其成為氧化壓力研究中有價值的藥理學探針。

label: HPLC
description: A compound with the same retention time as adrenochrome on HPLC was detected in a biological fluid rich in neutrophils, providing chromatographic evidence that the adrenochrome pathway can operate in vivo. High-performance liquid chromatography is the analytical technique used to separate and identify adrenochrome on the basis of its characteristic retention behavior, and this detection in a neutrophil-rich fluid is among the strongest indications that the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome occurs in biological contexts. Despite such observations, the authors note that adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids by an established method, highlighting both the technical challenge of measuring this short-lived, unstable molecule and the ongoing controversy about its clinical significance in stress-induced heart disease.
description_zh_TW: 在一富含中性粒細胞的生物液體中，偵測到一個與腎上腺素紅在 HPLC 上具有相同滯留時間的化合物，提供了腎上腺素紅途徑可在體內運作的色譜學證據。高效液相色譜法是根據其特徵性滯留行為來分離並鑑定腎上腺素紅的分析技術，而在此富含中性粒細胞的液體中偵測到該物質，是腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺素紅發生於生物學情境中最有力的指標之一。儘管有此類觀察結果，作者指出腎上腺素紅從未以既 established 方法在生物液體中被偵測到，突顯了測量此種短壽命、不穩定分子的技術挑戰，以及其在壓力誘發心臟疾病中臨床意義的持續爭議。

label: Neuromelanin formation
description: Adrenochrome and related aminochromes serve as intermediates in the synthesis of neuromelanin, the dark pigment that accumulates in catecholaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra and locus coeruleus. When catecholamines such as dopamine, norepinephrine, and adrenaline are oxidized, they generate reactive quinones and aminochromes that polymerize into melanin-like pigments. In the brain, this process is tied to iron- and metal-catalyzed autoxidation, and the oxidative metabolism of catecholamines into quinone compounds contributes to the age-dependent buildup of neuromelanin. Adrenochrome-like structures are thus chemically upstream of neuromelanin formation, with neuromelanin granules accumulating progressively from birth to middle-to-late adulthood.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 及相關的 aminochromes 是 neuromelanin 合成的中間產物，neuromelanin 是一種深色色素，會堆積在 substantia nigra 與 locus coeruleus 的兒茶酚胺能神經元中。當 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 adrenaline 等兒茶酚胺被氧化時，會產生具反應性的 quinones 與 aminochromes，並聚合成類黑色素色素。在大腦中，此過程與鐵及金屬催化的自氧化有關，而兒茶酚胺氧化代謝成 quinone 化合物，促成了 neuromelanin 隨年齡增長的堆積。因此，adrenochrome-like 結構在化學上位於 neuromelanin 形成上游，neuromelanin 顆粒從出生到中晚年持續漸進堆積。

description: Adrenochrome has a computed XLogP3-AA partition coefficient of -1.3, indicating that the molecule is substantially more hydrophilic than lipophilic. The negative logP value arises from the polar indoline-5,6-dione core with its two carbonyl oxygens, one hydroxyl group, and four hydrogen bond acceptors, giving adrenochrome limited ability to partition into lipid membranes. This water solubility is consistent with its behavior as a blood- and tissue-dissolved oxidation product of the hydrophilic catecholamine epinephrine rather than a membrane-accumulating species. The polarity also shapes its toxicology: adrenochrome remains in aqueous compartments such as serum and cytosol where it can encounter proteins, DNA, and small-molecule nucleophiles. The low partition coefficient is relevant to questions about whether and where the compound can form and persist in biological fluids.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的計算 XLogP3-AA 分配係數為 -1.3，表明該分子明顯更具親水性而非親脂性。負 logP 值源於極性 indoline-5,6-dione 核心，其兩個羰基氧、一個羥基和四個氫鍵受體，使 adrenochrome 分配到脂質膜的能力有限。這種水溶性與其作為親水性兒茶酚胺腎上腺素的血液和組織溶解氧化產物的行為一致，而非膜累積物種。極性也塑造了其毒理學：adrenochrome 保留在血清和細胞質等水性區室中，在那裡它可以遇到蛋白質、DNA 和小分子親核試劑。低分配係數與該化合物是否以及在何處可以在生物液體中形成和持續存在的問題相關。

label: 179.17 g/mol
description: Adrenochrome has a molecular weight of 179.17 g/mol, computed by PubChem for the formula C9H9NO3. This relatively low molecular mass places adrenochrome among small bioactive molecules that can diffuse through tissues and interact with intracellular targets. The mass is consistent with the monoisotopic value of 179.0582 Da and reflects the compact indoline-5,6-dione scaffold assembled from the oxidation and cyclization of epinephrine. As a small, polar electrophile, adrenochrome's mass underlies its ability to cross cell membranes, reach nuclear DNA, and form covalent adducts with proteins, contributing to its documented toxicity. Knowledge of its molecular weight is also essential for analytical detection by HPLC and mass spectrometry, methods that have been used to search for adrenochrome in biological fluids.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的分子量為 179.17 g/mol，由 PubChem 根據分子式 C9H9NO3 計算得出。這種相對較低的分子質量使 adrenochrome 屬於可以擴散穿過組織並與細胞內靶標相互作用的小型生物活性分子。該質量與單一同位素值 179.0582 Da 一致，反映了由腎上腺素氧化和環化組裝而成的緊密 indoline-5,6-dione 骨架。作為小型、極性親電試劑，adrenochrome 的質量是其穿越細胞膜、到達核 DNA 並與蛋白質形成共價加合物的基礎，導致其已記錄的毒性。了解其分子量對於通過 HPLC 和質譜進行分析檢測也至關重要，這些方法已被用於在生物液體中搜索 adrenochrome。

label: Coronary artery constriction
description: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, and one of its documented cardiovascular effects is constriction of the coronary arteries. Along with cell necrosis and arrhythmias, coronary artery constriction links adrenochrome to impaired blood supply to the heart muscle and thereby to the pathology of stress-induced heart disease. The vasoconstrictive action of this adrenaline oxidation product is consistent with the broader biology of catecholamine oxidation, where reactive quinone species exert direct effects on vascular smooth muscle. These findings are significant in the context of the adrenochrome pathway because oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils infiltrating the myocardium can drive adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome, potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 已知 Adrenochrome 具有心臟毒性，其已記錄的心血管作用之一是冠狀動脈收縮。除了細胞壞死和心律不整外，冠狀動脈收縮將 Adrenochrome 與心肌血液供應受損連結起來，進而與壓力性心臟疾病的病理相關。這種 adrenaline 氧化產物的血管收縮作用與 catecholamine 氧化的更廣泛生物學一致，其中活性醌類物種對血管平滑肌產生直接作用。這些發現在 Adrenochrome 途徑的背景下具有重要意義，因為浸潤心肌的活化嗜中性白血球產生的氧自由基可驅動 adrenaline 氧化為 Adrenochrome， potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.

label: Arrhythmias
description: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, causing arrhythmias among its effects on the heart. The capacity of this oxidation product of adrenaline to disturb cardiac electrical activity, together with its induction of cell necrosis and coronary artery constriction, has made it a candidate mediator of stress-induced heart disease. Arrhythmias are proposed to arise because adrenochrome, as a reactive quinone, modifies cardiac proteins and disrupts the ionic and signaling machinery of cardiomyocytes. These effects are relevant to the hypothesis that when stimulated neutrophils produce oxygen radicals that oxidize adrenaline through the adrenochrome pathway, the resulting cardiotoxic products could contribute to the electrical instability observed after myocardial infarction, although the in vivo significance remains controversial because adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome已被證實具有心臟毒性，其對心臟的影響包括心律不齊。這種腎上腺素氧化產物干擾心臟電活動的能力，加上其誘發細胞壞死和冠狀動脈收縮的作用，使其成為壓力性心臟病的候選介導因子。心律不齊的產生被認為是因為adrenochrome作為一種活性醌類，修飾心臟蛋白並破壞心肌細胞的離子與訊號傳導機制。這些效應與以下假說相關：當受刺激的中性白血球產生氧自由基，透過adrenochrome pathway氧化腎上腺素時，所產生的心臟毒性產物可能促成心肌梗塞後觀察到的電不穩定性，但其體內意義仍具爭議性，因為adrenochrome從未在生物液體中被偵測到。

label: Cell necrosis
description: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, causing cell necrosis as one of its principal effects on cardiac tissue. Alongside arrhythmias and coronary artery constriction, the induction of cell necrosis demonstrates that adrenochrome is not merely an inert pigment but a cytologically damaging oxidation product of adrenaline. The necrotic cell death it triggers is consistent with its behavior as a reactive electrophilic quinone that forms covalent adducts with proteins and DNA, disrupting cellular function. These toxic effects provide the rationale for investigating the adrenochrome pathway in stress-induced heart disease, where oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils infiltrating the myocardium can drive adrenaline oxidation, potentially converting an excess of the catecholamine into a locally necrotizing species in the heart.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome已知具有心臟毒性，導致細胞壞死為其對心臟組織的主要效應之一。除心律不齊和冠狀動脈收縮外，細胞壞死的誘導表明adrenochrome不僅僅是一種惰性色素，而是腎上腺素的細胞毒性氧化產物。其觸發的壞死性細胞死亡與其作為活性親電醌的行為一致，該醌可與蛋白質和DNA形成共價加合物，擾亂細胞功能。這些毒性效應提供了研究adrenochrome途徑在壓力誘發之心臟疾病中的依據，其中浸潤心肌的活化嗜中性球所產生的氧自由基可驅動腎上腺素氧化， potentially將過量的兒茶酚胺轉化為心臟局部壞死性物種。

label: C9H9NO3
description: Adrenochrome has the molecular formula C9H9NO3, corresponding to nine carbon atoms, nine hydrogen atoms, one nitrogen atom, and three oxygen atoms, with a computed molecular weight of 179.17 g/mol and a monoisotopic mass of 179.0582 Da. The three oxygen atoms reflect the two carbonyl groups of the quinone ring (the 5,6-dione) and a single hydroxyl group at the 3-position of the indoline ring. The single nitrogen atom is the methylated amine that becomes part of the five-membered ring after epinephrine cyclizes. With one hydrogen bond donor and four hydrogen bond acceptors and no rotatable bonds, the formula describes a rigid, compact, oxygen-rich heterocycle whose composition is consistent across PubChem identifiers CID 5898, ChEMBL1314174, and CHEBI:166544. These structural parameters explain adrenochrome's high polarity and reactivity as an electrophilic quinone.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的分子式為 C9H9NO3，對應九個碳原子、九個氫原子、一個氮原子和三個氧原子，計算分子量為 179.17 g/mol，單一同位素質量為 179.0582 Da。三個氧原子反映了醌環（5,6-二酮）的兩個羰基和吲哚啉環 3 位的一個羥基。單個氮原子是甲基化胺，在腎上腺素環化後成為五元環的一部分。具有一個氫鍵供體和四個氫鍵受體且無可旋轉鍵，該分子式描述了一個剛性、緊密、富氧的雜環，其組成在 PubChem 標識符 CID 5898、ChEMBL1314174 和 CHEBI:166544 中一致。這些結構參數解釋了 adrenochrome 作為親電醌的高極性和反應性。

label: oxidation product of epinephrine
description: Adrenochrome is a chemical compound formed by the oxidation of epinephrine (adrenaline), a catecholamine stress hormone. In humans it arises as a minor oxidative metabolite or byproduct rather than through a dedicated biosynthetic pathway. Oxidation converts the catechol ring of adrenaline to an o-quinone followed by internal cyclization to an indoline-5,6-dione structure. This process occurs in vivo, driven by reactive oxygen species such as superoxide anion and hydrogen peroxide, and in vitro. Because the reaction competes with the primary COMT and MAO degradation routes, adrenochrome formation becomes more prominent under oxidative stress, inflammation, and conditions where adrenaline levels are high, and it is considered a marker of failed homeostasis rather than a normal abundant product.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是由兒茶酚胺壓力荷爾蒙 epinephrine（adrenaline）氧化形成的化學化合物。在人體中，它是作為次要的氧化代謝物或副產物出現，而非透過專一的生物合成途徑。氧化將腎上腺素的兒茶酚環轉化為 o-quinone，隨後內部環化形成 indoline-5,6-dione 結構。此過程在體內由超氧陰離子與過氧化氫等活性氧物種驅動，亦發生於體外。由於此反應與主要的 COMT 與 MAO 降解途徑競爭，adrenochrome 形成在氧化壓力、發炎以及腎上腺素濃度高的情況下更為顯著，且被視為恆定失調的標記，而非正常的豐富產物。

label: Indoles
description: Adrenochrome is a cyclic amino ketone pigment classified as a member of indoles. It bears the core indoline-5,6-dione scaffold, a fused bicyclic ring system derived from the cyclized catecholamine backbone. This indole classification reflects adrenochrome's origin as an oxidation product of the catecholamine epinephrine, whose benzene ring and amine side chain fold into a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring during intramolecular cyclization. As an indole quinone, adrenochrome sits at the intersection of catecholamine and pigment biochemistry, connecting the chemistry of adrenaline to downstream reactive electrophiles. Its indole structure underlies both its characteristic pink color and its tendency to undergo further reactions, including polymerization into melanins. This classification is central to understanding adrenochrome's behavior as an electron-deficient quinone that forms adducts with cellular nucleophiles.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是一種環狀胺基酮色素，被歸類為吲哚類成員。它具有核心的 indoline-5,6-dione 骨架，這是一個源自環化兒茶酚胺骨架的融合雙環系統。這種吲哚分類反映了 Adrenochrome 作為兒茶酚胺腎上腺素的氧化產物的起源，其苯環和胺側鏈在分子內環化過程中摺疊成含氮的五元環。作為吲哚醌，Adrenochrome 位於兒茶酚胺和色素生物化學的交匯處，將腎上腺素的化學與下游反應性親電試劑聯繫起來。其吲哚結構是其特徵性粉紅色和傾向於進一步反應（包括聚合成黑色素）的基礎。這種分類對於理解 Adrenochrome 作為電子缺陷醌與細胞親核試劑形成加合物的行為至關重要。

label: Electrophile
description: Adrenochrome is a highly reactive electrophile, an electron-poor species that seeks electrons from other molecules. As a quinone, its electron-deficient carbonyl system readily bonds with nucleophilic sites on proteins, DNA, and other cellular structures, forming covalent adducts, and this reactivity is why the molecule is considered toxic to cells. The electrophilic character also drives adrenochrome's self-reactivity: it rapidly polymerizes into melanin pigments rather than persisting in solution. This electron-poor nature is the mechanistic basis for adrenochrome's reported cardiotoxic effects, including cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction, because covalent modification of cellular macromolecules disrupts their function. Electrophilicity therefore unifies adrenochrome's instability, its adduct-forming toxicity, and its position as the central reactive intermediate of the adrenaline oxidation pathway.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅是一種高活性的親電體，一種電子缺乏的物質，會從其他分子中尋求電子。作為一種醌類，其電子缺乏的羰基系統容易與蛋白質、DNA 及其他細胞結構上的親核位點結合，形成共價加合物，而這種反應活性正是該分子被認為對細胞具有毒性的原因。其親電特性也驅動了腎上腺素紅的自我反應性：它會迅速聚合形成黑色素顏料，而非在溶液中持續存在。這種電子缺乏的特性是腎上腺素紅所報告的心臟毒性效應的機制基礎，包括細胞壞死、心律不整和冠狀動脈收縮，因為對細胞大分子的共價修飾會破壞其功能。因此，親電性將腎上腺素紅的不穩定性、其形成加合物的毒性，以及其作為腎上腺素氧化途徑中核心反應中間體的地位統一起來。

label: Pigment
description: Adrenochrome is a pigment obtained by the oxidation of epinephrine, exhibiting a characteristic pink-to-red color in aqueous solution that has been recognized since its first description in 1856. The pink color results from the conjugated indoline-5,6-dione chromophore that forms when the catecholamine ring is oxidized and cyclized. As a pigment, adrenochrome is an intermediate in the melanin pathway, because its further polymerization produces dark brown and black melanin pigments; the visible reddening of adrenaline solutions left exposed to air is the classic demonstration of this chemistry. Beyond its color, the pigment identity connects adrenochrome to histochemical and forensic contexts, where oxidation products of catecholamines are used as stains, and to pathology, where it represents an oxidative transformation of adrenaline linked to cellular damage.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是一種通過腎上腺素氧化獲得的色素，在水溶液中呈現特徵性的粉紅至紅色，自 1856 年首次描述以來已被認識。粉紅色源於共軛的 indoline-5,6-dione 發色團，該發色團在兒茶酚胺環氧化和環化時形成。作為色素，adrenochrome 是黑色素途徑中的中間體，因為其進一步聚合產生深棕色和黑色黑色素；暴露於空氣中的腎上腺素溶液可見的變紅是這種化學反應的經典演示。除了顏色之外，色素身份將 adrenochrome 與組織化學和法醫學背景聯繫起來，在那裡兒茶酚胺的氧化產物用作染色劑，並與病理學聯繫起來，在那裡它代表與細胞損傷相關的腎上腺素氧化轉化。

label: Minutes to hours
description: Adrenochrome is a very unstable molecule in aqueous solution, with a half-life ranging from minutes to hours depending on temperature, pH, and the presence of nucleophiles. The instability arises because adrenochrome is a highly reactive electrophilic quinone that rapidly undergoes further reactions, principally polymerization into melanins and covalent adduct formation with proteins and DNA. This transience is a central reason why adrenochrome has proven difficult to detect in biological fluids despite decades of interest in its possible role in disease: it does not persist long enough to accumulate. The short half-life also frames the clinical controversy around the compound, since any effect it exerts must occur quickly after formation, and its fleeting nature makes measurement of the relevant intermediate states technically challenging.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在水溶液中是一種極不穩定的分子，其半衰期依溫度、pH 值及親核試體的存在與否，從數分鐘到數小時不等。此不穩定性源於 adrenochrome 是一種高反應性的親電醌，會迅速進行進一步反應，主要是聚合成 melanins 以及與蛋白質和 DNA 形成共價加合物。這種短暫性正是儘管數十年來對其在疾病中的潛在角色感興趣，adrenochrome 仍難以在生物液體中檢測出的核心原因：它存在時間不足以累積。短半衰期也構成了該化合物周圍的臨床爭議，因為其任何效應都必須在形成後迅速發生，而其轉瞬即逝的特性使得相關中間狀態的測量在技術上具挑戰性。

label: indoline-5,6-dione
description: Adrenochrome is chemically an indoline-5,6-dione, formally 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione. The molecule features a fused bicyclic system in which a six-membered benzene ring (oxidized to a quinone at positions 5 and 6) is fused to a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring bearing a hydroxy substituent and an N-methyl group. This structure arises when oxidized epinephrine undergoes intramolecular cyclization, in which the side-chain nitrogen attacks the electrophilic o-quinone ring (a Michael addition), closing the second ring. The quinone moiety and its o-quinone character account for much of adrenochrome's reactivity, including its ability to undergo redox cycling and one-electron reduction to the semiquinone radical.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在化學上是 indoline-5,6-dione，正式名稱為 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione。該分子具有融合雙環系統，其中一個六元苯環（於第 5 與第 6 位氧化為醌）與一個帶有羥基取代基與 N-甲基的五元含氮環融合。此結構源於氧化後的 epinephrine 發生分子內環化，其中側鏈氮攻擊親電性的 o-quinone 環（一種 Michael 加成），閉合第二個環。醌部分及其 o-quinone 特性解釋了 adrenochrome 大部分的反應性，包括其進行氧化還原循環與單電子還原為半醌自由基的能力。

label: Acute oral toxicity
description: Adrenochrome is classified under the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) with hazard statement H302, meaning it is harmful if swallowed, with acute oral toxicity category 4 (Acute Tox. 4, 100% of notifications). The signal word is Warning with an irritant pictogram. This regulatory classification reflects experimental evidence that ingestion of adrenochrome can produce adverse effects, complementing mechanistic studies showing that adrenochrome, as an electrophilic quinone, readily forms covalent adducts with proteins and DNA and is cardiotoxic, capable of causing cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction. The GHS designation provides a formal toxicological endpoint that supports the view of adrenochrome as a biologically reactive molecule rather than an inert pigment, though its clinical significance in human disease remains debated.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 根據全球統一分類系統 (GHS) 被分類，具有危險性說明 H302，意味著吞食有害，具有急性口服毒性類別 4（急性毒性 4，100% 通知）。信號詞為警告，帶有刺激性象形圖。這種監管分類反映了攝入 adrenochrome 可能產生不良反應的實驗證據，補充了機制研究，表明 adrenochrome 作為親電醌易於與蛋白質和 DNA 形成共價加合物，並具有心臟毒性，可導致細胞壞死、心律失常和冠狀動脈收縮。GHS 指定提供了一個正式的毒理學終點，支持將 adrenochrome 視為生物反應性分子而非惰性色素的觀點，儘管其在人類疾病中的臨床意義仍有爭議。

label: Aqueous solutions at physiological pH
description: Adrenochrome is highly unstable in aqueous solutions at physiological pH, rapidly polymerizing into neuromelanin-like compounds. This chemical instability is a critical translational challenge because it makes formulating adrenochrome or its derivatives to achieve a controlled, targeted therapeutic window in vivo extremely difficult. The rapid polymerization also means that observed biological effects of adrenochrome preparations may be confounded by the presence of its polymeric breakdown products, complicating both mechanistic studies and any proposed use as a senotherapeutic agent.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在生理 pH 的水溶液中高度不穩定，會快速聚合形成類似 neuromelanin 的化合物。這種化學不穩定性是一個關鍵的轉譯挑戰，因為它使得製劑 adrenochrome 或其衍生物以在體內實現受控、靶向的治療窗口極其困難。快速聚合也意味著 adrenochrome 製劑觀察到的生物效應可能因其聚合分解產物的存在而混淆，使機制研究和任何擬議作為 senotherapeutic agent 的用途變得複雜。

label: Melanins
description: Adrenochrome is inherently very unstable and, as a highly reactive electrophile, rapidly undergoes further reactions once formed. Chief among these is polymerization: adrenochrome molecules condense together to produce melanins, the black and brown pigments responsible for the darkening of oxidized adrenaline solutions and related to the pigment chemistry of skin and hair. This polymerization is part of why adrenochrome has only a fleeting existence in aqueous solution, with a half-life ranging from minutes to hours depending on temperature, pH, and the presence of nucleophiles. The melanin-forming instability also means that adrenochrome sits on the oxidative pathway connecting catecholamines to the pigment melanin, linking adrenaline oxidation to pigmentation biochemistry and to the tissue discoloration seen in oxidized catecholamine environments.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 本質上非常不穩定，作為高活性親電體，一旦形成便迅速進行進一步反應。其中最主要的是聚合反應：Adrenochrome 分子相互凝縮產生 melanin（黑色素），這是導致氧化 adrenaline 溶液變黑變棕的色素，與皮膚和毛髮的色素化學相關。這種聚合反應是 adrenochrome 在水溶液中僅能短暫存在的原因之一，其半衰期依溫度、pH 值及親核試體的存在與否，從數分鐘到數小時不等。形成 melanin 的不穩定性也意味著 adrenochrome 位於連接 catecholamine 與色素 melanin 的氧化途徑上，將 adrenaline 的氧化與色素生成生物化學，以及在氧化 catecholamine 環境中所見的組織變色連結起來。

label: Hydrazines
description: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid structure and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines, e.g., aminoguanidine, semicarbazide, phenylhydrazine, o-nitrophenylhydrazine, p-nitrophenylhydrazine, and 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine. These hydrazine derivatives serve both for the stabilization of adrenochrome and for the preparation of useful medicines such as hemostatics. The stabilization treatment is generally conducted for 30 minutes to 3 hours at a temperature of 0 to 15 degrees C.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與肼類（如胺基胍、氨基硫脲、苯肼、鄰硝基苯肼、對硝基苯肼和2,4-二硝基苯肼）的常規衍生化來穩定。這些肼衍生物既用於穩定腎上腺紅，也用於製備如止血劑等實用藥物。穩定化處理通常在0至15°C下進行30分鐘至3小時。

label: Cardiotoxicity
description: Adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, is linked to potential cardiotoxic effects when catecholamine levels are high or under oxidative stress. Oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome has been observed in isolated rat cardiomyocytes, and one hypothesis proposes that adrenochrome or its metabolites such as adrenolutin contribute to stress-induced heart problems. In inflammatory cardiac conditions such as myocardial infarction, where neutrophils infiltrate and release ROS, local conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome could be relevant, though the cardiotoxic contribution of adrenochrome specifically remains incompletely established.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, is linked to potential cardiotoxic effects when catecholamine levels are high or under oxidative stress。Oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome has been observed in isolated rat cardiomyocytes, and one hypothesis proposes that adrenochrome or its metabolites such as adrenolutin contribute to stress-induced heart problems。In inflammatory cardiac conditions such as myocardial infarction, where neutrophils infiltrate and release ROS, local conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome could be relevant, though the cardiotoxic contribution of adrenochrome specifically remains incompletely established。

label: Michael addition
description: Aminochromes are strong electrophiles capable of reacting with nucleophilic sulfhydryl (cysteine) groups on cellular proteins via Michael addition. This covalent modification is the proposed senomorphic mechanism: by alkylating critical cysteine residues on regulators such as IKK and the p65 subunit of NF-κB, adrenochrome could permanently inhibit NF-κB signaling and blunt transcription of SASP factors like IL-6 and IL-8. The same thiol-reactivity underlies aminochrome toxicity through adduct formation with proteins such as alpha-synuclein.
description_zh_TW: 氨基色素是強親電體，能通過麥克爾加成與細胞蛋白質上的親核硫氫基（半胱氨酸）反應。這種共價修飾是假定的衰老模仿機制：通過烷基化調節因子如IKK和NF-κB的p65亞基上的關鍵半胱氨酸殘基，腎上腺素色素可能永久抑制NF-κB信號並削弱IL-6和IL-8等SASP因子的轉錄。相同的硫醇反應性奠定了氨基色素通過與α-突觸核蛋白等蛋白質形成加合物的毒性。

label: IKK complex
description: Aminochromes such as adrenochrome can covalently modify the IKK complex (IkappaB kinase), a key upstream activator of NF-kappaB, via Michael addition to critical cysteine residues. IKK relies on cysteine residues for its activation, so alkylation would impair its kinase function and prevent phosphorylation-dependent activation of NF-kappaB. By disabling this upstream regulator, low concentrations of adrenochrome are hypothesized to suppress NF-kappaB-driven SASP transcription, shifting the senescent cell into a less inflammatory, senomorphic state rather than killing it outright.
description_zh_TW: 氨基色素如腎上腺素色素可通過麥克爾加成共價修飾IKK複合物（IκB激酶），NF-κB的關鍵上游激活因子，針對關鍵半胱氨酸殘基。IKK依賴半胱氨酸殘基進行激活，因此烷基化會損害其激酶功能並阻止NF-κB的磷酸化依賴性激活。通過禁用此上游調節因子，假定低濃度的腎上腺素色素抑制NF-κB驅動的SASP轉錄，將衰老細胞轉變為較少炎症的衰老模仿狀態，而非直接殺死。

label: Biological fluids
description: Despite decades of interest in the adrenochrome pathway, adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids, and no established method for its formation in vivo has been demonstrated; this is the central reason the clinical significance of the compound remains controversial. The difficulty of detection is consistent with the molecule's chemical properties, including its instability and short half-life in aqueous solution, its rapid polymerization into melanins, and its reactivity with proteins and DNA, all of which would prevent accumulation. The strongest evidence for in vivo formation is indirect, such as the detection of a compound with the same HPLC retention time as adrenochrome in a biological fluid rich in neutrophils and the presence of oxidase activity in serum after myocardial infarction. Its apparent absence from biological fluids, however, has fueled skepticism about whether the pathway is truly significant in human disease.
description_zh_TW: 儘管數十年來對 adrenochrome 途徑感興趣，adrenochrome 從未在生物液體中被檢測到，也尚未建立證明其在體內形成的既成方法；這是該化合物臨床意義仍具爭議性的核心原因。檢測的困難與該分子的化學性質一致，包括其在水溶液中的不穩定性與短半衰期、迅速聚合成 melanins，以及對蛋白質和 DNA 的反應性，這些都會阻止其累積。體內形成最強的證據是間接的，例如在富含中性粒細胞的生物液體中檢測到與 adrenochrome 具有相同 HPLC 滯留時間的化合物，以及心肌梗塞後血清中出現氧化酶活性。然而，它明顯不存在於生物液體中，助長了對該途徑是否在人類疾病中真正重要的懷疑。

label: 495 nm wavelength
description: During the oxidation of adrenaline, the reaction mixture is tinged with purplish red due to the production of adrenochrome, and its color becomes deeper with increasing adrenochrome content. The reaction is continued until the absorbance at a wavelength of 495 nm, measured by sampling the reaction mixture at an appropriate time, reaches a maximum, at which point further oxidation of the product is minimized and adrenochrome is obtained in maximum yield. The reaction time required for maximum yield varies from 30 to 45 minutes depending on the temperature of the reaction mixture and the level of catalyst employed.
description_zh_TW: 在腎上腺素氧化過程中，反應混合物因腎上腺紅的生成而呈紫紅色，且隨腎上腺紅含量增加而顏色加深。反應持續進行，直到於適當時間取樣反應混合物所測得的495 nm波長吸光度達到最大值，此時產物的進一步氧化降至最低，並以最大產率獲得腎上腺紅。達到最大產率所需的反應時間為30至45分鐘不等，取決於反應混合物的溫度和所用催化劑的量。

label: Keap1
description: Electrophilic stress from aminochromes also modifies Keap1, the adaptor that keeps the transcription factor Nrf2 targeted for degradation under basal conditions. Modification of Keap1's sensor cysteines releases Nrf2, which then upregulates antioxidant response element (ARE) genes. Because active Nrf2 mutually antagonizes NF-κB and represses several pro-inflammatory cytokine genes, adrenochrome-induced Nrf2 activation is proposed as a second, indirect mechanism of SASP suppression in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: 氨基色素的親電壓力也修飾Keap1，即在基礎條件下將轉錄因子Nrf2標靶為降解的適配器。Keap1的感測半胱氨酸修飾釋放Nrf2，後者隨後上調抗氧化反應元件（ARE）基因。由於活性Nrf2相互拮抗NF-κB並抑制幾個促炎細胞因子基因，腎上腺素色素誘導的Nrf2激活被提出作為衰老細胞中SASP抑制的第二間接機制。

label: Erythrocytes
description: Erythrocytes (red blood cells) are not a normal site of adrenochrome storage or production. They lack the organelles and major oxidative enzymes found in neutrophils or adrenal cells that actively generate adrenochrome, so any adrenochrome in red blood cells would be trace, transient, or the result of external oxidation in blood plasma. Hemoglobin can, however, catalyze epinephrine oxidation in blood, and the erythrocyte plasma membrane can convert adrenaline to aminochromes, so adrenochrome is more relevant to red blood cells as a potential reactant or byproduct that can damage cell membranes than as a normally present cellular component.
description_zh_TW: 紅血球（red blood cells）並非adrenochrome儲存或生成的常態位置。它們缺乏neutrophils或adrenal cells所具有、能主動生成adrenochrome的胞器與主要氧化酶，因此紅血球中任何的adrenochrome都會是微量、短暫的，或是blood plasma中external oxidation的結果。然而，Hemoglobin能在血液中催化epinephrine oxidation，且erythrocyte plasma membrane能將adrenaline轉化為aminochromes，因此對紅血球而言，adrenochrome更像是可能損害cell membranes的潛在反應物或副產物，而非正常存在的cellular component。

label: Metabolic waste
description: In the chemistry of catecholamine handling, the main route is a clean enzymatic process in which MAO and COMT specifically target adrenaline, process it, and prepare it for excretion, keeping blood pressure and heart rate controlled. The adrenochrome pathway, by contrast, is a side pathway that essentially produces metabolic waste: adrenochrome is a chemical mishap formed when the body's antioxidant defenses are failing and epinephrine oxidizes on its own. Adrenochrome is therefore not a purposeful catabolite but an incidental oxidation product whose formation is considered undesirable because of the molecule's electrophilic reactivity toward proteins and DNA. Viewing adrenochrome as metabolic waste frames it as a failure marker of homeostasis whose accumulation is linked to oxidative stress, rather than a regulated product of normal catecholamine metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 在兒茶酚胺處理的化學中，主要途徑是一個乾淨的酵素過程，其中 MAO 和 COMT 專一地標靶 adrenaline，處理它並為排泄做準備，從而控制血壓和心率。相對地，adrenochrome 途徑是一條側路，本質上產生代謝廢物：adrenochrome 是當身體抗氧化防禦失效、epinephrine 自行氧化時所形成的化學意外。因此，adrenochrome 並非有目的的分解代謝物，而是一種偶發的氧化產物，其形成被視為不可取，因為該分子對蛋白質和 DNA 具有親電反應性。將 adrenochrome 視為代謝廢物，使其成為恆定性失敗的標記，其累積與氧化壓力相關，而非正常兒茶酚胺代謝的受調節產物。

label: Reference standard
description: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control. Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use. Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air, manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products, and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control。Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use。Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air，manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products，and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies。

label: Impurity marker
description: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies. HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability, since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments. Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe, and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies。HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability，since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments。Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe，and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically。

label: NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase
description: NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase performs the one-electron reduction of aminochrome ortho-quinones such as adrenochrome, generating highly unstable semiquinone radicals. These radicals rapidly transfer their electron to molecular oxygen, producing superoxide anion and regenerating the parent quinone in a redox cycle. This enzyme-initiated reduction is the entry point for aminochrome-driven oxidative stress that is hypothesized to selectively push already-ROS-elevated senescent cells into apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: NADPH-細胞色素P450還原酶執行氨基色素鄰醌如腎上腺素色素的單電子還原，產生高度不穩定的半醌自由基。這些自由基迅速將其電子轉移到分子氧，產生超氧陰離子並在氧化還原循環中再生母體醌。此酶啟動的還原是氨基色素驅動的氧化應激的入口點，假定選擇性地將已ROS升高的衰老細胞推入凋亡。

label: Rheumatoid synovial fluid
description: Researchers have detected adrenochrome-like compounds in neutrophil-rich fluids such as synovial fluid from rheumatoid arthritis patients, where neutrophil activation and ROS release are prominent. This suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine oxidation in inflammatory or stress-related conditions, and one study proposed it as a potential catabolic route for adrenaline in inflammatory diseases. Adrenochrome detected in such fluids reflects local oxidation of catecholamines at sites of inflammation, consistent with the observation that cell-free medium from activated neutrophils retains adrenaline-oxidizing ability.
description_zh_TW: Researchers已在neutrophil-rich fluids中，例如rheumatoid arthritis患者的synovial fluid，detected adrenochrome-like compounds，此處neutrophil activation與ROS release顯著。這suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine oxidation in inflammatory或stress-related conditions，且有一項study proposed它可能是inflammatory diseases中adrenaline的potential catabolic route。在此類fluids中detected的adrenochrome reflects inflammation部位catecholamines的local oxidation，consistent with the observation that activated neutrophils的cell-free medium retains adrenaline-oxidizing ability。

label: Semicarbazide
description: Semicarbazide reacts with adrenochrome to form adrenochrome monosemicarbazone (carbazochrome), a hemostatic agent. In the patented process, semicarbazide hydrochloride is added to the adrenochrome solution at below 10 degrees C in the presence of a potassium acetate buffer, with the stabilization carried out at pH 5 to 7. The reaction yields about 40.0 g of crude powder that is purified by dissolving in dilute sodium hydroxide, active carbon treatment, and precipitation at pH 5.5, and the purified product shows an ultraviolet absorption maximum at 354 nm and characteristic infrared absorptions matching those of an authentic sample.
description_zh_TW: 氨基硫脲與腎上腺紅反應形成腎上腺紅單縮氨脲（carbazochrome），一種止血劑。在該專利方法中，於低於10°C下、在醋酸鉀緩衝液存在下將鹽酸氨基硫脲加入腎上腺紅溶液中，穩定化在pH 5至7下進行。反應產生約40.0 g粗粉末，經溶於稀氫氧化鈉、活性碳處理及在pH 5.5下沉澱純化，純化後的產物呈現354 nm的紫外線吸收極大值，以及與標準品相符的特徵紅外線吸收。

label: 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione
description: The IUPAC name of adrenochrome is 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione, which encodes the complete structure of the molecule: an indole (indoline) bicyclic core, a hydroxyl group at the 3-position, an N-methyl group on the ring nitrogen, and two ketone carbonyls at the 5- and 6-positions of the benzo ring. The 5,6-dione motif makes adrenochrome a quinone, while the 3-hydroxyl and N-methyl groups are the vestiges of the epinephrine side chain after oxidative cyclization. Alternative names such as indoline-5,6-dione refer to the same compound. The name captures the duality of adrenochrome: a rigid indole ring system that is simultaneously an electron-deficient quinone, explaining both its stability within the indole class and its electrophilic reactivity toward biological nucleophiles.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的 IUPAC 名稱為 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione，它編碼了分子的完整結構：一個吲哚（吲哚啉）雙環核心，3 位的一個羥基，環氮上的 N-甲基，以及苯環 5 和 6 位的兩個酮羰基。5,6-二酮基序使 adrenochrome 成為醌，而 3-羥基和 N-甲基是氧化環化後腎上腺素側鏈的殘留物。替代名稱如 indoline-5,6-dione 指的是同一種化合物。該名稱捕捉了 adrenochrome 的雙重性：一個剛性的吲哚環系統，同時是電子缺陷醌，解釋了其在吲哚類中的穩定性及其對生物親核試劑的親電反應性。

label: Epacadostat
description: Epacadostat is a small-molecule inhibitor of IDO1 tested in clinical trials as an immuno-oncology strategy, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors targeting PD-1/PD-L1. These combinations aim to relieve IDO1-mediated immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment by blocking tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production, thereby restoring effector T cell function. However, results from such trials have been mixed, and challenges including isoform selectivity, compensatory pathways (TDO, IDO2), and context-specific effects have limited clinical success.
description_zh_TW: Epacadostat是一種IDO1的小分子抑制劑，已在臨床試驗中作為免疫腫瘤學策略進行測試，常與標靶PD-1/PD-L1的檢查點抑制劑合併使用。這些合併療法旨在透過阻斷色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸（kynurenine）生成，來解除腫瘤微環境中IDO1介導的免疫抑制，從而恢復效應T細胞功能。然而，此類試驗的結果好壞參半，包括異構體選擇性、代償途徑（TDO、IDO2）與情境依賴性效應等挑戰，限制了臨床上的成功。

label: Branched-Chain Amino Acids
description: High circulating branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) levels - leucine, isoleucine, and valine - are associated with obesity, insulin resistance, and mortality in humans. High-BCAA diets promote obesity, insulin resistance, inflammation, and decreased lifespan in rodents, whereas dietary restriction of BCAAs promotes metabolic health, reduces frailty, and extends lifespan, recapitulating many benefits of protein restriction. BCAA restriction reduces mTORC1 signaling, induces Fgf21, reduces hepatic cellular senescence, and in human studies improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis while increasing circulating FGF21. Although BCAAs are often considered as a group, each individual BCAA plays distinct roles in aging.
description_zh_TW: 循環中高濃度的支鏈胺基酸（BCAA）——白胺酸（leucine）、異白胺酸（isoleucine）與纈胺酸（valine）——與人類的肥胖、胰島素阻抗及死亡率相關。高BCAA飲食會在囓齒類中促進肥胖、胰島素阻抗、發炎並縮短壽命；而膳食限制BCAA則可促進代謝健康、減少衰弱並延長壽命，重現蛋白質限制的許多益處。限制BCAA可降低mTORC1訊息傳導、誘導Fgf21、減少肝臟細胞衰老；在人體研究中則可改善胰島素敏感性與葡萄糖/胰島素恆定，同時提高循環中的FGF21。儘管BCAA常被視為一個群體，但每一種BCAA在衰老中都扮演著不同的角色。

label: Dioxygenase
description: IDO1 belongs to the family of heme-dependent dioxygenases (EC 1.13.11.52), distinct from but functionally related to tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase (TDO, mainly hepatic) and IDO2 (a less active paralog). It is a monomeric cytosolic protein of about 45 kDa encoded by the IDO1 gene on human chromosome 8p11.21. Crystal structures (e.g., PDB 2D0T, 5EK2) reveal a large domain with a deep heme-binding pocket and a smaller domain, and the active site shows plasticity that allows inhibitor and substrate binding. This structural information underpins the design of IDO1 inhibitors for immuno-oncology.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 屬於依賴血基質的雙加氧酶家族（EC 1.13.11.52），與色胺酸 2,3-雙加氧酶（TDO，主要位於肝臟）及 IDO2（活性較低的旁系同源物）有別但功能相關。它是由人類第 8 號染色體 8p11.21 上的 IDO1 基因編碼、約 45 kDa 的單體胞質蛋白。晶體結構（例如 PDB 2D0T、5EK2）顯示一個帶有深血基質結合口袋的大結構域與一個較小結構域，且活性位點展現容許抑制劑與受質結合的可塑性。此結構資訊支撐了用於免疫腫瘤學的 IDO1 抑制劑設計。

label: SOCS3
description: IDO1 is controlled post-translationally: phosphorylation of its ITIM motifs recruits SOCS3, leading to ubiquitination and degradation of IDO1 as a negative feedback mechanism. This degradation pathway limits IDO1 activity and terminates its immunosuppressive effects, representing a key regulatory checkpoint. IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic signaling such as PI3K activation. IDO2 may compete for heme and act as a negative regulator in some settings. These regulatory layers are important for therapeutic targeting of IDO1, as they influence the durability and magnitude of tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production in the tumor microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: IDO1在翻譯後被控制：其ITIM基序的磷酸化招募SOCS3，導致IDO1的泛素化和降解，作為負反饋機制。這種降解途徑限制IDO1活性並終止其免疫抑製作用，代表一個關鍵的調節檢查點。IDO1還可以介導非酶信號，如PI3K激活。IDO2可能在某些情況下競爭血紅素並作為負調節因子。這些調節層對於IDO1的治療靶向很重要，因為它們影響腫瘤微環境中色氨酸耗竭和犬尿氨酸產生的持久性和幅度。

label: Dendritic cells
description: IDO1 is highly expressed in the placenta, lymph nodes, lungs, small intestine, and certain immune cells including dendritic cells, macrophages and monocytes, and it is inducible in many tissues during inflammation. In antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells, IDO1 modulates T cell responses peripherally through local tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production, creating an immunosuppressive environment. This expression pattern underlies IDO1's roles in maternal-fetal tolerance (high placental expression), antimicrobial defense, regulation of inflammation and autoimmunity, and tumor immune escape.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 在胎盤、淋巴結、肺、小腸以及樹突細胞、巨噬細胞與單核球等特定免疫細胞中高度表現，並可在發炎期間於許多組織中被誘導。在樹突細胞等抗原呈現細胞中，IDO1 透過局部色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸生成在外周調節 T 細胞反應，創造免疫抑制環境。此表現模式構成 IDO1 在母胎耐受（胎盤高表現）、抗菌防禦、發炎與自體免疫調節以及腫瘤免疫逃逸中所扮演角色的基礎。

label: Interferon-gamma
description: IDO1 is strongly induced by inflammatory cytokines, especially interferon-gamma (IFNγ) via JAK/STAT signaling, but also by IFNα/β, TNF-α, IL-1, LPS, and other signals in immune and other cells; glucocorticoids can synergize in some contexts. Expression is high in placenta, lymph nodes, lungs, small intestine, and certain immune cells including dendritic cells, macrophages and monocytes, and is inducible in many tissues during inflammation. Post-translational control involves phosphorylation of ITIM motifs that recruit SOCS3, leading to ubiquitination and degradation as a negative feedback mechanism, and IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic signaling such as PI3K activation.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 由發炎性細胞激素強烈誘導，尤其是透過 JAK/STAT 訊息傳導的干擾素-γ（IFNγ），但也可由 IFNα/β、TNF-α、IL-1、LPS 及其他訊號在免疫細胞與其他細胞中誘導；糖皮質激素在某些情境下可產生協同作用。其表現於胎盤、淋巴結、肺、小腸及樹突細胞、巨噬細胞與單核球等特定免疫細胞中很高，並可在發炎期間於許多組織中被誘導。轉譯後調控涉及 ITIM 基序的磷酸化，招募 SOCS3 導致泛素化與降解，作為負回饋機制，且 IDO1 也可媒介如 PI3K 活化等非酶促訊號。

label: IDO2
description: IDO2, a less active paralog of IDO1, may compete for heme and act as a negative regulator in some settings. Both are heme-dependent dioxygenases functionally related to TDO (tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase, mainly hepatic). The existence of these compensatory pathways is a major challenge for IDO1-targeted therapy, as IDO2 and TDO can partially substitute for IDO1 in maintaining tryptophan catabolism and immunosuppression. This isospecificity issue, along with context-specific effects, has contributed to the mixed results of IDO1 inhibitor trials in immuno-oncology, where single-target blockade may be insufficient to relieve metabolic immunosuppression.
description_zh_TW: IDO2 是 IDO1 活性較低的旁系同源物，可能競爭血基質並在某些情境下作為負調節因子。兩者皆為與 TDO（色胺酸 2,3-雙加氧酶，主要位於肝臟）功能相關的依賴血基質雙加氧酶。這些代償途徑的存在是 IDO1 標靶治療的重大挑戰，因為 IDO2 與 TDO 可在維持色胺酸分解代謝與免疫抑制方面部分取代 IDO1。此同功酶特異性問題，加上情境特異性效應，導致免疫腫瘤學中 IDO1 抑制劑試驗結果好壞參半，因為單一標靶阻斷可能不足以解除代謝性免疫抑制。

label: Cardiolipin
description: Cardiolipin stimulates DRP1 GTPase activity for fission AND is required for OPA1-mediated fusion — it has dual pro-fusion and pro-fission roles depending on context.
description_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 刺激 DRP1 的 GTPase 活性以進行使分裂，同時也是 OPA1 介導融合所必需的——依情境不同，它具有促融合與促分裂的雙重角色。

label: Huntingtin
description: Mutant huntingtin (mHTT) uncouples fission from degradation while disrupting autophagic flux. Broad-spectrum autophagy activators like rapamycin may be insufficient if downstream transport remains blocked.
description_zh_TW: 突變 huntingtin（mHTT）使分裂與降解脫鉤，同時破壞自噬流。若下游運輸仍受阻，則 rapamycin 等廣譜自噬活化劑可能不足。

label: BNIP3
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: BNIP3 (BCL-2/adenovirus E1B interacting protein 3) is an outer mitochondrial membrane mitophagy receptor that interacts directly with LC3 to promote engulfment of damaged mitochondria, functioning independently of Parkin. NIX/BNIP3-mediated mitophagy is induced through hypoxia and stabilization of HIF-1alpha. BNIP3 also interacts with OPA1 to induce mitochondrial fragmentation and with FUNDC1 under the control of OPA1 and DRP1, and its protein levels are upregulated at early premalignant stages of several human solid cancers but frequently decrease when tumors become invasive.
description_zh_TW: BNIP3（BCL-2/adenovirus E1B interacting protein 3，BCL-2/腺病毒E1B相互作用蛋白3）是粒線體外膜上的粒線體自噬（mitophagy）受體，直接與LC3相互作用以促進受損粒線體的吞噬，其功能不依賴Parkin。NIX/BNIP3介導的粒線體自噬可透過缺氧與HIF-1alpha的穩定化而被誘導。BNIP3也與OPA1相互作用以誘導粒線體斷裂，並在OPA1與DRP1的調控下與FUNDC1相互作用；其蛋白質水平在多種人類實體癌的早期癌前階段上調，但當腫瘤變得具侵襲性時往往下降。

label: Mitochondrial Fission Sites
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: DRP1 is recruited from the cytosol to defined sites on the mitochondrial outer membrane, where division occurs. Its adaptor proteins, including MFF, FIS1, MID49, and MID51, serve as receptors that concentrate DRP1 at prospective fission sites, often at positions where mitochondria are already constricted or associated with the endoplasmic reticulum. In cultured cells, MFF recruits DRP1 to the majority of fission events, while MID49 and MID51 recruit DRP1 to mitochondria independently of MFF in certain conditions. Once concentrated, DRP1 oligomerizes into spirals that wrap around the tubule, and GTP hydrolysis drives the membrane constriction required for complete scission.
description_zh_TW: DRP1 從細胞質被招募至粒線體外膜上的特定位置，分裂即在此發生。其接合蛋白（包括 MFF、FIS1、MID49 與 MID51）作為受體，將 DRP1 集中於預定的分裂位點，這些位點通常位於粒線體已收縮或與內質網相關的位置。在培養細胞中，MFF 將 DRP1 招募至大多數的分裂事件，而在某些條件下，MID49 與 MID51 則獨立於 MFF 將 DRP1 招募至粒線體。一旦集中，DRP1 便寡聚化為環繞管狀結構的螺旋，而 GTP 水解驅動完成完全分裂所需的膜收縮。

label: FIS1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: FIS1 is a tail-anchored outer mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a receptor for DRP1, helping to recruit the fission machinery to mitochondria. In yeast, the FIS1 ortholog Fis1p is the main membrane anchor for the Dnm1p fission GTPase, whereas in mammalian cells FIS1 plays a more accessory role alongside MFF, MID49, and MID51, and may also mediate non-DRP1 functions such as recruiting proteasomal and autophagic machinery to mitochondria. Overexpression of FIS1 fragments mitochondria, whereas FIS1 knockdown produces elongated networks, confirming its pro-fission role, although its relative importance varies between cell types and conditions.
description_zh_TW: FIS1是一種錨定於粒線體外膜的蛋白質（tail-anchored protein），作為DRP1的受體，協助將分裂機製招募至粒線體。在酵母菌中，FIS1的直系同源物Fis1p是分裂GTP酶Dnm1p的主要膜錨點；而在哺乳類細胞中，FIS1則與MFF、MID49及MID51一同扮演較輔助性的角色，也可能中介非DRP1的功能，例如將蛋白酶體與自噬機製招募至粒線體。FIS1過度表現會使粒線體碎裂，而FIS1基因敲低則產生延長狀的網絡，證實其促分裂作用，儘管其相對重要性會因細胞類型與條件而異。

label: FUNDC1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: FUNDC1 (FUN14 domain containing 1) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that serves as a mitophagy receptor for hypoxia-induced mitophagy, interacting directly with LC3 after dephosphorylation by phosphoglycerate mutase 5. ULK1 interacts with FUNDC1 and phosphorylates it at serine 17, enhancing FUNDC1 binding to LC3, and FUNDC1 interacts with OPA1 and DRP1 in a manner regulated by serine 13 phosphorylation during hypoxia or membrane potential loss. DRP1 can interact with overexpressed FUNDC1 to facilitate mitochondrial fragmentation and Parkin-mediated mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: FUNDC1（FUN14 domain containing 1）是一種粒線體外膜蛋白，作為缺氧誘發粒線體自噬的受體，在經磷酸甘油酸變位酶5（phosphoglycerate mutase 5）去磷酸化後直接與LC3交互作用。ULK1與FUNDC1交互作用並在絲胺酸17（serine 17）處使其磷酸化，增強FUNDC1與LC3的結合；而在缺氧或膜電位喪失期間，FUNDC1與OPA1及DRP1的交互作用則受絲胺酸13磷酸化調節。DRP1可與過度表現的FUNDC1交互作用，以促進粒線體碎裂與Parkin介導的粒線體自噬。

label: Fasting
description: Intermittent fasting and time-restricted feeding compress the eating window to 8-10 hours to allow a 14-16 hour daily fasting period, described as the simplest and most effective way to activate AMPK and mitophagy. Constant snacking and chronic overeating abolish the fasting-induced AMPK signal necessary for mitophagy. Fasting-induced mitochondrial recycling is a core mitohormetic mechanism, and stopping food intake at least 3-4 hours before sleep is highlighted as a key variable that instantly improves overnight HRV by allowing the body to focus entirely on cellular repair during sleep.
description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食與限時進食將進食窗口壓縮至8–10小時，以達到每天14–16小時的禁食期，被描述為活化AMPK與粒線體自噬最簡單且最有效的方法。持續零嘴進食與慢性暴食會消除禁食誘發、粒線體自噬所需的AMPK訊號。禁食誘導的粒線體回收是核心的粒線體毒物興奮機制，而至少在睡前3–4小時停止進食被強調為關鍵變因，可讓身體在睡眠期間完全專注於細胞修復，立即改善夜間HRV。

label: Mdivi-1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mdivi-1 (mitochondrial division inhibitor 1), a quinazolinone derivative that specifically inhibits DRP1, attenuates cardiac dysfunction in diverse mouse cardiomyopathy models, likely by promoting mitochondrial elongation or reducing autophagy. It also attenuates neuronal cell death through mitochondrial elongation and inhibition of complex I activity and ROS generation in neurodegenerative disease models including Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease. However, treatment of myocardial infarction in pigs with Mdivi-1 did not reduce infarct size or preserve cardiac function, and Mdivi-1 has off-target effects such as cleaving L-OPA1 and altering OXPHOS complex protein expression.
description_zh_TW: Mdivi-1（粒線體分裂抑制劑 1）是一種喹唑啉酮衍生物，可特異性抑制 DRP1，在多種小鼠心肌病模型中減輕心臟功能障礙，可能透過促進粒線體延長或減少自噬。它在帕金森氏症與阿茲海默症等神經退化性疾病模型中，也透過粒線體延長以及抑制複合體 I 活性與 ROS 生成來減輕神經元細胞死亡。然而，以 Mdivi-1 治療豬的心肌梗塞並未減少梗塞面積或保存心臟功能，且 Mdivi-1 具有脫靶效應，例如切割 L-OPA1 與改變 OXPHOS 複合體蛋白質表現。

label: Complex I and Complex IV
description: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
description_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

label: Sphingosine-1-phosphate
description: ACase overexpression raises sphingosine/S1P levels, which is classically anti-apoptotic and helps senescent cells resist apoptosis via SCAP pathways.
description_zh_TW: ACase 過度表現提高 sphingosine/S1P 水平，此在經典上為抗凋亡，並透過 SCAP 路徑幫助衰老細胞抵抗凋亡。

label: ASAH1
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, aCDase) is encoded by ASAH1. It is a lysosomal hydrolase that cleaves ceramide into sphingosine and a free fatty acid.
description_zh_TW: 酸性神經醯胺酶（ACase、aCDase）由 ASAH1 編碼。它是一種溶酶體水解酶，可將神經醯胺裂解為鞘氨醇與游離脂肪酸。

label: Carmofur
description: Carmofur has IC50 29 nM against acid ceramidase, is clinically approved in Japan, crosses the BBB, and is a repurposing candidate for senolytic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Carmofur 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 為 29 nM，已在日本獲臨床核准，可穿過血腦屏障（BBB），是去衰老（senolytic）治療的再利用候選藥物。

label: PUFA
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase) over-expression increases the polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) content of membrane phospholipids, promoting a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile. Mechanistically, ACase-mediated ceramide breakdown releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that, via the Lands cycle, are exchanged into sn-2 PUFA-containing phospholipids (PL-PUFAs) - the substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACase knockdown in senescent cells decreased the most abundant PL-PUFA species (including PC-AA, PG-DHA, PG-DPA), thereby reducing the lipid peroxidation substrate pool and conferring ferroptosis resistance.
description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶 (ACase) 過表達增加了膜磷脂中的不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 含量，促進了促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態。從機制上講，ACase 介導的絲胺類分解釋放了自由飽和和一元飽和脂肪酸，透過 Lands 循環轉化為 sn-2 PUFA 含有磷脂 (PL-PUFAs) - 這是脂質過氧化反應的底物。在老化的細胞中，ACase 下調降低了最豐富的 PL-PUFA 物種（包括 PC-AA、PG-DHA、PG-DPA），從而降低了脂質過氧化反應底物池，並賦予了焦蛋白死亡的抵抗力。

label: Ceramide
description: Acid ceramidase breaks down ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, reshaping membrane lipid composition. In senescent cells, progressively higher expression of this enzyme drives a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids - the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Salk Institute researchers studying human lung cells discovered that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis and that removal of the enzyme protects both young and old cells from ferroptosis-induced death. Because acid ceramidase inhibitors already exist for other therapeutic purposes, the enzyme represents a druggable target for clearing senescent cells and supporting healthy aging.
description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶將絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，重塑膜脂類組成。在老化的細胞中，這種酶的表達水平隨著時間推移而升高，導致富含不飽和脂肪酸的促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。沙鹿研究所研究員在研究人類肺細胞時發現，升高後的酸陶瓷酶使老化的細胞更容易受到焦蛋白死亡的影響，並且去除這種酶可以保護年輕和年老的細胞免受焦蛋白誘導的死亡。因為酸陶瓷酶抑制劑已經存在於其他治療用途中，因此這種酶是一個可藥物標靶的目標，可以用於清除老化的細胞並支持健康老齡化。

label: Sphingosine
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Acid ceramidase catalyzes the breakdown of ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, directly producing sphingosine in the cell. This enzymatic hydrolysis is a key branch point in sphingolipid metabolism, and in senescent cells the resulting reshaping of membrane lipid composition pushes membranes toward a pro-ferroptotic profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Because the excess sphingosine and free fatty acids generated by elevated acid ceramidase feed the lipid-peroxidation cascade, the enzyme serves as a mechanistic link between the cellular programs of senescence and ferroptosis, and its removal protects cells from ferroptotic death.
description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶催化絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，直接在細胞中產生腎上腺素。這種酶促水解是腎上腺素脂質代謝中的一個關鍵分支點，在老化的細胞中，由此重塑的膜脂類組成推動膜朝向富含不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFAs) 的促進焦蛋白死亡的型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。因為過量的腎上腺素和由升高後的酸陶瓷酶產生的自由脂肪酸餵養了脂質過氧化反應的過程，因此這種酶作為細胞衰老和焦蛋白死亡兩個程序之間的機制聯繫，並且去除這種酶可以保護細胞免受焦蛋白死亡的死亡。

label: Senolytic Drug Target
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Acid ceramidase is a druggable, near-term, testable senotherapeutic target for clearing senescent cells. Experimental drugs targeting acid ceramidase have already been developed for other therapeutic purposes, demonstrating that the enzyme is targetable and lighting the way toward future innovation that could extend healthspans. Because elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis, inhibitors of the enzyme could selectively eliminate senescent 'zombie' cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy. The Salk team calls this a big milestone in the public health effort to support healthy aging, with the next steps being pathway completion, animal translation, and clinical trials.
description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶是一種可藥物標靶、近期且可測試的衰老細胞治療目標，用於清除衰老細胞。針對酸甘油酯酶的實驗性藥物已經針對其他治療目的而開發，證明該酶可標靶，為未來的創新開闢了道路，可能延長壽命。由於酸甘油酯酶升高會使衰老細胞更容易受到焦慮素突變的影響，因此抑制該酶可能能夠選擇性地消除衰老「殭屍」細胞，同時保持周圍細胞健康。沙鹿團隊將這歸結為公共衛生努力支持健康老齡化的重要里程碑，接下來的步驟包括通路完成、動物翻譯和臨床試驗。

label: ARN14794
description: ARN14794 is a specific chemical inhibitor of acid ceramidase (ACase). Treatment with ARN14794 protected proliferative and senescent WI-38 cells, as well as neuronal-derived murine HT22 cells (a well-studied ferroptosis model), against RSL3-induced ferroptosis. Because ACase inhibitors already exist as drug candidates developed for other indications, ACase represents a tractable senolytic/senomorphic target for attenuating the deleterious effects of senescent cells during aging - a potential 'two birds with one stone' strategy that eliminates senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy.
description_zh_TW: ARN14794 是一種針對酸甘油酯酶 (ACase) 的特定化學抑制劑。 施用 ARN14794 保護了增生和衰老 WI-38 細胞，以及來自神經元衍生的小鼠 HT22 細胞（一種廣泛研究的焦慮性死亡模型），使其對 RSL3 引起的焦慮性死亡具有保護作用。 由於 ACase 抑制劑已經存在作為用於其他適應症開發的藥物候選物，因此 ACase 是一個可行的促凋細胞/促衰老細胞模型靶點，可以減輕衰老過程中衰老細胞的有害影響——這是一種潛在的「一舉兩得」策略，既可以消除衰老細胞，又可以保持周圍細胞健康。

label: Flavones
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin (4',5,7-trihydroxyflavone) is a major plant flavone belonging to the flavonoid subclass flavones within the polyphenols. It is a yellow crystalline powder with the molecular formula C15H10O5 and a molecular weight of 270.24 Da, bearing hydroxyl groups at C-5 and C-7 of the A-ring and C-4' of the B-ring. Structurally it is related to biapigenin and naturally occurs as apigenin-7-O-glucoside and acylated derivatives. Its classification as a flavone underpins its shared antioxidant and anti-inflammatory pharmacology with other plant polyphenols such as quercetin and kaempferol.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧 (4',5,7-三羟基黄酮) 是一種主要植物黃酮類，屬於黃酮類群內的一種黃酮，屬於多酚類。它是一種黃色結晶粉末，分子式為 C15H10O5，分子量為 270.24 Da，在 A 環的 C-5 和 C-7 位以及 B 環的 C-4' 位帶有羟基。結構上與 البيبيجين (biapigenin) 相關，並自然存在於阿皮ゲ寧-7-O-葡萄糖苷和酰基衍生物中。它作為一種黃酮的分類，使其與如槲皮苷 (quercetin) 和  quercetin 苷等其他植物多酚類共享的抗氧化和抗炎藥理作用相符。

label: Flavone
description: Apigenin (4',5,7-trihydroxyflavone) is a naturally occurring flavone belonging to the class of dietary flavonoids found in fruits and vegetables. It is historically recognized for antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antiviral and anticancer activities, and it reduces reactive oxygen species production while raising glutathione and mitochondrial ATP to protect oocyte quality during aging. Its canonical downstream anti-inflammatory actions include suppressing the SASP partially by inhibiting IL-1α signaling through IRAK1/IRAK4, p38 MAPK and NF-κB, which reduces the aggressiveness of human breast cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧 (4',5,7-三羟基黄酮) 是一種天然的黃酮類化合物，屬於膳食黃酮類中的一種，存在於水果和蔬菜中。它在抗氧化、抗炎、抗病毒和抗癌方面具有歷史上的認識，並且降低活性氧物種的產生，同時提高谷胱甘肽和線粒體ATP，以保護衰老過程中卵子品質。它的規範性下游抗炎作用包括通過抑制IL-1α信號傳遞途徑中的IRAK1/IRAK4、p38 MAPK和NF-κB，部分抑制人類乳癌細胞的侵略性。

label: HDAC1
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin acts as a histone deacetylase inhibitor, directly targeting HDAC1 and HDAC3, which increases global histone acetylation and produces localized hyperacetylation of histone H3 on the p21/Waf1 promoter. In triple-negative breast cancer cells this drives histone H3 acetylation, decreasing cyclin A and cyclin B and increasing p21/Waf1/Cip1. Apigenin can additionally function as a dual epigenetic inhibitor that reverses both DNA methylation and trimethylation of lysine 27 on histone H3, qualifying it as an epigenetic modulator relevant to chemoprevention.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧作為組蛋白脫乙醯化酶抑制劑，直接靶向 HDAC1 和 HDAC3，從而增加全球組蛋白乙醯化程度，並在 p21/Waf1 促進子區域產生局部乙醯化程度增加，在三陰性乳癌細胞中，這會促進組蛋白 H3 的乙醯化，降低肌動素 A 和肌動素 B，並增加 p21/Waf1/Cip1。阿皮ゲ寧還可以作為雙重表觀遺傳修飾抑制劑，逆轉組蛋白 H3 上粒核苷酸 27 的 DNA 甲基化和三甲基化，使其成為與化療預防相關的表觀遺傳修飾劑。

label: Fatty Acid Synthase
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin inhibits fatty acid synthase (FASN), an enzyme that catalyzes long-chain fatty acid synthesis and is overexpressed in many cancers. Brusselmans and colleagues showed that plant flavonoids including apigenin induce apoptosis in prostate and breast carcinoma cells specifically through their ability to block fatty acid synthase activity, and this effect on lipogenesis was also observed in osteosarcoma cells where apigenin and luteolin downregulated FASN and acetyl-CoA carboxylase. By depriving cancer cells of de novo lipid synthesis, apigenin curbs cancer cell growth and survival through a metabolic route complementary to its effects on signaling kinases.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧抑制脂肪酸合成酶 (FASN)，一种催化长链脂肪酸合成的酶，并且在许多癌症中过度表达。布塞尔曼等人在研究中表明，包括阿皮ゲ寧在内的植物类黄酮类化合物诱导前列腺癌细胞和乳腺癌细胞凋亡，具体是通过阻断脂肪酸合成酶活性所致，并且这种对脂质生成的影响也被在骨肉瘤细胞中观察到，其中阿皮ゲ寧和卢特OLINA 下调了 FASN 和乙酰辅酶羧化酶。通过剥夺癌细胞的端粒脂质合成，阿皮ゲ寧通过与对信号转导激酶的影响相辅相成的代谢途径抑制癌细胞的生长和存活。

label: Parsley
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin is a major dietary flavone enriched in a range of fruits and vegetables, with parsley being the richest documented source. Dried parsley was reported to contain up to 45,035 ug/g apigenin, far exceeding dried chamomile flowers (3,000-5,000 ug/g), celery seeds (786.5 ug/g), vine spinach (622 ug/g), and Chinese celery (240.2 ug/g). It is also found in chamomile tea, red wine, and beer, and is a signature component of the Mediterranean diet, whose intake has been associated epidemiologically with lower rates of several human diseases including cancer.
description_zh_TW: 芹菜素是主要的膳食黃酮，富含於多種蔬果中，其中以歐芹（parsley）為文獻記載含量最豐富的來源。據報導，乾燥歐芹的芹菜素含量高達45,035 ug/g，遠超過乾燥洋甘菊花（3,000–5,000 ug/g）、芹菜籽（786.5 ug/g）、落葵（vine spinach，622 ug/g）與中國芹菜（240.2 ug/g）。它也存在於洋甘菊茶、紅酒與啤酒中，是地中海飲食的代表性成分；流行病學研究顯示，地中海飲食的攝取與包括癌症在內的多種人類疾病發生率較低有關。

label: CK2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin is a potent inhibitor of casein kinase 2 (CK2), a serine/threonine kinase that is elevated in many cancers. In prostate cancer, apigenin inhibited CK2 activity in both hormone-responsive LNCaP and hormone-refractory PC-3 cells, though apoptosis was induced only in LNCaP. In colon cancer cells, apigenin together with DRB inhibited CK2 expression and synergistically sensitized cells to TNF-alpha-mediated apoptosis. In cervical cancer stem-like cells, apigenin suppressed self-renewal by downregulating CK2-alpha, and in pancreatic cancer it stabilized the transcription factor Ikaros by downregulating CK2 to restore T-cell homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧是一種強效的酪蛋白激酶2 (CK2) 抑制劑，是一種絲胺類/酪蛋白激酶，在許多癌症中表現升高。在攝護腺癌中，阿皮ゲ寧抑制了 LNCaP 和 PC-3 細胞中的 CK2 活性（包括激素反應型和激素抵抗型細胞），儘管僅在 LNCaP 細胞中誘導了凋亡。在結直腸癌細胞中，阿皮ゲ寧與 DRB 結合，抑制了 CK2 的表達，並與 TNF-α 介導的細胞凋亡產生了協同作用。在子宮頸癌幹細胞中，阿皮ゲ寧通過下調 CK2-α 來抑制自我更新，而在胰腺癌中，它通過下調 CK2 來穩定轉錄因子 Ikaros，以恢復 T 細胞穩態。

label: Mitoxantrone
description: In a preclinical NOD-SCID xenograft model combining PC3 prostate cancer cells with senescent PSC27 stroma, co-administration of apigenin with the chemotherapy agent mitoxantrone (MIT) produced additional tumor reduction beyond MIT alone: MIT alone shrank tumors 57.8%, and the combination achieved an additional 51.1% reduction, for a total 74.9% decrease versus placebo. Apigenin reversed circulating SASP factors (amphiregulin/AREG, epiregulin/EREG) and enhanced DNA damage (γH2AX) and cleaved-caspase-3 apoptosis in tumors.
description_zh_TW: 在一個結合PC3前列腺癌細胞與衰老PSC27基質的臨床前NOD-SCID異種移植模型中，芹菜素與化療藥物米托蒽醌（mitoxantrone，MIT）合併投予，產生了超越單用MIT的額外腫瘤縮小效果：單用MIT使腫瘤縮小57.8%，合併療法再達成額外51.1%的縮小，總計較安慰劑組減少74.9%。芹菜素逆轉了循環中的SASP因子（雙調蛋白/AREG、上皮調節素/EREG），並增強腫瘤中的DNA損傷（γH2AX）與cleaved-caspase-3細胞凋亡。

label: UGT1A1
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: In the intestine and liver, apigenin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A1 (UGT1A1), the key enzyme converting it into glucuronide and sulfate derivatives that are more readily transported in blood and excreted in bile or urine, and apigenin itself induces UGT1A1 transcription in colon cells. Combined treatment with sulforaphane synergistically increased UGT1A1 mRNA induction, although apigenin did not induce GSTA1. This phase II metabolism underlies apigenin's rapid clearance and low plasma bioavailability after oral dosing, while its slow systemic elimination may allow peripheral tissue accumulation that supports chemopreventive efficacy.
description_zh_TW: 在腸道與肝臟中，芹菜素會被UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶1A1（UGT1A1）廣泛結合，此關鍵酵素將其轉化為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸衍生物，這些衍生物更易於在血液中運輸並經由膽汁或尿液排出；而芹菜素本身也會在結腸細胞中誘導UGT1A1的轉錄。與蘿蔔硫素（sulforaphane）合併處理可協同增強UGT1A1 mRNA的誘導，不過芹菜素不會誘導GSTA1。此第二相反應代謝是芹菜素口服後快速清除與低血漿生體可用率的原因，而其緩慢的全身性排除則可能使周邊組織累積，進而支持其化學預防功效。

label: catecholamine balance in Prefrontal Cortex
description: NET is critical for catecholamine balance in the prefrontal cortex because, in the relative absence of DAT, it is a major mechanism clearing both norepinephrine and dopamine, while COMT handles O-methylation. Disruption of NET, whether genetic or pharmacological, markedly alters prefrontal catechol tone and thus attention, arousal, working memory, and stress responses. Its role makes it a target for antidepressants and attention-deficit treatments. It functions in concert with COMT to maintain prefrontal dopamine homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: NET 對於前額葉皮質中的兒茶酚胺平衡至關重要，因為在相對缺乏 DAT 的情況下，它是清除 norepinephrine 和多巴胺的主要機制，而 COMT 則處理 O-甲基化。 NET 的破壞，無論是遺傳的還是藥理學的，都會顯著改變前額葉兒茶酚的張力，從而改變注意力、喚醒、工作記憶和壓力反應。它的作用使其成為抗憂鬱藥物和注意力缺陷治療的目標。它與 COMT 協同作用，維持前額多巴胺穩態。

label: dopamine in Prefrontal Cortex
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) also reuptakes dopamine in the prefrontal cortex, because DAT is sparse there and NET, with modest affinity for dopamine, clears a meaningful fraction of extracellular dopamine. This dual substrate specificity means prefrontal dopamine clearance is shared between NET and COMT, with both contributing to setting dopamine tone. The arrangement explains why noradrenergic drugs, such as NET inhibitors used as antidepressants and attention treatments, can influence prefrontal dopamine levels. It is a key feature of prefrontal catecholamine regulation.
description_zh_TW: norepinephrine 轉運蛋白 (NET) 也在前額葉皮質中重新攝取多巴胺，因為那裡的 DAT 很稀疏，而 NET 對多巴胺具有適度的親和力，可以清除相當一部分細胞外多巴胺。這種雙重底物特異性意味著 NET 和 COMT 共享前額多巴胺清除率，兩者都有助於設定多巴胺基調。這種安排解釋了為什麼去甲腎上腺素能藥物，例如用作抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的 NET 抑制劑，可以影響前額葉多巴胺水平。這是前額葉兒茶酚胺調節的關鍵特徵。

label: DAT expression
description: The prefrontal cortex has limited dopamine transporter expression compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine persists longer in the extracellular space and is inactivated mainly by diffusion, NET uptake, and COMT O-methylation. This anatomical constraint is the reason COMT genotype exerts its strongest cognitive effects in prefrontal-dependent tasks. It contrasts sharply with the DAT-dominated striatum, where reuptake is fast. This regional difference is foundational to understanding dopamine regulation and COMT's cognitive role.
description_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質的多巴胺轉運蛋白表達有限，這意味著多巴胺在細胞外空間中持續時間更長，並且主要透過擴散、NET 攝取和 COMT O-甲基化而失去活性。這種解剖學限制是 COMT genotype 在前額葉依賴性任務中發揮最強認知作用的原因。它與 DAT 主導的紋狀體形成鮮明對比，後者的再攝取速度很快。這種區域差異是理解多巴胺調節和 COMT 認知作用的基礎。

label: primary brain region for Working Memory
description: The prefrontal cortex is the primary brain region for working memory, as demonstrated by lesion, neuroimaging, and single-neuron recording studies showing its necessity for holding and manipulating information online. Its dopamine-dependent networks are exquisitely sensitive to COMT activity, since DAT is sparse and COMT dominates dopamine clearance there. This regional specialization makes it the focal point of COMT-cognition research and of the inverted-U dopamine model. Working memory is among the functions most strongly influenced by COMT genotype.
description_zh_TW: 病變、神經影像學和單神經元記錄研究表明，前額葉皮質是工作記憶的主要 brain 區域，表明其在線保存和操作資訊的必要性。它的多巴胺依賴性網絡對 COMT activity 非常敏感，因為 DAT 稀疏，而 COMT 在那裡主導多巴胺清除。這種區域專業化使其成為 COMT 認知研究和倒 U 型多巴胺模型的焦點。工作記憶是受 COMT genotype 影響最強烈的功能之一。

label: balanced dopamine in Prefrontal Cortex
description: Working memory depends on balanced dopamine in the prefrontal cortex, where too little (fast COMT) or too much (slow COMT) dopamine degrades performance according to the inverted-U principle, with D1 receptor signaling particularly critical. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set this dopamine level, making working memory exquisitely sensitive to COMT genotype. Optimal working memory therefore requires COMT activity within a narrow functional window. This is the core of the inverted-U model of dopamine and cognition.
description_zh_TW: 工作記憶取決於前額葉皮質中多巴胺的平衡，根據倒 U 原理，多巴胺太少（快 COMT）或太多（慢 COMT）都會降低性能，其中 D1 receptor 訊號尤其重要。由于前额叶 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 设置了这种多巴胺水平，使工作记忆对 COMT genotype 极其敏感。因此，最佳工作记忆需要 COMT activity 在狭窄的功能窗口内。這是多巴胺和認知倒U模型的核心。

label: limited-capacity cognitive system
description: Working memory is a limited-capacity cognitive system that temporarily holds and manipulates information for use in reasoning, comprehension, and planning, distinct from long-term storage. Its capacity is constrained by prefrontal resources and modulated by dopamine, which sets the efficiency of maintenance and manipulation. COMT genotype influences the dopamine tuning that determines an individual's working memory efficiency. It is a core component of executive function and a major focus of cognitive neuroscience.
description_zh_TW: 工作記憶是一種暫時保存和操作資訊以用於推理、理解和計劃的 limited-capacity cognitive system，與長期儲存不同。它的能力受到前額葉資源的限制，並受到多巴胺的調節，多巴胺決定了維護和操縱的效率。 COMT genotype 影響決定個人工作記憶效率的多巴胺調節。它是executive function的核心組件，也是認知神經科學的主要焦點。

label: Nucleic Acids
description: Nucleic acids are prone to damage by reactive oxygen species, particularly hydroxyl radicals, which attack both the sugar-phosphate backbone and nucleobases. Guanine is the most readily oxidized base, yielding 8-oxo-dG and strand lesions. The directionality is ROS to nucleic-acid modification. A caveat is that DNA is partly protected by histones, repair enzymes, and metal sequestration, so damage is non-uniform across the genome. Oxidative lesions accumulate with age and in numerous diseases, and their levels are widely used as biomarkers of oxidative exposure and damage.
description_zh_TW: Nucleic acids 很容易被 reactive oxygen species，特別是 hydroxyl radicals 損壞，hydroxyl radicals 會攻擊糖磷酸主鏈和核鹼基。鳥嘌呤是最容易被氧化的鹼基，產生 8-oxo-dG 和鏈損傷。方向性是ROS到核酸修飾。需要注意的是，DNA 部分受到組蛋白、修復酵素和金屬隔離的保護，因此基因組中的損傷是不均勻的。氧化損傷隨著年齡的增長和在許多疾病中積累，其水平被廣泛用作氧化暴露和損傷的生物標記。

label: UV Light
description: Ultraviolet light generates reactive oxygen species (ROS) that drive the oxidation of catecholamines such as epinephrine. Because ROS can steal electrons from the catechol hydroxyls, producing the o-quinone intermediate, light exposure accelerates the pathway that converts adrenaline into adrenochrome. This photochemical sensitivity is why pharmaceutical epinephrine is stored in amber vials away from light: preventing light-induced ROS formation slows the oxidation and cyclization reactions that degrade the drug. The same principle applies more broadly to catecholamine biochemistry, where photo-oxidation can convert adrenaline solutions pink. Temperature and light, as factors governing kinetic energy and radical generation, are therefore environmental controls that determine whether epinephrine remains stable or proceeds toward adrenochrome and its toxic downstream chemistry.
description_zh_TW: 紫外線產生活性氧（ROS），驅動兒茶酚胺如腎上腺素的氧化。因為ROS可以從兒茶酚羥基中夺取電子，產生鄰醌中間體，光照暴露加速了將腎上腺素轉化為腎上腺素紅的途徑。這種光化學敏感性是為什麼藥用腎上腺素儲存在避光的琥珀色玻璃瓶中：防止光照誘導的ROS形成可以減緩降解藥物的氧化和環化反應。相同原理更廣泛地應用於兒茶酚胺生物化學，其中光氧化可以使腎上腺素溶液變粉紅。溫度和光照作為控制動能和自由基生成的因素，因此是決定腎上腺素是保持穩定還是走向腎上腺素紅及其有毒下游化學的環境控制。

label: 2-Chlorophenothiazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: 2-Chlorophenothiazine, which consists of the phenothiazine nucleus without the amine side chains of methylene blue, acts as a direct free-radical scavenger independent of mitochondria and NADH. In the cell-free mitochondrial lysate oxidation assay it significantly reduced DCF fluorescence both with and without mitochondria/NADH, unlike MB which required both. Despite potent nanomolar neuroprotection against glutamate, IAA, and rotenone toxicity, it had no effect on oxygen consumption, anaerobic glycolysis, or the complex I-III electron shunt, and it did not upregulate complex IV expression, revealing a mechanism distinct from MB.
description_zh_TW: 2-Chlorophenothiazine 由吩噻嗪（phenothiazine）核心組成，不含亞甲藍（methylene blue）的胺側鏈，可作為直接的自由基清除劑，其作用不依賴粒線體與 NADH。在無細胞的粒線體裂解液氧化試驗中，無論有無粒線體/NADH，它皆能顯著降低 DCF 螢光，與必須同時具備兩者的 MB 不同。儘管對麩胺酸（glutamate）、IAA 與魚藤酮（rotenone）毒性具有強效的奈莫耳濃度神經保護作用，它對耗氧量、無氧糖解或複合體 I–III 電子分流皆無影響，也未上調複合體 IV 的表現，顯示其機制與 MB 截然不同。

label: Senescence-Messaging Secretome
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Senescent cells - often called 'zombie' cells - are a hallmark of aging: they do not completely die but also are not quite alive, and while sometimes harmless, they release harmful factors called the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) into surrounding tissues. This secretory phenotype is pro-inflammatory and can promote the development of diseases or disorders, including cancer, and accelerates aging by driving tissue dysfunction. Because senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions including arthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, clearing them - as proposed through acid ceramidase-mediated ferroptosis sensitization - is a major strategy for extending healthspan.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞——常被稱為「殭屍」細胞——是衰老的特徵之一：它們不會完全死亡，卻也不完全活著；雖然有時無害，它們會將稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的有害因子釋放到周圍組織。這種分泌表型具促發炎性，可促進包括癌症在內的疾病或障礙發展，並透過驅動組織功能障礙而加速衰老。由於衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括關節炎、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病，清除它們——如透過酸性神經醯胺酶介導的鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感化所提出——是延長健康壽命的主要策略。

label: Ferroptosis Susceptibility
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Vulnerable senescent cells are able to pass their ferroptosis vulnerability on to neighboring cells, helping explain why only a few senescent cells can turn into more and ultimately impact a larger tissue over time. This paracrine transmission of ferroptosis sensitivity means that a small number of senescent cells can spread susceptibility to ferroptotic death across a tissue, and it represents one mechanism by which the Salk team found ferroptosis and senescence to be connected during aging. The researchers describe the target as eliminating senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy for longer, and the finding underpins the therapeutic rationale for targeting acid ceramidase.
description_zh_TW: 脆弱的衰老細胞能將其鐵依賴性細胞死亡的脆弱性傳遞給鄰近細胞，這有助於解釋為何少數衰老細胞能轉變為更多衰老細胞，並最終隨時間影響更大的組織。這種鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感性的旁分泌傳遞，意味著少數衰老細胞就能將對鐵依賴性細胞死亡的易感性擴散至整個組織；Salk團隊發現這是鐵依賴性細胞死亡與衰老在老化過程中相互關聯的機制之一。研究人員將目標描述為清除衰老細胞，同時讓鄰近細胞更長久地保持健康；此發現支持了以酸性神經醯胺酶為標靶的治療學理。

label: TGFβ Superfamily
description: Activin A is a homodimer of inhibin beta-A (INHBA) subunits and a member of the TGFbeta superfamily of cytokines. Like other family members, it signals through serine/threonine kinase receptors to regulate cell fate, proliferation, and inflammation. Its classification within the TGFbeta superfamily situates it among the SASP factors with paracrine arrest-inducing capacity, alongside TGF-beta1, BMP2, and GDF15. Activin A is a structurally defined ligand that is distinct from TGF-beta1 but shares functional overlap, particularly in inducing cell-cycle inhibitors in receiving cells during paracrine senescence.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 是 inhibin beta-A（INHBA）次單元的同源二聚體，且是 TGFbeta 細胞激素超家族的成員。如同其他家族成員，它經絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶受體訊號調節細胞命運、增殖與發炎。其歸類於 TGFbeta 超家族將它置於具旁分泌停滯誘發能力的 SASP 因子中，與 TGF-beta1、BMP2 與 GDF15 並列。Activin A 是結構上確立的配體，不同於 TGF-beta1 但具功能重疊，特別在旁分泌衰老中誘發受體細胞的細胞週期抑制因子。

label: ALK4
description: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

label: Follistatin
description: Follistatin binds and neutralizes Activin A extracellularly, acting as a soluble antagonist that can block its paracrine senescence-inducing activity. This provides a natural brake on Activin A signaling and a potential therapeutic route to limit SASP-mediated arrest spread in tissue. The follistatin-Activin A axis is a classic antagonistic ligand-binding pair, and neutralization experiments confirm its functional relevance in paracrine senescence models. Because follistatin also regulates other TGFbeta-family ligands, it represents an endogenous checkpoint on the arrest-inducing arm of the senescent secretome.
description_zh_TW: Follistatin 在胞外結合並中和 Activin A，作為可阻斷其旁分泌衰老誘發活性的可溶性拮抗劑。這提供對 Activin A 訊號的自然制動，以及限制組織中 SASP 介導停滯擴散的潛在治療途徑。follistatin-Activin A 軸是經典的拮抗性配體—結合對，且中和實驗確認其在旁分泌衰老模型中的功能相關性。由於 follistatin 也調節其他 TGFbeta 家族配體，它代表衰老分泌組停滯誘發臂的內源性檢查點。

label: Early SASP
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: p21 supports an early secretory phenotype -- including factors such as CXCL14 and IGFBP3 -- that places stressed cells under immunosurveillance prior to full senescence. This early p21-associated secretome differs from the later NF-kB-dominated SASP, and it may help communicate cellular stress and recruit immune clearance. The relationship suggests p21 contributes to both arrest and the initial communicative state of stressed cells. It is more nuanced than simple arrest enforcement, giving moderate confidence.
description_zh_TW: p21 支持早期分泌表型——包括如 CXCL14 與 IGFBP3 等因子——使受壓細胞在完全衰老前處於免疫監視下。此早期 p21 相關分泌組不同於後期 NF-κB 主導的 SASP，且可能有助溝通細胞壓力並招募免疫清除。此關係顯示 p21 同時貢獻停滯與受壓細胞的初始溝通狀態。它比簡單的停滯執行更細微，信度中等。

label: ADMA
description: ADMA inhibits eNOS by competitively occupying the L-arginine binding site of all NOS isoforms, reducing NO production and promoting uncoupling. Elevated ADMA (from reduced catabolism by dimethylarginine dimethylaminohydrolase) is a marker of endothelial risk. The directionality is endogenous inhibitor to NO deficiency. A caveat is that ADMA also inhibits other NOS isoforms and its effects are modulated by L-arginine availability and methyltransferase activity.
