Because ADMA is primarily cleared by DDAH, oxidative inactivation of DDAH raises ADMA and further suppresses NO, a self-reinforcing cycle in endothelial disease.
description_zh_TW: ADMA 透過競爭性佔據所有 NOS 亞型的 L-arginine 結合位點、減少 NO 產生並促進解偶聯來抑制 eNOS。 ADMA 升高（由於二甲基精氨酸二甲氨基水解酶分解代謝減少）是內皮風險的標誌。方向性是NO缺乏的內源性抑制劑。需要注意的是，ADMA 也抑制其他 NOS 亞型，其作用受到 L-arginine 可用性和甲基轉移酶活性的調節。由於 ADMA 主要由 DDAH 清除，DDAH 的氧化失活會升高 ADMA 並進一步抑制 NO（內皮疾病的自我強化循環）。

label: serum AGE levels
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Food is an important source of exogenous advanced glycation end products, since significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins via the Maillard reaction. In a mouse model, feeding an AGE-rich diet for 16 weeks promoted a 53% increase in serum AGE levels. In renal failure patients, an AGE-rich diet produced a 29% increase in blood CML, while a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction. These findings suggest that a diet restricting AGEs is an effective way to reduce the AGE burden in the human body.
description_zh_TW: Food 是 exogenous advanced glycation end products 的重要來源，因為當 sugars 與 proteins 經由 Maillard reaction 一起 cooked 時，會產生顯著的 AGE。在 mouse model 中，餵食 AGE-rich diet 16 週使血清 AGE levels 增加 53%。在 renal failure patients 中，AGE-rich diet 使血液 CML 增加 29%，而 low-AGE diet 則使其降低 34%。這些 findings 顯示，限制 AGEs 的 diet 是降低人體 AGE burden 的有效方法。

label: Soluble VCAM-1
description: Soluble VCAM-1 is a biomarker for endothelial dysfunction, being elevated in cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypertension, and rheumatoid arthritis as a shed fragment of the adhesion molecule. Its level reflects chronic endothelial activation. The directionality is endothelial activation to soluble marker release. A caveat is that soluble VCAM-1 lacks the membrane anchor and its biological activity differs from full-length VCAM-1, so it is an index rather than a direct effector. Serum sVCAM-1 is now used in risk stratification and to monitor endothelial health in research cohorts.
description_zh_TW: Soluble VCAM-1 是 endothelial dysfunction 的生物標記物，在 cardiovascular disease、糖尿病、高血壓和類風濕性關節炎中作為黏附分子的脫落片段而升高。其水平反映了慢性內皮活化。方向性是內皮活化至可溶性標記物釋放。需要注意的是，soluble VCAM-1 缺乏膜錨，其生物活性與全長 VCAM-1 不同，因此它是一個指標而不是直接效應子。血清 sVCAM-1 現在用於風險分層和監測研究隊列中的內皮健康。

label: SIRT1 (resveratrol-activated)
description: Resveratrol-activated endothelial SIRT1 increases eNOS expression and deacetylates and activates it, enhancing nitric-oxide production and promoting vasodilation. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of eNOS activation in the endothelium. Improved NO bioavailability lowers vascular tone, protects against endothelial dysfunction, and reduces platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation. This underlies resveratrol's cardiovascular and French-paradox associations, and SIRT1's regulation of eNOS is one of its best-established vascular mechanisms, linking sirtuin activity directly to blood-vessel health and blood-pressure control.
description_zh_TW: 被白藜蘆醇活化的內皮 SIRT1 增加 eNOS 表達並去乙醯化和活化它，增強一氧化氮產生並促進血管舒張。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於內皮中 eNOS 活化的上游。改善的 NO 生物利用度降低血管張力、保護對抗內皮功能障礙，並減少血小板聚集和平滑肌增殖。這是白藜蘆醇心血管益處和法國悖論關聯的基礎，SIRT1 對 eNOS 的調節是其最佳確立的血管機制之一，將 sirtuin 活性直接與血管健康和血壓控制聯繫起來。

label: Parasiticidal effect
description: Activation of GluCls in nematodes and arthropods drives Cl- influx, membrane hyperpolarization, flaccid paralysis and death.
description_zh_TW: 線蟲和節肢動物中 GluCl 的活化會導致 Cl 流入、膜超極化、弛緩性麻痺和死亡。

label: GABA-gated chloride channels
description: Avermectins also potentiate invertebrate GABA-gated chloride channels; vertebrate GABA_A receptors require roughly 100-fold higher concentrations, underpinning selective safety.
description_zh_TW: Avermectins 也能增強無脊椎動物 GABA-gated chloride channels；脊椎動物 GABA_A 受體需要約高出 100 倍的濃度，以確保選擇性安全。

label: Merck & Co. Inc
description: Campbell's avermectin-to-ivermectin development was carried out at Merck & Co.
description_zh_TW: 坎貝爾的阿維菌素到伊維菌素的開發是在默克公司進行的。

label: Humans
description: Humans and other vertebrates lack glutamate-gated chloride channels, which underpins the selective safety of avermectin/ivermectin at therapeutic doses.
description_zh_TW: Humans和其他脊椎動物缺乏穀氨酸門控氯離子通道，這支撐了阿維菌素/伊維菌素在治療劑量下的選擇性安全性。

label: DNA, RNA and proteins
description: Once absorbed, silver binds to amino or carboxyl groups in RNA, DNA, and proteins, which is the molecular basis of both its antimicrobial action and its toxicity. By coordinating thiol, amino, and carboxyl moieties, silver can disrupt enzyme active sites, nucleic acid structure, and protein folding. This promiscuous binding explains the broad-spectrum antibacterial effects of silver compounds as well as the tissue deposition, glutathione peroxidase and Na+,K+-ATPase inhibition, and genotoxic effects observed with chronic or high-level silver exposure.
description_zh_TW: 一旦吸收，銀與RNA、DNA和蛋白質中的氨基或羧基結合，這是其抗菌作用和毒性的分子基礎。通過配位硫醇、氨基和羧基部分，銀可破壞酶活性位點、核酸結構和蛋白質折疊。這種多效結合解釋了銀化合物的廣譜抗菌效果，以及慢性或高劑量銀暴露觀察到的組織沉積、穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶和Na+,K+-ATPase抑制和基因毒性效應。

label: Inhalation, oral and dermal routes
description: Silver and its compounds can be absorbed via inhalation, while silver compounds can also be absorbed orally and dermally. Once absorbed, silver distributes throughout the body in the blood, particularly to the liver, and is eliminated primarily in the faeces. The multiple absorption routes mean that occupational and consumer exposures, from airborne dusts, drinking water, and topical products, can all raise the body silver burden. In large doses this absorbed silver becomes deposited in various tissues, producing the blue-gray pigmentation of argyria and the enzyme inhibition described in silver toxicity summaries.
description_zh_TW: 銀及其化合物可通過吸入吸收，而銀化合物也可通過口服和皮膚吸收。一旦吸收，銀通過血液分布至全身，特別是肝臟，主要通過糞便排出。多種吸收途徑意味著職業和消費者暴露，來自空氣中的粉塵、飲用水和局部產品，都會增加體內銀負荷。大劑量吸收的銀會沉積在各種組織中，導致argyria的藍灰色色素沉著和銀毒性摘要中描述的酶抑制。

label: Metallic element
description: Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47. It occurs naturally in its pure, free form, as an alloy with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. Silver itself is generally not toxic to humans, although most silver salts are toxic, and chronic accumulation can deposit metallic silver in tissues, producing the permanent blue-gray condition known as argyria that is disfiguring but not otherwise harmful to health. The distinction between benign elemental silver and toxic ionic silver salts is fundamental to understanding silver exposure.
description_zh_TW: 銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47。它自然存在於純淨游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。銀本身通常對人體無毒，但大多數銀鹽有毒，慢性積累可在組織中沉積金屬銀，導致稱為argyria的永久性藍灰色病變，雖毀容但對健康無其他損害。良性的元素銀與有毒的離子銀鹽之間的區別對理解銀暴露至關重要。

label: Gold
description: Silver occurs naturally in alloys with gold and other metals as well as in its free metallic form. Native silver-gold alloys are geologically important because they represent the metallic state of both precious metals outside of conventional ores. Understanding silver's alloying behavior matters toxicologically too: metallic silver that is oxidized in the body may be reduced back to the elemental state by ascorbic acid or catecholamines and deposited in tissues, driving the pigmentation seen in argyria.
description_zh_TW: 銀自然存在於與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及其游離金屬形式。天然銀金合金在地質學上很重要，因為它們代表了傳統礦石外兩種貴金屬的金屬狀態。理解銀的合金行為在毒理學上也很重要：在體內被氧化的金屬銀可能被抗壞血酸或兒茶酚胺還原回元素狀態並沉積在組織中，導致argyria中見到的色素沉著。

label: Argentite and chlorargyrite minerals
description: Silver occurs naturally in minerals such as argentite (silver sulfide) and chlorargyrite (silver chloride), which are among the primary silver ores. These mineral forms connect silver's environmental chemistry to its biology: insoluble silver salts absorbed into the body are transformed into soluble silver sulfide albuminates that bind to biomolecules. The sulfide chemistry of argentite mirrors the silver sulfide albuminates formed when silver is absorbed and distributed through the bloodstream to the liver.
description_zh_TW: 銀自然存在於如argentite（硫化銀）和chlorargyrite（氯化銀）等礦物中，這些是主要的銀礦石。這些礦物形式將銀的環境化學與其生物學聯繫起來：吸收體內的不溶性銀鹽被轉化為可溶性硫化銀白蛋白酸鹽，與生物分子結合。argentite的硫化物化學反映了銀吸收後通過血流分布至肝臟時形成的硫化銀白蛋白酸鹽。

label: 1027 mg/kg
description: Silver(I) oxide is acutely toxic in animal studies, with a reported LD50 of 1027 mg/kg by the oral route in mice and 2820 mg/kg orally in rats; intraperitoneal LD50 values are 37 mg/kg in mice and 70 mg/kg in rats. The much lower intraperitoneal threshold reflects efficient absorption of silver ions directly into the circulation, whereas oral silver is less bioavailable. These data establish silver oxide as a moderate acute hazard requiring careful handling in laboratory, industrial, and battery-manufacturing settings.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)在動物研究中具有急性毒性，報導的小鼠口服LD50為1027 mg/kg，大鼠口服為2820 mg/kg；腹腔注射LD50值小鼠為37 mg/kg，大鼠為70 mg/kg。低得多的腹腔注射閾值反映了銀離子直接吸收進入循環的效率，而口服銀的生物利用度較低。這些數據將氧化銀確立為中等急性危害，需要在實驗室、工業和電池製造環境中謹慎處理。

label: Silver oxide battery
description: Silver(I) oxide is used in the silver oxide battery, where the oxide serves as the cathode material. Silver oxide batteries deliver high energy density in compact zinc-silver(oxide) cells and are widely used in small devices such as watches, hearing aids, and cameras. The electrochemical application exploits the reduction of Ag(I) to metallic silver, linking the compound's utility directly to the redox chemistry of silver that also underlies its antimicrobial action and its tissue-staining properties.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)用於銀氧化物電池，其中氧化物作為正極材料。銀氧化物電池在緊湊的鋅-銀(氧化物)電池中提供高能量密度，廣泛用於手錶、助聽器和相機等小型設備。該電化學應用利用Ag(I)還原為金屬銀，將化合物的實用性直接與銀的氧化還原化學聯繫起來，這也奠定了其抗菌作用和組織染色特性。

label: A53T
description: Alpha-synuclein and A53T are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Alpha-synuclein and A53T may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

description: Eumelanin and Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Eumelanin and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Eumelanin 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Eumelanin 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Flortaucipir
description: Flortaucipir binds to Neuromelanin through physicochemical affinity, forming a complex that modulates the local concentration or activity of the bound species. Mechanistically, Flortaucipir acts as the ligand or matrix and Neuromelanin as the binding partner, with the interaction often driven by catechol, quinone, or charge complementarity. This binding is significant because it can sequester toxins or metals, buffer neurotransmitters, or localize damage within pigmented neurons. A caveat is that the physiological magnitude, reversibility, and functional sequelae of the binding in vivo are not always fully quantified and may differ between intracellular and extracellular contexts.
description_zh_TW: Flortaucipir 透過物理化學親和力與 Neuromelanin 結合，形成複合物，調節結合物質的局部濃度或活性。從機制上講，Flortaucipir 作為配體或基質，Neuromelanin 作為結合伴侶，相互作用通常由兒茶酚、醌或電荷互補性驅動。這種結合很重要，因為它可以隔離毒素或金屬、緩衝 neurotransmitters 或定位色素神經元內的損傷。需要注意的是，體內結合的生理程度、可逆性和功能後遺症並不總是完全量化的，並且在細胞內和細胞外環境之間可能有所不同。

label: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
description: Magnetic Resonance Imaging detects Neuromelanin using physical or chemical contrast properties specific to the pigment. Mechanistically, the technique reads signal generated by iron content, paramagnetism, or tracer binding to the pigment. This is significant because it enables non-invasive assessment of pigmented neuron integrity in health and Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that the signal is influenced by field strength, sequence, and confounders such as iron, requiring careful quantification.
description_zh_TW: Magnetic Resonance Imaging 使用顏料特有的物理或化學對比特性來檢測 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，該技術讀取由 iron 內容、順磁性或與顏料結合的示踪劑產生的訊號。這很重要，因為它可以對健康和 Parkinson's disease 中的色素神經元完整性進行非侵入性評估。需要注意的是，訊號受到場強、序列和 iron 等混雜因素的影響，需要仔細量化。

label: Autoxidation
description: Dopamine undergoes autoxidation, a spontaneous oxidation in which dopamine quinones, superoxide, H2O2, and 6-hydroxydopamine are produced, especially at physiological pH. This creates ROS in dopaminergic neurons independent of external insults. The directionality is catecholamine oxidation to oxidant and quinone formation. A caveat is that autoxidation is accelerated by metal ions and pH, and the quinones also form adducts that may be more directly toxic than the radicals. In Parkinson's disease, the resulting oxidant and quinone stress is thought to contribute to the selective vulnerability of dopaminergic substantia nigra neurons.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 經歷 autoxidation，這是一種自發性氧化，其中產生 dopamine 醌、超氧化物、H2O2 和 6-羥基dopamine，特別是在生理 pH 條件下。这在 dopaminergic 神经元中创建了 ROS，不受外部刺激的影响。方向性是儿茶酚胺氧化成氧化剂并形成醌。需要注意的是，金屬離子和 pH 值會加速 autoxidation 的生成，而醌也會形成可能比自由基更直接毒性的加合物。在 Parkinson's disease 中，由此产生的氧化剂和醌应激被认为导致了 dopaminergic 黑质神经元的选择性脆弱性。

label: Erythrocyte Plasma Membrane
description: Studies have shown that the human erythrocyte plasma membrane can convert epinephrine (adrenaline) to aminochromes, including adrenochrome and further derivatives, in a two-phase reaction. Aminochromes are the cyclized oxidation products of catecholamines, and this membrane-associated conversion represents a route for adrenochrome formation in blood even though erythrocytes lack the organelles and oxidative enzymes that actively produce it. This makes the erythrocyte membrane a site where catecholamine oxidation products can form, with potential consequences for red blood cell membrane integrity.
description_zh_TW: 研究顯示，人類erythrocyte plasma membrane能在two-phase reaction中將epinephrine（adrenaline）轉化為aminochromes，包括adrenochrome及進一步的derivatives。Aminochromes是catecholamines的cyclized oxidation products，而這種membrane-associated conversion代表了一條血液中adrenochrome形成的途徑，儘管erythrocytes缺乏主動生成它的胞器與oxidative enzymes。這使得erythrocyte membrane成為catecholamine oxidation products可以形成的位置，並可能對red blood cell membrane integrity造成影響。

label: Dopaminergic Neurons
description: Dopaminergic neurons, particularly those in the substantia nigra, synthesize neuromelanin through oxidative polymerization of catecholamine-derived precursors, and adrenochrome or related aminochromes can form as intermediates in this process. Neuromelanin synthesis is a normal physiological process, though an excess of reactive oxidation intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in these neurons and to hypotheses about oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurodegeneration. This connects catecholamine oxidation chemistry to the biology of pigmented brain regions.
description_zh_TW: Dopaminergic neurons, particularly those in the substantia nigra, synthesize neuromelanin through oxidative polymerization of catecholamine-derived precursors, and adrenochrome or related aminochromes can form as intermediates in this process。Neuromelanin synthesis is a normal physiological process, though an excess of reactive oxidation intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in these neurons and to hypotheses about oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurodegeneration。This connects catecholamine oxidation chemistry to the biology of pigmented brain regions。

label: Tau oligomerization
description: 4-hydroxynonenal promotes tau oligomerization by forming covalent Michael adducts with tau cysteine and lysine residues, altering its conformation and seeding oligomers. As a major lipid-peroxidation aldehyde, 4-HNE thus couples membrane oxidation to protein misfolding. The directionality is aldehyde adduct to tau aggregation propensity. A caveat is that 4-HNE at low levels can also induce adaptive responses, and other aldehydes (MDA, acrolein) modify tau similarly. Elevated 4-HNE and tau adducts colocalize in Alzheimer's disease brain, linking lipid peroxidation to neurofibrillary pathology.
description_zh_TW: 4-hydroxynonenal 透過與 tau 半胱胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成共價邁克爾加合物，改變其構象並播種寡聚物來促進 tau oligomerization。作为一种主要的脂质过氧化醛，4-HNE 将膜氧化与蛋白质错误折叠结合起来。方向性是醛加合物對tau聚集的傾向。需要注意的是，低水平的 4-HNE 也可以誘導適應性反應，其他醛（MDA、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 tau。升高的 4-HNE 和 tau 加合物共定位於阿茲海默症大腦中，將 lipid peroxidation 與神經纖維病理聯繫起來。

label: UV-induced photoaging
description: Singlet oxygen mediates UV-induced photoaging because UVA radiation excites endogenous photosensitizers (e.g., porphyrins, flavins) in skin, producing 1O2 that induces matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) expression. MMPs degrade collagen and elastin, producing wrinkles, laxity, and solar elastosis. The directionality is photon to radical to enzyme to matrix destruction. A caveat is that UVA also generates other ROS and activates signaling pathways independently, so singlet oxygen is one contributor among several in photoaging.
description_zh_TW: Singlet oxygen 介導 UV-induced photoaging，因為 UVA 輻射會激發皮膚中的內源性光敏劑（例如卟啉、黃素），產生 1O2，誘導基質金屬蛋白酶 (MMP) 表現。 MMP 會降解膠原蛋白和彈性蛋白，產生皺紋、鬆弛和日光性彈性組織變性。方向性是光子到自由基到酵素到基質破壞。需要注意的是，UVA 也會產生其他 ROS 並獨立活化訊號通路，因此 singlet oxygen 是 photoaging 中的幾個貢獻者之一。

label: cancer in fast COMT
description: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) increases cancer risk in fast COMT (Val/Val) individuals, as reported in subgroup analyses of supplementation trials where rapid COMT metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates was associated with adverse outcomes. The mechanism may involve altered handling of catecholestrogens or oxidative metabolites that differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction cautions against blanket vitamin E recommendation in fast genotypes. It underscores the importance of genotype-aware antioxidant guidance.
description_zh_TW: Vitamin E（α-生育醇）會增加快速 COMT（Val/Val）個體的癌症風險，正如補充試驗的亞組分析所報告的那樣，其中維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的快速 COMT 代謝與不良後果相關。該機制可能涉及改變兒茶酚雌激素或氧化代謝物的處理方式，這些代謝物因酶活性而異。這種基因-營養素交互作用提醒我們不要在快速基因型中全面推薦維生素 E。它強調了基因型感知抗氧化指導的重要性。

label: cancer risk in slow COMT
description: Vitamin E reduces cancer risk in slow COMT individuals, with the protective effect concentrated in Met/Met genotypes in stratified trial data, likely reflecting more favorable metabolism of vitamin E and associated catechols when COMT activity is low. This contrasts with the increased risk observed in fast COMT genotypes, demonstrating a bidirectional gene-nutrient interaction. The mechanism is thought to involve COMT-dependent handling of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and catecholestrogens. Genotype-stratified analysis is therefore essential for interpreting antioxidant trials.
description_zh_TW: Vitamin E 減少了 cancer risk in slow COMT 個體，分層試驗數據中的保護作用集中在 Met/Met 基因型上，這可能反映出當 COMT activity 較低時維生素 E 和相關兒茶酚的代謝更有利。這與快速 COMT 基因型中觀察到的風險增加形成鮮明對比，證明了基因與營養的雙向交互作用。此機制被認為涉及 COMT 依賴的維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體和兒茶酚雌激素的處理。因此，基因型分層分析對於解釋抗氧化試驗至關重要。

label: GABAergic inhibitory cells
description: Medium spiny neurons are GABAergic inhibitory projection neurons, the principal output cells of the striatum that integrate cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic inputs. Their inhibitory nature means dopamine modulation via D1/D2 receptors reshapes striatal output to basal ganglia circuits, controlling movement, habit, and reward. As the main targets of nigrostriatal dopamine, they are central to COMT's striatal effects and to dopamine-regulated behavior. They comprise about 95% of striatal neurons.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 是 GABA 能抑制性投射神經元，是整合皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的紋狀體的主要輸出細胞。它們的抑制性質意味著透過 D1/D2 受體的多巴胺調節來重塑 basal ganglia 電路的紋狀體輸出，控制 movement、習慣和 reward。作為黑質紋狀體多巴胺的主要標靶，它們是 COMT 紋狀體效應和多巴胺調節行為的核心。它們大約包括95% of striatal neurons。

label: 95% of striatal neurons
description: Medium spiny neurons comprise approximately 95% of the neuronal population in the striatum, making them the dominant cell type through which dorsal and ventral striatal circuits operate. Their density underscores why striatal dopamine signaling, and its modulation by COMT and DAT, exerts such broad control over movement, habit, and reward behavior. The remaining 5% consist of interneurons that shape MSN activity. This cellular composition defines the functional architecture of the striatum and of the basal ganglia input stage.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約佔紋狀體神經元群的 95%，使其成為背側和腹側紋狀體迴路運作的主要細胞類型。它們的密度強調了為什麼紋狀體多巴胺訊號傳導及其由 COMT 和 DAT 的調節對 movement、習慣和 reward 行為發揮如此廣泛的控制。剩下的 5% 由塑造 MSN 活動的中間神經元組成。這種細胞組成定義了紋狀體和 basal ganglia 輸入級的功能架構。

label: D1 receptor
description: Medium spiny neurons express D1 receptors on the direct pathway, where D1 activation promotes movement facilitation by disinhibiting thalamocortical output. The D1/D2 dichotomy partitions striatal output into direct and indirect pathways with opposing effects on motor control, providing the framework for understanding dopamine action in the basal ganglia. Dopamine's action at D1 receptors is thus a key node modulated by the dopamine tone that COMT helps set in regions of lower DAT density. D1 signaling is also implicated in reward and incentive learning.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 在直接途徑上表達 D1 受體，其中 D1 活化透過去抑制丘腦皮質輸出來促進 movement 的促進。 D1/D2 二分法將紋狀體輸出分為直接和間接途徑，對 motor control 有相反的影響，為理解 basal ganglia 中的多巴胺作用提供了框架。因此，Dopamine 對 D1 受體的作用是受多巴胺音調調節的關鍵節點，COMT 有助於在 DAT 密度較低的區域中設定多巴胺音調。 D1 訊號傳導也與 reward 和激勵學習有關。

label: nigrostriatal projection
description: Medium spiny neurons receive dopamine from the nigrostriatal projection originating in the substantia nigra pars compacta, making them the principal postsynaptic targets of striatal dopamine. The dopamine they receive is terminated mainly by DAT reuptake but also shaped by COMT in regions of lower DAT density. This dopaminergic input is essential for the motor and reward functions medium spiny neurons mediate, and its degeneration underlies Parkinson's disease. It is the central interface between dopamine neurons and striatal output.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 從源自黑質緻密部的 nigrostriatal projection 接收多巴胺，使它們成為紋狀體多巴胺的主要突觸後目標。他們接收到的多巴胺主要透過 DAT 再攝取而終止，但在 DAT 密度較低的區域也受到 COMT 的影響。這種多巴胺能輸入對於中等棘神經元介導的運動和 reward 功能至關重要，其退化是帕金森氏症的基礎。它是多巴胺神經元和紋狀體輸出之間的中央介面。

label: inhibitory dopamine receptor
description: The D2 receptor is an inhibitory (Gi/o-coupled) dopamine receptor whose activation reduces cAMP and opens GIRK potassium channels, hyperpolarizing neurons in the central nervous system. It is a major mediator of dopamine's modulatory effects on movement, reward, motivation, and cognition, and is highly expressed on striatal medium spiny neurons. Its inhibition of cAMP signaling contrasts with the excitatory D1 receptor, enabling bidirectional dopaminergic tuning of basal ganglia output. It is also the principal target of antipsychotic medications.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 是一種抑制性（Gi/o 偶聯）多巴胺受體，活化可降低 cAMP 並打開 GIRK 鉀通道，使中樞神經系統中的神經元超極化。它是多巴胺對 movement、reward、動機和認知的調節作用的主要介質，並且在紋狀體中型多棘神經元上高度表達。它對 cAMP 訊號傳導的抑制與興奮性 D1 receptor 形成對比，從而實現 basal ganglia 輸出的雙向多巴胺能調節。這也是antipsychotic medications的主要目標。

label: antipsychotic medications
description: The D2 receptor is the principal target of antipsychotic medications, especially typical (first-generation) antipsychotics, which exert therapeutic effect by blocking D2 signaling to reduce psychotic symptoms. Occupancy of striatal D2 receptors correlates with both clinical efficacy and the development of extrapyramidal side effects such as parkinsonism and tardive dyskinesia. This targeting links dopaminergic tone, shaped partly by COMT, to psychiatric treatment response. D2 blockade remains the common mechanism across most antipsychotic drug classes.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor是antipsychotic medications的主要靶點，尤其是典型的（第一代）抗精神病藥，它透過阻斷D2訊號傳導以減輕精神病症狀來發揮治療作用。紋狀體 D2 受體的佔據與臨床療效和錐體外系副作用（如帕金森氏症和遲發性運動障礙）的發生有關。這種標靶將多巴胺能音調（部分由 COMT 塑造）與精神治療反應聯繫起來。 D2 阻斷仍然是大多數抗精神病藥物類別的共同機制。

label: movement
description: The D2 receptor modulates movement by inhibiting striatal medium spiny neurons of the indirect pathway, which normally suppresses thalamocortical motor output; reduced D2 tone releases this suppression and produces hyperactivity, whereas excess activation suppresses movement. Dopamine acting on D2 thus finely calibrates motor initiation, smoothness, and sequencing. This mechanism is central to the hypokinesia of Parkinson's disease and to antipsychotic-induced movement disorders. The direct and indirect pathway balance determines net motor output.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制間接途徑的紋狀體中棘神經元來調節 movement，此間接途徑通常抑制丘腦皮質運動輸出；減少的 D2 音調會釋放這種抑制並產生過動症，而過度的活化會抑制 movement。 Dopamine 作用於 D2，從而精細地校準馬達啟動、平滑度和排序。這種機制對於帕金森氏症的運動功能減退和抗精神病藥物引起的 movement 疾病至關重要。直接和間接途徑的平衡決定了淨運動輸出。

label: reward
description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

label: Lands cycle
description: The Lands cycle exchanges fatty acids into the sn-2 position of membrane phospholipids. ACase-liberated fatty acids enter this cycle, enriching PUFA-containing species.
description_zh_TW: Lands cycle 將脂肪酸交換至膜磷脂的 sn-2 位置。ACase 釋放的脂肪酸進入此循環，富集含 PUFA 的種類。

label: Regulated Cell Death
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Ferroptosis is a regulated, iron-dependent cell death pathway in which cells lose their ability to regulate fats and eventually die, as distinct from unregulated necrotic death or other programmed death programs like apoptosis. It was discovered and named (originally 'oxytosis') by Pam Maher in 2001. The hallmark mechanism is accumulation of lipid peroxides to toxic levels, normally kept in check by glutathione, and the pathway is increasingly linked to neurodegeneration and age-related diseases. Because ferroptosis is druggable and genetically regulatable, it has become a promising therapeutic target alongside cellular senescence for supporting healthy aging and clearing dysfunctional cells.
description_zh_TW: 鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）是一種受調控、依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，細胞在此途徑中失去調節脂肪的能力並最終死亡，有別於不受調控的壞死性死亡或其他如細胞凋亡（apoptosis）的程式性死亡。它由Pam Maher於2001年發現並命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。其標誌性機制是脂質過氧化物累積至毒性濃度，此過程通常由麩胱甘肽（glutathione）加以控制，且此途徑日益與神經退化及年齡相關疾病相關。由於ferroptosis可被藥物調控且在遺傳上可調節，它與細胞衰老（cellular senescence）一同成為支持健康老化與清除功能失常細胞的具前景治療標靶。

label: SIRT6 silencing
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT6 silencing can overcome sorafenib resistance by promoting ferroptosis in gastric cancer, suggesting a therapeutic strategy for resistant malignancies. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of ferroptotic cell death and restored drug sensitivity. By triggering this iron-dependent form of cell death, SIRT6 depletion bypasses the resistance mechanisms that allow gastric cancer cells to survive sorafenib treatment. This reveals an unexpected pro-survival role for SIRT6 in this context, where its activity protects cells from ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6沉默可以透過促進胃癌中的鐵死亡來克服Sorafenib耐藥性，為耐藥性惡性腫瘤提供了治療策略。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於鐵死亡性細胞死亡和藥物敏感性恢復的上游。透過觸發這種鐵依賴性的細胞死亡形式，SIRT6耗竭繞過了使胃癌細胞在Sorafenib治療中存活的耐藥機制。這揭示了SIRT6在此環境中一個意想不到的促存活角色，其活性保護細胞免受鐵死亡。

label: HO-1
description: Heme oxygenase-1 has a biphasic relationship with ferroptosis. Mild damage: HO-1 expression stimulates mitophagy and disposal of damaged mitochondria, disposing of redox-active iron and reducing ferroptosis (as in cisplatin acute kidney injury via the ROS/HO-1/GPX4 axis). Sustained overexpression: HO-1 catabolizes heme into free iron, downregulates GPX4, and promotes lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis (as in TNBC cells). The direction depends on damage severity and HO-1 expression duration.
description_zh_TW: 血紅素加氧酶-1（HO-1）與鐵死亡之間呈雙相關係。輕度損傷時：HO-1 的表達會促進粒線體自噬並清除受損粒線體，處理具氧化還原活性的鐵而降低鐵死亡（如經由 ROS/HO-1/GPX4 軸線的 cisplatin 急性腎損傷）。持續過表達時：HO-1 將血紅素分解為游離鐵、下調 GPX4，促進脂質過氧化與鐵死亡（如 TNBC 細胞）。方向取決於損傷嚴重度與 HO-1 表達的持續時間。

label: NCOA4
description: NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy degrades ferritin stores, expanding the labile iron pool that feeds Fenton chemistry and lipid peroxidation — the core ferroptotic engine. Pharmacological or genetic inhibition of O-GlcNAc transferase activates both ferritinophagy and mitophagy, increasing labile iron and ROS and sensitizing cells to ferroptosis. Iron chelators (deferoxamine, ciclopirox) and ferritinophagy blockade therefore act on the same supply-side node of ferroptosis regulation.
description_zh_TW: NCOA4 介導的鐵蛋白自噬會降解鐵蛋白儲存，擴大可動用鐵池，進而餵養 Fenton 化學與脂質過氧化——鐵死亡的核心引擎。藥理或遺傳抑制 O-GlcNAc 轉移酶會同時活化鐵蛋白自噬與粒線體自噬，增加可動用鐵與 ROS，並使細胞對鐵死亡敏感。因此鐵螯合劑（deferoxamine、ciclopirox）與阻斷鐵蛋白自噬都作用在鐵死亡調控的同一供給端節點。

label: RSL3
description: RSL3 is the prototype class-II ferroptosis inducer: it directly inhibits glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), the only enzyme that can reduce lipid hydroperoxides inside membranes. GPX4 inhibition makes the cell unable to neutralize lipid peroxides regardless of GSH supply, committing it to ferroptotic death. RSL3 synergy with autophagic GPX4 degradation (Fin56, copper) and its use alongside system-xc- blockers like erastin represent the two supply-side and effector-side strategies for triggering ferroptosis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: RSL3 是第二類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型：它直接抑制麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶 4（GPX4）——唯一能在膜內還原脂質氫過氧化物的酶。GPX4 受抑制後，無論 GSH 供應如何，細胞都無法中和脂質過氧化物，注定走向鐵死亡。RSL3 與自噬介導的 GPX4 降解（Fin56、銅）之間的協同，以及與 system xc- 阻斷劑（如 erastin）的並用，代表觸發癌症鐵死亡的供給端與效應端兩大策略。

label: Amifostine
description: Amifostine scavenges hydroxyl radicals as a prodrug that is dephosphorylated to the active thiol WR-1065, which protects normal tissues during radiotherapy. By quenching OH* it spares DNA and proteins from radiation-induced damage. The directionality is radioprotectant to radical neutralization. A caveat is that amifostine preferentially protects some normal tissues over tumors, but it carries side effects (hypotension, nausea) that limit use. Selective uptake by normal tissues gives amifostine its cytoprotective profile during radiotherapy and chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: Amifostine 作為前藥清除 hydroxyl radicals，此前藥被去磷酸化為活性硫醇 WR-1065，可在放射治療期間保護正常組織。透過淬滅 OH*，它可以使 DNA 和 proteins 免受輻射引起的損傷。方向性對於自由基中和具有輻射防護作用。需要注意的是，amifostine 優先保護一些正常組織而不是腫瘤，但它的副作用（低血壓、噁心）限制了使用。正常組織的選擇性攝取使 amifostine 在放射治療和化療期間具有細胞保護作用。

label: ATM Kinase
description: Ionizing radiation activates ATM kinase by causing DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM, which then phosphorylates Chk2, p53, and BRCA1 to coordinate the damage response. This initiates cell-cycle arrest and repair. The directionality is DNA break to kinase signaling cascade. A caveat is that ATM also responds to oxidative stress and replication stress, so its activation is not uniquely radiation-driven. ATM is considered the master coordinator of the DNA-damage response to double-strand breaks, integrating cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis decisions.
description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 透過引起 DNA 雙股斷裂來活化 ATM kinase，從而募集 ATM 並使其自磷酸化，然後 ATM 磷酸化 Chk2、p53 和 BRCA1 以協調損傷反應。這啟動了細胞週期停滯和修復。方向性是 DNA 斷裂至激酶訊號級聯。需要注意的是，ATM 也會對 oxidative stress 和複製壓力做出反應，因此它的活化並不是唯一由輻射驅動的。 ATM 被認為是對雙股斷裂的 DNA 損傷反應的主協調員，整合了細胞週期停滯、修復和 apoptosis 決策。

label: Clustered DNA Damage
description: Ionizing radiation causes clustered DNA damage, defined as two or more lesions within one or two helical turns, a signature pattern that overwhelms repair and drives lethal or mutagenic breaks. This clustering distinguishes radiation from many chemical genotoxins. The directionality is radiation to locally concentrated lesions. A caveat is that clustering severity depends on radiation quality (LET) and oxygen enhancement, so not all exposures produce identical patterns. Clustered lesions are a hallmark of high-LET radiation and are repaired inefficiently, increasing the probability of mutation and cell death.
description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 導致 clustered DNA damage，定義為一兩個螺旋圈內的兩個或多個病變，這是一種壓倒修復並導致致命或誘變斷裂的特徵模式。这种聚类将辐射与许多化学基因毒素区分开来。方向性是局部集中病灶的輻射。需要注意的是，聚集的严重程度取决于辐射质量 (LET) 和氧气增强，因此并非所有暴露都会产生相同的模式。聚集性病变是高 LET 辐射的一个标志，修复效率低下，增加了突变和细胞死亡的可能性。

label: Iron accumulation in Substantia Nigra
description: Iron accumulation in the substantia nigra promotes the Fenton reaction because elevated redox-active iron there catalyzes conversion of H2O2 to hydroxyl radicals near dopaminergic neurons. The iron burden correlates with oxidative damage markers in Parkinson's disease. The directionality is iron accumulation to radical generation. A caveat is that iron accumulation may also be a downstream consequence of oxidative damage and impaired iron export, so the relationship is partly bidirectional. Iron chelation and restoration of ferritin expression are therefore investigated as strategies to protect dopaminergic neurons.
description_zh_TW: Iron 在黑質中的累積促進了 Fenton reaction，因為那裡的氧化還原活性 iron 升高會催化 dopaminergic 神經元附近的 H2O2 轉化為 hydroxyl radicals。 iron 負擔與 Parkinson's disease 中的氧化損傷標記有關。方向性是iron累積到激進生成。需要注意的是，iron 累積也可能是氧化損傷和 iron 輸出受損的下游結果，因此這種關係部分是雙向的。因此，研究了 Iron 螯合和 ferritin 表達的恢復，作為保護 dopaminergic 神經元的策略。

label: Blue-gray pigmentation of skin, eyes and mucous membranes
description: Argyria results in a blue-grayish pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes, caused by deposition of silver in body tissues after large doses of silver or its compounds are absorbed into the circulatory system. Argyria is rare, and although, so far as known, the condition does not otherwise harm a person's health, it is disfiguring and usually permanent. Mild forms of argyria are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis, which is clinically relevant because cyanosis signals hypoxemia while argyria simply reflects lifelong silver deposition.
description_zh_TW: Argyria導致皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的藍灰色色素沉著，由大劑量銀或其化合物吸收進入循環系統後在體組織中沉積引起。Argyria罕見，雖然據目前所知，該病變對健康無其他損害，但它會毀容且通常永久。輕度argyria有時被誤認為發紺，這在臨床上相關，因為發紺表示低氧血症，而argyria僅反映終身銀沉積。

label: Benzocaine
description: Benzocaine is a topical/local anesthetic that is a recognized trigger of acquired methemoglobinemia. Like other oxidizing drugs, it overwhelms the body's reducing systems, converting hemoglobin's ferrous iron to the ferric methemoglobin form. Acquired methemoglobinemia is much more common than congenital forms and can be acute and severe, especially with high-dose or combined exposures. Related local anesthetics prilocaine and lidocaine, along with antimalarials, dapsone, rasburicase and inhaled nitric oxide, are similarly implicated, and nitrite-based agents such as amyl and isobutyl nitrites and sodium nitrite are additional culprits.
description_zh_TW: Benzocaine is a topical/local anesthetic that is a recognized trigger of acquired methemoglobinemia。Like other oxidizing drugs, it overwhelms the body's reducing systems, converting hemoglobin's ferrous iron to the ferric methemoglobin form。Acquired methemoglobinemia is much more common than congenital forms and can be acute and severe, especially with high-dose or combined exposures。Related local anesthetics prilocaine and lidocaine, along with antimalarials, dapsone, rasburicase and inhaled nitric oxide, are similarly implicated, and nitrite-based agents such as amyl and isobutyl nitrites and sodium nitrite are additional culprits。

label: Co-oximetry
description: Co-oximetry is a laboratory technique that measures the percentage of methemoglobin directly and is considered the gold standard for diagnosing methemoglobinemia. It is needed because pulse oximetry reads inaccurately in methemoglobinemia (typically showing a value around 85% regardless of the true oxygenation status) and arterial blood gas analysis may show normal PaO2 while the patient is clinically cyanotic. Diagnosis is also supported clinically by cyanosis unresponsive to oxygen and chocolate-brown blood, and genetic testing can identify congenital forms.
description_zh_TW: Co-oximetry is a laboratory technique that measures the percentage of methemoglobin directly and is considered the gold standard for diagnosing methemoglobinemia。It is needed because pulse oximetry reads inaccurately in methemoglobinemia (typically showing a value around 85% regardless of the true oxygenation status) and arterial blood gas analysis may show normal PaO2 while the patient is clinically cyanotic。Diagnosis is also supported clinically by cyanosis unresponsive to oxygen and chocolate-brown blood, and genetic testing can identify congenital forms。

label: Cytochrome b5 reductase
description: Cytochrome b5 reductase (also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase or diaphorase) is the enzyme primarily responsible for reducing methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin. Autosomal recessive mutations causing deficiency of this enzyme produce the most common congenital form of methemoglobinemia: Type 1 affects only erythrocytes and mainly causes cyanosis, while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems. Congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are much rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia.
description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase (also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase or diaphorase) is the enzyme primarily responsible for reducing methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin。Autosomal recessive mutations causing deficiency of this enzyme produce the most common congenital form of methemoglobinemia: Type 1 affects only erythrocytes and mainly causes cyanosis, while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems。Congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are much rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia。

label: Dapsone
description: Dapsone is a medication that is a very common cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, especially with chronic use. Acquired methemoglobinemia is triggered when oxidizing agents overwhelm the body's reducing systems, and dapsone is among the most frequent offending drugs. Dapsone-related cases are often managed by dose reduction or discontinuation rather than always requiring methylene blue treatment. Other common drug triggers include topical and local anesthetics such as benzocaine, prilocaine and lidocaine, antimalarials such as chloroquine, rasburicase, and inhaled nitric oxide.
description_zh_TW: Dapsone is a medication that is a very common cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, especially with chronic use。Acquired methemoglobinemia is triggered when oxidizing agents overwhelm the body's reducing systems, and dapsone is among the most frequent offending drugs。Dapsone-related cases are often managed by dose reduction or discontinuation rather than always requiring methylene blue treatment。Other common drug triggers include topical and local anesthetics such as benzocaine, prilocaine and lidocaine, antimalarials such as chloroquine, rasburicase, and inhaled nitric oxide。

label: Sodium nitrite
description: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures. Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity. Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants. Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion.
description_zh_TW: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures。Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity。Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants。Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion。

label: Vitamin K
description: A 2022 extension (Mishima et al., Nature 608:778) showed FSP1 is also a warfarin-resistant vitamin K reductase: it reduces vitamin K to its hydroquinone (VKH2), sustaining a non-canonical vitamin K redox cycle that, like the CoQ10 cycle, supplies a reduced radical-trapping antioxidant independent of GPX4. This broadens FSP1 into a general quinone-reductase ferroptosis suppressor and explains its antidotal activity against warfarin poisoning.
description_zh_TW: 2022 年的延伸研究（Mishima et al., Nature 608:778）顯示 FSP1 也是一種抗 warfarin 的維生素 K 還原酶：它將維生素 K 還原為其氫醌（VKH2），維持一個非典型的維生素 K 氧化還原循環，如同 CoQ10 循環一般，提供不依賴 GPX4 的還原型自由基捕獲抗氧化劑。這將 FSP1 擴展為廣義的醌還原酶型鐵死亡抑制劑，也解釋了它對 warfarin 中毒的解毒活性。

label: GPX4 inhibitor
description: Because many therapy-resistant cancers rely on FSP1 for ferroptosis resistance, iFSP1 is being explored to sensitize tumors (e.g., hepatocellular carcinoma) to ferroptosis-based therapy, often in combination with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibitors rather than as monotherapy, reflecting the two-pillar ferroptosis-defense model.
description_zh_TW: 由於許多治療抗性腫瘤依賴 FSP1 來抵抗鐵死亡，iFSP1 被探索用於使腫瘤（例如肝細胞癌）對鐵死亡療法增敏，通常與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併使用而非單藥，這反映鐵死亡的雙支柱防禦模型。

label: Ferroptosis Suppressor
description: FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1, encoded by AIFM2) is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein NAD(P)H:ubiquinone oxidoreductase that constitutes the second major, glutathione-independent brake on ferroptosis, acting in parallel to GPX4. It was identified independently in 2019 by Doll et al. (Nature 575:693) and Bersuker et al. (Cell 177:1264) as a gene capable of rescuing cells from GPX4 loss.
description_zh_TW: FSP1（ferroptosis suppressor protein 1，由 AIFM2 編碼）是一種位於質膜的黃素蛋白 NAD(P)H:泛醌氧化還原酶，構成第二個主要的、不依賴谷胱甘肽的鐵死亡抑制系統，與 GPX4 平行運作。Doll et al.（Nature 575:693）與 Bersuker et al.（Cell 177:1264）於 2019 年各自獨立發現它是一個能在 GPX4 缺失時挽救細胞的基因的。

label: Plasma Membrane
description: FSP1 carries an N-terminal N-myristoylation motif that recruits it to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane, positioning the enzyme precisely where phospholipid peroxidation is initiated and propagated. Membrane association is essential for its ferroptosis-suppressive function.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 帶有 N 端 N-肉豆蔻酰化（myristoylation）基序，將其招募至質膜內葉，使酵素精確定位在磷脂過氧化起始與傳播的位置。膜結合對其抑制鐵死亡的功能不可或缺。

label: 3-Nitrotyrosine
description: 3-nitrotyrosine is a biomarker for nitrative stress, reflecting peroxynitrite- or myeloperoxidase-mediated nitration of protein tyrosines. It is elevated across many inflammatory and neurodegenerative conditions. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable protein modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can arise from multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or degraded, so it indicates historical rather than instantaneous nitrative load. Quantification in plasma, CSF, and tissue by mass spectrometry or immunoassay has made 3-NT a standard endpoint in redox biomarker studies.
description_zh_TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 的生物標記物，反映 peroxynitrite 或 myeloperoxidase 介導的蛋白質 tyrosines 硝化。它會導致許多發炎和神經退化性疾病。方向性是對穩定蛋白質修飾的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以由多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或降解，因此它表示歷史硝化負荷而不是瞬時硝化負荷。透過質譜或免疫分析對血漿、腦脊髓液和組織進行定量，使 3-NT 成為氧化還原生物標記研究的標準終點。

label: Alagebrium
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
description_zh_TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。

label: Innate Immune Defense
description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

label: Cytokines
description: Cytokines and Neuroinflammation are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Cytokines and Neuroinflammation may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Cytokines 和 Neuroinflammation 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Cytokines 和 Neuroinflammation 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Extracellular neuromelanin
source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, aging, and neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.md
description: Extracellular neuromelanin activates Microglia, serving as a trigger that switches the target cell or process into an active state. Mechanistically, the entity engages receptors or danger signals that provoke proliferation, phagocytosis, or cytokine release. This is significant because activation of glial or immune effectors can both clear debris and, when chronic, perpetuate neuronal injury. A caveat is that activation has a protective-to-harmful transition, so the consequence depends on whether the response resolves or becomes sustained.
description_zh_TW: Extracellular neuromelanin 啟動 Microglia，作為將目標單元或進程切換到活動狀態的觸發器。從機制上講，該實體與受體或危險信號結合，引發增殖、吞噬或細胞激素釋放。這很重要，因為神經膠質或免疫效應器的活化既可以清除碎片，並且在慢性時，可以使神經元損傷永久化。需要注意的是，活化有一個保護性到有害性的轉變，因此結果取決於 response 是否解決或持續。

label: Glial cells

Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.

description_zh_TW: Neuronophagia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuronophagia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Lysosomal Dysfunction
description: Failing lysosomes cannot clear α-synuclein oligomers, so aggregates accumulate into Lewy bodies — the hallmark of Parkinson's disease dopaminergic neurons. Lysosomal failure co-acts with Complex I defects, and dying neurons then release neuromelanin and aggregates as DAMPs that prime microglia. Because the lysosome is the terminal station of autophagy and mitophagy, its dysfunction converts otherwise-manageable protein load into lethal aggregation, and lipofuscin accumulation further buffers lysosomal pH upward.
description_zh_TW: 失能的溶酶體無法清除 α-synuclein 寡聚體，使聚集物累積成路易氏體——帕金森氏症多巴胺神經元的標誌。溶酶體失能與 Complex I 缺陷協同作用，垂死神經元隨後釋出神經黑色素與聚集物作為 DAMP 致敏小膠細胞。由於溶酶體是自噬與粒線體自噬的終點站，其失能會使原本可處理的蛋白負荷轉為致命聚集，而脂褐素的累積更進一步推高溶酶體的 pH。

label: Glycotoxins
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Cigarette smoking is an exogenous source of glycation compounds. The curing of tobacco leaves has been proposed as the source of compounds that can readily increase in vivo AGEs; Cerami and colleagues found that glycotoxins from cigarettes are inhaled into the alveoli, then transported to the bloodstream or to lung cells where they interact with other glycation products and contribute to AGE formation. Smoking thus adds to the body's AGE burden beyond diet and endogenous production. This exogenous route of AGE generation helps explain the accelerated tissue aging and cardiovascular risk observed in smokers.
description_zh_TW: 吸菸是糖化化合物的外源性來源。菸葉的烘烤被認為是能輕易增加體內 AGE 之化合物的來源；Cerami 及其同事發現，來自香菸的糖毒素（glycotoxins）被吸入肺泡，隨後被運送至血液或肺細胞，在那裡與其他糖化產物交互作用並促成 AGE 形成。因此，吸菸在飲食與內生性產生之外，額外增加了身體的 AGE 負擔。這種外源性的 AGE 生成途徑有助於解釋吸菸者中觀察到的加速組織老化與心血管風險。

label: SIRT1 and RelA/p65
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Exposure to cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 complex, diminishing deacetylation of RelA and leaving NF-κB in a more active, pro-inflammatory state. The consequence is heightened expression of inflammatory mediators in airway and other cells exposed to smoke. The directionality is that the environmental insult (smoke) reduces a protective protein–protein interaction, increasing inflammation. This provides a mechanistic link between smoking, impaired sirtuin function, and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
description_zh_TW: 暴露於香菸煙霧提取物會破壞 SIRT1–RelA/p65 複合體，削弱 RelA 的去乙醯化，使 NF-κB 處於更活躍的促發炎狀態。後果是在氣道和其他暴露於煙霧的細胞中發炎介質的表達增高。其方向性為：環境損害（煙霧）降低了一個保護性的蛋白-蛋白相互作用，增加發炎。這提供了吸煙、sirtuin 功能受損和慢性發炎性肺病之間的機制性聯繫。

label: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB
description: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB shifts signaling to necroptosis, as loss of NF-kappaB-dependent survival genes leaves RIPK1 free to engage RIPK3 and MLKL in lytic, pro-inflammatory cell death. This explains toxicity when NF-kappaB is inhibited in TNF-exposed cells. The directionality is NF-kappaB blockade to necroptotic switch. A caveat is that caspase-8 can still divert cells to apoptosis, so the outcome depends on the full death-receptor complex composition. Necroptosis is highly inflammatory because lysed cells release damage-associated molecular patterns, amplifying tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB 將訊號傳導轉移至 necroptosis，因為 NF-kappaB 依賴性存活基因的缺失使 RIPK1 可以自由地與 RIPK3 和 MLKL 結合，參與裂解性促發炎細胞死亡。这解释了 TNF 暴露细胞中 NF-κB 受到抑制时的毒性。方向性是 NF-kappaB 阻断坏死性凋亡开关。需要注意的是，caspase-8 仍然可以將細胞轉移到 apoptosis，因此結果取決於完整的死亡受體複合物組成。 Necroptosis 具有高度發炎性，因為裂解的細胞會釋放與損傷相關的分子模式，從而放大組織損傷。

label: VDAC
description: Parkin ubiquitinates the voltage-dependent anion channel VDAC on the mitochondrial outer membrane — a modification with dual cell-fate meaning: monoubiquitination of VDAC halts apoptosis, while polyubiquitination feeds PINK1/Parkin mitophagy. Parkin also ubiquitinates MFN1 and mitochondrial Rho GTPases, and regulates Drp1 activity and degradation. VDAC is therefore the point of intersection where the same E3 ligase executing mitophagy also restrains apoptotic permeabilization.
description_zh_TW: Parkin 會對粒線體外膜的電壓依賴性陰離子通道 VDAC 進行泛素化——此修飾具有雙重的細胞命運意義：VDAC 的單泛素化可阻止細胞凋亡，而多泛素化則驅動 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。Parkin 也會泛素化 MFN1 與粒線體 Rho GTPase，並調控 Drp1 的活性與降解。因此 VDAC 正是同一個 E3 連接酶在執行粒線體自噬之外、同時抑制凋亡通透化的交會點。

label: c-FLIP
description: c-FLIP heterodimerizes with caspase-8 and, in its long isoform (c-FLIPL), preserves just enough caspase-8 catalytic activity to cleave and inactivate RIPK1 and RIPK3 — the necrosome substrates — thereby suppressing necroptosis while blunting apoptosis. When caspase-8/c-FLIP activity drops below that threshold (z-VAD-FMK, viral c-FLIP mimetics, high RIPK3 expression), TNF signaling flips to necroptosis. The short isoform c-FLIPS blocks caspase-8 more completely while enhancing complex II assembly, promoting necroptosis instead.
description_zh_TW: c-FLIP 會與 caspase-8 形成異源二聚體；其長型（c-FLIPL）保留剛好足夠的 caspase-8 催化活性去切割並使 RIPK1 與 RIPK3——即 necrosome 的受質——失活，從而在減弱細胞凋亡的同時抑制程序性壞死。當 caspase-8/c-FLIP 活性低於此門檻（z-VAD-FMK、病毒型 c-FLIP 擬似劑、高 RIPK3 表達）時，TNF 訊號便翻轉為程序性壞死。短型 c-FLIPS 對 caspase-8 的阻斷更完全，且會促進 complex II 組裝，反而促進程序性壞死。

label: homocysteine to methionine
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

label: two forms
description: COMT exists in two major isoforms produced by alternative translation initiation: a soluble form (S-COMT) found predominantly in peripheral tissues such as liver, kidney, and erythrocytes, and a membrane-bound form (MB-COMT) anchored to the Golgi that predominates in the brain. MB-COMT has higher affinity for catechol substrates and is the principal neuronal isoform. This tissue-specific distribution explains why central and peripheral catechol metabolism are differentially affected by COMT genotype and inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: COMT 存在於由替代翻譯起始產生的兩種主要異構體中：主要存在於 peripheral tissues（如肝、腎和紅血球）中的可溶形式 (S-COMT)，以及錨定在高爾基體上的膜結合形式 (MB-COMT)，主要存在於 brain 中。 MB-COMT 對兒茶酚底物具有較高的親和力，是主要的神經元亞型。這種組織特異性分佈解釋了為什麼 COMT genotype 和抑制劑對中樞和周邊兒茶酚代謝的影響不同。

label: COMT variants
description: COMT genetic variants may influence susceptibility to Bipolar II Disorder, based on the enzyme's role in catecholamine regulation and interactions with folate-cycle genes such as MTHFR and MTHFD1. Association studies report modest, inconsistent effects, suggesting at most a small contribution to risk relative to the complex genetic architecture of the disorder. Catecholaminergic dysregulation is plausibly relevant to mood cycling and hypomania, but COMT is not a major determinant of the bipolar phenotype. It is typically studied jointly with methylation-pathway genes in mood disorder genetics.
description_zh_TW: 基於此酵素在兒茶酚胺調節中的作用以及與 folate 循環基因（例如 MTHFR 和 MTHFD1）的相互作用，COMT 遺傳變異可能會影響 Bipolar II Disorder 的易感性。關聯研究報告了適度且不一致的影響，顯示相對於該疾病的複雜遺傳結構，至多對風險的貢獻很小。兒茶酚胺能失調似乎與情緒循環和輕躁症有關，但 COMT 並不是雙極性情感疾患表型的主要決定因素。它通常與情緒障礙遺傳學中的甲基化途徑基因進行聯合研究。

label: Epinephrine levels
description: COMT inhibition increases epinephrine (adrenaline) levels because O-methylation to metanephrine is blocked, prolonging epinephrine signaling and allowing accumulation of the parent catecholamine. Clinically, COMT inhibitors such as entacapone and opicapone used as adjuncts to levodopa in Parkinson's disease raise circulating catecholamines, which is therapeutically useful for motor symptoms but can cause adrenergic side effects. The directionality is straightforward: less enzymatic inactivation yields higher epinephrine. This relationship also connects COMT blockade to downstream oxidative products such as adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: COMT 抑制會增加腎上腺素（腎上腺素）水平，因為 O-甲基化為變腎上腺素被阻斷，從而延長腎上腺素信號傳導並允許母體兒茶酚胺積累。臨床上，COMT 抑制劑（例如恩他卡朋和阿匹卡朋）用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，可提高循環 catecholamines，這對運動症狀有治療作用，但可能引起腎上腺素能副作用。方向性很簡單：較少的酵素失活會產生較高的腎上腺素。這種關係也將 COMT 阻斷與下游氧化產物（例如腎上腺素紅）聯繫起來。

label: impulsivity
description: COMT overexpression increases impulsivity in mice, measured as more premature responses in operant tasks, reflecting altered prefrontal and striatal catechol signaling that governs response inhibition. The phenotype aligns with the idea that excessive dopamine clearance perturbs the balance of impulsive and compulsive behaviors, and mirrors traits associated with fast human COMT genotypes. Effect sizes in animal models are moderate and task-dependent, but the causal manipulation strengthens the interpretation. The behavioral change is consistent with reduced dopamine-mediated inhibitory control.
description_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現會增加小鼠的 impulsivity，測量為操作任務中更多的過早反應，反映了控制反應抑制的前額葉和紋狀體兒茶酚訊號的改變。該表型與過多的多巴胺清除擾亂衝動和強迫行為的平衡的觀點相一致，並反映了與快速人類 COMT 基因型相關的特徵。動物模型中的效應大小適中且依賴任務，但因果操作加強了解釋。行為變化與多巴胺介導的抑制控制的減少一致。

label: striatal dopamine release
description: COMT overexpression increases striatal dopamine release capacity, observed in COMT-OE mice as enhanced phasic dopamine signaling in the striatum. The mechanism is thought to involve homeostatic upregulation of dopamine synthesis and release in response to chronically low extracellular dopamine tone produced by excess clearance. This contrasts with the cognitive deficits also seen in these mice, illustrating region-specific effects of COMT activity on striatal versus prefrontal dopamine systems. The finding helps dissociate the motor and cognitive consequences of COMT excess.
description_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現增加了 striatal dopamine release 的能力，在 COMT-OE 小鼠中觀察到，紋狀體中的階段性多巴胺訊號傳導增強。該機制被認為涉及多巴胺合成和釋放的穩態上調，以響應因過度清除而產生的長期較低的細胞外多巴胺張力。這與這些小鼠中也觀察到的認知缺陷形成鮮明對比，說明 COMT activity 對紋狀體多巴胺系統與前額葉多巴胺系統的區域特異性影響。這項發現有助於區分 COMT 過量對運動和認知的影響。

label: methyl groups from SAMe
description: COMT requires methyl groups derived from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe), the universal methyl donor generated by the methionine cycle, to methylate catechol substrates. Each catalytic turnover consumes one SAMe molecule, coupling COMT flux tightly to the cellular methyl budget and to folate- and B12-dependent remethylation that regenerates methionine and SAMe. This dependence means COMT activity is sensitive to overall methyl donor availability, including diet, supplementation, and genetic variants affecting one-carbon metabolism. It also explains why excess methyl donors can be poorly tolerated when COMT activity is already slow.
description_zh_TW: COMT 需要源自 S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe) 的 methyl groups（由蛋胺酸循環產生的通用 methyl donor）來甲基化兒茶酚底物。每次催化轉換消耗一個 SAMe 分子，將 COMT 通量與細胞甲基預算以及 folate 和 B12 依賴性再甲基化緊密耦合，從而再生蛋氨酸和 SAMe。這種依賴性意味著 COMT activity 對 methyl donor 的整體可用性敏感，包括飲食、補充劑和影響一碳代謝的遺傳變異。這也解釋了為什麼當 COMT activity 已經很慢時，過量的甲基供體的耐受性很差。

label: increased striatal dopamine release
description: COMT-OE (overexpression) mice display increased striatal dopamine release, a homeostatic adaptation to constitutively elevated COMT activity that lowers baseline extracellular dopamine. This enhanced release capacity manifests as greater phasic dopamine responses in the striatum, likely reflecting compensatory upregulation of dopamine synthesis and releasable pools. The finding helps dissociate the motor and striatal effects from the cognitive and prefrontal consequences of COMT excess. It illustrates how the brain compensates for chronically altered catecholamine clearance.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE（過度表達）小鼠表現出 increased striatal dopamine release，這是對持續升高的 COMT activity 的穩態適應，可降低基線細胞外多巴胺。這種增強的釋放能力表現為紋狀體中更大的階段性多巴胺反應，可能反映了多巴胺合成和可釋放池的補償性上調。這項發現有助於將運動和紋狀體的影響與 COMT 過量的認知和前額葉後果分開。它說明了 brain 如何補償長期改變的兒茶酚胺清除率。

label: increased compulsive behavior
description: COMT-OE mice show increased compulsive behavior, reflected in more perseverative responses, indicating that excess COMT activity shifts the impulsive-compulsive balance toward perseveration. This suggests COMT tone influences the tuning of habit and repetitive-behavior circuits, particularly in the striatum and prefrontal cortex. The observation extends the behavioral phenotyping of COMT overexpression beyond cognition and impulsivity. It is relevant to disorders characterized by compulsivity and rigid behavioral patterns.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased compulsive behavior，反映在更堅持不懈的反應中，顯示過量的 COMT activity 會使衝動-強迫平衡轉向堅持。這表明 COMT 音調影響習慣和重複行為迴路的調節，特別是在紋狀體和前額葉皮質。此觀察結果將 COMT 過度表現的行為表型擴展到認知和 impulsivity 之外。它與以強迫性和僵化行為模式為特徵的疾病有關。

label: increased impulsive behavior
description: COMT-OE mice show increased impulsive behavior, quantified as more premature responses in timed operant tasks, consistent with catecholaminergic perturbation of inhibitory control circuits in prefrontal and striatal regions. This mirrors impulsivity-related traits linked to fast COMT in humans, such as risk-taking and rapid decision-making under time pressure. The phenotype is reversible by manipulations that restore dopamine signaling, supporting causality rather than confounded effects. It extends the COMT-OE behavioral profile beyond cognition into impulse control.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased impulsive behavior，量化為定時操作任務中更多的過早反應，與前額葉和紋狀體區域抑制控制迴路的兒茶酚胺能擾動一致。這反映了與快速 COMT in humans 相關的 impulsivity 相關特徵，例如在時間壓力下承擔風險和快速決策。透過恢復多巴胺訊號傳導的操作，表型是可逆的，支持因果關係而不是混雜效應。它將 COMT-OE 行為特徵從認知擴展到衝動控制。

label: specific cognitive deficits
description: COMT-OE mice show specific cognitive deficits, particularly in stimulus-response learning and working memory, attributable to excess catecholamine clearance that reduces dopamine availability in prefrontal and striatal circuits. These deficits model the cognitive endophenotype associated with fast human COMT genotypes, providing a causal link between enzyme activity and cognition. The specificity, rather than global impairment, supports a circuit-level rather than generalized effect of COMT overexpression. Such models are central to translating COMT genetics into mechanistic understanding.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 specific cognitive deficits，特別是 stimulus-response learning 和工作記憶，這是由於兒茶酚胺清除過多，減少了前額葉和紋狀體迴路中多巴胺的可用性。這些缺陷模擬了與快速人類 COMT 基因型相關的認知內表型，提供了酶活性和認知之間的因果關係。 COMT 過度表現的特異性（而不是全局損傷）支持電路水平而非普遍效應。這些模型對於將 COMT 遺傳學轉化為機械理解至關重要。

label: Entacapone
description: Entacapone is a peripherally acting COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease to block the O-methylation of levodopa, prolonging its plasma half-life and brain availability. By inhibiting COMT, it raises levodopa and catecholamine levels, improving motor fluctuations and reducing off time. Unlike tolcapone, entacapone has minimal central nervous system penetration, which reduces the risk of hepatotoxicity. It exemplifies the therapeutic use of peripheral COMT blockade in dopaminergic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Entacapone 是一種外周作用的 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，阻斷左旋多巴的 O-甲基化，延長其血漿半衰期和 brain 的可用性。透過抑制 COMT，它可以提高左旋多巴和兒茶酚胺水平，改善運動波動並減少休息時間。與託卡朋不同，恩他卡朋具有最小的中樞神經系統滲透性，從而降低了肝毒性的風險。它例證了外周 COMT 阻斷在多巴胺能治療中的治療用途。

label: Green tea
description: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially the catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), which constitutes a major fraction of its antioxidant and bioactive content. EGCG is subsequently metabolized by COMT, linking green tea consumption to COMT-dependent pharmacokinetics, with slow genotypes clearing it more slowly. The high EGCG content is the basis for many of green tea's studied health effects, including antioxidant, metabolic, and neuroprotective actions. At dietary intake levels it does not significantly inhibit COMT in humans.
description_zh_TW: Green tea 富含多酚，尤其是兒茶素表沒食子兒茶素沒食子酸酯 (EGCG)，它構成了其抗氧化劑和生物活性成分的主要部分。 EGCG 隨後被 COMT 代謝，將綠茶攝取與 COMT 依賴性藥物動力學聯繫起來，而慢基因型清除它的速度更慢。 EGCG 的高含量是綠茶許多健康功效研究的基礎，包括抗氧化、代謝和神經保護作用。在飲食攝取量下，它不會顯著抑制 COMT in humans。

label: flavanone
description: Hesperidin is classified as a flavanone, a subclass of flavonoids characterized by a saturated C-ring and the absence of the catechol motif, distinguishing it from catechol flavonoids such as quercetin or luteolin. This structural class determines its metabolic fate and its lack of interaction with COMT, since it cannot serve as a substrate or inhibitor of the enzyme. Its glycosidic form is abundant in citrus peels and juices, where it contributes to antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity. The absence of vicinal hydroxyl groups is the key to its COMT neutrality.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 被歸類為 flavanone，是類黃酮的亞類，其特徵是具有飽和的 C 環且不存在兒茶酚基序，從而將其與槲皮素或木犀草素等兒茶酚類黃酮區分開來。這種結構類別決定了它的代謝命運以及它與 COMT 相互作用的缺乏，因為它不能充當酶的底物或抑制劑。它的糖苷形式在柑橘皮和果汁中含量豐富，有助於抗氧化和抗炎活性。鄰位羥基的缺失是其 COMT 中性的關鍵。

label: brain
description: MB-COMT (membrane-bound COMT) predominates in the brain, where its membrane-anchored localization near catechol release sites allows efficient perisynaptic O-methylation of dopamine and norepinephrine. This makes MB-COMT the major determinant of central COMT activity and of the genotype-dependent cognitive effects associated with Val158Met. Peripheral tissues instead rely more on the soluble S-COMT isoform, which has lower substrate affinity. This regional isoform distribution explains why COMT genotype affects brain and periphery differently.
description_zh_TW: MB-COMT（膜結合型 COMT）在 brain 中占主導地位，其在兒茶酚釋放位點附近的膜錨定定位允許多巴胺和 norepinephrine 進行有效的突觸周圍 O-甲基化。這使得 MB-COMT 成為中樞 COMT activity 以及與 Val158Met 相關的基因型依賴性認知效應的主要決定因素。相反，週邊組織更依賴可溶性 S-COMT 亞型，其底物親和力較低。這種區域亞型分佈解釋了為什麼 COMT genotype 對 brain 和周邊細胞的影響不同。

label: MTHFR variants
description: MTHFR genetic variants may influence susceptibility to Bipolar II Disorder through their effects on methyl donor availability and catecholamine-related epigenetic regulation, though associations are modest and inconsistent. Altered folate metabolism could perturb monoamine signaling relevant to mood cycling and hypomania, complementing COMT's role in catecholamine clearance. COMT and MTHFR are often studied jointly as candidate genes in bipolar genetics, reflecting shared effects on the methylation cycle. The combined contribution is small relative to the disorder's overall genetic architecture.
description_zh_TW: MTHFR 遺傳變異可能透過影響 methyl donor 的可用性和兒茶酚胺相關的表觀遺傳調控來影響對 Bipolar II Disorder 的易感性，儘管相關性有限且不一致。 folate 代謝的改變可能會擾亂與情緒週期和輕躁症相關的單胺訊號傳導，補充 COMT 在兒茶酚胺清除中的作用。 COMT 和 MTHFR 經常作為雙相遺傳學中的候選基因聯合研究，反映了對 methylation cycle 的共同影響。相對於該疾病的整體遺傳結構，綜合貢獻很小。

label: cofactor for COMT
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Magnesium is a required cofactor for COMT, with the enzyme's catalytic activity depending on divalent cations, magnesium prominently, to coordinate SAMe and the catechol substrate during methyl transfer. Magnesium deficiency can reduce COMT efficiency and impair catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetically slow COMT variants. Ensuring magnesium adequacy is a common recommendation for supporting healthy COMT activity in personalized protocols. It is a nutritional lever that directly affects enzyme catalysis.
description_zh_TW: Magnesium 是必需的 cofactor for COMT，該酶的催化活性取決於二價陽離子（主要是鎂），以在甲基轉移過程中協調 SAMe 和兒茶酚底物。 Magnesium 缺乏會降低 COMT 效率並損害兒茶酚胺清除率，加劇了遺傳性緩慢的 COMT variants 的影響。確保鎂充足是在個人化方案中支援健康 COMT activity 的常見建議。它是直接影響酵素催化作用的營養槓桿。

label: Opicapone
description: Opicapone is a third-generation, peripherally restricted COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease, with a long duration of action allowing once-daily dosing. By blocking COMT-mediated O-methylation of levodopa, it prolongs levodopa availability and reduces motor fluctuations and off time, improving motor symptom control. Its minimal brain penetration lowers the hepatotoxicity risk seen with tolcapone, and it is generally well tolerated. It represents the evolution of COMT inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in dopaminergic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Opicapone 是第三代外周限制性 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，作用持續時間長，允許每日一次給藥。透過阻斷 COMT 介導的左旋多巴 O-甲基化，它可以延長左旋多巴的有效性並減少運動波動和停頓時間，從而改善運動症狀控制。其最小的 brain 滲透降低了託卡朋的肝毒性風險，並且通常具有良好的耐受性。它代表了 COMT 抑製作為多巴胺能治療策略的演變。

label: COMT inhibitor supplements
description: Slow COMT individuals are sensitive to COMT inhibitor supplements, such as high-dose catechol flavonoids, because further reducing an already low COMT activity can excessively elevate catecholamines, risking adrenergic and mood side effects. Unlike fast individuals, they have little spare clearance capacity to absorb additional enzyme inhibition. This argues for caution with concentrated catechols such as quercetin, luteolin, and EGCG in slow genotypes. The sensitivity is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
description_zh_TW: 慢COMT個體對COMT inhibitor supplements敏感，例如高劑量兒茶酚黃酮類化合物，因為進一步減少已經存在的low COMT activity可能會過度升高catecholamines，從而存在腎上腺素能和情緒副作用的風險。與快速個體不同，它們幾乎沒有多餘的清除能力來吸收額外的酵素抑制。這表明在慢基因型中應謹慎使用濃縮兒茶酚，例如槲皮素、木犀草素和 EGCG。敏感性具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。

label: methylated vitamins
description: Slow COMT individuals are sensitive to methylated vitamins such as methylcobalamin and methylfolate because their reduced enzyme activity already leaves them with elevated catecholamine tone and a higher methyl burden, so additional methyl donors can push methylation beyond the optimal range and provoke mood effects. This sensitivity is the rationale for preferring non-methylated B12 forms and folinic acid in this group. The effect is dose- and genotype-dependent, with slow individuals reacting at lower doses. It is a core consideration in personalized supplementation.
description_zh_TW: 緩慢的 COMT 個體對 methylated vitamins（例如甲鈷胺和甲基葉酸）敏感，因為它們降低的酶活性已經使它們的兒茶酚胺張力升高和甲基負擔更高，因此額外的甲基供體可以將甲基化推到最佳範圍之外並引發情緒影響。這種敏感性是首選非甲基化 B12 形式和亞葉酸的基本原理。這種效應是劑量和基因型依賴性的，個體在較低劑量下反應較慢。這是個人化補充的核心考量。

label: EGCG more slowly
description: Slow COMT individuals metabolize EGCG more slowly because their reduced COMT activity delays O-methylation and excretion of this catechin, prolonging its plasma and tissue exposure. This altered pharmacokinetics can enhance both beneficial antioxidant effects and any inhibitory competition with endogenous catechols at the enzyme. Genotype thus modulates the dose-response of EGCG supplementation, with slow individuals potentially experiencing greater exposure. It is a clear example of COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition.
description_zh_TW: COMT 個體代謝 EGCG more slowly 較慢，因為 COMT activity 的減少會延遲兒茶素的 O-甲基化和排泄，延長其血漿和組織暴露時間。這種改變的藥物動力學可以增強有益的抗氧化作用以及與內源性兒茶酚在酵素上的任何抑制性競爭。因此，基因型調節 EGCG supplementation 的劑量反應，緩慢的個體可能會經歷更大的暴露。這是 COMT 依賴的多酚配置的明顯例子。

label: estrogen metabolite clearance
description: Slow COMT slows the clearance of certain estrogen metabolites, specifically catecholestrogens such as 2- and 4-hydroxyestrogens, because COMT O-methylation is the key detoxification step converting them to less genotoxic methoxyestrogens. Impaired clearance may increase exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones, a hypothesized risk factor for hormone-sensitive cancers. This links COMT genotype to estrogen-related disease susceptibility and to interactions with compounds like vitamin E. It is among the most clinically relevant consequences of slow COMT.
description_zh_TW: 緩慢的 COMT 會減慢某些雌激素代謝物的清除，特別是兒茶酚雌激素，如 2- 和 4- 羥基雌激素，因為 COMT O-甲基化是將它們轉化為遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素的關鍵解毒步驟。清除受損可能會增加活性兒茶酚雌激素醌的暴露，這是激素敏感癌症的假設危險因子。這將 COMT genotype 與雌激素相關疾病的易感性以及與維生素 E 等化合物的相互作用聯繫起來。這是緩慢的 COMT 與臨床最相關的後果之一。

label: COMT Val allele
description: The COMT Val allele is associated with increased schizophrenia risk in some populations, particularly through its effect on prefrontal dopamine signaling and possibly gene-environment interactions. Meta-analyses support a modest but significant association, which is stronger in certain ethnic groups and clinical subgroups, reflecting heterogeneity in genetic background. The biological rationale is that excessive dopamine catabolism in fast COMT may disrupt prefrontal networks implicated in the disorder, consistent with the dopamine hypothesis. The effect is small relative to the overall genetic architecture of schizophrenia.
description_zh_TW: COMT Val allele 與某些人群中精神分裂症風險增加有關，特別是透過其對前額多巴胺訊號傳導以及可能的基因-環境交互作用的影響。薈萃分析支持一種適度但顯著的關聯，這種關聯在某些種族群體和臨床亞組中更為強烈，反映了遺傳背景的異質性。生物學原理是，快速 COMT 中過多的多巴胺分解代謝可能會破壞與疾病有關的前額葉網絡，這與多巴胺假說一致。相對於精神分裂症的整體遺傳結構，這種影響很小。

label: chromosome 22q11.21
description: The COMT gene is located on chromosome 22 at band q11.21, a locus also associated with the 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, which presents with cardiac, craniofacial, and psychiatric features. Its genomic position places it within a region subject to copy-number variation that can affect COMT dosage and enzyme levels, with hemizygosity influencing catecholamine metabolism in deletion carriers. The well-characterized Val158Met polymorphism (rs4680) at this locus is among the most studied functional variants in neuropsychiatry and pharmacogenetics. The locus therefore links structural chromosomal variation to catecholamine physiology.
description_zh_TW: COMT 基因位於 22 號染色體 q11.21 條帶上，該位點也與 22q11.2 缺失症候群相關，該症候群表現為心臟、顱顏和精神特徵。它的基因組位置將其置於一個受拷貝數變異影響的區域內，該變異可以影響 COMT 劑量和酶水平，其半合性影響缺失載體中的兒茶酚胺代謝。該位點的充分錶徵的 Val158Met 多態性 (rs4680) 是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學中研究最多的功能變異之一。因此，該基因座將結構染色體變異與兒茶酚胺生理學連結起來。

label: Tolcapone
description: Tolcapone is a potent COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease, blocking peripheral and central O-methylation of levodopa to extend its half-life and brain penetration. Its central activity improves motor fluctuations but carries a risk of rare, sometimes fatal hepatotoxicity, requiring liver enzyme monitoring. It exemplifies the therapeutic use of COMT blockade in dopaminergic therapy. Its central penetration distinguishes it from peripherally restricted inhibitors such as entacapone and opicapone.
description_zh_TW: Tolcapone 是一種有效的 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，阻斷左旋多巴的周邊和中樞 O-甲基化，以延長其半衰期和 brain 滲透。其中樞活性可改善運動波動，但有罕見甚至致命的肝毒性風險，需要監測肝臟酵素。它例證了 COMT 阻斷劑在多巴胺能治療的治療用途。其中樞滲透使其有別於恩他卡朋和阿匹卡朋等周邊限制性抑制劑。

label: SAMe
description: SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine) is required by COMT as the methyl donor for all catechol O-methylation reactions, without which the enzyme cannot function. Generated from methionine by methionine adenosyltransferase, SAMe sits at the head of the methylation cycle that feeds COMT, linking folate, B12, and betaine metabolism to catechol clearance. Its availability is therefore the rate-limiting permissive factor for COMT activity. It is also the universal methyl donor for DNA, protein, and other methylation reactions.
description_zh_TW: SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine) 是 COMT 所必需的，與 methyl donor 一樣，用於所有兒茶酚 O-甲基化反應，沒有它該酶就無法發揮作用。 SAMe 由蛋氨酸透過蛋氨酸腺苷轉移酶產生，位於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 的頭部，將 folate、B12 和甜菜鹼代謝與兒茶酚清除聯繫起來。因此，它的可用性是 COMT activity 的速率限制許可因素。它也是用於 DNA、蛋白質和其他甲基化反應的通用 methyl donor。

label: Methyl donor supplements
description: Slow COMT individuals are sensitive to methyl donor supplements because their slower COMT clears methyl groups and catechols less efficiently, so supplemental methyl donors such as TMG, methylfolate, and methylB12 can raise SAMe and alter neurotransmitter methylation, producing irritability or anxiety. Managing dose and form is key in this subgroup, with low starting doses and non-methylated alternatives recommended. The sensitivity reflects the coupling between COMT activity and the methyl pool. It is a defining feature of the slow COMT supplementation profile.
description_zh_TW: 緩慢的 COMT 個體對 methyl donor supplements 敏感，因為其較慢的 COMT 清除 methyl groups 和兒茶酚的效率較低，因此補充甲基供體（如 TMG、甲基葉酸和甲基 B12）可以提高 SAMe 並改變神經傳導物質甲基化，產生煩躁或焦慮或焦慮。管理劑量和形式是該亞組的關鍵，建議使用低起始劑量和非甲基化替代品。靈敏度反映了 COMT activity 和甲基池之間的耦合。這是慢 COMT 補充配置檔的一個決定性特徵。

label: Antioxidant
description: Melatonin is described as a critical, mitochondria-targeted antioxidant whose endogenous production is maximized by ensuring complete darkness during sleep. Circadian alignment and sleep hygiene are presented as high-impact behaviors supporting the mitohormesis protocol, since deep sleep is when cellular repair and neural recovery occur. The document ties melatonin production to sleep quality, which in turn determines overnight HRV and recovery capacity, completing the loop between circadian biology, antioxidant defenses, and mitochondrial adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 褪黑激素被描述為一種關鍵的、以粒線體為標靶的抗氧化劑，其內源性生成可藉由確保睡眠期間完全黑暗而最大化。晝夜節律對齊與睡眠衛生被呈現為支持粒線體毒物興奮效應（mitohormesis）方案的高影響力行為，因為深度睡眠是細胞修復與神經恢復發生的時刻。該文件將褪黑激素生成與睡眠品質連結，而睡眠品質又決定整夜 HRV 與恢復能力，在晝夜節律生物學、抗氧化防禦與粒線體適應之間完成迴路。

label: Methionine
description: Methionine is the precursor of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAMe), the universal methyl donor used in methylation reactions throughout the body, including DNA and histone methylation. Dietary methionine deprivation may therefore impact physiology through changes in histone methylation resulting from decreased availability of methyl donors, providing a direct mechanistic link between dietary amino acid intake and the epigenome. Cells can preserve heterochromatic stability through upregulation of H3K9 methylation in the liver in response to methionine restriction. This methyl-donor pathway is a core mechanism by which methionine restriction recapitulates the benefits of protein restriction on metabolic health, frailty, and lifespan.
description_zh_TW: Methionine是S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAMe)的前體，SAMe是全身甲基化反應中使用的通用甲基供體，包括DNA和組蛋白甲基化。因此，飲食中methionine缺乏可能通過甲基供體可用性減少導致的組蛋白甲基化變化來影響生理功能，提供飲食氨基酸攝入與表觀基因組之間的直接機制聯繫。細胞可以通過在肝臟中上調H3K9甲基化來應對methionine限制，從而保持異染色質穩定性。這種甲基供體路徑是methionine限制重現蛋白質限制對代謝健康、虛弱和壽命益處的核心機制。

label: VEGFR2
description: At higher concentrations or after proteolytic processing, VEGF-C also engages VEGFR2 on blood vascular endothelium, supporting angiogenesis in addition to its lymphatic actions. This dual receptor usage broadens its angiogenic potential within the SASP and explains how VEGF-C can drive both blood- and lymphatic-vessel formation, depending on the local processing environment. The relationship is supported by receptor-binding and processing studies, and it positions processed VEGF-C as a shared ligand across the two receptor systems with distinct downstream signaling outputs.
description_zh_TW: 在較高濃度或經蛋白水解處理後，VEGF-C 也接合血血管內皮上的 VEGFR2，除淋巴作用外也支持血管生成。此雙重受體使用拓寬其在 SASP 內的血管生成潛力，並擴展其對組織血管化的貢獻。此靈活性意味 VEGF-C 依局部濃度與蛋白水解而橋接淋巴與血血管生成，使其成為分泌組中多功能的血管重塑因子。

label: Lymphangiogenesis
