description: Full-length VEGF-C preferentially activates VEGFR-3 and promotes lymphatic vessel sprouting, driving lymphangiogenesis. In senescence, this contributes to lymphatic remodeling and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes, shaping how immune cells access senescent tissue. The relationship is the canonical lymphangiogenic function of VEGF-C and expands the vascular consequences of the SASP beyond blood vessels. It is supported by studies of lymphatic development and tumor-associated lymphangiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 全長 VEGF-C 偏好活化 VEGFR-3 並促進淋巴管出芽，驅動淋巴生成。在衰老中，這貢獻淋巴重塑並可能影響免疫細胞遷移路徑，塑造免疫細胞如何接近衰老灶。其淋巴特異性角色補充 VEGF-A 的血血管生成，使 SASP 的血管效應具雙重性。它是連結細胞衰老到淋巴系統重塑的關鍵因子。

label: ATR
source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md
description: Stalled or collapsed replication forks generate single-stranded DNA gaps that engage the ATR-CHK1 cascade, activating a checkpoint that senses replication stress. In oncogene-induced senescence, ATR signaling contributes to arrest and senescence establishment by stabilizing p53 and enforcing cell-cycle exit. The relationship is a canonical DNA-damage-checkpoint response and links oncogene-driven hyper-replication to cell-cycle enforcement. ATR is considered the primary sensor of replication stress.
description_zh_TW: 停滯或崩塌的複製叉產生單股 DNA 缺口，接合 ATR-CHK1 級聯，活化感知複製壓力的檢查點。在致癌基因誘發衰老中，ATR 訊號貢獻停滯與衰老建立，與 ATM 並行運作。此活化將複製壓力直接耦合到細胞週期退出，確保過度複製的細胞進入持久停滯。它是 OIS 中 DDR 驅動生長停止的核心組成。

label: VEGF Family
description: VEGF-C is a member of the VEGF family of cysteine-knot growth factors, structurally related to VEGF-A but with distinct receptor usage and lymphatic specificity. Its classification situates it among the growth-factor arm of the SASP, and in senescence it is an early-induced angiogenic and lymphangiogenic factor. The family membership underpins its receptor interactions, particularly with VEGFR-3 and, after proteolytic processing, VEGFR-2. This dual receptor capacity distinguishes its vascular functions from other family members.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 是 VEGF 家族的胱胺酸結（cysteine-knot）生長因子成員，結構上與 VEGF-A 相關但具不同的受體使用與淋巴特異性。其分類將其置於 SASP 的生長因子臂，在衰老中它是連結分泌組到血管與淋巴管生成的因子。其與 VEGF-A 的關係反映 SASP 生長因子的多樣性，且其在促血管生成與淋巴生成間的雙重角色使其獨特。它是分泌組中較少被認識的組成。

label: VEGFR3
description: VEGF-C signals primarily through VEGFR-3 on lymphatic endothelium, promoting lymphangiogenesis and lymphatic vessel sprouting. This receptor usage distinguishes VEGF-C from VEGF-A's preferential VEGFR2 engagement and underlies its role in lymphatic remodeling around senescent tissue. In the SASP, VEGF-C-VEGFR3 signaling contributes to lymphatic vessel formation and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes. The relationship is a canonical VEGF-C function well established in lymphatic biology.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 主要透過淋巴內皮上的 VEGFR-3 訊號，促進淋巴生成與淋巴管出芽。此受體使用區分 VEGF-C 與 VEGF-A 偏好 VEGFR2 接合，並構成其淋巴重塑角色基礎，將 SASP 連結到淋巴血管系統。在衰老中，這可影響免疫細胞遷移路徑與組織液體穩態。它是 VEGF 家族受體特異性如何塑造分泌組血管效應的例證。

label: MitoQ
description: MitoQ reduces mitochondrial ROS as a mitochondria-targeted ubiquinone derivative that accumulates in the matrix and chain-breaks peroxyl radicals at their source. By concentrating antioxidant capacity inside mitochondria, it limits the downstream damage from leaked electrons. The directionality is targeted antioxidant to lowered mitochondrial oxidant burden. A caveat is that high doses of MitoQ can accumulate and potentially act as a pro-oxidant by virtue of its redox-cycling quinone structure. MitoQ has shown benefit in models of ischemia-reperfusion, neurodegeneration, and age-related vascular dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: MitoQ 將 mitochondrial ROS 還原為 mitochondria 靶向泛醌衍生物，該衍生物在基質中積累，並在其源頭斷鏈過氧自由基。透過將抗氧化能力集中在 mitochondria 內部，它限制了洩漏電子對下游的損害。方向性是靶向抗氧化劑以降低mitochondria1氧化劑負荷。需要注意的是，高劑量的 MitoQ 可能會積累，並可能因其氧化還原循環醌結構而充當促氧化劑。 MitoQ 在缺血再灌注、neurodegeneration 和年齡相關血管功能障礙模型中顯示出益處。

label: JNK Activation
description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for JNK activation downstream of TNFR1, representing an obligatory event in sustained JNK signaling that drives apoptosis and inflammation. The oxidants act as upstream amplifiers of the kinase cascade. The directionality is mtROS to JNK activation. A caveat is that JNK can also be activated by non-mitochondrial ROS and by MAPKKK upstream of mitochondria, so the requirement is context-dependent. Persistent JNK activation downstream of mitochondrial ROS promotes apoptosis and is implicated in stress-induced tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial ROS 是 TNFR1 的 JNK activation 下游所必需的，代表驅動 apoptosis 和發炎的持續 JNK 訊號傳導中的必然事件。氧化剂充当激酶级联的上游放大器。方向性是mtROS 到JNK activation。需要注意的是，JNK 也可以由非 mitochondrial ROS 和 mitochondria 上游的 MAPKKK 激活，因此該要求取決於上下文。 mitochondrial ROS 下游持續存在的 JNK activation 會促進 apoptosis，並參與壓力誘發的組織損傷。

label: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling
description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling, as mtROS promote removal of this negative feedback inhibitor, permitting full Smad2/3 activation. This embeds mitochondria within the TGF-beta pathway. The directionality is mtROS to loss of SMAD7 restraint. A caveat is that SMAD7 is also regulated by ubiquitination and other mechanisms, so ROS modulates rather than exclusively controls it. This places mitochondria as regulators of TGF-beta signaling strength and explains why mitochondrial antioxidants blunt fibrosis in some models.
description_zh_TW: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling 需要 Mitochondrial ROS，因為 mtROS 促進去除這種負回饋抑制劑，從而允許完全活化 Smad2/3。這將 mitochondria 嵌入到 TGF-beta 路徑中。方向性是 mtROS 到 SMAD7 失去約束。需要注意的是，SMAD7 也受到泛素化和其他機制的調節，因此 ROS 調節而不是專門控制它。這使得 mitochondria 成為 TGF-beta 訊號強度的調節器，並解釋了為什麼 mitochondrial antioxidants 在某些模型中會鈍化 fibros。

label: TNFR1 signaling
description: TNFR1 signaling generates mitochondrial ROS when TRAF2 recruits TRIM21, causing electron leak at Complex I and raising mtROS. These ROS then propagate the TNFR1 pro-inflammatory and pro-death program. The directionality is receptor signaling to mitochondrial oxidant production. A caveat is that TNFR1 also engages cytosolic NOX and other ROS sources, so mitochondria are one node in the oxidative response. This mitochondrial ROS signal contributes to necroptosis and inflammatory gene induction downstream of TNF-alpha, and can be suppressed by mitochondrial-targeted antioxidants.
description_zh_TW: 當 TRAF2 招募 TRIM21 時，TNFR1 signaling 產生 mitochondrial ROS，導致複合物 I 處的電子洩漏併升高 mtROS。然後，這些 ROS 傳播 TNFR1 促發炎和促死亡程序。方向性是針對mitochondria1氧化劑所產生的受體訊號傳導。需要注意的是，TNFR1 也參與胞質 NOX 和其他 ROS 來源，因此 mitochondria 是氧化反應中的一個節點。此mitochondrial ROS訊號有助於necroptosis和TNF-alpha下游的發炎基因誘導，並且可以被靶向mitochondria1的antioxidants抑制。

label: Cholesterol Homeostasis
description: ABCA1 regulates cholesterol homeostasis by mediating the efflux of cellular cholesterol and phospholipids to lipid-poor apolipoproteins such as apoA-I. This is the first step in reverse cholesterol transport and HDL biogenesis. The directionality is transporter activity to lipid export. A caveat is that ABCA1 also influences phospholipid trafficking and immune cell function, so its role extends beyond pure cholesterol handling. Loss of ABCA1 function underlies Tangier disease, and its deficiency in macrophages promotes foam-cell formation and accelerated atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 透過介導細胞 cholesterol 和磷脂質向脂質貧乏的 apolipoproteins（例如 apoA-I）的流出來調節 cholesterol homeostasis。這是reverse cholesterol transport和HDL生物發生的第一步。方向性是脂質輸出的轉運蛋白活性。需要注意的是，ABCA1 也影響磷脂運輸和免疫細胞功能，因此其作用超出了純粹的 cholesterol 處理範圍。 ABCA1 功能的喪失是 Tangier disease 的基礎，巨噬細胞中的 ABCA1 功能缺失會促進泡沫細胞的形成並加速 atherosclerosis。

label: Reverse Cholesterol Transport
description: LXRalpha promotes reverse cholesterol transport by upregulating ABCA1, ABCG1, ABCG5/ABCG8, and ApoE, which together mobilize cholesterol from peripheral cells to HDL and the liver. This is a central anti-atherogenic function. The directionality is receptor activation to cholesterol efflux. A caveat is that LXRalpha also induces lipogenic genes (SREBP-1c, FASN), so full activation can raise triglycerides, limiting therapeutic use. Pharmacological LXR activation replicates this program but is limited by concomitant lipogenesis, motivating development of isoform-selective and partial agonists.
description_zh_TW: LXRalpha 透過上調 ABCA1、ABCG1、ABCG5/ABCG8 和 ApoE 來促進 reverse cholesterol transport，這些因素共同將 cholesterol 從週邊細胞動員到 HDL 和肝臟。這是一種重要的抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是受體活化cholesterol 流出。需要注意的是，LXRalpha 也會誘導脂肪生成基因（SREBP-1c、FASN），因此完全活化會提高三酸甘油酯，從而限制治療用途。藥理學 LXR 活化複製了該程序，但受到伴隨的脂肪生成的限制，從而刺激異構體選擇性和部分激動劑的發展。

label: Inflammatory Gene Expression
description: LXRalpha suppresses inflammatory gene expression, as SUMOylated LXRalpha recruits corepressors such as NCoR to NF-kappaB target promoters, dampening cytokine responses. This links cholesterol sensing to immune moderation. The directionality is LXRalpha to transcriptional repression of inflammation. A caveat is that the anti-inflammatory effect is gene- and context-specific and can be overshadowed by pro-lipogenic actions at high activation. This transrepression is SUMO-dependent and independent of DNA binding, distinguishing it from classic LXR agonist responses.
description_zh_TW: LXRalpha 抑制 inflammatory gene expression，因為 SUMO 化的 LXRalpha 會將 NCoR 等輔阻遏物招募到 NF-kappaB 目標啟動子上，從而抑制細胞激素反應。這將 cholesterol 感測與免疫調節聯繫起來。 LXRα 的方向性是發炎轉錄抑制。需要注意的是，抗發炎作用是基因和環境特異性的，並且可能被高活化時的促脂肪生成作用所掩蓋。這種反式抑制是 SUMO 依賴性的並且獨立於 DNA 結合，使其與經典的 LXR 激動劑反應區分開來。

label: Oxysterols
description: Oxysterols regulate LXRalpha as endogenous ligands that activate the nuclear receptor and its target genes controlling cholesterol efflux and transport. This links sterol sensing to reverse cholesterol transport. The directionality is oxysterol to LXRalpha activation. A caveat is that oxysterol structure determines agonist versus antagonist activity at LXR, and some oxysterols also signal through other receptors. LXR activation in turn drives cholesterol efflux and limits inflammation, coupling oxysterol sensing to systemic lipid homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Oxysterols 將 LXRalpha 視為內源性配體調節，活化核受體及其控制 cholesterol 流出和轉運的目標基因。這將甾醇感測與 reverse cholesterol transport 聯繫起來。方向性是氧固醇對 LXRα 的活化。需要注意的是，氧甾醇結構決定了 LXR 的激動劑與拮抗劑活性，而一些 oxysterols 也透過其他受體發出訊號。 LXR 活化反過來驅動 cholesterol 外流並限制炎症，將氧甾醇感測與全身脂質穩態耦合。

label: Euchromatin
description: Histone acetylation promotes the formation of euchromatin, the open, transcriptionally permissive form of chromatin. Acetylation neutralizes the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, reducing their affinity for the negatively charged DNA backbone and loosening the nucleosome structure. This relaxed conformation allows transcription factors and RNA polymerase to access regulatory sequences, and acetylated lysines also serve as docking sites for bromodomain-containing reader proteins that further stimulate transcription.
description_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯化促進常染色質的形成，常染色質是開放的、轉錄允許的染色質形式。乙醯化會中和組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的正電荷，降低其與帶負電荷的 DNA 主鏈的親和力，並鬆開核小體結構。這種鬆弛的構象允許轉錄因子和 RNA 聚合酶存取調控序列，乙醯化離胺酸也可作為含溴結構域讀取蛋白的對接位點，進一步刺激轉錄。

label: ACLY
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: ACLY (ATP-citrate lyase) catalyzes the downstream conversion of mitochondria-derived citrate exported to the cytosol into acetyl-CoA, the principal substrate for cytosolic acetyl-CoA production and histone acetylation. ACLY expression is increased across multiple senescence models, and its silencing reduces both H3K27ac levels and SASP gene expression in irradiation-induced and replicative senescence. Conversely, citrate supplementation increases histone acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory gene expression in proliferating cells, confirming that increasing citrate availability is sufficient to drive the acetylation-dependent inflammatory programme.
description_zh_TW: ACLY（ATP-西妥環酶）催化由線粒體釋放至細胞質的檸檬酸下游轉化為乙酰-CoA，這是細胞質內乙酰-CoA的主要底物，以及組蛋白乙酰化。ACLY的表達在多個衰老模型中均增加，並且抑制其會降低H3K27ac的水平和輻射誘導和代數衰老引起的SASP基因表達。相反，檸檬酸補充會增加組蛋白乙酰化並誘導增生細胞中的促炎基因表達，這證實增加檸檬酸的供應足夠驅動乙酰化依賴的炎症程序。

label: IRAK1
description: Active IRAK4 phosphorylates IRAK1, which then recruits TRAF6 through its C-terminal TRAF6-binding motifs, extending the myddosome signaling complex. This step connects the receptor-proximal kinases to E3 ubiquitin ligase activity and TAK1 activation, ultimately driving NF-kB and MAPK signaling. In senescence, IRAK1 is required for full SASP establishment, linking the IL-1R pathway to the secretome. The relationship is a standard component of IL-1R/TLR signal propagation and is well validated biochemically.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 招募 IRAK1，其與 IRAK4 協作磷酸化並活化 TRAF6 以傳播 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊號。此步驟在 Myddosome 內組裝下游發炎級聯，將 IL-1R 感知連結到 SASP 基因轉錄。IRAK1 參與使其成為 MyD88 依賴衰老發炎中的功能性節點，且其在旁分泌衰老中的角色支持 MyD88—IRAK—TRAF6 軸的因果貢獻。它是慢性 SASP 輸出維持的組成。

label: IL-1R
description: IL-1R recruits MyD88 via TIR-TIR interactions, and MyD88 assembles the myddosome to propagate IL-1alpha/IL-1beta signals in senescent cells and responding macrophages. This transduction is essential for the NF-kB activation that drives SASP and paracrine arrest, and it requires the death-domain-mediated recruitment of IRAK kinases. The relationship positions MyD88 as the immediate downstream effector of IL-1R and is a canonical IL-1R signaling mechanism. Blocking this interaction can suppress IL-1-dependent inflammatory output.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 從 IL-1R 轉導訊號，在 IL-1alpha 或 IL-1beta 接合受體後招募 IRAK4 與 IRAK1 以活化 NF-κB。此轉導是 IL-1 介導旁分泌衰老與 SASP 放大所必需的，且連結頂層 SASP 放大器到下游轉錄。透過 MyD88 缺失阻斷此路徑可抑制衰老擴散，確認其在衰老溝通中的功能必要。它是 IL-1R 訊號至核心發炎輸出的確立橋樑。

label: Myddosome
description: MyD88 assembles into the helical oligomeric myddosome with IRAK4 and IRAK1/2, serving as the scaffolding platform that activates downstream kinases such as TAK1 and transcription factors such as NF-kB. This supramolecular complex is the mechanistic core of IL-1R/TLR signaling and is assembled through death-domain homotypic interactions. In senescence, myddosome formation underlies IL-1alpha-driven SASP, translating IL-1 receptor engagement into inflammatory transcription. The assembly is a defining structural feature of MyD88-dependent signaling and a validated drug target.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 與 IRAK4、IRAK1 及 TRAF6 組裝成稱為 Myddosome 的高階寡聚複合體，作為 IL-1R 與 TLR 下游訊號傳遞的平台。此支架將受體接合轉化為 NF-κB 與 MAPK 活化，驅動 SASP。Myddosome 形成整合 MyD88 的銜接功能與激酶級聯，使其成為衰老發炎輸出的分子引擎。其組裝是連結 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器到分泌組的關鍵步驟。

label: Adaptor Protein
description: MyD88 is a cytoplasmic adaptor protein serving as the central hub of Toll-like receptor (TLR) and IL-1R signaling, linking receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Its classification as an adaptor reflects its role in assembling signaling complexes rather than performing enzymatic catalysis, and it does so through death domain and TIR domain interactions. In senescence, MyD88 transduces IL-1alpha signals that sustain the SASP, placing it at the interface of innate immunity and senescence. It is a foundational innate immune signaling scaffold conserved across species.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 是一種銜接蛋白（adaptor protein），將先天免疫受體如 IL-1R 與 TLR 的胞質訊號域連結到下游 IRAK 激酶與 TRAF6。作為 Toll/IL-1R（TIR）訊號的主要轉接器，其歸類為銜接蛋白反映其在組裝訊號複合體中的支架角色。在衰老中，MyD88 是將 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器連結到 NF-κB 與 SASP 的核心節點。其銜接功能使其成為衰老發炎級聯的中央中樞。

label: IRAK4
description: MyD88 recruits IRAK4 via death-domain interactions, the first step in myddosome assembly after receptor engagement. IRAK4 then phosphorylates IRAK1/IRAK2, propagating the signal toward TRAF6 and TAK1 activation. This recruitment is a conserved early event in TLR/IL-1R pathways and is essential for downstream NF-kB and AP-1 signaling. In senescence it initiates the cascade that licenses SASP transcription, making IRAK4 a potential target for dampening IL-1-driven inflammation and the myddosome architecture ensures rapid, robust signal propagation.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 招募 IRAK4，IRAK4 是組裝 Myddosome 與啟動 IL-1R/TLR 下游 NF-κB 活化所必需的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶。此招募將受體訊號連結到 IRAK 級聯，並將 MyD88 置於衰老細胞 SASP 轉錄的促發炎訊號樞紐。作為 Myddosome 的組成，IRAK4 對 MyD88 依賴的發炎至為核心，且是潛在的藥理標靶以減弱衰老相關發炎。

label: Senescent Cells to Macrophages
description: Senescent-cell surface IL-1alpha engages IL-1R on macrophages, recruiting MyD88 to activate NF-kB and amplify SASP both in the sender cell through autocrine signaling and in recruited immune cells through paracrine signaling. This bridges the senescent cell and the macrophage through IL-1R/MyD88 signaling, propagating inflammation across the tissue. The relationship situates MyD88 at the interface of senescence and innate immunity and explains how local senescence ignites broader inflammatory responses. It is a key mechanism of SASP-driven immune amplification.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 橋接衰老細胞與巨噬細胞，使巨噬細胞中的 IL-1R 訊號感知源自衰老細胞的 IL-1alpha 並引發其對衰老細胞的發炎反應。此橋接將分泌組連結到免疫效應器，促進清除但也發炎，並使 MyD88 成為衰老—巨噬細胞交互作用的關鍵介體。透過將 SASP 轉化為巨噬細胞活化，MyD88 同時支持監視與潜在的 chronic inflammaging。其必要角色在 MyD88 缺失模型中顯示。

label: Nitric Oxide bioavailability
description: Genistein enhances nitric oxide bioavailability by upregulating eNOS expression and scavenging superoxide that would otherwise consume NO. The combined effect improves endothelial NO signaling. The directionality is isoflavone to increased bioavailable NO. A caveat is that genistein can also bind estrogen receptors, so part of its vascular benefit may be receptor-mediated rather than purely redox-based. Clinical studies report improved flow-mediated dilation after soy isoflavone intake, consistent with enhanced NO-dependent vasorelaxation in vivo.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 透過上調 eNOS 表現並清除超氧化物來增強 nitric oxide bioavailability，否則超氧化物會消耗 NO。綜合作用可改善內皮 NO 訊號傳導。異黃酮的方向性是增加生物可利用的一氧化氮。需要注意的是，genistein 還可以結合雌激素受體，因此其部分血管益處可能是受體介導的，而不是純粹基於氧化還原的。臨床研究報告稱，攝取大豆異黃酮後血流介導的擴張得到改善，這與體內 NO 依賴性血管舒張作用的增強一致。

label: Angiotensin II
description: NADPH oxidase is activated by angiotensin II via the AT1 receptor, which triggers assembly of NOX isoforms (especially NOX1) in vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells. This couples the renin-angiotensin system to vascular oxidative stress and hypertension. The directionality is hormone to enzyme activation. A caveat is that AT1 signaling also activates other ROS sources and inflammatory pathways, so NOX is a major but not sole mediator of angiotensin-II effects. Angiotensin-II-driven NOX activation is a well-established mechanism in hypertension, contributing to vascular remodeling and target-organ damage.
description_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase 被 angiotensin II 透過 AT1 受體激活，從而觸發血管平滑肌和內皮細胞中 NOX 同工型（尤其是 NOX1）的組裝。這將腎素-血管緊張素系統與血管 oxidative stress 和高血壓聯繫起來。方向性是荷爾蒙到酵素的活化。需要注意的是，AT1 訊號傳導也會活化其他 ROS 來源和發炎途徑，因此 NOX 是血管張力素 II 效應的主要但不是唯一的介質。血管張力素 II 驅動的 NOX 活化是高血壓的一種成熟機制，有助於血管重塑和目標器官損傷。

label: Pyridoxamine
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Pyridoxamine is a synthetic AGE inhibitor that prevents AGE accumulation by interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and acting as a carbonyl trap, similar to aminoguanidine. By scavenging carbonyl intermediates, pyridoxamine blocks the formation of advanced glycation end products and is considered a candidate for preventing glycation-mediated pathology. Unlike aminoguanidine, pyridoxamine (a vitamin B6 derivative) has a more favorable safety profile. AGE inhibitors and carbonyl-trapping agents remain an active area of research for reducing AGE burden in diabetes and aging.
description_zh_TW: Pyridoxamine 是一種 synthetic AGE inhibitor，透過與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並作為 carbonyl trap 來防止 AGE accumulation，類似於 aminoguanidine。透過 scavenging carbonyl intermediates，pyridoxamine 阻斷 advanced glycation end products 的形成，並被視為預防 glycation-mediated pathology 的 candidate。不同於 aminoguanidine，pyridoxamine（一種 vitamin B6 derivative）具有更有利的 safety profile。AGE inhibitors 與 carbonyl-trapping agents 仍是減少 diabetes 與 aging 中 AGE burden 的活躍研究領域。

label: Saturated Enzymatic Regime
description: For a network to produce a biphasic dose-response curve, the probability is highly increased if one of the bivalent interactions of the inhibited target operates in the saturated enzymatic regime, i.e., a Michaelis-Menten interaction with high affinity towards its substrate whose reaction speed does not depend on substrate amount. Specifically, the Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from Target to Input must be significantly low. Fixing K21 to a low value raises the percentage of hormetic parameter sets from about 6% to 80%, a roughly ten-fold increase in the probability of observing hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 若要讓網路產生雙相劑量反應曲線，若被抑制標靶的其中一個雙價交互作用運作於飽和酵素動力學區間——亦即對其受質具有高親和力、且反應速率不依賴受質濃度的Michaelis-Menten交互作用——則出現雙相曲線的機率會大幅提高。具體而言，從Target到Input之反向交互作用的Michaelis-Menten常數K21必須顯著偏低。將K21固定於低值，可使具毒物興奮效應（hormesis）的參數組比例從約6%提升至80%，觀察到毒物興奮效應的機率約增加十倍。

label: Michaelis-Menten Kinetics
description: The kinetic equations of the model are defined as three coupled ODEs where interactions between Input, Target and Output nodes are computed following a Michaelis-Menten approach of activation-deactivation. The Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from the Target to the Input node is the key parameter that distinguishes hormetic from monotonic responses, acting as an effective non-linear threshold that buffers the indirect pathway. The main limitation of this approach is that it implicitly assumes enzyme-substrate complex dissociation is basically instantaneous, which may not apply to all steps of a signaling pathway.
description_zh_TW: 模型的 kinetic equations 定義為三個 coupled ODEs，其中 Input、Target 和 Output 節點之間的交互作用按照 Michaelis-Menten 方法計算 activation-deactivation。Michaelis-Menten 常數 K21 是從 Target 到 Input 節點 backward interaction 的 key parameter，區分 hormetic 和 monotonic responses，作為 effective non-linear threshold 緩衝 indirect pathway。此方法的 main limitation 是它隱含假設 enzyme-substrate complex dissociation 基本上是 instantaneous，這可能不適用於 signaling pathway 的所有步驟。

label: Network Motif
description: The study screened 5346 possible three-node network topologies of a coarse-grained signaling cascade model using a high-throughput computational approach, with 5000 parameter sets and 30 inhibitor concentrations per topology. More than 500 topologies show clear non-monotonic dose-response curves, and hormesis is favored in networks with a high number of repressing interactions on average, with the highest fraction of hormetic parameter sets in a topology composed of four repressing interactions. The probability of hormesis increases as the network becomes more complex, indicating it depends on the density and complexity of the network.
description_zh_TW: 該研究以高通量計算方法篩檢了粗略顆粒化訊息傳導級聯模型的 5346 種可能三節點網路拓撲，每種拓撲使用 5000 組參數與 30 種抑制劑濃度。超過 500 種拓撲展現明確的非單調劑量反應曲線，且荷爾米希在平均抑制性交互作用數量較高的網路中更受青睞，其中由四條抑制性交互作用組成的拓撲擁有最高比例的荷爾米希參數組。荷爾米希的機率隨網路複雜度增加而上升，顯示其取決於網路的密度與複雜度。

label: Xenohormesis
description: Xenohormesis is the hypothesis that naturally occurring plant compounds - often synthesized when plants are under environmental stress such as drought - act as cross-species signaling molecules that induce a hormetic response when consumed by animals. These compounds are proposed to prepare the recipient organism for presumed worsening environmental conditions (famine for the animal, drought for the plant). This concept extends the hormesis framework to dietary phytochemicals and may help explain the medicinal value of certain plant-derived molecules.
description_zh_TW: 異源激素假說認為，天然存在的植物化合物——通常在植物遭受乾旱等環境壓力時合成——作為跨物種信號分子，當動物攝入時誘導 hormetic 反應。這些化合物被認為為接受生物體準備了預期的惡化環境條件（動物面臨飢荒，植物面臨乾旱）。此概念將 hormesis 框架擴展到飲食植物化學物質，可能有助於解釋某些植物來源分子的藥用價值。

label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
description_zh_TW: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A (CMT2A)，一種 peripheral neuropathy，直接由 mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2 的 heterozygous mutations 引起，MFN2 編碼外線粒體膜 GTPase mitofusin 2。MFN2 的突變或缺失減慢 axonal transport in both directions 並 impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves。MFN2 也通過與 mitochondrial Rho small GTPase 互動參與 mitochondrial transport，且 MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons 減少 dopamine nerve terminals 和 striatal dopamine levels。

label: Mitochondrial Quality Control
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control. Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units; through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components; and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated. The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population. Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control。Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units；through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components；and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated。The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population。Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage。

label: Mitochondrial DNA Mutations
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondrial fusion dilutes mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations by mixing the contents of healthy and damaged mitochondria, thereby enabling functional complementation between individual mitochondrial genomes. By exchanging mitochondrial DNA, proteins, lipids, and metabolites across a connected network, fusion allows a damaged genome to be complemented by the products of an intact genome. This content mixing is a principal functional rationale for the existence of the mitochondrial network and is experimentally demonstrated by the finding that fusion between a wild-type and a mutant mitochondrion restores oxidative phosphorylation function in heteroplasmic cells. Loss of fusion therefore accelerates the phenotypic manifestation of mtDNA mutations.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合透過混合健康和受損粒線體的內容物，稀釋粒線體 DNA（mtDNA）突變，從而實現個別粒線體基因體之間的功能互補。透過在互連網路中交換粒線體 DNA、蛋白質、脂質和代謝物，融合使得受損的基因體可由完整基因體的產物進行互補。這種內容混合是粒線體網路存在的主要功能原理，並透過實驗發現異質性細胞中野生型與突變粒線體的融合可恢復氧化磷酸化功能而得到證實。因此，融合的喪失會加速 mtDNA 突變的表型表現。

label: Guanylhydrazone
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM), historically known as S-Adchnon or adrenochrome guanylhydrazone, is formed by reacting adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine containing an indoline-5,6-dione core, with aminoguanidine, a nucleophilic hydrazine derivative. The reaction forms a stable guanylhydrazone linkage at one of the carbonyl groups of the dione structure. AMM therefore combines a redox-active indoline core with an established anti-glycation agent, providing a dual-action glyco-oxidative modulator designed to simultaneously target oxidative stress and protein crosslinking by advanced glycation end products.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM），歷史上稱為 S-Adchnon 或 adrenochrome guanylhydrazone，是由含 indoline-5,6-dione 核心的腎上腺素氧化產物 adrenochrome，與親核性肼衍生物 aminoguanidine 反應形成。該反應在二酮結構的其中一個羰基上形成穩定的 guanylhydrazone 連結。因此，AMM 將具氧化還原活性的 indoline 核心與既有的抗糖化劑結合，提供一種雙重作用的糖氧化調節劑，旨在同時標靶氧化壓力與晚期糖化終產物所引發的蛋白質交聯。

label: Prodrug
description: For adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine to act as an active AGE inhibitor despite its hydrazine group being locked in a hydrazone bond, it must either retain sufficient nucleophilicity through its remaining guanidine nitrogens, act as a prodrug that undergoes controlled in vivo hydrolysis to slowly release free aminoguanidine, or work via alternative pathways such as chelating transition metals that catalyze glycoxidation. The prodrug hypothesis is plausible because the conjugate is stable for clinical use yet could hydrolyze to release aminoguanidine over time. Whether the bound aminoguanidine retains dicarbonyl-scavenging activity remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 儘管 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 的肼基被鎖定在腙鍵中，要作為活性 AGE 抑制劑，它必須透過剩餘的胍氮保留足夠的親核性、作為前藥在體內經受控水解以緩慢釋出游離 aminoguanidine，或經由螯合催化糖氧化的過渡金屬等替代途徑作用。前藥假說是合理的，因為該共軛物在臨床上穩定可用，但隨時間可能水解釋出 aminoguanidine。被結合的 aminoguanidine 是否保留二羰基清除活性仍懸而未決。

label: Cathepsin B
description: Cathepsin B is a lysosomal cysteine protease that, together with cathepsin D, is a major enzyme responsible for breaking down AGE-modified proteins. Glycated proteins are directed to lysosomes for degradation, and these cathepsins ensure that proteins damaged by non-enzymatic glycation are cleared rather than allowed to accumulate. The activity of such lysosomal proteases declines with age and under UV exposure, which correlates with accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Maintaining lysosomal cathepsin function is therefore important for proteolytic clearance of glycated material and limiting AGE burden.
description_zh_TW: 組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B）是一種溶酶體半胱氨酸蛋白酶，與組織蛋白酶 D 一起是負責分解 AGE 修飾蛋白的主要酵素。糖化蛋白被導向溶酶體進行降解，而這些組織蛋白酶確保因非酵素性糖化而受損的蛋白質被清除而非堆積。此類溶酶體蛋白酶的活性隨年齡增長與紫外線暴露而下降，這與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，維持溶酶體組織蛋白酶功能對於糖化物質的蛋白水解清除與限制 AGE 負擔十分重要。

label: Arterial Stiffening
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a prominent advanced glycation end product formed from glycated proteins. There is a marked correlation between the serum concentration of CML and vessel stiffness in elderly individuals, reflecting the role of AGE accumulation and ECM cross-linking in arterial stiffening. CML also accumulates in heart tissue with age, and dietary CML-enriched protein induces functional arterial aging in a RAGE-dependent manner in mice. Serum CML is therefore used as a biomarker of glycation burden and age-related vascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是由 glycated proteins 形成的重要 advanced glycation end product。Elderly individuals 血清 CML concentration 與 vessel stiffness 之間存在顯著相關性，反映了 AGE accumulation 與 ECM cross-linking 在 arterial stiffening 中的作用。CML 也隨年齡堆積於 heart tissue，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。因此，血清 CML 被用作 glycation burden 與 age-related vascular pathology 的 biomarker。

label: Heart
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is an advanced glycation end product that increases with age in heart tissue. It is one of the most abundant AGEs and is also a biomarker of glycation burden, with serum CML correlating with vessel stiffness in elderly individuals. CML accumulation results from the non-enzymatic glycation of proteins by glucose and other carbonyls, and it contributes to the cross-linking and functional impairment of extracellular matrix proteins. Heart CML accumulation is part of the broader age-related AGE buildup that affects cardiovascular tissues.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是一種 advanced glycation end product，會隨年齡在 heart tissue 中增加。它是最豐富的 AGEs 之一，也是 glycation burden 的 biomarker，血清 CML 與 elderly individuals 的 vessel stiffness 相關。CML accumulation 源自 glucose 與其他 carbonyls 對蛋白質的非酵素 glycation，並促成 extracellular matrix proteins 的 cross-linking 與 functional impairment。Heart CML accumulation 是影響 cardiovascular tissues 的更廣泛 age-related AGE buildup 的一部分。

label: TFEB at S467
description: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, a C-terminal residue within the regulatory cluster that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor downstream of insulin and growth-factor signaling. By adding to the phosphorylation state of TFEB, Akt reinforces the anabolic, autophagy-suppressed state promoted by PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling. This modification complements mTORC1-mediated marks and integrates proliferative cues with repression of degradative transcription. The Akt-TFEB link embeds TFEB within the canonical survival signaling network.
description_zh_TW: Akt 在 serine 467 磷酸化 TFEB，此 C 端殘基位於調節簇內，在胰島素和生長因子信號下游促進該轉錄因子的細胞質保留。透過增加 TFEB 的磷酸化狀態，Akt 強化了 PI3K-Akt-mTOR 信號所促進的合成代謝、自噬受抑制狀態。此修飾補充了 mTORC1 介導的標記，並將增生線索與降解轉錄的抑制整合起來。Akt-TFEB 連結將 TFEB 嵌入典型的存活信號網絡中。

label: Chronic SASP
description: Chronic SASP, through IL-6 and IL-8 via JAK/STAT3, promotes cancer stem-cell traits and expands the CSC pool in neighbouring epithelial and tumour cells, enhancing tumour initiation and relapse potential. By driving stemness and survival, the persistent secretome fosters malignant progression and therapy resistance. The relationship is a key mechanism by which senescence can become tumor-promoting and is supported by cancer-stemness and senescence co-culture studies. It motivates the one-two punch strategy of senescence induction followed by senolytic clearance.
description_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 透過 IL-6 與 IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3 促進癌症幹細胞特性，並擴張鄰近上皮與腫瘤細胞中的 CSC 池，增強腫瘤起始與復發潛力。透過驅動幹性與存活，持續分泌組助長惡性進展並削弱治療。此促進將衰老與治療誘發衰老連結到腫瘤幹性，說明 SASP 在慢性脈絡中的雙重、促腫瘤面。它是年齡相關癌症的關鍵機制。

label: Drug Discovery
description: Drug discovery increasingly uses induced pluripotent stem cells as a renewable, patient-derived platform for high-throughput compound screening. Because iPSCs can be generated from individuals with specific genetic diseases and differentiated into disease-relevant cell types, they allow researchers to test drug candidates on cells carrying the actual disease mutation. This approach improves the translatability of preclinical findings, supports personalized medicine, and reduces reliance on animal models and fetal tissue for mechanistic drug studies.
description_zh_TW: 藥物發現越來越多地使用誘導多能幹細胞作為可再生的、源自患者的平台，用於高通量化合物篩選。由於 iPSC 可以從患有特定遺傳疾病的個體中產生，並分化為與疾病相關的細胞類型，因此研究人員可以利用它們在攜帶實際疾病突變的細胞上測試候選藥物。這種方法提高了臨床前研究結果的可轉化性，支持個人化醫療，並減少機械藥物研究對動物模型和胎兒組織的依賴。

label: Regenerative Medicine
description: Regenerative medicine uses induced pluripotent stem cells as a source of patient-matched cells for replacing damaged or lost tissue. Because iPSCs can be derived from a patient's own somatic cells and directed to differentiate into any cell type of the three germ layers, they offer the prospect of personalized grafts that avoid immune rejection. Clinical applications include iPSC-derived retinal pigment epithelium for macular degeneration, dopaminergic neurons for Parkinson's disease, and cardiac and neural cells for other degenerative conditions.
description_zh_TW: 再生醫學使用誘導多能幹細胞作為患者匹配細胞的來源，以取代受損或流失的組織。由於 iPSC 可以源自患者自身的體細胞，並可定向分化為三個胚層的任何細胞類型，因此它們為避免免疫排斥的個人化移植提供了前景。臨床應用包括用於治療黃斑部病變的 iPSC 衍生的視網膜色素上皮、用於治療帕金森氏症的多巴胺能神經元以及用於其他退化性疾病的心臟和神經細胞。

label: Shinya Yamanaka
description: Shinya Yamanaka and colleagues discovered induced pluripotent stem cells in 2006, showing that somatic fibroblasts could be reprogrammed to pluripotency by the four transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This landmark work, for which Yamanaka received the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012, demonstrated that cell identity is not fixed and could be reset by defined factors. iPSC technology opened new avenues for disease modeling, drug discovery, and patient-specific regenerative medicine.
description_zh_TW: Shinya Yamanaka 及其同事於 2006 年發現了誘導多能幹細胞，顯示體細胞纖維母細胞可以透過四種轉錄因子 Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc 重新編程為多能性。山中伸彌憑藉這項具有里程碑意義的工作獲得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎，它證明細胞身份不是固定的，可以透過確定的因素進行重置。 iPSC 技術為疾病建模、藥物發現和患者特異性再生醫學開闢了新途徑。

label: Neural Stem Cell
description: Sox2 maintains neural stem cells by preserving their self-renewal and multipotency, the ability to generate neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes. Sox2 is expressed in neural stem cells of the developing and adult brain, where it is a central determinant of neural identity and is often necessary and sometimes sufficient for direct neural conversion. In reprogramming to induced neural stem cells, forced expression of Sox2 remodels the somatic epigenome toward a neural fate. Sox2 is thus a linchpin connecting pluripotency regulation to neurogenesis and neural repair.
description_zh_TW: Sox2 透過保留神經幹細胞的自我更新和多能性、生成神經元、星狀膠質細胞和少突膠質細胞的能力來維持神經幹細胞。 Sox2 在發育中和成年 brain 的神經幹細胞中表達，它是神經身份的核心決定因素，對於直接神經轉換通常是必要的，有時是充分的。在對誘導神經幹細胞進行重編程時，Sox2 的強製表達將體細胞表觀基因組重塑為神經命運。因此，Sox2 是將多能性調節與神經生成和神經修復聯繫起來的關鍵。

label: Somatic Cells
description: The Yamanaka factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc, abbreviated OSKM) are a set of four transcription factors used to induce pluripotency in differentiated somatic cells. When introduced into fibroblasts or other somatic cells, they initiate a cascade of transcriptional and epigenetic changes that reset the cell toward an embryonic-stem-cell-like state, erasing somatic memory and installing the pluripotency network. This demonstration, pioneered by Shinya Yamanaka in 2006, established that cellular identity is not fixed but can be reprogrammed.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子（Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc，縮寫為 OSKM）是一組四個轉錄因子，用於誘導分化體細胞的多能性。當引入成纖維細胞或其他體細胞時，它們會啟動一系列轉錄和表觀遺傳學變化，將細胞重置為胚胎幹細胞樣狀態，消除體細胞記憶並安裝多能性網路。此演示由 Shinya Yamanaka 於 2006 年首創，證實細胞身份不是固定的，而是可以重新編程的。

label: OSKM
description: The Yamanaka factors are also known as the OSKM cassette, named after the initials of its four constituent transcription factors: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This quartet was identified by Shinya Yamanaka as sufficient to reprogram differentiated somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, a discovery that earned the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012. The OSKM designation is used throughout the reprogramming and rejuvenation literature, including in partial reprogramming protocols that express the factors transiently to reverse aging.
description_zh_TW: Yamanaka 因子也稱為 OSKM 盒，以其四個組成轉錄因子的縮寫命名：Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc。 Shinya Yamanaka 鑑定出這個四重體足以將分化的體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞，這一發現贏得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。 OSKM 名稱在整個重編程和復興文獻中使用，包括在短暫表達因子以逆轉衰老的部分重編程方案中。

label: Retinal Pigment Epithelium
description: The retinal pigment epithelium is a target for cell therapy using iPSC-derived RPE, which is being tested in clinical trials for age-related macular degeneration and Stargardt disease. iPSC-derived RPE cells are transplanted subretinally to replace dysfunctional RPE, restoring phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segments, the visual cycle, and the blood-retina barrier. Key release criteria for such grafts include polarized monolayer formation, phagocytic competence, and RPE65 expression, though immune rejection and graft integration remain challenges.
description_zh_TW: 視網膜色素上皮是使用 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 進行細胞治療的目標，該細胞療法正在針對老年黃斑部病變和 Stargardt 病的臨床試驗中進行測試。 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 細胞被移植到視網膜下以取代功能失調的 RPE，恢復感光器外節的吞噬作用、視覺週期和血液視網膜屏障。此類移植物的關鍵釋放標準包括極化單層形成、吞噬能力和 RPE65 表達，儘管免疫排斥和移植物整合仍然是挑戰。

label: Disease Modeling
description: Induced pluripotent stem cells enable disease modeling by providing an unlimited, patient-derived source of disease-relevant cells. Reprogramming fibroblasts from patients with genetic disorders and differentiating them into affected cell types recapitulates key disease phenotypes in vitro, such as TDP-43 mislocalization in frontotemporal dementia. These models enable mechanistic studies, drug screening, and personalized medicine while avoiding the ethical constraints of fetal tissue. The resulting models have become central platforms for studying both rare and common diseases.
description_zh_TW: 誘導多能幹細胞透過提供無限的、源自患者的疾病相關細胞來源來實現疾病建模。對患有遺傳性疾病的患者的成纖維細胞進行重編程並將其分化為受影響的細胞類型，可以在體外重現關鍵的疾病表型，例如額顳葉失智症中的 TDP-43 錯誤定位。這些模型可以進行機制研究、藥物篩選和個人化醫療，同時避免胎兒組織的倫理限制。由此產生的模型已成為研究罕見和常見疾病的中心平台。

label: Nanog
description: Cancer Stem Cells relates to Nanog through the relation express. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Nanog is a core pluripotency transcription factor re-expressed in cancer stem cells to sustain self-renewal. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 透過關係表達與 Nanog 相關。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 Nanog 是一個核心多能性轉錄因子，在 Cancer Stem Cells 中重新表達以維持自我更新。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: epigenetic information
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: Partial reprogramming (e.g., via Yamanaka factors) can reset epigenetic information, supporting the idea that aging is reversible at the information level. This connection to cellular reprogramming complements the RCM hypothesis, which frames aging as an epigenetic software problem rather than purely hardware (mutation) damage. Because epigenetic changes can potentially be reset, unlike permanent mutations, reprogramming-based approaches offer a route to restoring youthful gene expression patterns.
description_zh_TW: 部分重編程（例如透過 Yamanaka 因子）可以重置表觀遺傳資訊，支持了衰老在資訊層面可逆的觀點。這種與細胞重編程的關聯補充了 RCM 假說，該假說將衰老定位為表觀遺傳軟體問題，而非單純的硬體（突變）損傷。由於表觀遺傳變化不像永久性突變那樣無法逆轉，基於重編程的方法提供了恢復年輕基因表達模式的途徑。

label: mTOR, Rictor, mSIN1, Protor-1, mLST8, Deptor
description: mTOR complex 2 (mTORC2) comprises six core proteins: mTOR, Rictor (its defining scaffold), mSIN1 (required for mTORC2 integrity and Akt phosphorylation), Protor-1, mLST8, and the negative regulator Deptor. mTORC2 is best known for phosphorylating and activating Akt at Ser473 and for regulating cytoskeletal organization and cell survival. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2 is not acutely rapamycin-sensitive and is not directly recruited to lysosomes by Rag GTPases. Its distinct composition underlies its separate physiological roles in metabolism and actin dynamics.
description_zh_TW: mTOR 複合物 2（mTORC2）包含六個核心蛋白：mTOR、Rictor（其定義性支架）、mSIN1（mTORC2 完整性與 Akt 磷酸化所需）、Protor-1、mLST8，以及負向調節者 Deptor。mTORC2 最為人所知的是在 Ser473 磷酸化並活化 Akt，以及調節細胞骨架組織和細胞存活。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 不會被雷帕黴素急性抑制，也不會被 Rag GTPases 直接招募至溶酶體。其獨特組成奠定了其在代謝和肌動蛋白動力學中各自獨立的生理角色。

label: Akt at Ser473
description: mTORC2 phosphorylates Akt at serine 473 within its hydrophobic motif, a modification required for full Akt catalytic activation alongside PDK1-mediated phosphorylation at Thr308. Active Akt then drives survival, growth, and mTORC1 activation, establishing an mTORC2-to-Akt-to-mTORC1 signaling cascade. This relationship makes mTORC2 an upstream regulator of the same anabolic and autophagy-suppressing programs executed by mTORC1. mTORC2's role in Akt activation is central to its pro-survival and metabolic functions.
description_zh_TW: mTORC2 在其疏水性基序內的 serine 473 磷酸化 Akt，此修飾與 PDK1 在 Thr308 的磷酸化共同為 Akt 催化活化所需。活化態的 Akt 隨後驅動存活、生長和 mTORC1 活化，建立起 mTORC2 至 Akt 至 mTORC1 的信號級聯。此關係使 mTORC2 成為由 mTORC1 執行的同一合成代謝與自噬抑制程序的上游調節者。mTORC2 在 Akt 活化中的角色對其促存活與代謝功能至關重要。

label: Cytoskeletal organization
description: mTORC2 regulates actin cytoskeleton organization and cell migration through phosphorylation of PKCα and via effects on paxillin, RhoA, and Rac1 signaling. These outputs control cell polarity, stress-fiber formation, and the ability of cells to remodel their architecture during growth and movement. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2's roles are more closely tied to spatial organization and survival than to bulk nutrient sensing. Dysregulation of mTORC2-dependent cytoskeletal control contributes to cancer cell invasion and metastasis.
description_zh_TW: mTORC2 透過磷酸化 PKCα 以及經由對 paxillin、RhoA 和 Rac1 信號的效應，調節肌動蛋白細胞骨架組織和細胞遷移。這些輸出控制了細胞極性、應力纖維形成，以及細胞在生長和移動期間重塑其架構的能力。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 的角色更密切地與空間組織和存活相關，而非大規模的營養感知。mTORC2 依賴的細胞骨架控制失調促成癌細胞侵襲和轉移。

label: -CH3
description: A methyl group is a covalent substituent consisting of one carbon atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms (-CH3), the smallest alkyl group and the universal currency of biological methylation. It is transferred by methyltransferases such as COMT from donors like SAMe to acceptors including DNA, proteins, phospholipids, and catechol rings. Methyl group flux is central to epigenetic regulation, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. Its availability is governed by the folate and methionine cycles, linking diet to methylation capacity.
description_zh_TW: 甲基是一種共價取代基，由一個碳原子與三個氫原子鍵結 (-CH3) 組成，是最小的烷基，也是生物甲基化的通用貨幣。它透過甲基轉移酶（例如 COMT）從 SAMe 等供體轉移到包括 DNA、蛋白質、磷脂質和兒茶酚環在內的受體。甲基通量對於表觀遺傳調節、神經傳導物質失活和解毒至關重要。其可用性受 folate 和蛋氨酸循環控制，將飲食與甲基化能力聯繫起來。

label: serotonin to melatonin
description: Methylation converts the neurotransmitter serotonin into the hormone melatonin via N-acetyltransferase- and methyltransferase (ASMT/HIOMT)-catalyzed steps in the pineal gland, with the methyl group donated by SAMe. This reaction is the final biosynthetic step producing melatonin, which regulates circadian rhythm and sleep. The process exemplifies SAMe-dependent methylation outside the catechol system and links methyl donor status to sleep-wake physiology. It highlights the broad metabolic reach of the methylation cycle.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過松果體中的 N-乙醯轉移酶和甲基轉移酶 (ASMT/HIOMT) 催化步驟將神經傳導物質血清素轉化為褪黑激素，甲基基團由 SAMe 提供。此反應是產生褪黑激素的最後生物合成步驟，褪黑激素調節晝夜節律和睡眠。此過程例證了兒茶酚系統外 SAMe 依賴性甲基化，並將 methyl donor 狀態與睡眠-覺醒生理學連結起來。它凸顯了 methylation cycle 廣泛的代謝範圍。

label: Catechols via COMT
description: Methylation neutralizes catechols via COMT by transferring a methyl group from SAMe to the catechol hydroxyls, converting reactive catecholamines and xenobiotics into stable, less active O-methylated metabolites for excretion. This detoxification limits oxidative catechol quinone formation and protects tissues from catechol-derived damage. COMT is thus the central catalyst of this neutralizing methylation, and its activity determines the efficiency of catechol clearance. The reaction consumes one SAMe per catechol, linking detoxification to methyl budget.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過 COMT 中和兒茶酚，將甲基從 SAMe 轉移到兒茶酚羥基，將反應性 catecholamines 和異生物質轉化為穩定的、活性較低的 O-甲基化代謝物進行排泄。這種解毒作用限制了氧化兒茶酚醌的形成，並保護組織免受兒茶酚衍生的傷害。因此，COMT 是這種中和甲基化的中心催化劑，其活性決定了兒茶酚清除的效率。該反應每種兒茶酚消耗一個 SAMe，將解毒與甲基預算聯繫起來。

label: gene expression
description: Methylation regulates gene expression primarily through DNA methyltransferase-mediated addition of methyl groups to cytosine residues in CpG islands, typically repressing transcription and enabling cellular differentiation and genomic imprinting. It also modifies histones and transcription factors via SAMe-dependent reactions, forming an epigenetic regulatory layer responsive to environment and diet. Because SAMe is the universal donor, COMT activity and methyl donor availability indirectly influence the pool available for epigenetic regulation. This connection links catechol metabolism to broader gene regulation.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 主要透過 DNA 甲基轉移酶介導的 methyl groups 添加到 CpG 島的胞嘧啶殘基來調節 gene expression，通常抑制轉錄並實現細胞分化和基因組印記。它也透過 SAMe 依賴性反應修飾組蛋白和轉錄因子，形成對環境和飲食敏感的表觀遺傳調控層。由於 SAMe 是通用供體，COMT activity 和 methyl donor 的可用性間接影響可用於表觀遺傳調控的函式庫。這種關聯將兒茶酚代謝與更廣泛的基因調控聯繫起來。

label: Histone
description: A nucleosome, the fundamental repeating unit of chromatin, is composed of a histone octamer around which DNA is wrapped. The octamer contains two copies each of the core histones H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, and approximately 147 base pairs of DNA wind around this protein core in a left-handed superhelix. Nucleosomes package the genome into chromatin, and their positioning and modification regulate access to DNA for transcription, replication, and repair. Linker histone H1 associates with the DNA between nucleosomes and helps fold the fiber into higher-order structures.
description_zh_TW: 核小體是染色質的基本重複單位，由 DNA 包覆的組蛋白八聚體組成。此八聚體包含核心組蛋白 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各兩個拷貝，約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 以左手超螺旋纏繞在該蛋白質核心周圍。核小體將基因組包裝成染色質，它們的定位和修飾調節 DNA 的轉錄、複製和修復。連接組蛋白 H1 與核小體之間的 DNA 結合，幫助將纖維折疊成更高階的結構。

label: Enhancer-Promoter Looping
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Enhancer-promoter looping is regulated within topologically associating domains, the megabase-scale compartments in which DNA sequences interact more frequently with each other than with sequences outside. Because TADs confine enhancer-promoter contacts, genes are typically regulated by enhancers located within the same domain, and three-dimensional looping brings these regulatory elements into proximity with their target promoters. This organization allows the SASP to be driven by hyper-connected enhancer-promoter networks whose interactions are restructured during senescence.
description_zh_TW: 增強子-啟動子環在拓撲關聯域（兆鹼基級的區室）內受到調節，其中DNA序列彼此之間的相互作用比與外部序列之間的相互作用更頻繁。由於 TAD 限制了增強子-啟動子接觸，因此基因通常受到位於同一結構域內的增強子的調節，並且三維環使這些調節元件與其目標啟動子接近。這種組織允許 SASP 由超連接的增強子-啟動子網路驅動，其相互作用在老化過程中被重組。

label: Sirtuin activity (SIRT1, SIRT3)
description: 78c indirectly boosts SIRT1 and SIRT3 by maintaining NAD+ co-substrate availability, restoring their deacetylase function in aged tissue. Directionally, NAD+ preservation sits upstream of sirtuin reactivation. This is an indirect pan-sirtuin approach distinct from direct STACs, and it links CD38 pharmacology to longevity pathways. By preventing NAD+ consumption, 78c ensures that sirtuins have the co-substrate they require, effectively restoring the NAD+-dependent regulation that declines with age. This strategy is complementary to NAD+ precursor supplementation, and the two approaches are often combined.
description_zh_TW: 78c 透過維護 NAD+ 共同底物的可用性間接增強 SIRT1 和 SIRT3，恢復其在老年組織中的去乙醯酶功能。在方向性上，NAD+ 保存位於 sirtuin 重新活化的上游。這是與直接 STAC 不同的間接全 sirtuin 方法，將 CD38 藥理學與長壽途徑聯繫起來。透過防止 NAD+ 消耗，78c 確保 sirtuin 擁有所需的共同底物，有效恢復隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 依賴性調控。此策略與 NAD+ 前驅物補充互補，兩種方法經常結合使用。

label: CD38 (NAD+-glycohydrolase)
description: 78c is a highly potent, selective, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of CD38 NAD+-glycohydrolase activity. Directionally, 78c sits upstream of CD38 blockade. By stopping NAD+ consumption, it spares the co-substrate for sirtuins and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, and it is a leading age-reversal NAD+-preservation strategy. 78c's potency and oral bioavailability make it suitable for chronic in vivo studies, and its administration to aged mice restores NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity. These properties positioned 78c as the key pharmacological tool for validating CD38 as a longevity target.
description_zh_TW: 78c 是一種高效力、高選擇性、口服可利用的 CD38 NAD+ 糖水解酶活性小分子抑制劑。在方向性上，78c 位於 CD38 阻斷的上游。透過阻止 NAD+ 消耗，它節省了 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶的共同底物，是領先的衰老逆轉 NAD+ 保存策略。78c 的效力和口服可利用性使其適用於長期體內研究，其對老年小鼠的施用恢復了 NAD+ 水平和 sirtuin 活性。這些特性使 78c 成為驗證 CD38 作為長壽靶標的關鍵藥理學工具。

description: Administration of 78c to naturally aged male mice yields about a 14% lifespan extension, demonstrating in vivo geroprotective efficacy. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of prolonged lifespan. This effect is attributed to restored NAD+ and sirtuin function, and it validates CD38 as a longevity drug target. The lifespan benefit in naturally aged animals, rather than in accelerated-aging models, provides particularly strong evidence for translational relevance. 78c's efficacy, combined with its NAD+-sparing mechanism, established CD38 inhibition as a leading pharmacological strategy in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: 對自然衰老雄性小鼠施用 78c 可獲得約 14% 的壽命延長，展示了體內抗衰老療效。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於延長壽命的上游。此效應歸因於恢復的 NAD+ 和 sirtuin 功能，驗證了 CD38 作為長壽藥物靶標。在自然衰老動物（而非加速衰老模型）中的壽命益處提供了特別強的轉化相關性證據。78c 的療效結合其 NAD+ 節省機制，確立了 CD38 抑制作為老年科學中領先的藥理學策略。

label: NAD+ levels
description: By selectively inhibiting CD38, 78c prevents age-related NAD+ degradation, keeping cellular pools high in aged animals. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of preserved NAD+. Higher NAD+ then fuels sirtuin and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, reversing a hallmark of aging. Because CD38 expression rises with age, its inhibition becomes increasingly important for maintaining NAD+ homeostasis in older organisms. 78c's NAD+-preserving effect underlies its ability to restore sirtuin activity and extend lifespan, and it established the concept that pharmacologically limiting NAD+ consumption can counteract age-related decline.
description_zh_TW: 透過選擇性抑制 CD38，78c 防止年齡相關的 NAD+ 降解，在老年動物中保持較高的細胞 NAD+ 池。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於保存 NAD+ 的上游。較高的 NAD+ 隨後為 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶提供燃料，逆轉衰老的一個標誌。由於 CD38 表達隨年齡增長而升高，其抑制在維護老年機體的 NAD+ 恆定性方面變得越來越重要。78c 的 NAD+ 保存效應構成了其恢復 sirtuin 活性和延長壽命能力的基礎，並確立了藥理學限制 NAD+ 消耗可以對抗年齡相關退化的概念。

label: High-AGE diet
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: In a study of three groups of mice fed a caloric restriction (CR) diet, a regular diet, or a CR diet high in AGEs, CR mice lived longer than regular or CR-high mice, with median and maximal survival increased by 13.2% and 6%, respectively. Survival in CR-high mice was shorter than in regular-fed mice, and the CR-high group showed significantly increased oxidative stress and accelerated aging-related cardiovascular and renal disease. High dietary AGEs thus compete with the benefits of caloric restriction, indicating that the AGE content of the diet modulates lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 在一項針對三組小鼠的研究中，分別餵食熱量限制（CR）飲食、一般飲食或高 AGE 的 CR 飲食，CR 小鼠比一般或 CR-高 AGE 小鼠活得更久，中位與最大存活分別增加 13.2% 與 6%。CR-高 AGE 小鼠的存活短於一般飲食小鼠，且 CR-高 AGE 組顯示氧化壓力顯著增加與加速老化的心血管及腎臟疾病。因此，高飲食性 AGE 與熱量限制的好處相抗衡，顯示飲食的 AGE 含量會調節壽命。

label: NAD+/NADH redox imbalance
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The hallmark hyperglycemia of diabetes mellitus causes a redox imbalance between NAD+ and NADH that can lead to oxidative stress and a variety of metabolic syndromes. In cells whose glucose uptake is not insulin-dependent, glucose oversupply leads to NADH overproduction by both the conventional glucose combustion pathways (glycolysis and the Krebs cycle) and the polyol pathway. This NAD+/NADH imbalance, also known as pseudohypoxia, initially causes reductive stress and mitochondrial overload and dysfunction, which lead to oxidative stress and oxidative damage to DNA, lipids, and proteins. Additionally, PARP overactivation depletes NAD+, and this redox imbalance is a major factor contributing to the development of diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 糖尿病的標誌性高血糖造成 NAD+ 與 NADH 之間的氧化還原失衡，可能導致氧化壓力與多種代謝症候群。在葡萄糖攝取不依賴胰島素的細胞中，葡萄糖過量供給透過傳統的葡萄糖燃燒路徑（糖解作用與克氏循環）以及多元醇路徑導致 NADH 過度生成。這種 NAD+/NADH 失衡，亦稱為假性缺氧，最初造成還原壓力與粒線體超載及功能障礙，進而導致氧化壓力以及對 DNA、脂質與蛋白質的氧化損傷。此外，PARP 過度活化耗竭 NAD+，而此氧化還原失衡是促成糖尿病併發症發展的主要因素。

label: AGE inhibition
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: The inhibition of AGE formation and accumulation in tissues can lead to an increase in lifespan, as concluded from extensive evidence that AGE accumulation accompanies aging and age-related diseases. Because there are no enzymes to remove glycated products, AGEs accumulate as metabolic waste and contribute to tissue senescence. Inhibiting the glycation process and removing existing glycation products may prolong lifespan, and dietary herbal supplements or physiological exercise are advantageous in reducing the AGE burden in the body.
description_zh_TW: 抑制組織中 AGE 的形成與堆積可導致壽命延長，此結論源自大量證據顯示 AGE 堆積伴隨老化與老化相關疾病。由於體內缺乏可移除糖化產物的酵素，AGEs 便作為代謝廢物堆積並促進組織衰老。抑制糖化過程並清除既有的糖化產物或可延長壽命，而飲食草本補充劑或生理性運動則有利於減輕體內的 AGE 負擔。

label: H19
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md
description: H19 is a long non-coding RNA whose expression changes with age, and it functions to repress IGF-1 signaling. H19 associates with MBD1, a methyl-CpG-binding domain protein, to repress the expression of longevity genes including insulin-like growth factor 1, and loss of H19-dependent IGF-1 silencing may contribute to cellular senescence. Because IGF-1 signaling is a conserved regulator of the insulin/IGF-1 pathway that influences lifespan, the age-related deregulation of H19 has implications for both senescence and longevity.
description_zh_TW: H19 是一種長鏈非編碼 RNA，其表現隨年齡而變化，其功能是抑制 IGF-1 訊號傳導。 H19 與 MBD1（一種甲基 CpG 結合域蛋白）結合，抑制包括類胰島素生長因子 1 在內的長壽基因的表達，H19 依賴性 IGF-1 沉默的喪失可能導致細胞老化。由於 IGF-1 訊號傳導是影響壽命的胰島素/IGF-1 路徑的保守調節因子，因此 H19 與年齡相關的失調對老化和長壽都有影響。

label: TFEB at Ser142
description: CDK4/6 phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142, driving CRM1-dependent nuclear export and cytoplasmic sequestration during cell-cycle progression. This modification aligns TFEB repression with the biosynthetic demands of dividing cells, when autophagy is downregulated. Pharmacologic CDK4/6 inhibitors relieve this constraint, permitting TFEB nuclear accumulation and enhancing lysosome biogenesis and autophagic flux. The axis thereby couples cell-cycle machinery to the metabolic state of the cell.
description_zh_TW: CDK4/6 在 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，驅動 CRM1 依賴的核輸出以及在細胞週期進展期間的細胞質隔離。此修飾將 TFEB 抑制與分裂細胞的生物合成需求對齊，此時自噬被下調。藥理 CDK4/6 抑制劑解除此約束，允許 TFEB 核累積並增強溶酶體生物發生與自噬流。該軸因而將細胞週期機制與細胞的代謝狀態耦合。

label: Degradation center and signaling hub
description: The lysosome is the cell's terminal degradation center, containing acidic hydrolases that break down proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates delivered by endocytosis, phagocytosis, and autophagy. Beyond catabolism, lysosomes serve as signaling hubs that integrate nutrient and growth-factor inputs, most notably by hosting the activation of mTORC1 at their surface. This duality—as both waste-disposal organelle and metabolic command post—places lysosomes at the center of cellular homeostasis, development, and aging. Lysosomal dysfunction underlies a broad spectrum of storage and degenerative diseases.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體是細胞的終端降解中心，含有酸性水解酶，可分解經由胞吞作用、吞噬作用和自噬遞送的蛋白質、脂質、核酸和碳水化合物。除了分解代謝，溶酶體還作為整合營養和生長因子輸入的信號樞紐，最顯著者是在其表面主導 mTORC1 的活化。這種雙重性——既是廢物處理胞器也是代謝指揮站——使溶酶體位居細胞恆定性、發育與老化的中心。溶酶體功能失調是廣泛的儲存性和退化性疾病的基礎。

label: mTORC1 activation
description: The lysosome serves as the physical platform for mTORC1 activation, hosting the recruitment of mTORC1 via Rag GTPases and Ragulator and its encounter with the activator Rheb at the lysosomal surface. Amino-acid sensing, growth-factor inputs, and calcium signals all converge at this organelle to determine mTORC1 activity. By colocalizing mTORC1 with its upstream regulators, the lysosome functionally couples nutrient detection to the control of autophagy and anabolism. This spatial organization is essential for the rapid, reversible regulation of the pathway.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體作為 mTORC1 活化的物理平台，主導 mTORC1 經由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 的招募，以及其與溶酶體表面活化劑 Rheb 的相遇。胺基酸感知、生長因子輸入和鈣信號都在此胞器匯聚以決定 mTORC1 活性。透過將 mTORC1 與其上游調節者共定位，溶酶體在功能上將營養偵測耦合到自噬和合成代謝的控制。此空間組織對途徑快速、可逆的調節至為必要。

label: colon cancer cell proliferation, invasion, and migration
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In colon cancer, SIRT3 deficiency reduces cell proliferation, invasion, and migration while increasing apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of restrained colon cancer aggressiveness and enhanced cell death. SIRT3 could also be used as a marker for colon cancer. These findings indicate that SIRT3 supports the aggressive behaviour of colon cancer cells, and its inhibition may represent an anti-tumour strategy.
description_zh_TW: 在結腸癌中，SIRT3 缺乏可減少細胞增殖、侵襲和遷移，同時增加細胞凋亡。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 的缺失位於抑制結腸癌侵襲性和增強細胞死亡的上游。SIRT3 也可作為結腸癌的標記物。這些發現表明 SIRT3 支持結腸癌細胞的侵襲性行為，其抑制可能代表一種抗腫瘤策略。

label: Cell transformation
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: In mice and cultured cells, SIRT3 deficiency favors cell transformation in response to oncogenic Ras or Myc, and the same loss stabilizes HIF-1α with consequent induction of the glycolytic program of the Warburg effect. Because SIRT3 normally governs mitochondrial metabolism, ROS production, and genome stability, its absence releases a permissive environment for oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT3 acts upstream: reduced SIRT3 allows transformation and Warburg metabolism to proceed, defining its tumor-suppressive role in this context.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠和培養細胞中，SIRT3 缺乏有利於致癌性 Ras 或 Myc 引起的細胞轉化，且同一缺失穩定 HIF-1α 並導致 Warburg 效應的糖酵解程序誘導。由於 SIRT3 正常情況下掌控粒線體代謝、活性氧生成和基因組穩定性，其缺失釋放了一個允許致癌訊號和代謝重編程的環境。方向性上 SIRT3 位於上游：SIRT3 降低允許轉化和 Warburg 代謝進行，定義了其在此情境下的腫瘤抑制角色。

label: Lung fibrosis via TGF-β1
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 deficiency in the aging murine lung promotes a fibrotic response mediated by TGF-beta1 and augments mitochondrial DNA damage and apoptosis in alveolar epithelial cells. Conversely, SIRT3 overexpression can ameliorate asbestos-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Directionally, SIRT3 deficiency sits upstream of enhanced TGF-beta1-driven fibrosis, because by weakening mitochondrial antioxidant defenses it renders alveolar epithelial cells vulnerable to the damage that fuels the fibrotic program. Restoring SIRT3 could therefore protect against pulmonary fibrosis, making mitochondrial sirtuin activity an important determinant of lung resilience to environmental and aging-related fibrotic injury.
description_zh_TW: 老化小鼠肺部的SIRT3缺乏促進由TGF-beta1介導的纖維化反應，並增強肺泡上皮細胞的粒線體DNA損傷和凋亡。相反，SIRT3過表達可以改善石棉誘導的肺纖維化。方向上，SIRT3缺乏位於TGF-beta1驅動的纖維化增強的上游，因為透過削弱粒線體抗氧化防禦，它使肺泡上皮細胞容易受到推動纖維化程序的損傷。因此恢復SIRT3可能保護免受肺纖維化，使粒線體sirtuin活性成為肺部對環境和與年齡相關纖維化損傷韌性的重要決定因素。

label: Type 2 Diabetes
description: SIRT3 is consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, with deficiency correlating with insulin resistance and disturbed systemic energy homeostasis. In skeletal muscle, SIRT3 deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance and contributing to type 2 diabetes pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗和全身能量代謝失調相關。在骨骼肌中，SIRT3 缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重周邊胰島素阻抗並促進第 2 型糖尿病的病理生理學。

label: HRI
description: DELE1, previously identified as a poorly characterized mitochondrial protein from a yeast two-hybrid screen, was converged upon by two independent CRISPR-based screens as the mediator of mitochondrial stress signaling to the ISR. Under mitochondrial stress, the cleaved cytosolic fragment DELE1-S directly binds and activates the heme-regulated kinase HRI. Importantly, HRI activation by DELE1 was shown to be heme-independent, ruling out the classical heme-depletion mechanism. HRI activation in turn leads to eIF2alpha phosphorylation and downstream ATF4 induction, linking mitochondrial dysfunction to the integrated stress response.
description_zh_TW: DELE1 先前在酵母雙雜交篩選中被鑑定為一個特性不明的粒線體蛋白，而兩個獨立的 CRISPR 篩選共同指向它作為粒線體壓力訊號傳遞至 ISR 的媒介。在粒線體壓力下，被切割的細胞質片段 DELE1-S 直接結合並活化血基質調控激酶 HRI。重要的是，DELE1 對 HRI 的活化被證實與血基質無關，排除了經典的血基質耗竭機制。HRI 活化接著導致 eIF2alpha 磷酸化與下游 ATF4 誘導，將粒線體功能障礙與整合性壓力反應連結起來。

label: Dominant Optic Atrophy
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
description_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress
source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, one of the most overlooked molecules in modern medicine, is not a spectator.md
description: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Ubiquitin
description: Ubiquitin and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Ubiquitin and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Ubiquitin 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Ubiquitin 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Glucose metabolism
description: Resveratrol improves glucose metabolism and reduces LDL while elevating HDL, improving the lipid profile in metabolic models. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of better glycemic and lipoprotein control. These effects are largely SIRT1/AMPK-dependent, reflecting improved insulin sensitivity, reduced hepatic lipogenesis, and enhanced lipid oxidation. Human outcomes, however, are limited by resveratrol's poor bioavailability and short half-life, so translating these metabolic benefits to patients requires formulations that achieve effective plasma concentrations.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 改善葡萄糖代謝並降低 LDL 同時升高 HDL，改善代謝模型中的血脂特徵。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於改善血糖和脂蛋白控制的上游。這些效應主要依賴 SIRT1/AMPK，反映胰島素敏感性改善、肝臟脂肪生成減少和脂質氧化增強。然而，由於 resveratrol 生物利用度低且半衰期短，人體結果有限，因此要將這些代謝益處轉化為患者需要能達到有效血漿濃度的製劑。

label: TH17
description: IL-6, IL-1beta, and TGFbeta together drive naive T-cell differentiation toward the TH17 lineage, linking the SASP to adaptive immune reprogramming. TH17 cells recruited to senescent niches can amplify inflammation and promote autoimmunity-like responses. The relationship connects the secretome to a distinct effector T-cell subset with pro-inflammatory roles and is a well-established cytokine combination in TH17 biology. This illustrates how the SASP shapes not only innate but also adaptive immune responses.
description_zh_TW: IL-6、IL-1beta 與 TGFbeta 共同驅動初始 T 細胞朝 TH17 譜系分化，將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫重編程。被招募至衰老巢的 TH17 細胞可放大發炎並促進類自體免疫反應。此關係將分泌組連結到特定 T 細胞子集偏移，擴展 SASP 超越先天活化的免疫學後果。它是衰老與自體免疫樣發炎間的橋樑。

label: H3K27me3
description: H3K27me3 is a repressive histone modification that silences SASP genes when present at their loci. Depleting or inhibiting EZH2, the methyltransferase that deposits this mark, removes H3K27me3 from SASP gene loci and derepresses the SASP program, enabling expression of the inflammatory secretome. Thus the maintenance of H3K27me3 at SASP loci keeps the senescence-associated secretory phenotype in check until senescence entry triggers its removal. Understanding this repressive control is important for designing senomorphic drugs that limit harmful inflammation.
description_zh_TW: H3K27me3 是一種抑制性組蛋白修飾，當 SASP 基因存在於其位點時，它會沉默該基因。耗盡或抑制 EZH2（沉積此標記的甲基轉移酶），可以從 SASP 基因位點中去除 H3K27me3，並解除 SASP 程序的抑制，從而實現炎症分泌蛋白組的表達。因此，SASP 基因座上 H3K27me3 的維持使衰老相關的分泌表型保持在檢查狀態，直到衰老進入觸發其去除。了解這種抑制控制對於設計限制有害發炎的senomorphic藥物非常重要。

label: EZH2
description: EZH2 is the catalytic subunit of the Polycomb repressive complex 2 and the histone methyltransferase that deposits H3K27me3, a repressive mark that silences gene expression. Its depletion removes H3K27me3 from SASP loci, enabling derepression of SASP genes in multiple senescence models and in cancer immunotherapy contexts. Because EZH2-mediated silencing restrains the inflammatory secretome, EZH2 inhibition is proposed as a senomorphic strategy. Because EZH2 modulates inflammatory gene silencing, its activity is relevant to SASP regulation and to cancer immunotherapy responses.
description_zh_TW: EZH2 是 Polycomb 抑制複合物 2 和沈積 H3K27me3 的組蛋白甲基轉移酶的催化亞基，H3K27me3 是一種沉默 gene expression 的抑制標記。它的缺失將 H3K27me3 從 SASP 位點中移除，從而能夠在多種老化模型和癌症免疫治療背景下解除 SASP 基因的抑制。由於 EZH2 介導的沉默會抑制發炎分泌組，因此 EZH2 抑制被提議作為基因策略。由於 EZH2 調節發炎基因沉默，因此其活性與 SASP 調節和癌症免疫治療反應有關。

label: trastuzumab
description: Cancer is treated by trastuzumab. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against HER2 that inhibits signaling and recruits immune effector mechanisms in HER2-positive breast cancer. The directionality runs from trastuzumab toward Cancer, so trastuzumab is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 trastuzumab 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。曲妥珠單抗是一種針對 HER2 的單株抗體，可抑制訊號傳導並在 HER2 陽性 Breast Cancer 中招募免疫效應機制。方向性從 trastuzumab 向 Cancer，因此 trastuzumab 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: T Lymphocyte
description: Thymopoiesis is the process by which T cell development, maturation and induction of self-tolerance occur in the thymic epithelial space. Lymphoid progenitors enter the thymus at the cortico-medullary junction, migrate to the outer cortex for early development and TCR gene rearrangement and positive selection, then return to the medulla for negative selection before export to the periphery. Reduction of functional thymopoiesis with aging results in loss of TCR gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺生成是 T 細胞發育、成熟和自身耐受誘導在胸腺上皮空間中發生的過程。淋巴祖細胞在皮髓交界處進入胸腺，遷移至外皮質進行早期發育和 TCR 基因重排及陽性選擇，然後返回髓質進行陰性選擇，最後輸出至外周。隨著年齡增長，功能性胸腺生成的減弱導致 TCR 基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。

label: Osteoporosis
description: SIRT1 is protective in osteoporosis: SIRT1 knockout mice have low bone mass, SIRT1 increases osteoblast osteogenesis via FoxO3a, and it deacetylates sclerostin to promote Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Resveratrol restores alkaline phosphatase and osteocalcin via NF-kB. SIRT1 thus supports bone formation and opposes age-related bone loss.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨質疏鬆症中具保護性：SIRT1 基因敲除小鼠骨量低，SIRT1 透過 FoxO3a 增加造骨細胞成骨，且去乙醯化 sclerostin 以促進 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號。Resveratrol 透過 NF-kB 恢復鹼性磷酸酶與骨鈣素。SIRT1 因此支持骨形成並對抗年齡相關骨流失。

label: ChREBP
description: SIRT6 deacetylates ChREBP and SREBP-1c to suppress hepatic lipogenesis, and hepatocyte-specific SIRT6 knockout elevates fibrosis and oxidative stress in NASH mice. SIRT6 also antagonizes liver fibrosis by blocking hepatic stellate cell activation. These actions position SIRT6 as a protective metabolic regulator in NAFLD and NASH.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 ChREBP 與 SREBP-1c 以抑制肝臟脂生成，且肝細胞專一性 SIRT6 基因敲除在 NASH 小鼠中升高纖維化與氧化壓力。SIRT6 亦透過阻斷肝星狀細胞活化來對抗肝纖維化。這些作用將 SIRT6 定位為 NAFLD 與 NASH 中的保護性代謝調節因子。

label: PAI-1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: PAI-1 is transcriptionally repressed by SIRT6 through H3K9 deacetylation at its promoter (SIRT6 binding is a hallmark of PAI-1 downregulation), so PAI-1 elevation with age opposes SIRT6's anti-senescence and metabolic programs; Table 3 lists PAI-1 among negative regulators of SIRT6 (Van Meter et al., 2014).
description_zh_TW: PAI-1 的轉錄受 SIRT6 透過其啟動子 H3K9 去乙醯化所抑制（SIRT6 結合是 PAI-1 下調的標誌），因此 PAI-1 隨年齡升高會對抗 SIRT6 的抗衰老和代謝程序；表 3 將 PAI-1 列為 SIRT6 的負向調節因子（Van Meter et al., 2014）。

label: WRN
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates the Werner syndrome helicase WRN, linking SIRT1 to DNA repair and genomic stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 Werner 氏症候群解旋酶 WRN，將 SIRT1 與 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: stress responses
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is a central stress-response integrator that deacetylates p53, FOXO, NF-kB, and HIF to bias cells toward repair and survival, activates Nrf2 and antioxidant enzymes, and relocalizes to DNA-damage sites to support repair; these actions underpin SIRT1's stress resistance and longevity functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是一個核心的壓力反應整合因子，它去乙醯化 p53、FOXO、NF-kB 和 HIF，使細胞偏向修復和存活方向；活化 Nrf2 和抗氧化酶；並再定位至 DNA 損傷位點以支持修復；這些作用構成了 SIRT1 抗壓能力和長壽功能的基礎。

label: Lifespan extension
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 overexpression extends lifespan in male mice and is required for healthy aging, acting through DNA repair, metabolic regulation, and inflammation control; as with SIRT1, SIRT6 activity is NAD+-dependent and declines with age (Kanfi et al., 2012, Nature; source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過量表現可延長雄性小鼠的壽命，且是健康老化的必要條件，其作用機制涉及 DNA 修復、代謝調節和發炎控制；與 SIRT1 相似，SIRT6 的活性依賴 NAD+ 並隨年齡增長而下降（Kanfi et al., 2012, Nature; 來源文獻）。

label: H3K56
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K56 (Yang et al., 2009), a mark also touched by SIRT1; the node analysis flagged the missing direct SIRT6→H3K56 edge as a curation gap to fill in the next triples pass.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 H3K56（Yang et al., 2009），此標記亦受 SIRT1 作用；節點分析將缺失的 SIRT6→H3K56 直接邊標記為應補回的策展缺口。

label: FOXO3
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: FOXO3 is a positive regulator of the SIRT7 pathway: FOXO factors interact with SIRT7 to promote stress resistance, while SIRT7 deacetylates FOXO3 to prevent pro-apoptotic Ser574 phosphorylation, forming a mutual-activation loop (source review Table 3; SIRT7-FOXO3 cooperation).
description_zh_TW: FOXO3 是 SIRT7 途徑的正向調節因子：FOXO 因子與 SIRT7 互動以促進抗壓力能力，而 SIRT7 去乙醯化 FOXO3 以防止促凋亡的 Ser574 磷酸化，形成相互活化的迴路（來源文獻表 3; SIRT7-FOXO3 協同作用）。

label: HIF-2α
description: SIRT1 deacetylates HIF-2α, modulating its stability and transcriptional output to influence metabolic adaptation to hypoxia. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically tunes HIF-2α. This parallels SIRT1's regulation of HIF-1α, and the evidence carries moderate confidence reflecting less-complete characterization of this substrate. By modifying HIF-2α, SIRT1 may influence the balance between the two hypoxia-inducible factors and their distinct target genes. This regulation is relevant to oxygen sensing, erythropoiesis, and the metabolic adaptation of cells to low-oxygen environments.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 HIF-2α，調節其穩定性和轉錄輸出以影響對缺氧的代謝適應。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式調節 HIF-2α。這類似於 SIRT1 對 HIF-1α 的調控，但證據具有中等信心，反映了此底物的不完全表徵。透過修飾 HIF-2α，SIRT1 可能影響兩個缺氧誘導因子及其不同靶基因之間的平衡。此調控與氧氣感知、紅血球生成和細胞對低氧環境的代謝適應相關。

label: cognitive performance
description: COMT modulates cognitive performance through an inverted-U (or tonic-phasic) relationship in which intermediate dopamine levels in the prefrontal cortex optimize executive function, while both excessively high (slow COMT) and low (fast COMT) activity shift performance away from the optimum. Met-bearing (slow) genotypes favor stability and working memory under calm conditions, whereas Val-bearing (fast) genotypes favor rapid processing under stress. Thus COMT genotype is a major determinant of individual differences in cognition.
description_zh_TW: COMT 透過倒 U（或強直相位）關係調節 cognitive performance，其中前額葉皮質中的中間多巴胺水平優化 executive function，而過高（慢 COMT）和低（快 COMT）活動會使性能偏離最佳狀態。含有 Met 的（慢速）基因型有利於平靜條件下的穩定性和工作記憶，而含有 Val 的（快速）基因型則有利於在壓力下快速處理。因此，COMT genotype 是認知個體差異的主要決定因素。

label: Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin
description: Neuromelanin and Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuromelanin and Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 和 Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuromelanin 和 Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Monoamine oxidase B
description: MPP+ and Monoamine oxidase B are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically MPP+ and Monoamine oxidase B may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: MPP+ 和 Monoamine oxidase B 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，MPP+ 和 Monoamine oxidase B 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: E2F
description: Both the p53/p21 and p16/Rb axes converge on suppression of the E2F family of transcription factors, which are master regulators of genes required for DNA synthesis and S-phase progression. Hypophosphorylated Rb binds E2F and, together with SAHF-mediated heterochromatinization, represses E2F target loci; p21 additionally blocks CDK-mediated release of this repression.
