Inhibition of E2F is therefore the final common effector of the senescent growth arrest. This directed, downstream suppression is a defining mechanistic feature shared across senescent cell types.
description_zh_TW: p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 兩軸皆匯聚於抑制 E2F 轉錄因子家族，而 E2F 是 DNA 合成與 S 期進程所需基因的主要調節者。低磷酸化 Rb 結合 E2F，並與 SAHF 介導的異染色質化共同抑制 E2F 標的基因座；p21 進一步阻斷 CDK 介導的此抑制解除。因此抑制 E2F 是衰老生長停滯最終的共同效應器。此有向的下游抑制是所有衰老細胞類型共享的定義性機制特徵。

label: Lamin B1
description: Senescent cells characteristically show reduced expression of lamin B1 (encoded by LMNB1), a structural component of the nuclear lamina. Lamin B1 loss detaches lamina-associated domains (LADs) from the nuclear periphery, spatially reorganizing chromatin and contributing to the altered gene expression and genomic instability of senescence. This marker is relatively conserved across cell types and tissues, making it a practical histological and molecular signature of senescent cells in vivo. A caveat is that lamin B1 loss can also occur in certain differentiation and disease states, so it is best used in combination with other markers.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞具特徵性地展現 lamin B1（由 LMNB1 編碼）表現下降，lamin B1 是核核膜（nuclear lamina）的結構組成成分。lamin B1 的喪失使核膜相關區域（LADs）脫離核周邊，空間性地重組染色質，並導致衰老的基因表現改變與基因組不穩定。此標記在細胞類型與組織間相對保守，使其成為體內衰老細胞實用的組織學與分子特徵。需注意，lamin B1 喪失也可能發生於某些分化與疾病狀態，因此最好與其他標記合併使用。

label: HMGB2
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: HMGB2 is a chromatin-bound high mobility group box protein that protects SASP gene loci from silencing during oncogene-induced senescence. When chromatin-bound, HMGB2 binds to SASP gene loci and prevents the spread of repressive heterochromatin into them, keeping SASP genes out of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and thereby preserving their expression. Depletion of HMGB2 is associated with the derepression of SASP genes, and HMGB2 knockdown can prevent the emergence of SASP while leaving cell cycle arrest unaffected.
description_zh_TW: HMGB2 是一種染色質結合的高遷移率族盒蛋白，可保護 SASP 基因位點在癌基因誘導的衰老過程中免於沉默。當染色質結合時，HMGB2 與 SASP 基因位點結合，防止抑制性異染色質擴散到其中，使 SASP 基因遠離衰老相關的異染色質灶，從而保留其表達。 HMGB2 的耗盡與 SASP 基因的去抑制有關，HMGB2 敲低可以阻止 SASP 的出現，同時使細胞週期停滯不受影響。

label: Doxorubicin
description: Doxorubicin is a widely used anthracycline chemotherapeutic that induces therapy-induced senescence in cancer cells and normal fibroblasts. As a DNA-damaging agent, doxorubicin intercalates into DNA, poisons topoisomerase II, and generates reactive oxygen species, producing DNA damage that activates the p53-p21 axis and triggers permanent cell cycle arrest. The resulting senescent cells exhibit the SASP and persistent DNA damage signaling, which can contribute to both the therapeutic response and long-term side effects such as cardiac toxicity.
description_zh_TW: Doxorubicin 是一種廣泛使用的蒽環類化療藥物，可誘導癌細胞和正常纖維母細胞因治療而老化。作為 DNA 損傷劑，阿黴素會嵌入 DNA，毒害拓樸異構酶 II，並產生活性氧，產生 DNA 損傷，活化 p53-p21 軸並觸發永久性細胞週期停滯。由此產生的衰老細胞表現出 SASP 和持續的 DNA 損傷信號傳導，這可能有助於治療反應和長期副作用，例如心臟毒性。

label: Benzimidazole
description: Mebendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic in the same class as fenbendazole and albendazole.
description_zh_TW: Mebendazole是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，與芬苯達唑和阿苯達唑屬於同一類。

label: GLUT1
description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to GLUT1 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. GLUT1 is a high-capacity glucose transporter markedly upregulated on the tumor-cell surface to feed the glycolytic phenotype. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 GLUT1 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 GLUT1 是一種高容量葡萄糖轉運蛋白，在腫瘤細胞表面顯著上調以供給糖解表型。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: Hexokinase 2
description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Hexokinase 2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Hexokinase 2 is the glycolytic first-step enzyme most strongly induced in cancer, where it often tethers to mitochondria to couple glycolysis to survival. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 Hexokinase 2 與 Hexokinase 2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Hexokinase 2 是癌症中最強烈誘導的糖解第一步酶，它經常與粒線體結合，將糖解與生存結合。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: Microtubule
description: alpha/beta-tubulin heterodimers polymerize into microtubules, the dynamic polymers of the mitotic spindle and cytoskeleton.
description_zh_TW: α/β-微管蛋白異二聚體聚合成微管，即有絲分裂紡錘體和細胞骨架的動態聚合物。

label: muscle protein synthesis
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Accumulating evidence suggests that urolithin A may promote muscle protein synthesis and muscle growth through various pathways. It can increase the rate of protein synthesis within muscle cells while inhibiting protein degradation processes, allowing muscle cells to more effectively synthesize new proteins and maintain muscle mass. This anabolic action, combined with enhanced mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, supports muscle hypertrophy, the maintenance of muscle mass, and improved recovery after exercise.
description_zh_TW: 累積證據顯示 urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑促進肌肉蛋白合成與肌肉生長。它可提升肌肉細胞內蛋白質合成速率，同時抑制蛋白降解過程，使肌肉細胞能更有效地合成新蛋白並維持肌肉量。此合成代謝作用，結合增強的粒線體功能與能量代謝，支持肌肉肥大、肌肉量的維持，以及運動後更佳的恢復。

label: Quinones
description: Neuromelanin protects against Quinones by neutralizing, scavenging, or removing the threatening species or condition. Mechanistically, Neuromelanin acts as a sink or reductant that limits oxidative, toxic, or aggregate burden within catecholaminergic neurons. This protective role is significant because it may explain why pigmented neurons survive despite high metabolic stress, at least below a pathogenic threshold. A caveat is that the protection is conditional; under overload, redox perturbation, or iron release the same entity can contribute to damage rather than prevention.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 透過中和、清除或消除威脅物種或狀況來防禦 Quinones。從機制上講，Neuromelanin 充當水槽或還原劑，限制兒茶酚胺能神經元內的氧化、毒性或聚集負擔。這種保護作用很重要，因為它可以解釋為什麼色素神經元在高代謝壓力（至少低於致病閾值）下仍能存活。需要注意的是，這種保護是有條件的；在過載、氧化還原擾動或 iron 釋放同一實體的情況下，可能會造成損害而不是預防。

label: Epilepsy
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol and its structural analog magnolol have been evaluated as potential therapies for epilepsy and related seizure disorders. Intraperitoneal injections of honokiol or magnolol (1 and 5 mg/kg) increased seizure threshold in mice challenged with intravenous NMDA, with honokiol appearing more potent than magnolol. Honokiol also ameliorated the behavioral and neurotoxic impairments induced by NMDA injection into the cerebral ventricular system, showing augmented neuroprotection compared with tea polyphenol or memantine alone, supporting a role for honokiol in seizure prevention.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚及其結構類似物和厚朴酚已被評估為癲癇及相關發作疾病的潛在療法。腹腔注射厚朴酚或和厚朴酚（1 及 5 mg/kg）可提高靜脈注射 NMDA 挑戰小鼠的癲癇閾值，且厚朴酚的效力似乎優於和厚朴酚。厚朴酚也改善了腦室系統注射 NMDA 所誘發的行為與神經毒性損害，相較於單獨使用茶多酚或美金剛展現出增強的保護作用，支持厚朴酚在預防癲癇發作中的角色。

label: Blood
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is very unstable in the blood, which makes it difficult to measure and detect, and this instability is partially due to degradation of NR to nicotinamide (NAM), compromising its ability to reach peripheral tissues after oral administration. Despite this instability, the development of reliable methods for collection, processing, and measurement has enabled determination of the pharmacokinetic profile of orally administered NR, and the apparent oral bioavailability of a 1000 mg dose of NR is highly variable among individuals. The reduced form of NR, NRH, appears more stable than NR and does not undergo direct degradation in plasma.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）在血液中非常不穩定，使其難以測量與偵測，且此不穩定性部分源於 NR 降解為 nicotinamide（NAM，菸鹼醯胺），損害了其口服給藥後到達周邊組織的能力。儘管此不穩定性，可靠收集、處理與測量方法的發展已使得口服 NR 的藥物動力學特徵得以確定，且 1000 mg 劑量 NR 的表觀口服生體可用率在人與人之間差異極大。NR 的還原型 NRH 似乎比 NR 更穩定，且不會在血漿中發生直接降解。

label: Universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator
description: NMN is a direct NAD+ precursor that, once converted to NAD+, serves as a universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator by supplying the obligate co-substrate for all seven sirtuins. Directionally, NMN is converted to NAD+, which activates sirtuins. It raises NAD+ levels that decline with age, restoring sirtuin function systemically, and NMN repletion in mice reverses mitochondrial dysfunction and features of cellular senescence. NMN, together with NR, is a leading nutraceutical strategy to counteract age-related sirtuin attenuation, and its efficacy is enhanced when combined with agents that prevent NAD+ consumption, such as CD38 inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: NMN 是一種直接的 NAD+ 前體，一旦轉化為 NAD+，便通過為所有七種 sirtuin 提供必需的共同受質而充當通用的間接泛 sirtuin 活化因子。在方向性上，NMN 被轉化為 NAD+，NAD+ 活化 sirtuin。它提高隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 水平，恢復全身的 sirtuin 功能，小鼠中的 NMN 補充逆轉粒線體功能障礙和細胞衰老的特徵。NMN 與 NR 一起是對抗與年齡相關的 sirtuin 衰減的主要營養保健品策略，當與防止 NAD+ 消耗的藥劑（如 CD38 抑制劑）結合時，其功效增強。

label: Arterial aging
description: Spermidine reverses features of arterial aging, including large elastic artery stiffening, and restores nitric-oxide-mediated endothelial function in aged vessels. These vascular benefits are linked to spermidine-induced autophagy, which clears damaged mitochondria and reduces vascular oxidative stress and inflammation. By improving endothelial-dependent vasodilation, spermidine counteracts the stiffening that drives systolic hypertension and cardiovascular risk with age. The findings support spermidine as a candidate intervention for vascular rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: 精胺逆轉動脈老化的特徵，包括大彈性動脈僵硬化，並恢復老化血管中一氧化氮介導的內皮功能。這些血管益處與精胺誘發的自噬相關，後者清除受損粒線體並減少血管氧化壓力和發炎。透過改善內皮依賴性血管舒張，精胺抵消了隨年齡驅動收縮期高血壓和心血管風險的僵硬化。這些發現支持精胺作為血管回春的候選介入。

label: Transposable Elements
description: DNA methylation helps repress potentially harmful repetitive elements and retrotransposons within the genome. Methylation at the promoters and internal sequences of transposable elements such as LINE-1 and Alu elements maintains them in a transcriptionally silent state, preventing their mobilization and the genomic instability they would otherwise cause. Age-related loss of this methylation derepresses these elements, allowing their transcription and reverse transcription, which in turn triggers innate immune signaling and inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化有助於抑制基因組內潛在有害的重複元件和逆轉錄轉座子。 Methylation 位於轉座元件（例如 LINE-1 和 Alu 元件）的啟動子和內部序列上，使它們保持轉錄沉默狀態，防止它們的動員和否則會導致的基因組不穩定。與年齡相關的甲基化缺失會抑制這些元件，從而允許它們轉錄和逆轉錄，進而觸發先天免疫訊號傳導和發炎。

label: Inducible Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: Aminoguanidine (Pimagedine) is primarily known as a selective inhibitor of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), the enzyme responsible for producing high levels of nitric oxide during inflammation. By blocking iNOS, aminoguanidine prevents the overproduction of nitric oxide from the start of the inflammatory cascade, acting upstream of NO signaling. Because it selectively targets the inducible form rather than the healthy endothelial form (eNOS), it is considered a way to halt the inflammatory cascade without completely shutting down normal blood pressure regulation.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Pimagedine) 主要已知作為 inducible 硝酸 synthase (iNOS) 的選擇性抑制劑，該酶負責在發炎期間產生高濃度的硝酸鹽。通過阻斷 iNOS，氨基胍丁可以從發炎遞濫的開始處阻止硝酸鹽的過度產生，在 NO 訊號之前起作用。因為它選擇性地針對 inducible 形式而非健康內皮細胞形式 (eNOS)，因此被認為是停止發炎遞濫的方法，而無需完全關閉正常的血壓調節。

label: diabetic complications
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues and organs during diabetes and contribute to the pathogenesis of diabetic complications. AGE formation and accumulation in diabetic patients results in vascular alterations leading to diabetic vasculopathy, and glycation is implicated in diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications. Because the glycation reaction is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, poor glycemic control exacerbates AGE burden. AGE inhibitors such as aminoguanidine were shown to prevent diabetic complications by inhibiting AGE formation, supporting the causal role of glycation in diabetic pathology.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 在 diabetes 期間堆積於組織與器官，並促成 diabetic complications 的 pathogenesis。Diabetic patients 中 AGE formation 與 accumulation 導致 vascular alterations，引發 diabetic vasculopathy，而 glycation 涉及 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。由於 glycation reaction 受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，poor glycemic control 會加劇 AGE burden。Aminoguanidine 等 AGE inhibitors 已被證實能透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic complications，支持了 glycation 在 diabetic pathology 中的因果角色。

label: T Cell
description: Immunosenescence impairs T-cell immunity, featuring perturbed memory responses, thymic involution, reduced naive T-cell generation, and accumulation of differentiated, often dysfunctional memory and effector subsets such as EMRA CD8+ T cells. This limits responses to infection and vaccination in the elderly and weakens T-cell-mediated immune surveillance, including the clearance of senescent and premalignant cells. The impairment is a hallmark of adaptive immune aging. It directly contributes to the decline in senescence surveillance with age.
description_zh_TW: 免疫衰老損害 T 細胞免疫，特徵為記憶反應紊亂、胸腺退化、初始 T 細胞生成減少，以及分化、常功能障礙的記憶與效應子集（如 EMRA CD8+ T 細胞）累積。這限制老年人對感染與疫苗的回應，並削弱 T 細胞介導的免疫監視，包括清除衰老與癌前細胞。此損害是適應性免疫老化的特徵，直接促成隨年齡的衰老監視下降。

label: Integrins
description: FAK is activated by Integrins. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Integrins are transmembrane receptors that connect the extracellular matrix to the cytoskeleton and intracellular survival kinases. The directionality runs from Integrins toward FAK, so Integrins is the active agent and FAK the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: FAK 由 Integrins 活化。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。 Integrins 是將細胞外基質連接到細胞骨架和細胞內生存激酶的跨膜受體。方向性從 Integrins 朝向 FAK，因此 Integrins 是主動主體，FAK 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Glycemic Control
description: Regular physical exercise has beneficial effects on glycemic control, and because AGE formation is accelerated by hyperglycemia, improved glycemic control attenuates the formation and accumulation of AGEs in tissues. Exercise benefits diabetic patients by improving glycemic control, and physical activity reduces AGE accumulation in diabetic patients and during aging. The higher energy demands of exercise may also reduce the pool of reactive intermediates available for glycation. Together with its antioxidant effects, glycemic control is a major mechanism by which exercise reduces AGE burden.
description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動對血糖控制具有有益的效果，而由於高血糖會加速 AGE 的形成，改善血糖控制可減緩組織中 AGEs 的形成與堆積。運動透過改善血糖控制使糖尿病患者受益，且身體活動可減少糖尿病患者體內及老化過程中的 AGE 堆積。運動較高的能量需求也可能減少可用於糖化的反應性中間產物的庫存。結合其抗氧化作用，血糖控制是運動減輕 AGE 負擔的主要機制。

label: Total Daily Energy Expenditure
description: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

label: miR-34a
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: The 3'UTR of the SIRT1 transcript contains a miR-34a-responsive element; active miR-34a represses SIRT1 translation. Directionally, miR-34a sits upstream to lower SIRT1 protein. Because SIRT1 deacetylates and inhibits p53, this repression is part of a negative feedback loop that helps explain the drop in SIRT1 observed during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 轉錄本的 3'UTR 包含一個 miR-34a 響應元件；活性 miR-34a 抑制 SIRT1 的翻譯。方向性上 miR-34a 位於上游以降低 SIRT1 蛋白水平。由於 SIRT1 去乙醯化並抑制 p53，這種抑制是負回饋迴路的一部分，有助於解釋在衰老過程中觀察到的 SIRT1 下降。

source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md
description: SIRT1 deacetylates the scaffold protein 14-3-3ζ (lysine 49), identified by a biotin-switch proteomics screen for cytoplasmic SIRT1 substrates. Deacetylated 14-3-3ζ maintains its phosphorylation-dependent binding to caspase-2, shielding caspase-2 Ser135 (phosphorylated by CaMKII) from dephosphorylation. When SIRT1 activity drops, 14-3-3ζ becomes acetylated and dissociates from caspase-2, allowing the apical caspase to activate. This is the first demonstration of cytoplasmic 14-3-3 acetylation as a death-regulatory modification.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化支架蛋白 14-3-3ζ（離胺酸 49），此為針對細胞質 SIRT1 受質之 biotin-switch 蛋白質體學篩選的發現。去乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 維持其與 caspase-2 之磷酸化依賴性結合，保護 Caspase-2 Ser135（由 CaMKII 磷酸化）不被去磷酸化。當 SIRT1 活性下降時，14-3-3ζ 被乙醯化並與 caspase-2 解離，使這個頂端 caspase 得以活化。這是首次證明細胞質 14-3-3 乙醯化具有死亡調控功能。

label: Common Pathway
description: Apoptosis converges at Common Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The common execution phase of apoptosis is the point at which all initiation routes converge on effector caspases that proteolyze the cellular proteome. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Common Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 收斂於 Common Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的共同執行階段是所有起始途徑匯聚到效應器半胱天冬酶上的點，該效應器半胱天冬酶對細胞蛋白質組進行蛋白質分解。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Common Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: SHP1
description: Extrinsic Pathway is restored by SHP1. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. SHP1 is a protein tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and reactivates caspase-8, restoring death-receptor-induced apoptosis. The directionality runs from SHP1 toward Extrinsic Pathway, so SHP1 is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Extrinsic Pathway 由 SHP1 恢復。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 SHP1 是一種蛋白質酪胺酸磷酸酶，可去磷酸化並重新活化 caspase-8，恢復死亡受體誘導的細胞凋亡。方向性從 SHP1 朝向 Extrinsic Pathway，因此 SHP1 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Lamivudine
description: Lamivudine (3TC), a nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor, suppresses the SASP by inhibiting LINE-1 (L1) reverse transcription, thereby reducing cytosolic retroelement cDNA that would activate cGAS-STING-NF-kB signaling. This repurposes an antiretroviral agent as a senomorphic that targets the retrotransposon arm of SASP induction, complementing drugs that act on transcription factors or chromatin. The mechanism is supported by studies showing reduced SASP upon LINE-1 inhibition and is consistent with the finding that RB1 and SIRT6 normally restrain L1 activity. Clinical relevance is still investigative, keeping confidence moderate.
description_zh_TW: Lamivudine（3TC）是一種核苷逆轉錄酶抑制劑，透過抑制 LINE-1（L1）逆轉錄、從而減少會活化 cGAS-STING-NF-κB 訊號的胞質逆轉錄元件 cDNA，抑制 SASP。這將一種抗反轉錄病毒藥劑重新定位為標靶 SASP 誘發的逆轉錄元件臂的 senomorphic，補充作用於轉錄因子或染色質的藥物。此機制獲 L1 抑制後 SASP 降低的研究支持，並與 RB1 和 SIRT6 通常抑制 L1 活性的發現一致。臨床相關性仍屬探索中，信度中等。

label: Redox Cycling
description: Adrenochrome is not merely a passive end-product of adrenaline oxidation; it actively participates in redox cycling that amplifies oxidative stress. It accepts one electron from reducing agents or enzymes to form the adrenochrome semiquinone radical, which then donates its unpaired electron to molecular oxygen, regenerating adrenochrome and producing superoxide anion. Because newly generated superoxide can oxidize more adrenaline to adrenochrome, the cycle repeats without net consumption of adrenochrome, which acts catalytically. This cycling also consumes oxygen and produces hydrogen peroxide, and it has been directly demonstrated in submitochondrial particles using ESR spectroscopy and pulse radiolysis, explaining part of adrenochrome's cardiotoxic and neurodegenerative potential.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 不僅是 adrenaline 氧化的被動終產物；它主動參與放大氧化壓力的氧化還原循環。它從還原劑或酶接受一個電子形成 adrenochrome 半醌自由基，隨後將其未配對電子捐給分子氧，再生 adrenochrome 並產生超氧陰離子。由於新生成的超氧陰離子可氧化更多 adrenaline 為 adrenochrome，此循環在無 adrenochrome 淨消耗下重複，發揮催化作用。此循環也消耗氧氣並產生過氧化氫，且已在亞粒線體顆粒中透過 ESR 光譜與脈衝輻解直接證實，解釋了 adrenochrome 部分的心臟毒性與神經退化潛力。

label: Adrenolutin
description: Adrenochrome is unstable and undergoes further conversion to adrenolutin, particularly under alkaline conditions, as well as to semiquinone radicals and melanin-like polymers. These downstream transformations occur both in vitro and in vivo and contribute to the difficulty of detecting adrenochrome directly at significant levels in healthy tissues. Adrenolutin and other adrenochrome-derived products are among the oxidized metabolites implicated in oxidative stress and pigment accumulation, and adrenochrome can also participate in redox cycling to generate superoxide before or alongside these conversions.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 不穩定，會進一步轉化為 adrenolutin，尤其在鹼性條件下，也會轉化為 semiquinone radicals 與 melanin-like polymers。這些 downstream transformations 在體外與體內都會發生，並導致難以在健康組織中直接偵測到顯著水平的 adrenochrome。Adrenolutin 與其他 adrenochrome-derived products 是涉及 oxidative stress 與色素堆積的 oxidized metabolites 之一，且 adrenochrome 也可在這些轉化之前或同時參與 redox cycling 以產生 superoxide。

label: MFF
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: MFF (mitochondrial fission factor) is an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor protein that recruits DRP1 to the mitochondria to initiate fission. Its role is relatively simple: MFF overexpression enhances mitochondrial fragmentation, whereas low MFF expression inhibits DRP1 anchoring to the mitochondria and results in elongated mitochondria. MFF physically interacts with the MID proteins within a DRP1 complex, and MFF appears uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission, whereas FIS1 is involved in asymmetrical fission. MFF is upregulated in heart failure and pulmonary diseases where excessive fission predominates.
description_zh_TW: MFF（線粒體分裂因子）是一種外線粒體膜接頭蛋白，可招募 DRP1 到線粒體以啟動分裂。其作用相對簡單：MFF 過表達增強線粒體 fragment，而低 MFF 表達抑制 DRP1 錨定到線粒體，導致線粒體 elongated。MFF 與 DRP1 複合體中的 MID 蛋白 physically interacts，且 MFF 似乎 uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission，而 FIS1 參與 asymmetrical fission。MFF 在 heart failure 和 pulmonary diseases 中 upregulated，其中 excessive fission predominates。

label: Norepinephrine
description: COMT metabolizes norepinephrine by O-methylating the catechol ring to form normetanephrine, a reaction that terminates noradrenergic signaling, especially in tissues and brain regions lacking high norepinephrine transporter density. This inactivation complements NET-mediated reuptake and monoamine oxidase action, and is important in vascular, hepatic, renal, and central noradrenergic regulation. Because norepinephrine is a direct catechol substrate, impaired COMT activity or inhibition elevates norepinephrine levels alongside other catecholamines. This underlies increases in sympathetic tone and arousal when COMT is genetically slow or pharmacologically blocked.
description_zh_TW: COMT 透過鄰苯二酚環 O 甲基化形成去甲腎上腺素代謝 norepinephrine，該反應終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導，特別是在缺乏高 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白密度的組織和 brain 區域。這種失活補充了 NET 介導的再攝取和單胺氧化酶的作用，並且在血管、肝、腎和中樞去甲腎上腺素能調節中很重要。由於 norepinephrine 是直接兒茶酚底物，因此受損的 COMT activity 或抑製作用會升高 norepinephrine 水平以及其他 catecholamines 水平。這是當 COMT 基因緩慢或藥理學阻斷時交感神經張力和興奮增加的基礎。

label: executive function
description: The prefrontal cortex controls executive function, encompassing planning, decision-making, inhibition, and cognitive flexibility, through its extensive reciprocal connections with posterior cortex, striatum, and thalamus. Its operations depend critically on an optimal, COMT-genotype-sensitive level of dopamine, with both excess and deficiency degrading performance. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that governs these high-level functions. Dysregulation of prefrontal dopamine is implicated in numerous psychiatric and cognitive disorders.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過與後皮質、紋狀體和丘腦的廣泛相互連結來控制 executive function，包括計畫、決策、抑制和認知靈活性。其運作關鍵取決於 COMT 基因型敏感的最佳多巴胺水平，過量和缺乏都會降低表現。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了控制這些高階功能的多巴胺基調。前額葉多巴胺的失調與許多精神和認知障礙有關。

label: Mevalonate pathway
description: The substrate for FSP1 — ubiquinone/CoQ10 — is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Perturbations that suppress mevalonate output toward cholesterol (e.g., statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) starve FSP1 of its ubiquinone substrate, collapsing the FSP1 axis and predicting ferroptosis sensitivity. This makes the mevalonate pathway intersect ferroptosis at two nodes: selenocysteine-tRNA maturation for GPX4 and CoQ10 supply for FSP1.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 的受質——泛醌/CoQ10——是甲羥戊酸（mevalonate）路徑的非固醇產物。抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的擾動（例如 statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會使 FSP1 缺乏泛醌受質，瓦解 FSP1 軸並預示鐵死亡敏感性。這使甲羥戊酸路徑在兩個節點與鐵死亡交會：GPX4 所需的硒半胱氨酸-tRNA 成熟，以及 FSP1 所需的 CoQ10 供應。

label: Ubiquinone
description: FSP1 catalyzes the reduction of oxidized ubiquinone (CoQ10) to ubiquinol (CoQ10H2) at the expense of NAD(P)H, regenerating the membrane-embedded radical-trapping antioxidant pool that terminates phospholipid peroxyl-radical chains during lipid peroxidation. This is mechanistically distinct from GPX4, which consumes Glutathione to repair pre-formed phospholipid hydroperoxides.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 利用 NAD(P)H 將氧化的泛醌（CoQ10）還原為泛醇（CoQ10H2），重新生成膜內的自由基捕獲抗氧化劑池，終止脂質過氧化過程中的磷脂過氧自由基鏈。這在機制上不同於 GPX4——後者消耗 Glutathione 來修復已形成的磷脂氫過氧化物。

label: Cataract
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Cross-linking may be responsible for many of the problems of old age, including senile cataract, thickening of the arteries, some cancers and damage to the immune system. A damaged immune system leads to increased susceptibility to infection, and some cancers may arise from the effects of glucose on DNA, which can react with glucose to produce damaged DNA that causes abnormal cells to be produced. Aminoguanidine's ability to prevent cross-linking may help alleviate or prevent senile cataract as well as arterial thickening, kidney failure, thinning bones, osteoarthritis and skin wrinkles.
description_zh_TW: 交聯作用可能是老年許多問題的成因，包括老年性白內障、動脈增厚、某些癌症與免疫系統損傷。受損的免疫系統會導致對感染的易感性增加，而某些癌症可能源於葡萄糖對 DNA 的影響——DNA 可與葡萄糖反應而產生受損的 DNA，進而導致異常細胞的生成。胺基胍防止交聯的能力，可能有助於緩解或預防老年性白內障，以及動脈增厚、腎衰竭、骨質變薄、骨關節炎與皮膚皺紋。

label: Base Excision Repair
description: SIRT6 is required for efficient base-excision repair (BER), the pathway that removes oxidized and alkylated bases, and SIRT6-deficient cells accumulate DNA damage from defective BER. SIRT6 supports BER in part by mono-ADP-ribosylating and recruiting repair factors such as PARP1 and by maintaining heterochromatin at damaged sites. Directionally, SIRT6 activity sits upstream of proper BER execution. This function explains the genomic instability and premature aging of SIRT6 knockout mice, and links SIRT6 to tumor suppression, since loss of SIRT6-dependent repair predisposes cells to mutation accumulation and oncogenic transformation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 對高效的鹼基切除修復（BER）至關重要，該通路移除氧化和烷基化鹼基，SIRT6 缺乏的細胞會因 BER 缺陷而累積 DNA 損傷。SIRT6 部分通過單 ADP-核糖基化並招募修復因子（如 PARP1）以及在損傷位點維持異染色質來支持 BER。在方向性上，SIRT6 活性位於正確 BER 執行的上游。此功能解釋了 SIRT6 敲除小鼠的基因組不穩定性和早衰，並將 SIRT6 與腫瘤抑制聯繫起來，因為 SIRT6 依賴性修復的缺失使細胞容易累積突變並發生腫瘤轉化。

label: SOD2
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SOD2 (manganese superoxide dismutase) is the mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme that eliminates superoxide generated during respiration. Its activity is regulated by acetylation, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation increasing SOD2 activity. When NR raises NAD+ and activates SIRT3, SOD2 acetylation decreases, mitochondrial SOD2 activity rises, and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species levels fall. This reduced mitochondrial ROS burden lessens oxidative damage and supports mitochondrial quality control, contributing to NR's protective effects against oxidative stress, inflammasome activation, and age-related mitochondrial dysfunction in tissues such as the myocardium, skeletal muscle, and neurons.
description_zh_TW: SOD2（錳超氧化物歧化酶）是在呼吸過程中消除所產生的超氧化物的粒線體抗氧化酶。其活性受乙醯化調控，其中 SIRT3 介導的去乙醯化會增加 SOD2 活性。當 NR 提升 NAD+ 並活化 SIRT3 時，SOD2 乙醯化下降，粒線體 SOD2 活性上升，粒線體活性氧物種水平降低。這種減少的粒線體 ROS 負擔減輕了氧化損傷並支持粒線體品質控制，有助於 NR 對氧化壓力、發炎體活化以及心肌、骨骼肌和神經元等組織中與年齡相關的粒線體功能障礙的保護作用。

label: P-gp
description: Multidrug Resistance is mediated by P-gp. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) is an ATP-binding-cassette efflux pump that expels cytotoxic drugs from cells and is a major mediator of multidrug resistance. The directionality runs from P-gp toward Multidrug Resistance, so P-gp is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance是由P-gp介導的。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 P-糖蛋白（ABCB1）是一種ATP結合盒外排泵，可將細胞毒性藥物從細胞中排出，是Multidrug Resistance的主要介質。方向性從 P-gp 朝向 Multidrug Resistance，因此 P-gp 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: YAP1
description: Cancer is driven by YAP1. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. YAP1 is the transcriptional co-activator of the Hippo pathway that, when nuclear, promotes proliferation and is inhibited by ivermectin in several cancers. The directionality runs from YAP1 toward Cancer, so YAP1 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由YAP1 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 YAP1 是 Hippo 途徑的轉錄共活化因子，當進入細胞核時，可促進增殖，並在多種癌症中被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 YAP1 朝向 Cancer，因此 YAP1 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Cell Proliferation
description: At high doses rapamycin and everolimus slow cell proliferation, which decreases blood cell counts and results in mild and reversible thrombocytopenia, anemia and leukopenia as their most common side effects. A mild reduction of platelets may actually be beneficial, since one of the intended effects of aspirin is a decrease in platelet function. These reversible side effects contrast with the irreversible and inevitable effects of aging such as cancer, stroke, infarction, blindness and premature death, and can be avoided by intermittent scheduling or low-dose administration.
description_zh_TW: 在高劑量下，rapamycin和everolimus減緩細胞增殖，導致血細胞計數減少，並產生輕微且可逆的血小板減少症、貧血和白血球減少症作為其最常見的副作用。血小板的輕微減少實際上可能是有益的，因為aspirin的其中一個預期效果是減少血小板功能。這些可逆的副作用與老化的不可逆和不可避免的效應形成對比，如癌症、中風、梗塞、失明和過早死亡，可以透過間歇性安排或低劑量給藥來避免。

label: Dopaminochrome
description: Dopamine, like epinephrine, undergoes oxidation to an aminochrome: dopamine is converted through an o-quinone intermediate to dopaminochrome, the dopamine analog of adrenochrome. These aminochromes are unstable reactive intermediates that can polymerize into melanins, including neuromelanin in dopaminergic neurons. This oxidation pathway is relevant to the brain, where oxidative metabolism of catecholamines into quinone-like compounds contributes to the age-dependent buildup of neuromelanin pigments in the substantia nigra. The reactivity of dopaminochrome and related aminochromes underlies their potential neurotoxicity and their sequestration by neuromelanin.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 與 epinephrine 類似，會氧化成 aminochrome：dopamine 經由 o-quinone 中間產物轉化為 dopaminochrome，即 adrenochrome 的 dopamine 類似物。這些 aminochromes 是不穩定的反應性中間產物，可聚合成 melanins，包括多巴胺能神經元中的 neuromelanin。此氧化途徑與大腦相關，其中兒茶酚胺氧化代謝成類 quinone 化合物，促成了 substantia nigra 中 neuromelanin 色素隨年齡的堆積。Dopaminochrome 及相關 aminochromes 的反應性，是其潛在神經毒性以及被 neuromelanin 隔離的基礎。

label: Caspase-1
description: Inflammasome-activated caspase-1 cleaves Parkin, the E3 ligase essential for PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, halting the mitophagy pathway. Caspase-1 simultaneously enhances mitochondrial ROS production, permeabilization, and fragmentation, pushing damage beyond mitophagy's repair capacity. This is the pyroptosis-to-mitophagy inhibitory arm: lytic inflammatory death not only runs ahead of mitochondrial cleanup but actively dismantles it — although ambient ozone exposure studies show ROS can also activate PINK1-Parkin mitophagy upstream of NLRP3 pyroptosis, so the relationship is bidirectional and context-dependent.
description_zh_TW: 發炎體活化的 Caspase-1 會切割 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬所必需的 E3 連接酶 Parkin，使粒線體自噬路徑中止。Caspase-1 同時加劇粒線體 ROS 的產生、通透化與片段化，使損傷超出粒線體自噬的修復能力。這是焦亡至粒線體自噬的抑制臂：發炎性裂解死亡不只跑在粒線體清理之前，還主動拆解它——不過臭氧暴露研究顯示 ROS 也可在 NLRP3 焦亡的上游活化 PINK1-Parkin 粒線體自噬，因此兩者關係是雙向且取決於情境的。

label: Chemoresistance
description: Senescent stromal cells in the tumor microenvironment secrete soluble SASP factors that confer therapeutic resistance on residual cancer cells, including WNT16B, amphiregulin (AREG) and epiregulin (EREG). Conditioned media from bleomycin-senescent PSC27 stroma elevated viability, migration and invasion of prostate cancer lines (PC3, DU145, M12, LNCaP) and shifted their survival curves against mitoxantrone. Apigenin treatment of the stromal cells diminished this SASP-conferred resistance almost to basal levels and increased cancer cell apoptosis (caspase-3/7 activity).
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤微環境中的衰老基質細胞分泌可溶性SASP因子，賦予殘留癌細胞治療抵抗性，包括WNT16B、雙調蛋白（AREG）和上皮調節蛋白（EREG）。來自博來霉素衰老的PSC27基質的conditioned media提高了前列腺癌細胞系（PC3、DU145、M12、LNCaP）的活力、遷移和侵襲能力，並改變了它們對米托蒽醌的生存曲線。芹菜素處理基質細胞幾乎將這種SASP賦予的抗性降低到基線水平，並增加了癌細胞凋亡（caspase-3/7活性）。

label: Hormetic Window
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: The SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio determines the hormetic window: a high ratio (SIRT3-dominant) favors the adaptive branch, while a low ratio tilts toward the toxic branch of mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3/SIRT4 比例決定激素性窗口：比例高（SIRT3 主導）傾向適應分支，比例低則傾向粒線體激素性的毒性分支。

label: anti-inflammatory properties
description: Luteolin has anti-inflammatory properties, inhibiting NF-kappaB and AP-1 signaling and suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. These actions contribute to its studied benefits in neuroinflammation, allergic responses, and metabolic inflammation. Its anti-inflammatory profile is independent of COMT, making it usable alongside COMT-sensitive individuals, though high doses can still interact with the enzyme via its catechol structure. It is a prominent flavonoid in anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective research.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，抑制 NF-κB 和 AP-1 訊號傳導並抑制促發炎細胞因子，如 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β。這些作用有助於研究其在神經發炎、過敏反應和代謝發炎方面的益處。其抗發炎特性獨立於 COMT，使其可與 COMT 敏感個體一起使用，儘管高劑量仍可透過其兒茶酚結構與此酵素相互作用。它是抗發炎和神經保護研究中重要的黃酮類化合物。

label: Cytoplasmic Chromatin Fragments
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments activate the cGAS-STING pathway, the innate immune DNA-sensing cascade that links nuclear DNA damage to inflammation. During senescence, ruptures of the nuclear envelope release chromatin into the cytoplasm, where the DNA sensor cGAS binds this self-DNA and activates STING, driving NF-kB-dependent expression of SASP genes. This cGAS-STING signaling through cytoplasmic chromatin is a major mechanism coupling genomic instability to the inflammatory senescent phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質染色質片段會活化 cGAS-STING 通路，這是一種將核 DNA 損傷與發炎聯繫起來的先天免疫 DNA 感測級聯反應。在老化過程中，核膜的破裂將染色質釋放到細胞質中，其中 DNA 感測器 cGAS 結合這種自身 DNA 並活化 STING，驅動 SASP 基因的 NF-kB 依賴性表達。這種透過細胞質染色質的 cGAS-STING 訊號傳導是將基因組不穩定性與發炎老化表型耦合的主要機制。

label: HSPA8
description: HSPA8 (HSC70), a member of the heat shock protein 70 family, directly binds phosphorylated ATM, as shown by p-ATM-mediated co-immunoprecipitation, and this interaction is specifically attenuated by apigenin treatment. ATM is the central modulator of the DNA damage response whose activation drives a persistent SASP; the HSPA8-ATM crosstalk represents an upstream transduction step in the transition from the acute stress-associated phenotype to the full SASP.
description_zh_TW: HSPA8（HSC70）是熱休克蛋白 70 家族的成員，可直接結合磷酸化的 ATM（如 p-ATM 介導的共免疫沉澱所示），而此交互作用會特異性地被芹菜素處理削弱。ATM 是 DNA 損傷反應的核心調節者，其活化會驅動持續性的 SASP；HSPA8-ATM 交互對話代表從急性壓力相關表現型轉變為完整 SASP 過程中的上游傳導步驟。

label: HSP27
description: HSP27 is commonly upregulated in tumors and serves as a prognostic and therapeutic-resistance marker.
description_zh_TW: HSP27 在腫瘤中常被上調，並作為預後和治療抵抗的標誌物。

label: p21
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Urolithin A can regulate the cell cycle by increasing the levels of cell cycle inhibitory proteins such as p21 and p27, complementing its inhibition of cyclin-dependent kinase activity and its reduction of cyclin D1 expression. Elevation of these cell cycle inhibitory proteins promotes cell cycle arrest in the G1 phase. Together these effects define urolithin A's capacity to modulate cell cycle progression, a property with relevance to its anti-tumor and antiproliferative activity in cancer contexts.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可透過提升如 p21 與 p27 等細胞週期抑制蛋白的水平來調節細胞週期，補足其對 cyclin-dependent kinase 活性的抑制以及對 cyclin D1 表現的降低。這些細胞週期抑制蛋白的升高促進 G1 期細胞週期停滯。這些效應共同界定了 urolithin A 調節細胞週期進程的能力，此特性與其在癌症情境中的抗腫瘤與抗增殖活性相關。

label: ADP-ribosylation
description: SIRT4 functions principally as a mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase, using NAD+ to attach a single ADP-ribose group to target lysines rather than removing acetyl marks. Its best-characterized ADP-ribosylation target is glutamate dehydrogenase, whose activity it inhibits to dampen amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion. This enzymatic orientation means SIRT4 generally acts as a metabolic suppressor within mitochondria, opposing anabolic and growth signals. A caveat is that SIRT4's deacetylase activity is weak in vitro, so ADP-ribosylation is its physiologically dominant modality.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 主要作為單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶發揮功能，利用 NAD+ 將單個 ADP-核糖基團附加到目標離胺酸上，而非移除乙醯標記。其最具特徵的 ADP-核糖基化靶標是穀氨酸脫氫酶，SIRT4 抑制其活性以抑制胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌。這種酶學取向意味著 SIRT4 通常在粒線體內充時代謝抑制因子，對抗合成代謝和生長信號。需要注意的是，SIRT4 的去乙醯酶活性在體外較弱，因此 ADP-核糖基化是其生理上的主要作用模式。

label: SUV39H1
description: SIRT1 deacetylates and cooperates with the H3K9 methyltransferase Suv39h1 to enforce heterochromatin and silencing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並與 H3K9 甲基轉移酶 Suv39h1 協同作用，以強化異染色質和基因沉默。

label: MAPK
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin modulates the MAPK cascade, inducing dose-dependent phosphorylation of ERK and p38 while having little effect on JNK phosphorylation in colon carcinoma and keratinocyte models. It also suppresses MEKK1-driven activation of ERK, JNK, and p38 in bladder smooth-muscle cells, thereby inhibiting cell migration and actin polymerization. In thyroid cancer cells apigenin disrupted EGFR tyrosine auto-phosphorylation and downstream MAPK signaling. Its net effect on the MAPK axis contributes to its chemopreventive activity by restraining proliferation, migration, and invasion across multiple cancer types.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧調節 MAPK 級聯反應，誘導 ERK 和 p38 的劑量相關磷酸化，同時對 JNK 磷酸化影響不大，在結直腸癌和角質形成細胞模型中均有效。它還抑制 MEKK1 驅動的 ERK、JNK 和 p38 活化，從而抑制細胞遷移和焦磷酸鹽聚合。在甲狀腺癌細胞中，阿皮ゲ寧擾亂了 EGFR 酪氨酸自磷酸化和下游 MAPK 訊號傳導。它對 MAPK 軸的淨效應有助於其抗癌前列腺活性，藉由抑制多種癌症類型中的增殖、遷移和侵襲。

label: Cholangiocarcinoma
description: Cholangiocarcinoma is a malignancy of the bile-duct epithelium (adenocarcinoma).
description_zh_TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 是膽管上皮的惡性腫瘤（腺癌）。

label: basal ganglia
description: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

label: Age-Related Diseases
description: Anti-aging drugs extend healthspan and are most effective before overt diseases cause organ damage and loss of function, so rapamycin is most effective when administered at the pre-disease or even pre-pre-disease stages of age-related diseases. It delays the onset of age-related diseases, which are manifestations of aging, and although rapamycin may reverse some manifestations of aging, it is more effective at slowing aging than reversing it. Rapalogs may slow atherosclerosis, preventing myocardial infarction, but are unlikely to help reverse an infarction, and rapamycin may be useful for osteoporosis though not for a broken hip after an osteoporotic fracture.
description_zh_TW: 抗衰老藥物延長健康壽命，並在明顯疾病導致器官損傷和功能喪失之前最有效，因此rapamycin在年齡相關疾病的疾病前期甚至疾病前期前期階段給藥時最有效。它延遲年齡相關疾病的發病，這些疾病是老化的表現，雖然rapamycin可能逆轉一些老化的表現，但它在減緩老化方面比逆轉更有效。rapalogs可能減緩動脈粥樣硬化，預防心肌梗塞，但不太可能幫助逆轉梗塞，rapamycin可能對骨質疏鬆症有用，但對骨質疏鬆性骨折後的髖部骨折無效。

label: DNA
description: Adrenochrome is a reactive electrophilic quinone that readily bonds with DNA as well as proteins, forming covalent adducts that contribute to its cellular toxicity. Because the molecule is small and water soluble, it can reach nuclear material and modify nucleophilic sites on DNA bases. Such adduct formation can promote mutagenesis, genotoxic stress, and cell death, and it places adrenochrome among the oxidative metabolites of catecholamines with genotoxic potential. The DNA reactivity complements adrenochrome's protein-binding behavior and its reported cardiotoxicity, including cell necrosis, in stressed heart tissue. Because adrenochrome's half-life in aqueous solution is short, DNA damage from this pathway would be expected to occur rapidly after formation, emphasizing that the toxic window is brief but potentially severe.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅（Adrenochrome）是一種活性親電醌類物質，容易與DNA及蛋白質結合，形成共價加合物，進而造成細胞毒性。由於該分子體積小且具水溶性，可到達核物質並修飾DNA鹼基上的親核位點。此類加合物的形成可促進致突變作用、基因毒性應激及細胞死亡，使腎上腺素紅被歸類為具有基因毒性的兒茶酚胺氧化代謝物。DNA反應性與腎上腺素紅的蛋白質結合特性及其報導的心臟毒性（包括受損心臟組織中的細胞壞死）形成互補。由於腎上腺素紅在水溶液中的半衰期較短，此途徑造成的DNA損傷預期在形成後迅速發生，強調其毒性窗口雖短暫但潛在嚴重性高。

label: IL-8
description: IL-8 (CXCL8) is a prototypical SASP chemokine secreted by senescent cells, essential for neutrophil recruitment and, in tumors, cancer stemness via CXCR2 signaling. It is co-induced with IL-6 downstream of NF-kB and IL-1a and is frequently measured alongside IL-6 as a SASP readout. IL-8's roles in both inflammation and tumor promotion underscore the dual nature of the secretome, supporting wound-healing neutrophil influx acutely while contributing to chronic inflammation and therapy resistance. It is a canonical component of the senescent secretome.
description_zh_TW: 介白素-8（IL-8）與 IL-6 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。IL-8 由衰老細胞分泌，重塑局部組織微環境並對鄰近細胞發揮旁分泌效應。在本研究中，重組 IL-8（以 1:2 比例與 IL-6 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現，此現象可由衰老細胞共培養重現，導致脂質過氧化升高並使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

label: TSC
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: In tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC), where mTOR pathway hyperactivation is a hallmark due to variants in TSC1 or TSC2, rapamycin prevents seizures, reduces mortality, and rescues neuropathology including glial proliferation and disrupted cortical architecture in mouse models. In the EXIST-3 phase III trial, adjunctive everolimus significantly reduced seizure frequency in treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC, with about 40% of high-dose patients achieving at least 50% seizure reduction versus 15% placebo, leading to regulatory approval.
description_zh_TW: 在結節性硬化症（TSC）中，由於TSC1或TSC2變異，mTOR通路過度激活是一個標誌，rapamycin在小鼠模型中預防癲癇、降低死亡率並挽救神經病理學，包括膠質增生和皮質結構破壞。在EXIST-3 III期試驗中，輔助everolimus顯著降低了TSC引起的治療抵抗性癲癇的發作頻率，約40%的高劑量患者達到至少50%的癲癇減少，而安慰劑組為15%，從而獲得監管批准。

label: Chemotherapy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Standard therapy is maximal resection, radiotherapy and temozolomide; prognosis remains poor (median <15 months).
description_zh_TW: 標準治療是最大切除、放療和 temozolomide；預後仍然不良（中位數 <15 個月）。

label: Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff
description: Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Retrograde Signaling
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Mitochondria communicate stress to the nucleus through retrograde signaling pathways. In yeast this involves the Rtg1/Rtg3 transcription factors, whose activation extends replicative lifespan; in mammals the retrograde response involves calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation and may include the Retinoid X receptor alpha, PGC-1alpha, JNK, and ROS generation. Mitochondrial perturbations such as mtDNA deletion, respiratory chain inhibition, misfolded matrix proteins, or stalled ribosomes all elicit coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression that reconfigure metabolism and induce cytoprotective programs.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 通過 retrograde signaling pathways 與細胞核溝通壓力。在 yeast 中，這涉及 Rtg1/Rtg3 轉錄因子，其激活可延長 replicative lifespan；在 mammals 中，retrograde response 涉及 calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation 且可能包括 Retinoid X receptor alpha、PGC-1alpha、JNK 和 ROS 生成。Mitochondrial perturbations 如 mtDNA deletion、respiratory chain inhibition、misfolded matrix proteins 或 stalled ribosomes 都會引發 coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression，重新配置代謝並誘導 cytoprotective programs。

label: ERK2
description: ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 142, producing cytoplasmic retention and nuclear export of the transcription factor (PMID 21617040, 29992949). Phosphorylation at this site, shared with mTORC1 and CDK4/CDK6, keeps TFEB out of the nucleus and thereby represses its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes. This places TFEB under the control of mitogen/extracellular-signal-regulated kinase (ERK) signaling in addition to nutrient sensing, integrating growth factor cues into the control of lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. Dephosphorylation of S142 by calcineurin reverses this effect and promotes TFEB translocation to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: ERK2 在絲氨酸 142 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留和核輸出（PMID 21617040、29992949）。此位點的磷酸化與 mTORC1 和 CDK4/CDK6 共享，使 TFEB 保持在細胞核外，從而抑制其溶酶體和自噬基因的轉錄程序。這使 TFEB 除了營養感知外，還受到絲裂原/細胞外信號調節激酶（ERK）信號通路的控制，將生長因子線索整合到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的調節中。鈣調磷酸酶對 S142 的去磷酸化逆轉此效應，促進 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

label: JNK
description: JNK is a type of MAPK. JNK is a stress-activated MAPK that can promote apoptosis through Bim and Mcl-1 regulation yet also support tumor invasion. The mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades relay extracellular signals to transcriptional programs governing proliferation and stress responses. The directionality runs from MAPK toward JNK, so MAPK is the active agent and JNK the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: JNK 是 MAPK 的一種。 JNK是一種壓力活化的MAPK，可以透過Bim和Mcl-1調節促進細胞凋亡，同時也支持腫瘤侵襲。絲裂原活化的蛋白激酶級聯將細胞外訊號傳遞至控制增殖和壓力反應的轉錄程序。方向性從 MAPK 向 JNK，因此 MAPK 是活性劑，JNK 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase
description: Methylene blue acts as an inhibitor of soluble guanylyl cyclase (sGC), the downstream receptor for nitric oxide. Even when nitric oxide has already been produced, methylene blue prevents NO from triggering sGC-mediated cyclic GMP production, thereby blocking the vasodilation and hypotension that result from excessive NO signaling in conditions such as septic shock. By acting downstream at sGC rather than at NOS enzymes, methylene blue can rescue blood pressure even when NO levels are already high.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue作為可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶（sGC）的抑制劑發揮作用，sGC是一氧化氮的下游受體。即使一氧化氮已經產生，methylene blue也能防止NO觸發sGC介導的環磷酸GMP產生，從而阻斷在敗血症等情況下過度NO信號傳導導致的血管舒張和低血壓。通過在sGC而不是NOS酶的下游起作用，methylene blue甚至在NO水平已經很高時也能挽救血壓。

label: Stroke
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is neuroprotective in rodent models of stroke, reducing infarct volume and preserving neurological function. MB enhances cellular oxygen consumption in vivo and provides protection against hypoxia-induced injury, including in primary hepatocyte cultures. Its mechanism is distinct from conventional antioxidants: by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III and by upregulating complex IV activity and expression, MB sustains mitochondrial bioenergetics in ischemic tissue where electron transport is compromised.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在中風的囓齒類模型中具有神經保護作用，減少梗塞體積並保留神經功能。MB在體內增強細胞氧氣消耗，並提供對缺氧誘導損傷的保護，包括在原代肝細胞培養中。其機制與傳統抗氧化劑不同：通過作為繞過複合物I-III的替代電子轉運載體，並通過上調複合物IV活性和表達，MB在電子傳輸受損的缺血組織中維持粒線體生物能量學。

label: Blood-Brain Barrier
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Methylene blue crosses the blood-brain barrier easily, which is why its cognitive and mood effects appear at relatively modest doses. Once in the central nervous system it acts as a redox cycling agent inside mitochondria, donating and accepting electrons to keep the mitochondrial electron transport chain running more efficiently, and it has documented effects on tau protein aggregation, monoamine oxidase inhibition, and neuroprotection more broadly. Its central availability combined with its low-dose mitochondrial enhancement is the mechanistic basis for the small but real human evidence of improved memory encoding and retrieval and reduced anxiety and depression scores at low (0.5-4 mg) doses.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue容易穿過血腦屏障，這就是為什麼其認知和情緒效應在相對適中的劑量下出現。一旦進入中樞神經系統，它在粒線體內作為氧化還原循環劑發揮作用，捐贈和接受電子以使粒線體電子傳遞鏈更有效地運行，並且它對tau蛋白聚集、單胺氧化酶抑制和更廣泛的神經保護具有記錄在案的效果。其中樞可用性與其低劑量粒線體增強相結合，是在低劑量（0.5-4毫克）下改善記憶編碼和提取以及降低焦慮和抑鬱評分的小但真實的人類證據的機制基礎。

label: Bad
description: Bad is a BH3-only sensitizer: rather than activating BAX/BAK directly, it displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family restraint (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1), indirectly liberating the effectors. IKK-mediated phosphorylation of Bad at Ser26 inactivates it and confers TNFα resistance, and the BH3 mimetic compounds act on the same principle — competitively disrupting Bcl-2/Bcl-xL binding to beclin-1 as well, which releases beclin-1 for autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Bad 是 BH3-only 的敏化因子：它不直接活化 BAX/BAK，而是置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族（Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1）的抑制，間接解放效應蛋白。IKK 對 Bad Ser26 的磷酸化會使其失活並賦予 TNFα 抗性；BH3 擬似劑也基於相同原理——競爭性破壞 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 與 beclin-1 的結合，同時釋出 beclin-1 以促進自噬。

label: Smac DIABLO
description: MOMP releases Smac-DIABLO. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The relationship is directional, with MOMP acting as the operative agent upon Smac-DIABLO rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MOMP 發布 Smac-DIABLO。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。這種關係是有方向的，MOMP 充當 Smac-DIABLO 的操作代理，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Hallmarks of Cancer
description: Cancer is characterized by Hallmarks of Cancer. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The Hallmarks of Cancer are the enabling biological capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis, including sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The directionality runs from Hallmarks of Cancer toward Cancer, so Hallmarks of Cancer is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 的特徵是 Hallmarks of Cancer。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Hallmarks of Cancer是腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的生物學能力，包括持續增生、逃避死亡和轉移。方向性從 Hallmarks of Cancer 朝向 Cancer，因此 Hallmarks of Cancer 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Telomere
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at telomeric regions in response to DNA damage and stabilizes the WRN helicase at telomeres, tightening telomere structure and preventing dysfunction during replication. Directionally, SIRT6 maintains telomere integrity. Loss of SIRT6 causes H3K9 hyperacetylation and chromatin relaxation at telomeres, tying it to genomic stability in ageing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 DNA 損傷反應中去乙醯化端粒區域的 H3K9，並在端粒處穩定 WRN 解旋酶，緊密化端粒結構並防止複製過程中的功能障礙。方向性上 SIRT6 維護端粒完整性。SIRT6 的缺失導致端粒處 H3K9 超乙醯化和染色質鬆弛，將其與老化的基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: Macrophage polarization
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 decreases atherosclerotic plaque formation in LDL receptor-deficient mice by regulating macrophage polarization. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of anti-atherogenic macrophage phenotypes. By steering macrophages toward less inflammatory states, SIRT2 reduces the foam-cell accumulation and chronic inflammation that drive plaque development. This links SIRT2 to innate immune modulation in vascular disease, complementing the anti-inflammatory actions of other sirtuins. Because macrophages are central to atherosclerosis, interventions that preserve SIRT2 activity in these cells could help limit plaque burden and stabilize existing lesions, reducing the risk of cardiovascular events.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2在LDL受體缺陷小鼠中透過調節巨噬細胞極化來減少動脈粥樣硬化斑塊的形成。方向上，SIRT2位於抗動脈粥樣硬化的巨噬細胞表型的上游。透過將巨噬細胞引導至較不發炎的狀態，SIRT2減少了驅動斑塊發展的泡沫細胞積累和慢性發炎。這將SIRT2與血管疾病中的先天免疫調節聯繫起來，補充了其他sirtuin的抗發炎作用。由於巨噬細胞是動脈粥樣硬化的核心，維持這些細胞中SIRT2活性的介入措施可能有助於限制斑塊負荷並穩定現有病變，降低心血管事件的風險。

label: GSK3
description: GSK3beta phosphorylates TFEB at serine 138, promoting lysosomal localization and nuclear export (PMID 27617930, 29992949), and at S134 promoting lysosomal localization. Phosphorylation of TFEB by GSK3beta modulates its subcellular distribution, controlling access of the transcription factor to its nuclear targets. The S138 site is particularly notable because it is also subject to O-GlcNAc glucosylation that blocks TFEB nuclear export, illustrating cross-talk between phosphorylation and glycosylation at the same residue. GSK3beta regulation of TFEB links glycogen synthase kinase signaling to the control of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: GSK3beta 在絲氨酸 138 上磷酸化 TFEB，促進溶酶體定位和核輸出（PMID 27617930、29992949），並在 S134 上磷酸化 TFEB 促進溶酶體定位。GSK3beta 對 TFEB 的磷酸化調節其亞細胞分布，控制轉錄因子對其核靶標的可及性。S138 位點特別值得注意，因為它也受到 O-GlcNAc 糖基化的調節，該糖基化阻斷 TFEB 的核輸出，說明同一殘基上磷酸化和糖基化之間的交談。GSK3beta 對 TFEB 的調節將糖原合酶激酶信號與溶酶體生物發生和自噬的控制聯繫起來。

label: PTEN
description: PTEN is the main phosphatase that indirectly inactivates PI3K in the mTOR-PI3K signaling cascade, providing the antagonistic deactivating arm that balances PI3K activation. Alongside PP2A, which counteracts the effect of mTORC1 in the activation of S6K1/2, PTEN is one of the two key phosphatases modeled as kinase-phosphatase opposing pairs. The balance between activating and deactivating reactions at key nodes, such as the positive correlation between activation and deactivation of mTORC2, is consistent with the requirement for opposite reactions to underlie biphasic dose-responses.
description_zh_TW: PTEN是mTOR-PI3K訊號級聯中主要的磷酸酶，間接使PI3K失活，提供平衡PI3K活化的拮抗性失活臂。與抵消mTORC1對S6K1/2活化影響的PP2A一起，PTEN是兩個關鍵磷酸酶之一，被建模為激酶-磷酸酶對抗對。關鍵節點上活化和失活反應之間的平衡，例如mTORC2活化和失活之間的正相關，與相反反應作為雙相劑量反應基礎的要求一致。

label: ACSS2
description: ACSS2 (acetyl-CoA synthetase 2) is a nuclear-cytosolic enzyme that ligates acetate to coenzyme A to form acetyl-CoA, providing a mitochondrial-independent route of acetyl-CoA production that supports histone acetylation and gene expression.
description_zh_TW: ACSS2（acetyl-CoA synthetase 2）是一種核-胞質酵素，將乙酸（acetate）與輔酶 A 連接形成 acetyl-CoA，提供一條不依賴粒線體的 acetyl-CoA 生成路徑，以支持組蛋白乙醯化與基因表現。

label: Teratoma
description: Partial reprogramming contrasts with full reprogramming to induced pluripotent stem cells, which risks teratoma formation due to the loss of somatic identity. By limiting Yamanaka factor expression to a transient window, cells erase aging-associated epigenetic marks without being converted to a pluripotent state, so growth arrest and differentiation are preserved. This design avoids the tumor risk associated with full reprogramming while still restoring a more youthful molecular and functional phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 部分重編程與誘導多能幹細胞的完全重編程形成對比，後者因體細胞身份的喪失而面臨畸胎瘤形成的風險。透過將山中因子的表達限制在一個短暫的窗口內，細胞可以消除與老化相關的表觀遺傳標記，而不會轉化為多能狀態，從而保留生長停滯和分化。這種設計避免了與完全重編程相關的腫瘤風險，同時仍恢復較年輕的分子和功能表型。

label: Hypoxia
description: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues. Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin. Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues。Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin。Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated。

label: Caspase-6
description: Caspase-6 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-6 is an executioner caspase particularly important for cleavage of nuclear lamins and the structural collapse of the nucleus. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-6, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-6 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-6 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-6 是一種劊子手半胱天冬酶，對於核纖層蛋白的裂解和細胞核的結構崩潰特別重要。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-6，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-6 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Prostate Cancer
description: Enzalutamide is approved for castration-resistant prostate cancer.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於去勢抵抗性前列腺癌。

label: MAO
description: Graph node-analysis: MAO (degree 2, k-core 2) reaches Dopamine only through Epinephrine (no direct edge), with ~3–4× larger commute distance and near-null resistance z (Dopamine z = −0.70) — a peripheral metabolic spoke versus COMT's hub status.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：MAO（degree 2、k-core 2）僅能透過 Epinephrine 到達 Dopamine（無直接邊），通勤距離約大 3–4 倍且阻力 z 近於零（Dopamine z = −0.70）——相對於 COMT 的樞紐地位，它是周邊的代謝輻條。

label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
description: SIRT3 expression is lower in HCC tissue than in adjacent tissue. Modulating SIRT3 enhances sorafenib therapy, and SIRT3 downregulates GST-pi1 to enhance chemo- and sorafenib-induced apoptosis. Its loss therefore correlates with tumor aggressiveness and reduced treatment efficacy in hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 HCC 組織中的表現低於鄰近組織。調節 SIRT3 可增強 sorafenib 治療，且 SIRT3 下調 GST-pi1 以增強化療與 sorafenib 誘發的凋亡。因此，其缺失與肝細胞癌中的腫瘤侵襲性與治療效能降低相關。

label: GDH (Glutamate Dehydrogenase)
description: SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylates glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH), inhibiting its oxidative deamination of glutamate to α-ketoglutarate and thereby slowing anaplerotic carbon entry into the TCA cycle. This restrains amino-acid-derived ATP production and insulin secretion in pancreatic β-cells, limiting nutrient-driven hormonal output. Directionally, SIRT4 enzymatically inhibits GDH, acting as a mitochondrial brake on amino-acid catabolism. This opposes anabolic fueling of secretion, and because SIRT4 also inhibits MTPα, glutamine metabolism, and PPARα signaling, it broadly curbs mitochondrial oxidative capacity while promoting lipid conservation under nutrient-replete conditions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 對穀氨酸脫氫酶（GDH）進行單 ADP-核糖基化，抑制其將穀氨酸氧化脫氨為 α-酮戊二酸，從而減緩回補性碳源進入 TCA 循環。這限制了胰腺 β 細胞中胺基酸衍生的 ATP 產生和胰島素分泌，抑制營養物驅動的荷爾蒙輸出。在方向性上，SIRT4 在酶學上抑制 GDH，充時代謝的制動器限制胺基酸分解代謝。這對抗了分泌的合成代謝燃料供應，且由於 SIRT4 也抑制 MTPα、穀氨酰胺代謝和 PPARα 信號，它在營養充足條件下廣泛抑制粒線體氧化能力同時促進脂質保存。

label: Kaempferol
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Kaempferol, a flavonol (3,5,7,4'-tetrahydroxyflavone) and sister compound to quercetin/apigenin, directly activates SIRT1 as a natural polyphenol STAC via K-type allosteric Km lowering, and is frequently co-studied for anti-aging and cancer-risk reduction.
description_zh_TW: Kaempferol 是一種黄酮醇（3,5,7,4'-四羥基黄酮），是 quercetin/apigenin 的姊妹化合物，作為天然多酚類 STAC 透過 K 型別構降低 Km 直接活化 SIRT1，常與抗老化和降低癌症風險的研究並提。

label: IKK
description: IKK activates NFκB. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon NFκB rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: IKK 活化 NFκB。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。這種關係是定向的，IKK 充當 NFκB 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Nucleus
description: TFEB translocates to the nucleus in response to dephosphorylation of its cytoplasmic-retention sites. Dephosphorylation of S211 and S142 by calcineurin, and of S122 and S109/S114 by PP2A, promotes nuclear translocation, while phosphorylation of S401 by p38 MAPK also drives the transcription factor into the nucleus. Acetylation at K91/K103/K430 and PARsylation by TNKS1 likewise promote nuclear translocation, and O-GlcNAc glucosylation of S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 promotes nuclear entry while S138 glucosylation blocks nuclear export. Once in the nucleus, TFEB activates transcription of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes, making nuclear localization the key regulatory decision point.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 通過其胞質保留位點的去磷酸化響應而轉位至細胞核。鈣調磷酸酶對 S211 和 S142 的去磷酸化，以及 PP2A 對 S122 和 S109/S114 的去磷酸化，促進核轉位；p38 MAPK 對 S401 的磷酸化也驅動轉錄因子進入細胞核。K91/K103/K430 的乙醯化以及 TNKS1 的 PARylation 同樣促進核轉位，S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 的 O-GlcNAc 糖基化促進核輸入，而 S138 的糖基化則阻斷核輸出。一旦進入細胞核，TFEB 啟動溶酶體生物發生和自噬基因的轉錄，使核定位成為關鍵的調節決定點。

label: Liver Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
description: SIRT3 protects against liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: systemic GPCR5 knockout suppresses SIRT3, driving proinflammatory macrophages and exacerbated injury. As the dominant mitochondrial sirtuin, SIRT3 sustains mitochondrial function in hepatocytes during reperfusion stress. This protective role parallels SIRT3's cardioprotective function in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 保護對抗肝缺血—再灌流損傷：全身性 GPCR5 基因敲除抑制 SIRT3，驅動促發炎巨噬細胞與加劇的損傷。作為優勢的粒線體 sirtuin，SIRT3 在再灌流壓力下維持肝細胞的粒線體功能。此保護角色平行於 SIRT3 在心肌缺血—再灌流損傷中的心臟保護功能。

label: H3K56ac
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates H3K56ac, contributing to mitotic chromatin organization and genome stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 H3K56ac，有助於有絲分裂染色質組織和基因組穩定性。

label: Histone H4
description: SIRT2 deacetylates Lys16 on histone H4 (H4K16ac), a modification linked to chromatin condensation during the G2/M transition of mitosis. Removing H4K16ac promotes a more compact mitotic chromatin state compatible with chromosome segregation and mitotic fidelity. Enzymatically, SIRT2 directly deacetylates H4K16 to remodel chromatin at division, complementing its actions on α-tubulin and mitotic regulators. This chromatin function, together with SIRT2's peak expression at G2/M, couples deacetylation to cell-cycle control, and its loss is associated with mitotic defects, genomic instability, and, in some cancers, tumor progression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 上的 Lys16（H4K16ac），這種修飾與有絲分裂 G2/M 轉變期間的染色質凝縮相關。移除 H4K16ac 促進更緊密的有絲分裂染色質狀態，適合染色體分離和有絲分裂忠實度。在酶學上，SIRT2 直接去乙醯化 H4K16 以在分裂時重塑染色質，與其對 α-tubulin 和有絲分裂調節因子的作用互補。這種染色質功能與 SIRT2 在 G2/M 期的表達高峰相結合，將去乙醯化與細胞週期控制偶聯，其缺失與有絲分裂缺陷、基因組不穩定性以及某些癌症中的腫瘤進展相關。

label: lipid metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 prevents hepatic steatosis by deacetylating HNF4alpha, a master regulator of hepatic lipid genes, and suppresses adipocyte differentiation via FoxO1 deacetylation that restrains PPAR-gamma; reduced SIRT2 in obese adipose progenitors is linked to visceral fat expansion.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝臟脂質基因的主調控因子 HNF4α 來預防肝脂肪變性，並透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化抑制脂肪細胞分化（FoxO1 去乙醯化可抑制 PPAR-γ）；肥胖脂肪前體細胞中 SIRT2 的減少與內臟脂肪擴增相關。

label: carbohydrate metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 regulates carbohydrate metabolism by deacetylating G6PD (pentose phosphate pathway) and phosphoglycerate mutase (glycolysis) to influence NADPH production and glucose flux, and deacetylates PEPCK to support gluconeogenesis; these actions link SIRT2 to redox balance and metabolic control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 G6PD（磷酸戊糖途徑）和磷酸甘油酸變位酶（糖酵解）來調節碳水化合物代謝，影響 NADPH 產生和葡萄糖通量；並去乙醯化 PEPCK 以支持糖質新生；這些作用將 SIRT2 與氧化還原平衡和代謝控制聯繫起來。

label: Tenovin-6
description: Tenovin-6 inhibits SIRT2 with an IC50 of 10 μM, making SIRT2 its more potent sirtuin target compared with SIRT1. Directionally, Tenovin-6 blocks SIRT2 catalysis. By inhibiting SIRT2 deacetylation, it can protect neurons and reactivate p53, and it also inhibits SIRT3 with an IC50 of 67 μM, so its effects span multiple sirtuins. It is a chemical probe distinguishing SIRT2 from other sirtuins, and its p53-reactivation activity underlies its anticancer phenotype. The moderate potency and limited selectivity require careful interpretation of Tenovin-6 studies.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin-6 以 IC50 10 μM 抑制 SIRT2，使其成為相較於 SIRT1 更強效的 sirtuin 靶標。在方向性上，Tenovin-6 阻斷 SIRT2 催化作用。透過抑制 SIRT2 去乙醯化，它可以保護神經元並重新活化 p53，同時也以 IC50 67 μM 抑制 SIRT3，因此其效應跨越多個 sirtuin。它是區分 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的化學探針，其 p53 重新活化活性構成了其抗癌表型的基礎。中等效力和有限的選擇性需要謹慎詮釋 Tenovin-6 的研究。

label: Superoxide Dismutase
description: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) is an antioxidant enzyme that catalyzes the dismutation of superoxide anion into hydrogen peroxide and oxygen. In experiments with neutrophil homogenates, superoxide dismutase inhibits the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome, confirming that the reaction is driven by superoxide radicals. By removing superoxide, SOD blocks the radical-mediated catechol oxidation that initiates adrenochrome formation, interrupting both the initial oxidation and the regenerative redox cycle. This makes SOD a natural brake on the adrenochrome pathway under inflammatory conditions, and its age-related decline is thought to permit greater adrenaline oxidation in older organisms.
description_zh_TW: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）是一種催化超氧陰離子歧化為過氧化氫與氧的抗氧化酶。在中性球勻漿的實驗中，superoxide dismutase 抑制 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome，證實此反應由超氧自由基驅動。透過移除超氧，SOD 阻斷啟動 adrenochrome 形成的自由基介導兒茶酚氧化，中斷初始氧化與再生性氧化還原循環。這使 SOD 成為發炎條件下 adrenochrome 途徑的天然煞車，且其與年齡相關的下降被認為會容許年老個體中更多的 adrenaline 氧化。

label: Chronic Kidney Disease
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Semba and colleagues demonstrated in an older population of 1008 men and women aged 64 and older participating in the InCHIANTI study that elevated circulating AGEs were an independent predictor of renal function decline. Elevated plasma concentrations of CML were independently associated with chronic kidney disease and with the estimated glomerular filtration rate at baseline and after three and six years of follow-up. These findings suggest that the adverse effects of AGEs on the kidney apply to the general population of older community-dwelling adults, and that high CML levels may predict decreased renal function in the elderly.
description_zh_TW: Semba 及其同事在參與 InCHIANTI 研究的 1008 名 64 歲及以上老年男女性族群中證明，循環中升高的 AGE 是腎功能下降的獨立預測因子。升高的血漿 CML 濃度與慢性腎臟病以及基線時、三年與六年追蹤後的估計腎小球過濾率（estimated glomerular filtration rate）獨立相關。這些發現顯示，AGE 對腎臟的不良影響適用於一般社區居住的老年族群，且高 CML 濃度可能預測老年人的腎功能下降。

label: SMAD2
description: Phosphorylated SMAD2, together with SMAD3, complexes with SMAD4 and translocates to the nucleus to regulate target gene transcription downstream of Activin A-ALK4 signaling. This SMAD-dependent transduction is the principal route by which Activin A alters gene expression in receiving cells, driving expression of cell-cycle inhibitors that reinforce growth arrest. The pathway is a standard TGFbeta-superfamily output mechanism and is shared with TGF-beta1 signaling, explaining the functional overlap between these ligands in paracrine senescence. SMAD2/3 phosphorylation is therefore a key readout of Activin A activity in cell-based assays.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 一起，與 SMAD4 形成複合體並轉位至核，調節 Activin A-ALK4 訊號下游的標的基因轉錄。此 SMAD 依賴的轉導是 Activin A 改變受體細胞基因表現的主要途徑，驅動強化生長停滯的細胞週期抑制因子表現。此路徑是標準的 TGFbeta 超家族輸出機制，並與 TGF-beta1 訊號共享，解釋這些配體在旁分泌衰老中的功能重疊。SMAD2/3 磷酸化因此是細胞分析中 Activin A 活性的關鍵讀值。

label: ALIX
description: ALIX regulates Exosomes. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. Exosomes are nanovesicles shed by tumor cells that traffic immune-checkpoint ligands and growth signals within the microenvironment. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon Exosomes rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ALIX 調節 Exosomes。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 Exosomes 是腫瘤細胞脫落的奈米囊泡，在微環境中傳遞免疫檢查點配體和生長訊號。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 Exosomes 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: GATA4
description: SIRT7 ameliorates stress-induced cardiac hypertrophy by interacting with and deacetylating GATA4, a key cardiac transcription factor, modulating its target-gene program. Directionally, SIRT7 enzymatically regulates GATA4. This counters maladaptive hypertrophic signaling, and SIRT7-deficient mice display extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy. It is a nuclear mechanism by which SIRT7 protects the myocardium, complementing its nucleolar functions in ribosome biogenesis. The SIRT7-GATA4 interaction shows that SIRT7 controls cardiac gene expression through transcription-factor modification, and loss of this regulation contributes to pathological remodeling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 通過與 GATA4（一種關鍵的心臟轉錄因子）相互作用並去乙醯化它來改善壓力誘導的心臟肥大，調節其靶基因程序。在方向性上，SIRT7 在酶學上調節 GATA4。這對抗適應不良的肥大信號，SIRT7 缺乏的小鼠表現出廣泛的心肌纖維化和心肌病。這是 SIRT7 保護心肌的核內機制，與其在核糖體生物合成中的核仁功能互補。SIRT7-GATA4 相互作用表明 SIRT7 通過轉錄因子修飾控制心臟基因表達，此調節的缺失導致病理性重塑。

label: α-tubulin
description: SIRT1 deacetylates α-tubulin (alongside SIRT2), contributing to cytoskeletal/microtubule regulation and cytoplasmic deacetylase activity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 α-tubulin（與 SIRT2 協同），有助於細胞骨架/微管調控和細胞質去乙醯酶活性。

label: Cytoplasm
description: In breast tumor cell lines SIRT1 is found predominantly in the cytoplasm — very little nuclear signal — in contrast to the nuclear distribution seen in normal breast tissue. Cytoplasmic SIRT1 is the form that regulates the 14-3-3ζ-caspase-2 module, and cytoplasmic SIRT1 is also the form generated by caspase cleavage during apoptosis, where it behaves pro-apoptotically in a deacetylase-independent manner. Subcellular localization therefore flips SIRT1's functional valence: nuclear anti-apoptotic, cytoplasmic context-dependent.
description_zh_TW: 在乳腺癌細胞株中，SIRT1 主要分布於細胞質——核內訊號極少——與正常乳腺組織的細胞核分布形成對比。細胞質型 SIRT1 正是調控 14-3-3ζ-Caspase-2 模組的形式，也是細胞凋亡期間被 caspase 切割後產生的形式，此時它以不依賴去乙醯活性的方式促進凋亡。次細胞定位因此翻轉了 SIRT1 的功能極性：細胞核內抗凋亡，細胞質內則視情境而定。

label: Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition
description: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition (MET) are opposite and reversible programs of cellular plasticity. EMT converts polarized epithelial cells into migratory mesenchymal cells, repressing E-cadherin via transcription factors such as Snail, Slug, Twist, and ZEB1, whereas MET restores epithelial identity by silencing these factors and re-expressing E-cadherin and other epithelial genes. In cellular reprogramming the MET step is required to generate iPSCs, while EMT promotes the differentiation and dissemination programs that MET reverses.
description_zh_TW: 上皮到間質轉化（EMT）和間質到上皮轉化（MET）是細胞可塑性的相反且可逆的程序。 EMT 將極化上皮細胞轉化為遷移性間質細胞，透過 Snail、Slug、Twist 和 ZEB1 等轉錄因子抑制 E-鈣黏蛋白，而 MET 則透過沉默這些因子並重新表達 E-鈣黏蛋白和其他上皮基因來恢復上皮身份。在細胞重編程中，需要 MET 步驟來產生 iPSC，而 EMT 則促進 MET 逆轉的分化和傳播程序。

label: Aminochrome
description: Adrenochrome is an aminochrome, the class of oxidized, colored products formed from catecholamines. Aminochromes, specifically adrenochrome, are examined here as candidate senotherapeutics, and their chemistry, ortho-quinone electrophilicity and redox cycling, determines both their potential senolytic and senomorphic activity and their neurotoxicity and cardiotoxicity. As oxidation products of catecholamines such as epinephrine and dopamine, aminochromes are endogenous stress metabolites that accumulate under oxidative conditions.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺素色素是一種氨基色素，即由兒茶酚胺形成的氧化有色產物類。氨基色素，特別是腎上腺素色素，在此被研究為候選衰老治療藥物，其化學性質、鄰醌親電性和氧化還原循環決定了其潛在的溶細胞和衰老模仿活性，以及其神經毒性和心臟毒性。作為兒茶酚胺如腎上腺素和多巴胺的氧化產物，氨基色素是內源性壓力代謝物，在氧化條件下積累。

label: Caspase
description: Caspase-2 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-2, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-2 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 Caspase 是主動主體，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: fatty-acid metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 promotes fatty-acid metabolism by deacetylating and activating PGC-1alpha and PPARalpha to drive fatty-acid oxidation, represses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c, and mobilizes fat from white adipose tissue by repressing PPAR-gamma and aP2.
