This supports metabolic flexibility and the lean phenotype of caloric restriction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1alpha 和 PPARalpha 來促進脂肪酸氧化，透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成，並透過抑制 PPAR-gamma 和 aP2 從白色脂肪組織中動員脂肪。這支持了代謝靈活性和熱量限制的精瘦表型。

label: Natural Killer Cells
description: SASP chemokines including CCL2, CCL5, CXCL1, and CXCL10 act as find-me signals that recruit natural killer (NK) cells to sites of senescence. NK cells then directly kill senescent cells via NKG2D recognition of stress-induced ligands (MICA, MICB, ULBP2), making this recruitment a key arm of senescence surveillance that converts the secretome into an immune-clearance stimulus. Interferon signaling downstream of cGAS-STING in the senescent cell further boosts NK effector activity. The efficiency of recruitment and killing declines with age and immunosenescence, allowing senescent-cell accumulation, whereas enhancing this axis is an active therapeutic strategy to restore surveillance.
description_zh_TW: SASP 趨化因子包括 CCL2、CCL5、CXCL1 與 CXCL10 作為 find-me 訊號，招募自然殺手（NK）細胞至衰老部位。NK 細胞隨後透過 NKG2D 辨識壓力誘發配體（MICA、MICB、ULBP2）直接殺死衰老細胞，使此招募成為將分泌組轉化為免疫清除刺激的衰老監視關鍵臂。衰老細胞中 cGAS-STING 下游的干擾素訊號進一步增強 NK 效應活性。隨年齡與免疫衰老，招募與殺死效率下降，允許衰老細胞累積，而強化此軸是恢復監視的積極治療策略。

label: EGFR
description: Cancer is driven by EGFR. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The directionality runs from EGFR toward Cancer, so EGFR is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由EGFR 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。方向性從 EGFR 朝向 Cancer，因此 EGFR 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Stem Cells
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Excessive activation of the mTORC1 pathway leads to impaired proliferation and differentiation of stem cells, promoting their aging and apoptosis. Rapamycin's inhibition of mTORC1 can restore stem cell functionality and improve tissue regeneration, as demonstrated in animal models where it increased myogenic and chondrogenic differentiation of muscle cells and improved mesenchymal cell function in Klotho-deficient mice. The mechanism is mainly associated with activation of autophagy, which cleanses cells of damaged structures and increases their survival and resistance to stress, and rapamycin also induces growth factors such as IGF1 and VEGF.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1通路的過度激活導致幹細胞增殖和分化受損，促進其老化和凋亡。Rapamycin對mTORC1的抑製可以恢復幹細胞功能並改善組織再生，這在動物模型中得到證實，其中它增加了肌肉細胞的肌源性和軟骨源性分化，並改善了Klotho缺陷小鼠的間充質細胞功能。該機制主要與自噬激活有關，自噬清除細胞中的損傷結構並增加其存活和對壓力的抵抗力，rapamycin還誘導生長因子如IGF1和VEGF。

label: Glutamine metabolism
description: SIRT4 inhibits glutamine metabolism in colorectal cancer cells—for example by restraining GDH-dependent anaplerosis—acting as a tumor suppressor that limits nutrient fueling of proliferation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed glutamine catabolism. This constrains the glutamine addiction of many tumors, which rely on glutamine as a carbon and nitrogen source. It illustrates SIRT4's context-dependent tumor-suppressive role, contrasting with its metabolic-brake functions in normal tissue. Because glutamine metabolism supports both bioenergetics and nucleotide synthesis in cancer, SIRT4-mediated suppression of anaplerosis represents a potential therapeutic strategy.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 在大腸癌細胞中抑制穀氨酰胺代謝——例如通過限制 GDH 依賴性的回補反應——充時代謝抑制因子，限制增殖的營養燃料供應。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於抑制的穀氨酰胺分解代謝上游。這限制了許多腫瘤對穀氨酰胺的成癮依賴性，這些腫瘤依賴穀氨酰胺作為碳和氮源。它說明了 SIRT4 情境依賴性的腫瘤抑制角色，與其在正常組織中的代謝制動功能形成對比。由於穀氨酰胺代謝在癌症中支持生物能量學和核苷酸合成，SIRT4 介導的回補反應抑制代表了一種潛在的治療策略。

label: Proteins
description: Proteins are major targets of oxidative stress, sustaining side-chain oxidation, backbone fragmentation, and cross-linking that alter enzyme activity, signaling, and turnover. Because proteins are abundant and long-lived, they integrate oxidative exposure over time. The directionality is oxidant to protein modification. A caveat is that some oxidative modifications are reversible (e.g., methionine sulfoxide) and can serve signaling roles rather than purely damage. Protein oxidation markers such as carbonylation and 3-nitrotyrosine are therefore widely used to estimate the severity of oxidative burden in disease.
description_zh_TW: Proteins 是 oxidative stress 的主要靶標，維持側鏈氧化、主鏈斷裂和 cross 連接，從而改變酶活性、訊號傳導和周轉。由於 proteins 含量豐富且壽命長，因此它們會隨著時間的推移而整合氧化暴露。方向性是蛋白質修飾的氧化劑。需要注意的是，一些氧化修飾是可逆的（例如甲硫氨酸亞砜），並且可以發揮信號作用而不是純粹的損傷。因此，蛋白質氧化標記物（例如羰基化和 3-nitrotyrosine）被廣泛用於估計疾病中氧化負擔的嚴重程度。

label: IL-1β
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) decreases secretion of the pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-1beta in human immune cells. In healthy volunteers, 24-hour NR administration reduced IL-1beta secretion in monocytes by over 50% (from approximately 22,000 to 10,000 pg/mL) and in macrophages by around 20% (from above 300 to less than 250 pg/mL). This effect is mediated by SIRT3-dependent blunting of NLRP3 inflammasome activation and enhanced mitochondrial quality control. By reducing IL-1beta and TNF-alpha production, NR demonstrates systemic anti-inflammatory activity consistent with its NAD+-boosting and sirtuin-activating mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）降低人類免疫細胞中促發炎細胞激素 IL-1beta 的分泌。在健康志願者中，24 小時 NR 給藥使單核細胞中 IL-1beta 分泌減少超過 50%（從約 22,000 降至 10,000 pg/mL），巨噬細胞中減少約 20%（從 300 以上降至 250 以下 pg/mL）。此效應由 SIRT3 依賴性的 NLRP3 發炎體活化減弱以及增強的粒線體品質控制所介導。透過減少 IL-1beta 和 TNF-alpha 的產生，NR 展現出與其提升 NAD+ 及活化去乙醯酶機制一致的全身性抗發炎活性。

label: Smoking
description: Cigarette, cigar, and wood smoke contain enormous amounts of free radicals and oxidants (cigarette smoke alone carries on the order of 10^17 oxidant molecules per puff). These external oxidants directly increase reactive oxygen species, deplete antioxidants such as vitamin C and glutathione, and cause systemic oxidative stress. Smoke also activates sympathetic nervous system responses and inflammation, further raising endogenous ROS production. This oxidative environment promotes the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome and supports the redox cycle by which adrenochrome generates more superoxide, linking smoking to increased catecholamine oxidation and oxidative damage.
description_zh_TW: 香菸、雪茄與木柴煙霧含有大量自由基與氧化劑（單是香菸煙霧每口就帶有約 10^17 個氧化劑分子）。這些外部氧化劑直接增加活性氧物種、耗竭維生素 C 與麩胱甘肽等抗氧化劑，並造成全身性氧化壓力。煙霧也活化交感神經系統反應與發炎，進一步升高內源性 ROS 生成。此氧化環境促進 adrenaline 氧化為 adrenochrome，並支持 adrenochrome 藉以產生更多超氧陰離子的氧化還原循環，將吸菸與增加的兒茶酚胺氧化及氧化損傷連結起來。

label: Immune Aging
description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

label: Colorectal Cancer
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Ubiquitination-mediated SIRT1 degradation by SMURF2 suppresses colorectal cancer cell proliferation and tumorigenesis. This places SMURF2 on the tumor-suppressive side of the SIRT1-in-cancer debate: since SIRT1 supports survival of transformed epithelial cells, an E3 ligase that lowers SIRT1 abundance acts as a brake on tumor growth. It complements the DNA-damage arm (TRIM28) and the p53-axis arm (MDM2), giving three context-specific E3 ligases that control SIRT1 stability.
description_zh_TW: SMURF2 對 SIRT1 的泛素化降解會抑制大腸直腸癌細胞的增殖與腫瘤生成。這使 SMURF2 站在「SIRT1 與癌症」辯論中腫瘤抑制的一方：由於 SIRT1 支持轉化上皮細胞的存活，能降低 SIRT1 豐度的 E3 連接酶便成為腫瘤生長的煞車。它與 DNA 損傷臂（TRIM28）及 p53 軸線臂（MDM2）互補，共同構成三個依情境控制 SIRT1 穩定性的 E3 連接酶。

label: Macrophages
description: Mitochondrial signaling is increasingly implicated in macrophage biology, a cell type involved in processes from the inflammatory response to wound healing. LPS-stimulated macrophages show marked accumulation of the TCA cycle intermediate succinate, which stabilizes HIF-1alpha and leads to enhanced IL-1beta production; mitochondrial ROS generated by succinate oxidation is the critical signaling intermediate. Conversely, late-phase pro-resolving macrophages shift away from ROS-dependent signaling and adopt a UPRmt signature. This illustrates how the same mitochondrial stress pathways that produce hormesis also tune immune cell function.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體訊號傳導越來越與巨噬細胞生物學相關聯，巨噬細胞是參與從炎症反應到傷口癒合等過程的細胞類型。LPS 刺激的巨噬細胞顯示 TCA 循環中間體琥珀酸的顯著積累，琥珀酸穩定 HIF-1alpha 並導致 IL-1beta 產生增加；由琥珀酸氧化產生的粒線體 ROS 是關鍵的訊號中間體。相反地，後期促消退巨噬細胞轉離 ROS 依賴性訊號，並採用 UPRmt 特徵。這說明了產生促效應的相同粒線體壓力途徑如何也調節免疫細胞功能。

label: Senolytic
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senolytic. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senolytics are agents that preferentially kill senescent cells, often by disabling their anti-apoptotic SCAP survival networks. The directionality runs from Senolytic toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senolytic is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 用 Senolytic 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它們是優先殺死衰老細胞的藥物，通常是透過禁用其抗凋亡 SCAP 生存網絡來實現的。方向性從 Senolytic 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senolytic 是主動主體，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Cysteine
description: N-acetylcysteine is deacetylated to cysteine, whose availability governs the activity of glutamate-cysteine ligase, the rate-limiting enzyme of glutathione synthesis.
description_zh_TW: N-乙醯半胱胺酸去乙醯化為半胱胺酸，其可用性決定穀胱甘肽合成限速酶麩胺酸-半胱胺酸連接酶的活性。

label: Acute Stress-Associated Phenotype
description: The acute stress-associated phenotype (ASAP) is the early, prompt cellular response mounted upon stress before full senescence markers become evident; it can transition into the chronic SASP. ASAP represents a pre-secretome state that licenses subsequent inflammatory output, establishing a temporal hierarchy in which stress sensing occurs first and durable secretome production follows. Understanding ASAP helps separate acute protective responses from chronic, deleterious senescence inflammation. The distinction has therapeutic implications, as agents that block the ASAP-to-SASP transition could prevent inflammation before it becomes entrenched.
description_zh_TW: 急性壓力相關表型（ASAP）是壓力出現後、完整衰老標記顯現前 mounted 的早期、迅速細胞反應；它可轉變為慢性 SASP。ASAP 代表許可後續發炎輸出的前分泌組狀態，建立壓力感知先發生、持久分泌組產生隨後的時間層級。了解 ASAP 有助分離急性保護性反應與慢性、有害的衰老發炎。此區別有治療意涵，因阻斷 ASAP-to-SASP 轉變的藥劑可在發炎根深蒂固前預防之。

label: CDK2
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: p21CIP1 inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 2 (CDK2) by binding the cyclin E/A-CDK2 complex, preventing phosphorylation of Rb and thereby enforcing G1/S arrest. This is a direct enzymatic inhibition central to p53-driven senescence and quiescence, and by blocking S-phase entry, p21 locks cells out of the cell cycle. Its inhibitory action is a canonical CDK-inhibitor function and operates alongside p16/p15-mediated CDK4/6 inhibition. The cooperation between CIP/KIP and INK4 inhibitors provides redundant, robust arrest enforcement.
description_zh_TW: p21CIP1 透過結合 cyclin E/A-CDK2 複合體抑制細胞週期依賴激酶 2（CDK2），防止 Rb 磷酸化從而強制 G1/S 停滯。這是對 p53 驅動衰老與靜止至關的直接酶抑制，且透過阻斷 S 期進入，p21 將細胞鎖出細胞週期。其抑制動作是典型的 CDK 抑制因子功能，並與 p16/p15 介導的 CDK4/6 抑制並行運作。CIP/KIP 與 INK4 抑制因子的合作提供冗餘、強健的停滯執行。

label: Vitamin C
description: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) exhibits reducing properties similar to methylene blue and can serve as an alternative treatment for methemoglobinemia, though with significant limitations. Ascorbic acid reduces methemoglobin through a slower, nonenzymatic pathway that often requires multiple doses over several hours to achieve a significant effect. Although case reports demonstrate successful treatment with high-dose vitamin C, it is unlikely to be effective in a resuscitation situation. Vitamin C is most appropriate when methylene blue is contraindicated, such as in patients with G6PD deficiency, or when methylene blue is unavailable.
description_zh_TW: 維生素 C（抗壞血酸）表現出類似甲烯藍的還原特性，可作為高鐵血紅蛋白血症的替代治療，但有顯著限制。抗壞血酸通過較慢的非酵素途徑還原高鐵血紅蛋白，通常需要在數小時內多次給藥才能達到顯著效果。儘管個案報告證明高劑量維生素 C 治療成功，但在復甦情況下不太可能有效。維生素 C 最適合在甲烯藍禁忌時使用，例如 G6PD 缺乏症患者，或在甲烯藍不可用時。

label: Vascular Calcification
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 counteracts vascular calcification via mitochondrial function preservation and oxidative stress mitigation, deacetylating proteins in the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway to promote mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification. AMPK/SIRT3 axis activation attenuated mineralization through mitochondrial functional restoration, and sEH deficiency preserves SIRT3 bioavailability to impede VC progression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過維護粒線體功能和減輕氧化壓力來對抗血管鈣化，去乙醯化 PGC-1alpha/TFAM 途徑中的蛋白以促進粒線體生成同時減輕血管平滑肌細胞鈣化。AMPK/SIRT3 軸線活化透過粒線體功能恢復減輕礦化，sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 可用性以阻礙 VC 進展。

label: lipogenesis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 suppresses de novo lipogenesis by deacetylating histone H3 at the SREBP promoter, inhibiting SREBP1/2 and ChREBP — reinforcing its anti-Warburg, anti-cancer metabolic program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過在 SREBP 啟動子處去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 來抑制從頭脂肪生成，進而抑制 SREBP1/2 與 ChREBP——強化其抗 Warburg、抗癌的代謝程序。

label: Bmf
description: Bmf is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bmf, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bmf the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bmf 是Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從 Bcl-2 family 向 Bmf，因此 Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bmf 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: PIDD
description: PIDD forms PIDDosome. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon PIDDosome rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: PIDD 形式PIDDosome。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 PIDDosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: IL-1α
description: IL-1a is an apical SASP amplifier that sits at the top of the inflammatory cascade, and its proteolytic cleavage (by caspase-5 or calpain) is essential for full SASP regulatory function. Cell-surface and secreted IL-1a engage IL-1R on neighboring cells, activating MyD88-dependent NF-kB signaling that both sustains the SASP in the sender and induces paracrine senescence in recipients. As a master initiator rather than a passive component, IL-1a integrates with the noncanonical inflammasome, whose caspase-5 cleavage licenses the secretome. Its centrality makes IL-1a a key mechanistic and therapeutic node.
description_zh_TW: IL-1α 是位於發炎級聯頂端的頂層 SASP 放大器，其蛋白水解切割（由 caspase-5 或 calpain）對完整 SASP 調節功能不可或缺。細胞表面與分泌的 IL-1α 接合鄰近細胞的 IL-1R，活化 MyD88 依賴的 NF-κB 訊號，既維持傳送者的 SASP 又誘發受體者的旁分泌衰老。作為主要啟動者而非被動組成，IL-1α 與非典型發炎體整合，後者的 caspase-5 切割許可分泌組。其中心性使 IL-1α 成為關鍵的機制與治療節點。

label: Multidrug Resistance
description: Elevated HSP27 correlates with resistance to chemotherapy (e.g., docetaxel) in prostate and other cancers.
description_zh_TW: HSP27 升高與前列腺癌及其他癌症對化療（如 docetaxel）的抗性相關。

label: TGF-β
description: Beyond SIRT1, SMURF2's canonical function is negative regulation of TGF-β/BMP signaling: as a HECT-domain E3 ligase it ubiquitinates SMAD proteins and SMAD7-bound receptor complexes, shaping the strength and duration of the pathway. This dual identity — SMAD regulator and SIRT1 E3 — makes SMURF2 a node where developmental signaling and sirtuin-controlled stress metabolism intersect.
description_zh_TW: 除了 SIRT1 之外，SMURF2 的典型功能是對 TGF-β/BMP 訊號的負向調節：作為 HECT 結構域的 E3 連接酶，它會泛素化 SMAD 蛋白及與 SMAD7 結合的受體複合體，從而塑造路徑的強度與持續時間。這種雙重身份——SMAD 調節者與 SIRT1 的 E3——使 SMURF2 成為發育訊號與 sirtuin 控制的壓力代謝相互交會的節點。

label: Bid
description: Bid is a BH3-only direct activator: in the absence of anti-apoptotic restraint it can directly bind and trigger BAX (and BAK), bypassing the need for sensitizer displacement. In the extrinsic pathway, caspase-8 cleavage of Bid (tBid) routes death-receptor signals into the intrinsic mitochondrial arm in type II cells, and in ischemia-reperfusion injury models caspase-1 cleavage of Bid likewise converts pyroptotic signaling into mitochondrial apoptosis when gasdermin pores are unavailable.
description_zh_TW: Bid 是 BH3-only 的直接活化因子：在缺乏抗凋亡抑制時，它可直接結合並觸發 BAX（與 BAK），無需敏化因子的置換。在外在路徑中，caspase-8 對 Bid 的切割（tBid）使死亡受體訊號在 type II 細胞中轉入內在粒線體臂；而在缺血再灌注損傷模型中，Caspase-1 對 Bid 的切割同樣可在 gasdermin 孔道缺席時，將焦亡訊號轉為粒線體凋亡。

label: Oxidative Phosphorylation
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Adrenochrome can uncouple oxidative phosphorylation in mitochondria, particularly in cardiac tissue. Through Complex I-mediated redox cycling, adrenochrome accepts electrons and regenerates superoxide, diverting the electron transport chain from ATP synthesis and dissipating the proton gradient. This mitochondrial impairment reduces ATP production, damages mitochondria, and can promote cell death pathways, contributing to cardiotoxicity. The effect is most relevant in tissues with high catecholamine exposure and mitochondrial density, such as the heart, and it helps explain why adrenaline oxidation products are implicated in myocardial damage under conditions of chronic stress or ischemia-reperfusion.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 可使粒線體中的氧化磷酸化去偶聯，特別是在心臟組織中。透過 Complex I 介導的氧化還原循環，adrenochrome 接受電子並再生超氧陰離子，將電子傳遞鏈從 ATP 合成轉移並耗散質子梯度。此粒線體損傷減少 ATP 生成、損害粒線體，並能促進細胞死亡途徑，促成心臟毒性。此效應在兒茶酚胺暴露高與粒線體密度高的組織（如心臟）中最為相關，並有助於解釋為何在慢性壓力或缺血-再灌注條件下 adrenaline 氧化產物與心肌損傷有關。

label: Neuromelanin synthesis
description: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra. In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment. Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra。In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment。Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain。

label: Cell Cycle Arrest
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: SIRT1 governs cell-cycle checkpoints by deacetylating p53 (reducing its transcriptional activity) and RB, supporting DNA-repair-coupled arrest rather than apoptosis or premature senescence; age-related SIRT1 decline biases G1/S and G2/M responses toward senescence (reviewed in the source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 p53（減少其轉錄活性）和 RB 來控制細胞週期檢查點，支持 DNA 修復偶聯的停滯而非凋亡或過早衰老；與年齡相關的 SIRT1 下降使 G1/S 和 G2/M 反應偏向衰老（參見文獻綜述）。

label: BMAL1
description: SIRT1 deacetylates BMAL1, a core circadian transcription factor, gating circadian NAD+ oscillations and coupling metabolic state to clock-gene expression. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically tunes BMAL1. This places sirtuins at the interface of circadian rhythm and metabolism, and it explains how NAD+ rhythms drive daily transcriptional programs. Because BMAL1/CLOCK regulate NAMPT, the circadian system controls NAD+ production, which in turn activates SIRT1, which deacetylates BMAL1 to feed back on the clock. This SIRT1-BMAL1-NAMPT loop couples daily rhythms to cellular energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 BMAL1——一種核心生物鐘轉錄因子——調控晝夜節律性 NAD+ 振盪並將代謝狀態與時鐘基因表達偶聯。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式調節 BMAL1。這將 sirtuin 置於晝夜節律和代謝的交界處，並解釋了 NAD+ 節律如何驅動每日轉錄程式。由於 BMAL1/CLOCK 調控 NAMPT，生物鐘系統控制 NAD+ 的產生，後者反過來活化 SIRT1，SIRT1 去乙醯化 BMAL1 回饋到時鐘。此 SIRT1-BMAL1-NAMPT 迴路將每日節律與細胞能量代謝偶聯。

label: Streptomyces avermectinius
description: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
description_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

label: Kitasato Institute
description: Satoshi Omura performed the soil-microbe screening that isolated Streptomyces avermectinius at the Kitasato Institute, Tokyo.
description_zh_TW: Satoshi Omura 在東京 Kitasato Institute 進行了土壤微生物篩選並分離出 Streptomyces avermectinius。

label: Fibrosis
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD) and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. DMD is characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration, and decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression are also observed in this condition. By improving muscular strength, rejuvenating senescent muscle stem cells, and reducing levels of inflammation and fibrosis, NR could be effective in managing the progression of muscular dystrophy and degeneration. These findings support the use of NR for the human condition of DMD.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）被發現能改善 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。DMD 的特徵為 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化，且在此疾病中亦觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低。透過改善肌肉力量、使衰老的肌肉幹細胞年輕化，以及降低發炎與纖維化程度，NR 可能有效管理肌肉營養不良與退化的進程。這些發現支持將 NR 用於人類 DMD 病症。

label: Intrinsic Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Intrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Intrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Intrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Intrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Innate Immune System
description: Mitochondria act as platforms for orchestrating innate immune responses to external threats. The MAVS protein, an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor, binds retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) that sense viral RNA, self-propagates in a prion-like fashion, and recruits TRAF2, TRAF6, and RIPK1 to activate antiviral signaling. Additionally, mitochondrial ROS prime the NLRP3 inflammasome, whose activation leads to caspase-1 activation and proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta, linking mitochondrial stress to the inflammatory response.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 作為 orchestrate innate immune responses to external threats 的平台。MAVS 蛋白是一種外線粒體膜 adaptor，結合 retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) 感測 viral RNA，以 prion-like fashion 自我增殖，並招募 TRAF2、TRAF6 和 RIPK1 激活 antiviral signaling。此外，mitochondrial ROS priming NLRP3 inflammasome，其 activation 導致 caspase-1 activation 和 proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta，將 mitochondrial stress 與 inflammatory response 連結。

label: Hemolysis
description: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions. Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated. These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions。Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated。These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes。

label: Glycine
description: GlyNAC combines glycine and N-acetylcysteine (NAC) to jointly support glutathione synthesis, overcoming the dual glycine-and-cysteine limitation that limits NAC alone.
description_zh_TW: GlyNAC 由甘胺酸與 N-乙醯半胱胺酸（NAC）組成，共同支持穀胱甘肽合成，克服單用 NAC 時甘胺酸與半胱胺酸雙重限制的問題。

label: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins
description: Apoptosis is inhibited by Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The directionality runs from Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins toward Apoptosis, so Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 被 Apoptosis 抑制。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。方向性從Apoptosis向Apoptosis延伸，因此Apoptosis是活性劑，Apoptosis是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Polyphenols
description: Polyphenols activate NRF2 by modifying KEAP1 cysteine residues, releasing NRF2 to induce more than 200 cytoprotective and antioxidant genes. This harnesses the cell's own defense program rather than only direct scavenging. The directionality is electrophilic polyphenol to NRF2-dependent transcription. A caveat is that the specific cysteines and magnitude of activation differ among polyphenol structures and depend on metabolism. Examples include resveratrol, curcumin, and EGCG, whose electrophilic moieties and metabolites trigger NRF2 stabilization.
description_zh_TW: Polyphenols 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸殘基活化 NRF2，釋放 NRF2 誘導 200 多個細胞保護和抗氧化基因。這利用了細胞自身的防禦程序，而不僅僅是直接清除。方向性是親電子多酚到NRF2依賴的轉錄。需要注意的是，多酚結構之間的特定半胱氨酸和活化程度不同，並且取決於代謝。例子包括白藜蘆醇、薑黃素和 EGCG，其親電子部分和代謝物可觸發 NRF2 穩定。

label: Carbazochrome
description: Carbazochrome is the monosemicarbazone of adrenochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone; PubChem CID 2557), formed by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to stabilize the otherwise labile molecule (US Patent 2506294; J Pharm Soc Jpn 1956). This stabilization reduces its redox activity relative to adrenochrome, so carbazochrome should NOT be assumed to redox-cycle at Complex I like adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: 卡巴可羅是腎上腺素紅的一縮胺基脲（腎上腺素紅單縮胺基脲；PubChem CID 2557），由腎上腺素紅的醌羰基與縮胺基脲縮合而成，以穩定原本不穩定的分子（美國專利 2506294；日本藥學會誌 1956）。此穩定化降低了其相對於腎上腺素紅的氧化還原活性，因此不應假設卡巴可羅會像腎上腺素紅那樣在 Complex I 發生氧化還原循環。

label: PI3K/Akt
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: PI3K/AKT signaling regulates Sirt3 in various contexts, generally opposing SIRT3-mediated catabolic/mitochondrial programs (e.g., PI3K/AKT modulates Sirt3 in activated microglia); Table 3 lists PI3K/AKT among negative regulators of the SIRT3 pathway (PMID 37930585).
description_zh_TW: PI3K/AKT 信號在多種環境中調節 Sirt3，通常拮抗 SIRT3 介導的分解代謝/粒線體程序（例如 PI3K/AKT 在活化的小膠質細胞中調節 Sirt3）；表 3 將 PI3K/AKT 列為 SIRT3 通路的負向調節因子（PMID 37930585）。

label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia form a disease spectrum rather than fully separate disorders, since they share a common genetic basis and protein pathology. ALS is primarily a motor neuron disease, but the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion and TDP-43 pathology that cause familial ALS are also the most common hereditary causes of FTD, producing overlapping FTD-ALS syndromes. Thus ALS can give rise to frontotemporal dementia when the neurodegenerative process extends into the frontal and temporal lobes.
description_zh_TW: 肌萎縮側索硬化症和額顳葉失智症形成了一個疾病譜，而不是完全獨立的疾病，因為它們具有共同的遺傳基礎和蛋白質病理學。 ALS 主要是一種運動神經元疾病，但導致家族性 ALS 的 C9orf72 六核苷酸重複擴增和 TDP-43 病理也是 FTD 最常見的遺傳原因，產生重疊的 FTD-ALS 綜合徵。因此，當神經退化過程延伸到額葉和顳葉時，ALS 可能會導致額顳葉失智症。

label: Kidney Fibrosis
description: SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis through CTGF suppression, and SRT1720 attenuates UUO fibrosis, while SIRT1 represses HIF2alpha. However, SIRT1 downregulation may also inhibit fibroblast activation via EGFR/PDGFR-beta, creating therapeutic ambiguity. The dominant role is renoprotective, opposing tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過度表現透過抑制 CTGF 廢除 TGF-beta1 誘發的凋亡與纖維化，且 SRT1720 減弱 UUO 纖維化，而 SIRT1 抑制 HIF2alpha。然而，SIRT1 下調亦可經由 EGFR/PDGFR-beta 抑制纖維母細胞活化，造成治療上的曖昧。其優勢角色為腎保護，對抗小管間質纖維化。

label: Oocyte
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: In mouse oocytes aged in vivo or in vitro, expression of SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT3 is dramatically reduced; prolonged expression of these sirtuins reduces postovulatory oocyte ageing. Directionally, loss of SIRT3 (with SIRT1/2) accompanies oocyte ageing. SIRT1 and SIRT3 act as redox sensors in oocytes, implicating them in female fertility and age-related reproductive decline.
description_zh_TW: 在體內或體外老化的鼠卵母細胞中，SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT3 的表現顯著降低；延長這些 sirtuin 的表現可減少排卵後卵母細胞老化。方向性上 SIRT3（連同 SIRT1/2）的缺失伴隨卵母細胞老化。SIRT1 和 SIRT3 在卵母細胞中作為氧化還原感測器，將它們與女性生育力和年齡相關的生殖功能衰退聯繫起來。

label: β-Catenin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT1 catalyzes removal of acetyl groups from β-catenin, and this deacetylation suppresses β-catenin's ability to activate transcription and drive cell proliferation. The modification dampens the Wnt transcriptional output of the protein at target promoters. This is one of the tumor-suppressive arms of SIRT1 in cancer, complementing its deacetylation of the RelA/p65 NF-κB subunit. Directionality is enzymatic: SIRT1 is the deacetylase and β-catenin the substrate, and the net effect is reduced oncogenic transcriptional signaling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 催化去除 β-catenin 上的乙醯基，這種去乙醯化作用抑制 β-catenin 活化轉錄和驅動細胞增殖的能力。此修飾在靶啟動子處降低該蛋白的 Wnt 轉錄輸出。這是 SIRT1 在癌症中的腫瘤抑制功能之一，與其對 RelA/p65 NF-κB 次單元的去乙醯化作用互補。方向性為酵素性的：SIRT1 是去乙醯酶，β-catenin 是受質，最終效果是減少致癌性轉錄訊號。

label: Ku70
description: SIRT1 deacetylates Ku70 (Cohen 2004), the DNA-repair factor and Ku-complex subunit that also binds and inhibits the pro-apoptotic protein Bax. Deacetylation increases Ku70's affinity for Bax, sequestering Bax away from mitochondria and preventing outer-membrane permeabilization, coupling DNA-damage signaling to cell-survival decisions. This links SIRT1's genome-maintenance functions to a direct anti-apoptotic program; in some cancers the same axis helps tumor cells evade death, showing how a survival pathway can be co-opted in oncogenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 Ku70（Cohen 2004），這是一種 DNA 修復因子和 Ku 複合體亞基，它也結合並抑制促凋亡蛋白 Bax。去乙醯化增加 Ku70 對 Bax 的親和力，將 Bax 滯留在細胞質中，防止外膜通透化，將 DNA 損傷信號與細胞存活決定偶聯起來。這將 SIRT1 的基因組維護功能與直接的抗凋亡程序聯繫起來；在某些癌症中，同樣的軸有助於腫瘤細胞逃避免疫，顯示生存通路如何在腫瘤發生中被利用。

label: H4K16
description: SIRT1 removes the acetyl group from Lys16 of histone H4, a site whose acetylation is linked to telomeric and rDNA silencing and genome stability. Deacetylation at H4K16 promotes a more compact chromatin fiber and is shared with SIRT2 at this residue in certain contexts. The relationship is directional and repressive: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation consolidates heterochromatin-like states. Defective H4K16 deacetylation is associated with the genomic instability seen when SIRT1 function is compromised.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 從組蛋白 H4 的 Lys16 上移除乙醯基，該位點的乙醯化與端粒和 rDNA 沉默以及基因組穩定性相關。H4K16 的去乙醯化促進更緊密的染色質纖維，並在某些情況下與 SIRT2 共同作用於此殘基。其方向性為抑制性的：SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化鞏固異染色質樣狀態。H4K16 去乙醯化缺陷與 SIRT1 功能受損時出現的基因組不穩定性相關。

label: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 expression is significantly reduced in degenerated intervertebral discs, and its knockdown further exacerbates deterioration of nucleus pulposus cells under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis, while SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo, and hydrogel microspheres upregulating both SIRT3 and SOD2 maintain NPC viability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 表現在退化的椎間盤中顯著降低，其進一步敲減在氧化壓力下加劇髓核細胞的退化。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，而 SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度，同時上調 SIRT3 和 SOD2 的水凝膠微球維護 NPC 存活率。

label: Angiogenesis
description: Cancer induces Angiogenesis. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 誘發Angiogenesis。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Monoamine oxidase
description: Methylene blue is a potent inhibitor of monoamine oxidase, specifically MAO-A. This MAO-A inhibition means that combining methylene blue with serotonergic medications - such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), or certain pain relievers - can cause a life-threatening accumulation of serotonin (serotonin syndrome). This drug-interaction risk is a critical safety consideration when methylene blue is used clinically, particularly in the perioperative or critical-care setting.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue是單胺氧化酶的強效抑制劑，特別是MAO-A。這種MAO-A抑制意味著將methylene blue與血清素能藥物——如選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRIs）、血清素-去甲腎上腺素再吸收抑制劑（SNRIs）或某些止痛藥——結合使用可能導致危及生命的血清素積累（血清素症候群）。當methylene blue在臨床上使用時，這種藥物相互作用風險是關鍵的安全考慮因素，特別是在圍手术期或重症護理環境中。

label: COX-2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) suppresses inflammation and oxidative stress by downregulating cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2). In LPS-activated mouse and human macrophage cell lines (THP-1 and RAW264.7), treatment with 500 uM NMN decreased pro-inflammatory cytokine production and efficiently alleviated LPS-induced inflammation via the COX-2-PGE2 axis. NMN markedly decreased mRNA expression and extracellular secretion of IL-6 and IL-1beta and lowered cellular prostaglandin E2 levels, while proteins related to the inflammatory response such as RELL1, PTGS2, FGA, FGB, and igkv12-44 were reduced. NMN also suppressed prostanoid biosynthesis and NF-kB signaling, demonstrating broad anti-inflammatory activity in innate immune cells.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）透過下調環氧合酶-2（COX-2）抑制發炎與氧化壓力。在 LPS 活化的小鼠與人類巨噬細胞株（THP-1 和 RAW264.7）中，以 500 uM NMN 處理降低了促發炎細胞激素的產生，並透過 COX-2-PGE2 軸有效緩解 LPS 誘發的發炎。NMN 顯著降低 IL-6 和 IL-1beta 的 mRNA 表現與細胞外分泌，並降低細胞內前列腺素 E2 水平，而與發炎反應相關的蛋白如 RELL1、PTGS2、FGA、FGB 和 igkv12-44 則減少。NMN 也抑制類前列腺素生合成與 NF-kB 訊息傳導，展現先天免疫細胞中廣泛的抗發炎活性。

label: SRT1460
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT1460 is a potent, chemically diverse second-generation sirtuin-activating compound reported alongside SRT1720 and SRT2183 as more effective activators than the polyphenolic STACs. Most compounds of this class were also reported to have anticancer activity. A major caveat is that the mechanism of SRT1460 action remains unclear: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and the metabolic effects may reflect indirect actions (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK axis) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 enhances SIRT1 activity in assay systems, but interpretation of in vivo effects requires caution.
description_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種強效的、化學結構多樣的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起被報導為比多酚類 STAC 更有效的活化劑。此類化合物大多據報導具有抗癌活性。主要的注意事項是 SRT1460 的作用機制仍不清楚：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，且代謝效果可能反映間接作用（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 軸線）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 在試驗系統中增強 SIRT1 活性，但對體內效果的詮釋需要謹慎。

label: SRT2183
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT2183 is a potent second-generation sirtuin-activating compound identified with SRT1720 and SRT1460 as chemically diverse, more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation was frequently demonstrable only with fluorescently tagged substrates, and metabolic effects may be indirect (cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 activation. Directionally, SRT2183 stimulates SIRT1 deacetylase activity in biochemical assays. These caveats frame the ongoing debate about the physiological relevance of STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
description_zh_TW: SRT2183 是一種強效的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT1460 一起被鑑定為化學結構多樣、比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能在螢光標記的受質下驗證，且代謝益處可能反映間接作用（cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 活化。方向性上 SRT2183 在生化試驗中刺激 SIRT1 去乙醯酶活性。這些注意事項構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化生理相關性的持續爭論。

label: GW5074
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: GW5074, an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor, was tested with other kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 because sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. It showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range, placing it alongside the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 as a kinase-scaffold sirtuin inhibitor. Directionally, GW5074's scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, underscoring the value of structure-based follow-up for selectivity.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 最初是作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物，與其他激酶抑制劑一起被測試對 SIRT2 的活性，因為 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。它在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性，與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 一起被歸類為激酶骨架 sirtuin 抑制劑。方向性上 GW5074 的骨架結構使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了針對選擇性進行結構導向後續研究的價值。

label: Ro31-8220
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Ro31-8220, a bisindolylmaleimide originally developed as a protein kinase C inhibitor, was identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 on the rationale that sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. It showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range. Directionally, the shared adenosine scaffold allows this kinase inhibitor to engage sirtuin NAD+ binding. Because it retains potent kinase activity, Ro31-8220 serves as both a probe of sirtuin biology and a caution about off-target effects in sirtuin inhibitor studies.
description_zh_TW: Ro31-8220 最初是作為蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑開發的雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺，透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的活性而被鑑定，其原理是 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。它在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性。方向性上共享的腺嘌呤骨架允許此激酶抑制劑與 sirtuin NAD+ 結合位點結合。由於其保留強效激酶活性，Ro31-8220 既作為 sirtuin 生物學的探針，也警示 sirtuin 抑制劑研究中的脫靶效應。

label: Fatty acid oxidation
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: SIRT5 activates fatty-acid oxidation enzymes (VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD, ECHA) via desuccinylation, supporting lipid catabolism during fasting; SIRT5 deficiency impairs fatty-acid metabolism and lowers ATP.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化活化脂肪酸氧化酶（VLCAD、LCAD、MCAD、ECHA），支持禁食期間的脂質分解代謝；SIRT5 缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝並降低 ATP。

label: Human Growth Hormone
description: Human growth hormone (HGH) is widely used for rejuvenation and longevity, yet it actually accelerates aging and shortens lifespan. Growth hormone is a pro-aging hormone because it indirectly activates mTOR, and the hype around growth hormone is based on a single publication that misinterpreted its acute effects. Unlike HGH, the anti-aging effects of rapamycin are not based on a single paper or a wild guess but on the work of thousands of scientists studying mTOR and its inhibitors in diverse organisms from yeast to humans.
description_zh_TW: 人類生長激素（HGH）被廣泛用於回春與長壽，但它實際上會加速衰老並縮短壽命。生長激素是促衰老激素，因為它會間接活化 mTOR；而生長激素的炒作源於單一出版物誤解了其急性效應。與 HGH 不同，雷帕黴素的抗衰老效果並非基於單一論文或隨意猜測，而是基於數千名科學家從酵母菌到人類等各種生物中研究 mTOR 及其抑制劑的成果。

label: Proteasome
source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, aging, and neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.md
description: DNA damage drives SIRT1 loss post-transcriptionally through the ubiquitin-proteasome system, not autophagy-lysosomes and not mRNA downregulation. Cycloheximide chase showed a shortened SIRT1 half-life under etoposide; qRT-PCR showed unchanged SIRT1 mRNA; and only the proteasome inhibitor MG132 — not bafilomycin A1 or chloroquine — restored SIRT1 levels while its K48-polyubiquitination rose. This establishes UPS-dependent turnover as the mechanism of SIRT1 downregulation in the DDR.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷透過泛素-蛋白酶體系統（而非自噬-溶酶體、也非 mRNA 下調）以轉錄後方式造成 SIRT1 減少。cycloheximide chase 顯示 etoposide 下 SIRT1 半衰期縮短；qRT-PCR 顯示 SIRT1 mRNA 不變；且只有蛋白酶體抑制劑 MG132——而非 bafilomycin A1 或 chloroquine——能恢復 SIRT1 水平，同時其 K48 多泛素化上升。這確立了依賴 UPS 的代謝是 DDR 中 SIRT1 下調的機制。

label: SCAPs
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is resisted by SCAPs. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senescent-cell anti-apoptotic pathways are networks (Bcl-2 family, PI3K/Akt) that senescent cells upregulate to resist death and persist. The directionality runs from SCAPs toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so SCAPs is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 受到 SCAPs 的抵抗。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。衰老細胞抗凋亡途徑是衰老細胞上調以抵抗死亡並持續存在的網絡（Bcl-2 family、PI3K/Akt）。方向性從 SCAPs 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 SCAPs 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: catechol flavonoid
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Fisetin is a catechol-containing flavonoid, a flavonol found in fruits and vegetables such as strawberries and apples, and its catechol ring makes it both a substrate for and a potential inhibitor of COMT. As a dietary catechol, it is O-methylated by COMT during metabolism, linking its pharmacokinetics to COMT genotype. At high supplemental doses it can compete with endogenous catechols for the enzyme, though physiological dietary intake is generally modest. It is studied for its antioxidant, senolytic, and neuroprotective properties.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種含兒茶酚的黃酮類化合物，是一種存在於草莓和蘋果等水果和蔬菜中的黃酮醇，其兒茶酚環使其既是 COMT 的底物，又是 COMT 的潛在抑制劑。作為一種膳食兒茶酚，它在代謝過程中被 COMT O-甲基化，從而將其藥物動力學與 COMT genotype 聯繫起來。在高補充劑量下，它可以與內源性兒茶酚競爭酶，儘管生理飲食攝取量通常是適度的。人們對其抗氧化劑、senolytic 和 neuroprotective properties 進行了研究。

label: Apoptosome
description: Intrinsic Pathway activates Apoptosome. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. The relationship is directional, with Intrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosome rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 啟動Apoptosome。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。這種關係是有方向的，Intrinsic Pathway 充當Apoptosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: NLRP3
description: SIRT3 — a key mitophagy regulator — decreases NLRP3 inflammasome activation in human macrophages by reducing ROS, for example in electrical-stimulation models of Val-boroPro-induced pyroptosis. Because mtROS is a canonical second signal for NLRP3 assembly, SIRT3's control of mitochondrial redox places it upstream of inflammasome priming. Quercetin's promotion of mitophagy and MSC-exosome-mediated mitophagy suppression of microglial pyroptosis act on the same axis, while Parkin additionally restrains NF-κB via A20 induction.
description_zh_TW: 作為粒線體自噬的關鍵調節者，SIRT3 藉由降低 ROS 抑制人類巨噬細胞中 NLRP3 發炎體的活化（例如在 Val-boroPro 誘導焦亡的電刺激模型中）。由於 mtROS 是 NLRP3 組裝的典型第二訊號，SIRT3 對粒線體氧化還原的控制使其位於發炎體致敏的上游。Quercetin 促進粒線體自噬、以及間質幹細胞外泌體促進粒線體自噬以抑制小膠細胞焦亡，都作用在同一軸線上；此外 Parkin 亦可透過誘導 A20 抑制 NF-κB。

label: Hemoglobin
description: Hemoglobin, which is abundant in erythrocytes, can catalyze the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome in blood. This is more of a chemical reaction occurring in the presence of oxygen or radicals than active production by red blood cells themselves, and it involves hemoglobin-catalyzed peroxidation/oxidation processes. As a result, adrenochrome can form in blood as a reactant or byproduct, but red blood cells do not actively produce it, since erythrocytes lack the organelles and major oxidative enzymes found in neutrophils or adrenal cells.
description_zh_TW: Hemoglobin在erythrocytes中含量豐富，能在血液中催化epinephrine氧化為adrenochrome。這更像是在氧氣或自由基存在下發生的化學反應，而非red blood cells本身主動生成的產物，且涉及hemoglobin所催化的peroxidation/oxidation過程。因此，adrenochrome可在血液中作為反應物或副產物形成，但red blood cells並不主動生成它，因為erythrocytes缺乏neutrophils或adrenal cells所具有的胞器與主要氧化酶。

label: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: In an oncogenic mouse model, supplementation with NMN (500 mg/kg body weight daily for 13 days) significantly increased the secretory phenotype associated with pro-inflammatory senescence, promoting pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma progression. This raises the hypothesis that dietary supplements that increase NAD+ may be tumorigenic in vivo under stress conditions such as premalignant senescent lesions induced by activated oncogenes. The finding highlights the complex, context-dependent interplay between NAD+ metabolism and cancer biology, cautioning that NAD+ precursor supplementation could accelerate tumorigenesis in certain premalignant settings even as it confers health benefits in normal aging and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: 在致癌小鼠模型中，補充 NMN（每天 500 mg/kg 體重，持續 13 天）顯著增加了與促發炎性衰老相關的分泌型態，促進胰管腺癌的進展。這提出了這樣的假說：在活化致癌基因誘發的癌前衰老病變等壓力條件下，提升 NAD+ 的膳食補充劑可能在體內具有致癌性。此發現凸顯了 NAD+ 代謝與癌症生物學之間複雜且依賴情境的相互作用，並警示儘管 NAD+ 前驅物補充在正常老化與代謝疾病中帶來健康益處，但在某些癌前情境中可能加速腫瘤發生。

label: NADPH
description: FSP1's NAD(P)H-dependent ubiquinone oxidoreductase activity draws reducing equivalents from NAD(P)H to regenerate ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), the lipophilic radical trap that halts lipid peroxidation. NAD(P)H is therefore the obligate electron donor for the GPX4-independent FSP1 axis.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 依賴 NAD(P)H 的泛醌氧化還原酶活性，從 NAD(P)H 取得還原當量以重新生成泛醇（CoQ10H2）——這個脂溶性自由基陷阱能中止脂質過氧化。因此 NAD(P)H 是 FSP1 這條不依賴 GPX4 的路徑所必需的電子供體。

label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell
description: Among the three precursors nicotinic acid (NA), nicotinamide (NAM), and nicotinamide riboside (NR), only NR could prolong survival and induce hematopoietic stem cell regeneration, as documented in a study with mice treated with irradiation. This implies advantages of the NR precursor for potential use in cancer patients undergoing chemo- or radiotherapy, and orally administered NR was also found to improve resistance to and reversal of chemotherapeutic neuropathy. NR's ability to rejuvenate stem cells appears to be a general phenomenon during treatment and has been suggested to underlie a small but significant extension of lifespan in mice.
description_zh_TW: 在三種前驅物 nicotinic acid（NA）、nicotinamide（NAM）與 nicotinamide riboside（NR）之中，唯有 NR 能延長存活並誘發造血幹細胞再生，此記載於一項以照射處理小鼠的研究中。這暗示了 NR 前驅物在癌症患者接受化療或放療時潛在使用的優勢，且口服 NR 亦被發現能改善對化療神經病變的抵抗力與其逆轉。NR 使幹細胞年輕化的能力似乎為治療期間的普遍現象，並被認為是小鼠中微小但顯著的壽命延長的基礎。

label: Complex I
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Bovine heart submitochondrial particles show Complex I reduces adrenochrome to its semiquinone, which auto-oxidizes to superoxide, closing a redox cycle that amplifies ROS (Genova et al., Arch Biochem Biophys 2006, PMID 16487923; Bindoli et al., BBA Bioenergetics 1990, PMID 2158818). Adrenochrome is therefore an electron acceptor at Complex I.
description_zh_TW: 牛心亞粒線體顆粒顯示 Complex I 將腎上腺素紅還原為其半醌，後者自氧化產生超氧陰離子，形成放大 ROS 的氧化還原循環（Genova 等，Arch Biochem Biophys 2006，PMID 16487923；Bindoli 等，BBA Bioenergetics 1990，PMID 2158818）。因此腎上腺素紅是 Complex I 上的電子受體。

label: Gut Microbiome
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The production of urolithin A depends largely on the metabolic activities of the gut microbiota. During digestion, polyphenolic compounds such as tannins and anthocyanins undergo enzymatic reactions and metabolic conversions facilitated by microbial enzymes, culminating in the production of urolithin A. This metabolism predominantly takes place in the colon, which houses a variety of microbial groups including Proteobacteria, Clostridium, Bifidobacterium, Eubacterium, and Enterococcus faecium that possess distinct metabolic functions, so individual differences in intestinal microbial composition influence how much urolithin A a person produces and absorbs.
description_zh_TW: urolithin A 的生成主要取決於腸道菌叢的代謝活動。在消化期間，多酚類化合物（如 tannins（單寧）與 anthocyanins（花青素））經歷由微生物酵素促進的酵素反應與代謝轉化，最終產生 urolithin A。此代謝主要發生於結腸，其中棲息著多種微生物群體，包括 Proteobacteria、Clostridium、Bifidobacterium、Eubacterium 與 Enterococcus faecium，它們具有獨特的代謝功能，因此腸道微生物組成的個體差異會影響一個人生成與吸收的 urolithin A 量。

label: Immune Evasion
description: IDO1 is a major target in immuno-oncology due to its role in tumor evasion: it is often upregulated in cancers and the tumor microenvironment, where its tryptophan depletion and kynurenine accumulation create an immunosuppressive niche that suppresses effector T cells and promotes regulatory T cells. Inhibitors such as epacadostat, navoximod and linrodostat (BMS-986205) have been tested in clinical trials, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors (PD-1/PD-L1), though results have been mixed.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 因其在腫瘤逃逸中的角色而成為免疫腫瘤學的主要標靶：它在癌症與腫瘤微環境中常被上調，其色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸累積創造出免疫抑制微環境，抑制效應 T 細胞並促進調節性 T 細胞。諸如 epacadostat、navoximod 與 linrodostat（BMS-986205）等抑制劑已在臨床試驗中接受測試，通常與檢查點抑制劑（PD-1/PD-L1）合併使用，儘管結果好壞參半。

label: Wnt
description: β-catenin (Wnt pathway) transcriptionally represses the SIRT2 promoter, and SIRT2 reciprocally deacetylates β-catenin to destabilize it, so Wnt signaling opposes SIRT2 pathway activity and vice versa in intestinal and cancer cell contexts (BBA Mol Cell Res 2021).
description_zh_TW: β-catenin（Wnt 通路）轉錄抑制 SIRT2 啟動子，而 SIRT2 相互去乙醯化 β-catenin 以不穩定化它，因此 Wnt 信號在腸道和癌細胞環境中拮抗 SIRT2 通路活性，反之亦然（BBA Mol Cell Res 2021）。

label: Synaptic Vesicles
description: Dopamine is located in Synaptic Vesicles, establishing the anatomical or subcellular compartment where the entity exerts its function. Mechanistically, this localization reflects biosynthesis, vesicular storage, or the selective vulnerability of that region's neurons. It is significant because the site of localization determines which circuits and symptoms are affected, particularly in Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that localization is often regionally predominant rather than exclusive, and other brain areas may contain smaller amounts of the same entity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 位於 Synaptic Vesicles 中，建立實體發揮其功能的解剖或亞細胞區室。從機制上講，這種定位反映了該區域神經元的生物合成、囊泡儲存或選擇性脆弱性。這很重要，因為本地化的位置決定了哪些電路和症狀受到影響，特別是在 Parkinson's disease 中。需要注意的是，定位通常是區域性的，而不是排他性的，而其他大腦區域可能包含少量的相同實體。

label: Malondialdehyde
description: Lipid peroxidation produces malondialdehyde (MDA), a three-carbon dialdehyde arising from cyclization and fragmentation of peroxidized polyunsaturated fatty acids such as arachidonic acid. MDA is reactive and forms adducts with proteins and DNA, contributing to downstream toxicity. The directionality is membrane damage yielding a diffusible, immunogenic byproduct. A caveat is that MDA is one of many aldehyde products, so its measurement captures only part of the peroxidation burden. MDA forms under both physiological and pathological conditions and is the most commonly measured TBARS-based endpoint in redox research.
description_zh_TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 malondialdehyde (MDA)，一種三碳二醛，由過氧化 polyunsaturated fatty acids（例如花生四烯酸）環化和裂解產生。 MDA 具有反應性，可與 proteins 和 DNA 形成加合物，導致下游毒性。方向性是膜損傷，產生可擴散的免疫原性副產物。需要注意的是，MDA 是眾多醛類產品之一，因此其測量僅捕獲部分過氧化負擔。 MDA 在生理和病理條件下形成，是氧化還原研究中最常測量的基於 TBARS 的終點。

label: Quiescence
description: Quiescence is a state of reversible proliferative arrest in which cells exit the cell cycle but retain the capacity to re-enter upon appropriate stimuli. It is enforced at the restriction point by the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), which sequesters E2F transcription factors and blocks S-phase gene expression until mitogenic signals release the block. Unlike senescence, quiescence is reversible and lacks a senescence-associated secretory phenotype, and it is a key protective state for adult stem cells.
description_zh_TW: Quiescence 是一種可逆的增殖停滯狀態，其中細胞退出細胞週期，但保留在適當刺激下重新進入細胞週期的能力。它在限制點由視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白 (pRb) 強制執行，該蛋白隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期 gene expression，直到有絲分裂信號釋放阻斷。與老化不同，靜止是可逆的，並且缺乏與老化相關的分泌表型，它是成體幹細胞的關鍵保護狀態。

label: MPP+
description: MPP+ and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically MPP+ and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: MPP+ 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，MPP+ 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: PARP1
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Caspase-3 cleaves PARP1 at the DEVD↓G site during apoptosis, inactivating its DNA-repair capacity and conserving ATP for the death program. Directionally, caspase-3 sits upstream of PARP1 inactivation. This marks the point of irreversible commitment to apoptosis and is a classic biochemical marker of apoptotic execution. Because PARP1 is a major NAD+ consumer, its cleavage during apoptosis also spares NAD+ from repair-dependent depletion. The cleavage of PARP1 is widely used experimentally to detect apoptosis, and its regulation is relevant to both normal cell turnover and cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 在凋亡期間在 DEVD↓G 位點切割 PARP1，使其 DNA 修復能力失活並將 ATP 節省給死亡程式。在方向性上，caspase-3 位於 PARP1 失活的上游。這標誌著不可逆凋亡承諾的時點，是凋亡執行的經典生化標誌。由於 PARP1 是主要的 NAD+ 消耗者，其在凋亡期間的切割也節省了 NAD+ 免於修復依賴性的耗竭。PARP1 的切割在實驗中被廣泛用於檢測凋亡，其調控與正常細胞更新和癌症治療都相關。

label: CDKN2B
description: CDKN2B encodes p15INK4b, a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that blocks CDK4/6 and thereby enforces G1 arrest. As a tumor-suppressor locus often co-regulated with CDKN2A at chromosome 9p21, its product is a core effector of growth inhibition in response to TGFbeta signaling. In senescence, CDKN2B induction is a key event in paracrine and TGFbeta-driven arrest, acting downstream of SMAD3/SMAD4. The encoding relationship is a fundamental gene-to-protein fact with direct relevance to cell-cycle control.
description_zh_TW: CDKN2B 編碼 p15INK4b，一種阻斷 CDK4/6 從而強制 G1 停滯的細胞週期依賴激酶抑制因子。作為常與 CDKN2A 在染色體 9p21 共調節的腫瘤抑制基因座，其產物是對 TGFbeta 訊號生長抑制的核心效應器。在衰老中，CDKN2B 誘發是旁分泌與 TGFbeta 驅動停滯的關鍵事件，作用於 SMAD3/SMAD4 下游。此編碼關係是對細胞週期控制直接相關的基本基因—蛋白事實。

label: SMURF2
description: SMURF2, a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase, ubiquitinates SIRT1 and promotes its proteasomal degradation, suppressing proliferation and tumorigenesis in colorectal cancer (Yu et al., Oncogene 2020). Unlike TRIM28/KAP1 — whose SIRT1 degradation is ATM-dependent and DNA-damage-conditioned — SMURF2-mediated SIRT1 turnover was characterized outside DNA damage settings, making it a constitutive metabolic regulator of SIRT1 abundance rather than a DDR-specific one.
description_zh_TW: SMURF2 是一種 HECT 結構域的 E3 泛素連接酶，會泛素化 SIRT1 並促進其蛋白酶體降解，從而抑制大腸直腸癌的增殖與腫瘤生成（Yu 等人，Oncogene 2020）。有別於 TRIM28/KAP1——其對 SIRT1 的降解依賴 ATM 且限於 DNA 損傷情境——SMURF2 介導的 SIRT1 代謝是在非 DNA 損傷條件下被闡明的，因此它是 SIRT1 豐度的組成性代謝調節者，而非 DDR 專一性的調節者。

label: Bcl-w
description: Bad binds Bcl-w. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Bcl-w is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member overexpressed in several carcinomas and hematologic malignancies where it blunts chemotherapy-induced death. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-w rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Bad 綁定 Bcl-w。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-w 是一種抗凋亡 Bcl-2 family 成員，在多種癌症和血液惡性腫瘤中過度表達，可減少化療引起的死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Bcl-w 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: Obesity
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) prevents and improves metabolic disorders such as high-fat diet-induced obesity. NR supplementation promoted metabolic flexibility by enhancing energy expenditure, significantly attenuating high-fat diet-induced body weight gain and decreasing fat mass, particularly in the liver where triglyceride levels dropped by 40%. NR also protected against hyperinsulinemia and elevated total and LDL cholesterol caused by a high-fat diet, while having no effect on body weight when given with a normal chow diet. Additionally, NR-conditioned gut microbiota conferred protection against high-fat diet weight gain through fecal transfer, linking the gut microbiome to its anti-obesity effects.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）可預防並改善代謝紊亂，例如高脂飲食誘發的肥胖。NR補充透過增強能量消耗來促進代謝靈活性，顯著減緩高脂飲食誘發的體重增加並降低脂肪量，尤其是在肝臟中，三酸甘油酯水平下降了40%。NR也保護免受高脂飲食引起的胰島素過高血症以及總膽固醇與LDL膽固醇升高，而在正常飼料飲食下給予時對體重無影響。此外，經NR調理的腸道微生物群透過糞便移植賦予對高脂飲食體重增加的保護力，將腸道微生物組與其抗肥胖效應連結起來。

label: Mebendazole
description: Mebendazole binds beta-tubulin at the colchicine site, inhibiting microtubule assembly (Sasaki et al., Mol Cancer Ther 2002).
description_zh_TW: Mebendazole 在秋水仙鹼位點結合 β-微管蛋白，抑制微管組裝（Sasaki et al., Mol Cancer Ther 2002）。

label: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Monoamine oxidase inhibitors block the intracellular mitochondrial enzyme that oxidatively deaminates dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine. Because MAO-mediated deamination is one of the dominant routes of catecholamine breakdown, inhibition raises catecholamine concentrations and can produce cardiovascular and autonomic effects such as higher blood pressure and heart rate. In combination with COMT inhibition, MAO inhibition strongly reduces overall catecholamine degradation, and the resulting excess epinephrine has more opportunity to undergo autoxidation or radical-mediated conversion to adrenochrome. Such combinations are used in Parkinson's disease under medical supervision but carry risks of hypertensive crisis with non-selective or high-dose use.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase 抑制劑阻斷氧化脫胺多巴胺、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的細胞內粒線體酶。由於 MAO 介導的脫胺是兒茶酚胺分解的主要途徑之一，抑制會升高兒茶酚胺濃度，並可產生如血壓升高與心率加快等心血管與自主神經效應。與 COMT 抑制併用時，MAO 抑制強烈減少整體兒茶酚胺降解，所導致的過量 epinephrine 有更多機會經歷自氧化或自由基介導轉化為 adrenochrome。此類組合在醫療監督下用於帕金森氏症，但在非選擇性或高劑量使用時帶有高血壓危機的風險。

label: macroH2A
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci contain macroH2A, along with HP1, H3K9me3, and HMGA proteins, which together form compacted chromatin domains in the nuclei of senescent cells. The accumulation of macroH2A in these foci promotes transcriptional silencing of proliferation-associated genes and helps stabilize the senescent state. Although not essential for growth arrest, the incorporation of macroH2A into SAHFs is a hallmark of senescence-associated chromatin reorganization. The enrichment of macroH2A distinguishes SAHFs from ordinary heterochromatin domains.
description_zh_TW: Senescence 相關的異染色質灶包含 macroH2A 以及 HP1、H3K9me3 和 HMGA 蛋白，它們一起在老化細胞的細胞核中形成壓縮的染色質結構域。 macroH2A 在這些病灶中的累積促進了增殖相關基因的轉錄沉默，並有助於穩定老化狀態。儘管 macroH2A 摻入 SAHF 對生長停滯不是必需的，但它是衰老相關染色質重組的標誌。 macroH2A 的富集將 SAHF 與普通異染色質結構域區分開來。

label: TNF-alpha
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: SIRT1 suppresses TNF-α production/ signaling downstream of NF-κB deacetylation, blunting inflammation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 NF-κB 去乙醯化的下游抑制 TNF-α 的產生/信號傳導，減輕發炎反應。

label: Wound Healing
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Dietary advanced glycation end products are exogenous glycotoxins absorbed from food that trigger organ dysfunction and tissue aging. In genetically diabetic mice, adverse effects of dietary glycotoxins on wound healing have been demonstrated, and dietary AGEs also accelerate endothelial dysfunction and arterial aging with prolonged exposure. Because AGEs promote inflammation via RAGE and cross-link extracellular matrix proteins, dietary glycotoxins burden the body in addition to endogenous glycation. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE levels and may protect against AGE-related tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Dietary advanced glycation end products 是從食物吸收的 exogenous glycotoxins，會引發 organ dysfunction 與 tissue aging。在 genetically diabetic mice 中，已證實 dietary glycotoxins 對 wound healing 有 adverse effects，且長期暴露下 dietary AGEs 也會加速 endothelial dysfunction 與 arterial aging。由於 AGEs 透過 RAGE 促進 inflammation 並使 extracellular matrix proteins 交聯，dietary glycotoxins 在 endogenous glycation 之外還會加重身體負擔。限制 dietary AGEs 可降低 circulating AGE levels，並可能保護免受 AGE-related tissue damage。

label: BET inhibitors
description: Cancer is treated by BET inhibitors. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. The directionality runs from BET inhibitors toward Cancer, so BET inhibitors is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 BET inhibitors 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。方向性從 BET inhibitors 朝向 Cancer，因此 BET inhibitors 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Healthspan
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: The Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan review (Giblin, Skinner and Lombard 2014) concludes that mammalian sirtuins, especially SIRT1, SIRT3 and SIRT6, broadly suppress age-related pathologies and promote healthspan. Directionally, sirtuin activity sits upstream of preserved tissue function across organ systems. Consistent with this, increased SIRT1 or SIRT6 expression extends mouse lifespan, positioning the family as guardians of mammalian health rather than simple lifespan determinants. The review emphasizes that sirtuins oppose inflammation, metabolic decline, and cellular damage, making them attractive targets for interventions aimed at compressing late-life morbidity.
description_zh_TW: 《哺乳動物健康壽命的守護者》（Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan）綜述（Giblin, Skinner and Lombard 2014）總結認為，哺乳動物sirtuin，尤其是SIRT1、SIRT3和SIRT6，廣泛抑制與年齡相關的疾病並促進健康壽命。方向上，sirtuin活性位於各器官系統組織功能維持的上游。與此一致，增加SIRT1或SIRT6表達可延長小鼠壽命，將此家族定位為哺乳動物健康的守護者而非簡單的壽命決定因子。該綜述強調sirtuin對抗發炎、代謝衰退和細胞損傷，使其成為旨在壓縮晚年疾病目標的有吸引力的靶點。

label: Neurodegeneration
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Aging of the nervous system combined with decreased mitophagy is a hallmark of neurodegeneration, and mitophagy dysregulation is a predominant factor contributing to various neurodegenerative disorders including Alzheimer's disease, Huntington's disease, ALS and mixed dementia. The mitophagy pathway is affected at multiple stages, from cargo recognition to lysosomal fusion. Inducing mitophagy can produce pathological and cognitive outcomes in AD, yet suppressing mitophagy restored mitochondrial density in synapses in some models; in ALS, mitophagy may be neuroprotective initially but prolonged elevation can aggravate neuronal damage, illustrating its context-dependent role.
description_zh_TW: 神經系統老化加上線粒體自噬減少是神經退化的標誌，而線粒體自噬失調是導致多種神經退化性疾病的主要因素，包括阿茲海默症、亨廷頓症、肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症（ALS）和混合型失智症。線粒體自噬通路從貨物識別到溶酶體融合的多個階段均受影響。誘發線粒體自噬可在阿茲海默症中產生病理和認知結果，但在某些模型中抑制線粒體自噬可恢復突觸中的線粒體密度；在ALS中，線粒體自噬最初可能具有神經保護作用，但持續升高可能加重神經元損傷，說明其作用具有情境依賴性。

label: Survivin
description: In a mouse liver cancer model, increased SIRT6 expression reduces survivin expression by deacetylating H3K9Ac at the survivin promoter, and this induces apoptosis during cancer initiation. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of survivin suppression and prevention of tumor initiation. By silencing survivin, an anti-apoptotic factor, SIRT6 removes a key block to programmed cell death in early tumor cells. This allows damaged or transformed cells to undergo apoptosis rather than expand into tumors. The finding links SIRT6's epigenetic control of a critical survival gene to its tumor-suppressive activity in the liver.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠肝癌模型中，增加的SIRT6表達透過去乙醯化存活素啟動子上的H3K9Ac來減少存活素表達，這在癌症起始期間誘導凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於存活素抑制和腫瘤起始預防的上游。透過沉默存活素（一種抗凋亡因子），SIRT6移除了早期腫瘤細胞中程式性細胞死亡的關鍵阻礙。這使得受損或轉化細胞能夠經歷凋亡而非擴展為腫瘤。此發現將SIRT6對關鍵存活基因的表觀遺傳控制與其在肝臟中的腫瘤抑制活性聯繫起來。

label: Sodium Potassium ATPase
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: The silver ion inhibits Na+,K+-ATPase (sodium-potassium ATPase) activity, disrupting intracellular ion concentrations. Sodium-potassium ATPase maintains the electrochemical gradients essential for nerve conduction, muscle contraction, and nutrient transport, so its inhibition by silver perturbs cellular ion homeostasis and can produce systemic effects. Alongside glutathione peroxidase inhibition, this action is one of the two defined biochemical toxicities of silver ions described in toxicological summaries.
description_zh_TW: 銀離子抑制Na+,K+-ATPase（鈉鉀ATP酶）活性，干擾細胞內離子濃度。鈉鉀ATP酶維持神經傳導、肌肉收縮和營養物質運輸所必需的電化學梯度，因此其被銀抑制會擾亂細胞離子恆穩並可能產生系統效應。除了穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶抑制外，此作用是毒理學摘要中描述的銀離子兩種已定義生化毒性之一。

label: Metallic silver
description: Metallic silver is oxidized and may deposit in the tissues, causing argyria, a permanent blue-gray pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Argyria results when large doses of silver are absorbed into the circulatory system and deposited in body tissues; although disfiguring and usually permanent, the condition does not otherwise harm health, and mild forms are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis. The pigmentation reflects reduced elemental silver and silver sulfide granules lodged in the tissues.
description_zh_TW: 金屬銀被氧化並可能沉積在組織中，導致argyria，一種皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的永久性藍灰色色素沉著。當大劑量銀吸收進入循環系統並沉積在體組織中時，會導致argyria；雖然毀容且通常永久，但該病變對健康無其他損害，輕度形式有時被誤認為發紺。色素沉著反映了還原的元素銀和硫化銀顆粒滯留在組織中。

label: Warburg Effect
description: SIRT6 is the clearest anti-Warburg sirtuin: it corepresses HIF-1α and suppresses transcription of glycolytic enzymes (glucose transporters, Hexokinase 2), and its loss permits Warburg-like aerobic glycolysis. Restoration suppresses glycolysis in HCC/glioma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 是最明確的抗 Warburg sirtuin：它協同抑制 HIF-1α 並抑制糖酵解酶（葡萄糖轉運體、Hexokinase 2）的轉錄，其缺失會容許 Warburg 樣的有氧糖酵解。恢復 SIRT6 可抑制 HCC/神經膠質瘤中的糖酵解。

label: AIF
description: AIF relates to MOMP through the relation is_released_from. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: AIF 透過關係式 is_released_from 與 MOMP 相關。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: Immune System
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: In clinical settings, rapamycin's immunosuppressive mechanisms increase infection risk and impair wound healing, especially in otherwise healthy individuals without clinical manifestations that outweigh the risk of side effects. Some early clinical studies suggest short-term rapamycin or rapalogs may improve aspects of immune function in older adults, but these relied on serologic responses to influenza vaccination, a marker with limited predictive value for broader immunocompetence. Broader measures including T cell repertoire diversity, innate immune activity, and real-world infection resistance remain underexplored.
description_zh_TW: 在臨床環境中，rapamycin的免疫抑製機制增加感染風險並損害傷口癒合，特別是在其他方面健康、沒有臨床表現的個體中，其風險超過副作用的風險。一些早期臨床研究表明，短期rapamycin或rapalogs可能改善老年人免疫功能的某些方面，但這些研究依賴於對流感疫苗接種的血清學反應，這對更廣泛的免疫能力的預測價值有限。更廣泛的措施，包括T細胞庫多樣性、先天免疫活性和現實世界的感染抵抗力，仍然研究不足。

label: SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio
description: SIRT3 deacetylase activity is the numerator of the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio, a readout of the mitochondrial sirtuin balance that sets the adaptive-vs-toxic threshold of the hormetic window.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯酶活性是 SIRT3/SIRT4 比例的分子，反映粒線體 sirtuin 平衡，決定激素性窗口中適應與毒性之間的閾值。

label: Mitochondrial Membrane Potential
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Signals that provide an assessment of mitochondrial health have expanded beyond ROS, calcium, and metabolites to include mitochondrial membrane potential, protease activity, and protein import. For example, FCCP reduces mitochondrial membrane potential as one of the diverse strategies used to invoke mitochondrial stress and ATF4 activation. This broadens the sensing repertoire for mitochondrial dysfunction, indicating that mitohormesis is triggered not by a single signal but by a panel of readouts reflecting organelle integrity, metabolic state, and protein homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 提供粒線體健康評估的訊號已擴展到 ROS、鈣和代謝物之外，包括粒線體膜電位、蛋白酶活性和蛋白質輸入。例如，FCCP 降低粒線體膜電位，作為用於引發粒線體壓力和 ATF4 活化的多樣策略之一。這擴展了粒線體功能障礙的感知範圍，表明粒線體促效應並非由單一訊號觸發，而是由反映胞器完整性、代謝狀態和蛋白質體恆定性的一系列讀數觸發。

label: H3K9
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is the principal H3K9 deacetylase (Vaquero et al., 2007). The vault graph lacked a direct SIRT1→H3K9 edge, routing it through 19 three-hop paths; this triple fills that curation gap, consistent with the source review's substrate catalogue.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是主要的 H3K9 去乙醯酶（Vaquero et al., 2007）。vault 圖譜原本缺少直接的 SIRT1→H3K9 邊，需經 19 條三跳路徑繞行；此三元組填補該策展缺口，與來源回顧的受質目錄一致。

label: Insulin Secretion
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT1 supports glucose-stimulated insulin secretion by transcriptionally repressing UCP2 in pancreatic beta-cells, preserving mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis; beta-cell SIRT1 overexpression enhances, while SIRT1 loss impairs, the insulin response, linking SIRT1 to beta-cell function and diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過轉錄抑制胰腺 β 細胞中的 UCP2 來支持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌，維持粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成；β 細胞 SIRT1 過表達可增強胰島素反應，而 SIRT1 缺失則損害胰島素反應，將 SIRT1 與 β 細胞功能和糖尿病聯繫起來。

label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Reducing glucose from 2% to 0.5% in yeast medium extends replicative lifespan by roughly 30%, an effect mediated through elevated NAD+ availability and Sir2 activation. The mechanism hinges on CR lowering the nicotinamide/NAD+ ratio, thereby disinhibiting Sir2 and reinforcing silencing at repetitive rDNA and subtelomeric regions. This intervention is directional: the dietary manipulation is the cause and the lifespan gain the consequence. The finding seeded the broader hypothesis that sirtuin activation underlies longevity benefits of restricted feeding across species.
description_zh_TW: 在酵母培養基中將葡萄糖從 2% 降至 0.5% 可延長複製性壽命約 30%，這種效應是通過升高的 NAD+ 可用性和 Sir2 活化介導的。其機制核心在於 CR 降低菸鹼醯胺/NAD+ 比值，從而解除對 Sir2 的抑制，並加強在重複 rDNA 和亞端粒區域的沉默。這種干預是方向性的：飲食操控是原因，壽命延長是後果。該發現催生了一個更廣泛的假說，即 sirtuin 活化是跨物種限制性餵食帶來壽命益處的基礎。

label: Cardiomyocytes
description: SIRT3 strengthens mitochondrial function by deacetylating key metabolic enzymes such as SOD2 and IDH2, optimizing TCA cycle efficiency and preserving cardiomyocyte viability under stress, particularly in hypertensive heart failure models. SIRT3 protects cardiomyocytes by modulating ROS levels, oxidative phosphorylation, and Ku70 expression, and suppresses pathological hypertrophy and apoptotic signaling via mitochondrial quality control through PINK1-mediated autophagic pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化關鍵代謝酵素如 SOD2 和 IDH2 增強粒線體功能，優化 TCA 循環效率並在壓力下維護心肌細胞存活率，特別是在高血壓心臟衰竭模型中。SIRT3 透過調節活性氧水平、氧化磷酸化和 Ku70 表現保護心肌細胞，並透過 PINK1 介導的自噬途徑進行粒線體品質控制，抑制病理性肥厚和凋亡訊號。

label: RAS
description: Oncogenic RAS signaling drives a metabolic reprogramming in which transformed cells upregulate basal autophagy to supply the amino acids, lipids, and nucleotides needed for sustained proliferation. Mutant RAS activates both mTOR and, via nutrient and energy stress feedback, the autophagic machinery, allowing tumor cells to survive in nutrient-poor microenvironments. Pharmacologic or genetic blockade of autophagy selectively impairs the viability of RAS-driven tumors, highlighting autophagy as a dependency in these cancers. This dependency has motivated clinical efforts to combine RAS pathway-targeted or standard therapies with autophagy inhibition.
