description_zh_TW: 致癌性RAS訊號驅動一種代謝重編程，其中轉化細胞上調基礎自噬以供应持續增殖所需的胺基酸、脂質和核苷酸。突變RAS同時活化mTOR，並透過營養和能量壓力回饋活化自噬機制，使腫瘤細胞能在營養貧乏的微環境中存活。藥理或遺傳性阻斷自噬會選擇性地損害RAS驅動腫瘤的存活能力，凸顯自噬在這些癌症中的依賴性。此依賴性推動了將RAS路徑標靶或標準療法與自噬抑制相結合的臨床努力。

label: Pyroptosis
description: Gasdermin E (GSDME, formerly DFNA5) is cleaved by executioner caspase-3, releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain. In GSDME-high cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 converts the death program from quiet apoptosis into lytic, inflammatory pyroptosis; in GSDME-low settings GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3. PINK1-mediated mitophagy suppresses caspase-3/GSDME-dependent pyroptosis in postoperative cognitive dysfunction, tying mitophagy competence to which death modality prevails.
description_zh_TW: Gasdermin E（GSDME，舊稱 DFNA5）會被執行者 Caspase-3 切割，釋出其成孔的 N 端片段。在 GSDME 高表達的細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 會將死亡程序由安靜的細胞凋亡轉為裂解性、發炎性的焦亡；在 GSDME 低表達時，GSDME 反而位於 Caspase-3 的上游。PINK1 介導的粒線體自噬會抑制術後認知功能障礙中 Caspase-3/GSDME 依賴的焦亡，將粒線體自噬能力與何種死亡模式勝出連結起來。

label: Caspases
description: In the mammalian sirtuin signaling-pathway survey, caspases are listed as negative regulators of SIRT4 — the reciprocal of SIRT4's own restraint on procaspase-9/caspase-9 and procaspase-3/caspase-3 processing. SIRT4 prevents apoptosis by holding these procaspase ratios in check and blocking Bax translocation, while caspase activity feeds back to suppress SIRT4. This places the least-characterized sirtuin inside the cell-death control loop and marks the SIRT4-caspase relationship as emerging rather than fully established.
description_zh_TW: 在哺乳動物 sirtuin 訊息傳遞路徑的調查中，caspases 被列為 SIRT4 的負調節因子——這正好是 SIRT4 自身抑制 pro-Caspase-9/Caspase-9 與 pro-Caspase-3/Caspase-3 加工的鏡像。SIRT4 藉由維持這些前酶比例並阻止 Bax 轉位來防止細胞凋亡，而 caspase 活性則回饋抑制 SIRT4。這使研究最少的 sirtuin 也進入細胞死亡的控制迴路，並標示 SIRT4-caspase 的關係仍屬新興而非完全確立。

label: H3K9me3
description: During cellular reprogramming, Oct4 initiates the erasure of repressive marks, including H3K9me3 and H3K27me3, at target gene loci. As a pioneer-like factor, Oct4 binds enhancers and promoters of pluripotency genes and cooperates with chromatin remodelers to open compacted chromatin, allowing the establishment of the pluripotent transcriptional network. This erasure of repressive histone methylation at pluripotency loci is a key early step in resetting the somatic epigenome. This mark erasure is essential because repressive heterochromatin otherwise blocks the activation of pluripotency genes.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞重編程過程中，Oct4 啟動抑制標記的擦除，包括目標基因位點的 H3K9me3 和 H3K27me3。作為先鋒樣因子，Oct4結合多能基因的增強子和啟動子，並與染色質重塑者合作打開壓縮的染色質，從而建立多能轉錄網絡。這種多能性位點抑制性組蛋白甲基化的消除是重置體細胞表觀基因組的關鍵早期步驟。這種標記擦除是必要的，因為抑制性異染色質否則會阻止多能性基因的活化。

label: MTHFD1
description: MTHFD1 (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase/cyclohydrolase/formyltetrahydrofolate synthetase) is part of the folate-mediated one-carbon metabolism network that supplies methyl groups and formyl units for the methylation cycle and nucleotide synthesis. By generating 10-formyl-THF and interconverting folate derivatives, it supports the production of 5-methyl-THF that feeds methionine synthase and ultimately SAMe, the methyl donor for COMT. Its activity therefore links folate status and one-carbon flux to COMT substrate availability. Mutations in MTHFD1 can impair methylation efficiency similarly to MTHFR variants.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1（亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫酶/環化水解酶/甲醯四氫葉酸合成酶）是 folate 介導的一碳代謝網絡的一部分，為 methylation cycle 和核苷酸合成提供 methyl groups 和甲醯基單位。透過生成 10-甲酰基-THF 和互變 folate 衍生物，它支持 5-甲基-THF 的生產，為蛋氨酸合成酶提供原料，並最終為 SAMe（COMT 的 methyl donor）提供原料。因此，其活性將 folate 狀態和一碳通量與 COMT 底物可用性連結起來。與 MTHFR variants 類似，MTHFD1 的突變也會損害 methylation efficiency。

label: NF675
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: NF675 is the product of optimizing the suramin scaffold and is the most potent and selective molecule in the series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. Suramin itself inhibits SIRT1/SIRT2 at nanomolar concentrations with apparent SIRT1 preference, has anticancer activity, and has been studied in clinical trials. Directionally, NF675 inherits suramin's binding mode while improving isoform selectivity. Despite good potency and selectivity, suramin-derived compounds have modest drug-likeness owing to high molecular weight and anionic character, limiting therapeutic translation.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是優化 Suramin 骨架的產物，是該系列中最具活性和選擇性的分子，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。Suramin 本身在奈摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2，具有明顯的 SIRT1 偏好性，具有抗癌活性，並已在臨床試驗中研究。方向性上 NF675 繼承了 Suramin 的結合模式同時提高了同工型選擇性。儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性，Suramin 衍生物由於高分子量和陰離子特性而具有中等的類藥性，限制了治療轉化。

label: Kynurenine
description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

label: Persulfates
description: Ammonium persulfate is one of the suitable persulfate oxidizing agents for converting adrenaline into adrenochrome, together with potassium persulfate and sodium persulfate. Sodium and ammonium persulfates are preferred over potassium persulfate for their good solubility in water. In the examples, ammonium persulfate (about 0.42 mole) is used with a sodium hydrogencarbonate buffer and a bismuth salt catalyst at 0 to 5 degrees C to produce adrenochrome in maximum yield within about 30 to 45 minutes.
description_zh_TW: 過硫酸銨是將腎上腺素轉化為腎上腺紅的適用過硫酸鹽氧化劑之一，與過硫酸鉀和過硫酸鈉並用。過硫酸鈉和過硫酸銨因在水中溶解度良好而優於過硫酸鉀。在實施例中，過硫酸銨（約0.42莫耳）與碳酸氫鈉緩衝液及鉍鹽催化劑在0至5°C下使用，於約30至45分鐘內以最大產率生產腎上腺紅。

label: Transition Metals
description: Transition metals such as iron and copper catalyze the oxidation of epinephrine by accelerating electron transfer to oxygen. In the presence of these metals, the catechol hydroxyls of epinephrine lose electrons more readily, generating the reactive o-quinone that proceeds to cyclize into adrenochrome. This metal-dependent acceleration is why pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions and laboratory preparations are vulnerable to autoxidation unless protected. The catalytic role of transition metals explains the utility of chelating agents such as EDTA, which bind the metals and render them inert, drastically slowing epinephrine autoxidation and therefore adrenochrome formation. Metal-catalyzed oxidation is likewise a recognized mechanism by which oxidative stress in tissues, where iron and copper can be released from proteins, promotes catecholamine oxidation in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 鐵、銅等過渡金屬透過加速電子轉移至氧氣，催化 epinephrine 的氧化。在這些金屬存在下，epinephrine 的兒茶酚羥基更容易失去電子，生成會進一步環化為 adrenochrome 的反應性鄰苯醌。這種依賴金屬的加速作用，正是藥用 epinephrine 溶液與實驗室製備物除非加以保護否則易受自氧化影響的原因。過渡金屬的催化角色說明了如 EDTA 等螯合劑的效用——EDTA 結合金屬使其失去活性，大幅減緩 epinephrine 的自氧化，從而減少 adrenochrome 的形成。金屬催化的氧化同樣是組織中氧化壓力促進兒茶酚胺體內氧化的一個已知機制，因為鐵和銅可從蛋白質中釋出。

label: ETS transcription factor
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK4 (SAP-1) belongs to the ETS-domain ternary complex factor (TCF) subfamily of transcription factors, defined by a conserved ETS DNA-binding domain. Within sirtuin biology, ELK4 is notable for interacting with SIRT7 and stabilizing the deacetylase at target gene promoters, where SIRT7 deacetylates lysine 18 of histone H3 and represses tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, ELK4's identity as an ETS factor underlies its promoter-targeting function. This links the ETS transcription factor family to the pro-oncogenic SIRT7-H3K18ac axis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: ELK4（SAP-1）屬於 ETS 結構域三元複合物因子（TCF）轉錄因子亞家族，其特徵是保守的 ETS DNA 結合結構域。在 sirtuin 生物學中，ELK4 因與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處而引人注目，在那裡 SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。方向性上 ELK4 作為 ETS 因子的身份奠定了其啟動子靶向功能。這將 ETS 轉錄因子家族與癌症中的促致癌 SIRT7-H3K18ac 軸線聯繫起來。

label: Sex Steroid Ablation
description: Sex steroid ablation (SSA), accomplished surgically or with LHRH analogue administration, is a long-standing strategy for thymic rejuvenation. Mice castrated before puberty show delayed thymic atrophy; removal of sex steroids after puberty restores thymic architecture, increases thymic cellularity and enhances thymopoiesis in aged mice and humans. The number of early thymic progenitors, which decrease with age, is normalized after surgical castration. Thymic regeneration following castration is reversed in a dose-dependent manner by administration of testosterone or estrogen, indicating that sex steroids are primary drivers of thymic involution.
description_zh_TW: 性類固醇消融（SSA），通過手術或LHRH類似物給藥實現，是胸腺rejuvenation的長期策略。青春期前閹割的小鼠顯示胸腺萎縮延遲；青春期後移除性類固醇可恢復胸腺結構，增加胸腺細胞密度，並增強老年小鼠和人類的胸腺生成。隨著年齡增長而減少的早期胸腺祖細胞的數量在手術閹割後恢復正常。閹割後的胸腺再生以劑量依賴性的方式被睾酮或雌激素給藥逆轉，表明性類固醇是胸腺退化的主要驅動因素。

label: DNA Ligase IV
description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

label: TGF-beta1
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: TGF-β1 binds the type II receptor (TβRII), which recruits and phosphorylates the type I receptor (TβRI), leading to phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of SMAD2/3 to drive fibrotic transcription. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of SMAD3 activation. This canonical pathway is the main driver of pathological fibrosis across organs, inducing collagen, fibronectin, and other matrix genes. Sirtuins such as SIRT6 and SIRT7 intersect this axis at multiple points, either by deacetylating SMAD3 or by repressing SMAD3-dependent transcription. Understanding the TGF-β/SMAD cascade is essential for interpreting sirtuin effects on fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β1 結合 II 型受體（TβRII），後者招募並磷酸化 I 型受體（TβRI），導致 SMAD2/3 磷酸化和核轉位以驅動纖維化轉錄。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於 SMAD3 活化的上游。此經典途徑是跨器官病理性纖維化的主要驅動因子，誘導膠原蛋白、纖維連接蛋白和其他基質基因。如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7 等 sirtuin 在多個節點與此軸線交匯，或透過去乙醯化 SMAD3 或抑制 SMAD3 依賴性轉錄。理解 TGF-β/SMAD 級聯對於詮釋 sirtuin 對纖維化的效應至關重要。

label: Rotenone
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) protects HT-22 cells against rotenone-induced neurotoxicity. Rotenone inhibits mitochondrial complex I (NADH oxidase), reducing oxidative phosphorylation and generating excess ROS. When HT-22 cells were exposed to 5 uM rotenone for 24 hours, MB increased cell viability at concentrations from 10 nM to 10 uM, and MB-treated groups maintained significantly higher oxygen consumption even under rotenone challenge. This protection reflects MB's alternative electron-transfer shunt that bypasses the rotenone-blocked complex I, preserving electron flow to cytochrome c.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 可保護 HT-22 細胞免受魚藤酮誘導的神經毒性。魚藤酮抑制線粒體複合體 I（NADH 氧化酶），減少氧化磷酸化並產生過多的 ROS。當 HT-22 細胞暴露於 5 uM 魚藤酮 24 小時，MB 在 10 nM 至 10 uM 濃度下可提高細胞存活率，且 MB 處理組即使在魚藤酮挑戰下仍維持較高的氧氣消耗。這種保護作用反映了 MB 的替代電子傳遞旁路，可繞過被魚藤酮阻斷的複合體 I，維持電子流向細胞色素 c。

label: Mitochondrial Respiration
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Neutral red (NR), a phenazine formed by substituting nitrogen for the position-5 sulfur of the phenothiazine nucleus, retained the ability to increase cellular oxygen consumption (OCR) in Seahorse assays, similar to methylene blue and toluidine blue O, and these three compounds share similar negative redox potentials. However, NR had markedly weaker neuroprotective potency than MB in the glutamate, rotenone, and IAA assays and does not function as an alternative electron-transfer carrier in mitochondria, indicating that oxygen-consumption enhancement alone does not confer neuroprotection and that electron-shunt activity is the key protective feature.
description_zh_TW: 中性紅（NR）是一種由苯噻嗪核第5位硫被氮取代形成的吩嗪，在Seahorse分析中保留了增加細胞氧消耗率（OCR）的能力，類似於亞甲藍和甲苯胺藍O，這三種化合物具有相似的負氧化還原電位。然而，在麩氨酸、rotenone和IAA分析中，NR的神經保護效力明顯弱於MB，且不作為粒線體中的替代電子轉運載體發揮作用，表明僅增強氧消耗並不能賦予神經保護作用，而電子分流活性是關鍵的保護特徵。

label: Complex IV
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Photobiomodulation, applied as daily morning sunlight or targeted red and near-infrared light therapy, directly stimulates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) in the mitochondria, enhancing ATP production. It is listed among the light, temperature, and environmental exposures that act as mitohormetic stressors. Cold exposure similarly activates brown adipose tissue and induces uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) leading to increased mitochondrial density, while sauna heat exposure induces heat shock proteins that repair misfolded proteins and support mitochondrial function.
description_zh_TW: 光生物調節，作為每日早晨陽光或靶向紅光和近紅外光療法施用，直接刺激粒線體中的細胞色素c氧化酶（複合物IV），增強ATP產生。它被列為作為線粒體興奮壓力源的光、溫度和環境暴露之一。冷暴露同樣激活棕色脂肪組織並誘導解偶聯蛋白1（UCP1），導致粒線體密度增加，而桑拿熱暴露誘導熱休克蛋白，修復錯誤折疊的蛋白質並支持粒線體功能。

label: ACAT1
description: The acetyltransferase ACAT1 acetylates TFEB at multiple lysine residues with opposing functional outcomes: acetylation at K116 hinders TFEB binding to DNA (PMID 30059277), while acetylation at K91, K103, and K430 promotes nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These site-specific acetylation events modulate TFEB's ability to interact with chromatin and activate transcription of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The K116 acetylation that inhibits DNA binding is reversed by SIRT1 deacetylation, which enhances TFEB transcriptional activity. Together these marks show that acetylation acts as a dynamic post-translational switch controlling TFEB's DNA-binding capacity and thus its gene-regulatory output.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯基轉移酶 ACAT1 在多個賴氨酸殘基上乙醯化 TFEB，產生相反的功能結果：K116 的乙醯化阻礙 TFEB 與 DNA 的結合（PMID 30059277），而 K91、K103 和 K430 的乙醯化則促進核轉位與 DNA 結合。這些位點特異性的乙醯化事件調節 TFEB 與染色質相互作用並啟動溶酶體和自噬基因轉錄的能力。K116 的乙醯化抑制 DNA 結合，此作用可被 SIRT1 去乙醯化逆轉，進而增強 TFEB 的轉錄活性。這些修飾標記表明，乙醯化作為一個動態的翻譯後開關，控制 TFEB 的 DNA 結合能力及其基因調節輸出。

label: Acute Lung Injury
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: High efficiency of vitamin B3 (niacin or nicotinamide) in preventing lung tissue damage was confirmed in several animal models with bleomycin- and LPS-induced lung injury, and considering this strong lung-protective effect, vitamin B3 has been proposed as an early treatment-supporting agent against COVID-19, which otherwise causes a maladaptive hyperinflammatory response with a cytokine storm in lung tissue. Nicotinamide riboside (NR), as a vitamin B3 derivative, is therefore considered a potential therapeutic or supporting agent to reduce hyperinflammation and regenerate damaged lung tissue during SARS-CoV-2 infection, where excess leucocyte infiltration causes extensive tissue damage
description_zh_TW: 維生素 B3（niacin 或 nicotinamide）在預防肺組織損傷方面的高效性已在數種 bleomycin（博萊黴素）與 LPS 誘發肺損傷的動物模型中獲得證實，且考量到此強效的肺保護效果，維生素 B3 已被提議作為對抗 COVID-19 的早期治療支援劑，否則 COVID-19 會在肺組織中引發伴隨細胞激素風暴的適應不良過度發炎反應。因此，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）作為維生素 B3 的衍生物，被視為在 SARS-CoV-2 感染期間減少過度發炎並再生受損肺組織的潛在治療或支援劑，在此感染中過量的白血球浸潤造成廣泛的組織損傷。

label: Tumor suppressor
description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

label: Genomic Instability
description: SIRT1 works as an anti-apoptotic, genome-protecting protein in the DNA damage response: it is recruited to break sites by ATM, deacetylates ATM itself (stimulating autophosphorylation and stabilization), and deacetylates DDR factors such as TIP60, NBS1, XPA, and XPC. The 2022 stability study shows that TRIM28-mediated degradation plus caspase cleavage of SIRT1 enhance DNA-damage-induced cell death while helping maintain genome stability — i.e., removing SIRT1 is part of the cell-fate decision between repair and death.
description_zh_TW: 在 DNA 損傷反應中，SIRT1 是抗凋亡且保護基因體的蛋白：它會被 ATM 召募到斷裂位置、去乙醯化 ATM 本身（促進其自體磷酸化與穩定），並去乙醯化 TIP60、NBS1、XPA、XPC 等 DDR 因子。2022 年的穩定性研究顯示，TRIM28 介導的降解加上 caspase 對 SIRT1 的切割會加劇 DNA 損傷誘導的細胞死亡，同時有助於維持基因體穩定——也就是說，移除 SIRT1 本身就是修復與死亡之間細胞命運決策的一部分。

label: Stanniocalcin-1
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Stanniocalcin-1, a glycoprotein hormone, orchestrates a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis, and inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway to ameliorate renal injury in diabetic murine models. The hormetic description reflects STC1's pattern of effect: mild mitochondrial stress engages AMPK, supporting SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control.
description_zh_TW: Stanniocalcin-1 是一種糖蛋白激素，編排了一個激效性 AMPK/SIRT3 軸線以減輕氧化壓力和凋亡，並透過 AMPK/SIRT3 途徑抑制 BNIP3 表現以改善糖尿病小鼠模型中的腎損傷。激效性描述反映了 STC1 的作用模式：輕度粒線體壓力啟動 AMPK，支持 SIRT3 依賴的粒線體品質控制。

label: ATG4B
source_file: _document_ - The Beneficial and Adverse Effects of Autophagic Response to Caloric Restriction and Fasting.md
description: Starvation induces SIRT2 activity, which deacetylates ATG4B, a cysteine protease required for LC3 processing and autophagy induction. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatically activates ATG4B. This is necessary for proper autophagosome formation during nutrient deprivation, and it adds SIRT2 to the sirtuin network controlling autophagy. By promoting LC3 processing, SIRT2 supports the elongation of autophagosome membranes during starvation. This nutrient-responsive regulation connects SIRT2 to the cellular adaptation to fasting, complementing the roles of SIRT1 in autophagy regulation.
description_zh_TW: 飢餓誘導 SIRT2 活性，後者去乙醯化 ATG4B——一種 LC3 加工和自噬誘導所需的半胱氨酸蛋白酶。在方向性上，SIRT2 以酶性方式活化 ATG4B。這在營養缺乏期間對適當的自噬體形成是必需的，並為控制自噬的 sirtuin 網絡增添了 SIRT2。透過促進 LC3 加工，SIRT2 在飢餓期間支持自噬體膜的延伸。這種營養反應性調控將 SIRT2 與細胞對禁食的適應聯繫起來，與 SIRT1 在自噬調控中的角色互補。

label: P300
source_file: _document_ - The Beneficial and Adverse Effects of Autophagic Response to Caloric Restriction and Fasting.md
description: SIRT1 inhibits the coactivator p300 by deacetylation, dampening p300-dependent transcriptional programs.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化作用抑制共活化因子 p300，減弱 p300 依賴性的轉錄程序。

label: Beclin1
description: SIRT1 deacetylates Beclin-1 at multiple lysines, promoting its interaction with the class III PI3K Vps34 and enhancing autophagy initiation and flux. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically licenses Beclin-1. This supports autophagosome formation and cellular clearance, and it is a central SIRT1 autophagy substrate alongside LC3, Atg5, Atg7, and ULK1. By deacetylating Beclin-1, SIRT1 promotes the assembly of the autophagy initiation complex and couples nutrient status to cellular quality control. This mechanism contributes to SIRT1's protection against the accumulation of damaged proteins and organelles during aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在多個賴氨酸位點去乙醯化 Beclin-1，促進其與 III 型 PI3K Vps34 的相互作用並增強自噬啟動和通量。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式啟用 Beclin-1。這支持自噬體形成和細胞清除，是 SIRT1 的核心自噬底物之一，與 LC3、Atg5、Atg7 和 ULK1 並列。透過去乙醯化 Beclin-1，SIRT1 促進自噬啟動複合物的組裝，並將營養狀態與細胞品質控制偶聯。此機制有助於 SIRT1 在衰老過程中防止受損蛋白質和細胞器的積累。

label: BRCA1
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: BRCA1 is recruited to DNA double-strand breaks by the MRN complex, promotes end resection, and facilitates RAD51 loading via PALB2 and BRCA2 to execute homologous recombination repair. Directionally, BRCA1 sits upstream of high-fidelity double-strand-break repair. Loss of BRCA1 cripples homologous recombination, increasing mutation and cancer risk, particularly in breast and ovarian tissue. Sirtuins such as SIRT2 support BRCA1 localization to damage sites, linking sirtuin activity to genome stability. The BRCA1 pathway is also the basis for synthetic lethality with PARP inhibitors in BRCA-deficient cancers.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 被 MRN 複合物招募到 DNA 雙鏈斷裂處，促進末端切除，並透過 PALB2 和 BRCA2 協助 RAD51 裝載以執行同源重組修復。在方向性上，BRCA1 位於高保真雙鏈斷裂修復的上游。BRCA1 的缺失損害同源重組，增加突變和癌症風險，特別是在乳腺和卵巢組織中。如 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 支持 BRCA1 定位到損傷位點，將 sirtuin 活性與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。BRCA1 途徑也是 BRCA 缺陷癌症中與 PARP 抑制劑合成致死的基礎。

label: Butein
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Butein, a chalcone, is among the first-reported SIRT1 polyphenolic STACs (with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, myricetin), activating SIRT1 via K-type allosteric lowering of Km. It attenuates sepsis-induced brain injury through SIRT1 signaling.
description_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查耳酮，是最早被報導的 SIRT1 多酚類 STACs 之一（與白藜蘆醇、piceatannol、quercetin、myricetin 並列），透過 K 型別構降低 Km 來活化 SIRT1。它透過 SIRT1 訊號減緩敗血症誘發的腦損傷。

label: Haloperidol
description: HPP+ and Haloperidol are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically HPP+ and Haloperidol may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: HPP+ 和 Haloperidol 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，HPP+ 和 Haloperidol 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Axon Degeneration
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD38 knockdown in mice suppressed axon degeneration, demyelination, and immune cell infiltration after facial nerve axotomy compared with wild-type mice, identifying CD38 as a candidate molecule for regulating neurodegeneration. Correspondingly, intraperitoneal injection of NR at 400 mg/kg once daily for 1 week prior to facial nerve axotomy delayed axon degeneration and demyelination and significantly increased NAD+ levels in the facial nucleus and facial nerve of wild-type mice. These findings connect the age-related rise in CD38 activity to NAD+ depletion and axonal vulnerability, and show that NAD+ precursor supplementation can mimic the protection achieved by CD38 deletion.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠中 CD38 敲低與野生型小鼠相比，抑制了面神經軸突切斷後的軸突退化、髓鞘脫失與免疫細胞浸潤，將 CD38 確認為調節神經退化的候選分子。相應地，在面神經軸突切斷前，以 400 mg/kg 的 NR 每日一次腹腔注射一週，延遲了軸突退化與髓鞘脫失，並顯著提升野生型小鼠面神經核與面神經中的 NAD+ 水平。這些發現將年齡相關的 CD38 活性上升與 NAD+ 耗竭及軸突脆弱性相連結，並顯示 NAD+ 前體補充能模擬 CD38 缺失所達成的保護作用。

label: NAAD
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: In response to nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation, a remarkable increase (45-fold) in nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide (NAAD) was reported in a study with male human subjects and C57Bl6/J mice, indicating an additional conversion pathway of NR to NAD+. NAAD represents the most sensitive biomarker of effective NAD+ supplementation since it is undetectable in the blood prior to supplementation and its levels increase in the liver after orally administered NAD+ precursors. NR could also significantly elevate NAAD heart content, where the increase of NAD+ occurs in the absence of a steady-state NAD+ increase, and NR increased NAAD by at least 45-fold compared to baseline.
description_zh_TW: 在對 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充的反應中，一項針對男性人類受試者與 C57Bl6/J 小鼠的研究報導了 nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide（NAAD，菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）的顯著增加（45 倍），顯示 NR 轉化為 NAD+ 的額外路徑。NAAD 代表了有效 NAD+ 補充最敏感的生物標記，因為它在補充前於血液中無法偵測，且其水平在口服 NAD+ 前驅物後於肝臟中上升。NR 亦能顯著提升心臟中的 NAAD 含量，其中 NAD+ 的增加發生於缺乏穩態 NAD+ 增加的情況下，且 NR 相較於基線將 NAAD 提升了至少 45 倍。

label: BDNF
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT1 directly regulates BDNF transcription by deacetylating and repressing Hes1, a transcriptional repressor of BDNF, thereby relieving inhibition and promoting neuronal survival. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylates Hes1, which induces BDNF. This links sirtuin activity to neurotrophic support, and it is a mechanism for SIRT1's neuroprotective and cognitive benefits. By removing the Hes1 brake on the BDNF promoter, SIRT1 increases BDNF expression in the brain. This regulation is engaged by caloric restriction and exercise, both of which elevate BDNF through SIRT1-dependent pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並抑制 Hes1——一種 BDNF 的轉錄抑制因子——直接調控 BDNF 轉錄，從而解除抑制並促進神經元存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 去乙醯化 Hes1，後者誘導 BDNF。這將 sirtuin 活性與神經營養支持聯繫起來，是 SIRT1 神經保護和認知益處的機制。透過移除 Hes1 對 BDNF 啟動子的制動，SIRT1 增加大腦中的 BDNF 表達。此調控在限制熱量和運動中被啟動，兩者都透過 SIRT1 依賴性途徑提高 BDNF。

label: Phosphocreatine (PCr)
description: Oral creatine monohydrate — typically 3-5 g/day maintenance or 20 g/day loading — raises total muscle and brain creatine stores by roughly 20-40%, enlarging the phosphocreatine buffer that the creatine phosphate shuttle uses to spatially buffer ATP. The largest responses occur in individuals with low baseline stores (vegetarians, low meat intake), and the ergogenic and neuroprotective effects follow from the widened energy buffer rather than from any direct receptor action.
description_zh_TW: 口服肌酸單水合物——通常每日 3-5 克維持劑量或每日 20 克負荷期——可使肌肉與腦部的總肌酸儲量提升約 20-40%，擴大肌酸磷酸穿梭用以空間性緩衝 ATP 的磷肌酸緩衝庫。基線儲量較低者（素食者、少肉飲食）反應最大，而其增補運動表現與神經保護的效應正是來自加寬的能量緩衝，而非任何直接的受體作用。

label: MicroRNA
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic alterations—The silent indicator for early aging and age‐associated health‐risks.md
description: MicroRNA levels generally decline with age, contributing to the altered gene expression that accompanies aging. In C. elegans, most miRNAs are down-regulated with age and this decline is reversed by caloric restriction, while in mice and humans aging is associated with reproducible changes in miRNA abundance, though not in all organs. The age-related reduction in miRNAs, partly driven by declining levels of the processing enzyme Dicer, contributes to the loss of post-transcriptional gene regulation and to cellular senescence.
description_zh_TW: MicroRNA 水平通常隨著年齡的增長而下降，導致 gene expression 隨年齡增長而改變。在秀麗隱桿線蟲中，大多數 miRNA 會隨著年齡的增長而下調，而這種下降可以透過熱量限制來逆轉，而在小鼠和人類中，老化與 miRNA 豐度的可重複變化相關，儘管並非在所有器官中都如此。與年齡相關的 miRNA 減少，部分是由於加工酶 Dicer 水平下降所致，導致轉錄後基因調控的喪失和細胞老化。

label: Intermedin
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models. Because vascular calcification, a hallmark of advanced CKD, is driven by mitochondrial dysfunction and osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells, intermedin's SIRT3-dependent improvement of cristae architecture opposes the calcific phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Intermedin（腎上腺髓質素 2）在血管鈣化模型中透過 AMPK/SIRT3 介導的嵴重塑增強粒線體生物能容量。由於血管鈣化是進階 CKD 的特徵，由粒線體功能障礙和血管平滑肌細胞的骨源性轉分化所驅動，intermedin 的 SIRT3 依賴性嵴結構改善對抗鈣化表型。

label: Liquiritigenin
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: The licorice-derived compound liquiritigenin induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while simultaneously suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models. This dual action mitigates oxidative stress injury and cell death, highlighting liquiritigenin's therapeutic value in AKI and related redox-driven pathologies.
description_zh_TW: 源自甘草的化合物 liquiritigenin 誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡。此雙重作用減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡，凸顯 liquiritigenin 在 AKI 及相關氧化還原驅動病變中的治療價值。

label: MDL-800
description: MDL-800 is a bis-benzenesulfonamide prodrug and potent, selective SIRT6 activator, with an EC50 of 10.3 μM, that stimulates SIRT6 deacetylase activity. Directionally, MDL-800 allosterically activates SIRT6. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, mitigating kidney fibrosis and tumor glycolysis in preclinical models. It is a lead chemical tool for SIRT6 biology, and its improved potency and selectivity make it well suited for in vivo studies of SIRT6 activation, supporting the therapeutic potential of pharmacologic SIRT6 engagement.
description_zh_TW: MDL-800 是一種雙苯磺酰胺前藥和強效選擇性 SIRT6 活化因子，EC50 為 10.3 μM，刺激 SIRT6 去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-800 變構活化 SIRT6。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在臨床前模型中減輕腎纖維化和腫瘤糖解。它是 SIRT6 生物學的先導化學工具，其改善的效力和選擇性使其非常適合 SIRT6 活化的體內研究，支持藥理性 SIRT6 參與的治療潛力。

label: Meteorin-like protein
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Meteorin-like protein activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, which stimulates AMPK at Thr172 and increases UCP1-dependent proton leak, thereby preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism, particularly in diabetic nephropathy. The cascade links an exercise-induced myokine to mitochondrial quality control through the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3/AMPK/UCP1 pathway.
description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like 蛋白活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，後者在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，從而維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝，特別是在糖尿病腎病變中。此級聯將運動誘導的肌肉因子透過 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3/AMPK/UCP1 途徑與粒線體品質控制聯繫起來。

label: MyoD
description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

label: Lysine
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: AGE formation begins when glucose attaches in a non-enzymatic fashion to a free amino acid on a protein, lipid, or DNA molecule, with lysine and arginine being the main targets, forming a reversible Schiff base within hours. Whether the reaction proceeds depends on glucose concentration, and it reverses if glucose levels drop. This first step is the entry point of the Maillard reaction that ultimately yields advanced glycation end products. Because glucose preferentially modifies lysine and arginine residues, these amino acids are the principal sites of protein glycation, and their modification contributes to the accumulation of AGEs in long-lived structural proteins.
description_zh_TW: AGE formation begins when glucose attaches in a non-enzymatic fashion to a free amino acid on a protein、lipid或DNA molecule，其中以lysine與arginine為main targets，在hours內形成reversible Schiff base。Whether the reaction proceeds depends on glucose concentration，若glucose levels drop則reverses。此first step是Maillard reaction的entry point，ultimately yields advanced glycation end products。由於glucose preferentially modifies lysine與arginine residues，這些amino acids是protein glycation的principal sites，其modification contributes to AGEs在long-lived structural proteins中的accumulation。

label: OX2R
description: In BRASTO mice, hypothalamic SIRT1 deacetylates the transcription factor NKX2-1, which drives expression of the orexin type 2 receptor (OX2R); increased OX2R in DMH/LH raises neural activity, physical activity, and energy expenditure, underpinning the approximately 11% lifespan extension. This positions the SIRT1-to-NKX2-1-to-OX2R pathway as a hypothalamic longevity axis that mimics calorie restriction. By increasing physical activity and energy expenditure through orexin signaling, SIRT1 promotes a CR-like metabolic state. This brain-centered mechanism demonstrates that sirtuin effects on lifespan can be mediated through neural control of energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 在BRASTO小鼠中，下丘腦SIRT1去乙醯化轉錄因子NKX2-1，後者驅動食慾素第2型受體（OX2R）的表達；DMH/LH中OX2R的增加提升了神經活動、身體活動和能量消耗，支撐了約11%的壽命延長。這將SIRT1-NKX2-1-OX2R通路定位為一種模擬熱量限制的下丘腦長壽軸。透過食慾素訊號增加身體活動和能量消耗，SIRT1促進了類CR的代謝狀態。這種以大腦為中心的機制表明，sirtuin對壽命的影響可以透過神經控制能量平衡來介導。

label: GLO2
description: GLO2 (glyoxalase II) is the second enzyme of the glyoxalase system. It converts S-D-lactoylglutathione into D-lactate, regenerating glutathione in the process. Because glutathione is both the cofactor for GLO1 and a major cellular antioxidant, GLO2 activity sustains the capacity of the glyoxalase system to detoxify methylglyoxal and other dicarbonyls. The conversion of reactive dicarbonyl intermediates into lactate thereby prevents them from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on proteins, making GLO2 an integral component of the body's defense against glycation stress.
description_zh_TW: GLO2（glyoxalase II）是乙二醛酶系統的第二個酵素。它將 S-D-lactoylglutathione 轉化為 D-乳酸（D-lactate），過程中再生麩胱甘肽。由於麩胱甘肽既是 GLO1 的輔酶也是主要的細胞抗氧化劑，GLO2 活性維持了乙二醛酶系統解毒甲基乙二醛與其他二羰基物的能力。將反應性二羰基中間產物轉化為乳酸，從而防止它們在蛋白質上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯，使 GLO2 成為身體對抗糖化壓力防禦中不可或缺的組成部分。

label: STUB1
description: The E3 ubiquitin ligase STUB1 ubiquitinates TFEB, and this ubiquitination enhances TFEB activity (PMID 28754656). Rather than simply marking TFEB for degradation, ubiquitination by STUB1 in this case increases the transcription factor's functional output, consistent with the growing appreciation that ubiquitination can serve non-proteolytic regulatory functions. This adds TFEB to the set of proteins whose activity is tuned by ubiquitin conjugation. The finding illustrates the diversity of post-translational modifications - including ubiquitination, PARsylation, and SUMOylation in addition to phosphorylation and acetylation - that regulate TFEB's localization, stability, and transcriptional activity in the control of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: E3 泛素連接酶 STUB1 泛素化 TFEB，此泛素化增強 TFEB 活性（PMID 28754656）。在此情況下，STUB1 的泛素化並非簡單地將 TFEB 標記為降解，而是增加該轉錄因子的功能輸出，這與日益增強的認識一致——泛素化可以發揮非蛋白水解的調節功能。這將 TFEB 加入活性通過泛素偶聯調節的蛋白質集合。此發現說明了翻譯後修飾的多樣性——包括泛素化、PARylation 和 SUMO 化，以及磷酸化和乙醯化——共同調節 TFEB 的定位、穩定性和轉錄活性，以控制溶酶體生物發生和自噬。

label: PKC
description: Protein kinase C beta (PKCbeta) phosphorylates TFEB at S466 and the cluster S461/S462 and S468, promoting its stability (PMID 23599343). Phosphorylation at S466 is shared with AMPK, which phosphorylates the same site to enhance transcriptional activity, while PKCbeta-mediated phosphorylation stabilizes the TFEB protein. By stabilizing TFEB, PKCbeta signaling can raise the cellular pool of the transcription factor available for nuclear translocation when other activating signals arrive. This illustrates how post-translational phosphorylation by multiple kinases converges on TFEB to control its abundance, localization, and activity, integrating diverse cellular signaling inputs into the regulation of lysosomal and autophagic gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCbeta）在 S466 以及 S461/S462 和 S468 群簇上磷酸化 TFEB，促進其穩定性（PMID 23599343）。S466 的磷酸化與 AMPK 共享，AMPK 磷酸化同一部位以增強轉錄活性，而 PKCbeta 介導的磷酸化穩定 TFEB 蛋白。通過穩定 TFEB，PKCbeta 信號可以增加細胞中可用於核轉位的轉錄因子池，當其他啟動信號到達時。這說明多重激酶的翻譯後磷酸化如何匯聚在 TFEB 上，控制其豐度、定位和活性，將多樣的細胞信號輸入整合到溶酶體和自噬基因表達的調節中。

label: Bifidobacterium
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These genera are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune system support. NAD+ precursors modulate gut microbiota by providing an energy source for beneficial bacteria, activating sirtuins, and improving gut barrier function. NMN and NR thereby reverse gut dysbiosis and promote beneficial effects at both intestinal and extraintestinal levels, linking dietary NAD+ precursor intake to a healthier gut microbial community.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些屬與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及支持免疫系統。NAD+ 前驅物透過提供有益細菌的能量來源、活化去乙醯酶以及改善腸道屏障功能來調節腸道菌叢。NMN 和 NR 因此逆轉腸道失調，並在腸內與腸外層面促進有益效應，將膳食性 NAD+ 前驅物攝取與更健康的腸道微生物群落連結起來。

label: soluble epoxide hydrolase
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: A regulatory axis exists in which soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation, with sEH deficiency preserving SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impede renal vascular calcification progression. sEH inhibition or deficiency therefore acts as an indirect SIRT3-stabilizing strategy in advanced CKD-associated vascular calcification.
description_zh_TW: 存在一個調控軸線，其中可溶性環氧化物水解酶（sEH）透過蛋白水解降解調節 SIRT3 的周轉，sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 的可用性以滿足生物能需求並阻礙腎血管鈣化的進展。因此 sEH 抑制或缺乏作為進階 CKD 相關血管鈣化中間接穩定 SIRT3 的策略。

label: Vimentin
description: The N308K substitution selectively reduces SIRT6-vimentin interaction, which normally promotes SIRT6 degradation, thereby increasing SIRT6 protein levels. Directionally, N308K sits upstream of weakened vimentin binding. This stabilizes SIRT6 and enhances its functional output, and it is the molecular explanation for the centenarian variant phenotype. Because vimentin normally targets SIRT6 for proteasomal degradation, the N308K variant escapes this turnover. This post-translational stabilization, rather than transcriptional upregulation, underlies the increased SIRT6 abundance seen in carriers of the longevity-associated variant.
description_zh_TW: N308K 取代選擇性地減少 SIRT6-vimentin 的相互作用——後者通常促進 SIRT6 降解——從而增加 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，N308K 位於 vimentin 結合弱化的上游。這穩定 SIRT6 並增強其功能輸出，是百歲人瑞變異體表型的分子解釋。由於 vimentin 通常靶向 SIRT6 進行蛋白酶體降解，N308K 變異體逃避了這種周轉。這種轉錄後穩定化（而非轉錄上調）構成了長壽相關變異體攜帶者中 SIRT6 豐度增加的基礎。

label: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network
description: The Peroxisome Biogenesis Network (PBN), a dynamic pool of pre-peroxisomal precursors residing in the cytosol, receives lipids and membrane material from the endoplasmic reticulum through direct ER-PBN contact sites. Pre-peroxisomal vesicles bud from the ER membrane and mature by importing peroxisomal proteins and lipids.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network（PBN，位於細胞質的前過氧化物體前驅池）透過直接的 ER-PBN 接觸位点，自內質網獲得脂質與膜物質。前過氧化物體囊泡自內質網膜出芽，並藉由輸入過氧化物體蛋白與脂質而成熟。

label: GSK3β
description: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) phosphorylates TFEB at serines 134 and 138, residues that influence its subcellular localization and association with lysosomal membranes. These phosphorylations contribute to the regulated shuttling of TFEB and modulate its activity in response to Wnt and growth-factor signaling contexts. Because GSK3β activity is itself controlled by Akt and by nutrient state, this modification embeds TFEB within the broader insulin/PI3K signaling network. The sites complement the better-characterized S211 mark in fine-tuning TFEB localization.
description_zh_TW: 糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3β）於 serine 134 和 138 磷酸化 TFEB，這些殘基影響其亞細胞定位和與溶酶體膜的關聯。這些磷酸化有助於 TFEB 的調節性穿梭，並在 Wnt 和生長因子信號背景下調節其活性。由於 GSK3β 活性本身受 Akt 和營養狀態控制，此修飾將 TFEB 嵌入更廣泛的胰島素／PI3K 信號網絡。這些位點補充了特徵更清楚的 S211 標記，以微調 TFEB 定位。

label: 5-Azacytidine
description: 5-Azacytidine inhibits DNMT1, the maintenance DNA methyltransferase that copies methylation patterns onto daughter strands during DNA replication. As a cytidine analog, 5-azacytidine is incorporated into DNA, where it covalently traps DNMT1 and depletes the enzyme, causing passive loss of methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates silenced genes, including tumor suppressors, and underlies its clinical use in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia. It is also studied for its capacity to modulate senescence and reactivate silenced developmental programs.
description_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine 抑制 DNMT1，這是一種維持 DNA 甲基轉移酶，在 DNA 複製過程中將甲基化模式複製到子鏈上。作為胞苷類似物，5-氮雜胞苷摻入 DNA 中，共價捕獲 DNMT1 並耗盡該酶，導致新合成鏈上的甲基化被動喪失。这种去甲基化重新激活了沉默的基因，包括肿瘤抑制基因，这是其在骨髓增生异常综合征和急性髓系白血病中的临床应用的基础。人們也研究了它調節衰老和重新激活沉默的發育程序的能力。

label: Epicatechin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Epicatechin is a flavanol with potent anti-glycation and AGE-breaking properties. In vitro it destroys preformed glycated serum albumin, and in vivo it decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. The nucleophilic C6 and C8 carbons of epicatechin's A-ring can attack the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures, breaking AGE cross-links. Epicatechin's dual capacity to inhibit glycation and break existing AGEs makes it a promising natural agent for reducing AGE burden, and its effects are similar to or stronger than those of aminoguanidine.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種具有強效抗糖化與 AGE 裂解特性的黃烷醇。在體外，它能破壞已形成的糖化血清白蛋白；在體內，它降低了注射外源性 AGE 之大鼠視網膜組織中的 AGE 累積。Epicatechin 之 A 環具親核性的 C6 與 C8 碳原子可攻擊 AGE 結構的吡咯環碳原子，切斷 AGE 交聯。Epicatechin 同時抑制糖化並裂解既有 AGE 的雙重能力，使其成為降低 AGE 負擔的極具潛力天然物質，且其效果與 aminoguanidine 相似或更佳。

label: Glucosepane
description: Glucosepane is the most abundant and stubborn protein-protein AGE crosslink in human structural tissues, driving the systemic stiffening associated with aging and diabetes. Humans lack endogenous enzymes capable of directly breaking the glucosepane ring without destroying the surrounding collagen. Because of its abundance and stability, glucosepane is considered a major molecular target for anti-glycation therapies. Its crosslinks accumulate in long-lived proteins such as collagen and elastin, and are a principal cause of the extracellular matrix stiffening that contributes to arterial stiffening and age-related loss of tissue compliance.
description_zh_TW: Glucosepane 是人體結構組織中最豐富且頑固的蛋白-蛋白 AGE 交聯，驅動與衰老及糖尿病相關的全身性僵硬。人類缺乏能夠在不破壞周圍膠原蛋白的情況下直接切斷 glucosepane 環的內源性酶。由於其豐富性與穩定性，glucosepane 被視為抗糖化療法的主要分子標靶。其交聯累積於膠原蛋白與彈力蛋白等長壽蛋白中，是導致細胞外基質僵硬的主因，進而促成動脈僵硬與年齡相關的組織順應性喪失。

label: Daratumumab
description: Daratumumab (Darzalex, first approved 2015) and isatuximab (Sarclisa, approved 2020/2021) are IgG1 monoclonal antibodies that bind distinct epitopes on CD38, a cell-surface ectoenzyme. By engaging CD38 on malignant plasma cells, daratumumab triggers antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and complement-dependent killing. The directionality is the antibody acting on CD38-expressing cells. Although primarily an anticancer agent, depleting CD38 also reduces NAD+ consumption, indirectly favoring sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: Daratumumab（Darzalex，2015 年首次獲批）和 isatuximab（Sarclisa，2020/2021 年獲批）是 IgG1 單克隆抗體，結合 CD38（一種細胞表面外酶）的不同表位。通過結合惡性漿細胞上的 CD38，daratumumab 觸發抗體依賴性細胞毒性和補體依賴性殺傷。在方向性上，抗體作用於表達 CD38 的細胞。雖然主要是抗癌藥物，但耗竭 CD38 也減少 NAD+ 消耗，間接有利於 sirtuin 活性。

label: GM-CSF
description: The SASP factor GM-CSF stimulates myeloid expansion and biases differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs, recruiting them into senescent and tumor tissues. GM-CSF thereby shapes the myeloid compartment to be tolerogenic and arrest-promoting, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links a specific SASP cytokine to myeloid suppressor accumulation and is a recognized driver of MDSC expansion in inflammation and cancer. Blocking GM-CSF signaling can reduce MDSC generation.
description_zh_TW: MDSCs 被 GM-CSF 招募，GM-CSF 是一種在發炎與衰老微環境中上調的骨髓生成細胞激素，驅動未成熟抑制性骨髓前驅細胞的擴張與遷移。此招募將 SASP 與組織發炎連結到免疫抑制性骨髓浸潤。透過 GM-CSF，衰老細胞可無意中促成免疫逃逸，因招募的 MDSC 隨後抑制清除衰老細胞所需的 T 細胞。它是衰老相關免疫調節的正向迴圈。

label: Niacin
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Niacin was previously suggested as an anti-inflammatory therapy in a preclinical study as a potent agent to decrease proinflammatory cytokines, including IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-alpha, and it might also decrease neutrophil infiltration while exhibiting a prolonged anti-inflammatory effect during ventilator-induced lung injury. Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can similarly decrease IL-2, IL-5, IL-6, and TNF-alpha. Targeting IL-6 has been proposed as a promising treatment to block the inflammatory storm, especially in severe COVID-19 patients.
description_zh_TW: Niacin（菸鹼酸）先前在臨床前研究中被提議作為抗發炎療法，是一種能降低促發炎性細胞激素（包括 IL-1、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha）的有效藥劑，且其亦可能減少嗜中性球浸潤，同時在呼吸器誘發的肺損傷期間展現持久的抗炎效果。nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）同樣能降低 IL-2、IL-5、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha。針對 IL-6 已被提議為阻斷發炎風暴（尤其是重症 COVID-19 患者）的有前景療法。

label: Proton Leak
description: Uncoupling protein 3 (UCP3) is expressed primarily in skeletal muscle and is a candidate mediator of the proton leak that contributes to resting metabolic rate and exercise-related energy expenditure. Speakman cites evidence that UCP3 mRNA is elevated after exercise and that its expression, together with UCP2, may account for a fraction of the exercise-induced rise in metabolic rate. The functional importance of UCP3 in mediating proton leak remains debated, because knockout studies in mice do not show gross changes in resting metabolic rate, but its induction by training and by lipids keeps it a focus for understanding inter-individual differences in energy expenditure.
description_zh_TW: 解偶聯蛋白 3（UCP3）主要在骨骼肌中表達，是貢獻於靜息代謝率和運動相關能量消耗的質子洩漏的候選介導因子。Speakman 引用了 UCP3 mRNA 在運動後升高的證據，以及其表達與 UCP2 一起可能解釋運動誘導代謝率上升的一部分。UCP3 在介導質子洩漏中的功能重要性仍有爭議，因為小鼠基因敲除研究未顯示靜息代謝率的顯著變化，但其被訓練和脂質誘導的特性使其成為理解個體間能量消耗差異的焦點。

label: Adiposity
description: Butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid produced by gut bacteria such as Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, Eubacterium rectale, and Roseburia, reduces adiposity by inhibiting intestinal cholesterol biosynthesis and promoting beneficial metabolic effects including insulin secretion, insulin sensitivity, and energy expenditure. Butyrate can also increase satiety and gut motility by upregulating the expression of peptide YY and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1). In studies where NR supplementation enriched butyrate-producing Firmicutes, these metabolic benefits contributed to protection against high-fat diet-induced weight gain, and fecal transfer reproduced the effect, underscoring butyrate as a key mediator of microbiota-driven metabolic health.
description_zh_TW: 丁酸是一種由腸道細菌如 Faecalibacterium prausnitzii、Eubacterium rectale 和 Roseburia 產生的短鏈脂肪酸，透過抑制腸道膽固醇生合成並促進包括胰島素分泌、胰島素敏感性與能量消耗在內的有益代謝效應來減少肥胖。丁酸也能透過上調 peptide YY 與類升糖素胜肽-1（GLP-1）的表現來增加飽足感與腸道蠕動。在 NR 補充富集產丁酸 Firmicutes 的研究中，這些代謝益處有助於防護高脂飲食誘發的體重增加，且糞便移植重現了此效應，凸顯丁酸作為微生物群驅動代謝健康的關鍵介導者。

label: Epigenome
description: Protein restriction alters the epigenome, one of its six hallmarks. Aging is accompanied by erosion of the epigenetic landscape - DNA methylation and post-translational modifications of histone tails - that promotes hallmarks of aging including cellular senescence. PR in pregnant rodents leads to loci-specific changes in histone methylation and gene expression, and dietary levels of specific amino acids regulate histone post-translational modifications, linking nutrient sensing to the epigenome. Methionine is the precursor of S-adenosyl methionine, the universal methyl donor, so dietary methionine deprivation may affect physiology through changes in histone methylation due to decreased methyl-donor availability, with cells preserving heterochromatic stability through upregulation of H3K9 methylation in the liver.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改變表觀基因組，這是其六個標誌之一。老化伴隨著表觀遺傳景觀的侵蝕——DNA甲基化和組蛋白尾部的轉錄後修飾——這促進了包括細胞衰老在內的老化標誌。懷孕囓齒動物中的PR導致組蛋白甲基化和基因表達的位點特異性變化，特定胺基酸的飲食水平調節組蛋白轉錄後修飾，將營養感知與表觀基因組聯繫起來。甲硫氨酸是S-腺苷甲硫氨酸的前體，S-腺苷甲硫氨酸是通用的甲基供體，因此飲食甲基剝奪可能透過組蛋白甲基化的變化影響生理，這是由於甲基供體可用性降低，細胞透過在肝臟中上調H3K9甲基化來保持異染色質穩定性。

label: Mitokines
description: Mitokines are soluble factors released by stressed mitochondria that communicate mitochondrial stress status to distal tissues, enabling cell-non-autonomous regulation of stress responses and lifespan. In C. elegans, knockdown of the cytochrome c oxidase component cco-1 in the brain activates the UPRmt response in the intestine and extends lifespan, implying that stressed mitochondria in the nervous system release signals that modulate stress defenses elsewhere in the soma. This allows mitochondria in one tissue to act as sensors of overall metabolic status for the entire organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體因子是由受壓粒線體釋放的可溶性因子，將粒線體壓力狀態傳遞給遠端組織，實現壓力反應和壽命的細胞非自主性調節。在 C. elegans 中，腦中細胞色素 c 氧化酶成分 cco-1 的敲低會在腸道活化 UPRmt 反應並延長壽命，暗示神經系統中受壓粒線體釋放的訊號在其他體細胞部位調節壓力防禦。這使得一個組織中的粒線體能夠作為整個生物體整體代謝狀態的感測器。

label: Kynurenine Pathway
description: Downstream of IDO1, the kynurenine pathway (KP) leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+. The KP accounts for about 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production, making it the dominant route of tryptophan-to-NAD+ flux. Both type 1 and type 2 diabetes show disrupted NAD+ homeostasis, with the KP (via IDO1/TDO) being a major Trp-to-NAD+ route. This positions IDO1 at the intersection of metabolism, immunity and inflammation, integrating tryptophan availability with immune modulation and NAD+ biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: 在 IDO1 下游，犬尿胺酸途徑（KP）產生包括犬尿烯酸、3-羥基犬尿胺酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素與 NAD+ 前驅物）以及最終 NAD+ 在內的多種代謝物。KP 佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解，使其成為色胺酸至 NAD+ 流量的主導途徑。第 1 型與第 2 型糖尿病皆顯示 NAD+ 恆定受到破壞，而 KP（經由 IDO1/TDO）是 Trp 至 NAD+ 的主要途徑。這使 IDO1 處於代謝、免疫與發炎的交會點，將色胺酸可用性與免疫調節及 NAD+ 生合成整合起來。

label: Adenosine Triphosphate
description: NMRK2 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 2) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) using only a single molecule of ATP, whereas synthesis of NMN from nicotinamide by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents. This makes the NMRK2 pathway an energy-sparing mechanism that may be favored in the failing heart, where the shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis represents a common adaptive response. NR is expressed and active mainly in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which may explain the better ability of these tissues to respond to NR. NR supplementation is therefore regarded as a powerful approach to preserve cardiac function in heart failure.
description_zh_TW: NMRK2（nicotinamide ribose kinase 2，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 2）僅需單一分子的 ATP 即可將 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）轉化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸），而 NAMPT 由菸鹼醯胺合成 NMN 則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。這使得 NMRK2 路徑成為一種節能機制，可能在衰竭的心臟中受到偏好，因為在該處由 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 進行 NAD+ 合成代表一種常見的適應性反應。NR 主要在心肌與骨骼肌中表現並具活性，這或許解釋了這些組織對 NR 較佳的反應能力。因此，NR 補充被視為維持心衰竭中心臟功能的有力方法。

label: Ferritin
description: Ferritin sequesters free iron by storing up to roughly 4,500 Fe3+ atoms per molecule in a mineral core, keeping redox-active iron away from peroxide and the Fenton reaction. This buffering is a front-line antioxidant defense. The directionality is iron chelation to suppressed radical formation. A caveat is that ferritin can be released or degraded during inflammation and hemorrhage, liberating iron that then becomes pro-oxidant. Iron released from ferritin by ferritinophagy or by reduction is what fuels ferroptosis, so ferritin level is a determinant of ferroptosis sensitivity.
description_zh_TW: Ferritin 透過在礦物核心中每個分子儲存約 4,500 個 Fe3+ 原子來隔離 free iron，使具有氧化還原活性的 iron 遠離過氧化物和 Fenton reaction。這種緩衝是一種前線抗氧化防禦。方向性是iron螯合以抑制自由基的形成。需要注意的是，ferritin 在發炎和出血期間可能會釋放或降解，釋放出 iron，然後變成促氧化劑。透過ferritin自噬或還原從ferritin釋放的Iron是ferroptosis的燃料，因此ferritin水平是ferroptosis敏感性的決定因素。

label: Multiple Sclerosis
description: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
description_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

label: 5,6-indolequinone
description: 5,6-indolequinone and Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically 5,6-indolequinone and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: 5,6-indolequinone 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，5,6-indolequinone 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Major histocompatibility complex class I
description: Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Aminochromes
description: Studies have shown that the human erythrocyte plasma membrane can convert epinephrine (adrenaline) to aminochromes, including adrenochrome and further derivatives, in a two-phase reaction. Aminochromes are the cyclized oxidation products of catecholamines, and this membrane-associated conversion represents a route for adrenochrome formation in blood even though erythrocytes lack the organelles and oxidative enzymes that actively produce it. This makes the erythrocyte membrane a site where catecholamine oxidation products can form, with potential consequences for red blood cell membrane integrity.
description_zh_TW: 研究顯示，人類erythrocyte plasma membrane能在two-phase reaction中將epinephrine（adrenaline）轉化為aminochromes，包括adrenochrome及進一步的derivatives。Aminochromes是catecholamines的cyclized oxidation products，而這種membrane-associated conversion代表了一條血液中adrenochrome形成的途徑，儘管erythrocytes缺乏主動生成它的胞器與oxidative enzymes。這使得erythrocyte membrane成為catecholamine oxidation products可以形成的位置，並可能對red blood cell membrane integrity造成影響。

label: 4-Hydroxynonenal
description: Lipid peroxidation produces 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE), a highly reactive alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde generated mainly from n-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids. 4-HNE forms Michael adducts with protein cysteine, histidine, and lysine residues, altering enzyme function and signaling. The directionality is membrane oxidation yielding a potent endogenous electrophile. A caveat is that at low concentrations 4-HNE can act as a signaling molecule inducing adaptive responses, blurring the line between damage and signal.
description_zh_TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE)，這是一種主要由 n-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids 產生的高反應性 α,β-不飽和醛。 4-HNE 與蛋白質半胱胺酸、組胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成邁可加合物，改變酵素功能和訊號傳導。方向性是膜氧化產生有效的內源性親電子試劑。需要注意的是，在低濃度下，4-HNE 可以充當誘導適應性反應的訊號分子，模糊損傷和訊號之間的界限。

label: Phospholipid
description: ACSL4 localizes to the outer mitochondrial membrane and ER and supplies PUFA-CoA for phospholipid remodeling via the Lands cycle (with PLA2), enriching membrane phospholipids with oxidizable polyunsaturated fatty acids that become the substrates of lipid peroxidation and, consequently, ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: ACSL4 定位於粒線體外膜與內質網，透過 Lands cycle（與 PLA2 配合）提供 PUFA-CoA 進行磷脂重塑，使膜磷脂富含可氧化的多不飽和脂肪酸，這些脂肪酸隨即成為脂質過氧化乃至鐵死亡的受質。

label: Fenton reaction
description: The Fenton reaction produces hydroxyl radicals according to Fe2+ + H2O2 to Fe3+ + OH* + OH-, a one-electron reduction of hydrogen peroxide by ferrous iron. This reaction is the principal mechanism by which relatively inert H2O2 is converted into the supremely reactive hydroxyl radical at sites of free iron. The directionality is metal-catalyzed conversion of a diffusible oxidant into a locally devastating radical. A caveat is that the ferric product can be recycled back to Fe2+ by reductants, sustaining chain production of hydroxyl radicals as long as iron and peroxide coexist.
description_zh_TW: Fenton reaction 根據 Fe2+ + H2O2 產生 hydroxyl radicals 至 Fe3+ + OH* + OH-，這是亞鐵 iron 對 hydrogen peroxide 的單電子還原。此反應是相對惰性的 H2O2 在 free iron 位點轉化為活性極高的羥基自由基的主要機制。方向性是擴散氧化劑在金屬催化下轉化為局部破壞性自由基。需要注意的是，只要 iron 和過氧化物共存，三價鐵產品就可以透過還原劑回收 Fe2+，從而維持 hydroxyl radicals 的鍊式生產。

label: iFSP1
description: iFSP1, the first-in-class FSP1 inhibitor (IC50 ≈ 103 nM), binds human FSP1 at a pocket centered on residue F360 and blocks its NAD(P)H-dependent reduction of ubiquinone to ubiquinol, removing the GPX4-independent radical trap. Alone it is often insufficient in high-GPX4 cells but strongly synergizes with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibition to trigger ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: iFSP1 是第一個 FSP1 抑制劑（IC50 ≈ 103 nM），結合於人類 FSP1 以 F360 殘基為中心的口袋，鎖定並阻斷其依賴 NAD(P)H 將泛醌還原為泛醇的活性，移除不依賴 GPX4 的自由基陷阱。單獨使用在 GPX4 高表現細胞中往往不足，但與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併時強烈協同誘發鐵死亡。

label: iNOS
description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

label: Microglia
source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, aging, and neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.md
description: Extracellular neuromelanin activates Microglia, serving as a trigger that switches the target cell or process into an active state. Mechanistically, the entity engages receptors or danger signals that provoke proliferation, phagocytosis, or cytokine release. This is significant because activation of glial or immune effectors can both clear debris and, when chronic, perpetuate neuronal injury. A caveat is that activation has a protective-to-harmful transition, so the consequence depends on whether the response resolves or becomes sustained.
description_zh_TW: Extracellular neuromelanin 啟動 Microglia，作為將目標單元或進程切換到活動狀態的觸發器。從機制上講，該實體與受體或危險信號結合，引發增殖、吞噬或細胞激素釋放。這很重要，因為神經膠質或免疫效應器的活化既可以清除碎片，並且在慢性時，可以使神經元損傷永久化。需要注意的是，活化有一個保護性到有害性的轉變，因此結果取決於 response 是否解決或持續。

label: Betaine
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

label: Magnesium
description: COMT requires magnesium as a cofactor, because the enzyme's catalytic domain depends on divalent cations, magnesium in particular, to stabilize the SAMe-substrate complex and support efficient methyl transfer to the catechol ring. Magnesium deficiency can therefore impair COMT efficiency and slow catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetic slow variants. Adequate magnesium status is frequently emphasized in protocols supporting slow or balanced COMT function, since the metal is essential for catalysis. This makes magnesium a practical nutritional lever for maintaining healthy COMT activity.
description_zh_TW: COMT 需要鎂作為輔助因子，因為該酶的催化結構域依賴二價陽離子，特別是鎂，以穩定 SAMe-底物複合物並支持有效的甲基轉移到兒茶酚環。因此，Magnesium 缺陷會損害 COMT 效率並減慢兒茶酚胺清除率，從而加劇遺傳慢變異的影響。在支援緩慢或平衡 COMT 功能的方案中經常強調充足的鎂狀態，因為金屬對於催化至關重要。這使得鎂成為維持健康的實用營養槓桿 COMT activity。

label: S-adenosylmethionine
description: Catechol-O-methyltransferase (COMT) methylates the catechol ring of catecholamines using S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) as the methyl donor. In this reaction SAM transfers a methyl group to one of the adjacent hydroxyl groups of epinephrine, producing metanephrine and S-adenosylhomocysteine. COMT-mediated methylation is one of the dominant routes for terminating adrenaline and dopamine signaling. COMT inhibition can raise SAM levels while MAO inhibition may lower them, and the balance of these effects depends on the specific inhibitors used. This methylation pathway keeps adrenochrome formation a minor route under normal metabolic conditions.
description_zh_TW: Catechol-O-methyltransferase（COMT）使用 S-adenosylmethionine（SAM）作為甲基供體，甲基化兒茶酚胺的兒茶酚環。在此反應中，SAM 將一個甲基轉移至 epinephrine 的相鄰羥基之一，產生 metanephrine 與 S-adenosylhomocysteine。COMT 介導的甲基化是終止 adrenaline 與多巴胺訊號的主要途徑之一。COMT 抑制可升高 SAM 濃度，而 MAO 抑制可能降低之，這些效應的平衡取決於所使用的特定抑制劑。此甲基化途徑在正常代謝條件下使 adrenochrome 形成維持為次要路線。

label: EGCG
description: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially the catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), which constitutes a major fraction of its antioxidant and bioactive content. EGCG is subsequently metabolized by COMT, linking green tea consumption to COMT-dependent pharmacokinetics, with slow genotypes clearing it more slowly. The high EGCG content is the basis for many of green tea's studied health effects, including antioxidant, metabolic, and neuroprotective actions. At dietary intake levels it does not significantly inhibit COMT in humans.
description_zh_TW: Green tea 富含多酚，尤其是兒茶素表沒食子兒茶素沒食子酸酯 (EGCG)，它構成了其抗氧化劑和生物活性成分的主要部分。 EGCG 隨後被 COMT 代謝，將綠茶攝取與 COMT 依賴性藥物動力學聯繫起來，而慢基因型清除它的速度更慢。 EGCG 的高含量是綠茶許多健康功效研究的基礎，包括抗氧化、代謝和神經保護作用。在飲食攝取量下，它不會顯著抑制 COMT in humans。

label: Hesperidin
description: Hesperidin is classified as a flavanone, a subclass of flavonoids characterized by a saturated C-ring and the absence of the catechol motif, distinguishing it from catechol flavonoids such as quercetin or luteolin. This structural class determines its metabolic fate and its lack of interaction with COMT, since it cannot serve as a substrate or inhibitor of the enzyme. Its glycosidic form is abundant in citrus peels and juices, where it contributes to antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity. The absence of vicinal hydroxyl groups is the key to its COMT neutrality.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 被歸類為 flavanone，是類黃酮的亞類，其特徵是具有飽和的 C 環且不存在兒茶酚基序，從而將其與槲皮素或木犀草素等兒茶酚類黃酮區分開來。這種結構類別決定了它的代謝命運以及它與 COMT 相互作用的缺乏，因為它不能充當酶的底物或抑制劑。它的糖苷形式在柑橘皮和果汁中含量豐富，有助於抗氧化和抗炎活性。鄰位羥基的缺失是其 COMT 中性的關鍵。

label: Biphasic Dose-Response Curve
description: The probability of a network topology producing a hormetic (non-monotonic) dose-response curve increases with network complexity: the highest number of hormetic topologies contain six or seven links, and normalized by topology count the probability of exhibiting hormesis increases as the number of active links increases, indicating that hormesis depends on network density and complexity. More than 500 of the 5346 possible three-node topologies tested show clear non-monotonic dose-response curves, and hormesis is favored in networks with a high number of repressing interactions on average.
description_zh_TW: 網路拓撲產生荷爾米希（非單調）劑量反應曲線的機率隨網路複雜度增加而上升：荷爾米希拓撲數量最多者含六或七條連結，且依拓撲數量標準化後，荷爾米希反應的機率隨活性連結數量增加而上升，顯示荷爾米希取決於網路密度與複雜度。在測試的 5346 種三節點拓撲中，超過 500 種展現明確的非單調劑量反應曲線，且荷爾米希在平均抑制性交互作用數量較高的網路中更易出現。

label: MFN2
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: MFN2 is one of the two mitofusin GTPases that drive outer mitochondrial membrane fusion and, together with MFN1, is essential for tethering and merging adjacent mitochondria. Unlike MFN1, MFN2 additionally localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum, where it participates in tethering mitochondria to the ER and may play a role in lipid exchange. Mutations in MFN2 cause the peripheral neuropathy Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A, underscoring its physiological importance. MFN2 expression is regulated by PGC-1alpha and transcriptional co-activators, so changes in MFN2 levels couple mitochondrial fusion capacity to cellular metabolic demand.
description_zh_TW: MFN2 是兩個驅動粒線體外膜融合的 mitofusin GTP 酶之一，與 MFN1 一起對於栓繫和融合相鄰粒線體至關重要。與 MFN1 不同，MFN2 還定位於內質網，參與將粒線體栓繫到內質網，並可能在脂質交換中扮演角色。MFN2 突變會導致周圍神經病變 Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A，突顯其生理重要性。MFN2 表達受 PGC-1alpha 和轉錄共激活因子調節，因此 MFN2 水平的變化將粒線體融合能力與細胞代謝需求相連結。

label: Nucleosome
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Chromatin is composed of nucleosomes, the repeating structural units that package the genome within the nucleus. Each nucleosome consists of a histone octamer, with two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, wrapped by approximately 147 base pairs of DNA. Nucleosomes are arranged along the DNA in a beads-on-a-string fashion and further compact into higher-order fibers, with their positioning and modification determining whether underlying DNA is accessible for transcription, replication, and repair.
description_zh_TW: Chromatin 由核小體組成，核小體是將基因組包裝在細胞核內的重複結構單元。每個核小體由一個組蛋白八聚體組成，其中 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各有兩個拷貝，由大約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 包裹。核小體以串珠的方式沿著 DNA 排列，並進一步壓縮成高級纖維，其定位和修飾決定了底層 DNA 是否可用於轉錄、複製和修復。

label: Topologically Associating Domain
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Topologically associating domains organize chromatin into discrete three-dimensional compartments at an intermediate scale, spanning tens of kilobases to megabases. Within TADs, DNA sequences interact more frequently with each other than with sequences outside the domain, constraining enhancer-promoter contacts and insulating regulatory elements from inappropriate targets. The boundaries of these domains are delineated by proteins such as CTCF and HMGB1/2, and their disruption alters gene expression during senescence and aging.
description_zh_TW: 拓樸關聯結構域將染色質組織成中等規模的離散三維區室，跨越數十千鹼基到兆鹼基。在 TAD 內，DNA 序列之間的相互作用比與域外序列的相互作用更頻繁，從而限制了增強子-啟動子的接觸，並將調節元件與不適當的標靶隔離。這些結構域的邊界由 CTCF 和 HMGB1/2 等蛋白質劃定，它們的破壞會在老化和老化過程中改變 gene expression。

label: DELE1
description: OMA1 is a mitochondrial protease whose activity is markedly elevated following mitochondrial stress. Upon stress, OMA1 catalyzes the cleavage of DELE1 during the stage of mitochondrial protein import and processing, producing a smaller cytosolic form (DELE1-S) that accumulates in the cytosol. The OMA1-dependent cleavage is required for subsequent ISR activation. Notably, perturbations of protein import across the inner mitochondrial membrane produce cytosolic DELE1 accumulation independent of OMA1, and iron deficiency causes full-length DELE1 (DELE1-L) accumulation on the outer mitochondrial membrane that activates HRI without OMA1-mediated cleavage.
description_zh_TW: OMA1是一種粒線體蛋白酶，其活性在粒線體壓力後顯著升高。壓力下，OMA1在粒線體蛋白質輸入和加工階段催化DELE1裂解，產生一個較小的細胞質形式（DELE1-S），該形式在細胞質中積累。OMA1依賴性裂解是後續ISR啟動所必需的。值得注意的是，內粒線體膜蛋白質輸入的干擾會產生OMA1非依賴性的細胞質DELE1積累，而鐵缺乏導致全长DELE1（DELE1-L）在外粒線體膜上積累，在沒有OMA1介導裂解的情況下激活HRI。

label: Paracrine Reprogramming
description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

label: AGK2
description: AGK2 is a highly selective SIRT2 inhibitor with an IC50 of 3.5 μM and over 10-fold selectivity over SIRT1 and SIRT3. Directionally, AGK2 blocks SIRT2. Its selectivity makes it the preferred probe for SIRT2-specific biology, and it rescues neurons in Parkinson's models, supporting SIRT2 inhibition therapeutically. By preserving α-tubulin acetylation, AGK2 protects microtubule stability and neuronal viability. AGK2's potency and selectivity established it as the reference SIRT2 inhibitor and a key tool for studying SIRT2's roles in neurodegeneration and cancer.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 是一種高度選擇性的 SIRT2 抑制劑，IC50 為 3.5 μM，對 SIRT1 和 SIRT3 具有超過 10 倍的選擇性。在方向性上，AGK2 阻斷 SIRT2。其選擇性使其成為 SIRT2 特定生物學的首選探針，在帕金森氏症模型中拯救神經元，支持 SIRT2 抑制的治療意義。透過保留 α-微管蛋白的乙醯化，AGK2 保護微管穩定性和神經元活性。AGK2 的效力和選擇性確立其作為參考 SIRT2 抑制劑和研究 SIRT2 在神經退行性和癌症中角色的關鍵工具。

label: Thymus
description: The thymus is a vital organ for homeostatic maintenance of the peripheral immune system. Within its two compartments, the true thymic epithelial space (TES, comprising cortex and medulla) and the perivascular space (PVS), T cells develop, mature, and undergo induction of self-tolerance in a process called thymopoiesis. The cortex hosts early thymocyte development including T cell receptor gene rearrangement and positive selection, while the medulla carries out negative selection to remove autoreactive T cells. The perivascular space, composed of adipocytes, peripheral lymphocytes and stroma, is a non-thymopoietic component.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺是外周免疫系統穩態維持的重要器官。在其兩個隔室——真正的胸腺上皮空間（TES，包含皮質和髓質）和血管周圍空間（PVS）——中，T 細胞發育、成熟並經歷稱為胸腺生成的自身耐受誘導過程。皮質主持早期胸腺細胞發育，包括 T 細胞受體基因重排和陽性選擇，而髓質執行陰性選擇以清除自身反應性 T 細胞。血管周圍空間由脂肪細胞、外周淋巴細胞和基質組成，是非胸腺生成的成分。

label: Thymic Epithelial Cells
description: Thymic epithelial cells (TECs) in the cortex and medulla form a complex network that supports T cell differentiation, providing the essential microenvironment for productive thymopoiesis. The thymus consists of cells of stromal and hematopoietic origin, including TECs, mesenchymal cells (fibroblasts), endothelial cells and dendritic cells. Differentiating thymocytes migrate from the cortico-medullary junction through the cortex and back to the medulla, encountering functionally distinct microenvironments that regulate positive and negative selection.
description_zh_TW: 皮質和髓質中的胸腺上皮細胞（TECs）形成一個複雜的網絡，支持 T 細胞分化，為 productive thymopoiesis 提供必要的微環境。胸腺由基質和造血來源的細胞組成，包括 TECs、間充質細胞（成纖維細胞）、內皮細胞和樹突狀細胞。分化中的胸腺細胞從皮髓交界處遷移穿過皮質再回到髓質，遇到功能不同的微環境，調節陽性和陰性選擇。

label: p66Shc
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 binds the P66shc promoter and deacetylates histone H3 there, reducing P66shc transcription and lowering this pro-oxidant adaptor. Directionally, SIRT1 suppresses P66shc. This axis lowers mitochondrial ROS and is a plausible contributor to the ~30% lifespan extension seen in P66shc knockout mice, and to calorie-restriction benefits.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 結合 P66shc 啟動子並在該處去乙醯化組蛋白 H3，降低 P66shc 的轉錄並降低此促氧化接頭蛋白。方向性上 SIRT1 抑制 P66shc。此軸線降低粒線體活性氧，是 P66shc 基因敲除小鼠所見約 30% 壽命延長以及熱量限制益處的可能貢獻因素。

label: stimulus-response learning
description: Stimulus-response learning depends on dopamine signaling in the striatum, particularly within corticostriatal circuits where dopamine modulates the synaptic plasticity underlying habit formation. Both excessive and insufficient striatal dopamine, shaped by DAT, COMT, and receptor tone, disrupt S-R acquisition and procedural learning. COMT overexpression models demonstrate that altered dopamine clearance impairs this learning. This makes striatal dopamine a key determinant of habit and skill learning efficiency.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 依賴紋狀體中的多巴胺訊號傳導，特別是在皮質紋狀體迴路中，其中多巴胺調節 habit formation 底層的 synaptic plasticity。由 DAT、COMT 和受體音調形成的紋狀體多巴胺過多和不足都會擾亂 S-R 獲取和程序性學習。 COMT 過度表現模型顯示多巴胺清除率的改變會損害這種學習。這使得紋狀體多巴胺成為習慣和技能學習效率的關鍵決定因素。

label: Locus Coeruleus
description: Locus Coeruleus and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Locus Coeruleus and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Locus Coeruleus 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Locus Coeruleus 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: EX-527
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The selective SIRT1 inhibitor EX-527 (Selisistat) enhanced DNA-damage-induced cell death in HeLa cells treated with etoposide or camptothecin, mirroring the effect of SIRT1 knockdown in TRIM28-deficient backgrounds. Combined with the reciprocal observation — TRIM28 knockout cells die more when SIRT1 is depleted, and re-expression rescues — this demonstrates that SIRT1 catalytic activity is protective during the DDR and that pharmacological SIRT1 inhibition removes that protection.
description_zh_TW: 選擇性 SIRT1 抑制劑 EX-527（Selisistat）會加劇 etoposide 或 camptothecin 處理之 HeLa 細胞的 DNA 損傷性死亡，與在 TRIM28 缺陷背景下沉默 SIRT1 的效果一致。結合反向觀察——TRIM28 基因敲除細胞在 SIRT1 缺失時死亡更多，而重新表達可 rescue——這證明 SIRT1 的催化活性在 DDR 中具有保護性，藥理性抑制 SIRT1 等於移除該保護。

label: Pheomelanin
description: Benzothiazine and Pheomelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Benzothiazine and Pheomelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Benzothiazine 和 Pheomelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Benzothiazine 和 Pheomelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: PP2A
description: The protein phosphatase PP2A dephosphorylates TFEB at S122 and at the cluster S109 and S114, promoting translocation of the transcription factor to the nucleus (PMID 29945972). Dephosphorylation of these sites reverses the cytoplasmic-retention effect of mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at S122, releasing TFEB to enter the nucleus and activate lysosomal and autophagic gene transcription. This places protein phosphatase 2A as a counteracting force to nutrient-sensing kinase pathways, helping determine the net phosphorylation state of TFEB and thus its subcellular localization. Together with calcineurin, PP2A provides the dephosphorylation arm of TFEB's regulatory cycle.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 PP2A 在 S122 以及 S109 和 S114 群簇上去磷酸化 TFEB，促進該轉錄因子轉位至細胞核（PMID 29945972）。這些位點的去磷酸化逆轉 mTORC1 介導的 S122 磷酸化所產生的胞質保留效應，釋放 TFEB 進入細胞核並啟動溶酶體和自噬基因轉錄。這使蛋白磷酸酶 2A 成為營養感知激酶通路的拮抗力量，有助於決定 TFEB 的淨磷酸化狀態及其亞細胞定位。與鈣調磷酸酶一起，PP2A 提供了 TFEB 調節週期的去磷酸化臂。

label: L-arginine
description: L-arginine is a precursor for nitric oxide, as the guanidino nitrogen of arginine is converted to NO and L-citrulline by nitric oxide synthase. This makes arginine availability a determinant of NO production. The directionality is substrate to product in NOS catalysis. A caveat is that arginine availability rarely limits basal eNOS because intracellular arginine is usually sufficient, though competition with arginase can matter. The arginine paradox, in which supplemental arginine raises NO despite saturating intracellular concentrations, points to compartmentalized arginine pools and competition with arginase.
description_zh_TW: L-arginine 是 nitric oxide 的前體，因為精胺酸的胍基氮被 nitric oxide synthase 轉化為 NO 和 L-瓜胺酸。這使得精胺酸的可用性成為一氧化氮產生的決定因素。 NOS 催化中的方向性是從底物到產物。需要注意的是，精胺酸的可用性很少限制基礎 eNOS，因為細胞內精胺酸通常就足夠了，儘管與 arginase 的競爭可能很重要。精氨酸悖論是，儘管細胞內濃度已飽和，但補充精氨酸仍會升高 NO，這表明精氨酸庫區分開來，並與 arginase 競爭。

label: Collagen
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: In the extracellular matrix, matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) such as MMP-1 and MMP-2 are involved in remodeling collagen and elastin that have been stiffened by glycation. Because AGE crosslinks make these long-lived structural proteins resistant to normal turnover, MMP-mediated remodeling helps manage matrix that has accumulated glycation damage, though MMP activity can become dysregulated under high-AGE conditions.
