MMPs thereby act as a degradative countermeasure to AGE-induced matrix stiffening, balancing crosslink formation and matrix turnover in vascular and connective tissue, although excessive or dysregulated MMP activity contributes to matrix destruction.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞外基質中，基質金屬蛋白酶（MMPs），如 MMP-1 與 MMP-2，參與重塑因糖化而變僵硬的膠原蛋白與彈力蛋白。由於 AGE 交聯使這些長壽結構蛋白對正常更新產生抗性，MMP 介導的重塑有助於處理已累積糖化損傷的基質，儘管在高 AGE 條件下 MMP 活性可能失調。因此，MMPs 作為對抗 AGE 誘發基質僵硬的降解性對策，在血管與結締組織中平衡交聯形成與基質更新，儘管過度或失調的 MMP 活性會導致基質破壞。

label: Apaf-1
description: Cytochrome c released through BAX/BAK-permeabilized mitochondria binds Apaf-1 (apoptotic protease activating factor-1), which together with procaspase-9 assembles the heptameric apoptosome. Within this platform procaspase-9 is activated and in turn cleaves caspase-3, committing the cell to intrinsic apoptosis. The apoptosome is therefore the router that converts mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization into caspase-9 activation, and it is the very complex whose additional components (such as SIRT1 after caspase cleavage) reshape cell fate.
description_zh_TW: 經由 BAX/BAK 通透化的粒線體所釋出的 Cytochrome c 會結合 Apaf-1（凋亡蛋白酶活化因子-1），並與 pro-Caspase-9 共同組裝成七聚體凋亡體（apoptosome）。在此平台上 pro-Caspase-9 被活化，進而切割 Caspase-3，使細胞走向內在凋亡。凋亡體因此是將粒線體外膜通透化轉換為 Caspase-9 活化的路由器，也正是 SIRT1（在 caspase 切割後）重塑細胞命運時所處的複合體。

label: Mitochondrial-Derived Peptide
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: MOTS-c is a 16 amino acid peptide encoded by the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene, and is one of eight mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs) described to date along with humanin and small humanin-like peptides 1-6 (SHLPs 1-6). It is an exercise-induced factor that increases insulin sensitivity and visceral fat accumulation, with circulating levels rising acutely with exercise. The peptide has also been observed to translocate to the nucleus during energetic stress, suggesting both cell-autonomous and non-cell-autonomous functions.
description_zh_TW: MOTS-c是由粒線體12S rRNA基因編碼的16胺基酸肽，是迄今描述的八種粒線體衍生肽（MDPs）之一，與humanin和小型humanin類似肽1-6（SHLPs 1-6）並列。它是一種運動誘導因子，可增加胰島素敏感性和內臟脂肪堆積，其循環水平在運動後急性升高。該肽還被觀察到在能量應激時易位至細胞核，提示其具有細胞自主和非細胞自主功能。

label: NAD+ Biosynthesis
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NRH (dihydronicotinamide riboside) is the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside and has recently been shown to promote NAD+ synthesis. Alongside NMNH (dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide), the reduced form of nicotinamide mononucleotide, NRH expands the repertoire of NAD+ precursors beyond the amidated molecules nicotinamide, NMN, and NR. These reduced precursors are additional substrates for the salvage pathway and are considered orally bioavailable NAD+ precursors. Their discovery illustrates the redundancy of NAD+ biosynthetic routes and suggests that multiple dietary and pharmacological compounds can contribute to maintaining intracellular NAD+ levels across tissues.
description_zh_TW: NRH（二氫菸鹼醯胺核糖）是菸鹼醯胺核糖的還原形式，最近被證實能促進 NAD+ 生合成。與 NMNH（二氫菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸，即菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸的還原形式）一起，NRH 將 NAD+ 前驅物的範疇擴展到醯胺化分子菸鹼醯胺、NMN 和 NR 之外。這些還原型前驅物是回收路徑的額外受質，被視為口服具生物可利用性的 NAD+ 前驅物。它們的發現說明了 NAD+ 生合成路徑的冗餘性，並顯示多種膳食與藥理化合物可貢獻於維持跨組織的細胞內 NAD+ 水平。

label: ABT-263
description: BH3 mimetics include ABT-263. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor to ABT-737 whose Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia. The relationship is directional, with BH3 mimetics acting as the operative agent upon ABT-263 rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: BH3 mimetics 包括 ABT-263。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。 ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物利用型後繼者，其 Bcl-xL 抑製作用會導致標靶血小板減少症。這種關係是有方向的，BH3 mimetics 充當 ABT-263 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: SADS
description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Food is an important source of exogenous advanced glycation end products, since significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins via the Maillard reaction. In a mouse model, feeding an AGE-rich diet for 16 weeks promoted a 53% increase in serum AGE levels. In renal failure patients, an AGE-rich diet produced a 29% increase in blood CML, while a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction. These findings suggest that a diet restricting AGEs is an effective way to reduce the AGE burden in the human body.
description_zh_TW: Food 是 exogenous advanced glycation end products 的重要來源，因為當 sugars 與 proteins 經由 Maillard reaction 一起 cooked 時，會產生顯著的 AGE。在 mouse model 中，餵食 AGE-rich diet 16 週使血清 AGE levels 增加 53%。在 renal failure patients 中，AGE-rich diet 使血液 CML 增加 29%，而 low-AGE diet 則使其降低 34%。這些 findings 顯示，限制 AGEs 的 diet 是降低人體 AGE burden 的有效方法。

label: Methylglyoxal
description: The glyoxalase system, composed of GLO1 and GLO2, is the primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. Methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone are highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, and if left unchecked they form irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. The glyoxalase system neutralizes these precursors, and maintaining GLO1 activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation. Dysfunction of this system is therefore linked to increased dicarbonyl stress and accelerated protein glycation, with consequences for aging, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 由 GLO1 與 GLO2 組成的乙二醛酶系統（glyoxalase system）是對抗二羰基壓力的主要防禦系統。甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）、乙二醛（glyoxal）與 3-deoxyglucosone 是糖解與脂質過氧化過程中產生的高度反應性二羰基中間產物，若不加控制，它們會在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。乙二醛酶系統中和這些前驅物，而維持 GLO1 活性是減少內生性 AGE 堆積的主要標的。因此，此系統的功能障礙與二羰基壓力增加及蛋白質糖化加速有關，對老化、糖尿病與心血管疾病產生影響。

label: DNA Replication Stress
source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md
description: Constitutive oncogenic RAS signaling pushes cells into hyper-replication, where DNA replication forks are initiated at excessive frequency and become stalled or collapsed. This generates single-stranded DNA gaps and replication stress that activate checkpoint kinases ATR and ATM, converging on p53 stabilization. The relationship is a central mechanism linking oncogene activation to senescence-inducing damage and is well established in OIS biology. It explains how proliferative overload is converted into a senescence signal.
description_zh_TW: 組成型致癌 RAS 訊號將細胞推入過度複製，其中 DNA 複製叉以過高頻率起始並停滯或崩塌。這產生單股 DNA 缺口與複製壓力，活化檢查點激酶（ATR/ATM）與 DDR。在 OIS 中，此複製壓力是衰老誘發的核心上游事件，將癌基因活化連結到遺傳不穩定與停滯。它是 RAS 驅動衰老的關鍵機制前因。

label: IGF1
description: Intermittent fasting lowers circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), a potent mitogenic and pro-survival hormone whose signaling converges on the PI3K-Akt-mTOR axis to inhibit autophagy. In a breast cancer model, a 48-hour fasting period reduced IGF-1 levels by approximately 70%, dampening pro-tumorigenic IGF-1 receptor signaling. The resulting reduction in mTORC1 activity contributes to the fasting-induced activation of autophagy and the enhanced stress resistance of normal tissues. Lower IGF-1 during fasting is therefore a key endocrine mechanism linking IF to both tumor suppression and longevity.
description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食降低循環的類胰島素生長因子1（IGF-1），這是一種強效的促有絲分裂和促存活激素，其訊號匯聚於PI3K-Akt-mTOR軸以抑制自噬。在乳腺癌模型中，48小時斷食使IGF-1水平降低約70%，減弱促腫瘤生成的IGF-1受體訊號。由此產生的mTORC1活性降低有助於斷食誘導的自噬活化和正常組織增強的壓力抵抗。因此，斷食期間較低的IGF-1是將IF與腫瘤抑制和長壽連結的關鍵內分泌機制。

label: NAD+ Salvage Pathway
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NAMPT (nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, converting nicotinamide into nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in an energetically costly step. NAMPT activity therefore determines how much NAD+ precursor is available to fuel sirtuins and other NAD+-consuming enzymes such as CD38 and the poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases. Directionally, NAMPT sits upstream of NAD+ pool size and sirtuin activity. Because NAMPT couples cellular energy state to NAD+ biosynthesis, it is a primary node linking metabolism to sirtuin function and a key target for interventions aimed at restoring NAD+ during aging.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT（菸鹼醯胺磷酸核糖轉移酶）是NAD+補救合成途徑的限速酶，在一個耗能的步驟中將菸鹼醯胺轉化為菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）。因此NAMPT活性決定了有多少NAD+前體可用於驅動sirtuin和其他NAD+消耗酶（如CD38和多聚ADP-核糖聚合酶）。方向上，NAMPT位於NAD+池大小和sirtuin活性的上游。因為NAMPT將細胞能量狀態與NAD+生物合成耦合，它是連結代謝與sirtuin功能的主要節點，也是旨在恢復老化過程中NAD+的介入措施的關鍵靶點。

label: Argyria
description: Metallic silver is oxidized and may deposit in the tissues, causing argyria, a permanent blue-gray pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Argyria results when large doses of silver are absorbed into the circulatory system and deposited in body tissues; although disfiguring and usually permanent, the condition does not otherwise harm health, and mild forms are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis. The pigmentation reflects reduced elemental silver and silver sulfide granules lodged in the tissues.
description_zh_TW: 金屬銀被氧化並可能沉積在組織中，導致argyria，一種皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的永久性藍灰色色素沉著。當大劑量銀吸收進入循環系統並沉積在體組織中時，會導致argyria；雖然毀容且通常永久，但該病變對健康無其他損害，輕度形式有時被誤認為發紺。色素沉著反映了還原的元素銀和硫化銀顆粒滯留在組織中。

label: Noxa
description: Bcl-2 family includes Noxa. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Noxa is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein with selective affinity for Mcl-1 and A1, sensitizing cells to mitochondrial apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Noxa rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bcl-2 family 包括 Noxa。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Noxa 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，對 Mcl-1 和 A1 具有選擇性親和力，使細胞對粒線體凋亡敏感。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當Noxa 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Silver ion
description: The silver ion is known to inhibit glutathione peroxidase and Na+,K+-ATPase activity, disrupting selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions and intracellular ion concentrations, respectively. Glutathione peroxidase is the selenoenzyme that detoxifies hydroperoxides, so its inhibition by silver impairs cellular antioxidant defense and promotes oxidative stress. This enzyme-inhibitory activity is a key mechanism linking silver exposure to toxicity and mirrors the redox disruption that makes silver compounds effective antimicrobials.
description_zh_TW: 已知銀離子抑制穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶和Na+,K+-ATPase活性，分別干擾硒催化的硫氫基氧化還原反應和細胞內離子濃度。穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶是解毒氫過氧化物的硒酶，因此其被銀抑制損害細胞抗氧化防禦並促進氧化應激。這種酶抑制活性是將銀暴露與毒性聯繫起來的關鍵機制，反映了使銀化合物成為有效抗菌劑的氧化還原干擾。

label: Mesenchymal-to-Epithelial Transition
description: During cellular reprogramming, Oct4 initiates the mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition (MET), a required early step in which fibroblast-like cells adopt an epithelial morphology. By suppressing mesenchymal genes and promoting epithelial ones, Oct4 helps reorganize the cytoskeleton and cell-adhesion program toward the epithelial identity characteristic of pluripotent cells. This MET is followed by erasure of somatic marks and establishment of the pluripotency network, and it is reinforced by the cooperation of Klf4.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞重編程過程中，Oct4 啟動間質到上皮的轉變 (MET)，這是纖維母細胞樣細胞採用上皮形態所需的早期步驟。透過抑制間質基因並促進上皮基因，Oct4 有助於重組細胞骨架和細胞黏附程序，以實現多能細胞的上皮身份特徵。該 MET 隨後是體細胞標記的擦除和多能性網絡的建立，並透過 Klf4 的合作得到加強。

label: SLC25A1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: SLC25A1, the mitochondrial citrate carrier, exports citrate from the mitochondrial matrix to the cytosol, where it can be converted to acetyl-CoA. SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels in multiple senescence contexts, and this citrate export sustains the nucleocytosolic acetyl-CoA pool required for histone acetylation. Genetic ablation of SLC25A1 does not alter CDK inhibitor expression or cell cycle arrest but markedly reduces SASP gene expression, and inhibition with the third-generation inhibitor CTPI2 selectively suppresses SASP-associated inflammation without clearing senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A1，線粒體枸櫞酸載體，將枸櫞酸從線粒體基質輸出到細胞質，在那裡可以轉化為乙酰輔酶A。SLC25A1表達在多種衰老背景下在mRNA和蛋白質水平上都顯著增加，這種枸櫞酸輸出維持組蛋白乙酰化所需的核質乙酰輔酶A池。SLC25A1的基因消融不改變CDK抑製劑表達或細胞週期停滯，但顯著減少SASP基因表達，使用第三代抑製劑CTPI2的抑製選擇性地抑制SASP相關炎症而不清除衰老細胞。

label: HDAC4
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: HDAC4 possesses SUMO E3 ligase activity and sumoylates MEF2D at Lys424, locking it into an inactive, transcription-repressing state. Directionally, HDAC4 sits upstream of MEF2D inactivation. This regulates muscle-gene expression independently of sirtuins, and it is included as a parallel chromatin regulatory mechanism contextualizing SIRT1's muscle actions. By sumoylating MEF2D, HDAC4 represses its transcriptional activity and the muscle genes it controls. This regulation is distinct from the acetylation-deacetylation balance that sirtuins influence, illustrating the diversity of muscle-gene control.
description_zh_TW: HDAC4 具有 SUMO E3 連接酶活性，在 Lys424 位點 SUMO 化 MEF2D，將其鎖定在不活化的轉錄抑制狀態。在方向性上，HDAC4 位於 MEF2D 失活的上游。這獨立於 sirtuin 調控肌肉基因表達，被納入作為將 SIRT1 肌肉作用置於背景中的平行染色質調控機制。透過 SUMO 化 MEF2D，HDAC4 抑制其轉錄活性和它所控制的肌肉基因。此調控不同於 sirtuin 影響的乙醯化-去乙醯化平衡，說明了肌肉基因控制的多樣性。

label: NOX2
description: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
description_zh_TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

label: Muscle Wasting
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reversed the progressive wasting syndrome in skeletal muscle in mice lacking Nampt while restoring endurance in as little as 1 week of treatment. Decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression were also observed in Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD), a condition histologically and transcriptionally similar to progressive wasting syndrome and characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration. NR was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of DMD and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. These findings support NR as an effective approach to managing muscular dystrophy and degeneration.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）逆轉了缺乏 Nampt 小鼠骨骼肌中的漸進性消耗症候群，同時在僅 1 週的治療內恢復耐力。在 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）中也觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低，此疾病在組織學與轉錄組學上類似於漸進性消耗症候群，並以 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化為特徵。NR 被發現能改善 DMD 的 mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。這些發現支持 NR 作為管理肌肉營養不良與退化的有效方法。

label: Silver nanoparticles
description: Silver nanoparticles are believed to disrupt the mitochondrial respiratory chain, causing oxidative stress, reduced ATP synthesis, and DNA damage. The mitochondrial electron transport chain is the major source of cellular energy, and its disruption collapses oxidative phosphorylation and elevates reactive oxygen production. This nanoparticle-specific toxicity is attributed to sustained release of silver ions and direct interaction with respiratory complexes, distinguishing it from the bulk-metal effects of larger silver particles.
description_zh_TW: 相信銀奈米粒子會干擾粒線體呼吸鏈，導致氧化應激、ATP合成減少和DNA損傷。粒線體電子傳遞鏈是細胞能量的主要來源，其干擾會使氧化磷酸化崩潰並增加活性氧產生。此奈米粒子特異性毒性歸因於銀離子的持續釋放和與呼吸複合物的直接相互作用，區別於較大銀粒子的塊狀金屬效應。

label: AP-1
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: The transcription factor AP-1 acts as a pioneering factor that binds to enhancers associated with SASP and other senescence-related genes, initiating the opening of closed chromatin. By pioneering open chromatin at these enhancers, AP-1 enables subsequent recruitment of transcriptional machinery, the histone acetyltransferase p300, and activation of SASP gene expression. Depletion of the AP-1 family member c-Jun alone can partially reverse senescence-associated cell cycle arrest, underscoring AP-1's central regulatory role.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子 AP-1 作為先鋒因子，與 SASP 和其他老化相關基因相關的增強子結合，啟動封閉染色質的打開。透過在這些增強子上率先開放染色質，AP-1 能夠隨後招募轉錄機制、組蛋白乙醯轉移酶 p300，並活化 SASP gene expression。單獨消耗 AP-1 家族成員 c-Jun 可以部分逆轉老化相關的細胞週期停滯，強調了 AP-1 的核心調節作用。

label: Renal Cell Carcinoma
description: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the most common malignant kidney tumor, usually clear-cell subtype.
description_zh_TW: 腎細胞癌 (RCC) 是最常見的惡性腎臟腫瘤，通常為透明細胞亞型。

label: Mitochondrial Dynamics
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Drp1 is the GTP-binding protein that executes mitochondrial fission: it translocates from the cytosol to mitochondria to sever the organelle, a prerequisite for segregating damaged mitochondria and enacting mitophagy. Drp1-mediated fission sits at the hub of multiple death modalities — PGAM5 and RIPK3 recruit it for necroptosis, BNIP3-interacting pathways engage it in apoptosis, and Parkin regulates its activity and degradation by polyubiquitination. Its recruitment is therefore both a quality-control step and a death-priming step depending on context.
description_zh_TW: Drp1 是執行粒線體分裂的 GTP 結合蛋白：它會由細胞質轉位至粒線體將其切斷，這是隔離受損粒線體並執行粒線體自噬的前提。Drp1 介導的分裂位於多種死亡模式的樞紐——PGAM5 與 RIPK3 為程序性壞死而招募它，BNIP3 相關路徑在細胞凋亡中動用它，而 Parkin 則透過多泛素化調控其活性與降解。因此 Drp1 的招募依情境不同，既可能是品質管制步驟，也可能是死亡致敏步驟。

label: Advanced Glycation End Products formation
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Genistein is an isoflavone flavonoid reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Together with other flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercitrin, and quercetin, genistein inhibits the glycation process in vitro. The anti-glycation activities of these polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than aminoguanidine, and they act in part through trapping reactive carbonyl species and antioxidant capacity. Herbal products and dietary plants containing these flavonoids are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for preventing glycation and AGE accumulation during aging.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 是一種異黃酮類黃酮，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他黃酮類如 kaempferol、quercitrin 與 quercetin 一起，Genistein 在體外抑制糖化過程。這些多酚的抗糖化活性與 aminoguanidine 相似甚至更強，且部分透過捕捉活性羰基物種與抗氧化能力來作用。因此，含有這些黃酮類的草藥產品與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 堆積的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

label: Leukemia
description: Leukemia is a clonal hematologic malignancy arising from abnormal hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells.
description_zh_TW: Leukemia 是一種由異常造血幹/祖細胞引起的克隆性血液惡性腫瘤。

label: NLRP3 Inflammasome
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT1 plays a protective role in inflammation by deacetylating and attenuating NLRP3 inflammasome activity, reducing caspase-1 activation and IL-1β maturation. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed NLRP3. This is mediated in part through the AMPKα/spliced-XBP1 pathway in macrophages, and SIRT1 also inhibits NLRP3 by reducing mitochondrial ROS that prime the inflammasome. It links sirtuins to innate immune regulation and metabolic inflammation, and its decline with age is associated with inflammasome-driven pathology. SIRT1-dependent restraint of the NLRP3 inflammasome is thus a key mechanism in aging and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 通過去乙醯化並減弱 NLRP3 炎症小體活性在發炎中發揮保護作用，減少 caspase-1 活化和 IL-1β 成熟。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於被抑制的 NLRP3 上游。這部分通過巨噬細胞中的 AMPKα/spliced-XBP1 通路介導，SIRT1 還通過減少粒線體 ROS（這些 ROS 作為炎症小體的引發因子）來抑制 NLRP3。這將 sirtuin 與先天免疫調節和代謝性發炎聯繫起來，其隨年齡的下降與炎症小體驅動的病理相關。SIRT1 依賴性的 NLRP3 炎症小體抑制因此是衰老和發炎中的關鍵機制。

label: Acute Kidney Injury
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 is a pivotal coordinator of renal bioenergetics maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis, enhancing antioxidant defenses, and modulating ECM dynamics; its expression is reduced across nephropathies and negatively correlated with histological injury severity. SIRT3 overexpression alleviates AKI and CKD progression in multiple preclinical models, via Nrf2 pathway upregulation, NF-kappaB suppression through IkappaBalpha stabilization, and inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是腎臟生物能學的關鍵協調者，維護粒線體恆定、增強抗氧化防禦並調節 ECM 動態；其表現在腎病變中降低，且與組織學損傷嚴重程度呈負相關。SIRT3 的過量表現在多個臨床前模型中緩解 AKI 和 CKD 進展，透過 Nrf2 途徑上調、NF-kappaB 抑制（經由 IkappaBalpha 穩定化）和 NLRP3 炎症小體活化的抑制。

label: H3K27ac
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: ChIP-seq analysis of histone H3 acetylation at lysine 27 (H3K27ac) showed that loci gaining acetylation during senescence are markedly reduced following mitochondrial clearance, and these regions are enriched for inflammatory and interleukin signalling pathways central to the SASP. A 51-gene SASP signature induced during senescence is suppressed upon mitochondrial removal, with genes such as IL6 and CCL2 showing coordinated decreases in chromatin acetylation and mRNA expression. Multiple nodes of the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis converge to control H3K27ac at SASP loci, selectively modulating inflammatory gene expression without affecting the senescence-associated cell cycle arrest.
description_zh_TW: 對組蛋白H3在賴氨酸27處的乙酰化（H3K27ac）的ChIP-seq分析表明，在衰老過程中獲得乙酰化的位點在線粒體清除後顯著減少，並且這些區域富含與SASP核心相關的炎症和白細胞介素信號通路。在衰老過程中誘導的51個基因的SASP特徵在線粒體移除後被抑制，IL6和CCL2等基因顯示出染色質乙酰化和mRNA表達的協調減少。線粒體枸櫞酸-乙酰輔酶A軸的多個節點匯聚以控制SASP位點的H3K27ac，選擇性地調節炎症基因表達而不影響衰老相關的細胞週期停滯。

label: o-quinone
description: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid (o-quinone) structure, and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines such as aminoguanidine and semicarbazide to form hemostatic medicines. This instability also means that during the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline, the produced adrenochrome may be further oxidized and decompose to black by-products, so the reaction is monitored by sampling and measuring the absorbance at 495 nm, which is stopped at the point of maximum yield.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式（o-quinone）結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與胺基胍和氨基硫脲等肼類的常規衍生化來穩定，以形成止血藥物。此不穩定性也意味著在腎上腺素的過硫酸鹽氧化過程中，生成的腎上腺紅可能進一步氧化並分解為黑色副產物，因此反應透過取樣並測量495 nm的吸光度來監控，並在產率最大時停止。

label: VEGF
description: VEGF drives Angiogenesis. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with VEGF acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: VEGF 驅動 Angiogenesis。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，VEGF 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: CML
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: CML (N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine) has been reported as one of the most abundant advanced glycation end products in vivo and was one of the first AGEs to be characterized in foods, particularly milk and milk products. Because of its abundance and relative ease of measurement, CML is chosen in most studies as a marker of AGEs in both foods and in vivo. It is a glycoxidation product of lysine residues and accumulates in long-lived proteins. CML is the basis of a food database of approximately 500 items and is widely used as a biomarker linking dietary and circulating AGE burden to health outcomes.
description_zh_TW: CML（N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine）被報導為體內最豐富的晚期糖化終產物之一，也是最早在食物中（特別是牛奶與乳製品）被表徵的 AGE 之一。由於其豐富性與相對容易測量，CML 在大多數研究中被選作食物與體內 AGE 的標記。它是賴氨酸殘基的糖氧化產物，並堆積於長壽命蛋白中。CML 是約 500 項食品資料庫的基礎，並被廣泛用作連結飲食與循環 AGE 負擔和健康結果的生物標記。

label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
description_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

label: PD-L1
description: PD-L1 enables Immune Evasion. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. Immune evasion is a recognized hallmark whereby tumors disarm or exclude cytotoxic lymphocytes through checkpoints and immunosuppressive microenvironments. The relationship is directional, with PD-L1 acting as the operative agent upon Immune Evasion rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: PD-L1 啟用 Immune Evasion。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。 Immune Evasion是一個公認的標誌，腫瘤透過檢查點和免疫抑制微環境解除或排除細胞毒性淋巴細胞。這種關係是有方向的，PD-L1 充當 Immune Evasion 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta
description: Dopamine is located in Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta, establishing the anatomical or subcellular compartment where the entity exerts its function. Mechanistically, this localization reflects biosynthesis, vesicular storage, or the selective vulnerability of that region's neurons. It is significant because the site of localization determines which circuits and symptoms are affected, particularly in Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that localization is often regionally predominant rather than exclusive, and other brain areas may contain smaller amounts of the same entity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 位於 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 中，建立實體發揮其功能的解剖或亞細胞區室。從機制上講，這種定位反映了該區域神經元的生物合成、囊泡儲存或選擇性脆弱性。這很重要，因為本地化的位置決定了哪些電路和症狀受到影響，特別是在 Parkinson's disease 中。需要注意的是，定位通常是區域性的，而不是排他性的，而其他大腦區域可能包含少量的相同實體。

label: Energy Expenditure
description: Several single-nucleotide polymorphisms in the human SIRT1 gene are significantly associated with systemic energy expenditure in Finnish cohorts, suggesting that SIRT1 variation influences metabolic rate. These variants may alter SIRT1 expression or activity, shifting how individuals burn fuel at rest and during activity. Directionally, genetic SIRT1 variation is linked to an energy-expenditure phenotype. As with most genetic-association findings, effect sizes are modest and context-dependent, and replication in other populations is needed.
description_zh_TW: 人類 SIRT1 基因中的幾個單核苷酸多態性與芬蘭研究組的全身能量消耗顯著相關，表明 SIRT1 變異影響代謝率。這些變異可能改變 SIRT1 的表達或活性，改變個體在靜息和活動狀態下的燃料燃燒方式。在方向性上，遺傳性 SIRT1 變異與能量消耗表型相關。與大多數遺傳關聯研究一樣，效應量 modest 且取決於情境，需要在其他人群中進行複製驗證。

label: Dihydromyricetin
description: Dihydromyricetin (DHM), a flavonoid from vine tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata), activates SIRT3 mitochondrial deacetylase activity, leading to MnSOD deacetylation and lowered ROS. Directionally, DHM sits upstream of SIRT3 activation. This mitochondrial action underlies DHM's hepatoprotective and metabolic benefits, including protection against alcoholic and metabolic liver injury. DHM also activates AMPK, synergizing with SIRT3 via NAD+ elevation, so its effects reflect coordinated activation of both energy-sensing pathways. The compound is abundant in vine tea, which provides a practical dietary source at therapeutic doses.
description_zh_TW: 二氫楊梅素（Dihydromyricetin，DHM）是一種來自藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）的類黃酮，活化 SIRT3 粒線體去乙醯酶活性，導致 MnSOD 去乙醯化和 ROS 降低。在方向性上，DHM 位於 SIRT3 活化的上游。這種粒線體作用是 DHM 肝臟保護和代謝益處的基礎，包括保護對抗酒精性和代謝性肝損傷。DHM 也活化 AMPK，通過 NAD+ 升高與 SIRT3 協同，因此其效應反映了兩種能量感知通路的協調活化。該化合物在藤茶中含量豐富，提供了實際的飲食來源以達到治療劑量。

label: Cyanosis
description: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'. Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron. Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'。Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron。Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages。

label: DNA Methyltransferase
description: DNA methylation is catalyzed by a family of enzymes known as DNA methyltransferases (DNMTs), which transfer a methyl group from the cofactor S-adenosylmethionine to the C5 position of cytosine residues, predominantly within CpG dinucleotides. The family is divided into maintenance methyltransferases such as DNMT1, which copies methylation patterns onto the daughter strand during DNA replication, and de novo methyltransferases such as DNMT3a and DNMT3b, which establish new methylation at previously unmethylated loci. The accessory factor DNMT3L stimulates the catalytic activity of the de novo enzymes, and dysregulation of this enzyme family underlies cancer and age-related epigenetic drift.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化由稱為 DNA 甲基轉移酶 (DNMT) 的酶家族催化，該酶將甲基從輔因子 S-adenosylmethionine 轉移到胞嘧啶殘基的 C5 位置，主要在 CpG 二核苷酸內。該家族分為維持甲基轉移酶（如 DNMT1）和從頭甲基轉移酶（如 DNMT3a 和 DNMT3b），前者在 DNA 複製過程中將甲基化模式複製到子鏈上，後者在先前未甲基化的位點建立新的甲基化。輔助因子 DNMT3L 刺激從頭酶的催化活性，該酶家族的失調是癌症和與年齡相關的表觀遺傳漂移的基礎。

label: Immunosenescence
description: Immunosenescence is the systemic, age-related deterioration of immune function -- encompassing innate and adaptive arms -- that accompanies and is accelerated by aging. It is characterized by reduced naive T-cell output, expanded memory/effector subsets, impaired NK function, and chronic low-grade activation. As a subtype of aging-related decline, it directly undermines senescence surveillance and wound defense. Its classification as an aging phenomenon reflects its universality across the elderly.
description_zh_TW: 免疫衰老是伴隨並被老化加速的、系統性、年齡相關的免疫功能退化——涵蓋先天與適應臂。其特徵為初始 T 細胞產出減少、記憶/效應子集擴張、NK 功能受損與慢性低程度活化。作為老化相關衰退的亞型，它直接破壞衰老監視與傷口防禦。其歸類為老化現象反映其在老年人中的普遍性。

label: Mitochondrial Function
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: GlyNAC increased ATP production in PBMCs by 60% and improved mitochondrial membrane potential in a 24-week trial in older adults.
description_zh_TW: 老年受試者 24 週試驗中，GlyNAC 使周邊血單核細胞 ATP 生成增加 60%，並改善粒線體膜電位。

label: ERK
description: Cancer is driven by ERK. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. The directionality runs from ERK toward Cancer, so ERK is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由ERK 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。方向性從 ERK 朝向 Cancer，因此 ERK 是主動主體，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: N-Acetylcysteine
description: The NAC component of GlyNAC is deacetylated to cysteine, supplying the rate-limiting amino acid for glutathione synthesis.
description_zh_TW: GlyNAC 中的 NAC 成分會去乙醯化為半胱胺酸，提供穀胱甘肽合成中限速的胺基酸來源。

label: Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: Aminoguanidine, the first AGE inhibitor, has a safety concern related to its inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. By blocking NOS, aminoguanidine can reduce nitric oxide production, which together with its pro-oxidant activities prevented its clinical use. This NOS inhibition is one of the adverse effects that emerged during evaluation of aminoguanidine as a therapeutic agent. Despite these limitations, aminoguanidine remains a key research compound that established the concept of AGE inhibition for preventing diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 作為首個 AGE inhibitor，其 safety concern 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase（NOS）有關。透過 blocking NOS，aminoguanidine 可減少 nitric oxide production，這與其 pro-oxidant activities 一起阻止了其 clinical use。此 NOS inhibition 是在評估 aminoguanidine 作為 therapeutic agent 期間出現的 adverse effects 之一。儘管有這些 limitations，aminoguanidine 仍是確立 AGE inhibition 以預防 diabetic complications 概念的關鍵 research compound。

label: Sox2
description: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc that reprogram somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and they include Sox2. Sox2 cooperates with Oct4 as a heterodimer to regulate pluripotency genes such as Nanog, Fgf4, and osteopontin, and it is also expressed in neural stem cells where it maintains neural identity. Its ectopic expression is essential for the establishment and maintenance of the pluripotent state. Sox2 is therefore essential both for pluripotency maintenance and for the reprogramming process itself.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子是將體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的四種轉錄因子Oct4、Sox2、Klf4和c-Myc，其中包括Sox2。 Sox2 與 Oct4 作為異二聚體配合調節 Nanog、Fgf4 和骨橋蛋白等多能性基因，並且在神經幹細胞中也表達，維持神經特性。其異位表達對於多能狀態的建立和維持至關重要。因此，Sox2 對於多能性維持和重編程過程本身至關重要。

label: BH3 mimetics
description: Cancer is treated by BH3 mimetics. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward Cancer, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由BH3 mimetics 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從BH3 mimetics 向Cancer 延伸，因此BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: COVID-19
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Combined metabolic activators (CMAs), consisting of NR (1 g), l-carnitine tartrate (3.73 g), N-acetylcysteine (2.55 g), and serine (12.35 g), improved COVID-19 outcomes in clinical trials. Patients taking the mixture orally for 14 days had significantly faster complete recovery times than placebo (6.6 vs 9.3 days in a phase 2 study and 5.7 vs 9.2 days in a phase 3 study). CMAs were found to reinforce the immune response and regulate amino acid and lipid metabolism, and patients showed improvements in plasma levels of inflammation and antioxidant metabolism-related biomarkers including alanine aminotransferase, lactate dehydrogenase, creatinine, glucose, and proteins. NR within the mixture contributes NAD+ restoration supporting antiviral PARP function.
description_zh_TW: 合併代謝活化劑（CMAs）由 NR（1 g）、酒石酸左旋肉鹼（3.73 g）、N-乙醯半胱胺酸（2.55 g）和絲胺酸（12.35 g）組成，在臨床試驗中改善了 COVID-19 結果。口服此混合物 14 天的患者，其完全康復時間顯著快於安慰劑組（第二期研究為 6.6 對 9.3 天，第三期研究為 5.7 對 9.2 天）。CMAs 被發現能強化免疫反應並調節胺基酸與脂質代謝，且患者的發炎與抗氧化代謝相關生物標記血漿水平有所改善，包括丙胺酸轉胺酶、乳酸脫氫酶、肌酸酐、葡萄糖與蛋白質。混合物中的 NR 有助於 NAD+ 恢復，支持抗病毒 PARP 功能。

label: ULK1
description: ULK1 functions within a stable initiation complex containing ATG13, FIP200 (RB1CC1), and ATG101, which nucleates autophagosome formation in response to nutrient status. Directionally, the complex sits upstream of autophagy initiation. SIRT1 deacetylates and activates ULK1 within this complex, positioning sirtuins at the top of the autophagic machinery. The ULK1 complex integrates signals from AMPK and mTORC1, which either activate or inhibit it depending on energy and nutrient state. This makes the initiation complex the central decision point for whether autophagy proceeds.
description_zh_TW: ULK1 在一個包含 ATG13、FIP200（RB1CC1）和 ATG101 的穩定啟動複合物中發揮功能，該複合物在回應營養狀態時 nucleate 自噬體形成。在方向性上，該複合物位於自噬啟動的上游。SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化此複合物中的 ULK1，將 sirtuin 置於自噬機制的頂端。ULK1 複合物整合來自 AMPK 和 mTORC1 的訊號，根據能量和營養狀態啟動或抑制自噬。這使啟動複合物成為自噬是否進行的決策核心。

label: ABCA1
description: ABCA1 regulates cholesterol homeostasis by mediating the efflux of cellular cholesterol and phospholipids to lipid-poor apolipoproteins such as apoA-I. This is the first step in reverse cholesterol transport and HDL biogenesis. The directionality is transporter activity to lipid export. A caveat is that ABCA1 also influences phospholipid trafficking and immune cell function, so its role extends beyond pure cholesterol handling. Loss of ABCA1 function underlies Tangier disease, and its deficiency in macrophages promotes foam-cell formation and accelerated atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 透過介導細胞 cholesterol 和磷脂質向脂質貧乏的 apolipoproteins（例如 apoA-I）的流出來調節 cholesterol homeostasis。這是reverse cholesterol transport和HDL生物發生的第一步。方向性是脂質輸出的轉運蛋白活性。需要注意的是，ABCA1 也影響磷脂運輸和免疫細胞功能，因此其作用超出了純粹的 cholesterol 處理範圍。 ABCA1 功能的喪失是 Tangier disease 的基礎，巨噬細胞中的 ABCA1 功能缺失會促進泡沫細胞的形成並加速 atherosclerosis。

label: Hyperglycemia
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 is also consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, where its deficiency correlates with insulin resistance, and in skeletal muscle its deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中也持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗相關，在骨骼肌中其缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重第 2 型糖尿病的周邊胰島素阻抗。

label: FOXO3a
description: SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3a in multiple cell types, including neurons and fibroblasts, shifting its target-gene program toward stress resistance and away from apoptosis. Deacetylated FOXO3a induces antioxidant enzymes such as SOD2 and catalase, promotes autophagy and mitophagy through BNIP3, and reduces death-gene expression, biasing cells toward repair and survival. Directionally, SIRT1 modifies FOXO3a, and the altered transcription follows downstream. This stress-resistant switch is central to SIRT1-mediated protection in aging and neurodegeneration, and it links sirtuin activity to redox homeostasis and cellular quality control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在多種細胞類型（包括神經元和纖維母細胞）中去乙醯化 FOXO3a，將其靶基因程序轉向壓力抗性並遠離凋亡。去乙醯化的 FOXO3a 誘導抗氧化酶（如 SOD2 和 catalase），通過 BNIP3 促進自噬和粒線體自噬，並降低死亡基因表達，使細胞偏向修復和存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 修飾 FOXO3a，隨後的轉錄改變發生在下游。這種壓力抗性開關是 SIRT1 介導的在衰老和神經退行性疾病中保護的核心，將 sirtuin 活性與氧化還原穩態和細胞品質控制聯繫起來。

label: Acetyl-CoA
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: ACSS2 (acetyl-CoA synthetase 2) is a nuclear-cytosolic enzyme that ligates acetate to coenzyme A to form acetyl-CoA, providing a mitochondrial-independent route of acetyl-CoA production that supports histone acetylation and gene expression.
description_zh_TW: ACSS2（acetyl-CoA synthetase 2）是一種核-胞質酵素，將乙酸（acetate）與輔酶 A 連接形成 acetyl-CoA，提供一條不依賴粒線體的 acetyl-CoA 生成路徑，以支持組蛋白乙醯化與基因表現。

label: Ubiquitin-Proteasome System
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The ubiquitin-proteasome system stands as one of the main pathways responsible for the degradation of intracellular proteins, including muscle proteins. Studies have found that urolithin A can attenuate the degradation of muscle proteins by inhibiting the activity of the ubiquitin-proteasome system, possibly by influencing the activity of specific ubiquitin ligases or proteasomes. This inhibition contributes to urolithin A's muscle-sparing and anti-atrophic effects, helping to preserve muscle mass during catabolic states.
description_zh_TW: 泛素-蛋白酶體系統（ubiquitin-proteasome system）是負責細胞內蛋白（包括肌肉蛋白）降解的主要路徑之一。研究發現 urolithin A 可透過抑制泛素-蛋白酶體系統的活性來減緩肌肉蛋白的降解，可能是透過影響特定泛素連接酶或蛋白酶體的活性。此抑制作用有助於 urolithin A 的肌肉保留與抗萎縮效應，在分解代謝狀態下幫助保留肌肉量。

label: Cross-linking
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
description_zh_TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。

label: Lewy Bodies
description: Alpha-synuclein and Lewy Bodies are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Alpha-synuclein and Lewy Bodies may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 和 Lewy Bodies 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Alpha-synuclein 和 Lewy Bodies 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Tryptophan
description: Tryptophan (Trp) is the dietary precursor for de novo NAD+ biosynthesis, which proceeds through an eight-step pathway that passes through quinolinic acid before generating NAD+. This de novo route complements the salvage pathways, which recycle nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinic acid (NA), nicotinamide riboside (NR), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) back into NAD+ in two or three steps. Dietary tryptophan, or less than 20 mg of niacin daily, is sufficient to meet baseline NAD+ synthesis requirements, although greater rates of NAD+ synthesis through precursor supplementation are required to achieve therapeutic effects.
description_zh_TW: 色氨酸（Trp）是從頭合成 NAD+ 的飲食前驅物，此途徑經過八個步驟，在生成 NAD+ 之前會通過喹啉酸。這條從頭合成路徑補充了補救途徑，後者將菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼酸（NA）、菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）與菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）在兩到三個步驟內回收為 NAD+。飲食中的色氨酸，或每日少於 20 毫克的菸鹼酸，即足以滿足基礎 NAD+ 合成需求，然而要達到治療效果，則需透過前驅物補充來提高 NAD+ 合成速率。

label: GPX4
description: RSL3 is the prototype class-II ferroptosis inducer: it directly inhibits glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), the only enzyme that can reduce lipid hydroperoxides inside membranes. GPX4 inhibition makes the cell unable to neutralize lipid peroxides regardless of GSH supply, committing it to ferroptotic death. RSL3 synergy with autophagic GPX4 degradation (Fin56, copper) and its use alongside system-xc- blockers like erastin represent the two supply-side and effector-side strategies for triggering ferroptosis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: RSL3 是第二類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型：它直接抑制麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶 4（GPX4）——唯一能在膜內還原脂質氫過氧化物的酶。GPX4 受抑制後，無論 GSH 供應如何，細胞都無法中和脂質過氧化物，注定走向鐵死亡。RSL3 與自噬介導的 GPX4 降解（Fin56、銅）之間的協同，以及與 system xc- 阻斷劑（如 erastin）的並用，代表觸發癌症鐵死亡的供給端與效應端兩大策略。

label: DJ-1
description: Oxidative Stress and DJ-1 are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Oxidative Stress and DJ-1 may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 和 DJ-1 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Oxidative Stress 和 DJ-1 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Caspase-7
description: Alongside caspase-3, the executioner caspase-7 is a downstream target of the SIRT1-FOXO4 survival axis. FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 shifts FOXO output away from apoptosis (caspase-3/7 activation) toward stress resistance and repair gene expression. RNAi silencing of SIRT1 in p53-wildtype colorectal cancer cells produced caspase-3 and caspase-7 cleavage products and massive apoptosis, rescued by FOXO4 co-silencing — establishing caspase-7 as a co-executioner of the SIRT1-regulated death pathway.
description_zh_TW: 與 Caspase-3 並列，執行者半胱天冬酶-7 是 SIRT1-FOXO4 存活軸的下游目標。SIRT1 對 FOXO4 的去乙醯化會將 FOXO 的輸出由細胞凋亡（Caspase-3/7 活化）轉向壓力抗性與修復基因表達。在 p53 母源型大腸直腸癌細胞中以 RNAi 沉默 SIRT1 會產生 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 的切割片段並引發大量凋亡，而共同沉默 FOXO4 可 rescue——確立 Caspase-7 為 SIRT1 調控死亡路徑的共同執行者。

label: Lysosomal biogenesis
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, and its overexpression drives coordinated activation of numerous lysosomal genes encoding membrane proteins, hydrolases, and v-ATPase subunits. This global upregulation increases both the number and functional capacity of lysosomes, expanding degradative reserve. As the central node of the CLEAR network, TFEB integrates diverse stress signals into a unified lysosomal expansion program. Its master-regulator status makes it a prime target for therapies aimed at enhancing cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 是溶酶體生物發生的主轉錄調節者，其過度表現驅動編碼膜蛋白、水解酶和 v-ATPase 次單元的眾多溶酶體基因的協調活化。此全局上調增加了溶酶體的數量和功能能力，擴展了降解儲備。作為 CLEAR 網絡的中樞節點，TFEB 將多樣的壓力信號整合為統一的溶酶體擴張程序。其主調節者地位使它成為旨在增強細胞清除之療法的首要標靶。

label: BRCA
description: Cancer is suppressed by BRCA. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. The directionality runs from BRCA toward Cancer, so BRCA is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 被 BRCA 抑制。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。方向性從 BRCA 朝向 Cancer，因此 BRCA 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: MYC
description: The SIRT7-Myc axis is bidirectional: SIRT7 assembles with Myc at ribosomal protein (RP) gene promoters to silence gene expression and relieve ER stress, while Myc-driven proliferation opposes SIRT7-dependent growth-quiescence programs in some contexts; Table 3 lists Myc among negative regulators of SIRT7 (Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7-Myc 軸線是雙向的：SIRT7 與 Myc 在核糖體蛋白（RP）基因啟動子處組裝以沉默基因表現並緩解內質網壓力，而 Myc 驅動的增殖在某些情境下對抗 SIRT7 依賴的生長靜止程序；表 3 將 Myc 列為 SIRT7 的負向調節因子（Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820）。

label: PINK1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: The mitochondrial phosphatase PGAM5 stabilizes PINK1 on damaged mitochondrial membranes and can attach to LC3, supporting PINK1/Parkin mitophagy. It simultaneously serves the necroptosis machinery by anchoring the necrosome and activating Drp1-driven fission. Which role dominates depends on damage severity: mild stress favors the PGAM5-PINK1 mitophagy arm (cell preservation), while severe RIPK3 activation shifts PGAM5-Drp1 toward necroptotic rupture.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體磷酸酶 PGAM5 會將 PINK1 穩定在受損的粒線體膜上並可結合 LC3，支持 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。同時它也服務於程序性壞死機器：錨定 necrosome 並活化 Drp1 驅動的分裂。何種角色占上風取決於損傷程度：輕度壓力偏向 PGAM5-PINK1 的粒線體自噬臂（細胞保存），而強烈的 RIPK3 活化則使 PGAM5-Drp1 轉向程序性壞死破裂。

label: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
description: Alpha-lipoic acid recycles glutathione by providing the reduced dihydrolipoic acid (DHLA) form, which directly reduces oxidized glutathione and also regenerates vitamins C and E. This restores the cellular thiol redox buffer and amplifies other antioxidants. The directionality is lipoate redox cycling to antioxidant network support. A caveat is that exogenous lipoic acid's in vivo recycling efficiency depends on tissue uptake and the endogenous reductase capacity. By maintaining the GSH pool, lipoic acid indirectly supports glutathione peroxidase, glutaredoxin, and glutathione S-transferase activity throughout the cell.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-lipoic acid 透過提供還原的二氫硫辛酸 (DHLA) 形式來回收 glutathione，直接還原氧化的 glutathione，並再生維生素 C 和 E。這會恢復細胞硫醇氧化還原緩衝液並放大其他 antioxidants。方向性是硫辛酸氧化還原循環至抗氧化網路支援。需要注意的是，外源硫辛酸的體內回收效率取決於組織吸收和內源性還原酶能力。透過維持 GSH 池，硫辛酸間接支持整個細胞內的 glutathione peroxidase、谷氧還蛋白和 glutathione S-轉移酶活性。

label: Reactive Nitrogen Species
description: Reactive nitrogen species are derived from nitric oxide, which combines with superoxide or other radicals to yield peroxynitrite, nitrogen dioxide, and related species. Thus NO is the nitrogenous precursor of the broader RNS family. The directionality is NO to RNS expansion. A caveat is that RNS also include species from myeloperoxidase and other enzymatic pathways, so RNS origin is not exclusively nitric-oxide-derived. Because NO is itself a free radical with signaling functions, RNS can be viewed as both downstream products and, under excess, pathological mediators of nitrative stress.
description_zh_TW: Reactive nitrogen species 衍生自 nitric oxide，它與超氧化物或其他自由基結合產生 peroxynitrite、二氧化氮和相關物質。因此，NO 是更廣泛的 RNS 家族的含氮前驅物。 RNS 擴展的方向性是「否」。需要注意的是，RNS 還包括來自 myeloperoxidase 和其他酶途徑的物種，因此 RNS 起源不僅來自一氧化氮​​。由於NO本身是具有訊號傳導功能的自由基，RNS既可以被視為下游產物，也可以被視為nitrative stress過量時的病理介質。

label: Parkin
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Inflammasome-activated caspase-1 cleaves Parkin, the E3 ligase essential for PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, halting the mitophagy pathway. Caspase-1 simultaneously enhances mitochondrial ROS production, permeabilization, and fragmentation, pushing damage beyond mitophagy's repair capacity. This is the pyroptosis-to-mitophagy inhibitory arm: lytic inflammatory death not only runs ahead of mitochondrial cleanup but actively dismantles it — although ambient ozone exposure studies show ROS can also activate PINK1-Parkin mitophagy upstream of NLRP3 pyroptosis, so the relationship is bidirectional and context-dependent.
description_zh_TW: 發炎體活化的 Caspase-1 會切割 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬所必需的 E3 連接酶 Parkin，使粒線體自噬路徑中止。Caspase-1 同時加劇粒線體 ROS 的產生、通透化與片段化，使損傷超出粒線體自噬的修復能力。這是焦亡至粒線體自噬的抑制臂：發炎性裂解死亡不只跑在粒線體清理之前，還主動拆解它——不過臭氧暴露研究顯示 ROS 也可在 NLRP3 焦亡的上游活化 PINK1-Parkin 粒線體自噬，因此兩者關係是雙向且取決於情境的。

label: Metabolic Reprogramming
description: Cancer undergoes Metabolic Reprogramming. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Metabolic Reprogramming rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer經歷Metabolic Reprogramming。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Metabolic Reprogramming 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: MPTP
description: MPP+ and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically MPP+ and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: MPP+ 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，MPP+ 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Immune Checkpoint
description: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Singlet Oxygen
description: Singlet oxygen (1O2) is an electronically excited, non-radical state of molecular oxygen generated by photosensitization or during leukocyte killing. Although not a free radical, it is classified among reactive oxygen species because of its high energy and reactivity toward unsaturated lipids and nucleobases. The directionality is from energy absorption to direct oxidation without chain initiation. A caveat is that singlet oxygen is quenched very efficiently by carotenoids and alpha-tocopherol, so its range is extremely short.
description_zh_TW: Singlet oxygen (1O2) 是光敏作用或白血球殺傷過程中產生的電子激發的非自由基狀態的分子氧。雖然不是自由基，但由於其高能量以及對不飽和脂質和核鹼基的反應性，它被歸類為 reactive oxygen species。方向性是從能量吸收到沒有鏈引發的直接氧化。需要注意的是，singlet oxygen 可以被類胡蘿蔔素和 α-生育醇非常有效地猝滅，因此它的作用範圍極短。

label: Mitochondrial Complex I
description: SIRT3, as a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase, activates mitochondrial Complex I of the electron-transport chain, improving respiratory efficiency. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of Complex I activation. This boosts oxidative phosphorylation and reduces proximal electron leak, and it is a direct mechanism for SIRT3's bioenergetic benefits. By deacetylating Complex I subunits, SIRT3 enhances electron flux and ATP production while limiting superoxide generation. This regulation is central to SIRT3's support of cellular energy metabolism and its protection against oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 作為粒線體 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶活化電子傳遞鏈的粒線體 Complex I，改善呼吸效率。在方向性上，SIRT3 位於 Complex I 活化的上游。這增強氧化磷酸化並減少近端電子洩漏，是 SIRT3 生物能益處的直接機制。透過去乙醯化 Complex I 亞基，SIRT3 增強電子通量和 ATP 產生，同時限制超氧陰離子生成。此調控對 SIRT3 支持細胞能量代謝和對抗氧化壓力的保護至關重要。

label: EMT
description: Within the tubular epithelium, SIRT3 suppresses epithelial-mesenchymal transformation (EMT) through activation of FOXO3a, which directly induces mitochondrial SOD2 and peroxisomal catalase expression. This coordinated antioxidant enzyme induction mitigates intracellular oxidative stress, preventing ECM component deposition associated with early fibrotic lesions, and SIRT3 also disrupts the NF-kappaB/TGF-beta1/Smad axis that drives fibrogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 在腎小管上皮中，SIRT3 透過活化 FOXO3a 抑制上皮-間質轉化（EMT），FOXO3a 直接誘導粒線體 SOD2 和過氧化物酶體 catalase 的表達。這種協調的抗氧化酵素誘導減輕細胞內氧化壓力，防止與早期纖維化病灶相關的 ECM 成分沉積；SIRT3 還中斷驅動纖維化的 NF-kappaB/TGF-beta1/Smad 軸線。

label: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is widely considered a hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome as it is found to be associated with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and insulin resistance, and sirtuins are downregulated in NAFLD patients, a state characterized by liver steatosis. Raising NAD+ through nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation can restore sirtuin-driven fatty acid oxidation, inhibit lipogenesis, and reduce cholesterol levels, thereby improving liver health and reducing fat accumulation through induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
description_zh_TW: 非酒精性脂肪肝疾病（NAFLD）被廣泛視為代謝症候群的肝臟表現，因為它被發現與第二型糖尿病、肥胖與胰島素抗性相關，且 sirtuins 在 NAFLD 患者中被下調，此狀態以肝臟脂肪變性為特徵。透過 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充提升 NAD+ 能恢復 sirtuin 驅動的脂肪酸氧化、抑制脂肪生成並降低膽固醇水平，從而透過誘發粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應改善肝臟健康並減少脂肪堆積。

label: Proteostasis
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: The mTORC1 pathway controls mRNA translation, and its overactivity increases the rate of protein synthesis at the expense of protein quality. Inhibition of mTORC1 by rapamycin reduces translation, improves its accuracy, and promotes longer life by reducing genetic code reading errors and the accumulation of abnormal proteins, a mechanism confirmed in Drosophila and C. elegans models. Rapamycin also inhibits cap-dependent translation of mRNA, supporting alternative stress-resistant translation that increases production of stress-response and mitochondrial-protection proteins such as HSP70 and TFAM, and by activating ATF4 and producing hydrogen sulfide it increases resistance to oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1途徑控制mRNA翻譯，其過度活化以蛋白質質量為代價增加蛋白質合成速率。Rapamycin對mTORC1的抑制減少翻譯，提高其準確性，並透過減少遺傳密碼讀取錯誤和異常蛋白質的累積來促進更長壽命，這一機制在黑腹果蠅和秀丽隱桿線蟲模型中得到證實。Rapamycin還抑制mRNA的帽依賴性翻譯，支持替代性抗壓力翻譯，增加壓力反應和粒線體保護蛋白如HSP70和TFAM的產生，並透過活化ATF4和產生硫化氫來增加對氧化壓力的抵抗力。

label: p21 CIP1
source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md
description: DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 binds and inhibits cyclin-CDK complexes, notably CDK2, enforcing a G1/S arrest. This p53-to-p21 axis is a primary, rapid enforcement mechanism of senescence and quiescence, and the induction is dose-dependent and reversible in the short term but locks the arrest when sustained. It exemplifies tumor-suppressive cell-cycle control and is a core target of the DNA damage response. p21 also supports an early secretory phenotype during stress.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷穩定 p53，p53 轉錄誘發 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 結合並抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體，特別是 CDK2，強制 G1/S 停滯。此 p53-to-p21 軸是衰老與靜止的主要、快速執行機制，且此誘發在短期內依劑量且可逆，但在持續時鎖定停滯。它例示腫瘤抑制性細胞週期控制，是 DNA 損傷反應的核心標靶。p21 也在壓力期間支持早期分泌表型。

label: Ischemic stroke
description: AGK2 confers neuroprotection under ischemic and hypoxic conditions by suppressing phospho-JNK and FOXO3a and preventing caspase-3 cleavage. Directionally, AGK2/SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of reduced neuronal death. This broadens AGK2's neuroprotective utility beyond proteinopathy, and it reinforces the inverse therapeutic logic for SIRT2. By blunting JNK and FOXO3a death signaling and preventing effector-caspase activation, AGK2 protects neurons in ischemic stroke models. These findings support SIRT2 inhibition as a candidate strategy across diverse forms of acute and chronic neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 在缺血和缺氧條件下賦予神經保護，透過抑制磷酸化 JNK 和 FOXO3a 並防止 caspase-3 切割。在方向性上，AGK2/SIRT2 抑制位於減少神經元死亡的上游。這擴展了 AGK2 超越蛋白質病變的神經保護效用，並強化了 SIRT2 的反向治療邏輯。透過削弱 JNK 和 FOXO3a 死亡訊號並防止效應型 caspase 活化，AGK2 在缺血性中風模型中保護神經元。這些發現支持 SIRT2 抑制作為跨多種急性和慢性神經退行性疾病的候選策略。

label: Asthma
description: Upregulated SIRT6 ameliorates airway remodeling in asthma through regulation of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, representing a protective role against structural airway changes. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of suppressed EMT and preserved airway architecture. By restraining the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition that contributes to airway remodeling, SIRT6 helps maintain the normal structure of the airways during chronic inflammation. This protective function contrasts with the profibrotic role of SIRT7 in asthma and suggests that the balance of sirtuin activities shapes disease outcome.
description_zh_TW: 上調的SIRT6透過調節上皮-間質轉化改善氣喘中的氣道重塑，代表了對結構性氣道變化的保護作用。方向上，SIRT6位於EMT抑制和氣道結構維持的上游。透過抑制促成氣道重塑的上皮-間質轉化，SIRT6在慢性發炎期間幫助維持氣道的正常結構。此保護功能與SIRT7在氣喘中的促纖維化作用形成對比，並表明sirtuin活性的平衡塑造疾病結局。

label: Neurodegenerative Diseases
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions, including osteoarthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, according to senior author Pam Maher. The harmful factors senescent cells release (the SASP) promote tissue dysfunction and disease development in surrounding tissue. Because senescence and ferroptosis are both independently linked to age-related dysfunction, the discovery that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis offers a two-birds-with-one-stone strategy: eliminating senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy. Clearing senescent cells is considered a promising therapeutic approach for a multitude of age-related diseases and disorders.
description_zh_TW: 根據資深作者Pam Maher，衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括骨關節炎、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病。衰老細胞釋放的有害因子（SASP）會促進周圍組織的功能障礙與疾病發展。由於衰老與鐵依賴性細胞死亡均獨立地與年齡相關功能障礙有關，酸性神經醯胺酶升高使衰老細胞更易發生鐵依賴性細胞死亡的發現，提供了一石二鳥的策略：在清除衰老細胞的同時，保持鄰近細胞健康。清除衰老細胞被認為是治療多種年齡相關疾病與障礙的具前景療法。

label: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation
description: Failing lysosomes cannot clear α-synuclein oligomers, so aggregates accumulate into Lewy bodies — the hallmark of Parkinson's disease dopaminergic neurons. Lysosomal failure co-acts with Complex I defects, and dying neurons then release neuromelanin and aggregates as DAMPs that prime microglia. Because the lysosome is the terminal station of autophagy and mitophagy, its dysfunction converts otherwise-manageable protein load into lethal aggregation, and lipofuscin accumulation further buffers lysosomal pH upward.
description_zh_TW: 失能的溶酶體無法清除 α-synuclein 寡聚體，使聚集物累積成路易氏體——帕金森氏症多巴胺神經元的標誌。溶酶體失能與 Complex I 缺陷協同作用，垂死神經元隨後釋出神經黑色素與聚集物作為 DAMP 致敏小膠細胞。由於溶酶體是自噬與粒線體自噬的終點站，其失能會使原本可處理的蛋白負荷轉為致命聚集，而脂褐素的累積更進一步推高溶酶體的 pH。

label: Ghrelin
description: The metabolic hormone ghrelin, a major regulator of food intake, also exerts immunomodulatory and thymopoietic effects. Ghrelin binds immune cell subsets via ghrelin-specific receptors and localizes to lipid rafts of activated T cells. Dixit et al. reported that ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice, and in aged thymus both ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease in correlation with functional thymic involution and elevated inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 代謝激素ghrelin（飢餓素）是食物攝取的主要調節者，也具有免疫調節與胸腺生成（thymopoietic）效應。Ghrelin透過ghrelin特異性受體與免疫細胞亞群結合，並定位於活化T細胞的脂筏。Dixit等人報告ghrelin可減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應，而在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平均下降，與功能性胸腺退化及發炎升高相關。

label: SAHF
description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF) are DAPI-dense, punctate bodies of facultative heterochromatin assembled in senescent human cells to stably silence proliferation-promoting genes. They are deposited by the HIRA/ASF1a histone chaperone complex and macroH2A, marked by H3K9me3, and seeded through hypophosphorylated Rb recruitment of HDACs to E2F target loci. SAHF reinforce the arrested state by locking E2F-responsive S-phase genes into repressive chromatin. They are most prominent in oncogene-induced and replicative senescence of human fibroblasts and are a structural hallmark rather than a universal feature across all cell types.
description_zh_TW: 衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）是 DAPI 緻密、點狀的兼性異染色質小體，在衰老的人類細胞中組裝以穩定地靜默促增殖基因。它們由 HIRA/ASF1a 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體與 macroH2A 沉積，標記 H3K9me3，並透過低磷酸化 Rb 招募 HDAC 至 E2F 標的基因座而播種。SAHF 透過將 E2F 反應性的 S 期基因鎖入抑制性染色質來強化停滯狀態。它們在致癌基因誘發與複製性衰老的人類纖維母細胞中最為顯著，是一種結構性標記而非所有細胞類型普遍具備的特徵。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: GCN5
description: SIRT6 deacetylates the acetyltransferase GCN5, one of its direct non-histone substrates, altering the chromatin acetylation balance at metabolic and growth promoters and complementing SIRT6's histone deacetylation at H3K9/H3K56. In hepatocytes, SIRT6 also engages GCN5 to acetylate and inhibit PGC-1alpha and thereby restrain gluconeogenesis, so the same enzyme-substrate pair can be tuned in different directions depending on cellular context.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6去乙醯化乙醯轉移酶GCN5，這是其直接的非組蛋白底物之一，改變了代謝和生長啟動子上的染色質乙醯化平衡，並補充了SIRT6在H3K9/H3K56上的組蛋白去乙醯化。在肝細胞中，SIRT6也與GCN5相互作用以乙醯化並抑制PGC-1alpha，從而抑制糖質新生，因此相同的酶-底物對可以根據細胞環境以不同方向調節。

label: Mitochondrial DNA
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs) are small peptides encoded within the mitochondrial genome in addition to the canonical 13 protein-coding mitochondrial genes. In theory, mtDNA could contain hundreds of short open reading frames that encode putative microproteins, and the mitochondrial transcriptome includes many discrete smaller mRNAs that do not map to traditional protein-encoding genes, particularly from the 16S rRNA region including the site of the humanin ORF. There is compelling evidence of biologically active peptides of 11-32 amino acids encoded by small open reading frames from polycistronic mRNA, supporting the concept of genes-within-genes in the compact mitochondrial genome.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體衍生肽（MDPs）是除了 13 個典型的粒線體蛋白編碼基因外，在粒線體基因體內編碼的小肽段。理論上，mtDNA 可能包含數百個編碼推定微蛋白的短開放閱讀框，且粒線體轉錄體包含許多離散的較小 mRNA，這些 mRNA 不映射到傳統的蛋白編碼基因，特別是來自 16S rRNA 區域，包括 humanin ORF 的位點。有令人信服的證據表明，多順反子 mRNA 中的小開放閱讀框編碼了具有生物活性的 11-32 個胺基酸的肽段，支持了緊湊粒線體基因體中基因內基因的概念。

label: Sarcopenia
description: In the Women's Health and Aging Study I, serum carboxymethyl-lysine (CML), the soluble receptor for advanced glycation end products (sRAGE), endogenous secretory RAGE (esRAGE), and grip strength were measured in 559 moderately to severely disabled women aged 65 and older. Women with higher concentrations of CML had less grip strength than women with lower CML concentrations, leading the authors to conclude that women with higher AGEs have more muscle weakness. These findings support a role for AGE accumulation in age-related muscle weakness and sarcopenia, although the studies are not conclusive of a causal relationship.
description_zh_TW: 在女性健康與老化研究 I（Women's Health and Aging Study I）中，於 559 名 65 歲及以上、中度至重度失能的女性中測量了血清羧甲基賴氨酸（CML）、晚期糖化終產物之可溶性受體（sRAGE）、內源性分泌型 RAGE（esRAGE）與握力。CML 濃度較高的女性比 CML 濃度較低的女性握力較差，使作者得出結論：AGE 較高的女性有較多的肌肉無力。這些發現支持 AGE 堆積在年齡相關肌肉無力與肌少症中的角色，儘管這些研究尚無法確立因果關係。

label: SAMD
description: SAMD (senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction) is a specific form of mitochondrial dysfunction that is a hallmark of senescent cells, encompassing reduced oxidative phosphorylation, altered mitochondrial dynamics, and elevated ROS production. It is distinct from generalized mitochondrial disease in being a programmed, senescence-associated feature that both results from and feeds back into the arrested state. SAMD drives the SASP through ROS and mtDNA release, coupling metabolic derangement to inflammation. Its classification as mitochondrial dysfunction situates it within the metabolic hallmarks of aging.
description_zh_TW: SAMD（senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction，衰老相關粒線體功能障礙）是粒線體功能障礙的一種特定形式，是衰老細胞的特徵，涵蓋氧化磷酸化降低、粒線體動態改變與 ROS 產生升高。它不同於一般性粒線體疾病之處，在於其為一種程序性、衰老相關的特徵，既由停滯狀態產生又回饋至停滯狀態。SAMD 透過 ROS 與 mtDNA 釋放驅動 SASP，將代謝失調耦合到發炎。其歸類為粒線體功能障礙，使其定位於老化的代謝特徵之中。

label: FGF21
description: SIRT1 deacetylates PPARgamma, and this deacetylation promotes expression of FGF21 among a broader set of thermogenic and browning genes. Induction of FGF21, in turn, supports adipose tissue browning and increases energy expenditure, consistent with SIRT1's anti-obesity actions. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of PPARgamma deacetylation and FGF21 induction. FGF21 acts systemically to enhance glucose uptake, lipid oxidation, and adaptive thermogenesis, extending the effects of SIRT1 beyond the adipocyte itself.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1去乙醯化PPARgamma，此去乙醯化促進FGF21在一組更廣泛的生熱和褐化基因中的表達。FGF21的誘導反過來支持脂肪組織褐化並增加能量消耗，與SIRT1的抗肥胖作用一致。方向上，SIRT1位於PPARgamma去乙醯化和FGF21誘導的上游。FGF21在全身作用以增強葡萄糖攝取、脂質氧化和適應性生熱，將SIRT1的效果延伸到脂肪細胞本身之外。

label: Lysosome biogenesis
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB activates lysosome biogenesis by binding CLEAR elements in the promoters of genes encoding lysosomal membrane proteins, hydrolases, and v-ATPase subunits, coordinately increasing lysosomal number and capacity. This transcriptional program ensures that autophagic demand is matched by degradative capacity, preventing futile autophagosome accumulation. TFEB activation therefore expands the entire lysosomal network rather than individual enzymes. The effect is a cornerstone of cellular adaptation to starvation and stress.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過結合編碼溶酶體膜蛋白、水解酶和 v-ATPase 次單元的基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件，活化溶酶體生物發生，協調性地增加溶酶體的數量與能力。此轉錄程序確保自噬需求由降解能力所匹配，防止徒勞的自噬體累積。因此 TFEB 活化擴展了整個溶酶體網絡而非個別酵素。此效應是細胞適應飢餓與壓力的基石。

label: ROS
description: SIRT3 inhibits ROS (e.g., p53, ROS, lipogenesis) by deacetylating upstream regulators, protecting against damage and tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化上游調節因子抑制 ROS（例如 p53、ROS、脂肪生成），保護免受損傷和腫瘤發生。

label: PGC-1α
description: SIRT6 inhibits PGC-1α (e.g., by deacetylation), modulating gluconeogenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 抑制 PGC-1α（例如透過去乙醯化），調節糖質新生。

label: Oct4
description: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors used to reprogram somatic cells to induced pluripotency, and they include Oct4. Oct4 is the master regulator of pluripotency, expressed in pluripotent cells during embryogenesis and in embryonic stem cells, and it is essential for establishing and maintaining the pluripotent state. Because Oct4 is required to initiate the reprogramming process, its inclusion among the Yamanaka factors is central to iPSC generation. Without Oct4, the reprogramming cascade cannot initiate, underscoring its irreplaceable role.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子是用於將體細胞重編程為誘導多能性的四種轉錄因子，其中包括 Oct4。 Oct4 是多能性的主要調節因子，在胚胎髮生過程中的多能細胞和胚胎幹細胞中表達，對於建立和維持多能狀態至關重要。由於需要 Oct4 來啟動重編程過程，因此將其納入 Yamanaka 因子對於 iPSC 生成至關重要。如果沒有Oct4，重編程級聯就無法啟動，這凸顯了其不可取代的作用。

label: Glioblastoma
description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most malignant primary brain tumor in adults (grade IV astrocytoma).
description_zh_TW: 膠質母細胞瘤 (GBM) 是成人中最惡性的原發性腦腫瘤（IV級星形細胞瘤）。

label: Senomorphic
description: Apigenin is a dietary flavone flavonoid identified by screening a 66-compound natural product library against bleomycin-senescent PSC27 human prostate stromal cells. It functions as a senomorphic agent: it suppresses the pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) without killing senescent cells or forcing them back into the cell cycle, in contrast to senolytics such as ABT-263 or procyanidin C1, which preferentially lyse senescent cells. Because it leaves the growth arrest intact, apigenin is classified specifically as a natural senomorphic rather than a senolytic, aligning with the ideal profile for SASP-restraining geroprotective therapy.
description_zh_TW: 芹菜素是一種膳食黃酮類化合物（flavone flavonoid），透過以博萊黴素（bleomycin）誘導衰老的人類前列腺基質細胞PSC27篩選含66種化合物的天然產物庫而鑑定出來。它的功能是衰老形態調節劑（senomorphic agent）：在不殺死衰老細胞、也不強迫其重返細胞週期的情況下，抑制促發炎的衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）；這與優先溶解衰老細胞的衰老細胞清除劑（如ABT-263或原花青素C1）形成對比。由於芹菜素保留了生長停滯狀態，它被明確歸類為天然衰老形態調節劑而非衰老細胞清除劑，符合以抑制SASP為目標的老年保護療法之理想特性。

label: Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
description: SIRT1 protects against myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury: knockout increases infarct size while overexpression upregulates FoxO1 and MnSOD and downregulates caspase-3 and Bax. Signaling upstream of SIRT1 includes miR-132 inhibition leading to PGC-1alpha/Nrf2, and lncRNA Oip5-as1 acting through the SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1alpha axis. SIRT1 is thus an endogenous cardioprotective factor against reperfusion damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在心肌缺血—再灌流損傷中受保護：基因敲除增加梗塞面積，而過度表現上調 FoxO1 與 MnSOD 並下調 caspase-3 與 Bax。SIRT1 上游的訊號包括 miR-132 抑制導致 PGC-1alpha/Nrf2，以及 lncRNA Oip5-as1 經由 SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1alpha 軸作用。SIRT1 因此是對抗再灌流損傷的內源性心臟保護因子。

label: GlyNAC
description: Reducing systems maintain adrenochrome in its reduced (leuco) form, which is less redox-active; DT-diaphorase 2-electron reduction of adrenochrome to leukoaminochrome is proposed as a protective, detoxifying mechanism (PMID 2113029), and aminochromes deplete cellular glutathione through sulfhydryl interactions (PMID 2665188). GlyNAC-driven glutathione elevation therefore buffers the adrenochrome/leuco-adrenochrome equilibrium toward the reduced, less toxic form. The quantitative 2-fold-GSH shift in the Mitohormetic Redox-Relay model remains theoretical.
description_zh_TW: 還原系統將腎上腺素紅維持於其還原態（白形式），後者氧化還原活性較低；DT-diaphorase 將腎上腺素紅二電子還原為白胺基色體被視為一種保護性解毒機制（PMID 2113029），而胺基色體會透過與硫醇基交互作用耗竭細胞穀胱甘肽（PMID 2665188）。因此 GlyNAC 提升的穀胱甘肽將腎上腺素紅／白腎上腺素紅平衡推向還原、低毒的形式。粒線體激素性氧化還原繼電器模型中「2 倍 GSH 偏移」的具體數值仍屬理論推測。

label: Genistein
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Genistein is an isoflavone flavonoid reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Together with other flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercitrin, and quercetin, genistein inhibits the glycation process in vitro. The anti-glycation activities of these polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than aminoguanidine, and they act in part through trapping reactive carbonyl species and antioxidant capacity. Herbal products and dietary plants containing these flavonoids are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for preventing glycation and AGE accumulation during aging.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 是一種異黃酮類黃酮，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他黃酮類如 kaempferol、quercitrin 與 quercetin 一起，Genistein 在體外抑制糖化過程。這些多酚的抗糖化活性與 aminoguanidine 相似甚至更強，且部分透過捕捉活性羰基物種與抗氧化能力來作用。因此，含有這些黃酮類的草藥產品與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 堆積的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

label: ATP
