description: Methylene blue maintains ATP production by acting as a redox cycling agent in mitochondria, donating and accepting electrons to keep the mitochondrial electron transport chain running efficiently. It can bypass dysfunctional Complex I and Complex III, rerouting electron flow to sustain ATP synthesis when normal pathways are impaired - essentially a backup generator for cellular energy production. The dose range that shows this effect in cellular and animal studies is consistently in the sub-1 mg/kg range (1-4 mg per dose for most adults). These mitochondrial effects are the mechanistic basis for proposed cognitive and energy benefits, though most supporting evidence comes from cell cultures and rodents rather than human trials.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過在粒線體內作為氧化還原循環劑發揮作用來維持ATP產生，捐贈和接受電子以使粒線體電子傳遞鏈有效運行。它可以繞過功能障礙的複合物I和III，在正常路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP合成——本質上是細胞能量產生的備用發電機。在細胞和動物研究中顯示這種效果的劑量範圍始終在低於1 mg/kg的範圍內（大多數成人每次1-4毫克）。這些粒線體效應是提出的認知和能量益處的機制基礎，儘管大多數支持證據來自細胞培養和囓齒類動物而不是人體試驗。

label: Antioxidants
description: SIRT3, a mitochondrial sirtuin whose activity depends on NAD+, weakens antioxidant defenses and mitochondrial detoxification when NAD+ is depleted during aging. Reduced SIRT3 activity compromises the deacetylation of mitochondrial antioxidant and metabolic enzymes, leaving cells vulnerable to ROS-driven mitochondrial damage. Together with SIRT1, SIRT3 regulates PGC-1α, FOXO and NRF1 transcriptional programs that coordinate mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant responses. Because NAD+ decline lowers SIRT3 function, NAD+ repletion is a strategy to restore sirtuin-dependent mitochondrial resilience, delay stem cell senescence, and dampen the ROS-NF-κB-inflammaging axis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3是一種線粒體sirtuin，其活性依賴於NAD+，在老化過程中NAD+耗盡時削弱抗氧化防禦和線粒體解毒。SIRT3活性降低損害線粒體抗氧化和代謝酶的去乙酰化，使細胞容易受到ROS驅動的線粒體損傷。與SIRT1一起，SIRT3調節PGC-1α、FOXO和NRF1轉錄程序，這些程序協調線粒體生物發生和抗氧化反應。由於NAD+下降降低SIRT3功能，NAD+補充是恢復sirtuin依賴性線粒體恢復力、延遲幹細胞衰老和抑制ROS-NF-κB-inflammaging軸的策略。

label: Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces fat accumulation in the liver through a mechanism that involves induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt), which is elicited by NAD+ repletion and reverses fatty liver disease in mice. Through this pathway, as well as through activation of SIRT1 and factors associated with cholesterol homeostasis, NR can reduce cholesterol levels and improve liver health. In regenerating liver, NR reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to faster recovery of liver weight.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）透過涉及誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的機制減少肝臟中的脂肪堆積，此反應由 NAD+ 補充所引發，並在小鼠中逆轉脂肪肝疾病。透過此路徑，以及透過活化 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定相關的因子，NR 能降低膽固醇水平並改善肝臟健康。在再生肝臟中，NR 減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，導致肝臟重量更快恢復。

label: COPD
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: SIRT1 protein levels are substantially decreased in the lungs of patients with COPD and emphysema, as well as in the lungs of rodents exposed to cigarette smoke. SIRT1 has anti-inflammatory, anti-apoptotic, and antioxidant roles in COPD pathogenesis. Directionally, COPD and smoke exposure sit upstream of reduced SIRT1. Because SIRT1 normally dampens inflammation and oxidative stress, its depletion contributes to the progressive tissue damage and airspace destruction seen in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1蛋白水平在COPD和肺氣腫患者的肺部以及暴露於香菸煙霧的囓齒動物肺部顯著降低。SIRT1在COPD發病機制中具有抗發炎、抗凋亡和抗氧化作用。方向上，COPD和煙霧暴露位於SIRT1降低的上游。因為SIRT1通常抑制發炎和氧化壓力，其耗竭導致慢性阻塞性肺疾病中可見的進行性組織損傷和氣腔破壞。

label: c-Myc
description: SIRT6 inhibits the transcriptional activities of c-MYC, resulting in repression of the glycolytic metabolic reprogramming that supports tumor growth. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of c-MYC inhibition and tumor suppression. This complements SIRT6's repression of HIF-1alpha, giving SIRT6 a dual brake on the two major oncogenic drivers of glycolysis. By restricting the metabolic switch to aerobic glycolysis, SIRT6 limits the biosynthetic and energetic advantages that cancer cells depend on. This positions SIRT6 as a central regulator of the metabolic reprogramming that underlies many cancers and as a rational target for therapeutic activation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6抑制c-MYC的轉錄活性，導致支持腫瘤生長的糖解代謝重編程被抑制。方向上，SIRT6位於c-MYC抑制和腫瘤抑制的上游。這補充了SIRT6對HIF-1alpha的抑制，賦予SIRT6對兩個主要糖解致癌驅動因子的雙重制動。透過限制向有氧糖解的代謝轉換，SIRT6限制了癌細胞依賴的生物合成和能量優勢。這將SIRT6定位為支撐許多癌症的代謝重編程的核心調節因子，以及治療活化的合理靶點。

label: Breast Cancer
description: SIRT7 expression is significantly elevated in breast carcinoma compared with normal breast tissue, and high SIRT7 correlates with poorer prognosis in several tumor types. Its overexpression supports tumor growth and ribosomal biogenesis, and it can deacetylate oncogenic transcription factors such as GATA4. The directionality is that increased SIRT7 abundance is associated with and likely promotes malignant phenotypes. A caveat is that sirtuin roles in cancer are context-dependent, and SIRT7 can be either tumor-promoting or, in some tissues, tumor-suppressive.
description_zh_TW: 與正常乳腺組織相比，SIRT7 在乳腺癌中顯著高表達，且高 SIRT7 與多種腫瘤類型的較差預後相關。其過量表達支持腫瘤生長和核糖體生物合成，並可去乙醯化致癌轉錄因子如 GATA4。其方向性為 SIRT7 表達量增加與惡性表型相關並可能促進之。需要注意的是，sirtuin 在癌症中的角色取決於情境，SIRT7 可能促進或在某些組織中抑制腫瘤。

label: NRH
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, is bioavailable in mice and increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and in mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR, and it is detectable in circulation after oral intake or intraperitoneal injection. A NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase has been demonstrated, consistent with the recent discovery of a novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH through the NMNH intermediate, where adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase. The presence of endogenous NRH in the liver of mouse models was confirmed, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
description_zh_TW: NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）在小鼠中具有生物可用率，並以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+，且在口服攝取或腹腔注射後可在循環中偵測到。NRH 誘發的 NAD+ 增加之 NMRK 非依賴性路徑已被證實，這與近期發現的從 NRH 經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑一致，其中 adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）作為 NRH 激酶。小鼠模型肝臟中內源性 NRH 的存在已獲確認，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

label: Enzalutamide
description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: Senomorphic Therapy
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is suppressed by Senomorphic Therapy. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senomorphics suppress the SASP without killing senescent cells, dampening chronic inflammation and paracrine tumor promotion. The directionality runs from Senomorphic Therapy toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senomorphic Therapy is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 被 Senomorphic Therapy 抑制。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它可以抑制衰老細胞而不殺死衰老細胞，從而抑制慢性發炎和旁分泌腫瘤的發生。方向性從 Senomorphic Therapy 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senomorphic Therapy 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: methylation cycle
description: MTHFD1 (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase/cyclohydrolase/formyltetrahydrofolate synthetase) is part of the folate-mediated one-carbon metabolism network that supplies methyl groups and formyl units for the methylation cycle and nucleotide synthesis. By generating 10-formyl-THF and interconverting folate derivatives, it supports the production of 5-methyl-THF that feeds methionine synthase and ultimately SAMe, the methyl donor for COMT. Its activity therefore links folate status and one-carbon flux to COMT substrate availability. Mutations in MTHFD1 can impair methylation efficiency similarly to MTHFR variants.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1（亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫酶/環化水解酶/甲醯四氫葉酸合成酶）是 folate 介導的一碳代謝網絡的一部分，為 methylation cycle 和核苷酸合成提供 methyl groups 和甲醯基單位。透過生成 10-甲酰基-THF 和互變 folate 衍生物，它支持 5-甲基-THF 的生產，為蛋氨酸合成酶提供原料，並最終為 SAMe（COMT 的 methyl donor）提供原料。因此，其活性將 folate 狀態和一碳通量與 COMT 底物可用性連結起來。與 MTHFR variants 類似，MTHFD1 的突變也會損害 methylation efficiency。

label: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor
description: Kynurenine and its derivatives activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), promoting regulatory T cell (Treg) differentiation and suppressing effector T/NK cells. This metabolite-driven AhR signaling is the second major mechanism of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression alongside local tryptophan depletion, and together they create an immunosuppressive microenvironment in tissues such as tumors, placenta and inflamed sites. The context-dependent nature of this pathway is notable: it is protective via tolerance induction in autoimmunity but potentially detrimental when overactive in metabolic inflammation, where elevated KP activity links to insulin resistance and chronic low-grade inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸及其衍生物活化芳香烴受體（AhR），促進調節性 T 細胞（Treg）分化並抑制效應 T/NK 細胞。此代謝物驅動的 AhR 訊息傳導是 IDO1 媒介免疫抑制的第二個主要機制，與局部色胺酸耗竭並行，兩者共同在腫瘤、胎盤與發炎部位等組織中創造免疫抑制微環境。此路徑的情境依賴性值得注意：它在自體免疫中經由耐受誘導具有保護作用，但在代謝性發炎中過度活化則可能有害，此時升高的 KP 活性與胰島素抗性及慢性低度發炎相關。

label: Non-homologous End Joining
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 facilitates DNA double-strand break repair by enhancing the recruitment of 53BP1, thereby promoting the efficiency of non-homologous end joining (NHEJ). It also promotes H3K56 deacetylation to enhance NHEJ fidelity, and interacts with critical DNA repair proteins such as PARP1, Ku70/80, XRCC1, and DNA ligase 4 to repair mitochondrial and genomic DNA damage. This nuclear DNA-repair program complements SIRT3's mitochondrial antioxidant function in maintaining genomic stability and preventing cellular senescence (Fig. 1B).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過增強 53BP1 的招募促進 DNA 雙股斷裂修復，從而促進非同源末端接合（NHEJ）的效率。它還促進 H3K56 去乙醯化以提高 NHEJ 精準度，並與關鍵 DNA 修復蛋白如 PARP1、Ku70/80、XRCC1 和 DNA ligase 4 互動以修復粒線體和基因組 DNA 損傷。此核 DNA 修復程序與 SIRT3 的粒線體抗氧化功能互補，共同維護基因組穩定性和防止細胞衰老（圖 1B）。

label: NMRK2
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NMRK2 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 2) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) using only a single molecule of ATP, whereas synthesis of NMN from nicotinamide by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents. This makes the NMRK2 pathway an energy-sparing mechanism that may be favored in the failing heart, where the shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis represents a common adaptive response. NR is expressed and active mainly in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which may explain the better ability of these tissues to respond to NR. NR supplementation is therefore regarded as a powerful approach to preserve cardiac function in heart failure.
description_zh_TW: NMRK2（nicotinamide ribose kinase 2，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 2）僅需單一分子的 ATP 即可將 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）轉化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸），而 NAMPT 由菸鹼醯胺合成 NMN 則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。這使得 NMRK2 路徑成為一種節能機制，可能在衰竭的心臟中受到偏好，因為在該處由 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 進行 NAD+ 合成代表一種常見的適應性反應。NR 主要在心肌與骨骼肌中表現並具活性，這或許解釋了這些組織對 NR 較佳的反應能力。因此，NR 補充被視為維持心衰竭中心臟功能的有力方法。

label: OMA1
description: The proteolytic processing of OPA1 is mediated by several mitochondrial proteases, including the metalloendopeptidase OMA1, the ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease YME1L1, the rhomboid protease PARL, paraplegin and the mAAA protease complex. Under stress conditions such as mitochondrial depolarization, the S1 site of OPA1 is cleaved by YME1L1 or OMA1 to produce the short form S-OPA1, which lacks a membrane anchor but can modulate fusion by complexing with membrane-bound L-OPA1. DRP1-mediated zinc influx into the matrix causes membrane depolarization, resulting in OMA1 activation and OPA1 inactivation to enable clearance of damaged mitochondrial fragments by mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: OPA1的蛋白水解加工由幾種粒線體蛋白酶介導，包括金屬內肽酶OMA1、ATP依賴性鋅金屬蛋白酶YME1L1、菱形蛋白酶PARL、paraplegin和mAAA蛋白酶複合物。在粒線體去極化等壓力條件下，OPA1的S1位點被YME1L1或OMA1裂解以產生短形式S-OPA1，該形式缺乏膜錨定但可通過與膜結合的L-OPA1形成複合物來調節融合。DRP1介導的鋅流入基質導致膜去極化，引起OMA1激活和OPA1失活，從而通過線粒體自噬清除受損的粒線體片段。

label: METTL3
description: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

label: Rutin
description: Rutin is a glycoside of quercetin, formed by rutinose, a disaccharide, attached to the quercetin aglycone, which modifies its solubility, absorption, and bioavailability in the gut. After deglycosylation, the quercetin backbone, a catechol flavonoid, is metabolized partly by COMT, linking rutin intake to COMT-dependent disposition. This structural relationship explains rutin's COMT-interacting potential once converted to quercetin. Found in buckwheat, apples, and citrus, it is a common dietary flavonoid glycoside.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 是 glycoside of quercetin，由芸香糖（一种二糖）形成，附着在槲皮素苷元上，改变其在肠道中的溶解度、吸收和生物利用度。去糖基化后，槲皮素骨架（catechol flavonoid）部分被 COMT 代谢，将芦丁摄入与 COMT 依赖性处置联系起来。這種結構關係解釋了蘆丁在轉化為槲皮素後具有 COMT 相互作用潛力。它存在於蕎麥、蘋果和柑橘中，是一種常見的膳食黃酮苷。

label: Dietary AGEs
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。

label: Fucoidan
description: Fucoidan, notably Fucoidan-FV, activates SIRT6 by increasing its protein abundance and preferentially stimulating its mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity rather than its deacetylase activity. This selectively recruits KAP1 and HP1alpha to silence LINE-1 retrotransposons, yielding antifibrotic and genome-stabilizing effects, and demonstrates that SIRT6's functions can be pharmacologically separated. Fucoidan extends healthspan and lifespan in aged mice, making it a natural SIRT6-targeted intervention of considerable geroscience interest.
description_zh_TW: Fucoidan（褐藻醣膠），特別是 Fucoidan-FV，透過增加 SIRT6 蛋白豐度並優先刺激其單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性（而非去乙醯酶活性）來活化 SIRT6。這選擇性地招募 KAP1 和 HP1alpha 沉默 LINE-1 逆轉座子，產生抗纖維化和基因組穩定化效應，並表明 SIRT6 的功能可以被藥理學分離。Fucoidan 延長老年小鼠的健康壽命和壽命，使其成為具有重要老年科學意義的天然 SIRT6 靶向干預措施。

label: Hippocampus
description: The hippocampus is critically involved in memory consolidation, the process by which newly acquired information is stabilized into long-term storage via hippocampal-neocortical dialogue and synaptic plasticity. COMT expressed in the hippocampus modulates the catecholamine tone that supports this plasticity, linking the enzyme to memory processes beyond the prefrontal cortex. Hippocampal integrity is therefore sensitive to COMT-dependent dopaminergic and noradrenergic signaling, and its dysfunction is central to amnesia and age-related cognitive decline. The region's plasticity mechanisms are fundamental to learning.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體在 memory consolidation 中發揮至關重要的作用，memory consolidation 是新獲得的資訊透過海馬體新皮質對話和 synaptic plasticity 穩定並長期儲存的過程。海馬體中表達的 COMT 調節支持這種可塑性的兒茶酚胺基調，將該酶與前額葉皮質以外的記憶過程聯繫起來。因此，海馬完整性對 COMT 依賴性多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能訊號傳導敏感，其功能障礙是健忘症和年齡相關認知能力下降的核心。該區域的可塑性機制是學習的基礎。

label: Cutaneous Melanoma
description: Cutaneous Melanoma and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Cutaneous Melanoma and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Cutaneous Melanoma 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Cutaneous Melanoma 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Cerebellum
description: The cerebellum controls motor coordination, precision, timing, and motor learning through its integration of sensory and motor inputs, processed by Purkinje cell outputs to deep nuclei and downstream motor pathways. It fine-tunes ballistic and skilled movements rather than initiating them, and its integrity is essential for smooth, coordinated locomotion. Its role provides a useful anatomical contrast to forebrain structures in COMT-OE studies, where the CaMKIIalpha promoter leaves cerebellar function intact. This preserved function serves as a negative control for forebrain manipulations.
description_zh_TW: 小腦透過感覺和運動輸入的整合來控制 motor coordination 的精確度、計時和運動學習，這些輸入由浦肯野細胞輸出處理到深層核和下游運動路徑。它對彈道和熟練的運動進行微調，而不是啟動它們，其完整性對於平穩、協調的運動至關重要。它的作用為 COMT-OE 研究中的前腦結構提供了有用的解剖學對比，其中 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子使小腦功能保持完整。這種保留的功能可作為前腦操作的陰性對照。

label: L-DOPA
description: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Ionizing Radiation
description: Ionizing radiation produces hydroxyl radicals through radiolysis of water, generating OH*, hydrated electrons, and hydrogen atoms within picoseconds of energy deposition. These radicals initiate the bulk of radiation-induced biomolecular damage. The directionality is photon/particle energy to water radiolysis to radicals. A caveat is that direct ionization of DNA also occurs, so radicals are the major but not sole mechanism of radiation injury. Because water constitutes most of cellular mass, radiolysis-generated hydroxyl radicals account for roughly two-thirds of radiation-induced DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 透過水的輻射分解產生 hydroxyl radicals，在能量沉積的皮秒內產生 OH*、水合電子和氫原子。這些自由基引發了大部分輻射引起的生物分子損傷。方向性是光子/粒子能量到水輻射分解到自由基。需要注意的是，DNA 的直接電離也會發生，因此自由基是輻射損傷的主要但不是唯一機制。由於水構成了細胞質量的大部分，輻射分解產生的 hydroxyl radicals 約佔輻射引起的 DNA damage 的三分之二。

label: Cigarette Smoke
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Exposure to cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 complex, diminishing deacetylation of RelA and leaving NF-κB in a more active, pro-inflammatory state. The consequence is heightened expression of inflammatory mediators in airway and other cells exposed to smoke. The directionality is that the environmental insult (smoke) reduces a protective protein–protein interaction, increasing inflammation. This provides a mechanistic link between smoking, impaired sirtuin function, and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
description_zh_TW: 暴露於香菸煙霧提取物會破壞 SIRT1–RelA/p65 複合體，削弱 RelA 的去乙醯化，使 NF-κB 處於更活躍的促發炎狀態。後果是在氣道和其他暴露於煙霧的細胞中發炎介質的表達增高。其方向性為：環境損害（煙霧）降低了一個保護性的蛋白-蛋白相互作用，增加發炎。這提供了吸煙、sirtuin 功能受損和慢性發炎性肺病之間的機制性聯繫。

label: Necroptosis
description: Through its mitophagy arm, PGAM5 protects cells from necroptosis: it stabilizes PINK1 on damaged mitochondria and supports the RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 fission route that segregates damaged mitochondria for clearance. Inhibition of PGAM5 in rat hearts following ischemia-reperfusion reduced necroptosis via Drp1 suppression, and PGAM5 is described as an important regulator of PINK1-dependent mitophagy. The protection holds under mild damage; under severe RIPK3 activation the same protein serves the necrosome instead.
description_zh_TW: 透過其粒線體自噬臂，PGAM5 保護細胞免於程序性壞死：它將 PINK1 穩定在受損粒線體上，並支持隔離受損粒線體以供清除的 RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 分裂路徑。在缺血再灌注後的大鼠心臟中，抑制 PGAM5 藉由 Drp1 的壓制而減少程序性壞死，且 PGAM5 被視為 PINK1 依賴性粒線體自噬的重要調節者。此保護作用在輕度損傷下成立；在強烈的 RIPK3 活化下，同一蛋白反而服務於 necrosome。

label: Lysosome
description: The lysosome is the cell's terminal degradation center, containing acidic hydrolases that break down proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates delivered by endocytosis, phagocytosis, and autophagy. Beyond catabolism, lysosomes serve as signaling hubs that integrate nutrient and growth-factor inputs, most notably by hosting the activation of mTORC1 at their surface. This duality—as both waste-disposal organelle and metabolic command post—places lysosomes at the center of cellular homeostasis, development, and aging. Lysosomal dysfunction underlies a broad spectrum of storage and degenerative diseases.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體是細胞的終端降解中心，含有酸性水解酶，可分解經由胞吞作用、吞噬作用和自噬遞送的蛋白質、脂質、核酸和碳水化合物。除了分解代謝，溶酶體還作為整合營養和生長因子輸入的信號樞紐，最顯著者是在其表面主導 mTORC1 的活化。這種雙重性——既是廢物處理胞器也是代謝指揮站——使溶酶體位居細胞恆定性、發育與老化的中心。溶酶體功能失調是廣泛的儲存性和退化性疾病的基礎。

label: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus
source_file: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus.md
description: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Catechols
description: COMT methylates catechols by transferring a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to the meta-hydroxyl group of the catechol ring, converting the active catechol into a less reactive O-methylated metabolite that is more readily excreted. This reaction detoxifies and inactivates endogenous catecholamines such as dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, as well as exogenous catechol compounds including certain flavonoids and catecholestrogens. The requirement for SAMe as methyl donor links COMT flux directly to the cellular methylation budget. This broad substrate scope makes COMT central to both neurotransmitter homeostasis and xenobiotic detoxification.
description_zh_TW: COMT 將甲基從 S-adenosylmethionine 轉移到兒茶酚環的間羥基，將兒茶酚甲基化，將活性兒茶酚轉化為反應性較低、更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。此反應可解毒並滅活內源性 catecholamines（如多巴胺、norepinephrine 和腎上腺素）以及外源性兒茶酚化合物（包括某些類黃酮和兒茶酚雌激素）。 SAMe 的要求與 methyl donor 一樣，將 COMT 通量直接與細胞甲基化預算連結起來。這種廣泛的底物範圍使 COMT 對於神經傳導物質穩態和異生物質解毒至關重要。

label: Glutamate-gated Cl- channels
description: Avermectins are allosteric potentiators/agonists of invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls); Cl- influx hyperpolarizes and paralyzes parasites.
description_zh_TW: 是無脊椎動物穀氨酸門控氯離子通道 (GluCls) 的變構增強劑/激動劑； Cl-流入使寄生蟲超極化並麻痺。

label: TFE3
description: TFE3, the closely related MiT/TFE family member, also binds CLEAR elements and induces lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy in response to nutrient deprivation and stress. Like TFEB, TFE3 is repressed by mTORC1 through phosphorylation and released upon starvation, calcineurin activation, or ER stress. The overlapping but non-identical target sets of TFEB and TFE3 provide redundancy and specificity in the lysosomal program. TFE3's distinct regulation, including PERK-dependent activation, broadens the stress-responsive control of degradation.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 是關係密切的 MiT/TFE 家族成員，同樣結合 CLEAR 元件，並在營養匱乏和壓力下誘發溶酶體生物發生與自噬。如同 TFEB，TFE3 經由磷酸化受 mTORC1 抑制，並在飢餓、calcineurin 活化或內質網壓力時釋放。TFEB 與 TFE3 重疊但非完全相同的標的組，提供了溶酶體程序中的冗餘與特異性。TFE3 獨特的調節——包括 PERK 依賴的活化——拓寬了對降解的壓力反應性控制。

label: Norepinephrine transporter
description: The norepinephrine transporter is responsible for the reuptake of norepinephrine from the synaptic cleft into presynaptic terminals, terminating noradrenergic signaling and recycling the transmitter. As a member of the SLC6A family, NET is the primary determinant of noradrenergic tone in brain and periphery, and its blockade underlies many antidepressants and attention treatments. Its dopamine-reuptake capacity additionally links it to prefrontal dopamine regulation where DAT is sparse. It is a major target in psychopharmacology.
description_zh_TW: norepinephrine轉運蛋白負責將norepinephrine從突觸間隙重新攝取到突觸前末梢，終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導並回收發射器。作為 SLC6A 家族的一員，NET 是 brain 和周邊去甲腎上腺素能張力的主要決定因素，其阻斷是許多抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的基礎。它還具有多巴胺再攝取能力，與 DAT 稀疏的前額多巴胺調節有關。它是精神藥理學的一個主要目標。

label: Klf4
description: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc that reprogram somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and they include Klf4. Klf4 is a zinc-finger transcription factor that interacts directly with Oct4, is required for activation of Nanog, and promotes the mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition needed for reprogramming. Klf4 can act as both a tumor suppressor and an oncogene depending on cellular context. Klf4's dual nature underscores how context determines the function of reprogramming factors.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子是將體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的四種轉錄因子Oct4、Sox2、Klf4和c-Myc，其中包括Klf4。 Klf4 是一種鋅指轉錄因子，可與 Oct4 直接相互作用，是激活 Nanog 所必需的，並促進重編程所需的間質到上皮的轉變。根據細胞環境，Klf4 可以充當腫瘤抑制基因和癌基因。 Klf4 的雙重性質強調了情境如何決定重編程因子的功能。

label: PPARγ
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A modulates the activity of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), a crucial transcription factor involved in adipocyte differentiation, glucose metabolism, and cholesterol metabolism. Studies indicate that urolithin A can increase the expression of PPARγ and the transcription of its downstream target genes, thereby promoting fatty acid oxidation, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing cholesterol synthesis and absorption. These metabolic regulatory effects position PPARγ signaling as a mediator of urolithin A's influence on energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 調節 peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) 的活性，這是參與脂肪細胞分化、葡萄糖代謝與膽固醇代謝的重要轉錄因子。研究指出 urolithin A 可提升 PPARγ 的表現及其下游標的基因轉錄，從而促進脂肪酸氧化、改善胰島素敏感性，並降低膽固醇合成與吸收。這些代謝調節效應使 PPARγ 訊號成為 urolithin A 影響能量代謝的中介者。

label: Metastasis
description: HMGB1-RAGE signaling can promote tumor cell migration, invasion and metastasis in several contexts.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1-RAGE 信號在多種情況下可促進腫瘤細胞遷移、侵襲和轉移。

label: CCL20
description: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
description_zh_TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

label: KRAS
description: Lung Cancer is driven by KRAS. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. The directionality runs from KRAS toward Lung Cancer, so KRAS is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 由KRAS 驅動。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。方向性從 KRAS 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 KRAS 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Adrenochrome Pathway
description: The adrenochrome pathway produces adrenochrome as one of its two major catabolites, the other being adrenolutin. It is an oxidative pathway in which adrenaline is oxidized, a reaction mediated by oxygen radicals, to yield the pink oxidation product adrenochrome. Although the pathway was at one time considered the principal route of adrenaline catabolism, its clinical importance has remained controversial because no established method for adrenochrome formation in vivo has been demonstrated and the compound has never been detected in biological fluids. Interest in the pathway persists because adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, causing cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction, making it a candidate mediator of stress-induced heart disease when oxidant production is elevated.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome路徑產生adrenochrome作為其兩種主要代謝物之一，另一種是adrenolutin。這是一種氧化路徑，其中adrenaline被氧化，反應由氧自由基介導，產生粉紅色的氧化產物adrenochrome。儘管該路徑曾一度被視為adrenaline分解的主要途徑，但其臨床重要性一直存在爭議，因為尚未建立體內形成adrenochrome的既定方法，且該化合物從未在生物液體中被檢測到。對該路徑的興趣持續存在，因為adrenochrome已被證明具有心臟毒性，導致細胞壞死、心律不齊和冠狀動脈收縮，使其在氧化劑產生增加時成為壓力誘發心臟病的候選介導因子。

label: Bak
description: MOMP is driven by Bak. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The directionality runs from Bak toward MOMP, so Bak is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MOMP 由Bak 驅動。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。方向性從 Bak 向 MOMP，因此 Bak 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: PRDX6
description: Peroxiredoxin 6 is a unique 1-Cys member of the peroxiredoxin family, which comprises six highly conserved antioxidant enzymes (PRDX1-PRDX6) featuring a cysteine residue involved in peroxide reduction. Uniquely among peroxiredoxins, PRDX6 possesses three activities: peroxidase, acidic calcium-independent phospholipase A2 (aiPLA2), and lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase (LPCAT). It is important for lipid peroxidation repair, inflammatory signaling, and antioxidant damage responses, and it is extensively studied in brain disorders such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: Peroxiredoxin 6是peroxiredoxin家族中獨特的1-Cys成員，該家族包含六個高度保守的抗氧化酶（PRDX1-PRDX6），具有參與過氧化物還原的半胱氨酸殘基。在peroxiredoxins中，PRDX6獨特地具有三種活性：過氧化物酶、酸性鈣非依賴性磷脂酶A2（aiPLA2）和溶血磷脂醯膽鹼醯基轉移酶（LPCAT）。它對脂質過氧化修復、發炎訊號和抗氧化損傷反應很重要，在阿茲海默症和帕金森氏症等腦部疾病中被廣泛研究。

label: PARP
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide (NAM), the amide form of vitamin B3 and a product released from NAD+-consuming reactions, inhibits PARP activity while being effective at increasing NAD+ levels in tissues. At high doses, NAM is metabolized by nicotinamide N-methyltransferase into N1-methylnicotinamide for urinary elimination, which can progressively lower the cellular methyl pool, potentially reducing DNA and protein methylation and altering gene expression and protein activity. This dual role as both NAD+ precursor and PARP/sirtuin inhibitor distinguishes NAM from NMN and NR, which elevate NAD+ without this inhibitory action, and may explain differences in their metabolic outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺（NAM）是維生素 B3 的醯胺形式，也是 NAD+ 消耗反應釋放的產物，它在有效提升組織 NAD+ 水平的同時抑制 PARP 活性。在高劑量下，NAM 被菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶代謝為 N1-甲基菸鹼醯胺以經尿液排出，這可能逐步降低細胞甲基池，潛在減少 DNA 與蛋白質甲基化並改變基因表現與蛋白質活性。這種同時作為 NAD+ 前驅物與 PARP/去乙醯酶抑制劑的雙重角色，使 NAM 有別於 NMN 和 NR——後者提升 NAD+ 而不具此抑制作用，並可能解釋其代謝結果的差異。

label: Oleacein
description: Oleacein is a phenolic secoiridoid compound found in extra virgin olive oil, where it contributes to the oil's characteristic bitterness and health-promoting profile. As a dietary polyphenol it is metabolized in part by COMT, linking olive oil consumption to COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition. It exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that underlie part of the Mediterranean diet's cardiovascular benefits. Its presence makes olive oil a significant dietary source of COMT-interacting phenolics.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是一種在 extra virgin olive oil 中發現的酚類環烯醚萜化合物，它賦予了油特有的苦味和促進健康的特性。作為一種膳食多酚，它部分由 COMT 代謝，將橄欖油消耗與 COMT 依賴性多酚處置聯繫起來。它所含的抗氧化劑和 anti-inflammatory properties 是地中海飲食對心血管的部分益處的基礎。它的存在使得橄欖油成為 COMT 相互作用酚類物質的重要飲食來源。

label: Frailty
description: In humans, lower serum SIRT1 levels are associated with frailty compared with non-frail individuals, suggesting circulating sirtuins as a non-invasive frailty marker. Directionally, the association is correlative: reduced SIRT1 tracks frail phenotype. A caveat is that this is a biomarker correlation, not proof of causality.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，較低的血清 SIRT1 水平與衰弱相關，相較於非衰弱個體，提示循環 sirtuin 作為非侵入性衰弱標記。方向性上此關聯為相關性：SIRT1 降低追蹤衰弱表型。需要注意的是這是生物標記的相關性，而非因果關係的證據。

label: PARK7
description: PARK7 (DJ-1), historically characterized as a protein deglycase, is now understood from biochemical evidence to function primarily as a glutathione-independent glyoxalase. It stereospecifically detoxifies free methylglyoxal and glyoxal directly into L-lactate and glycolic acid, preventing these reactive species from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. Mutations or loss of PARK7 lead to significant tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs. PARK7 therefore provides a second, glutathione-independent layer of protection against dicarbonyl stress in addition to the classical glyoxalase system.
description_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）歷來被表徵為一種蛋白質去糖化酶（protein deglycase），但現在根據生化證據被理解為主要作為一種不依賴麩胱甘肽的乙二醛酶。它立體特異性地將游離甲基乙二醛與乙二醛直接解毒為 L-乳酸（L-lactate）與乙醇酸（glycolic acid），防止這些反應性物種在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。PARK7 的突變或缺失會導致顯著的組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積。因此，PARK7 除了經典的乙二醛酶系統外，提供了第二層不依賴麩胱甘肽的二羰基壓力保護。

label: MLKL
description: RIPK3 phosphorylates MLKL on its activation loop (human Thr357/Ser358), exposing the N-terminal four-helix bundle that executes necroptosis. This phosphorylation is the final licensure step of the necrosome cascade: without it MLKL stays monomeric and inert. Phosphorylated MLKL then oligomerizes and traffics to the plasma membrane, where its four-helix bundles form cation channels. MLKL is a pseudokinase — it binds ATP but does not hydrolyze it — so its function is structural membrane disruption rather than signaling.
description_zh_TW: RIPK3 會將 MLKL 的活化環（人類 Thr357/Ser358）磷酸化，暴露出執行程序性壞死的 N 端四螺旋束。此磷酸化是 necrosome 級聯的最終許可步驟：缺少它時 MLKL 保持單體且不活化。磷酸化的 MLKL 隨後寡聚化並轉位至細胞膜，其四螺旋束在此形成陽離子通道。MLKL 是一種偽激酶——會結合 ATP 但不水解——因此其功能是結構性的膜破壞而非訊號傳遞。

label: William C. Campbell
description: Campbell shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing avermectin into ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 坎貝爾分享了2015年將阿維菌素發展成伊維菌素的歷程。

label: Luteolin
description: Luteolin has anti-inflammatory properties, inhibiting NF-kappaB and AP-1 signaling and suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. These actions contribute to its studied benefits in neuroinflammation, allergic responses, and metabolic inflammation. Its anti-inflammatory profile is independent of COMT, making it usable alongside COMT-sensitive individuals, though high doses can still interact with the enzyme via its catechol structure. It is a prominent flavonoid in anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective research.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，抑制 NF-κB 和 AP-1 訊號傳導並抑制促發炎細胞因子，如 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β。這些作用有助於研究其在神經發炎、過敏反應和代謝發炎方面的益處。其抗發炎特性獨立於 COMT，使其可與 COMT 敏感個體一起使用，儘管高劑量仍可透過其兒茶酚結構與此酵素相互作用。它是抗發炎和神經保護研究中重要的黃酮類化合物。

label: Working Memory
description: The prefrontal cortex controls working memory by maintaining and manipulating information online through sustained firing of pyramidal networks, a process tightly gated by dopamine D1 receptor signaling. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that determines working memory capacity, making this region exquisitely sensitive to COMT genotype. Genotype-dependent COMT activity is therefore a major modulator of this function. The region is the primary substrate of working memory in humans.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過錐體網路的持續放電來在線上維護和操作訊息，從而控制工作記憶，這個過程受到多巴胺 D1 receptor 訊號的嚴格控制。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了決定工作記憶容量的多巴胺基調，使該區域對 COMT genotype 極為敏感。因此，基因型依賴性 COMT activity 是此功能的主要調節劑。此區域是人類工作記憶的主要基質。

label: Silver(I) Oxide
description: Silver(I) oxide (PubChem CID 88641, formula Ag2H2O, molecular weight 233.752 g/mol) is an oxide of silver used to prepare other silver compounds and in silver oxide batteries. Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47 that occurs naturally in free form, in alloys with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. The oxide therefore serves as a convenient silver source for synthesis and for electrochemical applications in consumer electronics.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)（PubChem CID 88641，化學式Ag2H2O，分子量233.752 g/mol）是用於製備其他銀化合物及銀氧化物電池的銀氧化物。銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47，自然存在於游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。因此，該氧化物可作為合成及消費電子產品電化學應用的便捷銀源。

label: Dicarbonyls
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Aminoguanidine is an AGE inhibitor that acts as a carbonyl trap, interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and preventing them from reacting with proteins. These reactive carbonyls include dicarbonyls such as methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which are key intermediates in AGE formation. By trapping these dicarbonyl species, aminoguanidine blocks AGE accumulation and the downstream glycation damage. This mechanism is shared with other AGE inhibitors such as pyridoxamine, and underpins aminoguanidine's ability to prevent diabetic complications in animal models.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 AGE inhibitor，作為 carbonyl trap，與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並防止其與蛋白質反應。這些 reactive carbonyls 包括 methylglyoxal、glyoxal 與 3-deoxyglucosone 等 dicarbonyls，它們是 AGE formation 的關鍵 intermediates。透過 trapping 這些 dicarbonyl species，aminoguanidine 阻斷 AGE accumulation 與 downstream glycation damage。此 mechanism 與 pyridoxamine 等其他 AGE inhibitors 共享，並構成 aminoguanidine 在 animal models 中預防 diabetic complications 能力的基礎。

label: Alpha-synuclein
description: Alpha-synuclein and A53T are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Alpha-synuclein and A53T may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: NAMPT
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Activated AMPK increases expression of NAMPT, the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway that converts nicotinamide to NMN. Directionally, AMPK sits upstream of NAMPT induction. More NAMPT elevates intracellular NAD+, the obligate co-substrate for sirtuins, and the AMPK-to-NAMPT-to-NAD+ axis is a major indirect route by which resveratrol, exercise, and caloric restriction activate SIRT1. Because NAMPT is rate-limiting, its induction is a decisive step in raising NAD+ availability, and AMPK and SIRT1 also induce each other, creating a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit that sustains NAD+-dependent processes.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 AMPK 增加 NAMPT 的表達，NAMPT 是 NAD+ 回收代謝通路的限速酶，將菸鹼醯胺轉化為 NMN。在方向性上，AMPK 位於 NAMPT 誘導的上游。更多的 NAMPT 提高細胞內 NAD+——sirtuin 的必需共同受質，AMPK-NAMPT-NAD+ 軸是白藜蘆醇、運動和熱量限制活化 SIRT1 的主要間接途徑。由於 NAMPT 是限速酶，其誘導是提高 NAD+ 可用性的決定性步驟，且 AMPK 和 SIRT1 也相互誘導，形成一個自我強化的代謝電路，維持 NAD+ 依賴性過程。

label: ACSL4
description: ACSL4 is a canonical positive regulator of ferroptosis. By charging long-chain PUFAs (e.g., arachidonic acid) to their acyl-CoA thioesters for re-esterification into membrane phospholipids (Lands cycle), ACSL4 enriches the sn-2 position of phosphatidylethanolamines with oxidizable PUFAs — the direct substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACSL4 overexpression raises ferroptosis sensitivity; knockdown protects against RSL3/GPX4 inhibition.
description_zh_TW: ACSL4 是鐵死亡的典型正向調節因子。它將長鏈 PUFA（如花生四烯酸）活化為其醯基-CoA 硫酯，重新酯化進膜磷脂（Lands cycle），使磷脂醯乙醇胺的 sn-2 位置富含可氧化的 PUFA——也就是脂質過氧化的直接受質。ACSL4 過表現會提高鐵死亡敏感性；敲低則能抵抗 RSL3/GPX4 抑制。

label: Coenzyme Q10
description: Ubiquinone (CoQ10, oxidized) is the direct electron acceptor for FSP1, a plasma-membrane flavoprotein that uses NAD(P)H to reduce CoQ10 to ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that terminates phospholipid peroxyl-radical chains and suppresses ferroptosis. This FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis is glutathione-independent and acts in parallel to GPX4. Because CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway, statin-mediated depletion starves FSP1 of substrate and sensitizes cells to ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 泛醌（CoQ10，氧化態）是 FSP1 的直接電子受體；FSP1 是一種質膜黃素蛋白，利用 NAD(P)H 將 CoQ10 還原為泛醇（CoQ10H2），後者是脂溶性自由基捕獲抗氧化劑，能終止磷脂過氧自由基鏈並抑制鐵死亡。這條 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸不依賴谷胱甘肽，並與 GPX4 平行運作。由於 CoQ10 是甲羥戊酸路徑的非固醇產物，statin 介導的耗竭會使 FSP1 缺乏受質並使細胞對鐵死亡增敏。

label: Histone Acetyltransferase
description: Histone acetyltransferases (HATs) catalyze the transfer of acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to specific lysine residues on histone tails, a key step in epigenetic regulation. Acetylation neutralizes the positive charge of the lysine side chains, weakening histone-DNA interactions and opening the chromatin for transcription. HAT activity is opposed by histone deacetylases, and the balance between these opposing enzymes determines the acetylation state of chromatin and hence its transcriptional activity.
description_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯轉移酶 (HAT) 催化乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部的特定離胺酸殘基，這是表觀遺傳調控的關鍵步驟。乙醯化會中和賴氨酸側鏈的正電荷，削弱組蛋白-DNA 相互作用並打開染色質進行轉錄。 HAT 的活性與組蛋白去乙醯化酶相反，這些相反酶之間的平衡決定了染色質的乙醯化狀態，從而決定了其轉錄活性。

label: Tumor Microenvironment
description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibodies eliminate CD38+ Tregs and MDSCs and reduce adenosine-mediated immunosuppression, restoring T- and NK-cell function in the tumor microenvironment. Directionally, anti-CD38 therapy sits upstream of tumor-microenvironment reprogramming. This is both an anticancer action and a means to spare NAD+ for sirtuins, and it illustrates the dual therapeutic logic of CD38 targeting. By depleting immunosuppressive cells and reducing adenosine, these antibodies restore effector immune responses. The resulting reshaping of the tumor microenvironment contributes to the efficacy of anti-CD38 antibodies in multiple myeloma and other cancers.
description_zh_TW: 抗 CD38 單克隆抗體消除 CD38+ 調節性 T 細胞和 MDSC，並減少腺苷介導的免疫抑制，恢復腫瘤微環境中 T 細胞和 NK 細胞的功能。在方向性上，抗 CD38 治療位於腫瘤微環境重編程的上游。這既是抗癌作用也是為 sirtuin 節省 NAD+ 的手段，說明了 CD38 靶向的雙重治療邏輯。透過清除免疫抑制細胞和減少腺苷，這些抗體恢復效應免疫反應。由此產生的腫瘤微環境重塑有助於抗 CD38 抗體在多發性骨髓瘤和其他癌症中的療效。

label: Bik
description: Bik is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bik, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bik the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bik 是Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從Bcl-2 family 向Bik 延伸，因此Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bik 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: TNFα
description: TNF-α binding to TNFR1 assembles complex I (RIPK1, TRADD, TRAF2, LUBAC, cIAP1, CYLD, NEMO). When NF-κB activation is suppressed, RIPK1 deubiquitinates and assembles complex IIa (ripoptosome) with FADD, TRADD, and pro-caspase-8 for apoptosis; with cIAP1 inhibited, complex IIb forms. Only when caspase-8 is absent or inhibited does RIPK1 recruit RIPK3 and MLKL into the necrosome — making TNF signaling a three-way fate decision in which the necrosome is the final, caspase-suppressed branch.
description_zh_TW: TNF-α 與 TNFR1 結合會組裝 complex I（RIPK1、TRADD、TRAF2、LUBAC、cIAP1、CYLD、NEMO）。當 NF-κB 活化受抑制時，RIPK1 去泛素化並與 FADD、TRADD 及 pro-Caspase-8 組裝出 complex IIa（ripoptosome）以進行細胞凋亡；當 cIAP1 受抑制時則形成 complex IIb。只有當 caspase-8 缺席或受抑制時，RIPK1 才會招募 RIPK3 與 MLKL 組成 necrosome——使 TNF 訊號成為三向的命運決定，而 necrosome 是 caspase 受壓制後的最終分支。

label: Intermittent Fasting
description: SIRT3 is induced by intermittent fasting, which enhances mitochondrial health and stress resistance, paralleling caloric restriction. Directionally, fasting sits upstream of SIRT3 induction. This raises the protective SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio and counters the age-related decline in mitochondrial function, and it is a translatable lifestyle intervention engaging sirtuin biology. By increasing SIRT3, intermittent fasting promotes oxidative metabolism, antioxidant defense, and mitochondrial quality control. These effects contribute to the metabolic benefits of fasting, including improved insulin sensitivity and resistance to age-related dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 被間歇性禁食誘導，後者增強粒線體健康和壓力抗性，類似於限制熱量。在方向性上，禁食位於 SIRT3 誘導的上游。這提高保護性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 比率並對抗粒線體功能的年齡相關下降，是一種可轉化的涉及 sirtuin 生物學的生活方式干預。透過增加 SIRT3，間歇性禁食促進氧化代謝、抗氧化防禦和粒線體品質控制。這些效應有助於禁食的代謝益處，包括改善胰島素敏感性和對年齡相關功能障礙的抵抗力。

label: Epigenetic Drift
description: The best-characterized signature of epigenetic drift is global hypomethylation of repetitive elements and gene bodies coupled with site-specific hypermethylation of gene promoters. This age-related divergence of methylation patterns erodes the stability of the epigenome and contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity. Because drift accumulates with time and is modified by environment, lifestyle, and interventions such as caloric restriction, it underlies both biological aging and the age-associated increase in disease risk.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳漂變的最佳特徵是重複元件和基因體的整體低甲基化以及基因啟動子的位點特異性高甲基化。這種與年齡相關的甲基化模式的差異會侵蝕表觀基因組的穩定性，並導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失。由於漂移會隨著時間的推移而累積，並會受到環境、生活方式和熱量限制等乾預措施的改變，因此它是生物老化和與年齡相關的疾病風險增加的基礎。

label: Cardiovascular Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML), a predominant advanced glycation end product, can serve as a predictor of cardiovascular mortality. Semba and colleagues studied 559 women aged 65 and older from the Women's Health and Aging Study I for 4.5 years, during which 22% died, 43.9% from cardiovascular disease; women in the highest quartiles of CML had the highest risk of dying from cardiovascular disease. CML, the most abundant AGE both in vivo and in foods, is therefore used as a circulating biomarker of AGE burden and an indicator of cardiovascular risk in older populations.
description_zh_TW: N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）是一種predominant advanced glycation end product，可作為cardiovascular mortality的predictor。Semba及其colleagues studied 559 women aged 65 and older from the Women's Health and Aging Study I for 4.5 years，期間22% died，43.9% from cardiovascular disease；CML處於highest quartiles的女性died from cardiovascular disease的risk最高。CML是in vivo與in foods中最abundant的AGE，因此被used as a circulating biomarker of AGE burden與an indicator of cardiovascular risk in older populations。

label: Catecholamines
description: COMT inhibitors such as entacapone, tolcapone, and opicapone block catechol-O-methyltransferase, one of the principal enzymes that degrades catecholamines by methylation. Inhibiting COMT therefore increases synaptic and circulating levels of dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, and this is exploited clinically in Parkinson's disease, often combined with MAO inhibitors and levodopa, to prolong dopaminergic effects and reduce off time. The resulting higher catecholamine levels, together with inhibition of MAO-mediated clearance, provide more substrate for oxidative conversion to adrenochrome, though this effect is mostly theoretical in clinical use and benefits are generally judged to outweigh risks.
description_zh_TW: COMT 抑制劑如 entacapone、tolcapone 與 opicapone 阻斷 catechol-O-methyltransferase，這是透過甲基化降解兒茶酚胺的主要酶之一。因此，抑制 COMT 會升高多巴胺、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的突觸與循環濃度，這在臨床上用於帕金森氏症，常與 MAO 抑制劑及 levodopa 併用以延長多巴胺能效應並減少 off time。所導致的較高兒茶酚胺濃度，加上 MAO 介導清除的抑制，提供了更多氧化轉化為 adrenochrome 的受質，儘管此效應在臨床使用中多屬理論性，且效益通常被認為大於風險。

label: Extrinsic Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Extrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Extrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Extrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Extrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Epigenetics
description: DNA methylation is one of the most extensively studied epigenetic mechanisms, operating alongside histone modification and non-coding RNA regulation. It involves the covalent addition of methyl groups to cytosines at CpG dinucleotides, repressing gene expression in promoter CpG islands by recruiting methyl-binding proteins and chromatin remodeling factors. Patterns are established de novo by DNMT3 enzymes and maintained by DNMT1 during replication, while methylation also silences transposable elements. Age-related global hypomethylation with focal hypermethylation defines the aging methylome, and selected CpG sites feed the epigenetic clocks that estimate biological age.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化是研究最廣泛的表觀遺傳機制之一，與組蛋白修飾和非編碼 RNA 調控一起發揮作用。它涉及將 methyl groups 共價添加到 CpG 二核苷酸的胞嘧啶上，透過招募甲基結合蛋白和染色質重塑因子來抑制啟動子 CpG 島中的 gene expression。模式由 DNMT3 酶從頭建立，並在複製過程中由 DNMT1 維持，而甲基化也會沉默轉座元件。與年齡相關的整體低甲基化和局部高甲基化定義了衰老的甲基化組，並且選定的 CpG 位點為估計生物年齡的表觀遺傳時鐘提供了資訊。

label: Diabetic nephropathy
description: Aminoguanidine (pimagedine) manages diabetic nephropathy and is beneficial in treating patients with the condition, either alone or in combination with other therapies. Diabetic nephropathy is the progressive kidney damage driven by hyperglycemia, advanced glycation end product accumulation, and hemodynamic stress. By inhibiting AGE formation and, to a lesser extent, aldose reductase and nitric oxide synthase, aminoguanidine targets several pathways implicated in the renal injury of diabetes, which is why it was developed and clinically investigated for diabetic kidney disease.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine (pimagedine) 用於治療糖尿病腎病變，對患有此病症的患者有益，可單獨使用或與其他療法結合使用。糖尿病腎病變是由高血糖、晚期糖化終產物積累和血液動力學壓力所導致的進行性腎損傷。通過抑制 AGE 形成，以及較少程度地抑制醛糖還原酶和一氧化氮合酶，aminoguanidine 針對多種與糖尿病腎損傷相關的通路，這就是為什麼它被開發並臨床研究用於糖尿病腎病。

label: Leuco-adrenochrome
description: Leuco-adrenochrome, the reduced leuco-form of the aminochrome system, is further oxidized to form adrenochrome, a distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound whose color arises from its extended conjugated system. Adrenochrome is the classic oxidation product of epinephrine studied since the 19th century. Because leuco-adrenochrome is highly unstable in the presence of oxygen and acts as a ready electron donor, this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily, which is why leuco-adrenochrome is difficult to isolate outside controlled laboratory environments and why pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations is a recognized stability problem.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome，aminochrome system 的 reduced leuco-form，is further oxidized to form adrenochrome，一種 distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound，其 color arises from its extended conjugated system。Adrenochrome 是 classic oxidation product of epinephrine，自 19th century 以來被研究。由於 leuco-adrenochrome 在 oxygen presence 下 highly unstable 且 acts as a ready electron donor，this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily，這就是為什麼 leuco-adrenochrome 在 controlled laboratory environments 外 difficult to isolate，以及 pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations 是 recognized stability problem。

label: Splitomicin
description: Splitomicin inhibits human SIRT1 with an IC50 of 96 μM in vitro by blocking NAD+-dependent deacetylation. Directionally, Splitomicin sits upstream of SIRT1 inhibition. It is an early-tool sirtuin inhibitor used to probe SIRT1 phenotypes, though its moderate potency limits in vivo utility. Splitomicin also inhibits SIRT2 with an IC50 of 113 μM, and its effects on NF-κB acetylation and inflammation are consistent with sirtuin inhibition. As a first-generation inhibitor, Splitomicin helped establish the concept that sirtuin blockade can be achieved pharmacologically.
description_zh_TW: Splitomicin 以 IC50 96 μM 在體外抑制人類 SIRT1，透過阻斷 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯化。在方向性上，Splitomicin 位於 SIRT1 抑制的上游。它是一種早期工具性 sirtuin 抑制劑，用於探究 SIRT1 表型，但其較低的效力限制了體內應用。Splitomicin 也以 IC50 113 μM 抑制 SIRT2，其對 NF-κB 乙醯化和發炎的效應與 sirtuin 抑制一致。作為第一代抑制劑，Splitomicin 幫助建立了 sirtuin 阻斷可以透過藥理學實現的概念。

label: Xanthine Oxidase
description: Xanthine oxidase catalyzes the conversion of hypoxanthine to xanthine and xanthine to uric acid, using molecular oxygen as the electron acceptor. This enzyme thus sits at the junction of purine catabolism and ROS production. The directionality is purine oxidation to urate plus superoxide generation. A caveat is that the enzyme exists in an NAD+-dependent dehydrogenase form (XDH) that, when converted to the oxidase form (XO), becomes the prominent ROS-producing variant. The reaction also generates superoxide and hydrogen peroxide when oxygen serves as the electron acceptor, coupling urate production to oxidant release.
description_zh_TW: Xanthine oxidase 使用分子氧作為電子受體催化次黃嘌呤轉化為黃嘌呤以及黃嘌呤轉化為 uric acid。因此，此酵素位於嘌呤分解代謝和 ROS 生產的結合點。方向性是嘌呤氧化為尿酸鹽加上超氧化物的生成。需要注意的是，該酶以 NAD+ 依賴性脫氫酶形式 (XDH) 存在，當轉換為氧化酶形式 (XO) 時，它會成為主要的 ROS 生成變體。當氧氣作為電子受體時，此反應也會產生超氧化物和 hydrogen peroxide，從而將尿酸鹽的產生與氧化劑的釋放耦合。

label: Inflammasome
description: Canonical inflammasomes activate caspase-1, which processes pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into their mature secreted forms and cleaves gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. This activation is the central effector step of the inflammasome pathway and requires assembly of sensor, ASC, and procaspase-1. In senescence, caspase-1 activity also feeds the SASP, particularly during oncogene-induced senescence where the canonical inflammasome is engaged. The relationship is a foundational inflammasome mechanism with direct relevance to senescence-associated inflammation and sterile immunity.
description_zh_TW: 典型發炎體活化 caspase-1，caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 與 pro-IL-18 切割為成熟、分泌形式，驅動發炎。此切割是衰老細胞中促發炎性 IL-1beta 釋放的核心步驟，且構成 SASP 的 IL-1 臂。不同於 IL-1alpha（細胞內並經 calpain 切割），IL-1beta 嚴格依賴 caspase-1 活化，使發炎體成為 SASP 中此細胞激素的必要閘門。此活化連結 DAMP 感知到分泌組的發炎輸出。

label: SMAD3
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: TGF-β1 binds the type II receptor (TβRII), which recruits and phosphorylates the type I receptor (TβRI), leading to phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of SMAD2/3 to drive fibrotic transcription. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of SMAD3 activation. This canonical pathway is the main driver of pathological fibrosis across organs, inducing collagen, fibronectin, and other matrix genes. Sirtuins such as SIRT6 and SIRT7 intersect this axis at multiple points, either by deacetylating SMAD3 or by repressing SMAD3-dependent transcription. Understanding the TGF-β/SMAD cascade is essential for interpreting sirtuin effects on fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β1 結合 II 型受體（TβRII），後者招募並磷酸化 I 型受體（TβRI），導致 SMAD2/3 磷酸化和核轉位以驅動纖維化轉錄。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於 SMAD3 活化的上游。此經典途徑是跨器官病理性纖維化的主要驅動因子，誘導膠原蛋白、纖維連接蛋白和其他基質基因。如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7 等 sirtuin 在多個節點與此軸線交匯，或透過去乙醯化 SMAD3 或抑制 SMAD3 依賴性轉錄。理解 TGF-β/SMAD 級聯對於詮釋 sirtuin 對纖維化的效應至關重要。

label: Amadori products
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Glycation is a spontaneous non-enzymatic reaction of free reducing sugars with free amino groups of proteins, DNA, and lipids. It is initiated by the attack of a reactive carbonyl group of a sugar or aldehyde on a nucleophilic free amino group, rapidly forming an unstable Schiff base that rearranges into a more stable Amadori product. Amadori products then undergo irreversible dehydration, oxidation, polymerization, and cross-linking reactions over days to weeks, yielding advanced glycation end products. Glycation causes loss of protein function and impaired tissue elasticity, is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, and is implicated in diabetic complications and aging.
description_zh_TW: Glycation 是游離 reducing sugars 與蛋白質、DNA 和脂質的游離 amino groups 自發性非酵素反應。它由糖或 aldehyde 的 reactive carbonyl group 攻擊 nucleophilic 游離 amino group 所啟動，迅速形成不穩定的 Schiff base，再重排為更穩定的 Amadori product。Amadori products 隨後在數天至數週內經歷不可逆的 dehydration、oxidation、polymerization 與 cross-linking 反應，產生 advanced glycation end products。Glycation 導致蛋白質功能喪失與組織彈性受損，受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，並涉及 diabetic complications 與 aging。

label: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine
description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is a biomarker for oxidative stress, representing the major product of DNA oxidation and one of the most widely used indicators of oxidative DNA damage in urine and tissue. Its steady-state level integrates the rate of formation by ROS and the efficiency of repair and sanitization. The directionality is DNA oxidation to measurable lesion. A caveat is that sample handling and artifactual oxidation during extraction can inflate measurements, requiring careful standardized assays.
description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 是 oxidative stress 的生物標記物，代表 DNA 氧化的主要產物，也是尿液和組織中最廣泛使用的氧化 DNA damage 指標之一。其穩態水準綜合了ROS的形成速率以及修復和消毒的效率。方向性是DNA氧化至可測量的損傷。需要注意的是，樣品處理和萃取過程中的人為氧化可能會導致測量結果誇大，需要仔細的標準化測定。

label: Insulin Sensitivity
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: GlyNAC reduced HOMA-IR by 30% and improved glucose handling in older adults and type 2 diabetes patients.
description_zh_TW: GlyNAC 使 HOMA-IR 下降 30%，並改善老年受試者與第二型糖尿病患者之葡萄糖代謝。

label: Noncanonical Inflammasome
description: The noncanonical inflammasome is an innate immune surveillance pathway distinct from the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 pathway, centered on human caspase-4/5 and mouse caspase-11. It is activated directly by cytosolic LPS and amplifies inflammatory signaling, including through gasdermin D pore formation. In senescence, it is a principal SASP-licensing mechanism via IL-1alpha cleavage. Its classification as an inflammasome variant reflects shared gasdermin-mediated outcomes and inflammatory cell death, despite the absence of an upstream sensor protein.
description_zh_TW: 非典型發炎體是一種不同於典型 NLRP3/caspase-1 路徑的先天免疫監視途徑，以人類 caspase-4/5 與小鼠 caspase-11 為中心。它直接被胞質 LPS 活化並放大發炎訊號，包括透過 gasdermin D 孔洞形成。在衰老中，此途徑提供 IL-1alpha 成熟與 SASP 驅動的替代機制，補充典型發炎體。其區分身分使其成為衰老相關發炎的重要調節者。

label: LINE-1
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: SIRT6 represses LINE-1 retrotransposons by maintaining repressive chromatin at L1 loci through its deacetylase and mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activities. SIRT6 recruits KAP1 and HP1 to deposit and maintain heterochromatin marks that silence LINE-1 elements, and this silencing declines with age as SIRT6 levels fall. Loss of SIRT6 permits LINE-1 derepression, and activating SIRT6 is explored as a strategy to suppress retrotransposon-driven inflammation in aging. Restoring SIRT6 activity may therefore help suppress retrotransposon-driven inflammation in aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過其去乙醯化酶和單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性維持 L1 位點的抑制性染色質，進而抑制 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座子。 SIRT6 招募 KAP1 和 HP1 來沉積和維持使 LINE-1 元件沉默的異染色質標記，並且隨著 SIRT6 水平下降，這種沉默隨著年齡的增長而減弱。 SIRT6 的缺失使得 LINE-1 去抑制，並且激活 SIRT6 被探索作為抑制衰老過程中逆轉錄轉座子驅動的炎症的策略。因此，恢復 SIRT6 活性可能有助於抑制老化過程中逆轉錄轉座子驅動的發炎。

label: Endothelial dysfunction
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) rescues endothelial dysfunction associated with aging. In aged mice, intraperitoneal NMN at 500 mg/kg/day for 14 days reversed aging-induced cerebrovascular endothelial dysfunction and rescued neurovascular coupling responses, improving cognitive performance by increasing endothelial NO-mediated vasodilation. NMN also restored angiogenic capacity (capillary-like structure formation, proliferative and migratory capability) and attenuated oxidative stress in aged cerebromicrovascular endothelial cells. These vascular protective effects, which depend on NAD+ restoration and likely SIRT1 activation, prevent arterial and endothelial dysfunction and support NMN's role in preserving cardiovascular and cognitive health during aging.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）挽救與老化相關的內皮功能障礙。在老化小鼠中，以 500 mg/kg/天腹腔注射 NMN 14 天，逆轉了老化誘發的腦血管內皮功能障礙並挽救神經血管耦合反應，透過增加內皮 NO 介導的血管舒張改善認知表現。NMN 也恢復了血管生成能力（毛細血管樣結構形成、增殖與遷移能力），並減輕老化腦微血管內皮細胞中的氧化壓力。這些依賴 NAD+ 恢復且可能依賴 SIRT1 活化的血管保護效應，預防動脈與內皮功能障礙，並支持 NMN 在老化期間維持心血管與認知健康的角色。

label: Cytochrome c
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: SIRT5 deacetylates cytochrome c, the mitochondrial intermembrane protein central to oxidative metabolism and apoptosis initiation. SIRT5 overexpression ameliorates cytochrome c leakage into the cytoplasm and the resulting caspase-3 activation, alleviating apoptosis. Together with SIRT4's restraint of procaspase processing, this places the mitochondrial sirtuins directly on the cytochrome c/apoptosome entry point of the caspase cascade rather than only on transcriptional or redox arms.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 會去乙醯化 cytochrome c——這個位於粒線體膜間腔、對氧化代謝與細胞凋亡起始至關重要的蛋白。SIRT5 的過表達能改善 cytochrome c 洩漏至細胞質及其後續的 Caspase-3 活化，從而減輕細胞凋亡。與 SIRT4 對 pro-caspase 加工的抑制並列，這使粒線體 sirtuins 不只作用於轉錄或氧化還原臂，而是直接作用於 caspase 級聯的 cytochrome c/凋亡體入口。

label: melittin
description: Cancer is treated by melittin. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward Cancer, so melittin is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 melittin 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 朝向 Cancer，因此 melittin 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: ERK1_2
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at ERK1/2 gene promoters, inhibiting ERK1/2 expression and thereby dampening pro-hypertrophic MAPK signaling. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of ERK1/2 suppression. Reduced ERK signaling limits growth and fibrotic responses in the heart and vasculature, and it adds a MAPK-regulatory dimension to SIRT6's cardiovascular protection. By directly controlling the expression of the ERK1/2 genes themselves, rather than only their activity, SIRT6 provides sustained restraint of this pro-growth pathway, complementing its inhibition of IGF-Akt signaling in cardiac hypertrophy.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 ERK1/2 基因啟動子上去乙醯化 H3K9，抑制 ERK1/2 的表達，從而抑制促肥大的 MAPK 訊號。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 ERK1/2 抑制的上游。減少的 ERK 訊號限制了心臟和血管中的生長和纖維化反應，並為 SIRT6 的心血管保護增添了 MAPK 調節維度。透過直接控制 ERK1/2 基因本身的表達（而不僅僅是其活性），SIRT6 對此促生長通路提供了持久的抑制，與其在心臟肥大中抑制 IGF-Akt 訊號的作用互補。

label: Nigrostriatal System
description: Addiction and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Addiction and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Cancer Stem Cells
description: Glioblastoma stem-like cells (GSCs) drive therapy resistance and recurrence.
description_zh_TW: 膠質母細胞瘤幹細胞樣細胞 (GSCs) 驅動治療抵抗和復發。

label: Neutrophils
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Neutrophils are white blood cells that generate large quantities of reactive oxygen species, primarily superoxide anion and hydroxyl radicals, during the respiratory burst that accompanies infection and inflammation. This burst is the basis of their microbicidal activity but also mediates non-specific oxidation reactions, including the conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome both intracellularly and extracellularly. Neutrophil-derived oxidants also include hydrogen peroxide and products of myeloperoxidase. In the lungs and other tissues flooded by neutrophils during conditions such as pneumonia, ARDS, COPD exacerbations, and acute lung injury, this ROS production makes epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation a prominent local reaction.
description_zh_TW: 中性球是在感染與發炎伴隨的呼吸爆發期間產生大量活性氧物種（主要為超氧陰離子與羥基自由基）的白血球。此爆發是其殺微生物活性的基礎，但也介導非特異性氧化反應，包括在細胞內與細胞外將 epinephrine 轉化為 adrenochrome。中性球衍生的氧化劑也包括過氧化氫與 myeloperoxidase 的產物。在肺炎、ARDS、COPD 急性惡化與急性肺損傷等情況下被中性球淹沒的肺部與其他組織中，此 ROS 產生使 epinephrine 至 adrenochrome 的氧化成為顯著的局部反應。

label: Glutathione Peroxidase
description: Intracellular AGE modification of proteins reduces the activity of several antioxidant enzymes, including glutathione peroxidase, catalase, and glutathione reductase. Glutathione peroxidase normally reduces hydrogen peroxide and lipid peroxides using glutathione, and its inhibition by glycation increases cellular oxidative stress. These alterations of antioxidant enzyme activities contribute to the pro-oxidant state seen in aging and diabetic tissues, and represent one mechanism by which glycation impairs cellular function. This is distinct from the extracellular cross-linking and RAGE-mediated effects of AGEs.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質的 intracellular AGE modification 降低多種 antioxidant enzymes 的活性，包括 glutathione peroxidase、catalase 與 glutathione reductase。Glutathione peroxidase 通常使用 glutathione 來 reduce hydrogen peroxide 與 lipid peroxides，其受 glycation 抑制會增加細胞 oxidative stress。這些 antioxidant enzyme activities 的 alterations 促成 aging 與 diabetic tissues 中可見的 pro-oxidant state，並代表 glycation impairs cellular function 的一種機制。這不同於 AGEs 的 extracellular cross-linking 與 RAGE-mediated effects。

label: LKB1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: SIRT1 deacetylates LKB1, triggering its translocation from nucleus to cytoplasm where it phosphorylates and activates AMPK, alleviating oxidative stress. Because LKB1 is the master upstream AMPK kinase, SIRT1-dependent LKB1 relocalization is a key route by which sirtuin activity engages the energy sensor, reinforcing the SIRT1-AMPK reciprocal loop and linking sirtuin signaling to AMPK-dependent catabolism, autophagy, and mitochondrial biogenesis. The relationship is context-dependent, reflecting reciprocal regulation of the energy-sensing axes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 LKB1，觸發其從細胞核轉位到細胞質，在此處磷酸化並活化 AMPK，減輕氧化壓力。由於 LKB1 是主要的上游 AMPK 激酶，SIRT1 依賴性的 LKB1 重新定位是 sirtuin 活性參與能量感測器的關鍵途徑，強化 SIRT1-AMPK 互惠迴路並將 sirtuin 信號與 AMPK 依賴性的分解代謝、自噬和粒線體生物合成聯繫起來。此關係取決於情境，反映了能量感知軸的互惠調節。

label: Tubulin
description: SIRT1 deacetylates α-tubulin (confidence ~0.9 in the source review), a direct substrate edge recovered by the node analysis as part of the sirtuin target/substrate catalogue.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 α-tubulin（來源回顧中置信度約 0.9），是節點分析從 sirtuin 受質目錄中還原的直接受質邊。

label: ATM
description: ATM phosphorylates TRIM28/KAP1 at Ser824 in response to DNA double-strand breaks (and also during mitosis), a modification that relaxes chromatin and licenses the DDR functions of KAP1. In the SIRT1-stability axis, ATM activity restrains SIRT1 destruction: the ATM inhibitor KU-55933 lowered pATM(Ser1981) and pKAP1(Ser824), accelerated SIRT1 cleavage and degradation, and increased cell death — effects that were absent in TRIM28-knockout cells, establishing the ATM-TRIM28-SIRT1 signaling axis.
description_zh_TW: ATM 會在 DNA 雙股斷裂時（有絲分裂期間亦然）將 TRIM28/KAP1 的 Ser824 磷酸化，此修飾可鬆弛染色質並賦予 KAP1 在 DNA 損傷反應中的功能。在 SIRT1 穩定性軸線中，ATM 活性會抑制 SIRT1 的破壞：ATM 抑制劑 KU-55933 降低了 pATM(Ser1981) 與 pKAP1(Ser824)，加速 SIRT1 的切割與降解並增加細胞死亡——這些效應在 TRIM28 基因敲除細胞中消失，確立了 ATM-TRIM28-SIRT1 訊號軸。

label: Senolytic Therapy
description: Tumor Microenvironment is targeted by Senolytic Therapy. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. Senolytic therapy selectively eliminates senescent cells to remove their SASP and has been explored to blunt therapy-induced relapse. The directionality runs from Senolytic Therapy toward Tumor Microenvironment, so Senolytic Therapy is the active agent and Tumor Microenvironment the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Tumor Microenvironment 的目標是 Senolytic Therapy。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。 Senolytic 療法選擇性地消除衰老細胞以消除其SASP，並已被探索用於抑制治療引起的復發。方向性從 Senolytic Therapy 朝向 Tumor Microenvironment，因此 Senolytic Therapy 是活性劑，Tumor Microenvironment 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Substantia Nigra
description: The striatum receives dopamine from the substantia nigra pars compacta via the nigrostriatal pathway, the loss of which characterizes Parkinson's disease. This dopaminergic input is terminated mainly by DAT reuptake and shaped by COMT, especially in lower-DAT compartments, and is essential for normal striatal and motor function. The integrity of this projection is required for coordinated movement and reward processing. Its degeneration produces the cardinal motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體透過黑質紋狀體途徑從黑質緻密部接收多巴胺，多巴胺的喪失是帕金森氏症的特徵。這種多巴胺能輸入主要由 DAT 再攝取終止，並由 COMT 塑造，特別是在低 DAT 區室中，對於正常紋狀體和運動功能至關重要。協調 movement 和 reward 處理需要此投影的完整性。它的退化產生了帕金森氏症的主要運動症狀。

label: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine
description: Adrenochrome is an intermediate for adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, a hemostatic agent formed when aminoguanidine reacts with the freshly generated adrenochrome. This hydrazone derivative both stabilizes the chemically unstable adrenochrome and serves as a useful medicine. Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine obtained by the bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process is far less colored than that prepared by the method using potassium ferricyanide, and its identity is confirmed by UV absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅是腎上腺紅單胺基胍的中間體，後者為胺基胍與新鮮生成的腎上腺紅反應所形成的止血劑。此腙衍生物既能穩定化學上不穩定的腎上腺紅，又可用作有用的藥物。經鉍催化過硫酸鹽法所得的腎上腺紅單胺基胍，其色澤遠低於以鐵氰化鉀法製備者，其身份經348 nm和445 nm的紫外線吸收極大值確認。

label: PI3K
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Urolithin A regulates protein synthesis and growth of muscle cells by inhibiting specific regulatory factors within the mTOR signaling pathway, such as PI3K (phosphoinositide 3-kinase) and AKT (protein kinase B). The literature demonstrates that urolithin A inhibits mTOR by first inhibiting PI3K and then AKT. Downregulation of PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling underlies several of urolithin A's reported anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and pro-autophagic effects, and it supports muscle growth while maintaining muscle quality.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 透過抑制 mTOR 訊息傳遞路徑中的特定調節因子（如 PI3K (phosphoinositide 3-kinase) 與 AKT (protein kinase B)）來調節肌肉細胞的蛋白質合成與生長。文獻顯示 urolithin A 先抑制 PI3K 再抑制 AKT，從而抑制 mTOR。PI3K-AKT-mTOR 訊號的下調，是 urolithin A 被報導的數項抗發炎、代謝與促自噬效應的基礎，並在維持肌肉品質的同時支持肌肉生長。

label: STAT3
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: SIRT1 deacetylates STAT3 as part of its broad anti-inflammatory and metabolic regulatory functions, altering STAT3-driven transcription. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically tunes STAT3. Because STAT3 drives proliferation and inflammation, its deacetylation influences cytokine signaling and cell growth, and the effect is relevant to both cancer and chronic inflammation. The evidence for this regulation carries moderate confidence, reflecting incomplete characterization. By modifying STAT3, SIRT1 provides another route to restrain inflammatory and growth-promoting transcription, complementing its actions on NF-κB.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 作為其廣泛的抗發炎和代謝調節功能的一部分去乙醯化 STAT3，改變 STAT3 驅動的轉錄。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式調節 STAT3。由於 STAT3 驅動增殖和發炎，其去乙醯化影響細胞因子訊號和細胞生長，此效應與癌症和慢性發炎都相關。此調控的證據具有中等信心，反映了不完全的表徵。透過修飾 STAT3，SIRT1 提供了另一條抑制發炎和促生長轉錄的途徑，與其對 NF-κB 的作用互補。

label: Osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions, including osteoarthritis (arthritis), poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's or Parkinson's. The pro-inflammatory factors that senescent cells secrete into surrounding tissues promote tissue dysfunction and disease development, contributing to the joint degeneration seen in arthritis. The Salk findings suggest that making senescent cells vulnerable to ferroptosis through acid ceramidase could provide a novel target for therapeutics applicable to a multitude of diseases and disorders, including arthritis. Senescent cells are considered a hallmark of aging, and clearing them is a major goal of senolytic research for extending healthspan.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括骨關節炎（關節炎）、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症或帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病。衰老細胞分泌至周圍組織的促發炎因子會促進組織功能障礙與疾病發展，促成關節炎中所見的關節退化。Salk團隊的發現顯示，透過酸性神經醯胺酶使衰老細胞易受鐵依賴性細胞死亡影響，可為適用於多種疾病與障礙（包括關節炎）的療法提供新穎標靶。衰老細胞被視為衰老的特徵之一，清除它們是延長健康壽命之衰老細胞清除研究的主要目標。

label: Antioxidant Properties
description: Creatine is reported to exert antioxidant effects, scavenging reactive oxygen and nitrogen species and stabilizing membranes, effects that are proposed to protect tissues from oxidative damage. Some studies suggest creatine supplementation reduces markers of oxidative stress and muscle damage after intense exercise, and experimental work indicates creatine can directly scavenge superoxide and peroxynitrite in vitro. Because oxidative stress contributes to DNA damage and tumor promotion, creatine's antioxidant capacity is cited in the trace as one possible mechanism for an anti-cancer effect, although direct evidence linking creatine's antioxidant action to cancer prevention in humans is lacking.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸據報導具有抗氧化作用，可清除活性氧與活性氮物種並穩定細胞膜，這些作用被認為能保護組織免受氧化損傷。部分研究顯示，補充肌酸可降低劇烈運動後的氧化壓力與肌肉損傷指標，而實驗研究亦指出肌酸在體外能直接清除超氧化物與過氧亞硝酸鹽。由於氧化壓力會促成 DNA 損傷與腫瘤促進，肌酸的抗氧化能力在該追蹤中被引述為抗癌作用的可能機制之一，儘管目前缺乏直接證據將肌酸的抗氧化作用與人類癌症預防連結起來。

label: DNA Repair
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
