description: SIRT6 functions in DNA repair; as the nuclear/chromatin sirtuin it guards genome integrity, telomeres, metabolism, and inflammation (Mostoslavsky 2006; Mao 2011 PMID 21680843). It is a core DNA double-strand-break repair factor: recruited to DSBs, it deacetylates H3K9/H3K56 and CtIP and stimulates PARP1 to promote homologous recombination and genomic stability (Kaidi et al., 2010, PMC2943420).
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 參與 DNA 修復功能；作為細胞核/染色質 sirtuin，它維護基因組完整性、端粒、代謝和發炎調控（Mostoslavsky 2006; Mao 2011 PMID 21680843）。SIRT6 是 DNA 雙股斷裂修復的核心因子：被招募至 DSB 處後，它去乙醯化 H3K9/H3K56 及 CtIP，並刺激 PARP1 促進同源重組及基因組穩定性（Kaidi et al., 2010, PMC2943420）。

label: Caspase-8
description: In the extrinsic (death receptor) pathway, FasL or TNF-α engagement assembles the DISC, activating initiator caspase-8 (with caspase-10), which directly cleaves the executioner caspase-3 in type I cells. In type II cells caspase-8 instead cleaves Bid, routing through mitochondria. Caspase-8 sits at the crossroads of apoptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis because its active form also cleaves RIPK1 and RIPK3, preventing necroptosis — so caspase-8-to-caspase-3 flow is simultaneously a death signal and a necroptosis suppressor.
description_zh_TW: 在外在（死亡受體）路徑中，FasL 或 TNF-α 的結合組裝出 DISC，活化起始 caspase-8（與 caspase-10），其在 type I 細胞中直接切割執行者 Caspase-3；在 type II 細胞中 caspase-8 則切割 Bid，改經粒線體路徑。Caspase-8 位於細胞凋亡、程序性壞死與細胞焦亡的十字路口，因為其活化形式也會切割 RIPK1 與 RIPK3 從而阻止程序性壞死——因此 caspase-8 至 Caspase-3 的流動既是死亡訊號，也是程序性壞死的抑制者。

label: Tau
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue has documented effects on tau protein aggregation, the kind of buildup linked to Alzheimer's disease. These tau-modifying effects derive primarily from cell studies and are mechanistically interesting but do not constitute clinical evidence - the article emphasizes that a cell study is not a clinical trial, and there are no solid human data supporting long-term cognitive protection or Alzheimer's prevention in healthy adults. While tau aggregation data are promising, this remains an area where the internet's claims outpace the evidence base, and the human translation is unproven. This illustrates the general caution that most mechanistic methylene blue evidence comes from cell cultures and rodents.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍對 tau 蛋白聚集有 documented 影響，這種積累與阿爾茨海默病相關。這些 tau 修改效果主要來自細胞研究，機制上有趣但不構成臨床證據——文章強調細胞研究不是臨床試驗，沒有堅實的人類數據支持長期認知保護或健康成人的阿爾茨海默病預防。雖然 tau 聚集數據有希望，但這仍是一個網路聲稱超過證據基礎的領域，人類轉化尚未證實。這說明了大多數機制性亞甲基藍證據來自細胞培養和囓齒動物的普遍 caution。

label: PGAM5
description: Through its mitophagy arm, PGAM5 protects cells from necroptosis: it stabilizes PINK1 on damaged mitochondria and supports the RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 fission route that segregates damaged mitochondria for clearance. Inhibition of PGAM5 in rat hearts following ischemia-reperfusion reduced necroptosis via Drp1 suppression, and PGAM5 is described as an important regulator of PINK1-dependent mitophagy. The protection holds under mild damage; under severe RIPK3 activation the same protein serves the necrosome instead.
description_zh_TW: 透過其粒線體自噬臂，PGAM5 保護細胞免於程序性壞死：它將 PINK1 穩定在受損粒線體上，並支持隔離受損粒線體以供清除的 RIPK3-PGAM5-Drp1 分裂路徑。在缺血再灌注後的大鼠心臟中，抑制 PGAM5 藉由 Drp1 的壓制而減少程序性壞死，且 PGAM5 被視為 PINK1 依賴性粒線體自噬的重要調節者。此保護作用在輕度損傷下成立；在強烈的 RIPK3 活化下，同一蛋白反而服務於 necrosome。

label: ELK4
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The ETS-family transcription factor ELK4 interacts with SIRT7 and stabilizes the deacetylase at target gene promoters, allowing SIRT7 to deacetylate histone H3 at lysine 18 and repress tumor-suppressor genes. This tethering is required to maintain cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, ELK4-bound promoter occupancy precedes SIRT7-dependent H3K18 deacetylation. SIRT7 depletion accordingly reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, highlighting the ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 axis as an oncogenic regulatory circuit.
description_zh_TW: ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 SIRT7 能去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。這種錨定對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等癌症特徵是必需的。方向性上 ELK4 結合的啟動子占據先於 SIRT7 依賴的 H3K18 去乙醯化。SIRT7 的耗竭相應地降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，凸顯 ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 軸線作為致癌性調控迴路的重要性。

label: Microgliosis
description: Microglia and Microgliosis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Microglia and Microgliosis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Microglia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Microglia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Adenosylcobalamin
description: Adenosylcobalamin is one of two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12 (cobalamin), alongside methylcobalamin, serving as an essential cofactor for mitochondrial enzymes in the methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolic pathways. Unlike methylcobalamin, it does not donate a methyl group directly to the methylation cycle, so it does not contribute to the body's methyl burden. This distinction makes adenosylcobalamin particularly relevant for individuals with slow COMT activity, who may be sensitive to methyl-donating B12 forms.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12（鈷胺素）的兩種活性輔酶形式之一，與甲鈷胺一起，作為蛋氨酸和甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 代謝途徑中線粒體酶的重要輔助因子。與甲鈷胺不同，它不會直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基，因此不會增加人體的甲基負擔。這種區別使得腺苷鈷胺素對於 COMT activity 緩慢的個體特別重要，他們可能對甲基供體 B12 形式敏感。

label: Methylfolate
description: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

label: Modafinil
description: Modafinil is a wakefulness-promoting agent approved for narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea-related sleepiness, and shift-work sleep disorder, acting via dopamine transporter inhibition and orexin system modulation. It improves daytime alertness and reduces excessive sleepiness with a lower abuse liability than classical psychostimulants such as amphetamines. Its efficacy provides the clinical anchor for its off-label cognitive and nootropic uses. It is a key tool in sleep medicine and in performance-enhancement contexts.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 是一種覺醒促進劑，被批准用於治療 narcolepsy、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症相關的嗜睡和輪班工作睡眠障礙，透過多巴胺轉運蛋白抑制和食慾素系統調節發揮作用。它可以提高白天的警覺性並減少過度嗜睡，並且比安非他明等經典精神興奮劑的濫用可能性更低。其功效為其標籤外認知和 nootropic 用途提供了臨床依據。它是睡眠醫學和提高表現的關鍵工具。

label: Hydroxocobalamin
description: Hydroxocobalamin is a precursor to the two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12, methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, being intracellularly reduced and alkylated to whichever coenzyme is required. This makes it a versatile B12 source that supports both the methylation cycle, via methylcobalamin for methionine synthase, and mitochondrial energy metabolism, via adenosylcobalamin for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Its precursor status distinguishes it from the directly active methyl-donating form, allowing physiological regulation of coenzyme production. This flexibility underlies its clinical use in B12 repletion.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是兩種活性輔酶形式維生素 B12（甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素）的前體，在細胞內還原並烷基化為所需的輔酶。這使其成為多功能 B12 來源，可透過甲硫胺酸合成酶的甲基鈷胺素支持 methylation cycle，並透過甲基丙二酸單醯輔酶 A 變位酶的腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。其前驅狀態使其有別於直接活性的甲基供體形式，從而可以對輔酶產生進行生理調節。這種靈活性是其在補充 B12 方面的臨床應用的基礎。

label: MXL-3
description: In C. elegans, the MAX-like transcription factor MXL-3 represses transcription of lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) when food is abundant, limiting lipid mobilization. This repression maintains lipid storage under fed conditions and is relieved during fasting, allowing lipolysis. MXL-3 thus acts as a nutritional gatekeeper of lysosomal lipid catabolism, analogous to MYC's repression of lysosomal programs in mammals. Its activity positions lipid degradation within the broader nutrient-responsive regulatory network.
description_zh_TW: 在線蟲 C. elegans 中，MAX 樣轉錄因子 MXL-3 在食物充裕時抑制溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的轉錄，限制脂質動員。此抑制在進食條件下維持脂質儲存，並在禁食期間解除，允許脂解作用。因此 MXL-3 作為溶酶體脂質分解代謝的營養閘門，類似於 MYC 在哺乳動物中對溶酶體程序的抑制。其活性將脂質降解定位於更廣泛的營養反應性調節網絡中。

label: Physical Activity
description: The doubly labelled water (DLW) technique is the gold-standard method for measuring total daily energy expenditure and the physical activity component of the energy budget in free-living humans. Subjects drink water labeled with the stable isotopes deuterium and oxygen-18; carbon dioxide production is calculated from the differential loss rates of the two isotopes, and energy expenditure is derived using standard equations. In the studies reviewed by Speakman, DLW has been used to quantify total daily energy expenditure (TEE) over 7-14 day periods, showing that within-individual day-to-day variability of TEE is small even when physical activity varies.
description_zh_TW: 雙標記水（DLW）技術是測量自由生活人類每日總能量支出和能量預算中體力活動成分的黃金標準方法。受試者飲用含有穩定同位素氘和氧-18標記的水；二氧化碳產生量根據兩種同位素的差異損失率計算，能量支出使用標準方程式得出。在Speakman回顧的研究中，DLW被用於量化7-14天期間的每日總能量支出（TEE），顯示即使體力活動變化，個體內每日TEE變異性也很小。

label: Methylation
description: Methylation is the biochemical transfer of a methyl group (-CH3) from a donor such as S-adenosylmethionine to an acceptor molecule, DNA, proteins, lipids, or small metabolites like catechols. This covalent modification alters the chemical properties, activity, or signaling of the target without changing its carbon skeleton, enabling regulation of gene expression, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. COMT-catalyzed catechol methylation is a classic example within neurotransmitter metabolism. Methylation is thus a universal regulatory and detoxifying mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

label: LXRα
description: ABCA1 is regulated by LXRalpha, as the nuclear receptor directly drives ABCA1 transcription in response to oxysterol ligands, coordinating cholesterol efflux. This places ABCA1 downstream of LXR-controlled reverse-cholesterol-transport programs. The directionality is LXRalpha activation to ABCA1 expression. A caveat is that PPARgamma and other transcription factors also regulate ABCA1, so LXRalpha is a major but not exclusive controller. This LXR-ABCA1 axis is also redox-responsive, since oxidative modifications of LDL generate LXR ligands that upregulate the transporter as a protective response.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 受 LXRalpha 調節，因為核受體響應氧甾醇配體直接驅動 ABCA1 轉錄，協調 cholesterol 流出。這將 ABCA1 置於 LXR 控制的反向 cholesterol 傳輸程式的下游。方向性是LXRalpha活化至ABCA1表達。需要注意的是，PPARgamma 和其他轉錄因子也調節 ABCA1，因此 LXRalpha 是主要但不是唯一的控制者。此 LXR-ABCA1 軸也具有氧化還原反應性，因為 LDL 的氧化修飾會產生 LXR 配體，從而上調轉運蛋白作為保護性反應。

label: Nitrative Stress
description: Peroxynitrite causes nitrative stress by oxidizing and nitrating biomolecules, most characteristically forming 3-nitrotyrosine on proteins, an irreversible modification that can inactivate enzymes. It also nitrates nucleic acids and lipids, broadening its toxic footprint. The directionality is hybrid oxidant to nitrative modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can also arise from other nitrating species such as myeloperoxidase-derived species, so it is not exclusively peroxynitrite-specific.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過氧化和硝化生物分子產生 nitrative stress，最典型的是在 proteins 上形成 3-nitrotyrosine，這是一種可以使酵素失去活性的不可逆修飾。它還會硝酸化 nucleic acids 和脂質，從而擴大其毒性足跡。方向性是混合氧化劑與硝化改質。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 也可以由其他硝化物質產生，例如 myeloperoxidase 衍生物質，因此它並不完全是 peroxynitrite 特有的。

label: SIRT1 and SIRT2
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Nicotinamide, a product of the sirtuin deacetylation reaction itself, is a micromolar non-competitive inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 that interacts with the C (nicotinamide) pocket of the catalytic site. It was one of the first endogenous compounds studied as a sirtuin inhibitor and inspired the search for NAD+ and nicotinamide analogs. SIRT1 inhibition with nicotinamide was reported to have anticancer activity in B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia and prostate cancer. Its limitations, and those of NAD+ analogs, lie in modest potency and limited therapeutic potential, which motivated development of more potent scaffolds.
description_zh_TW: 尼可醯胺是 sirtuin 去乙醯化反應本身的產物，是 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的微摩爾級非競爭性抑制劑，與催化位點的 C（尼可醯胺）口袋相互作用。它是最早被研究作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的內源性化合物之一，並啟發了 NAD+ 和尼可醯胺類似物的搜索。利用尼可醯胺抑制 SIRT1 據報導在 B 細胞慢性淋巴性白血病和前列腺癌中具有抗癌活性。其局限性，以及 NAD+ 類似物的局限性，在於效能有限和治療潛力不足，這促進了更強效骨架結構的開發。

label: Myeloperoxidase
description: Myeloperoxidase is a heme enzyme released by activated neutrophils during inflammation and the respiratory burst. It catalyzes the oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, contributing to adrenochrome formation at inflammatory sites. This enzyme-assisted route operates alongside purely radical-driven oxidation by superoxide and hydroxyl radicals, and it is one reason the adrenochrome pathway is a feature of neutrophil-mediated oxidative stress in inflamed or infected tissues rather than normal metabolism. Myeloperoxidase-derived oxidants can also generate additional reactive oxygen species, further favoring catecholamine oxidation and the generation of aminochromes including adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase 是一種由活化中性球在發炎與呼吸爆發期間釋放的含血基質酶。它催化 adrenaline 氧化為 adrenochrome，促成發炎部位的 adrenochrome 形成。此酶輔助途徑與超氧陰離子及羥基自由基純粹自由基驅動的氧化並行作用，也是 adrenochrome 途徑成為發炎或感染組織中中性球介導氧化壓力特徵、而非正常代謝的原因。Myeloperoxidase 衍生的氧化劑也能產生額外的活性氧物種，進一步促進兒茶酚胺氧化與包括 adrenochrome 在內的 aminochromes 生成。

label: Mitochondrial Fission
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Because autophagosomes in mammalian cells are approximately 500-1500 nm, a large interconnected mitochondrial network must be broken up by fission before mitophagy can occur, and the degradation of fusion- or fission-related factors is required for mitophagy. DRP1-mediated fission promotes mitophagy: inhibition of DRP1 reduces Parkin-mediated mitophagy, and asymmetric fission produces a small dysfunctional fragment that is prevented from fusing and subsequently engulfed and degraded. However, DRP1 is not always necessary for mitophagy, since some reports show that cardiac-specific DRP1 knockout mice maintain mitophagy and that FIS1 can mediate mitophagy independently.
description_zh_TW: 由於哺乳動物細胞中的自噬體直徑約為500-1500奈米，大型互連的線粒體網絡必須先透過分裂破碎，線粒體自噬才能發生，且融合或分裂相關因子的降解也是線粒體自噬所必需的。DRP1介導的分裂促進線粒體自噬：抑制DRP1會減少Parkin介導的線粒體自噬，而不對稱分裂會產生一個功能異常的小片段，該片段無法融合隨後被吞噬和降解。然而，DRP1並非線粒體自噬所必需，因為一些報告顯示心臟特異性DRP1基因敲除小鼠仍能維持線粒體自噬，且FIS1可以獨立介導線粒體自噬。

label: PPARα
description: PPARα positively drives FSP1 expression; PPARα activators such as fenofibrate and bezafibrate raise FSP1 levels and increase ferroptosis resistance. Conversely, the MDM2/MDMX complex suppresses FSP1 by inhibiting PPARα activity, lowering FSP1 and sensitizing cells to ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: PPARα 正向驅動 FSP1 的表現；PPARα 活化劑如 fenofibrate 與 bezafibrate 會提升 FSP1 含量並增加鐵死亡抗性。相反地，MDM2/MDMX 複合物透過抑制 PPARα 活性來壓低 FSP1，使細胞對鐵死亡更敏感。

label: Tyrosinase
description: Melanogenesis and Tyrosinase are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Melanogenesis and Tyrosinase may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Melanogenesis 和 Tyrosinase 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Melanogenesis 和 Tyrosinase 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: DNMT3b
description: DNMT3a forms functional complexes with its paralog DNMT3b and with the accessory protein DNMT3L to deposit methylation at targeted loci. The two de novo methyltransferases share sequence homology but exhibit distinct genomic targeting preferences, with DNMT3b favoring repetitive elements while DNMT3a acts more broadly across gene bodies and intergenic regions. Their cooperative activity is critical during early embryogenesis for establishing the genome-wide methylation patterns that are subsequently maintained by DNMT1, and both are essential for normal development.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 與其旁系同源物 DNMT3b 和輔助蛋白 DNMT3L 形成功能複合物，在目標位點沉積甲基化。這兩種從頭甲基轉移酶具有序列同源性，但表現出不同的基因組靶向偏好，其中 DNMT3b 有利於重複元件，而 DNMT3a 在基因體和基因間區域中發揮更廣泛的作用。它們的合作活動在早期胚胎髮生過程中對於建立隨後由 DNMT1 維持的全基因組甲基化模式至關重要，並且兩者對於正常發育都是必需的。

label: mTORC2
description: Rapamycin-induced mTORC2 inhibition has been shown to induce insulin resistance, highlighting a mechanistic trade-off between metabolic side effects and longevity benefits. While rapamycin's canonical target is mTORC1, chronic exposure also suppresses mTORC2, and this unintended suppression - rather than mTORC1 inhibition alone - mediates the glucose intolerance and insulin resistance observed in mice and humans. Lamming et al. demonstrated that rapamycin-induced insulin resistance is mediated by mTORC2 loss and is uncoupled from longevity.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin誘導的mTORC2抑制已被證明會誘發胰島素阻抗，突顯了代謝副作用和壽命益處之間的機制權衡。雖然rapamycin的典型靶點是mTORC1，但長期暴露也會抑制mTORC2，這種意外抑制——而非僅僅mTORC1抑制——介導了在小鼠和人類中觀察到的葡萄糖不耐症和胰島素阻抗。Lamming等人證明rapamycin誘導的胰島素阻抗是由mTORC2缺失介導的，並且與壽命解偶聯。

label: Heart Rate Variability
description: The sympathetic nervous system is the fight, flight, or freeze branch of the autonomic nervous system. It releases adrenaline and cortisol to prepare the body for action during events such as a HIIT workout, cold plunge, or fasting. When the SNS is active, it forces the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, thereby lowering HRV. Chronic sympathetic dominance keeps the system stuck in the on position, producing a chronically depressed HRV that signals under-recovery and overtraining rather than adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 交感神經系統是自主神經系統的戰鬥、逃跑或凍結分支。它釋放腎上腺素和皮質醇，使身體在HIIT鍛煉、冷水浸泡或禁食等事件期間準備行動。當SNS活躍時，它迫使心臟跳動更快、更規律，從而降低HRV。慢性交感神經主導地位使系統卡在開啟位置，產生慢性抑鬱的HRV，表示恢復不足和過度訓練而非適應。

label: Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells
description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are a heterogeneous population of immature myeloid cells with potent immunosuppressive activity, expanded under pathological stress including cancer and chronic inflammation. Their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state rather than a single lineage, with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets recognized. In senescence contexts, MDSCs are recruited by SASP factors and blunt anti-tumor and anti-senescence immunity, shifting the immune balance away from clearance. They represent a key immunosuppressive cell type bridging aging, inflammation, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: MDSCs（骨髓源性抑制細胞）是一群異質、未成熟骨髓細胞，在發炎與癌症中擴張並具免疫抑制功能。其歸類為未成熟骨髓細胞將其定位於骨髓生成與免疫調節的交會點，且其在衰老中重要性上升。在衰老脈絡中，MDSC 累積貢獻免疫抑制與監視受損。其未成熟本質使其對發炎細胞激素與趨化因子高度反應，成為衰老相關免疫逃脫的關鍵角色。

label: XIAP
description: Intrinsic Pathway is inhibited by XIAP. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Intrinsic Pathway, so XIAP is the active agent and Intrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 被XIAP 抑制。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Intrinsic Pathway，因此 XIAP 是活性劑，Intrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Hypochlorous acid
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) uses hydrogen peroxide as a substrate to catalyze the two-electron oxidation of halides, mainly chloride, into hypohalous acids, with the primary reaction converting chloride to hypochlorous acid (HOCl): MPO + H2O2 + Cl- produces HOCl + H2O. Hypochlorous acid is a potent antimicrobial oxidant that damages microbial proteins, lipids, and DNA, and this halogenation cycle is central to the neutrophil's oxidative burst. The same oxidant can damage host tissues when released in excess, linking MPO to tissue injury, atherosclerosis, and chronic inflammatory diseases.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）以hydrogen peroxide為substrate，催化halides（mainly chloride）的two-electron oxidation生成hypohalous acids，其主要reaction將chloride轉化為hypochlorous acid（HOCl）：MPO + H2O2 + Cl- produces HOCl + H2O。Hypochlorous acid是一種potent antimicrobial oxidant，可damages microbial proteins、lipids與DNA，此halogenation cycle是neutrophil's oxidative burst的核心。當此oxidant過量released時，同樣會damages host tissues，將MPO與tissue injury、atherosclerosis及chronic inflammatory diseases聯繫起來。

label: FOXO
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: SIRT2 activates FOXO via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 FOXO（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: Glycation
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Flavonoids are the major class of polyphenols and possess anti-glycation properties. Anti-glycation activities of various flavonoids, such as kaempferol, genistein, quercitrin, and quercetin, have been reported, with potencies similar to or stronger than the reference AGE inhibitor aminoguanidine. These natural products with high antioxidant capacity inhibit protein glycation both in vitro and in vivo, and their anti-AGE activity may be one mechanism of their beneficial effects on human health. Herbal products rich in flavonoids are therefore investigated as safer alternatives to synthetic AGE inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: 類黃酮是多酚的主要類別，並具有抗糖化特性。各種類黃酮（如山奈酚、金雀異黃素、槲皮苷與槲皮素）的抗糖化活性已有文獻報導，其效力與參考用 AGE 抑制劑氨基胍相似或更強。這些具有高抗氧化能力的天然產物在體外與體內均能抑制蛋白質糖化，而其抗 AGE 活性可能是其對人體健康有益作用的機制之一。因此，富含類黃酮的草本產品被研究作為合成 AGE 抑制劑的更安全替代方案。

label: Free Radicals
description: Free radicals are reactive species bearing one or more unpaired electrons that are most often generated in biological systems as derivatives of oxygen (reactive oxygen species, ROS) or nitrogen (reactive nitrogen species, RNS). The unpaired electron makes them intrinsically unstable, driving them to abstract electrons from nearby molecules such as DNA, proteins, and lipids. This directionality, radicals attacking stable macromolecules, is the mechanistic basis of oxidative damage. A key caveat is that not all free radicals are harmful; at controlled low levels they serve as signaling intermediates, so the pathological state depends on concentration and antioxidant defense capacity.
description_zh_TW: Free radicals 是帶有一個或多個不成對電子的活性物質，通常在生物系統中作為氧（reactive oxygen species、ROS）或氮（reactive nitrogen species、RNS）的衍生物產生。不成對的電子使它們本質上不穩定，驅使它們從附近的分子（例如 DNA、proteins 和脂質）中奪取電子。這種自由基攻擊穩定大分子的方向性是氧化傷害的機制基礎。需要注意的是，並非所有 free radicals 都是有害的；在受控的低水平下，它們充當信號中間體，因此病理狀態取決於濃度和抗氧化防禦能力。

label: HMGB1
description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

label: HLA-E
description: HLA-E is a non-classical (class Ib) major histocompatibility complex molecule with limited polymorphism, presenting a restricted set of peptides, often leader peptides derived from other MHC class I molecules, to innate lymphoid receptors. Its classification distinguishes it from classical MHC class Ia molecules and underpins its specialized ligand-receptor interactions with NKG2A/CD94. In senescence, HLA-E upregulation becomes a mechanism of immune evasion that protects arrested cells from cytotoxic lymphocytes. The class Ib identity enables the checkpoint-like function central to its role in senescence surveillance.
description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是一種低多態性的非典型（class Ib）主要組織相容性複合體分子，呈現一組受限的肽，常為來自其他 MHC class I 分子的導肽，給先天淋巴受體。其分類區分它與典型 MHC class Ia 分子，並支撐其與 NKG2A/CD94 的特化配體—受體交互作用。在衰老中，HLA-E 上升成為保護停滯細胞對抗細胞毒性淋巴球的免疫逃脫機制。此 class Ib 身分啟用對其在衰老監視中角色至為核心的檢查點樣功能。

label: Bcl-2
description: Bad is a BH3-only sensitizer: rather than activating BAX/BAK directly, it displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family restraint (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1), indirectly liberating the effectors. IKK-mediated phosphorylation of Bad at Ser26 inactivates it and confers TNFα resistance, and the BH3 mimetic compounds act on the same principle — competitively disrupting Bcl-2/Bcl-xL binding to beclin-1 as well, which releases beclin-1 for autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Bad 是 BH3-only 的敏化因子：它不直接活化 BAX/BAK，而是置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族（Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1）的抑制，間接解放效應蛋白。IKK 對 Bad Ser26 的磷酸化會使其失活並賦予 TNFα 抗性；BH3 擬似劑也基於相同原理——競爭性破壞 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 與 beclin-1 的結合，同時釋出 beclin-1 以促進自噬。

label: Regulatory T cells
description: SIRT1 in dendritic cells modulates the balance between pro-inflammatory Th1 and anti-inflammatory Foxp3+ regulatory T (Treg) cells; its knockout restrains Treg generation. Directionally, DC SIRT1 sits upstream of Treg differentiation. This shapes peripheral tolerance and limits autoimmunity, and DC-specific SIRT1 loss drives Th1 polarization and promotes inflammation. It links sirtuins to immune homeostasis beyond metabolism, showing that SIRT1 activity in antigen-presenting cells influences the outcome of T-cell responses. This immunoregulatory role is relevant to autoimmune disease, where tipping the balance toward Tregs is protective.
description_zh_TW: 樹突細胞中的 SIRT1 調節促發炎 Th1 和抗發炎 Foxp3+ 調節性 T（Treg）細胞之間的平衡；其敲除限制 Treg 生成。在方向性上，DC SIRT1 位於 Treg 分化的上游。這塑造周邊耐受並限制自體免疫，DC 特異性 SIRT1 的缺失驅動 Th1 偏向並促進發炎。這將 sirtuin 與超越代謝的免疫穩態聯繫起來，表明抗原呈遞細胞中的 SIRT1 活性影響 T 細胞反應的結果。這種免疫調節角色與自體免疫疾病相關，在這些疾病中平衡向 Treg 偏向具有保護作用。

label: Ischemia-reperfusion Injury
description: Several laboratories have tested the protective effect of humanin on various types of stress or disease states, including myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury in mice and cerebral ischemia/reperfusion injury in rats, as well as focal cerebral ischemia in mice as a stroke model. Humanin also protects against familial ALS in mice expressing mutant SOD1, dexamethasone-induced apoptosis in rat Leydig cells, and IGFBP-3-induced apoptosis in cerebral endothelial cells. Many of these stressors and models have oxidative stress as a common mechanistic denominator, suggesting a specific oxidative-insult-related cytoprotective role of humanin.
description_zh_TW: 數個實驗室已測試 humanin 對各種壓力或疾病狀態的保護作用，包括小鼠的心肌缺血/再灌流損傷與大鼠的腦缺血/再灌流損傷，以及作為中風模型的小鼠局部腦缺血。Humanin 也保護表現突變 SOD1 的小鼠免於家族性 ALS、保護大鼠 Leydig 細胞免於地塞米松誘導的細胞凋亡，並保護腦內皮細胞免於 IGFBP-3 誘導的細胞凋亡。這些壓力源與模型中有許多以氧化壓力為共同的機制性分母，顯示 humanin 具有特定針對氧化傷害的細胞保護角色。

label: Sirtinol
description: Sirtinol inhibits SIRT1 with an IC50 of approximately 131 μM, preventing deacetylation of histones and non-histone targets. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of SIRT1 inhibition. It is the parent compound of salermide and a classic sirtuin research tool, and its weaker potency spurred development of more active derivatives. Sirtinol also inhibits SIRT2 with an IC50 of about 38-68 μM, showing comparable or stronger activity against SIRT2 than SIRT1. Its use established the sirtuin-inhibitor chemical scaffold on which more selective and potent compounds were later built.
description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 以約 131 μM 的 IC50 抑制 SIRT1，阻止組蛋白和非組蛋白靶標的去乙醯化。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於 SIRT1 抑制的上游。它是 salermide 的母體化合物和經典的 sirtuin 研究工具，其較弱的效力促進了更活性衍生物的開發。Sirtinol 也以約 38-68 μM 的 IC50 抑制 SIRT2，對 SIRT2 顯示相當或更強的活性。其使用確立了 sirtuin 抑制化學骨架，後來更選擇性和更強效的化合物在此基礎上建立。

label: Cambinol
description: Cambinol inhibits human SIRT1 with an IC50 of 56 μM by blocking access to both NAD+ and acetyl-lysine substrate-binding regions. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of SIRT1 inhibition. It also inhibits SIRT2 with an IC50 of 59 μM, with minimal activity against SIRT3 or class I/II HDACs, and it sensitizes cancer cells to chemotherapy and suppresses invasion. By targeting the catalytic pocket, Cambinol prevents both substrate binding and NAD+ utilization. Its dual SIRT1/2 inhibition reactivates pro-apoptotic programs in cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: Cambinol 以 IC50 56 μM 抑制人類 SIRT1，透過阻斷 NAD+ 和乙醯賴氨酸底物結合域的進入。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於 SIRT1 抑制的上游。它也以 IC50 59 μM 抑制 SIRT2，對 SIRT3 或 I/II 類 HDAC 活性極低，並使癌細胞對化療增敏及抑制侵襲。透過靶向催化口袋，Cambinol 阻止底物結合和 NAD+ 利用。其雙重 SIRT1/2 抑制重新活化癌細胞中的促凋亡程式。

label: Salermide
description: Salermide is a potent synthetic sirtuin inhibitor with improved potency against SIRT1 relative to the parent compound sirtinol. Directionally, Salermide blocks SIRT1 deacetylase activity. This reactivates proapoptotic genes silenced by SIRT1 in cancer, and it is a research and anticancer chemical probe. Salermide also potently inhibits SIRT2, broadening its sirtuin-blocking profile, and its improved potency made it a widely used tool for studying the consequences of SIRT1/2 inhibition in cancer biology. The compound's effects on apoptosis and senescence are attributed to its dual sirtuin inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 是一種強效的合成 sirtuin 抑制劑，對 SIRT1 具有相較於母體化合物 sirtinol 改善的抑制效力。在方向性上，Salermide 阻斷 SIRT1 去乙醯酶活性。這重新活化在癌細胞中被 SIRT1 沉默的促凋亡基因，是研究和抗癌化學探針。Salermide 也有效抑制 SIRT2，擴展其 sirtuin 阻斷譜，其改善的效力使其成為研究 SIRT1/2 抑制在癌症生物學中後果的廣泛使用工具。該化合物對凋亡和衰老的效應歸因於其雙重 sirtuin 抑制。

label: Iron
description: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent cell death pathway in which the accumulation of lipid peroxides becomes toxic to cells. Pam Maher, the Salk senior author, discovered the pathway and named it (originally 'oxytosis') in 2001. Healthy cells keep lipid peroxides at steady levels with the help of glutathione, an antioxidant that can stave off ferroptosis. Ferroptosis has been increasingly linked to neurodegeneration - Maher's lab recently reported that chronic iron overexposure in neurons makes them less resilient over time and more vulnerable to neurodegeneration - and targeting the pathway has become a promising therapeutic strategy for age-related diseases alongside senescence research.
description_zh_TW: Ferroptosis是一種依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，其中脂質過氧化物的累積對細胞產生毒性。Salk研究所的資深作者Pam Maher於2001年發現此途徑並加以命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。健康細胞在麩胱甘肽（一種可抵禦ferroptosis的抗氧化劑）的幫助下，將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平。Ferroptosis日益與神經退化相關——Maher的實驗室近期報告指出，神經元長期過度暴露於鐵會使其隨時間韌性下降，並更容易發生神經退化——而標靶此途徑已與衰老研究一同成為年齡相關疾病的具前景治療策略。

label: p16
description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

label: Activin A
description: Activin A is a homodimer of inhibin beta-A (INHBA) subunits and a member of the TGFbeta superfamily of cytokines. Like other family members, it signals through serine/threonine kinase receptors to regulate cell fate, proliferation, and inflammation. Its classification within the TGFbeta superfamily situates it among the SASP factors with paracrine arrest-inducing capacity, alongside TGF-beta1, BMP2, and GDF15. Activin A is a structurally defined ligand that is distinct from TGF-beta1 but shares functional overlap, particularly in inducing cell-cycle inhibitors in receiving cells during paracrine senescence.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 是 inhibin beta-A（INHBA）次單元的同源二聚體，且是 TGFbeta 細胞激素超家族的成員。如同其他家族成員，它經絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶受體訊號調節細胞命運、增殖與發炎。其歸類於 TGFbeta 超家族將它置於具旁分泌停滯誘發能力的 SASP 因子中，與 TGF-beta1、BMP2 與 GDF15 並列。Activin A 是結構上確立的配體，不同於 TGF-beta1 但具功能重疊，特別在旁分泌衰老中誘發受體細胞的細胞週期抑制因子。

label: Striatum
description: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

label: Cardiac Hypertrophy
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Through SIRT3 activation, honokiol reverses pathological cardiac hypertrophy and protects against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity in preclinical models. Directionally, honokiol activates SIRT3 to engage antihypertrophic and antioxidant programs. By activating mitochondrial defenses, it counters the oxidative and energetic deficits of failing myocardium and suppresses the ROS-driven signaling that sustains hypertrophic growth. This positions SIRT3 as a therapeutic node in heart failure, consistent with the observations that SIRT3-deficient mice develop severe hypertrophy and fibrosis while SIRT3-overexpressing mice are resistant to hypertrophy-inducing stimuli.
description_zh_TW: 通過 SIRT3 活化，厚朴酚在臨床前模型中逆轉病理性心臟肥大並保護對抗 doxorubicin 誘導的心臟毒性。在方向性上，厚朴酚活化 SIRT3 以啟動抗肥大和抗氧化程序。通過活化粒線體防禦，它對抗衰竭心肌的氧化和能量缺陷，並抑制維持肥大生長的 ROS 驅動信號。這將 SIRT3 定位為心臟衰竭的治療節點，與 SIRT3 缺乏小鼠發展嚴重肥大和纖維化而 SIRT3 過量表達小鼠對肥大誘導刺激具有抗性的觀察一致。

label: Oncogene-Induced Senescence
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: BRAF, particularly the oncogenic BRAF V600E mutant, induces oncogene-induced senescence when expressed at high levels in normal cells. Hyperactive BRAF signaling drives aberrant proliferation and DNA damage, which activates the DNA damage response and p53, triggering a permanent growth arrest that protects against malignant transformation. Cells in BRAF-induced senescence display the full senescence phenotype, including senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and the SASP, making this a key experimental model.
description_zh_TW: BRAF，特別是致癌 BRAF V600E 突變體，當在正常細胞中高水平表達時，會誘導癌基因誘導的衰老。過度活躍的 BRAF 訊號傳導會驅動異常增殖和 DNA 損傷，進而活化 DNA 損傷反應和 p53，引發永久性生長停滯，從而防止惡性轉化。 BRAF 誘導的衰老細胞表現出完整的衰老表型，包括衰老相關的異染色質灶和 SASP，使其成為關鍵的實驗模型。

label: Caspase-10
description: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: HIF-1α
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: SIRT6 represses hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha (HIF-1alpha) as a co-repressor (Zhong et al., 2010), suppressing downstream glycolytic and lipogenic programs and opposing the Warburg-like shift seen in cancer and aging. By limiting HIF-1alpha target transcription, SIRT6 favors oxidative metabolism and genomic stability, complementing its repression of c-MYC and its deacetylation of H3K9 and H3K56 at glycolytic promoters. Loss of SIRT6, seen in many cancer cell lines, derepresses glycolytic metabolism and supports tumor growth.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 作為共抑制因子抑制缺氧誘導因子 1alpha（HIF-1alpha）（Zhong et al., 2010），抑制下游糖解和脂肪生成程序，對抗在癌症和衰老中看到的類 Warburg 轉變。通過限制 HIF-1alpha 靶基因轉錄，SIRT6 偏向氧化代謝和基因組穩定性，與其對 c-MYC 的抑制以及對糖解啟動子處 H3K9 和 H3K56 的去乙醯化互補。SIRT6 的缺失（見於許多癌細胞系）解除對糖解代謝的抑制並支持腫瘤生長。

label: Mitochondrial Biogenesis
description: In mice on a high-calorie diet, resveratrol increases mitochondrial number and function, an effect accompanied by elevated SIRT1 and PGC-1α activity. This shift counters diet-induced metabolic dysfunction by improving oxidative capacity, increasing endurance, and protecting against the metabolic consequences of overnutrition. Directionally, resveratrol activates SIRT1/PGC-1α to drive mitochondrial biogenesis. The finding, from Baur and Sinclair's 2006 study in Cell, helped popularize resveratrol as a caloric-restriction mimetic against diet-induced obesity and demonstrated that a small molecule could reproduce key metabolic benefits of dietary restriction in mammals.
description_zh_TW: 在高熱量飲食小鼠中，白藜蘆醇增加粒線體數量和功能，這種效應伴隨著 SIRT1 和 PGC-1α 活性的升高。這種轉變通過提高氧化能力、增加耐力和保護對抗過度營養的代謝後果來對抗飲食誘導的代謝功能障礙。在方向性上，白藜蘆醇活化 SIRT1/PGC-1α 以驅動粒線體生物合成。這一發現來自 Baur 和 Sinclair 2006 年在 Cell 上的研究，幫助推廣白藜蘆醇作為熱量限制模擬物對抗飲食誘導的肥胖，並證明小分子可以在哺乳動物中重現飲食限制的關鍵代謝益處。

label: Caspase-2
description: 14-3-3ζ directly inhibits caspase-2 by binding it in a phosphorylation-dependent manner and protecting the Ser135 phosphorylation (deposited by CaMKII) that keeps the apical caspase inactive. This shield is acetylation-sensitive: 14-3-3ζ deacetylated by SIRT1 binds caspase-2 robustly, whereas acetylated 14-3-3ζ dissociates. In Xenopus egg extract, glucose-6-phosphate — which promotes caspase-2/14-3-3ζ binding — enhanced 14-3-3ζ-directed sirtuin activity, while sirtuin inhibition promoted 14-3-3ζ release and caspase-2 activation in both extract and human cells.
description_zh_TW: 14-3-3ζ 以磷酸化依賴方式直接結合 caspase-2 並保護維持其不活化狀態的 Ser135 磷酸化（由 CaMKII 負責），藉此抑制 caspase-2。此保護罩對乙醯化敏感：被 SIRT1 去乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 能穩固結合 caspase-2，而乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 則會解離。在非洲爪蟾卵萃取液中，可促進 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 結合的 glucose-6-phosphate 會增強 14-3-3ζ 導向的 sirtuin 活性；抑制 sirtuin 活性則促使 14-3-3ζ 釋出並活化 caspase-2（於萃取液與人類細胞皆然）。

label: Cisplatin
description: Cisplatin is a platinum-based chemotherapeutic whose efficacy is augmented when combined with intermittent fasting in both cellular and animal models. Fasting generates a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while many tumor cells remain vulnerable to platinum-DNA adduct formation. The improved therapeutic window reduces chemotherapy-associated toxicity while slowing tumor growth, suggesting a combinatorial strategy. These findings support IF as an adjunct to sensitize tumors and protect host tissue during cisplatin-based regimens.
description_zh_TW: Cisplatin是一種鉑類化療藥，在細胞和動物模型中與間歇性斷食合併使用時其療效增強。斷食產生一種差異性壓力抵抗，其中正常細胞進入保護性的、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而許多腫瘤細胞仍易受鉑—DNA加合物形成的影響。改善的治療窗口在減緩腫瘤生長的同時降低化療相關毒性，提示一種組合策略。這些發現支持將IF作為輔助手段，在以cisplatin為基礎的療程中增敏腫瘤並保護宿主組織。

label: SREBP-1c
description: SIRT6 improves systemic insulin sensitivity and prevents ectopic lipid accumulation by repressing the lipogenic transcription factor SREBP-1c. Repression of SREBP-1c inhibits fatty-acid synthesis in the liver and promotes oxidative disposal of lipids rather than storage. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of suppressed lipogenic gene programs. This keeps hepatic triglyceride production in check and limits fat deposition in tissues such as the liver and muscle. By opposing de novo lipogenesis, SIRT6 protects against hepatic steatosis, insulin resistance, and the metabolic sequelae of a chronic nutrient surplus.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過抑制脂肪生成轉錄因子SREBP-1c來改善全身胰島素敏感性並防止異位脂質積累。SREBP-1c的抑制阻礙了肝臟中的脂肪酸合成，促進脂質的氧化處置而非儲存。方向上，SIRT6位於脂肪生成基因程序抑制的上游。這使肝臟三酸甘油酯的產生受到控制，並限制肝臟和肌肉等組織中的脂肪沉積。透過對抗從頭脂肪生成，SIRT6保護機體免受肝脂肪變性、胰島素阻抗和慢性營養過剩的代謝後果。

label: FOXO1
description: SIRT1 deacetylates the forkhead factor FOXO1, redirecting its transcriptional program toward metabolic homeostasis and stress resistance while tempering apoptosis. Deacetylated FOXO1 cooperates with C/EBPα to induce adiponectin and with PGC-1α to support oxidative metabolism, gluconeogenesis, and antioxidant gene expression. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically modifies FOXO1 to reshape its target-gene output. This regulation is central to SIRT1's control of glucose handling and insulin sensitivity, and the two proteins form a positive feedback loop in which FOXO1 also activates the SIRT1 promoter, amplifying stress-resistance and metabolic-adaptation programs across tissues.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化叉頭因子 FOXO1，將其轉錄程序重新導向代謝穩態和壓力抗性，同時調節凋亡。去乙醯化的 FOXO1 與 C/EBPα 協同誘導脂聯素，與 PGC-1α 協同支持氧化代謝、糖質新生和抗氧化基因表達。在方向性上，SIRT1 在酶學上修飾 FOXO1 以重塑其靶基因輸出。這種調節是 SIRT1 控制葡萄糖處理和胰島素敏感性的核心，兩種蛋白形成正回饋迴路，其中 FOXO1 也活化 SIRT1 啟動子，在各組織中放大壓力抗性和代謝適應程序。

label: BAX
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Activated BAX (with BAK) drives opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, causing cytochrome c to diffuse into the cytosol where it nucleates the apoptosome with Apaf-1 and caspase-9. BH3-only activators (Bid, Bim, PUMA) can directly engage BAX/BAK, while sensitizers (Bad, Noxa, Bik) displace the anti-apoptotic Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Mcl-1 restraint. The pore event is the point of no return separating transcriptional death decisions from caspase execution.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 BAX（與 BAK）會驅動粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟，使 cytochrome c 擴散進入細胞質，並與 Apaf-1 及 Caspase-9 組裝凋亡體。BH3-only 活化因子（Bid、Bim、PUMA）可直接結合 BAX/BAK，而敏化因子（Bad、Noxa、Bik）則置換抗凋亡的 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 與 Mcl-1。孔道開啟是區分轉錄層面死亡決定與 caspase 執行的不可逆節點。

label: Bcl-2 family
description: Intrinsic Pathway is regulated by Bcl-2 family. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Intrinsic Pathway, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Intrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 受Bcl-2 family 調節。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從Bcl-2 family 向Intrinsic Pathway 延伸，因此Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Intrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Bcl-xL
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: PUMA neutralizes the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL, freeing BAX and BAK to permeabilize the mitochondrial outer membrane. Notably, PUMA is dual-function: it can act as a direct BAX/BAK activator (like Bid and Bim) or as a sensitizer (like Bad, Noxa, and Bik) that displaces Bcl-2-family restraint. This places p53-PUMA signaling at the point where transcriptional death decisions become mitochondrial permeabilization.
description_zh_TW: PUMA 會中和抗凋亡的 BCL-xL，釋放 BAX 與 BAK 以通透化粒線體外膜。值得注意的是 PUMA 具雙重功能：它既能像 Bid 與 Bim 一樣直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能像 Bad、Noxa 與 Bik 一樣作為敏化因子置換 Bcl-2 家族的抑制。這使 p53-PUMA 訊號正好位於轉錄層面的死亡決定轉換為粒線體通透化的節點。

label: Cognition
description: Since brain inflammation is closely related to cognitive impairment, nicotinamide riboside (NR) treatment reduced neuroinflammation and amyloidogenesis in the whole brain of high-fat-diet-fed mice by decreasing amyloid-beta levels and several inflammatory markers, and cognitive function and recognition memory could be attenuated by NR treatment within only 6 weeks. NR can improve multiple aspects of Alzheimer's disease neuropathology, including pTau, amyloid-beta, neurogenesis, neuroinflammation, hippocampal synaptic plasticity, and cognition, by increasing NAD+ levels and supporting DNA repair.
description_zh_TW: 由於腦部發炎與認知障礙密切相關，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）治療透過降低 amyloid-beta（類澱粉乙型）水平與數種發炎標記，減少了高脂飲食小鼠全腦的神經發炎與類澱粉生成，且認知功能與辨識記憶可在僅 6 週的 NR 治療內獲得改善。NR 能透過提升 NAD+ 水平並支持 DNA 修復，改善阿茲海默症神經病理的多個面向，包括 pTau、amyloid-beta、神經生成、神經發炎、海馬突觸可塑性與認知功能。

label: cGAS-STING Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: The release of mitochondrial DNA can trigger critical innate immune pathways such as the cGAS-STING pathway. While these damage-associated molecular pattern sensing pathways are intimately linked to exogenous pathogens, evidence suggests that mitochondrial DNA-stimulated cGAS-STING activation likely contributes to the sterile inflammation seen in many age-related chronic diseases. Mitochondria and mitophagy also play roles in inflammasome activation, and bacteria secrete factors that influence host mitochondrial function, connecting the mitochondrial stress response to immune surveillance and host defense.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 DNA 的釋放可觸發關鍵的先天免疫途徑，如 cGAS-STING 途徑。雖然這些損傷相關分子模式感知途徑與外源性病原體密切相關，但證據表明，粒線體 DNA 刺激的 cGAS-STING 活化可能促成許多與年齡相關的慢性疾病中看到的無菌性炎症。粒線體和粒線體自噬也在炎症小體活化中扮演角色，細菌分泌影響宿主粒線體功能的因子，將粒線體壓力反應與免疫監視和宿主防禦相連結。

label: Berberine
description: Berberine does not inhibit COMT because it lacks the catechol (1,2-dihydroxybenzene) structural motif required for both substrate binding and competitive inhibition of the enzyme. Because it neither blocks COMT nor donates methyl groups, berberine can be used therapeutically without perturbing catecholamine or catechol-drug metabolism mediated by COMT. This makes it a metabolically clean anti-inflammatory option for individuals concerned about COMT interactions, particularly those with slow COMT who are sensitive to methyl donors and enzyme inhibitors. Its structural difference from catechol-bearing flavonoids is central to this safety profile.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 不會抑制 COMT，因為它缺乏底物結合和酶的競爭性抑制所需的兒茶酚（1,2-二羥基苯）結構基序。由於小檜鹼既不阻斷 COMT 也不貢獻 methyl groups，因此可以在不干擾 COMT 介導的兒茶酚胺或兒茶酚藥物代謝的情況下用於治療。這使得它成為關注 COMT 相互作用的個體的代謝清潔抗炎選擇，特別是那些對甲基供體和酶抑製劑敏感的 COMT 緩慢的個體。它與含兒茶酚類黃酮的結構差異是這種安全性的核心。

label: Histone Deacetylase
description: Histone acetyltransferases (HATs) act in dynamic opposition to histone deacetylases (HDACs) to control the steady-state acetylation of histones. HATs deposit acetyl groups that open chromatin and promote gene activation, whereas HDACs remove them to restore a compact, repressive state. Signal-dependent recruitment of HATs couples extracellular cues to gene activation, and the antagonism between these enzyme families is disrupted in aging, neurodegeneration, and cancer, where restoring the balance is explored as a therapeutic strategy.
description_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯轉移酶 (HAT) 與組蛋白去乙醯化酶 (HDAC) 動態對抗，以控制組蛋白的穩態乙醯化。 HAT 沉積乙醯基，打開染色質並促進基因激活，而 HDAC 則去除乙醯基以恢復緊湊的抑制狀態。 HAT 的訊號依賴性募集將細胞外訊號與基因活化結合起來，這些酵素家族之間的拮抗作用在老化、神經退化性疾病和癌症中被破壞，恢復平衡被探索作為一種治療策略。

label: Heterochromatin
description: SIRT7 deacetylates H3K18ac at pericentric heterochromatin, maintaining heterochromatic compaction and suppressing transcription of repetitive elements to preserve genomic stability. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of heterochromatin stabilization. Loss of SIRT7 derepresses retrotransposons and increases genomic instability, and this chromatin role complements SIRT7's nucleolar functions in ribosome biogenesis. By maintaining the repressive state of pericentric heterochromatin, SIRT7 protects genome integrity across cell divisions, and its decline with age may contribute to the derepression of repetitive elements seen in aging cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 在著絲粒周圍異染色質上去乙醯化 H3K18ac，維護異染色質的緊密包裝並抑制重複元件的轉錄以維護基因組穩定性。在方向性上，SIRT7 位於異染色質穩定化的上游。SIRT7 的缺失解除逆轉座子的抑制並增加基因組不穩定性，這種染色質角色與 SIRT7 在核仁中核糖體生物合成的功能互補。透過維護著絲粒周圍異染色質的抑制狀態，SIRT7 在細胞分裂中保護基因組完整性，其隨年齡的下降可能與衰老細胞中重複元件的去抑制有關。

label: Senolytics
description: The combination of Dasatinib and Quercetin (D+Q) was the first rationally identified senolytic, targeting SCAPs such as Bcl-2 family members and PI3K-delta. Intermittent D+Q treatment improves frailty, osteoporosis, cardiovascular function, and pulmonary fibrosis in aged or progeroid mice, motivating the search for more potent single-agent flavonoids like Fisetin.
description_zh_TW: Dasatinib 與 Quercetin 的合併使用（D+Q）是首個以假說驅動方式發現的 senolytic，可攻擊 Bcl-2 家族成員及 PI3K-delta 等 SCAPs。間歇性 D+Q 治療能改善年老或早衰小鼠的衰弱、骨質疏鬆、心血管功能與肺纖維化，也因此促成尋找如 Fisetin 這類更強效單一成分類黃酮的研究。

label: MTRR
description: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is part of the methylation cycle, responsible for maintaining methionine synthase in its active, reduced cobalamin-dependent state by regenerating the B12 cofactor after oxidative inactivation. By supporting homocysteine remethylation to methionine, MTRR sustains the methionine-to-SAMe axis that supplies methyl donors to COMT and other methyltransferases. Its inclusion in the cycle makes it a determinant of overall methyl donor capacity alongside MTHFR and B12 status. MTRR variants can therefore influence methylation efficiency.
description_zh_TW: MTRR（蛋氨酸合成酶還原酶）是 methylation cycle 的一部分，負責透過在氧化失活後再生 B12 輔因子來維持蛋氨酸合成酶處於活性、還原的鈷胺素依賴性狀態。透過支持同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸，MTRR 維持蛋氨酸至 SAMe 軸，為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶提供甲基供體。它包含在循環中使其成為 methyl donor 總體產能以及 MTHFR 和 B12 狀態的決定因素。因此，MTRR 變異體會影響 methylation efficiency。

label: CDK4/6
description: Cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6), central drivers of G1 cell-cycle progression, phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142 and promote its nuclear export through a CRM1-dependent mechanism. This action sequesters TFEB in the cytoplasm during phases of active proliferation, when degradative programs are downregulated. Conversely, pharmacological CDK4/6 inhibition permits TFEB nuclear retention and enhances lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. The CDK4/6-TFEB link couples cell-cycle state to the metabolic and degradative status of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 細胞週期蛋白依賴型激酶 4 和 6（CDK4/6）是 G1 細胞週期進展的核心驅動者，於 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，並透過 CRM1 依賴機制促進其核輸出。此作用在降解程序下調的主動增殖階段，將 TFEB 隔離於細胞質中。相反地，藥理 CDK4/6 抑制允許 TFEB 核保留並增強溶酶體生物發生和自噬。CDK4/6-TFEB 連結將細胞週期狀態耦合到細胞的代謝和降解狀態。

label: Suramin
description: Suramin, a polyanionic urea derivative, inhibits sirtuins with IC50 values of approximately 297 nM, 1150 nM, and 22 μM for SIRT1, SIRT2, and SIRT5 respectively, showing relative selectivity for SIRT5 at higher concentrations. Directionally, suramin blocks sirtuin catalysis. Its broad activity limits specificity, but it remains a tool to probe SIRT5, and it has also been studied as a therapeutic agent. Clinically, suramin is an antiparasitic and anticancer drug with off-target sirtuin effects, and understanding its sirtuin inhibition informs both its pharmacology and the design of more selective inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Suramin 是一種聚陰離子脲衍生物，對 sirtuin 的 IC50 值分別約為 SIRT1 297 nM、SIRT2 1150 nM 和 SIRT5 22 μM，在較高濃度下對 SIRT5 顯示相對選擇性。在方向性上，suramin 阻斷 sirtuin 催化。其廣泛活性限制了特異性，但它仍然是探測 SIRT5 的工具，也被作為治療劑進行研究。在臨床上，suramin 是一種抗寄生蟲和抗癌藥物，具有脫靶 sirtuin 效應，了解其 sirtuin 抑制為其藥理學和更選擇性抑制劑的設計提供了資訊。

label: David Sinclair
description: David Sinclair identified SIRT1 as a mediator of caloric-restriction benefits and, in a landmark 2003 study, discovered resveratrol as a sirtuin-activating compound (STAC). Directionally, the discovery establishes SIRT1/STAC centrality to longevity research. This launched the modern sirtuin field, and it connects basic yeast findings to mammalian therapeutics. By showing that resveratrol extends yeast lifespan through Sir2, Sinclair bridged the caloric-restriction and sirtuin fields. This work catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development and made SIRT1 a central target in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: David Sinclair 鑑定 SIRT1 為限制熱量益處的介導因子，並在 2003 年的里程碑研究中發現 resveratrol 作為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC）。在方向性上，此發現確立了 SIRT1/STAC 在長壽研究中的核心地位。這啟動了現代 sirtuin 領域，並將基礎酵母發現與哺乳動物治療學聯繫起來。透過展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，Sinclair 架起了限制熱量和 sirtuin 領域之間的橋樑。此工作催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，使 SIRT1 成為老年科學的核心靶標。

label: Medium spiny neurons
description: Medium spiny neurons are GABAergic inhibitory projection neurons, the principal output cells of the striatum that integrate cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic inputs. Their inhibitory nature means dopamine modulation via D1/D2 receptors reshapes striatal output to basal ganglia circuits, controlling movement, habit, and reward. As the main targets of nigrostriatal dopamine, they are central to COMT's striatal effects and to dopamine-regulated behavior. They comprise about 95% of striatal neurons.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 是 GABA 能抑制性投射神經元，是整合皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的紋狀體的主要輸出細胞。它們的抑制性質意味著透過 D1/D2 受體的多巴胺調節來重塑 basal ganglia 電路的紋狀體輸出，控制 movement、習慣和 reward。作為黑質紋狀體多巴胺的主要標靶，它們是 COMT 紋狀體效應和多巴胺調節行為的核心。它們大約包括95% of striatal neurons。

label: CD38 inhibitor 78c
description: CD38 inhibitor 78c prevents degradation of NMN, prolonging its availability as an NAD+ precursor and amplifying NAD+ and sirtuin activation.
description_zh_TW: CD38 抑制劑 78c 防止 NMN 被降解，延長其作為 NAD+ 前體的可用性，放大 NAD+ 與 sirtuin 活化。

label: DNMT3a
description: DNMT3a is a de novo DNA methyltransferase that establishes new DNA methylation patterns at previously unmethylated loci, playing a central role in setting up the methylation landscape during development. It cooperates with DNMT3b and the stimulatory accessory factor DNMT3L to deposit methyl groups at targeted regions, and it prefers gene bodies and intergenic regions in contrast to the repetitive element bias of DNMT3b. DNMT3a is essential for hematopoiesis, and its somatic mutation drives clonal hematopoiesis and acute myeloid leukemia, making it both a developmental regulator and a disease-relevant enzyme.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 是一種從頭 DNA 甲基轉移酶，可在先前未甲基化的位點建立新的 DNA 甲基化模式，在發育過程中建立甲基化景觀中發揮核心作用。它與DNMT3b和刺激輔助因子DNMT3L合作，將methyl groups沉積在目標區域，與DNMT3b的重複元件偏向相比，它更喜歡基因體和基因間區域。 DNMT3a 對於造血至關重要，其體細胞突變可驅動克隆造血和急性髓性白血病，使其既是發育調節因子，也是疾病相關酶。

label: DISC
description: Extrinsic Pathway forms DISC. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. The relationship is directional, with Extrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon DISC rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Extrinsic Pathway 形式DISC。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。這種關係是有方向的，Extrinsic Pathway 充當 DISC 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: Adrenochrome formation
description: Acidic conditions strongly slow or prevent the cyclization step of adrenochrome formation, because at low pH the side-chain amine of the oxidized epinephrine intermediate is protonated and reduced in nucleophilicity, so it cannot easily attack the quinone ring. In highly acidic solutions the open-chain quinone form is favored and more stable, while neutral-to-alkaline pH accelerates cyclization and oxidation. This pH dependence explains why pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions are kept acidic (pH 3-5) with antioxidants to minimize oxidation and adrenochrome formation, and it is the most important factor in controlling the reaction rate.
description_zh_TW: 酸性條件會強烈減緩或阻止 adrenochrome 形成的 cyclization 步驟，因為在低 pH 下，氧化 epinephrine 中間產物的 side-chain amine 會被質子化且 nucleophilicity 降低，因此無法輕易攻擊 quinone ring。在強酸性溶液中，open-chain quinone 形式較受青睞且更穩定，而中性至鹼性 pH 則加速 cyclization 與氧化。這種 pH dependence 解釋了為何藥用 epinephrine 溶液需保持酸性（pH 3-5）並添加 antioxidants，以最小化氧化與 adrenochrome 形成，且這是控制反應速率最重要的因素。

label: VEGFc
description: VEGF-C is a member of the VEGF family of cysteine-knot growth factors, structurally related to VEGF-A but with distinct receptor usage and lymphatic specificity. Its classification situates it among the growth-factor arm of the SASP, and in senescence it is an early-induced angiogenic and lymphangiogenic factor. The family membership underpins its receptor interactions, particularly with VEGFR-3 and, after proteolytic processing, VEGFR-2. This dual receptor capacity distinguishes its vascular functions from other family members.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 是 VEGF 家族的胱胺酸結（cysteine-knot）生長因子成員，結構上與 VEGF-A 相關但具不同的受體使用與淋巴特異性。其分類將其置於 SASP 的生長因子臂，在衰老中它是連結分泌組到血管與淋巴管生成的因子。其與 VEGF-A 的關係反映 SASP 生長因子的多樣性，且其在促血管生成與淋巴生成間的雙重角色使其獨特。它是分泌組中較少被認識的組成。

label: Fenbendazole
description: Fenbendazole binds the colchicine site of beta-tubulin, preventing polymerization and destabilizing microtubules (Dogra & Mukhopadhyay, Sci Rep 2018).
description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 結合 β-微管蛋白的秋水仙鹼位點，阻止聚合並 destabilizing 微管（Dogra & Mukhopadhyay, Sci Rep 2018）。

label: Amyloid Beta
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces beta-amyloid levels and protects cognitive function in Alzheimer's disease models. In Tg2576 mice, NR treatment lowered beta-amyloid and increased the chance of recognizing a novel object by 20%, indicating improved recognition memory. NR also significantly reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage, while increasing neurogenesis by almost 20%. These cognitive and synaptic protective effects are attributed to NR's ability to elevate NAD+ and upregulate proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1-alpha-regulated beta-secretase 1 degradation and mitochondrial gene expression, linking NAD+ precursor supplementation to preservation of learning, memory, and motor function.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）可降低 beta-amyloid 水平，並在阿茲海默症模型中保護認知功能。在 Tg2576 小鼠中，NR 處理降低了 beta-amyloid，並使辨識新物體的機率提高 20%，顯示辨識記憶改善。NR 也顯著減少神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化 Tau 與 DNA 損傷，同時使神經生成增加近 20%。這些認知與突觸保護作用歸因於 NR 提升 NAD+ 並上調由 proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1-alpha 調控的 beta-secretase 1 降解與粒線體基因表現的能力，將 NAD+ 前驅物補充與學習、記憶及運動功能的維持相連結。

label: Avermectin
description: Avermectin B1a is the natural macrocyclic-lactone precursor of ivermectin (22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a), the semi-synthetic lead derivative developed for human and veterinary medicine.
description_zh_TW: Avermectin B1a 是伊維菌素（22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a）的天然大環內酯前體，伊維菌素是為人類和獸醫開發的半合成先導衍生物。

label: Sir2 (yeast)
description: Sir2 (silent information regulator 2) is the founding member of the sirtuin family, first identified in Saccharomyces cerevisiae as a regulator of mating-type locus silencing and replicative lifespan. The seven mammalian paralogues SIRT1–SIRT7 evolved from this ancestral NAD+-dependent deacetylase, retaining the conserved catalytic core while diversifying in subcellular localization and substrate repertoire. This phylogenetic continuity means insights from yeast Sir2 historically informed mammalian sirtuin biology, although the mammalian enzymes acquired lineage-specific regulatory domains. The relationship is directional: yeast Sir2 is the evolutionary precursor, not a downstream effector, of the SIRT1–7 family.
description_zh_TW: Sir2（silent information regulator 2）是 sirtuin 家族的始祖成員，最早在釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中被發現，作為交配型基因座沉默和複製性壽命的調節因子。哺乳動物的七個旁系同源物 SIRT1–SIRT7 從這個祖先型 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶演化而來，保留了保守的催化核心，同時在次細胞定位和受質譜方面多樣化。這種系統發生學上的連續性意味著來自酵母 Sir2 的見解在歷史上促進了對哺乳動物 sirtuin 生物學的理解，儘管哺乳動物酶獲得了譜系特異性的調節結構域。這種關係是方向性的：酵母 Sir2 是 SIRT1–7 家族的演化前體，而非下游效應因子。

label: Yamanaka Factors
description: The Yamanaka factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc, abbreviated OSKM) are a set of four transcription factors used to induce pluripotency in differentiated somatic cells. When introduced into fibroblasts or other somatic cells, they initiate a cascade of transcriptional and epigenetic changes that reset the cell toward an embryonic-stem-cell-like state, erasing somatic memory and installing the pluripotency network. This demonstration, pioneered by Shinya Yamanaka in 2006, established that cellular identity is not fixed but can be reprogrammed.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子（Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc，縮寫為 OSKM）是一組四個轉錄因子，用於誘導分化體細胞的多能性。當引入成纖維細胞或其他體細胞時，它們會啟動一系列轉錄和表觀遺傳學變化，將細胞重置為胚胎幹細胞樣狀態，消除體細胞記憶並安裝多能性網路。此演示由 Shinya Yamanaka 於 2006 年首創，證實細胞身份不是固定的，而是可以重新編程的。

label: Methemoglobin
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methemoglobin (MetHb) is a form of hemoglobin in which the iron in the heme group is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state. Unlike normal hemoglobin, it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen and appears bluish chocolate-brown in color. In healthy individuals, a small amount (typically less than 1-2% of total hemoglobin) forms spontaneously but is rapidly reduced back to functional hemoglobin by enzymes, primarily NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase (also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase). Hemoglobin is a tetramer of 2 alpha and 2 beta chains, each with a heme group containing iron.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin (MetHb) is a form of hemoglobin in which the iron in the heme group is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state。Unlike normal hemoglobin, it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen and appears bluish chocolate-brown in color。In healthy individuals, a small amount (typically less than 1-2% of total hemoglobin) forms spontaneously but is rapidly reduced back to functional hemoglobin by enzymes, primarily NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase (also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase)。Hemoglobin is a tetramer of 2 alpha and 2 beta chains, each with a heme group containing iron。

label: Chromatin
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Chromatin is composed of nucleosomes, the repeating structural units that package the genome within the nucleus. Each nucleosome consists of a histone octamer, with two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, wrapped by approximately 147 base pairs of DNA. Nucleosomes are arranged along the DNA in a beads-on-a-string fashion and further compact into higher-order fibers, with their positioning and modification determining whether underlying DNA is accessible for transcription, replication, and repair.
description_zh_TW: Chromatin 由核小體組成，核小體是將基因組包裝在細胞核內的重複結構單元。每個核小體由一個組蛋白八聚體組成，其中 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各有兩個拷貝，由大約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 包裹。核小體以串珠的方式沿著 DNA 排列，並進一步壓縮成高級纖維，其定位和修飾決定了底層 DNA 是否可用於轉錄、複製和修復。

label: Mitochondrial Fusion
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) promotes mitochondrial fusion, particularly in the diabetic heart. Daily oral gavage of NR at 400 mg/kg/day for 4 weeks alleviated diabetes-induced cardiomyopathy and improved cardiac function in diabetic mice by elevating myocardium NAD+ content and promoting mitofusin 2-mediated mitochondrial fusion. This action occurs via the SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha pathway and suppresses oxidative stress and cell apoptosis. By restoring balanced mitochondrial dynamics in a disease state characterized by mitochondrial fragmentation and dysfunction, NR supports cardiomyocyte survival and cardiac bioenergetics.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）促進粒線體融合，特別是在糖尿病心臟中。每天以 400 mg/kg/天 NR 口服灌胃 4 週，透過提升心肌 NAD+ 含量並促進 mitofusin 2 介導的粒線體融合，減輕糖尿病誘發的心肌病並改善糖尿病小鼠的心臟功能。此作用透過 SIRT1-PGC1alpha-PPARalpha 路徑發生，並抑制氧化壓力與細胞凋亡。透過在粒線體碎裂與功能障礙為特徵的疾病狀態中恢復平衡的粒線體動態，NR 支持心肌細胞存活與心臟生物能量學。

label: Silver compounds
description: Silver(I) oxide is used to prepare other silver compounds, serving as a versatile silver precursor in synthetic chemistry. Because it is a stable, readily handled oxidant and silver source, it can be converted into soluble silver salts, coordination complexes, and metal nanoparticles, including the silver oxide nanoparticle dispersions used in antimicrobial and electronic applications. The compound also appears in consumer and industrial products, where its reported functional uses include antimicrobial activity, biocidal action, batteries, and personal care formulations.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)用於製備其他銀化合物，作為合成化學中的多功能銀前體。因其是穩定且易於處理的氧化劑和銀源，可轉化為可溶性銀鹽、配位複合物和金屬奈米粒子，包括用於抗菌和電子應用的氧化銀奈米粒子分散液。該化合物也存在於消費和工業產品中，其報導的功能用途包括抗菌活性、殺菌作用、電池和個人護理配方。

label: Spermidine
description: Spermidine is a naturally occurring polyamine with conserved anti-aging properties that acts as a potent inducer of autophagy across organisms from yeast to humans. It promotes autophagy through multiple mechanisms, including enhancement of histone H3 deacetylation and, via hypusination of eIF5A, facilitation of TFEB translation and lysosomal gene expression. Dietary spermidine supplementation extends lifespan and protects against cardiovascular and cognitive decline in preclinical models. Its ability to engage the autophagy-lysosomal network safely makes it a leading caloric-restriction mimetic candidate.
description_zh_TW: Spermidine是一種天然存在、具有保守抗老化特性的多胺，作為從酵母到人類各生物中強效的自噬誘導劑。它透過多種機制促進自噬，包括增強組蛋白H3去乙醯化和透過eIF5A的hypusination促進TFEB轉譯及溶酶體基因表現。飲食補充spermidine在臨床前模型中延長壽命並保護免受心血管和認知衰退。其安全參與自噬—溶酶體網絡的能力，使其成為領先的熱量限制擬似物候選者。

label: HLH-30
description: HLH-30, the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian TFEB, induces expression of the lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) in response to fasting, promoting mobilization of stored lipids. This transcriptional activation mirrors TFEB's induction of lipolytic and autophagic programs in mammals during nutrient scarcity. The HLH-30–lipase axis provides a molecular explanation for fasting-induced lipophagy and lifespan extension in worms. It demonstrates deep conservation of the MiT/TFE nutrient-response program.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 是哺乳動物 TFEB 在線蟲中的同源物，在回應禁食時誘發溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的表現，促進儲存脂質的動員。此轉錄活化反映了哺乳動物 TFEB 在營養匱乏時對脂解和自噬程序的誘發。HLH-30–脂肪酶軸為禁食誘發的脂噬和線蟲壽命延長提供了分子解釋。它展示了 MiT/TFE 營養反應程序的高度保守性。

label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Mitochondrial dysfunction is a major endogenous source of reactive oxygen species, since a small percentage of electrons leak from the electron transport chain during ATP production and reduce oxygen to superoxide. With aging, mitochondrial dysfunction becomes more common and contributes to the elevated baseline ROS characteristic of older organisms. Because adrenochrome formation is driven by ROS-mediated oxidation of adrenaline, higher mitochondrial ROS can shift more epinephrine toward the adrenochrome pathway. Adrenochrome in turn can impair mitochondrial function through redox cycling and uncoupling, establishing a feedback loop between mitochondrial damage and catecholamine oxidation.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體功能障礙是活性氧物種的主要內源性來源，因為在 ATP 生成期間有少量電子從電子傳遞鏈洩漏並將氧還原為超氧陰離子。隨著衰老，粒線體功能障礙變得更常見，並促成年老個體特有的升高基線 ROS。由於 adrenochrome 形成由 ROS 介導的 adrenaline 氧化所驅動，較高的粒線體 ROS 可將更多 epinephrine 推向 adrenochrome 途徑。Adrenochrome 反過來可透過氧化還原循環與去偶聯損害粒線體功能，在粒線體損傷與兒茶酚胺氧化之間建立回饋迴圈。

label: Diabetes Mellitus
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Diabetes mellitus is often seen as a form of accelerated aging, and the levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of their equivalent normal non-diabetics. Advanced glycation end products are increased in diabetes and play an important role in the development of diabetic complications. Aminoguanidine acts to bind to sugars, preventing them from binding to the lysine groups of proteins, and diabetic clinical trials with humans have highlighted its ability to prevent oxidative modification of LDL, inhibit atherosclerotic plaque formation, reduce albuminuria and delay end-stage renal disease.
description_zh_TW: 糖尿病常被視為一種加速老化的形式，而糖尿病患者體內的交聯產物濃度是年齡相當的正常非糖尿病者的二至三倍。晚期糖化終產物在糖尿病中增加，並在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。胺基胍的作用是與糖結合，防止糖與蛋白質的離胺酸基團結合；人體糖尿病臨床試驗已突顯其預防 LDL 氧化修飾、抑制動脈粥狀硬化斑塊形成、減少白蛋白尿並延緩末期腎病的能力。

label: Senescence Surveillance
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senescence Surveillance. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senescence surveillance is the immune-mediated clearance of senescent cells orchestrated by their SASP chemokine and cytokine output. The directionality runs from Senescence Surveillance toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senescence Surveillance is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由Senescence Surveillance 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。監視是由衰老細胞的趨化因子和細胞激素輸出協調的免疫介導的清除。方向性從 Senescence Surveillance 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senescence Surveillance 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: OPA1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: OPA1 (optic atrophy 1) is the dynamin-related GTPase that mediates inner mitochondrial membrane fusion, needed in only one of two colliding mitochondria for fusing the inner membranes. OPA1 exists as eight isoforms and is proteolytically processed by OMA1, YME1L1, PARL, paraplegin and the mAAA protease to generate long (L-OPA1) and short (S-OPA1) forms; L-OPA1 promotes fusion while S-OPA1 modulates it by forming complexes with L-OPA1. Decreased OPA1 reduces fusion and contributes to separating dysfunctional mitochondria for mitophagic removal, and OPA1 mutations cause dominant optic atrophy.
description_zh_TW: OPA1（視神經萎縮1）是介導內粒線體膜融合的dynamin相關GTP酶，在兩個碰撞的粒線體中只需一個即可融合內膜。OPA1以八種異構體形式存在，並被OMA1、YME1L1、PARL、paraplegin和mAAA蛋白酶蛋白水解加工以產生長形式（L-OPA1）和短形式（S-OPA1）；L-OPA1促進融合，而S-OPA1通過與L-OPA1形成複合物來調節融合。OPA1減少降低融合並有助於分離功能異常的粒線體以進行線粒體自噬清除，OPA1突變導致顯性視神經萎縮。

label: Lifespan
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: BRASTO mice overexpress SIRT1 in the dorsomedial and lateral hypothalamus, raising physical activity and oxygen consumption, preserving skeletal-muscle mitochondrial morphology and body-temperature homeostasis, and extending median lifespan ~11% with delayed cancer-related death in both sexes. The mechanism is SIRT1 upregulating OX2R via NKX2-1 deacetylation, recapitulating calorie restriction. Notably, global SIRT1 overexpression does not extend lifespan, so the effect is brain-specific and dose-dependent.
description_zh_TW: BRASTO小鼠在下丘腦背內側和外側過表達SIRT1，提高了身體活動量和氧氣消耗，維持了骨骼肌粒線體形態和體溫恆定，並使中位壽命延長約11%，在兩性中均延遲了與癌症相關的死亡。其機制是SIRT1透過NKX2-1去乙醯化上調OX2R，重現了熱量限制的效果。值得注意的是，全身性SIRT1過表達並不能延長壽命，因此此效果具有腦部特異性且呈劑量依賴性。

label: Vitamin E
description: Coenzyme Q10 regenerates vitamin E by reducing the alpha-tocopheroxyl radical back to alpha-tocopherol, extending the chain-breaking lifetime of vitamin E in membranes. This places CoQ10 upstream of vitamin E in the antioxidant network. The directionality is ubiquinol to tocopherol recycling. A caveat is that this regeneration competes with CoQ10's own peroxyl-radical scavenging, and the net effect depends on local ratios. The recycling interaction places CoQ10 and vitamin E as partners in a lipid-phase antioxidant network that also involves vitamin C at the membrane interface.
description_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 透過將 α-生育酚自由基還原回 α-生育醇來再生 vitamin E，從而延長了 vitamin E 在膜中的斷鏈壽命。這使得 CoQ10 在抗氧化網路中位於 vitamin E 的上游。方向性是泛醇到生育醇的回收。需要注意的是，這種再生與 CoQ10 自身的過氧自由基清除作用相競爭，淨效應取決於局部比率。這種回收相互作用將 CoQ10 和 vitamin E 作為脂相抗氧化網絡中的合作夥伴，該網絡還涉及膜界面上的維生素 C。

label: Neuroinflammation
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease models and in alcohol-induced depression models. In AD models, NR significantly reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage while increasing neurogenesis. In mice with alcohol-induced depression, dietary NR for 10 weeks reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels and inhibited microglial activation, with the protective effect attributed to NR upregulating brain-derived neurotrophic factor by altering gut microbiota composition. These findings connect NR's NAD+-boosting action to suppression of neuroinflammation, microglial reactivity, and preservation of cognitive and emotional function.
description_zh_TW: 煙醯胺核糖（NR）可降低Alzheimer's disease模型與酒精誘發憂鬱模型中的神經發炎。在AD模型中，NR顯著降低神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化Tau與DNA損傷，同時增加神經生成。在酒精誘發憂鬱的小鼠中，飲食補充NR達10週降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素濃度，並抑制小膠質細胞活化，其保護作用歸因於NR透過改變gut microbiota組成而上調brain-derived neurotrophic factor。這些發現將NR提升NAD+的作用與抑制神經發炎、小膠質細胞反應性，以及維持認知與情緒功能相連結。

label: MOMP
description: Intrinsic Pathway relates to MOMP through the relation involves. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 透過涉及關係與 MOMP 相關。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: Prefrontal Cortex
description: COMT (catechol-O-methyltransferase) dominates dopamine clearance in the prefrontal cortex because this brain region is sparsely populated with the dopamine transporter (DAT), forcing reliance on extracellular enzymatic degradation rather than rapid reuptake. By methylating dopamine into inactive 3-methoxytyramine using SAMe as cofactor, COMT sets the extracellular dopamine tone that governs prefrontal cognition, working memory, and executive control. The norepinephrine transporter contributes secondarily to this clearance. Because the Val158Met polymorphism changes COMT activity three- to four-fold, genetic variation in COMT has an outsized impact on prefrontal dopamine signaling.
description_zh_TW: COMT（兒茶酚-O-甲基轉移酶）主導前額葉皮質中的多巴胺清除，因為該 brain 區域稀疏地分佈有多巴胺轉運蛋白（DAT），迫使其依賴細胞外酶促降解而不是快速再攝取。透過使用 SAMe 作為輔因子將多巴胺甲基化為不活躍的 3-methoxytyramine，COMT 設定了控制前額認知、工作記憶和執行控制的細胞外多巴胺基調。 norepinephrine 運輸車對這項清除起到了次要的作用。由於 Val158Met 多態性使 COMT activity 發生三到四倍的變化，COMT 的遺傳變異對前額葉多巴胺訊號傳導產生巨大影響。

label: Heart Failure
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Coenzyme Q10 reduces heart-failure morbidity and mortality, as suggested by the Q-SYMBIO trial showing a substantial reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events with supplementation in chronic heart failure. Its benefit is attributed to improved mitochondrial bioenergetics and reduced oxidative stress. The directionality is supplementation to improved cardiac outcomes. A caveat is that trial results are mixed and effect sizes vary, so CoQ10 is adjunctive rather than replacement therapy. Improved mitochondrial ATP production and endothelial function are also invoked to explain the cardiac benefit, though larger confirmatory trials are still needed.
description_zh_TW: Q-SYMBIO 試驗表明，Coenzyme Q10 可以降低心臟衰竭的發病率和死亡率，該試驗顯示，補充慢性 heart failure 後，主要不良反應 cardiovascular events 大幅減少。其益處歸因於改進的mitochondria1生物能學和減少的oxidative stress。方向性是改善心臟結果的補充。需要注意的是，試驗結果參差不齊，效果大小也各不相同，因此 CoQ10 是輔助療法，而不是替代療法。儘管仍需要更大規模的驗證性試驗，但改善的mitochondria1 ATP產生和內皮功能也被用來解釋心臟益處。

label: RAGE
description: RAGE (receptor for advanced glycation end products) is the best-characterized cell surface molecule that recognizes AGEs. The interaction between an AGE and its receptor alters cell and organ functions mainly through inflammatory molecules, leading to aging. RAGE regulates cell processes of crucial importance including inflammation, apoptosis, ROS signaling, proliferation, autophagy, and aging. AGE-RAGE signaling is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging and age-related diseases, and dietary CML-enriched protein induces functional arterial aging in a RAGE-dependent manner in mice.
description_zh_TW: RAGE（receptor for advanced glycation end products）是辨識 AGEs 最具特徵性的 cell surface molecule。AGE 與其 receptor 之間的 interaction 主要透過 inflammatory molecules 改變細胞與器官功能，導致 aging。RAGE 調節包括 inflammation、apoptosis、ROS signaling、proliferation、autophagy 與 aging 在內的重要 cell processes。AGE-RAGE signaling 是 AGEs 促成 aging 與 age-related diseases 的三大主要機制之一，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。

label: Therapy-Induced Senescence
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is a type of Senescence. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Cellular senescence is an irreversible arrest program triggered by telomere dysfunction, oncogene activation, or therapy that limits tumor growth. The directionality runs from Senescence toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senescence is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 是Senescence 的一種。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。細胞老化是由端粒功能障礙、癌基因活化或限制腫瘤生長的治療引發的不可逆的停滯程序。方向性從 Senescence 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senescence 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Information Theory of Aging
