description: Because the ICE Mouse phenotype occurs without mutations, it is attributed to loss of epigenetic information rather than hardware damage, supporting the Information Theory of Aging. Directionally, mutation-free double-strand-break repair sits upstream of information loss. This reframes aging as a software, not hardware, failure, and it is a foundational claim of Sinclair's theory. By showing that repair of faithful breaks still accelerates aging, the ICE Mouse separates epigenetic information loss from genetic mutation. This has profound implications for aging research, suggesting that age-related decline may be reversible by restoring epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: 由於 ICE 小鼠表型在沒有突變的情況下發生，被歸因於表觀遺傳資訊的喪失而非硬體損傷，支持衰老資訊理論。在方向性上，無突變的雙鏈斷裂修復位於資訊喪失的上游。這將衰老重新定義為軟體（而非硬體）故障，是 Sinclair 理論的基本主張。透過展示對忠實斷裂的修復仍然加速衰老，ICE 小鼠將表觀遺傳資訊喪失與基因突變分離。這對衰老研究具有深遠影響，表明年齡相關退化可能透過恢復表觀遺傳資訊而逆轉。

label: Methyl groups
description: Creatine synthesis is the single largest consumer of S-adenosylmethionine-derived methyl groups in the body, using approximately 70 percent of available methyl donor flux. Guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase transfers a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to guanidinoacetate to form creatine, thereby competing with DNA methylation and other methylation reactions for the methyl pool. Because exogenous creatine supplementation reduces the demand for endogenous creatine synthesis, it can spare methyl groups and shift the balance of methylation reactions. This creatine-methionine interaction forms the mechanistic basis for the hypothesis that creatine could influence epigenetic processes relevant to cancer.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸合成是體內 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸衍生甲基的最大單一消耗者，使用約 70% 的可用甲基供應通量。胍基乙酸 N-甲基轉移酶將甲基從 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸轉移至胍基乙酸以形成肌酸，從而與 DNA 甲基化及其他甲基化反應競爭甲基池。由於外源性肌酸補充可降低內源性肌酸合成的需求，因此能節省甲基並改變甲基化反應的平衡。這種肌酸—甲硫胺酸交互作用，構成了肌酸可能影響與癌症相關之表觀遺傳過程此一假說的機制基礎。

label: CamKIIα
description: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) is a serine/threonine protein kinase central to neuronal signaling, activated by the Ca2+-calmodulin complex downstream of NMDA receptor activation and voltage-gated calcium influx. It is highly abundant in postsynaptic densities, where it phosphorylates numerous substrates including AMPA receptors to encode synaptic strength and plasticity. Its autophosphorylation produces persistent, calcium-independent activity that sustains long-term potentiation. It is therefore a key molecular substrate of activity-dependent plasticity and memory.
description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) 是一種對神經元訊號傳導至關重要的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，由 NMDA 受體活化和電壓門控鈣流入下游的 Ca2+-鈣調蛋白複合物活化。它在突觸後密度中高度豐富，可磷酸化包括 AMPA 受體在內的多種底物，以編碼突觸強度和可塑性。其自身磷酸化產生持久的、不依賴鈣的活性，維持長期增強作用。因此，它是活動依賴性可塑性和記憶的關鍵分子底物。

label: Resting Metabolic Rate
description: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

label: Inflammaging
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Mitochondrial dysfunction is not merely a hallmark of aging but an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion and inflammaging, the chronic low-grade inflammation characteristic of aging. Mitochondrial damage is decoded as inflammation through cytosolic mtDNA activating cGAS-STING and NF-κB pathways, while dysfunctional mitochondria persisting due to defective mitophagy remain metabolically active yet generate excessive ROS that sustains SASP signaling. Mitochondrial lipid peroxidation byproducts (4-HNE, oxidized cardiolipin) further stimulate inflammatory pathways via toll-like receptors and inflammasomes.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction 不僅僅是 aging 的 hallmark，更是 stem cell exhaustion 和 inflammaging（aging 特徵的 chronic low-grade inflammation）的 upstream driver。Mitochondrial damage 通過 cytosolic mtDNA 激活 cGAS-STING 和 NF-κB pathways 被解讀為 inflammation，而 dysfunctional mitochondria 由於 defective mitophagy 持續存在，卻產生 excessive ROS 維持 SASP signaling。Mitochondrial lipid peroxidation byproducts（4-HNE、oxidized cardiolipin）進一步通過 toll-like receptors 和 inflammasomes 刺激 inflammatory pathways。

label: Mitochondrial ROS
description: SIRT3 reduces mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating and activating MnSOD and other antioxidant enzymes and by optimizing electron-transport-chain function. Directionally, SIRT3 activity sits upstream of lowered mitochondrial oxidant production. This antioxidant action protects tissues from oxidative damage in cardiovascular and metabolic disease, and it is central to SIRT3's longevity and stress-resistance phenotype. By lowering mitochondrial ROS, SIRT3 also reduces inflammasome priming and preserves mitochondrial DNA integrity, coupling redox homeostasis to genome stability and innate immune regulation, and its induction by fasting and caloric restriction reinforces these protective effects.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 通過去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD 及其他抗氧化酶以及優化電子傳遞鏈功能來減少粒線體 ROS。在方向性上，SIRT3 活性位於降低粒線體氧化劑產生的上游。這種抗氧化作用保護組織免受心血管和代謝疾病中的氧化損傷，是 SIRT3 長壽和壓力抗性表型的核心。通過降低粒線體 ROS，SIRT3 還減少炎症小體的引發並保留粒線體 DNA 完整性，將氧化還原穩態與基因組穩定性和先天免疫調節偶聯，其由禁食和熱量限制誘導強化了這些保護效應。

label: Thymopoiesis
description: The thymus is a vital organ for homeostatic maintenance of the peripheral immune system. Within its two compartments, the true thymic epithelial space (TES, comprising cortex and medulla) and the perivascular space (PVS), T cells develop, mature, and undergo induction of self-tolerance in a process called thymopoiesis. The cortex hosts early thymocyte development including T cell receptor gene rearrangement and positive selection, while the medulla carries out negative selection to remove autoreactive T cells. The perivascular space, composed of adipocytes, peripheral lymphocytes and stroma, is a non-thymopoietic component.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺是外周免疫系統穩態維持的重要器官。在其兩個隔室——真正的胸腺上皮空間（TES，包含皮質和髓質）和血管周圍空間（PVS）——中，T 細胞發育、成熟並經歷稱為胸腺生成的自身耐受誘導過程。皮質主持早期胸腺細胞發育，包括 T 細胞受體基因重排和陽性選擇，而髓質執行陰性選擇以清除自身反應性 T 細胞。血管周圍空間由脂肪細胞、外周淋巴細胞和基質組成，是非胸腺生成的成分。

label: Melatonin
description: Melatonin upregulates SIRT3, which promotes mitophagy to mitigate oxidative stress-induced damage, and SIRT3 knockout completely abolishes melatonin's benefits against contrast-induced AKI. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin promotes autophagy, reduces apoptosis, and mitigates mitochondrial dysfunction by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154 acting as a pivotal molecular switch for mitophagic flux.
description_zh_TW: Melatonin 上調 SIRT3，後者促進粒線體自噬以減輕氧化壓力誘導的損傷，且 SIRT3 基因敲除完全消除 melatonin 對比劑誘導 AKI 的保護益處。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙，其中 SIRT3 介導的 TFAM 在 Lys154 處的去乙醯化作為粒線體自噬通量的關鍵分子開關。

label: Senescent Cells
description: Senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis because they upregulate Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs), including Bcl-2 family pro-survival proteins and the PI3K/Akt axis. Different senescent cell types rely on different SCAPs, which is why no single senolytic clears all senescent cells — and why SCAP-targeting drugs such as Fisetin, D+Q, and Navitoclax show cell-type selectivity.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞因上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs，包括 Bcl-2 家族促存活蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 軸）而抵抗細胞凋亡。不同衰老細胞類型依賴不同的 SCAPs，因此沒有任何單一 senolytic 能清除所有衰老細胞——這也是為何攻擊 SCAPs 的藥物如 Fisetin、D+Q 與 Navitoclax 呈現細胞類型選擇性的原因。

label: TGFβ
description: Activation of SIRT1, together with SIRT3, by resveratrol attenuates cardiac fibrosis in mice by inhibiting the TGF-β/Smad3 pathway. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of TGF-β/Smad3 suppression. This reduces collagen deposition and myofibroblast activation, preserving cardiac structure and function. It is a key antifibrotic mechanism relevant to heart and kidney disease, and it is consistent with SIRT1's ability to abolish TGF-β1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis and suppress CTGF expression. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of organ injury, SIRT1 activation represents a broad antifibrotic strategy across tissues.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 與 SIRT3 一起被白藜蘆醇活化，通過抑制 TGF-β/Smad3 通路在小鼠中減輕心臟纖維化。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於 TGF-β/Smad3 抑制的上游。這減少膠原蛋白沉積和肌成纖維細胞活化，保留心臟結構和功能。這是與心臟和腎臟疾病相關的關鍵抗纖維化機制，與 SIRT1 消除 TGF-β1 誘導的凋亡和纖維化並抑制 CTGF 表達的能力一致。由於纖維化是器官損傷的共同最終通路，SIRT1 活化代表了一種跨組織的廣泛抗纖維化策略。

label: Lung Cancer
description: SIRT1 and SIRT2 promote cell proliferation and play a pro-tumorigenic role in lung cancer. Expression of sirtuin 1 and 2 is associated with poor prognosis in non-small cell lung cancer patients. Directionally, SIRT1 and SIRT2 sit upstream of lung cancer cell proliferation and aggressive disease. Their elevated expression is linked to poor prognosis, supporting SIRT1 and SIRT2 as therapeutic targets and prognostic biomarkers in lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 和 SIRT2 促進細胞增殖並在肺癌中發揮促腫瘤作用。Sirtuin 1 和 2 的表達與非小細胞肺癌患者的不良預後相關。從作用方向而言，SIRT1 和 SIRT2 位於肺癌細胞增殖和侵襲性疾病的上游。其表達上調與不良預後相關，支持 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 作為肺癌的治療靶點和預後生物標記。

label: Hormesis
description: Xenohormesis is the hypothesis that naturally occurring plant compounds - often synthesized when plants are under environmental stress such as drought - act as cross-species signaling molecules that induce a hormetic response when consumed by animals. These compounds are proposed to prepare the recipient organism for presumed worsening environmental conditions (famine for the animal, drought for the plant). This concept extends the hormesis framework to dietary phytochemicals and may help explain the medicinal value of certain plant-derived molecules.
description_zh_TW: 異源激素假說認為，天然存在的植物化合物——通常在植物遭受乾旱等環境壓力時合成——作為跨物種信號分子，當動物攝入時誘導 hormetic 反應。這些化合物被認為為接受生物體準備了預期的惡化環境條件（動物面臨飢荒，植物面臨乾旱）。此概念將 hormesis 框架擴展到飲食植物化學物質，可能有助於解釋某些植物來源分子的藥用價值。

label: Longevity
description: An SNP in SIRT3 (rs11555236, in linkage with a putative enhancer) is associated with increased longevity, male-specific in some cohorts and whole-population in the TRELONG study, with homozygotes showing higher SIRT3 expression, supporting a role for SIRT3 variation in human lifespan. Directionally, the genetic variant is associated with longevity through increased SIRT3 expression. By raising SIRT3 levels, the variant may enhance mitochondrial function and stress resistance. These genetic associations complement the animal data linking SIRT3 to healthspan and position SIRT3 as a candidate human longevity gene.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3中的一個SNP（rs11555236，與一個推定增強子連鎖）與壽命延長相關，在某些群體中具有雄性特異性，在TRELONG研究中則為全人群相關，純合子表現出較高的SIRT3表達，支持SIRT3變異在人類壽命中的作用。方向上，遺傳變異透過增加SIRT3表達與壽命延長相關。透過提高SIRT3水平，該變異可能增強粒線體功能和壓力抗性。這些遺傳關聯補充了將SIRT3與健康壽命聯繫的動物數據，並將SIRT3定位為人類長壽的候選基因。

label: NADPH oxidase
description: NADPH oxidase (NOX) enzymes generate superoxide as their primary product and are a major pathological ROS source in the kidney. In angiotensin II-induced nephropathy, SIRT3 counteracts iron overload and inhibits NADPH oxidase-mediated ROS overproduction, attenuating renal fibrogenesis and delaying CKD progression.
description_zh_TW: NADPH 氧化酶（NOX）酵素以超氧陰離子為主要產物，是腎臟中主要的病理性活性氧來源。在血管張力素 II 誘導的腎病變中，SIRT3 對抗鐵過載並抑制 NADPH 氧化酶介導的活性氧過度產生，減輕腎纖維化並延緩 CKD 進展。

label: DNMT1
description: SIRT1 modulates the activity of DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT1) by deacetylating it. Deacetylation of DNMT1 at certain lysine residues improves its methyltransferase activity, alters its transcription suppression activity, and impairs its ability to silence tumour suppressor genes. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of DNMT1 enzymatic activity and thus influences DNA methylation patterns and gene silencing, providing a direct molecular link between sirtuins and the epigenetic machinery.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1透過去乙醯化來調節DNA甲基轉移酶1（DNMT1）的活性。DNMT1在特定賴氨酸殘基的去乙醯化改善了其甲基轉移酶活性，改變了其轉錄抑制活性，並損害了其沉默腫瘤抑制基因的能力。方向上，SIRT1位於DNMT1酵素活性的上游，從而影響DNA甲基化模式和基因沉默，提供了sirtuin與表觀遺傳機制之間的直接分子聯繫。

label: Superoxide Radicals
description: Superoxide radical (O2-*) is the prototypical reactive oxygen species, formed by the addition of a single electron to ground-state molecular oxygen. It is the primary, upstream ROS from which hydrogen peroxide and peroxynitrite are derived through dismutation and radical-radical reactions. Its directionality is as a precursor rather than a terminal effector, and it is relatively unreactive toward most biomolecules compared with downstream species. A caveat is that its major toxicity often arises indirectly through conversion to more reactive products (H2O2, hydroxyl radical, peroxynitrite) rather than from superoxide itself.
description_zh_TW: 超氧自由基 (O2-*) 是典型的 reactive oxygen species，是透過向基態分子氧添加單一電子而形成的。它是主要的上游ROS，透過歧化和自由基-自由基反應衍生出hydrogen peroxide和peroxynitrite。它的方向性是作為前體而不是末端效應器，與下游物種相比，它對大多數生物分子的反應性相對較低。需要注意的是，其主要毒性通常是透過轉化為更具反應性的產物（H2O2、羥基自由基、peroxynitrite）而非超氧化物本身間接產生的。

label: Silver
description: Silver(I) oxide (PubChem CID 88641, formula Ag2H2O, molecular weight 233.752 g/mol) is an oxide of silver used to prepare other silver compounds and in silver oxide batteries. Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47 that occurs naturally in free form, in alloys with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. The oxide therefore serves as a convenient silver source for synthesis and for electrochemical applications in consumer electronics.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)（PubChem CID 88641，化學式Ag2H2O，分子量233.752 g/mol）是用於製備其他銀化合物及銀氧化物電池的銀氧化物。銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47，自然存在於游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。因此，該氧化物可作為合成及消費電子產品電化學應用的便捷銀源。

label: Ascorbic Acid
description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) acts as an antioxidant and reducing agent that inhibits the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome. It scavenges reactive oxygen species that drive catechol oxidation and reduces oxidized intermediates back to epinephrine, effectively reversing the early steps of the reaction. In laboratory settings vitamin C has been shown to inhibit the pink-to-red discoloration of adrenaline solutions caused by adrenochrome formation, and it is used as a stabilizing agent in pharmaceutical epinephrine preparations. Antioxidants such as ascorbic acid therefore represent a natural brake on the adrenochrome pathway in both formulations and biological systems.
description_zh_TW: Ascorbic acid（維生素 C）作為 antioxidant 與 reducing agent，抑制 epinephrine 氧化成 adrenochrome。它清除驅動兒茶酚氧化的 reactive oxygen species，並將氧化的中間產物還原回 epinephrine，有效逆轉反應的早期步驟。在實驗室環境中，維生素 C 已被證實能抑制 adrenaline 溶液因 adrenochrome 形成而產生的粉紅至紅色變色，並被用作藥用 epinephrine 製劑中的 stabilizing agent。因此，ascorbic acid 等 antioxidants 在製劑與生物系統中，都代表了對 adrenochrome pathway 的天然制動作用。

label: Partial Reprogramming
description: Partial reprogramming (e.g., via Yamanaka factors) can reset epigenetic information, supporting the idea that aging is reversible at the information level. This connection to cellular reprogramming complements the RCM hypothesis, which frames aging as an epigenetic software problem rather than purely hardware (mutation) damage. Because epigenetic changes can potentially be reset, unlike permanent mutations, reprogramming-based approaches offer a route to restoring youthful gene expression patterns.
description_zh_TW: 部分重編程（例如透過 Yamanaka 因子）可以重置表觀遺傳資訊，支持了衰老在資訊層面可逆的觀點。這種與細胞重編程的關聯補充了 RCM 假說，該假說將衰老定位為表觀遺傳軟體問題，而非單純的硬體（突變）損傷。由於表觀遺傳變化不像永久性突變那樣無法逆轉，基於重編程的方法提供了恢復年輕基因表達模式的途徑。

label: Nitric Oxide
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) has 'NO oxidase' activity, consuming nitric oxide and thereby contributing to endothelial dysfunction. Because nitric oxide is a key vasodilator, its MPO-mediated consumption shifts the local redox balance and is one way MPO promotes cardiovascular pathology. Elevated MPO levels and activity are associated with increased oxidative stress, cardiovascular risk, and chronic inflammation, and MPO serves as both a biomarker and a mediator of these processes, with its oxidants also modifying LDL into more atherogenic forms.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）具有「NO oxidase」activity，consuming nitric oxide從而contributing to endothelial dysfunction。由於nitric oxide是key vasodilator，其MPO-mediated consumption shifts the local redox balance，是MPO promotes cardiovascular pathology的one way。Elevated MPO levels與activity與increased oxidative stress、cardiovascular risk及chronic inflammation相關，且MPO serves as both a biomarker與a mediator of these processes，其oxidants亦modifying LDL into more atherogenic forms。

label: Glycolysis
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: SIRT5 is protumorigenic in CRC, HCC and NSCLC, reprogramming metabolism toward glycolysis and glutaminolysis; it desuccinylates LDHB to hyperactivate autophagy, feeding recycled nutrients to tumor cells. Its desuccinylase chemistry makes it resistant to nicotinamide inhibition.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 在 CRC、HCC 與 NSCLC 中具促癌性，將代謝重新編程朝向糖酵解與谷氨酰胺分解；它去琥珀酰化 LDHB 以過度活化自噬，為腫瘤細胞提供回收營養。其去琥珀酰酶化學特性使其對煙鹼醯胺抑制具抗性。

label: MyD88
description: MyD88 is a cytoplasmic adaptor protein serving as the central hub of Toll-like receptor (TLR) and IL-1R signaling, linking receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Its classification as an adaptor reflects its role in assembling signaling complexes rather than performing enzymatic catalysis, and it does so through death domain and TIR domain interactions. In senescence, MyD88 transduces IL-1alpha signals that sustain the SASP, placing it at the interface of innate immunity and senescence. It is a foundational innate immune signaling scaffold conserved across species.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 是一種銜接蛋白（adaptor protein），將先天免疫受體如 IL-1R 與 TLR 的胞質訊號域連結到下游 IRAK 激酶與 TRAF6。作為 Toll/IL-1R（TIR）訊號的主要轉接器，其歸類為銜接蛋白反映其在組裝訊號複合體中的支架角色。在衰老中，MyD88 是將 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器連結到 NF-κB 與 SASP 的核心節點。其銜接功能使其成為衰老發炎級聯的中央中樞。

label: IDO1
description: IDO1 is controlled post-translationally: phosphorylation of its ITIM motifs recruits SOCS3, leading to ubiquitination and degradation of IDO1 as a negative feedback mechanism. This degradation pathway limits IDO1 activity and terminates its immunosuppressive effects, representing a key regulatory checkpoint. IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic signaling such as PI3K activation. IDO2 may compete for heme and act as a negative regulator in some settings. These regulatory layers are important for therapeutic targeting of IDO1, as they influence the durability and magnitude of tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production in the tumor microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: IDO1在翻譯後被控制：其ITIM基序的磷酸化招募SOCS3，導致IDO1的泛素化和降解，作為負反饋機制。這種降解途徑限制IDO1活性並終止其免疫抑製作用，代表一個關鍵的調節檢查點。IDO1還可以介導非酶信號，如PI3K激活。IDO2可能在某些情況下競爭血紅素並作為負調節因子。這些調節層對於IDO1的治療靶向很重要，因為它們影響腫瘤微環境中色氨酸耗竭和犬尿氨酸產生的持久性和幅度。

label: Cellular Reprogramming
description: Cellular reprogramming is fundamentally an epigenetic remodeling process that erases somatic memory and installs a new cellular identity. Reprogramming requires global erasure of somatic DNA methylation, reconfiguration of histone marks, and resetting of the chromatin landscape at pluripotency loci, driven by pioneer factors and chromatin remodelers. The process proceeds through defined phases, including a mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition, and culminates in the establishment of a stable pluripotent state in induced pluripotent stem cells.
description_zh_TW: 細胞重編程從根本上來說是一種表觀遺傳重塑過程，它會消除體細胞記憶並安裝新的細胞身份。重編程需要在先鋒因子和染色質重塑因子的驅動下，全面消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化、重新配置組蛋白標記以及重置多能性位點的染色質景觀。這個過程經歷確定的階段，包括間質到上皮的轉變，並最終在誘導多能幹細胞中建立穩定的多能狀態。

label: Hydrogen Peroxide
description: Catalase, constitutively present in the peroxisomal matrix, decomposes hydrogen peroxide — a toxic byproduct of peroxisomal oxidase reactions — into water and oxygen (2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2). This makes peroxisomes central to cellular detoxification of reactive oxygen species.
description_zh_TW: Catalase 恆定存在於過氧化體基質中，可將過氧化氫（過氧化物體氧化酶反應產生的毒性副產物）分解為水與氧（2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2）。這使過氧化物體成為細胞解毒活性氧族群的核心場所。

label: Aspirin
description: Aspirin not only reduces inflammation, a hallmark of aging, it also reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease, thrombosis and cancer; low-dose aspirin prevents one-third of colorectal, gastric and esophageal cancers. Millions of people take aspirin daily to prevent cardiovascular disease and cancer, and it was calculated that the benefits of aspirin are greater than its risks despite side effects including life-threatening gastric bleeding. The author argues that the benefits of the anti-aging effects of rapamycin and everolimus may be even greater, and that aspirin can be combined with rapamycin in an anti-aging formulation.
description_zh_TW: 阿斯匹靈（aspirin）不僅能減少發炎——衰老的特徵之一——還能降低心血管疾病、血栓與癌症的風險；低劑量阿斯匹靈可預防三分之一的結直腸癌、胃癌與食道癌。數百萬人每天服用阿斯匹靈以預防心血管疾病與癌症；據估算，儘管有包括危及生命的胃出血等副作用，阿斯匹靈的益處仍大於風險。作者主張，雷帕黴素（rapamycin）與依維莫司（everolimus）的抗衰老效果益處可能更大，且阿斯匹靈可與雷帕黴素合併納入抗衰老配方。

label: Paracrine Senescence
description: SASP factors such as IL-1α, TGFβ, VEGF, and CCL2 can act in an autocrine and paracrine manner to reinforce the senescent state and induce growth arrest in neighboring healthy cells -- a process termed paracrine (or bystander) senescence. This spreads the arrested phenotype through tissues, amplifying the functional impact of a small senescent fraction. The directionality is outward: the secretome of one cell converts adjacent cells into a senescent state. A caveat is that paracrine senescence requires susceptible recipients and sufficient SASP magnitude, and it can be both tumor-suppressive and pathological.
description_zh_TW: SASP 因子如 IL-1α、TGFβ、VEGF 與 CCL2 可以自分泌與旁分泌方式作用，強化衰老狀態並誘發鄰近健康細胞的生長停滯——此過程稱為旁分泌（或旁觀者）衰老。這透過組織擴散停滯表型，放大少數衰老細胞的功能性影響。其方向性向外：一個細胞的分泌組將鄰近細胞轉化為衰老狀態。需注意，旁分泌衰老需要易受影响的受體細胞與足夠的 SASP 強度，且可同時具腫瘤抑制與致病性。

label: Histone Acetylation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: SIRT1 removes acetyl groups from histones, promoting a repressive/condensed chromatin state at target loci.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 移除組蛋白上的乙醯基團，促進靶位點的抑制性/凝縮染色質狀態。

label: Liver
description: Once absorbed into the circulation, urolithin A undergoes further metabolism through multiple metabolic pathways, with the liver playing a central role. Metabolic enzymes present in the liver convert urolithin A into its mercaptan and sulfate forms. Hepatic enzyme inducers such as rifampicin and carbamazepine can increase the activity of these metabolic enzymes, accelerating urolithin A metabolism and reducing its half-life in the body, whereas enzyme inhibitors such as clarithromycin slow its metabolism and clearance and can lead to accumulation of urolithin A.
description_zh_TW: 一旦吸收進入循環系統，urolithin A 會經由多條代謝途徑進一步代謝，其中肝臟扮演核心角色。肝臟中的代謝酶將 urolithin A 轉化為其硫醇（mercaptan）與硫酸鹽（sulfate）形式。肝臟酶誘導劑如 rifampicin 與 carbamazepine 可提升這些代謝酶的活性，加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期；而酶抑制劑如 clarithromycin 則減緩其代謝與清除，可能導致 urolithin A 蓄積。

label: D2 receptor
description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

label: Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
description: The four Yamanaka factors revert differentiated somatic cells such as fibroblasts to an embryonic-stem-cell-like state, generating induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). Reprogramming erases somatic methylation and chromatin marks and re-establishes the pluripotency network, yielding cells capable of differentiating into all three germ layers. iPSCs are widely used for disease modeling, drug discovery, and regenerative medicine, and are validated by their ability to form teratomas containing derivatives of all three germ layers.
description_zh_TW: 四種山中因子將纖維母細胞等分化的體細胞恢復為胚胎幹細胞樣狀態，產生誘導性多能幹細胞 (iPSC)。重編程消除了體細胞甲基化和染色質標記，並重新建立了多能性網絡，產生能夠分化為所有三個胚層的細胞。 iPSC 廣泛用於疾病建模、藥物發現和再生醫學，並透過其形成含有所有三個胚層衍生物的畸胎瘤的能力得到驗證。

label: eNOS
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Resveratrol-activated endothelial SIRT1 increases eNOS expression and deacetylates and activates it, enhancing nitric-oxide production and promoting vasodilation. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of eNOS activation in the endothelium. Improved NO bioavailability lowers vascular tone, protects against endothelial dysfunction, and reduces platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation. This underlies resveratrol's cardiovascular and French-paradox associations, and SIRT1's regulation of eNOS is one of its best-established vascular mechanisms, linking sirtuin activity directly to blood-vessel health and blood-pressure control.
description_zh_TW: 被白藜蘆醇活化的內皮 SIRT1 增加 eNOS 表達並去乙醯化和活化它，增強一氧化氮產生並促進血管舒張。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於內皮中 eNOS 活化的上游。改善的 NO 生物利用度降低血管張力、保護對抗內皮功能障礙，並減少血小板聚集和平滑肌增殖。這是白藜蘆醇心血管益處和法國悖論關聯的基礎，SIRT1 對 eNOS 的調節是其最佳確立的血管機制之一，將 sirtuin 活性直接與血管健康和血壓控制聯繫起來。

label: Catalase
description: Catalase, constitutively present in the peroxisomal matrix, decomposes hydrogen peroxide — a toxic byproduct of peroxisomal oxidase reactions — into water and oxygen (2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2). This makes peroxisomes central to cellular detoxification of reactive oxygen species.
description_zh_TW: Catalase 恆定存在於過氧化體基質中，可將過氧化氫（過氧化物體氧化酶反應產生的毒性副產物）分解為水與氧（2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2）。這使過氧化物體成為細胞解毒活性氧族群的核心場所。

label: Peroxynitrite
description: Superoxide radicals form peroxynitrite upon reaction with nitric oxide, producing a powerful oxidant and nitrating agent (ONOO-). This species is the key molecular bridge between oxidative and nitrative stress pathways. The directionality flows from two radicals to a single, more damaging hybrid molecule. A caveat is that peroxynitrite exists in equilibrium with its conjugate acid and decomposes to secondary radicals, so its biological effects are context- and pH-dependent. This union is among the fastest known reactions and outcompetes superoxide dismutase for superoxide, so peroxynitrite builds up readily in inflamed or reperfused tissue.
description_zh_TW: Superoxide radicals 與 nitric oxide 反應形成 peroxynitrite，產生強氧化劑和硝化劑（ONOO-）。該物種是氧化途徑和 nitrative stress 途徑之間的關鍵分子橋樑。方向性從兩個自由基流向一個更 damaging 混合分子。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 與其共軛酸處於平衡狀態，並分解為次級自由基，因此其生物效應取決於環境和 pH 值。這種結合是已知最快的反應之一，並且在超氧化物方面勝過 superoxide dismutase，因此 peroxynitrite 很容易在發炎或再灌注的組織中累積。

label: Caspase-9
description: Cytochrome c released through BAX/BAK-permeabilized mitochondria binds Apaf-1 (apoptotic protease activating factor-1), which together with procaspase-9 assembles the heptameric apoptosome. Within this platform procaspase-9 is activated and in turn cleaves caspase-3, committing the cell to intrinsic apoptosis. The apoptosome is therefore the router that converts mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization into caspase-9 activation, and it is the very complex whose additional components (such as SIRT1 after caspase cleavage) reshape cell fate.
description_zh_TW: 經由 BAX/BAK 通透化的粒線體所釋出的 Cytochrome c 會結合 Apaf-1（凋亡蛋白酶活化因子-1），並與 pro-Caspase-9 共同組裝成七聚體凋亡體（apoptosome）。在此平台上 pro-Caspase-9 被活化，進而切割 Caspase-3，使細胞走向內在凋亡。凋亡體因此是將粒線體外膜通透化轉換為 Caspase-9 活化的路由器，也正是 SIRT1（在 caspase 切割後）重塑細胞命運時所處的複合體。

label: Protein Restriction
description: Dietary protein restriction (PR) is a robust geroprotective regimen that extends lifespan in yeast, flies, and rodents and improves healthspan. Rodent studies demonstrate lifespan extension across many strains (for example, 34.9% in male C57BL/6J mice on a 21% vs 7% protein diet, and large extensions in flies), while restriction of specific essential amino acids - particularly methionine, isoleucine, and valine - recapitulates many of PR's benefits. FGF21-null mice do not live longer on PR, identifying FGF21 as essential for the longevity benefits. The Okinawan population's ~9% protein diet is cited as a human parallel to PR's lifespan effects.
description_zh_TW: 飲食蛋白質限制（PR）是一種強健的抗老化方案，在酵母、果蠅和囓齒動物中延長壽命並改善健康span。囓齒動物研究顯示多種品系的壽命延長（例如，21%對7%蛋白質飲食的雄性C57BL/6J小鼠延長34.9%，果蠅中也有大幅延長），而特定必需胺基酸——特別是甲硫氨酸、異亮氨酸和纈氨酸——的限制重現了PR的許多益處。FGF21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長，確定了FGF21對壽命益處的必要性。沖繩人口約9%蛋白質飲食被引用為人類中與PR壽命效應平行的例子。

label: FSP1
description: Ubiquinone (CoQ10, oxidized) is the direct electron acceptor for FSP1, a plasma-membrane flavoprotein that uses NAD(P)H to reduce CoQ10 to ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that terminates phospholipid peroxyl-radical chains and suppresses ferroptosis. This FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis is glutathione-independent and acts in parallel to GPX4. Because CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway, statin-mediated depletion starves FSP1 of substrate and sensitizes cells to ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 泛醌（CoQ10，氧化態）是 FSP1 的直接電子受體；FSP1 是一種質膜黃素蛋白，利用 NAD(P)H 將 CoQ10 還原為泛醇（CoQ10H2），後者是脂溶性自由基捕獲抗氧化劑，能終止磷脂過氧自由基鏈並抑制鐵死亡。這條 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸不依賴谷胱甘肽，並與 GPX4 平行運作。由於 CoQ10 是甲羥戊酸路徑的非固醇產物，statin 介導的耗竭會使 FSP1 缺乏受質並使細胞對鐵死亡增敏。

label: Insulin Resistance
description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is widely considered a hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome as it is found to be associated with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and insulin resistance, and sirtuins are downregulated in NAFLD patients, a state characterized by liver steatosis. Raising NAD+ through nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation can restore sirtuin-driven fatty acid oxidation, inhibit lipogenesis, and reduce cholesterol levels, thereby improving liver health and reducing fat accumulation through induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
description_zh_TW: 非酒精性脂肪肝疾病（NAFLD）被廣泛視為代謝症候群的肝臟表現，因為它被發現與第二型糖尿病、肥胖與胰島素抗性相關，且 sirtuins 在 NAFLD 患者中被下調，此狀態以肝臟脂肪變性為特徵。透過 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充提升 NAD+ 能恢復 sirtuin 驅動的脂肪酸氧化、抑制脂肪生成並降低膽固醇水平，從而透過誘發粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應改善肝臟健康並減少脂肪堆積。

label: IL-6
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) treatment decreases IL-6 along with other inflammatory markers including NLRP3, CASP1, IL-1, and TNF-alpha in the whole brain of high-fat-diet-fed mice, contributing to reduced neuroinflammation and improved cognitive function. NR can similarly decrease IL-2, IL-5, IL-6, and TNF-alpha in human studies, and a 21-day supplementation of NR decreased numerous circulating inflammatory cytokines. Targeting IL-6 has been proposed as a promising treatment to block the inflammatory storm, especially in severe COVID-19 patients, supporting the potential of NR as an anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory agent in infection and age-related inflammatory conditions.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）治療降低了高脂飲食小鼠全腦中的 IL-6 以及其他發炎標記，包括 NLRP3、CASP1、IL-1 與 TNF-alpha，有助於減少神經發炎並改善認知功能。NR 在人體研究中同樣能降低 IL-2、IL-5、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha，且 21 天的 NR 補充降低了眾多循環中的發炎性細胞激素。針對 IL-6 已被提議為阻斷發炎風暴（尤其是重症 COVID-19 患者）的有前景療法，這支持了 NR 在感染與年齡相關發炎狀態中作為抗發炎與免疫調節劑的潛力。

label: p38 MAPK
description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates caspase-3 at Ser150, suppressing its proteolytic activity; this inhibition is reversed by the phosphatase PP2A. Directionally, p38 sits upstream of caspase-3 inhibition. This provides a survival signal that tempers apoptosis under certain stresses, and it shows that stress kinases can directly restrain executioner caspases. By phosphorylating pro-caspase-3, p38 reduces the pool available for proteolytic activation, blunting the death response. This regulatory layer illustrates how the balance between kinases and phosphatases determines the threshold for apoptotic commitment under stress.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在 Ser150 位點磷酸化 caspase-3，抑制其蛋白水解活性；此抑制可被磷酸酶 PP2A 逆轉。在方向性上，p38 位於 caspase-3 抑制的上游。這在某些壓力下提供生存訊號以調節凋亡，並表明壓力激酶可以直接抑制效應型 caspase。透過磷酸化前 caspase-3，p38 減少可用於蛋白水解活化的池，削弱死亡反應。這一調控層說明了激酶和磷酸酶之間的平衡如何決定壓力下的凋亡承諾閾值。

label: Methemoglobinemia
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'. Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron. Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'。Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron。Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages。

label: Akt
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Akt signaling is associated with inhibition of SIRT2-dependent cell-cycle and stress outputs (e.g., cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylates SIRT2 at Ser331 to reduce its deacetylase activity), placing AKT signaling among negative regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304).
description_zh_TW: Akt 信號與 SIRT2 依賴性的細胞週期和壓力輸出的抑制相關（例如 cyclin E-CDK2 在 Ser331 處磷酸化 SIRT2 以降低其去乙醯酶活性），將 AKT 信號列為 SIRT2 通路的負向調節因子（Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304）。

label: Hydroxyl Radicals
description: Hydroxyl radicals (OH*) are the most reactive and indiscriminately damaging members of the reactive oxygen species family, reacting at near diffusion-limited rates with almost every class of biomolecule. They are not stored or transported but arise locally and instantaneously from hydrogen peroxide via Fenton or Haber-Weiss chemistry in the presence of reduced transition metals. Their directionality is terminal and destructive; they cannot be enzymatically scavenged once formed because they react before diffusing. A caveat is that their extreme reactivity means damage is confined to the site of generation, implicating metal localization as the critical determinant of target selectivity.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals (OH*) 是 reactive oxygen species 家族中反應性最強且不加區別的 damaging 成員，幾乎與每一類生物分子都以接近擴散極限的速率發生反應。它們不會被儲存或運輸，而是在還原的過渡金屬存在下透過芬頓或哈伯-韋斯化學從 hydrogen peroxide 本地即時產生。它們的方向性是終極的、具破壞性的；它們一旦形成就不能被酵素清除，因為它們在擴散之前發生反應。需要注意的是，它們的極端反應性意味著損傷僅限於產生部位，這意味著金屬定位是目標選擇性的關鍵決定因素。

label: synaptic plasticity
description: CaMKIIalpha is essential for synaptic plasticity, including long-term potentiation (LTP) and long-term depression (LTD), by phosphorylating AMPA receptor subunits and structural proteins that consolidate changes in synaptic efficacy. Inhibition or knockout of CaMKIIalpha abolishes LTP at many synapses, confirming its necessity. Its autophosphorylation at threonine 286 generates calcium-independent activity that maintains potentiated transmission over time. It thus serves as a molecular switch converting transient calcium signals into lasting synaptic memory.
description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha 對於 synaptic plasticity 至關重要，包括長時程增強 (LTP) 和長時程抑制 (LTD)，透過磷酸化 AMPA 受體亞基和結構蛋白來鞏固突觸功效的變化。抑製或敲除 CaMKIIalpha 可消除許多突觸的 LTP，證實了其必要性。其蘇氨酸 286 處的自磷酸化產生不依賴鈣的活性，可隨著時間的推移維持增強的傳輸。因此，它充當分子開關，將瞬態鈣訊號轉換為持久的突觸記憶。

label: ICE Mouse
description: The ICE (Induced Changes in Epigenetics) Mouse uses inducible I-PpoI expression to introduce targeted double-strand breaks that are repaired without introducing mutations. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of controlled double-strand-break formation. This lets researchers trigger DNA damage alone, isolating epigenetic from mutational effects, and it is the experimental engine of the RCM model. By using sequence-specific breaks that are repaired faithfully, the ICE Mouse creates pure DNA-repair events. This design is central to testing whether DNA damage drives aging through epigenetic information loss.
description_zh_TW: ICE（表觀遺傳誘導變化）小鼠使用誘導型 I-PpoI 表達引入靶向的雙鏈斷裂，這些斷裂在不引入突變的情況下被修復。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於受控雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。這讓研究人員僅觸發 DNA 損傷，將表觀遺傳與突變效應分離，是 RCM 模型的實驗引擎。透過使用被忠實修復的序列特異性斷裂，ICE 小鼠創造純粹的 DNA 修復事件。此設計對於測試 DNA 損傷是否透過表觀遺傳資訊喪失驅動衰老至關重要。

label: Lipid Peroxidation
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Coenzyme Q10 protects against lipid peroxidation because ubiquinol reduces lipid peroxyl radicals in the bilayer, terminating chain reactions similarly to vitamin E. Its high concentration in membranes makes it a front-line chain breaker. The directionality is reduced CoQ10 to peroxyl radical termination. A caveat is that ubiquinol is rapidly consumed and must be regenerated enzymatically, so its protective capacity depends on the redox state of the CoQ pool. CoQ10 levels decline with age and in some pathologies, and supplementation is often used to restore membrane redox protection.
description_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 可防止 lipid peroxidation，因為泛醇可減少雙層中的脂質過氧自由基，從而終止與 vitamin E 類似的鍊式反應。它在膜中的高濃度使其成為一線的鏈條破壞者。方向性是 CoQ10 還原為過氧自由基終止。需要注意的是，泛醇會迅速消耗，必須透過酵素再生，因此其保護能力取決於 CoQ 池的氧化還原狀態。 CoQ10 水平隨著年齡的增長和某些疾病而下降，補充通常用於恢復膜的氧化還原保護。

label: Nicotinamide
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide, the deamidated form of vitamin B3 and a product of the sirtuin deacetylation reaction, is an endogenous non-competitive feedback inhibitor of sirtuins that binds the C-pocket of the catalytic domain at high concentrations, blocking NAD+ re-entry. High nicotinamide-to-NAD+ ratios therefore suppress SIRT1 activity, providing a natural brake that is relieved when the ratio is high, for example during caloric restriction. This rationalizes NAD+ precursor supplementation to disinhibit sirtuins. SIRT5, notably, is relatively resistant to nicotinamide inhibition.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺（Nicotinamide）是維生素 B3 的去醯胺形式，也是 sirtuin 去乙醯化反應的產物，是 sirtuin 的內源性非競爭性回饋抑制劑，在高濃度時結合催化域的 C 型口袋，阻斷 NAD+ 的再進入。因此高菸鹼醯胺/NAD+ 比率會抑制 SIRT1 活性，提供一種在比率升高時（例如在限制熱量期間）被解除的天然制動器。這合理解釋了使用 NAD+ 前驅物補充以解除 sirtuin 抑制的策略。值得注意的是，SIRT5 對菸鹼醯胺抑制具有相對抗性。

label: Inflammation
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: MLKL-driven plasma membrane rupture releases damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), which immune cells recognize to eliminate harmful cells and initiate repair. When the inflammatory response remains uncontrolled, this same mechanism drives pathology: cancer, Alzheimer's, parkinsonism, multiple sclerosis, pulmonary, liver, enteric, and cardiac diseases. MLKL-mediated DAMP release is therefore the mechanistic bridge between necroptosis as a host-defense program and necroinflammatory chronic disease.
description_zh_TW: MLKL 驅動的細胞膜破裂會釋出損傷相關分子模式（DAMP），免疫細胞藉此辨識並清除有害細胞、啟動修復。當發炎反應失控時，同一機制便成為病理推手：癌症、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症、多發性硬化症、肺、肝、腸道與心臟疾病。MLKL 介導的 DAMP 釋放因此是「程序性壞死作為宿主防禦程序」與「壞死性發炎慢性疾病」之間的機制橋樑。

label: DRP1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Drp1 is the GTP-binding protein that executes mitochondrial fission: it translocates from the cytosol to mitochondria to sever the organelle, a prerequisite for segregating damaged mitochondria and enacting mitophagy. Drp1-mediated fission sits at the hub of multiple death modalities — PGAM5 and RIPK3 recruit it for necroptosis, BNIP3-interacting pathways engage it in apoptosis, and Parkin regulates its activity and degradation by polyubiquitination. Its recruitment is therefore both a quality-control step and a death-priming step depending on context.
description_zh_TW: Drp1 是執行粒線體分裂的 GTP 結合蛋白：它會由細胞質轉位至粒線體將其切斷，這是隔離受損粒線體並執行粒線體自噬的前提。Drp1 介導的分裂位於多種死亡模式的樞紐——PGAM5 與 RIPK3 為程序性壞死而招募它，BNIP3 相關路徑在細胞凋亡中動用它，而 Parkin 則透過多泛素化調控其活性與降解。因此 Drp1 的招募依情境不同，既可能是品質管制步驟，也可能是死亡致敏步驟。

label: Flavonoids
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Flavonoids are the major class of polyphenols and possess anti-glycation properties. Anti-glycation activities of various flavonoids, such as kaempferol, genistein, quercitrin, and quercetin, have been reported, with potencies similar to or stronger than the reference AGE inhibitor aminoguanidine. These natural products with high antioxidant capacity inhibit protein glycation both in vitro and in vivo, and their anti-AGE activity may be one mechanism of their beneficial effects on human health. Herbal products rich in flavonoids are therefore investigated as safer alternatives to synthetic AGE inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: 類黃酮是多酚的主要類別，並具有抗糖化特性。各種類黃酮（如山奈酚、金雀異黃素、槲皮苷與槲皮素）的抗糖化活性已有文獻報導，其效力與參考用 AGE 抑制劑氨基胍相似或更強。這些具有高抗氧化能力的天然產物在體外與體內均能抑制蛋白質糖化，而其抗 AGE 活性可能是其對人體健康有益作用的機制之一。因此，富含類黃酮的草本產品被研究作為合成 AGE 抑制劑的更安全替代方案。

label: Neuroprotection
description: SIRT1 confers neuroprotection by deacetylating FOXO and PGC-1alpha to drive antioxidant and mitochondrial programs, suppressing NF-kB-mediated neuroinflammation, and promoting non-amyloidogenic APP processing via ADAM10; it protects against beta-amyloid toxicity and supports BDNF expression through Hes1 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 FOXO 和 PGC-1alpha 來驅動抗氧化和粒線體程序，抑制 NF-kB 介導的神經發炎反應，並透過 ADAM10 促進非類澱粉樣 APP 處理，從而賦予神經保護作用；它保護免受 β-類澱粉毒性並透過 Hes1 去乙醯化支持 BDNF 表達。

label: MnSOD
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates MnSOD (SOD2); the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio therefore reflects mitochondrial ROS-buffering capacity and links the ratio node to its MnSOD substrate.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD（SOD2）；因此 SIRT3/SIRT4 比例反映粒線體 ROS 緩衝能力，並將比例節點連結至其 MnSOD 基質。

label: Thymic Involution
description: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

label: Chemical memory
description: Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: DNA Damage
description: Dietary supplementation of nicotinamide riboside (NR) restored NAD+ levels caused by impaired biosynthesis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma and thereby prevented both DNA damage and tumorigenesis. NAD+ is required by sirtuins and PARPs that mediate DNA repair, and its depletion, driven by DNA damage and stress, is a feature of aging and age-associated pathology. By maintaining NAD+ availability for DNA repair enzymes and improving oxidative stress responses, NR displays beneficial effects on DNA repair in Alzheimer's disease mouse models as well. These findings support NR as a protective agent against genotoxic stress and tumorigenesis in the liver.
description_zh_TW: 飲食補充菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）恢復了因生物合成受損而下降的 NAD+ 水平，此現象見於肝細胞癌小鼠模型，並因此同時預防了 DNA 損傷與腫瘤發生。NAD+ 是介導 DNA 修復的 sirtuins 與 PARPs 所必需的，而其耗竭由 DNA 損傷與壓力所驅動，是老化及老化相關病理的一項特徵。透過維持 NAD+ 供應給 DNA 修復酶並改善氧化壓力反應，NR 在阿茲海默症小鼠模型中亦展現對 DNA 修復的有益效果。這些發現支持 NR 作為對抗肝臟基因毒性壓力與腫瘤發生的保護性物質。

label: Metformin
description: Metformin, the first-line type 2 diabetes drug, activates AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) primarily by inhibiting mitochondrial respiratory complex I, which mildly elevates the cellular AMP/ATP ratio. Activated AMPK phosphorylates downstream targets that restore energy homeostasis, including TSC2 and Raptor, which in turn suppress mTORC1. This indirect, energy-stress-mediated activation distinguishes metformin from direct AMPK agonists and underlies many of its metabolic benefits. AMPK activation by metformin also accounts for its autophagy-inducing and potential anti-aging effects.
description_zh_TW: Metformin是一線第二型糖尿病藥物，主要透過抑制粒線體呼吸鏈複合體I來活化AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK），輕微提高細胞AMP/ATP比值。活化的AMPK磷酸化下游標靶以恢復能量穩態，包括TSC2和Raptor，後者進而抑制mTORC1。這種間接的、能量壓力介導的活化使metformin有別於直接的AMPK激動劑，並構成其許多代謝益處的基礎。Metformin對AMPK的活化也解釋了其誘導自噬和潛在抗老化的效應。

label: Glutathione
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Glycine is the third residue of the gamma-glutamyl-cysteinyl-glycine tripeptide and becomes rate-limiting for glutathione synthesis under metabolic stress, aging, and methylglyoxal overload.
description_zh_TW: 甘胺酸是 γ-麩胺醯-半胱胺醯-甘胺酸三肽的第三個殘基，在代謝壓力、老化與甲基乙二醛過載下成為穀胱甘肽合成的限速因子。

label: Caspase-3
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: In the extrinsic (death receptor) pathway, FasL or TNF-α engagement assembles the DISC, activating initiator caspase-8 (with caspase-10), which directly cleaves the executioner caspase-3 in type I cells. In type II cells caspase-8 instead cleaves Bid, routing through mitochondria. Caspase-8 sits at the crossroads of apoptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis because its active form also cleaves RIPK1 and RIPK3, preventing necroptosis — so caspase-8-to-caspase-3 flow is simultaneously a death signal and a necroptosis suppressor.
description_zh_TW: 在外在（死亡受體）路徑中，FasL 或 TNF-α 的結合組裝出 DISC，活化起始 caspase-8（與 caspase-10），其在 type I 細胞中直接切割執行者 Caspase-3；在 type II 細胞中 caspase-8 則切割 Bid，改經粒線體路徑。Caspase-8 位於細胞凋亡、程序性壞死與細胞焦亡的十字路口，因為其活化形式也會切割 RIPK1 與 RIPK3 從而阻止程序性壞死——因此 caspase-8 至 Caspase-3 的流動既是死亡訊號，也是程序性壞死的抑制者。

label: CD38
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Beyond direct K-type SIRT1 activation, quercetin (with apigenin) inhibits CD38, an NAD+ hydrolase, thereby boosting cellular NAD+ availability — a NAD+-boosting mechanism distinct from allostery. This dual role means quercetin sits in both the direct-STAC and the NAD+-modulator camps.
description_zh_TW: 除了直接 K 型活化 SIRT1，quercetin（與 apigenin）還抑制 CD38（一種 NAD+ 水解酶），從而提升細胞 NAD+ 可及性——這是不同於別構的 NAD+ 提升機制。此雙重角色使 quercetin 同時處於直接 STAC 與 NAD+ 調節劑兩個陣營。

label: Acid ceramidase
description: Acid ceramidase (ASAH1) is a poor-prognosis marker and therapeutic target in GBM stem-like cells (Doan et al., Oncotarget 2017; PMID 29348854).
description_zh_TW: 酸性神經醯胺酶 (ASAH1) 是 GBM 幹細胞樣細胞中預後不良的標誌物和治療靶標（Doan et al., Oncotarget 2017; PMID 29348854）。

label: Humanin
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。

label: Quercetin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Quercetin is a flavonol that directly activates SIRT1 via the K-type allosteric mechanism (lowering Km for NAD+ and substrate), placing it among the natural polyphenol STACs alongside resveratrol, piceatannol, butein, fisetin and kaempferol. It also independently boosts SIRT1 by inhibiting CD38 and raising NAD+, giving it a dual (direct STAC + NAD+-modulator) role.
description_zh_TW: Quercetin 是一種黄酮醇，透過 K 型別構機制（降低 NAD+ 與受質的 Km）直接活化 SIRT1，與白藜蘆醇、piceatannol、butein、fisetin、kaempferol 同屬天然多酚類 STACs。它也能透過抑制 CD38、提升 NAD+ 來獨立增強 SIRT1，因此兼具雙重角色（直接 STAC + NAD+ 調節劑）。

label: Mitochondria
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Coenzyme Q10 transfers electrons between mitochondrial Complex I (or II) and Complex III as a mobile lipophilic carrier in the inner membrane, shuttling single electrons and buffering the pool. In its reduced form (ubiquinol) it also acts as an antioxidant. The directionality is electron transport coupled to redox buffering. A caveat is that CoQ10's electron-transfer role is distinct from its antioxidant role, and statin-mediated depletion can affect both. CoQ10 is synthesized endogenously via the mevalonate pathway and is also a potent lipophilic antioxidant in both its ubiquinol and ubiquinone forms.
description_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 作為內膜中的移動親脂載體在 mitochondrial Complex I（或 II）和複合物 III 之間轉移電子，穿梭單一電子並緩衝池。其還原形式（泛醇）也可作為抗氧化劑。方向性是與氧化還原緩衝耦合的電子傳遞。需要注意的是，CoQ10 的電子轉移作用與其抗氧化作用不同，而他汀類藥物介導的耗竭會影響這兩者。 CoQ10 透過甲羥戊酸途徑內源合成，其泛醇和泛醌形式也是一種有效的親脂性抗氧化劑。

label: Mitophagy
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: SIRT1 is an upstream activator of PINK1/Parkin mitophagy — for example via the SIRT1-FOXO1/3-PINK1-Parkin axis recruited during exercise and stress adaptation. Sirtuins also drive mitophagy directly by post-translationally modifying mitophagy proteins (ATG5, ATG7, ATG8) or indirectly by inducing mTORC1-relieved, Parkin, beclin-1, and BNIP3 expression. Because mitophagy disposes of ROS-leaking damaged mitochondria, SIRT1's mitophagy arm connects NAD+ metabolism to both pyroptosis and ferroptosis suppression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬的上游活化因子——例如在運動與壓力適應中招募的 SIRT1-FOXO1/3-PINK1-Parkin 軸線。Sirtuins 也能透過對粒線體自噬蛋白（ATG5、ATG7、ATG8）的轉譯後修飾直接驅動粒線體自噬，或間接透過解除 mTORC1 抑制並誘導 Parkin、beclin-1 與 BNIP3 的表達。由於粒線體自噬會清除滲漏 ROS 的受損粒線體，SIRT1 的這條路徑將 NAD+ 代謝與焦亡及鐵死亡的抑制串聯起來。

label: Alzheimer's Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: NAD+ depletion was observed during the aging process in multiple animals, including humans, and is considered the major risk factor for Alzheimer's disease (AD). Neurodegenerative disorders such as AD are associated with DNA damage and oxidative stress, which accumulate with age and lead to impaired mitochondrial function, while excitotoxicity-driven axonal degeneration causes strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. When administered in AD mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) displays beneficial effects on both oxidative stress and DNA repair by increasing NAD+ levels, and it improves pTau, amyloid-beta, neurogenesis, neuroinflammation, hippocampal synaptic plasticity, and cognition.
description_zh_TW: 在多種動物（包括人類）的老化過程中觀察到 NAD+ 耗竭，且被視為阿茲海默症（AD）的主要風險因子。諸如 AD 之類的神經退化性疾病與 DNA 損傷和氧化壓力相關，這些隨年齡累積並導致粒線體功能受損，而興奮毒性驅動的軸突退化則在神經元中造成強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。在 AD 小鼠模型中給予 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）時，NR 透過提升 NAD+ 水平對氧化壓力與 DNA 修復均展現有益效果，並改善 pTau、amyloid-beta（類澱粉乙型）、神經生成、神經發炎、海馬突觸可塑性與認知功能。

label: mTOR
description: SIRT1 restrains mTOR signaling indirectly (via AMPK/energy sensing), opposing growth/hypertrophic programs.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過 AMPK/能量感知間接地抑制 mTOR 信號，對抗生長/肥大程序。

label: NRF2
description: The NAC moiety acts as a weak electrophile that activates NRF2 signaling, inducing phase-2 antioxidant enzymes independently of glutathione elevation.
description_zh_TW: NAC 成分作為弱親電子試劑活化 NRF2 訊號，在穀胱甘肽提升之外獨立誘導第二相抗氧化酵素。

label: Atherosclerosis
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: SIRT6 protects against endothelial dysfunction, vascular smooth muscle cell senescence, and atherosclerosis in mice through multiple mechanisms, including deacetylation of H3K9 at inflammatory gene promoters and suppression of NF-kappaB signaling. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of vascular homeostasis. By restraining inflammatory gene expression and maintaining endothelial and smooth muscle function, SIRT6 resists the cellular changes that drive atherogenesis. This places SIRT6 among the key sirtuins defending the vasculature against age-related dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6在小鼠中透過多種機制保護免受內皮功能障礙、血管平滑肌細胞衰老和動脈粥樣硬化，包括在發炎基因啟動子上去乙醯化H3K9和抑制NF-kappaB訊號。方向上，SIRT6位於血管恆定的上游。透過抑制發炎基因表達並維持內皮和平滑肌功能，SIRT6抵抗驅動動脈粥樣硬化的細胞變化。這將SIRT6列為防禦血管與年齡相關功能障礙的關鍵sirtuin之一。

label: Ferroptosis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy degrades ferritin stores, expanding the labile iron pool that feeds Fenton chemistry and lipid peroxidation — the core ferroptotic engine. Pharmacological or genetic inhibition of O-GlcNAc transferase activates both ferritinophagy and mitophagy, increasing labile iron and ROS and sensitizing cells to ferroptosis. Iron chelators (deferoxamine, ciclopirox) and ferritinophagy blockade therefore act on the same supply-side node of ferroptosis regulation.
description_zh_TW: NCOA4 介導的鐵蛋白自噬會降解鐵蛋白儲存，擴大可動用鐵池，進而餵養 Fenton 化學與脂質過氧化——鐵死亡的核心引擎。藥理或遺傳抑制 O-GlcNAc 轉移酶會同時活化鐵蛋白自噬與粒線體自噬，增加可動用鐵與 ROS，並使細胞對鐵死亡敏感。因此鐵螯合劑（deferoxamine、ciclopirox）與阻斷鐵蛋白自噬都作用在鐵死亡調控的同一供給端節點。

label: Epigenetic Clock
description: Reprogramming — from Yamanaka-factor iPSC generation to cyclic partial reprogramming in vivo — is the only intervention shown to reverse DNA methylation age while restoring chromatin organization, mitochondrial function, and senescence burden toward youthful states. Partial reprogramming interrupts the process early enough to erase epigenetic marks without losing cell identity, making the epigenetic clock both the readout and the target. This is also the strongest causal evidence that aging is substantially information loss rather than damage accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 重編程——從 Yamanaka 因子的 iPSC 生成到體內的週期性部分重編程——是目前唯一被證明可逆轉 DNA 甲基化年齡的介入方式，同時使染色質組織、粒線體功能與老化負擔朝年輕狀態恢復。部分重編程會在足夠早期的階段中止，以在不喪失細胞身份的前提下抹除表觀遺傳標記，使表觀遺傳時鐘既是測量指標也是作用標的。這也是「老化主要是資訊丟失而非損傷累積」這一論點最強的因果證據。

label: Apigenin
description: Apigenin is a dietary flavone flavonoid identified by screening a 66-compound natural product library against bleomycin-senescent PSC27 human prostate stromal cells. It functions as a senomorphic agent: it suppresses the pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) without killing senescent cells or forcing them back into the cell cycle, in contrast to senolytics such as ABT-263 or procyanidin C1, which preferentially lyse senescent cells. Because it leaves the growth arrest intact, apigenin is classified specifically as a natural senomorphic rather than a senolytic, aligning with the ideal profile for SASP-restraining geroprotective therapy.
description_zh_TW: 芹菜素是一種膳食黃酮類化合物（flavone flavonoid），透過以博萊黴素（bleomycin）誘導衰老的人類前列腺基質細胞PSC27篩選含66種化合物的天然產物庫而鑑定出來。它的功能是衰老形態調節劑（senomorphic agent）：在不殺死衰老細胞、也不強迫其重返細胞週期的情況下，抑制促發炎的衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）；這與優先溶解衰老細胞的衰老細胞清除劑（如ABT-263或原花青素C1）形成對比。由於芹菜素保留了生長停滯狀態，它被明確歸類為天然衰老形態調節劑而非衰老細胞清除劑，符合以抑制SASP為目標的老年保護療法之理想特性。

label: DNA Methylation
description: Aberrant DNA methylation has been observed around PEX genes, ABCD1, and AMPK regulatory genes in peroxisomal disorder cells, suggesting epigenetic silencing downstream of primary genetic defects can further impair peroxisome biogenesis. DNMT inhibitors and HDAC inhibitors are being explored as potential epigenetic therapies, though causation versus correlation remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 在過氧化物體疾病細胞中，已觀察到 PEX 基因、ABCD1 及 AMPK 調控基因周圍出現異常 DNA 甲基化，顯示初級基因缺陷下游的表觀遺傳沉默可能進一步削弱過氧化物體生成。DNMT 抑制劑與 HDAC 抑制劑正被探索為潛在表觀遺傳療法，惟因果關係仍未釐清。

label: Exercise
description: Exercise raises both BDNF and NAD+ levels, and SIRT1 may mediate exercise-induced BDNF upregulation in the hippocampus. Directionally, exercise sits upstream of BDNF and NAD+ elevation. Higher NAD+ fuels SIRT1, which then supports BDNF, and this provides a mechanistic bridge between physical activity, sirtuins, and brain health. By raising NAD+, exercise engages the sirtuin pathway that promotes BDNF expression and mitochondrial function. This axis is central to the well-established cognitive benefits of exercise and to the geroscience concept of exercise as medicine.
description_zh_TW: 運動同時提高 BDNF 和 NAD+ 水平，SIRT1 可能中介運動誘導的海馬 BDNF 上調。在方向性上，運動位於 BDNF 和 NAD+ 提升的上游。較高的 NAD+ 為 SIRT1 提供燃料，後者隨後支持 BDNF，這提供了身體活動、sirtuin 和大腦健康之間的機制橋樑。透過提高 NAD+，運動啟動促進 BDNF 表達和粒線體功能的 sirtuin 途徑。此軸線是運動公認的認知益處和老年科學中運動即藥物概念的核心。

label: NAD+
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Inhibiting CD38, a major consumer of NAD+ that generates nicotinamide and cADPR, preserves cellular NAD+ pools by reducing their catabolic drain. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of higher NAD+ availability. Because all sirtuins require NAD+ as an obligate co-substrate, preserving NAD+ indirectly sustains sirtuin activity across the family. This is a leading strategy to reverse age-related NAD+ decline, and CD38 expression rises with age, further depleting NAD+ and compromising sirtuin function. Pharmacologic CD38 inhibitors such as 78c restore NAD+ and sirtuin activity, and in aged male mice extend lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 抑制 CD38（NAD+ 的主要消耗者，產生菸鹼醯胺和 cADPR）通過減少其分解代謝消耗來保留細胞 NAD+ 池。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於更高 NAD+ 可用性的上游。由於所有 sirtuin 都需要 NAD+ 作為必需共同受質，保留 NAD+ 間接維持整個家族的 sirtuin 活性。這是逆轉與年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降的主要策略，CD38 表達隨年齡升高，進一步消耗 NAD+ 並損害 sirtuin 功能。藥理性 CD38 抑制劑如 78c 恢復 NAD+ 和 sirtuin 活性，在年老雄性小鼠中延長壽命。

label: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside is phosphorylated by NMRK1/NMRK2 to nicotinamide mononucleotide, the direct biosynthetic bridge linking the two major NAD+ precursors and completing the NR->NMN->NAD+ salvage sequence.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷經 NMRK1/NMRK2 磷酸化為菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸，是直接連接兩大 NAD+ 前體的生物合成橋樑，完成 NR→NMN→NAD+ 補救序列。

label: Cellular Senescence
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: SIRT1 inhibits cellular senescence and apoptosis in c-Myc- and PML-driven cancers by deacetylating and inactivating p53 and proapoptotic FOXO transcription factors and by sequestering Bax via deacetylated Ku70. These actions blunt the tumor-suppressive programs that would otherwise eliminate premalignant cells. The directionality is that SIRT1 activity is upstream of senescence suppression, protecting cells from growth arrest. Consequently, SIRT1 inhibitors are frequently anticancer on their own and sensitize cancer cells to anticancer agents or oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並使 p53 和促凋亡 FOXO 轉錄因子失活，以及透過去乙醯化的 Ku70 隔離 Bax，抑制 c-Myc 和 PML 驅動的癌症中的細胞衰老和凋亡。這些作用削弱了 otherwise 會消除癌前細胞的腫瘤抑制程序。方向性上 SIRT1 活性位於衰老抑制的上游，保護細胞免於生長停滯。因此，SIRT1 抑制劑本身常具有抗癌作用，並使癌細胞對抗癌藥物或氧化壓力敏感。

label: mTORC1
description: Under nutrient-rich conditions, mTORC1 phosphorylates ULK1 at Ser757, disrupting its interaction with AMPK and suppressing autophagy. Directionally, mTORC1 sits upstream of ULK1 inhibition. This couples nutrient abundance to autophagic restraint, and it is the basis for rapamycin's autophagy-promoting effects. Sirtuin and AMPK activation opposes mTORC1 to relicense ULK1, connecting sirtuin biology to the nutrient-sensing control of autophagy. The AMPK-mTORC1-ULK1 network is a central regulatory circuit that determines autophagic flux in response to energy and growth signals.
description_zh_TW: 在營養豐富條件下，mTORC1 在 Ser757 位點磷酸化 ULK1，破壞其與 AMPK 的相互作用並抑制自噬。在方向性上，mTORC1 位於 ULK1 抑制的上游。這將營養豐富與自噬抑制偶聯，也是 rapamycin 促自噬效應的基礎。Sirtuin 和 AMPK 活化反對 mTORC1 以重新啟用 ULK1，將 sirtuin 生物學與自噬的營養感知控制聯繫起來。AMPK-mTORC1-UNK1 網絡是決定自噬通量的核心調控迴路，回應能量和生長訊號。

label: Sirtuins
description: As a direct NAD+ precursor, NMN raises NAD+ which supplies the obligate co-substrate for all seven sirtuins, indirectly activating them systemically.
description_zh_TW: 作為直接 NAD+ 前體，NMN 提升 NAD+，提供全部七種 sirtuin 必需的共用受質，進而在全身間接活化它們。

label: Epinephrine
description: Graph node-analysis: COMT links directly to Epinephrine (1 hop) and carries the strongest latent link pull (Adamic-Adar 0.721) of any source–target pair, placing it as the systemic catecholamine-metabolism hub in the wiki graph.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：COMT 直接連結 Epinephrine（1 跳）並帶有所有來源–標的對中最強的潛在連結拉力（Adamic-Adar 0.721），在 wiki 圖譜中居於系統性兒茶酚胺代謝樞紐。

label: Honokiol
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol, a biphenolic lignan from Magnolia bark, physically interacts with SIRT3, increasing its deacetylase activity and upregulating SIRT3 protein expression. Directionally, honokiol sits upstream of SIRT3 activation. This engagement yields downstream deacetylation of mitochondrial antioxidant and metabolic targets, including MnSOD and OSCP. Honokiol thereby mimics caloric-restriction benefits specifically within mitochondria, and its effects are lost when SIRT3 is knocked down, confirming SIRT3 dependence. Because honokiol is lipophilic and poorly water-soluble, its formulation and delivery are practical considerations for therapeutic use.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚（Honokiol）是一種來自厚朴樹皮的雙酚木脂素，與 SIRT3 物理相互作用，增加其去乙醯酶活性並上調 SIRT3 蛋白表達。在方向性上，厚朴酚位於 SIRT3 活化的上游。這種結合產生對粒線體抗氧化和代謝靶標的下游去乙醯化，包括 MnSOD 和 OSCP。厚朴酚因此在粒線體內特異性地模擬熱量限制的益處，其效應在 SIRT3 被敲低時消失，確認了 SIRT3 依賴性。由於厚朴酚是疏水性的且水溶性差，其製劑和遞送是治療應用的實際考量。

label: Mitohormesis
description: NRF2 (nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor) is a leucine zipper transcription factor that is clearly activated by oxidative stress and participates in the hormetic induction of increased stress resistance. It regulates the expression of a host of gene products that help mediate resistance to oxidative stress. Its worm homolog SKN-1 directly binds mitochondria and is required to mediate the longevity benefits associated with mitochondrial oxidant release, establishing NRF2/SKN-1 as a key effector of the mitochondrial ROS-driven hormetic response.
description_zh_TW: NRF2（紅細胞核因子2相關因子）是一種亮氨酸拉鏈轉錄因子，明顯被氧化應激激活，並參與壓力抗性增強的興奮性誘導。它調節一系列有助於介導氧化抗性的基因產物的表達。其線蟲同源物SKN-1直接結合粒線體，是介導與粒線體氧化劑釋放相關的長壽益處所必需的，確立NRF2/SKN-1為粒線體ROS驅動興奮反應的關鍵效應器。

label: Ivermectin
description: Ivermectin enhanced enzalutamide activity in LNCaP prostate cancer cells (Tang et al., 2020; PMID 32971268).
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 在 LNCaP 前列腺癌細胞中增強 enzalutamide 活性（Tang et al., 2020; PMID 32971268）。

label: Reactive Oxygen Species
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: As a high Trolox-equivalent antioxidant flavonol, Fisetin acts directly as a reducing agent: its electron-donating hydroxyl groups allow it to chemically react with and neutralize reactive oxygen species, complementing its indirect antioxidant effects via glutathione upregulation.
description_zh_TW: 作為高 Trolox 當量抗氧化值的黃酮醇，Fisetin 可直接作為還原劑：其提供電子的羥基使其能與活性氧族群發生化學反應並將其中和，與其透過上調麩胱甘肽產生的間接抗氧化效果相輔相成。

label: Aminoguanidine
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Aminoguanidine reacts with adrenochrome to form adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, a hemostatic agent. In the patented process, an aqueous aminoguanidine hydrochloride solution is added to the adrenochrome reaction mixture at below 5 degrees C, the pH is adjusted to about 2.9 for the stabilization step, and the product is precipitated at a final pH of 9.0 to 10.0 with sodium hydroxide. The reaction yields about 41.0 g of crude product that is purified by dissolving in sulfurous acid, active carbon treatment, and the addition of EDTA, and the purified compound shows ultraviolet absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm.
description_zh_TW: 胺基胍與腎上腺紅反應形成腎上腺紅單胺基胍，一種止血劑。在該專利方法中，於低於5°C下將鹽酸胺基胍水溶液加入腎上腺紅反應混合物中，將pH調整至約2.9以進行穩定化步驟，並以氫氧化鈉在最終pH 9.0至10.0下沉澱產物。反應產生約41.0 g粗產物，經溶於亞硫酸、活性碳處理及添加EDTA純化，純化後的化合物呈現348 nm和445 nm的紫外線吸收極大值。

label: SIRT4
description: In the mammalian sirtuin signaling-pathway survey, caspases are listed as negative regulators of SIRT4 — the reciprocal of SIRT4's own restraint on procaspase-9/caspase-9 and procaspase-3/caspase-3 processing. SIRT4 prevents apoptosis by holding these procaspase ratios in check and blocking Bax translocation, while caspase activity feeds back to suppress SIRT4. This places the least-characterized sirtuin inside the cell-death control loop and marks the SIRT4-caspase relationship as emerging rather than fully established.
description_zh_TW: 在哺乳動物 sirtuin 訊息傳遞路徑的調查中，caspases 被列為 SIRT4 的負調節因子——這正好是 SIRT4 自身抑制 pro-Caspase-9/Caspase-9 與 pro-Caspase-3/Caspase-3 加工的鏡像。SIRT4 藉由維持這些前酶比例並阻止 Bax 轉位來防止細胞凋亡，而 caspase 活性則回饋抑制 SIRT4。這使研究最少的 sirtuin 也進入細胞死亡的控制迴路，並標示 SIRT4-caspase 的關係仍屬新興而非完全確立。

label: Advanced Glycation End Products
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Epicatechin is a flavanol with potent anti-glycation and AGE-breaking properties. In vitro it destroys preformed glycated serum albumin, and in vivo it decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. The nucleophilic C6 and C8 carbons of epicatechin's A-ring can attack the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures, breaking AGE cross-links. Epicatechin's dual capacity to inhibit glycation and break existing AGEs makes it a promising natural agent for reducing AGE burden, and its effects are similar to or stronger than those of aminoguanidine.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種具有強效抗糖化與 AGE 裂解特性的黃烷醇。在體外，它能破壞已形成的糖化血清白蛋白；在體內，它降低了注射外源性 AGE 之大鼠視網膜組織中的 AGE 累積。Epicatechin 之 A 環具親核性的 C6 與 C8 碳原子可攻擊 AGE 結構的吡咯環碳原子，切斷 AGE 交聯。Epicatechin 同時抑制糖化並裂解既有 AGE 的雙重能力，使其成為降低 AGE 負擔的極具潛力天然物質，且其效果與 aminoguanidine 相似或更佳。

label: Urolithin A
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Urolithin A activates mitochondrial autophagy (mitophagy), the selective degradation of damaged or defective mitochondria that maintains mitochondrial turnover and homeostasis. It promotes this process by activating the PINK1/Parkin signaling pathway and by upregulating glutathione S-transferases via the NRF2-ARE signaling pathway, thereby enhancing cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control. This mitophagy-activating activity is central to urolithin A's reported effects on mitochondrial health, muscle energy metabolism, and the prevention of dysfunctional mitochondrial accumulation that could otherwise lead to cellular degeneration.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 活化粒線體自噬（mitophagy），即對受損或缺陷粒線體進行選擇性降解，以維持粒線體更新與恆定。它透過活化 PINK1/Parkin 訊息傳遞路徑，以及經由 NRF2-ARE 訊息傳遞路徑上調 glutathione S-transferases，來促進此過程，從而增強細胞自噬與粒線體品質控制。此粒線體自噬活化活性，是 urolithin A 被報導對粒線體健康、肌肉能量代謝，以及預防失能粒線體堆積（否則可能導致細胞退化）產生效益的核心。

label: Senescence
description: ACSL4 is up-regulated during cellular senescence, contributing to the pro-ferroptotic state of senescent cells and their vulnerability to ferroptosis. Its PUFA-charging activity converges with acid ceramidase on membrane PUFA-phospholipid abundance but through an independent mechanism (ACSL4 levels are unchanged by ACase knockdown).
description_zh_TW: ACSL4 在細胞衰老過程中被上調，促成衰老細胞的促鐵死亡狀態及其對鐵死亡的脆弱性。它的 PUFA 活化活性與 acid ceramidase 在膜 PUFA-磷脂豐度上趨同，但機制各自獨立（ACase 敲低不改變 ACSL4 含量）。

label: Val158Met
description: Val158Met modulates the effect of vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) supplementation on cancer prevention, such that slow COMT individuals derive protective benefit whereas fast COMT individuals may experience increased cancer risk. The proposed mechanism involves COMT-dependent metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and interactions with catecholestrogen handling, which differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction has emerged from genotype-stratified analyses of supplementation trials. It highlights the need for genotype-aware antioxidant recommendations.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節維生素 E（α-生育醇）補充劑對癌症預防的作用，使得行動緩慢的 COMT 個體獲得保護性益處，而行動快速的 COMT 個體可能會經歷更高的癌症風險。所提出的機制涉及維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的 COMT 依賴性代謝以及與兒茶酚雌激素處理的相互作用，其因酶活性而異。這種基因與營養素的相互作用是從補充劑試驗的基因型分層分析中得出的。它強調了對基因型敏感的抗氧化劑建議的需求。

label: Dopamine
description: Graph node-analysis (networkx/scipy, 15 Aug 2026): COMT sits 1 hop from both Dopamine and Epinephrine with the highest Adamic-Adar latent pull (0.51–0.72) and #3 personalized-PageRank rank for both — the direct enzymatic gateway/hub of catecholamine handling, versus MAO which is peripheral.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析（networkx/scipy，2026-08-15）：COMT 距 Dopamine 與 Epinephrine 皆 1 跳，具最高的 Adamic-Adar 潛在連結拉力（0.51–0.72）與兩者皆 #3 的個人化 PageRank 排名——是兒茶酚胺處理的直接酵素樞紐/閘門，相對於周邊的 MAO。

label: Rapamycin
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Rapamycin delays immune aging by inhibiting mTORC1, an intervention shown to restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance the generation and persistence of memory CD8+ T cells in aged subjects. Mechanistically, mTORC1 inhibition shifts lymphocytes toward a more naïve, less exhausted state and promotes autophagy-mediated quality control within immune cells. In preclinical and clinical studies, transient rapamycin treatment improved immune responses to vaccination in the elderly. These effects illustrate how targeting the mTOR-autophagy axis can functionally rejuvenate the aging immune system.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin透過抑制mTORC1來延緩免疫老化，此介入已被證明可恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強老年個體中記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成與持續。在機制上，mTORC1抑制將淋巴細胞推向更初始、較不耗竭的狀態，並促進免疫細胞內自噬介導的品質控制。在臨床前和臨床研究中，短暫的rapamycin治療改善了老年人對疫苗的免疫反應。這些效應說明了標靶mTOR—自噬軸如何能在功能上使老化的免疫系統恢復年輕。

label: Apoptosis
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: SIRT1 is a stress-activated survival factor: Sir2α-deficient cells are hypersensitive to ionizing radiation, staurosporine, and oxidative stress. Mechanistically it deacetylates p53 (blunting transactivation) and FOXO3/FOXO4 (shifting output from death to repair), so cells with high SIRT1 activity resist pro-apoptotic stimuli. The 2006 Ohsawa-Miura study adds the inverse arm — once apoptosis does trigger, caspases cleave SIRT1 — making SIRT1 both a gatekeeper and, after cleavage, a casualty of the death program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是壓力誘導的存活因子：缺乏 Sir2α 的細胞對游離輻射、staurosporine 與氧化壓力高度敏感。機制上它去乙醯化 p53（減弱其轉錄活化）以及 FOXO3/FOXO4（將輸出由死亡轉向修復），因此高 SIRT1 活性的細胞能抵抗促凋亡刺激。2006 年 Ohsawa-Miura 的研究補上了反向的一臂——一旦細胞凋亡啟動，caspases 便會切割 SIRT1——使 SIRT1 既是守門者，也是切割後的犧牲品。

label: SIRT7
description: SIRT7 is concentrated in the nucleolus, the site of ribosomal DNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis, where it deacetylates histone H3K18 and regulates RNA polymerase I. Its nucleolar residence positions it to control rRNA synthesis and, consequently, protein synthetic capacity and growth. SIRT7 also deacetylates extra-nucleolar targets such as GATA4 and SMAD3, linking it to cardiac and fibrotic pathways. Deficiency of SIRT7 yields extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy, revealing its importance in stress responses of the heart.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 集中在核仁中，該處是核糖體 DNA 轉錄和核糖體生物合成的場所，在此處它去乙醯化組蛋白 H3K18 並調節 RNA 聚合酶 I。其核仁定位使其能夠控制 rRNA 合成，進而控制蛋白質合成能力和細胞生長。SIRT7 還去乙醯化核仁外的靶標如 GATA4 和 SMAD3，將其與心臟和纖維化通路聯繫起來。SIRT7 缺乏會導致廣泛的心肌纖維化和心肌病，揭示其在心臟壓力反應中的重要性。

label: p53
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Nuclear p53 transcriptionally activates PUMA (p53 upregulated modulator of apoptosis), a BH3-only protein that binds and inhibits the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL. Because PUMA can act both as a direct activator of BAX/BAK and as a sensitizer that displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members, p53-PUMA signaling lowers the mitochondrial threshold for cytochrome c release. Cytoplasmic p53 additionally retains the ability to activate BAX and BAK directly.
description_zh_TW: 細胞核內的 p53 會轉錄活化 PUMA（p53 上調凋亡調控因子），一種可結合並抑制抗凋亡 BCL-xL 的 BH3-only 蛋白。由於 PUMA 既能直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能作為置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員的敏化因子，p53-PUMA 訊號降低了粒線體釋出 cytochrome c 的門檻。此外，細胞質型的 p53 仍可直接活化 BAX 與 BAK。

label: Caloric Restriction
description: In yeast, the replicative lifespan extension conferred by caloric restriction is abolished when the SIR2 gene is deleted, establishing Sir2 as a required mediator of the CR response. This dependence reflects the fact that CR raises the NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, which relieves nicotinamide feedback inhibition and boosts Sir2 deacetylase activity. The relationship is directional: CR acts upstream and Sir2 is the necessary downstream effector in this genetic pathway. A caveat is that in higher organisms the requirement is distributed across multiple sirtuins and redundant pathways, so SIR2/SIRT1 is necessary but not solely sufficient.
description_zh_TW: 在酵母中，熱量限制所賦予的複製性壽命延長在 SIR2 基因被刪除時被消除，確立了 Sir2 作為 CR 反應的必需介導因子。這種依賴性反映了 CR 提高 NAD+/菸鹼醯胺比值的事實，從而解除菸鹼醯胺的回饋抑制並增強 Sir2 去乙醯酶活性。這種關係是方向性的：CR 作用在上游，Sir2 是該遺傳通路中必要的下游效應因子。需要注意的是，在高等生物體中，這種需求分佈在多個 sirtuin 和冗餘通路中，因此 SIR2/SIRT1 是必要的但並非單獨充分的。

label: SIRT5
description: SIRT5 deacetylates cytochrome c, the mitochondrial intermembrane protein central to oxidative metabolism and apoptosis initiation. SIRT5 overexpression ameliorates cytochrome c leakage into the cytoplasm and the resulting caspase-3 activation, alleviating apoptosis. Together with SIRT4's restraint of procaspase processing, this places the mitochondrial sirtuins directly on the cytochrome c/apoptosome entry point of the caspase cascade rather than only on transcriptional or redox arms.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 會去乙醯化 cytochrome c——這個位於粒線體膜間腔、對氧化代謝與細胞凋亡起始至關重要的蛋白。SIRT5 的過表達能改善 cytochrome c 洩漏至細胞質及其後續的 Caspase-3 活化，從而減輕細胞凋亡。與 SIRT4 對 pro-caspase 加工的抑制並列，這使粒線體 sirtuins 不只作用於轉錄或氧化還原臂，而是直接作用於 caspase 級聯的 cytochrome c/凋亡體入口。

label: AMPK
description: DHM activates AMPK, which synergistically raises NAD+ via NAMPT upregulation and thereby further potentiates SIRT3 activity. Directionally, DHM activates AMPK, which increases NAD+ to boost SIRT3. This dual SIRT3/AMPK engagement amplifies mitochondrial and metabolic defenses, protecting the liver and other tissues from metabolic and oxidative injury. It mirrors the indirect resveratrol cascade, suggesting convergent circuitry among polyphenols, and it illustrates how natural compounds often activate multiple, reinforcing pathways rather than a single target—an important consideration for interpreting their biological effects.
description_zh_TW: DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 協同性地通過 NAMPT 上調提高 NAD+，進而進一步增強 SIRT3 活性。在方向性上，DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 增加 NAD+ 以提升 SIRT3。這種 SIRT3/AMPK 的雙重參與放大粒線體和代謝防禦，保護肝臟和其他組織免受代謝和氧化損傷。它反映了白藜蘆醇的間接級聯反應，提示多酚之間的趨同電路，並說明天然化合物通常活化多個強化的通路而非單一靶點——這是解釋其生物學效應時的重要考量。

label: Fisetin
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin, a flavonol, activates SIRT1 via the K-type allosteric mechanism and is also a well-characterized senolytic in the wiki; it increases yeast replicative lifespan by ~33% in the source literature. Its SIRT1 activation is part of the natural-polyphenol STAC cluster.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種黄酮醇，透過 K 型別構機制活化 SIRT1，同時也是 wiki 中特徵明確的 senolytic；在來源文獻中可將酵母複製壽命延長約 33%。其 SIRT1 活化屬於天然多酚類 STAC 群集。

label: Parkinson's Disease
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: SIRT2 is found to be overexpressed in Parkinson's disease. SIRT2 is also overexpressed in neurodegenerative disorders generally and protects neural cells from oxidative damage caused by ageing and disease. Directionally, elevated SIRT2 sits upstream of neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease. Sirtuin inhibitors have been considered for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, alongside cancer therapy, because of this SIRT2 involvement.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 被發現在帕金森氏症中過度表達。SIRT2 在神經退行性疾病中也普遍過度表達，並保護神經細胞免受衰老和疾病引起的氧化損傷。從作用方向而言，SIRT2 的升高位於帕金森氏症神經退行性變的上游。由於 SIRT2 的這種參與，sirtuin 抑制劑已被考慮用於帕金森氏症的治療以及癌症治療。

label: Autophagy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Activated MLKL attenuates autophagy following its translocation to intracellular membranes, meaning necroptosis does not merely co-occur with failing autophagy but actively suppresses it. Conversely autophagy can induce necroptosis through ROS byproducts — Baf-A1 (late-stage autophagy inhibition) downregulates RIP1/RIP3, and 3-MA (early inhibition) suppresses RIPK1/RIPK3 interaction — so the two pathways regulate each other in both directions, with TNF-induced necroptosis stimulating early autophagy (RIPK3-AMPK) while blocking late autophagosome-lysosome fusion.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 MLKL 在轉位至細胞內膜後會減弱自噬，這表示程序性壞死不只是伴隨自噬失能，還會主動抑制它。反過來，自噬也可透過 ROS 副產物誘導程序性壞死——晚期自噬抑制劑 Baf-A1 會下調 RIP1/RIP3，早期抑制劑 3-MA 會抑制 RIPK1/RIPK3 的交互作用——因此兩條路徑雙向調控彼此；TNF 誘導的程序性壞死會經 RIPK3-AMPK 刺激早期自噬，卻阻斷晚期的自噬體-溶酶體融合。

label: Methylene blue
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes. Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis. In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen.
