description_zh_TW: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes。Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis。In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen。

label: Resveratrol
description: Resveratrol — a SIRT1 activator — attenuated cell death caused by the topoisomerase poisons etoposide and camptothecin in HeLa cells, while the SIRT1 inhibitor Selisistat (EX-527) did the opposite. SIRT1 activity in these experiments was tracked by acetyl-p53 (Lys379) levels, a canonical SIRT1 substrate readout. Functionally this anchors the anti-apoptotic role of SIRT1 in the DDR: raising its activity protects against genotoxic death, and the protection is lost when TRIM28 can no longer be restrained.
description_zh_TW: 作為 SIRT1 活化劑的 Resveratrol 能減輕拓撲異構酶毒物 etoposide 與 camptothecin 在 HeLa 細胞中造成的細胞死亡，而 SIRT1 抑制劑 Selisistat（EX-527）則相反。實驗中以 acetyl-p53（Lys379）水平作為 SIRT1 活性指標。這在功能上確立了 SIRT1 在 DDR 中的抗凋亡角色：提高其活性可抵抗基因毒性死亡，而當 TRIM28 無法被抑制時保護作用便會消失。

label: Neuromelanin
description: Neuromelanin is a dark pigment that forms from the breakdown products of catecholamine neurotransmitters, including dopamine, norepinephrine, and adrenaline, via their oxidative conversion to quinones and aminochromes such as adrenochrome. Neuromelanin granules are virtually absent at birth and progressively accumulate with age, peaking in middle-to-late adulthood in catecholaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra and locus coeruleus. The pigment is thought to act as a sponge that sequesters toxic reactive intermediates, protecting neurons, though excessive accumulation and iron binding may eventually contribute to neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 是一種深色色素，由兒茶酚胺神經傳導物質（包括 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 adrenaline）的分解產物，經氧化轉化為 quinones 與 adrenochrome 等 aminochromes 而形成。Neuromelanin 顆粒在出生時幾乎不存在，並隨年齡漸進堆積，在 substantia nigra 與 locus coeruleus 的兒茶酚胺能神經元中於中晚年達到高峰。此色素被認為扮演海綿角色，隔離有毒的反應性中間產物以保護神經元，儘管過度堆積與鐵結合最終可能促進 Parkinson's disease 的神經退化。

label: TFEB
description: SIRT2 directly binds the 3'UTR of transcription factor EB (TFEB) and enhances its mRNA stability, raising TFEB protein availability. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of stabilized TFEB message. TFEB then drives lysosomal and autophagic gene programs, so SIRT2 promotes autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis through this post-transcriptional mechanism. This reveals an RNA-binding facet of SIRT2's regulation of autophagy, distinct from its enzymatic deacetylation of other substrates. By stabilizing TFEB mRNA, SIRT2 supports cellular clearance of damaged components, linking sirtuin activity to lysosomal quality control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 直接結合轉錄因子 EB（TFEB）的 3'UTR 並增強其 mRNA 穩定性，提高 TFEB 蛋白質的可用量。在方向性上，SIRT2 位於穩定化的 TFEB 訊息上游。TFEB 隨後驅動溶酶體和自噬基因程式，因此 SIRT5 透過此轉錄後機制促進自噬和溶酶體生物合成。這揭示了 SIRT2 調控自噬的一個 RNA 結合面向，有別於其對其他底物的酶性去乙醯化作用。透過穩定 TFEB mRNA，SIRT2 支持細胞清除受損組件，將 sirtuin 活性與溶酶體品質控制聯繫起來。

label: Creatine
description: Creatine supplementation is one of the most effective and best-documented ergogenic aids for improving performance in high-intensity, short-duration activities. By increasing muscle phosphocreatine stores, creatine enhances the capacity to regenerate ATP during repeated bouts of maximal exercise, increasing power output, strength gains during resistance training, and work performed in repeated sprint protocols. Meta-analyses consistently show moderate improvements in measures such as maximal strength, sprint performance, and lean body mass, with benefit most pronounced in activities relying on the phosphocreatine energy system. These well-established performance effects are the context in which the trace asks whether creatine also influences cancer outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸是改善高強度、短時間運動表現最有效且文獻記載最完整的增能劑之一。透過增加肌肉磷酸肌酸儲備，肌酸可提升反覆最大強度運動期間再生 ATP 的能力，進而增加功率輸出、阻力訓練中的肌力增長，以及反覆衝刺訓練中的做功量。統合分析一致顯示，肌酸在最大肌力、衝刺表現與去脂體重等指標上帶來中等程度的改善，其效益在依賴磷酸肌酸能量系統的活動中最為顯著。這些確立已久的表現效益，正是該追蹤探討肌酸是否也影響癌症結果的背景脈絡。

label: Oxidative Stress
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: In older adults, 24-week GlyNAC supplementation reduced plasma F2-isoprostanes by 40% and protein carbonyls by 35%, markers of oxidative damage.
description_zh_TW: 老年受試者中，24 週 GlyNAC 補充使血漿 F2-異前列腺素下降 40%、蛋白質羰基下降 35%，皆為氧化損傷指標。

label: Nicotinamide Riboside
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside is phosphorylated by NMRK1/NMRK2 to nicotinamide mononucleotide, the direct biosynthetic bridge linking the two major NAD+ precursors and completing the NR->NMN->NAD+ salvage sequence.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷經 NMRK1/NMRK2 磷酸化為菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸，是直接連接兩大 NAD+ 前體的生物合成橋樑，完成 NR→NMN→NAD+ 補救序列。

label: SIRT2
description: SIRT2 is the dominant α-tubulin/H4K16 deacetylase (confidence ~0.95), recovered as a direct edge by the node analysis; its Tubulin–SIRT2 axis is now an active drug-discovery hot spot (selective inhibitors/degraders).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是主要的 α-tubulin/H4K16 去乙醯酶（置信度約 0.95），由節點分析還原為直接邊；其 Tubulin–SIRT2 軸現為活躍的藥物開發熱點（選擇性抑制劑/降解劑）。

label: Aging
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Aging is associated with declining SIRT3 activity and rising SIRT4, which narrows the hormetic window and increases vulnerability to mitochondrial stressors. Directionally, aging sits upstream of the altered ratio. This shift favors oxidant stress and metabolic inflexibility, and restoring the ratio, for example via caloric restriction or NAD+ precursors, is a proposed anti-aging strategy. By reducing the protective SIRT3/SIRT4 balance, aging impairs mitochondrial quality control and stress adaptation. This association links mitochondrial sirtuin biology to the functional decline of aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: 衰老與 SIRT3 活性下降和 SIRT4 上升相關，這縮窄了激效窗口並增加對粒線體壓力源的脆弱性。在方向性上，衰老位於改變比率的上游。這種變化有利於氧化壓力和代謝不靈活性，恢復比率（例如透過限制熱量或 NAD+ 前驅物）是一種擬議的抗衰老策略。透過降低保護性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡，衰老損害粒線體品質控制和壓力適應。此關聯將粒線體 sirtuin 生物學與衰老組織的功能退化聯繫起來。

label: Adrenochrome
description: Carbazochrome is the monosemicarbazone of adrenochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone; PubChem CID 2557), formed by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to stabilize the otherwise labile molecule (US Patent 2506294; J Pharm Soc Jpn 1956). This stabilization reduces its redox activity relative to adrenochrome, so carbazochrome should NOT be assumed to redox-cycle at Complex I like adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: 卡巴可羅是腎上腺素紅的一縮胺基脲（腎上腺素紅單縮胺基脲；PubChem CID 2557），由腎上腺素紅的醌羰基與縮胺基脲縮合而成，以穩定原本不穩定的分子（美國專利 2506294；日本藥學會誌 1956）。此穩定化降低了其相對於腎上腺素紅的氧化還原活性，因此不應假設卡巴可羅會像腎上腺素紅那樣在 Complex I 發生氧化還原循環。

label: SASP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: In mitochondria-depleted senescent cells, acetate supplementation is converted into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, restoring histone acetylation (including H3K27ac) and partially rescuing the mitochondrial-dependent SASP programme (IL6, IL8, IL1B, CCL2) without affecting p16/p21 cell-cycle regulators. This shows acetyl-CoA availability, not mitochondria themselves, gates SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: 在粒線體缺失的衰老細胞中，乙酸補充會被 ACSS2 轉化為 acetyl-CoA，恢復組蛋白乙醯化（包括 H3K27ac）並部分挽救依賴粒線體的 SASP 程序（IL6、IL8、IL1B、CCL2），且不影響 p16/p21 細胞週期調節因子。這顯示是 acetyl-CoA 的可及性、而非粒線體本身，在調控 SASP 表現。

label: Cancer
description: SIRT3 exerts context-dependent roles in cancer: as a tumor suppressor it stabilizes chromosomal integrity via OGG1-mediated DNA repair potentiation, facilitates H3K56 deacetylation for NHEJ fidelity, destabilizes HIF-1alpha to attenuate the Warburg effect, and deacetylates IDH2 at K143 to suppress ROS-mediated mutagenesis. Yet it can be oncogenic (pyroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 Lys228, SHMT2 Lys95, glycine decarboxylase Lys514 deacetylation) and enables chemoresistance in CLL via ROS buffering.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在癌症中發揮情境依賴性角色：作為腫瘤抑制因子，它透過 OGG1 介導的 DNA 修復增強穩定染色體完整性，促進 H3K56 去乙醯化以維持 NHEJ 精準度，不穩定化 HIF-1alpha 以減輕 Warburg 效應，並在 K143 處去乙醯化 IDH2 以抑制活性氧介導的致突變作用。然而它也可以是致癌性的（pyroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 Lys228、SHMT2 Lys95、glycine decarboxylase Lys514 去乙醯化），並在 CLL 中透過活性氧緩衝賦予化療抗性。

label: NF-κB
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: IKKα (IKK1, CHUK) functions in two NF-κB modes: within the IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO heterocomplex it contributes to IκBα phosphorylation and canonical NF-κB activation downstream of TNFα, IL-1, LPS, and DNA damage; released from NEMO it forms homodimers that — driven by NIK — phosphorylate p100 into p52, driving non-canonical NF-κB (RelB:p52) signaling for lymphoid development and B-cell survival. IKKα also has nuclear, NF-κB-independent roles such as histone H3 Ser10 phosphorylation in mitosis.
description_zh_TW: IKKα（IKK1，CHUK）在兩種 NF-κB 模式中運作：在 IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO 異源複合體中，它參與 IκBα 的磷酸化與 TNFα、IL-1、LPS 及 DNA 損傷下游的典型 NF-κB 活化；脫離 NEMO 後，它形成同源二聚體，在 NIK 驅動下將 p100 磷酸化為 p52，推動非典型 NF-κB（RelB:p52）訊號以支配淋巴器官發育與 B 細胞存活。IKKα 另有獨立於 NF-κB 的細胞核角色，例如有絲分裂中組蛋白 H3 Ser10 的磷酸化。

label: SIRT6
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 (Michishita et al., 2008/2009), contributing to its chromatin/DNA-repair program. The direct edge was missing from the graph and is restored here per the node-analysis curation-gap flag.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 H3K9（Michishita et al., 2008/2009），參與其染色質/DNA 修復程序。此直接邊原本缺漏，依節點分析的策展缺口標記在此補回。

label: COMT
description: Graph node-analysis (networkx/scipy, 15 Aug 2026): COMT sits 1 hop from both Dopamine and Epinephrine with the highest Adamic-Adar latent pull (0.51–0.72) and #3 personalized-PageRank rank for both — the direct enzymatic gateway/hub of catecholamine handling, versus MAO which is peripheral.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析（networkx/scipy，2026-08-15）：COMT 距 Dopamine 與 Epinephrine 皆 1 跳，具最高的 Adamic-Adar 潛在連結拉力（0.51–0.72）與兩者皆 #3 的個人化 PageRank 排名——是兒茶酚胺處理的直接酵素樞紐/閘門，相對於周邊的 MAO。

label: SIRT3
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: SIRT3 activates AMPK/Parkin-mediated mitophagy (for example via the FOXO3a/PINK1-Parkin route in retinal pigment epithelial cells under high glucose), and simultaneously suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome activation by lowering mitochondrial ROS in human macrophages. In myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, abnormalities in the SIRT1-SIRT3 axis silence PINK1/Parkin mitophagy, raising ROS and activating ferroptosis — making the SIRT1/SIRT3 pair a joint upstream gate for mitophagy and, through it, for multiple death modalities.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 會活化 AMPK/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬（例如高糖環境下視網膜色素上皮細胞中的 FOXO3a/PINK1-Parkin 路徑），並在人類巨噬細胞中藉由降低粒線體 ROS 抑制 NLRP3 發炎體的活化。在心肌缺血再灌注損傷中，SIRT1-SIRT3 軸線的異常會沉默 PINK1/Parkin 粒線體自噬，升高 ROS 並活化鐵死亡——使 SIRT1/SIRT3 這一對成為粒線體自噬（進而及於多種死亡模式）的共同上游閘門。

label: SIRT1
description: SMURF2, a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase, ubiquitinates SIRT1 and promotes its proteasomal degradation, suppressing proliferation and tumorigenesis in colorectal cancer (Yu et al., Oncogene 2020). Unlike TRIM28/KAP1 — whose SIRT1 degradation is ATM-dependent and DNA-damage-conditioned — SMURF2-mediated SIRT1 turnover was characterized outside DNA damage settings, making it a constitutive metabolic regulator of SIRT1 abundance rather than a DDR-specific one.
description_zh_TW: SMURF2 是一種 HECT 結構域的 E3 泛素連接酶，會泛素化 SIRT1 並促進其蛋白酶體降解，從而抑制大腸直腸癌的增殖與腫瘤生成（Yu 等人，Oncogene 2020）。有別於 TRIM28/KAP1——其對 SIRT1 的降解依賴 ATM 且限於 DNA 損傷情境——SMURF2 介導的 SIRT1 代謝是在非 DNA 損傷條件下被闡明的，因此它是 SIRT1 豐度的組成性代謝調節者，而非 DDR 專一性的調節者。

label: Nutlin 3a
description: Nutlin 3a suppresses the pro-inflammatory SASP by inhibiting MDM2, the E3 ligase that marks p53 for degradation, thereby stabilizing the tumor suppressor; stabilized p53 in turn restrains NF-kB-driven expression of SASP cytokines and chemokines. This mechanism exploits the natural tumor-suppressive rheostat of p53 rather than broadly blocking inflammation, and it is consistent with the observation that loss of p53 dramatically amplifies secretome output. The compound is primarily a research tool with limited clinical development, which constrains its translational confidence, but mechanistically its SASP-suppressive action is well grounded in p53's restraint of the inflammatory secretome.
description_zh_TW: Nutlin 3a 透過抑制 MDM2（標記 p53 降解的 E3 連接酶）而穩定腫瘤抑制因子，從而抑制促發炎性 SASP；穩定的 p53 反過來抑制 NF-κB 驅動的 SASP 細胞激素與趨化因子表現。此機制利用 p53 天然的腫瘤抑制變阻器，而非廣泛阻斷發炎，且與 p53 缺失大幅放大分泌組輸出的觀察一致。此化合物主要是研究工具、臨床開發有限，限制了其轉譯信度，但在機制上其 SASP 抑制作用是立基於 p53 對發炎分泌組的抑制。

label: Senescent cell anti-apoptotic pathways
description: Senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis because they upregulate Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs), including Bcl-2 family pro-survival proteins and the PI3K/Akt axis. Different senescent cell types rely on different SCAPs, which is why no single senolytic clears all senescent cells — and why SCAP-targeting drugs such as Fisetin, D+Q, and Navitoclax show cell-type selectivity.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞因上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs，包括 Bcl-2 家族促存活蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 軸）而抵抗細胞凋亡。不同衰老細胞類型依賴不同的 SCAPs，因此沒有任何單一 senolytic 能清除所有衰老細胞——這也是為何攻擊 SCAPs 的藥物如 Fisetin、D+Q 與 Navitoclax 呈現細胞類型選擇性的原因。

label: NMRK1
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, which suggests that Nmrk1 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 1) might be the key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of nicotinamide riboside (NR). Two possible mechanisms of neuroprotection have been proposed: increasing mitochondrial NAD+ to support SIRT3 and preserving axonal NAD+ to supply damage-induced SARM1 activation. NMRK1 is expressed ubiquitously and converts NR to NMN in the salvage pathway for NAD+ synthesis. This neuroprotective role of NMRK1 supports the potential use of NR against excitotoxicity-induced axonal degeneration and neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，這顯示 Nmrk1（nicotinamide ribose kinase 1，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 1）可能是 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。已提出兩種可能的神經保護機制：提升粒線體 NAD+ 以支持 SIRT3，以及保留軸突 NAD+ 以供應損傷誘發的 SARM1 活化。NMRK1 廣泛表現，並在 NAD+ 合成的回收路徑中將 NR 轉化為 NMN。NMRK1 的此一神經保護角色支持了 NR 用於對抗興奮毒性誘發的軸突退化與神經退化的潛在用途。

label: ovarian cancer
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Epidemiologic and case-control studies support an inverse relationship between apigenin-containing flavonoid intake and the risk of several cancers, including ovarian cancer. A multi-centric Italian case-control study of 1,031 epithelial ovarian cancer cases and 2,411 controls confirmed an inverse association between consumption of common flavonoids and ovarian cancer risk, and a Zutphen study established that dietary supplementation of five flavonoids including apigenin decreased ovarian cancer risk. Similar protective associations were reported for breast, gastric, and colorectal cancers, with a 5-year follow-up of elderly subjects concluding that high fruit-and-vegetable flavonoid intake reduces cancer incidence.
description_zh_TW: 流行病學與病例對照研究支持攝取含芹菜素之黃酮類化合物與多種癌症（包括卵巢癌）風險之間呈負相關。一項納入1,031名上皮性卵巢癌病例與2,411名對照組的多中心義大利病例對照研究證實，常見黃酮類化合物的攝取與卵巢癌風險呈負相關；Zutphen研究則確立膳食補充包括芹菜素在內的五種黃酮類化合物可降低卵巢癌風險。乳癌、胃癌與大腸直腸癌也有類似的保護性關聯報導；一項對老年受試者為期5年的追蹤研究結論指出，攝取高量的蔬果黃酮類化合物可降低癌症發生率。

label: AGE-modified proteins
description: Lysosomal proteases are responsible for degrading glycated proteins intracellularly. Cathepsin D, an aspartic protease, and Cathepsin B, a cysteine protease, are major enzymes that break down AGE-modified proteins after they are directed to lysosomes for degradation. A decrease in Cathepsin D expression or activity, which occurs during aging and UV exposure, directly correlates with the accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Cathepsin-dependent lysosomal degradation therefore represents the third line of defense against AGE accumulation, removing established glycated proteins that prevention and repair enzymes cannot handle.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體蛋白酶負責在細胞內降解糖化蛋白。組織蛋白酶 D（Cathepsin D，一種天冬胺酸蛋白酶）與組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B，一種半胱氨酸蛋白酶）是將 AGE 修飾蛋白在導向溶酶體降解後分解的主要酵素。組織蛋白酶 D 表現或活性在老化與紫外線暴露期間下降，直接與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，依賴組織蛋白酶的溶酶體降解代表對抗 AGE 堆積的第三道防線，移除預防與修復酵素無法處理的已建立糖化蛋白。

label: Lamins
description: Caspase-3 cleaves Lamins. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Lamins are the intermediate-filament proteins of the nuclear lamina whose cleavage by caspases drives nuclear collapse during apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon Lamins rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 劈開 Lamins。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Lamins 是核纖層的中間絲蛋白，在細胞凋亡過程中被半胱天冬酶裂解驅動核塌陷。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 Lamins 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: CDK4
source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md
description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

label: Dopamine Transporter
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: The dopamine transporter is sparse in the prefrontal cortex compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine clearance there relies far more on diffusion, extracellular enzymatic O-methylation by COMT, and uptake by the norepinephrine transporter. This anatomical fact is the reason COMT genotype so strongly influences prefrontal dopamine and cognition, since DAT cannot rapidly buffer synaptic dopamine. Reduced DAT expression shifts the burden of inactivation to COMT and NET. It is a cornerstone of the regional dopamine regulation model.
description_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質中的多巴胺轉運蛋白稀疏，這意味著那裡的多巴胺清除更依賴擴散、COMT 的細胞外酶促 O-甲基化以及 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白的攝取。這項解剖事實是 COMT genotype 如此強烈影響前額葉多巴胺和認知的原因，因為 DAT 無法快速緩衝突觸多巴胺。減少的 DAT expression 將失活的負擔轉移到 COMT 和 NET。它是區域多巴胺調節模型的基石。

label: Uric Acid
description: Uric acid scavenges peroxynitrite, acting as a physiologic antioxidant in humans (who lack the uricase that degrades it) at the high plasma concentrations typical of the species. It reacts with peroxynitrite to limit tyrosine nitration and lipid oxidation. The directionality is scavenger to oxidant neutralization. A caveat is that urate is also pro-oxidant and pro-inflammatory at high levels and contributes to gout, so its net effect is concentration- and context-dependent. Because humans and great apes lost uricase, urate circulates at near-saturating concentrations, providing a constitutive antioxidant buffer in plasma.
description_zh_TW: Uric acid 清除 peroxynitrite，在人類（缺乏降解它的尿酸酶）中在該物種典型的高血漿濃度下充當生理抗氧化劑。它與 peroxynitrite 反應，限制 tyrosine 硝化和脂質氧化。方向性是清除劑至氧化劑中和。需要注意的是，高水平的尿酸鹽還具有促氧化和促炎作用，並會導致痛風，因此其淨效應取決於濃度和環境。由於人類和類人猿失去了尿酸酶，尿酸鹽以接近飽和的濃度循環，在血漿中提供了組成型抗氧化緩衝劑。

label: TRAIL
description: Apoptosis is induced by TRAIL. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The directionality runs from TRAIL toward Apoptosis, so TRAIL is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 TRAIL 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。方向性從 TRAIL 向 Apoptosis，因此 TRAIL 是主動主體，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Chemotherapy Resistance
description: EMT promotes Chemotherapy Resistance. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with EMT acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: EMT 促進 Chemotherapy Resistance。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，EMT 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Synthetic STAC
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT1460 is a second-generation synthetic sirtuin-activating compound (STAC) of the imidazothiazole class, developed with SRT1720 and SRT2183 as chemically diverse and more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and in vivo effects may be indirect (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 belongs to the synthetic STAC class whose biology underlies the ongoing debate about STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
description_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種咪唑噻唑類的第二代合成 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起作為化學結構多樣且比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑而開發。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質驗證，且體內效果可能是間接的（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 屬於合成 STAC 類別，其生物學構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化的持續爭論。

label: Kinase-inhibitor scaffold
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Ro31-8220 is a bisindolylmaleimide compound originally developed as a protein kinase C inhibitor; its adenosine-binding scaffold allowed it to be repurposed as an inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. It belongs to the kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins, sharing this property with the indolinone GW5074. Directionally, Ro31-8220's identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold underlies its cross-reactivity with sirtuins through the shared adenosine-binding site. Because it retains potent kinase activity, cellular effects cannot be attributed solely to sirtuin inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Ro31-8220 是一種最初作為蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑開發的雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺化合物；其腺嘌呤結合骨架使其被重新定位為低微摩爾範圍內的 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 抑制劑。它屬於透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 活性而鑑定的激酶抑制劑骨架，與吲哚啉酮 GW5074 共享此特性。方向性上 Ro31-8220 作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份奠定了其透過共享腺嘌呤結合位點對 sirtuin 的交叉反應性。由於其保留強效激酶活性，細胞效應不能僅歸因於 sirtuin 抑制。

label: PAK1
description: Ivermectin promotes proteasomal degradation of PAK1 via the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway without affecting PAK1 mRNA levels. This is its primary host kinase target for anticancer effects.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 透過泛素—蛋白酶體途徑促進 PAK1 的蛋白酶體降解，且不影響 PAK1 mRNA 水平。這是其抗癌作用的主要宿主激酶標的。

label: Satoshi Ōmura
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: Paclitaxel
description: Paclitaxel stabilizes microtubules by binding polymerized tubulin, arresting mitosis (contrast to benzimidazole destabilizers).
description_zh_TW: Paclitaxel 通過結合聚合的微管蛋白穩定微管，阻斷有絲分裂（與苯並咪唑 destabilizers 相比）。

label: Cathepsin D
description: Lysosomal proteases are responsible for degrading glycated proteins intracellularly. Cathepsin D, an aspartic protease, and Cathepsin B, a cysteine protease, are major enzymes that break down AGE-modified proteins after they are directed to lysosomes for degradation. A decrease in Cathepsin D expression or activity, which occurs during aging and UV exposure, directly correlates with the accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Cathepsin-dependent lysosomal degradation therefore represents the third line of defense against AGE accumulation, removing established glycated proteins that prevention and repair enzymes cannot handle.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體蛋白酶負責在細胞內降解糖化蛋白。組織蛋白酶 D（Cathepsin D，一種天冬胺酸蛋白酶）與組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B，一種半胱氨酸蛋白酶）是將 AGE 修飾蛋白在導向溶酶體降解後分解的主要酵素。組織蛋白酶 D 表現或活性在老化與紫外線暴露期間下降，直接與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，依賴組織蛋白酶的溶酶體降解代表對抗 AGE 堆積的第三道防線，移除預防與修復酵素無法處理的已建立糖化蛋白。

label: SIRT3 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 deficiency in the aging murine lung promotes a fibrotic response mediated by TGF-beta1 and augments mitochondrial DNA damage and apoptosis in alveolar epithelial cells. Conversely, SIRT3 overexpression can ameliorate asbestos-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Directionally, SIRT3 deficiency sits upstream of enhanced TGF-beta1-driven fibrosis, because by weakening mitochondrial antioxidant defenses it renders alveolar epithelial cells vulnerable to the damage that fuels the fibrotic program. Restoring SIRT3 could therefore protect against pulmonary fibrosis, making mitochondrial sirtuin activity an important determinant of lung resilience to environmental and aging-related fibrotic injury.
description_zh_TW: 老化小鼠肺部的SIRT3缺乏促進由TGF-beta1介導的纖維化反應，並增強肺泡上皮細胞的粒線體DNA損傷和凋亡。相反，SIRT3過表達可以改善石棉誘導的肺纖維化。方向上，SIRT3缺乏位於TGF-beta1驅動的纖維化增強的上游，因為透過削弱粒線體抗氧化防禦，它使肺泡上皮細胞容易受到推動纖維化程序的損傷。因此恢復SIRT3可能保護免受肺纖維化，使粒線體sirtuin活性成為肺部對環境和與年齡相關纖維化損傷韌性的重要決定因素。

label: Pluripotency
description: Oct4 is the master regulator of pluripotency, the transcription factor that establishes and maintains the pluripotent state of embryonic stem cells and induced pluripotent stem cells. It is required for the development of the inner cell mass of the blastocyst, and its absence prevents pluripotency while its dosage must be tightly controlled. Oct4 functions with Sox2 and Nanog to regulate the pluripotency gene network, and it is essential for initiating cellular reprogramming. Its role makes Oct4 both a defining marker and a key tool of pluripotent stem cell research.
description_zh_TW: Oct4 是多能性的主要調節因子，是建立和維持胚胎幹細胞和誘導多能幹細胞的多能狀態的轉錄因子。它是囊胚內細胞團發育所必需的，它的缺乏會阻礙多能性，同時必須嚴格控制其劑量。 Oct4 與 Sox2 和 Nanog 一起調節多能性基因網絡，對於啟動細胞重編程至關重要。它的作用使得 Oct4 既是定義標記，也是多能幹細胞研究的關鍵工具。

label: COMT Inhibitors
description: COMT inhibitors such as entacapone, tolcapone, and opicapone block catechol-O-methyltransferase, one of the principal enzymes that degrades catecholamines by methylation. Inhibiting COMT therefore increases synaptic and circulating levels of dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, and this is exploited clinically in Parkinson's disease, often combined with MAO inhibitors and levodopa, to prolong dopaminergic effects and reduce off time. The resulting higher catecholamine levels, together with inhibition of MAO-mediated clearance, provide more substrate for oxidative conversion to adrenochrome, though this effect is mostly theoretical in clinical use and benefits are generally judged to outweigh risks.
description_zh_TW: COMT 抑制劑如 entacapone、tolcapone 與 opicapone 阻斷 catechol-O-methyltransferase，這是透過甲基化降解兒茶酚胺的主要酶之一。因此，抑制 COMT 會升高多巴胺、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的突觸與循環濃度，這在臨床上用於帕金森氏症，常與 MAO 抑制劑及 levodopa 併用以延長多巴胺能效應並減少 off time。所導致的較高兒茶酚胺濃度，加上 MAO 介導清除的抑制，提供了更多氧化轉化為 adrenochrome 的受質，儘管此效應在臨床使用中多屬理論性，且效益通常被認為大於風險。

label: mtDNA
description: mtDNA released by minority MOMP activates cGAS-STING, driving type-I interferon and NF-kB-dependent SASP without causing full cell death. The cytosolic mtDNA acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern recognized by cGAS, linking mitochondrial dysfunction (SAMD) directly to innate immune activation. This activation is a pivotal bridge between metabolism and senescence inflammation and also enhances immune surveillance of the arrested cell. It is a well-validated mechanism in multiple senescence models.
description_zh_TW: 少數 MOMP 釋放的 mtDNA 活化 cGAS-STING，驅動第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 依賴的 SASP 而不引起完全細胞死亡。胞質 mtDNA 作為 cGAS 辨識的損傷相關分子模式，將粒線體功能障礙（SAMD）直接連結到先天免疫活化。此活化是代謝與衰老發炎間的關鍵橋樑，也增強對停滯細胞的免疫監視。它在多種衰老模型中為良好驗證的機制。

label: ATFS-1
description: ATFS-1 (Activating Transcription Factor associated with Stress-1) is the transcription factor required for activation of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) in C. elegans. Uniquely, it possesses both a mitochondrial targeting sequence and a nuclear localization signal: in the absence of stress it is imported into mitochondria and rapidly degraded, whereas under mitochondrial dysfunction its import is impaired and it translocates to the nucleus to orchestrate a broad transcriptional response, including induction of mitochondrial chaperones. Nuclear ATFS-1 thereby couples mitochondrial status directly to nuclear gene expression.
description_zh_TW: ATFS-1（Activating Transcription Factor associated with Stress-1，壓力相關活化轉錄因子-1）是線蟲（C. elegans）中啟動粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）所需的轉錄因子。其獨特之處在於同時擁有粒線體目標序列與核定位訊號：在無壓力情況下，它會被送入粒線體並迅速降解；而在粒線體功能障礙時，其輸入受阻，轉而移位至細胞核，調控包含粒線體伴護蛋白誘導在內的廣泛轉錄反應。因此，細胞核中的ATFS-1將粒線體狀態直接與核基因表現連結起來。

label: IRS1
description: S6K1/2 (SK61_2), activated by mTORC1 phosphorylation, inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylating it, forming the negative feedback loop that is central to the incoherent bivalent motif underlying rapamycin hormesis. This feedback arm is the backward reaction from the inhibited target (mTORC1) toward the Input node (IRS1, controlled by S6K1/2), and its low Michaelis-Menten constant in the saturated regime strongly increases the probability of biphasic dose-responses. S6K1/2 also deactivates mTORC2, and a significant negative correlation exists between the inhibition of the IRS1-insulin complex and mTORC2 deactivation by the same enzyme S6K1.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2（SK61_2）被mTORC1磷酸化激活，通過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成rapamycin hormesis基礎的incoherent bivalent motif核心的負反饋迴路。這個反饋臂是從被抑製的靶點（mTORC1）向輸入節點（IRS1，由S6K1/2控制）的backward reaction，並且其低Michaelis-Menten常數在飽和條件下強烈增加了雙相劑量反應的可能性。S6K1/2還使mTORC2失活，並且在IRS1-胰島素复合物的抑製和同一酶S6K1對mTORC2的失活之間存在顯著的負相關。

label: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine
description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a prominent advanced glycation end product formed from glycated proteins. There is a marked correlation between the serum concentration of CML and vessel stiffness in elderly individuals, reflecting the role of AGE accumulation and ECM cross-linking in arterial stiffening. CML also accumulates in heart tissue with age, and dietary CML-enriched protein induces functional arterial aging in a RAGE-dependent manner in mice. Serum CML is therefore used as a biomarker of glycation burden and age-related vascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是由 glycated proteins 形成的重要 advanced glycation end product。Elderly individuals 血清 CML concentration 與 vessel stiffness 之間存在顯著相關性，反映了 AGE accumulation 與 ECM cross-linking 在 arterial stiffening 中的作用。CML 也隨年齡堆積於 heart tissue，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。因此，血清 CML 被用作 glycation burden 與 age-related vascular pathology 的 biomarker。

label: JAK-STAT3
description: The JAK-STAT3 signaling axis promotes a pro-inflammatory SASP by interacting with p38 MAPK and mTOR and by transducing cues from SASP cytokines such as IL-6. STAT3 activation contributes to age-related frailty and to the immune-modulatory and tumor-promoting facets of the secretome. JAK1/2 inhibitors (e.g., ruxolitinib) reduce SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8, validating the axis as a senomorphic target. The pathway is especially important for the feed-forward, self-reinforcing inflammation characteristic of chronic senescence.
description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 訊號軸透過與 p38 MAPK 和 mTOR 交互作用，以及轉導來自 SASP 細胞激素如 IL-6 的訊號，促進促發炎性 SASP。STAT3 活化促成年齡相關衰弱，以及分泌組的免疫調節與促腫瘤面向。JAK1/2 抑制劑（如 ruxolitinib）降低 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8，證實此軸作為 senomorphic 標靶。該路徑對慢性衰老特有的正向、自我強化發炎尤為重要。

label: Bim
description: MOMP is inhibited by Bim. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bim is a sentinel BH3-only protein sequestered at microtubules that is released by stress to directly activate Bax/Bak. The directionality runs from Bim toward MOMP, so Bim is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: MOMP 被 Bim 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bim 是一種隔離在微管中的前哨 BH3 蛋白，壓力釋放時可直接活化 Bax/Bak。方向性從 Bim 向 MOMP，因此 Bim 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Cognitive Decline
description: In transgenic models predisposed to Alzheimer's disease-like pathology, rapamycin prevented memory deficits and reduced cognitive decline, and inhibition of mTOR by rapamycin abolished cognitive deficits and reduced amyloid-beta levels in a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease. These robust neurological effects contrast with a systematic review finding that rapamycin and its derivatives improved immune, cardiovascular, and integumentary systems in humans but not neurological systems.
description_zh_TW: 在易患阿爾茨海默病樣病理的轉基因模型中，rapamycin預防了記憶缺陷並減少了認知能力下降，rapamycin對mTOR的抑製消除了認知缺陷並降低了阿爾茨海默病小鼠模型中的β-澱粉樣蛋白水平。這些強大的神經系統效應與一項系統評價形成對比，該評價發現rapamycin及其衍生物改善了人類的免疫、心血管和皮膚系統，但未改善神經系統。

label: Minority MOMP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Minority MOMP (sublethal mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization) allows mtDNA release from mitochondria into the cytosol without full apoptotic execution, providing a non-lethal route for mitochondrial danger signals to engage innate immunity. Cytosolic mtDNA acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern that activates the cGAS-STING axis, inducing type I interferon responses and reinforcing senescence-linked cytokine circuits and the SASP.
description_zh_TW: Minority MOMP（sublethal mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization）允許 mtDNA 從 mitochondria 釋放到 cytosol，而無需 full apoptotic execution，提供了一條 non-lethal route 讓 mitochondrial danger signals 參與 innate immunity。Cytosolic mtDNA 作為 damage-associated molecular pattern 激活 cGAS-STING axis，誘導 type I interferon responses 並強化 senescence-linked cytokine circuits 和 SASP。

label: DNA-SCARS
description: Genotoxic stress in therapy-induced senescence generates persistent DNA damage foci termed DNA-SCARS (DNA segments with chromatin alterations reinforcing senescence), which are precursors to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments. These structures sustain DDR signaling and the arrested state, and their shedding into the cytosol activates cGAS-STING and the SASP. DNA-SCARS thereby mechanistically link damage to durable senescence and inflammation. They are a defining feature distinguishing TIS from transient damage responses.
description_zh_TW: 治療誘發衰老中的基因毒性壓力產生稱為 DNA-SCARS（具染色質改變以強化衰老的 DNA 片段）的持續 DNA 損傷灶，它們是胞質染色質片段的前驅物。這些結構維持 DDR 訊號與停滯狀態，其脫落至胞質活化 cGAS-STING 與 SASP。DNA-SCARS 因此在機制上將損傷連結到持久衰老與發炎。它們是區分 TIS 與短暫損傷反應的定義性特徵。

label: SARM1
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SARM1 is an NAD+-consuming enzyme that, along with PARP1, PARP2, and CD38, can deplete cellular NAD+ pools and compromise sirtuin function. Directionally, SARM1 activity sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and impaired sirtuin signaling. Its activity is particularly relevant in neuronal contexts, where NAD+ depletion drives axonal degeneration. By consuming NAD+ upon injury or stress, SARM1 can starve sirtuins of their co-substrate at the very moment when their protective functions are most needed. This makes SARM1 an attractive therapeutic target for neurodegenerative conditions, where preventing NAD+ loss could preserve both axonal integrity and sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: SARM1是一種NAD+消耗酶，與PARP1、PARP2和CD38一起，可以耗竭細胞NAD+池並損害sirtuin功能。方向上，SARM1活性位於NAD+耗竭和sirtuin訊號受損的上游。其活性在神經元環境中尤為重要，因為NAD+耗竭驅動軸突退化。透過在損傷或壓力下消耗NAD+，SARM1可以在sirtuin的保護功能最需要的時刻使其缺乏共同底物。這使SARM1成為神經退行性疾病的有吸引力的治療靶點，在這些疾病中防止NAD+流失可以同時保留軸突完整性和sirtuin活性。

label: HAT
description: HAT is the standard abbreviation for histone acetyltransferase, a family of enzymes that transfer acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to lysine residues on histone tails. These enzymes are grouped into families such as the GNAT, MYST, and p300/CBP families, and their activity is central to epigenetic control of gene expression. HATs oppose the action of histone deacetylases and are frequently deregulated in cancer and aging, where changes in acetylation contribute to aberrant gene silencing and loss of transcriptional fidelity.
description_zh_TW: HAT 是組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的標準縮寫，該酶是將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的酶家族。這些酵素分為 GNAT、MYST 和 p300/CBP 等家族，它們的活性對於 gene expression 的表觀遺傳控制至關重要。 HAT 對抗組蛋白去乙醯化酶的作用，並且在癌症和老化過程中經常失調，其中乙醯化的變化會導致異常基因沉默和轉錄保真度喪失。

label: MFN1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Activated Parkin (PRKN), an E3 ubiquitin ligase recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by PINK1, polyubiquitinates outer membrane proteins such as MFN1, MFN2 and VDAC1 for subsequent recognition by mitophagy adaptors including p62/SQSTM1. Ubiquitination of MFN1 and MFN2 leads to mitochondrial fission, fragmentation and subsequent mitophagic degradation via autophagosome formation. Parkin-mediated mitophagy promotes clearance of damaged mitochondria and is protective in cardiovascular recovery, yet its constitutive activation can be detrimental; Parkin mutations cause early-onset Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: 活化的Parkin（PRKN）是一種E3泛素連接酶，被PINK1招募至外粒線體膜，對外膜蛋白如MFN1、MFN2和VDAC1進行多聚泛素化，隨後被包括p62/SQSTM1在內的線粒體自噬接頭蛋白識別。MFN1和MFN2的泛素化導致粒線體分裂、碎片化，隨後通過自噬體形成進行線粒體自噬降解。Parkin介導的線粒體自噬促進受損粒線體的清除，並在心血管恢復中具有保護作用，但其組成性活化可能有害；Parkin突變導致早發性帕金森氏症。

label: Low-Density Lipoprotein
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Advanced glycation end products damage the cardiovascular system in part by glycating low-density lipoproteins (LDL) on both the apolipoprotein B and phospholipid components of the particle. Glycated LDL is more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall than non-glycated LDL, and it is not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway, so it accumulates in the vessel wall. Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation and the development of atheroma. This glycoxidative modification of LDL is thus a direct route through which AGEs promote atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products部分透過對low-density lipoproteins（LDL）顆粒上的apolipoprotein B與phospholipid components進行glycating，來damages the cardiovascular system。Glycated LDL比non-glycated LDL更susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall，且它not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway，因此accumulates in the vessel wall。Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation與atheroma的development。因此，此glycoxidative modification of LDL是AGEs promote atherosclerosis的direct route。

label: SRC kinase
description: Extrinsic Pathway is suppressed by SRC kinase. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. SRC is a non-receptor tyrosine kinase that promotes survival and, notably, phosphorylates and inactivates caspase-8 and Bik. The directionality runs from SRC kinase toward Extrinsic Pathway, so SRC kinase is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Extrinsic Pathway 被 SRC kinase 抑制。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 SRC 是一種非受體酪胺酸激酶，可促進存活，尤其是磷酸化 caspase-8 和 Bik 並使其失去活性。方向性從SRC kinase 向Extrinsic Pathway 延伸，因此SRC kinase 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: NOX4
description: NOX4 produces hydrogen peroxide rather than superoxide because it is constitutively active and dismutates its product internally, releasing H2O2 as the main extracellular and matrix signaling oxidant. This makes NOX4 a major source of the diffusible second messenger in fibroblasts and the kidney. The directionality is enzyme activity to H2O2 signaling. A caveat is that NOX4's H2O2 output is context-dependent and can be both profibrotic via TGF-beta signaling and protective depending on tissue. NOX4 is unique among NOX isoforms in being constitutively active and regulated primarily at the transcriptional level, for instance by TGF-beta and hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: NOX4 產生 hydrogen peroxide 而不是超氧化物，因為它具有組成活性並在內部歧化其產物，釋放 H2O2 作為主要的細胞外和基質信號傳導氧化劑。這使得 NOX4 成為成纖維細胞和腎臟中可擴散第二信使的主要來源。方向性是酵素對 H2O2 訊號傳導的活性。需要注意的是，NOX4 的 H2O2 輸出是上下文相關的，並且可以透過 TGF-beta 訊號傳導促進纖維化，也可以根據組織提供保護作用。 NOX4 在 NOX 同工型中是獨特的，因為它具有組成型活性，並且主要在轉錄層面上受到調節，例如透過 TGF-beta 和缺氧調節。

label: Caspase-5
description: Caspase-5 (human) is the inducible noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D to drive SASP and pyroptosis. Its activation is essential for the noncanonical inflammasome's role in senescence, and its expression is induced by interferons and controlled upstream by the cGAS-STING pathway. The relationship positions caspase-5 as the enzymatic executor of the pathway in human cells. It is supported by cleavage-site and loss-of-function studies showing reduced SASP after CASP5 knockdown.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-5（人類）是可誘發的非典型效應 caspase，切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptosis。其活化對非典型發炎體在衰老中的角色必要，且其表現被干擾素誘發並受上游 cGAS-STING 控制。透過產生活性 IL-1alpha，caspase-5 許可 SASP 本身而非僅回應它，將非典型發炎體置於分泌組上游。此切割是連結先天免疫到衰老溝通的關鍵步驟。

label: Fructosamine-3-kinase
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) is an intracellular enzyme that initiates protein deglycation by phosphorylating fructosamine, the Amadori residues on glycated proteins, converting them into fructosamine-3-phosphate. This phosphorylated compound is highly unstable and spontaneously decomposes, regenerating the original, undamaged amino acid and releasing 3-deoxyglucosone, which is then neutralized by detoxifying enzymes. By repairing early glycation intermediates before they progress to irreversible AGEs, FN3K provides the repair arm of the enzymatic defense against AGE accumulation, complementary to prevention by dicarbonyl detoxification.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶（Fructosamine-3-kinase, FN3K）是一種細胞內酵素，透過磷酸化果糖胺（即糖化蛋白上的阿馬多里殘基）來啟動蛋白質去糖化，將其轉化為果糖胺-3-磷酸（fructosamine-3-phosphate）。此磷酸化化合物高度不穩定並自發分解，再生原始的未受損胺基酸並釋出 3-deoxyglucosone，隨後被解毒酵素中和。透過在不可逆 AGE 形成之前修復早期糖化中間產物，FN3K 提供了對抗 AGE 堆積之酵素防禦的修復臂，補充二羰基解毒的預防作用。

label: Adrenoleukodystrophy
description: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
description_zh_TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

label: Adrenochrome Hypothesis
description: The adrenochrome hypothesis is a largely discredited theory from the 1950s, associated with researchers such as Abram Hoffer and Humphry Osmond, proposing that the abnormal oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome produces hallucinogenic or psychotogenic compounds that cause schizophrenia. The hypothesis proposed that adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine, could be a psychotomimetic molecule. Subsequent research did not support a causal role for adrenochrome in schizophrenia, and the hypothesis is now viewed as historically significant but not mainstream. It contributed to the cultural fascination with adrenochrome, though the compound has no proven psychoactive or clinical use.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome hypothesis 是 1950 年代一個大致已被否定的理論，與 Abram Hoffer 和 Humphry Osmond 等研究者相關，主張 adrenaline 異常氧化成 adrenochrome 會產生致幻或致精神病的化合物，導致 schizophrenia。該假說主張，adrenochrome 作為 epinephrine 的氧化產物，可能是一種 psychotomimetic 分子。後續研究並未支持 adrenochrome 在 schizophrenia 中的因果角色，此假說現在被視為具有歷史意義但非主流。它助長了對 adrenochrome 的文化迷戀，儘管該化合物並無證實的 psychoactive 或臨床用途。

label: MethylB12
description: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) can cause mood side effects, such as anxiety, irritability, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it is a direct methyl donor that adds to an already slowly processed methyl burden. The excess methyl groups can shift neurotransmitter and epigenetic methylation beyond the optimal range, producing emotional dysregulation. Slower COMT individuals are therefore often advised to use non-methylated B12 forms such as hydroxocobalamin or adenosylcobalamin. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) 可能會在緩慢的 COMT 個體中引起情緒副作用，例如焦慮、易怒或過度刺激，因為它是直接的 methyl donor，會增加已經緩慢處理的甲基負擔。過量的 methyl groups 可以使神經傳導物質和表觀遺傳甲基化超出最佳範圍，從而產生情緒失調。因此，速度較慢的 COMT 個體通常被建議使用非甲基化 B12 形式，例如羥鈷胺或腺苷鈷胺。其作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。

label: adrenochrome synthesis
description: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
description_zh_TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

label: SIRT1 overexpression
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 overexpression reduces α-synuclein aggregates, supporting a role in Parkinson's protection (via FOXO/autophagy pathways).
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過表達減少 α-synuclein 聚集體，支持其在帕金森氏症保護中的作用（透過 FOXO/自噬通路）。

label: SIRT3 activation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT3 activation prevents amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons from developing metabolic abnormalities. ALS motor neurons exhibit hallmark metabolic defects including decreased mitochondrial respiration and increased glycolysis, which arise from systemic NAD+ depletion. SIRT3 activation and/or NAD+ supplementation has been discovered as a treatment for disease phenotypes in both sporadic and familial ALS, restoring normal mitochondrial metabolism and rescuing motor neuron viability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3活化防止肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症（ALS）運動神經元出現代謝異常。ALS運動神經元表現出標誌性的代謝缺陷，包括粒線體呼吸降低和糖解作用增加，這些源於全身性NAD+耗竭。SIRT3活化和/或NAD+補充已被發現可治療散發性和家族性ALS的疾病表型，恢復正常的粒線體代謝並挽救運動神經元存活能力。

label: Folinic acid
description: Folinic acid (5-formyltetrahydrofolate) bypasses the MTHFR enzyme because it enters folate metabolism downstream of the MTHFR-catalyzed reduction step, requiring conversion by other enzymes to 5-methyl-THF without direct MTHFR dependence. This makes it useful for individuals with MTHFR variants who cannot efficiently generate methylfolate from folic acid or 5,10-methylene-THF. It provides methyl groups for the cycle without relying on the impaired enzymatic step. It is a common alternative in personalized methylation support protocols.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid（5-甲醯四氫葉酸）繞過 MTHFR 酶，因為它進入 MTHFR 催化還原步驟下游的 folate 代謝，需要其他酶轉化為 5-甲基-THF，而不直接依賴 MTHFR。這使得它對於患有 MTHFR variants 且無法有效地從葉酸或 5,10-亞甲基-THF 生成甲基葉酸的個體非常有用。它為循環提供 methyl groups，而不依賴受損的酶促步驟。它是個人化甲基化支持方案中的常見替代方案。

label: AMPK activation
description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
description_zh_TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

label: TRPML1
description: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
description_zh_TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

label: Nicotinic acid
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day, and several preclinical studies have confirmed that both NA and nicotinamide (NAM) can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NA shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels and is used to treat dyslipidemia, but this flushing side effect limits its tolerability. In contrast, nicotinamide riboside (NR) elevates NAD+ levels without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, and was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects.
description_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關，且數項臨床前研究已確認 NA 與 nicotinamide（NAM）皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。NA 展現降低血脂水平的效果並被用於治療血脂異常，但此潮紅副作用限制了其耐受性。相對地，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）提升 NAD+ 水平而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），並在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用。

label: Ferroptosis in IDD
description: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 髓核細胞在椎間盤退化中衰退，在氧化壓力下被 SIRT3 敲減加劇。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，加速 NPC 功能衰退；SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度。

label: LipA
description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

label: SIRT2 inhibition
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Inhibition of SIRT2 suppresses the in vitro growth and in vivo engraftment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells through diminished deacetylation of LIM domain only 2 (LMO2). Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of LMO2-dependent leukemia suppression. LMO2 is a key oncogenic transcription factor in T-ALL, and its activity depends on deacetylation by SIRT2. Blocking SIRT2 reduces LMO2 function, impairing both the expansion of leukemic cells in culture and their ability to engraft in vivo. This identifies SIRT2 inhibition as a promising approach for T-ALL therapy, targeting a central oncogenic driver in this disease.
description_zh_TW: 抑制SIRT2透過減少LIM domain only 2（LMO2）的去乙醯化來抑制T細胞急性淋巴性白血病細胞的體外生長和體內植入。方向上，SIRT2抑制位於LMO2依賴性白血病抑制的上游。LMO2是T-ALL中的關鍵致癌轉錄因子，其活性依賴SIRT2的去乙醯化。阻斷SIRT2降低LMO2功能，損害白血病細胞在培養中的擴增和在體內的植入能力。這將SIRT2抑制確定為T-ALL治療的有前景方法，靶向此疾病中的核心致癌驅動因子。

label: SARS-CoV-2
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SARS-CoV-2 infection triggers a maladaptive immune response, notably an exaggerated proinflammatory response leading to a cytokine storm in lung tissue, and lymphopenia with a drastic decline of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells. Upon activation of the adaptive immune response, the overexpression of CD38 in both CD4+ and CD8+ lymphocytes further exaggerates NAD+ depletion, leading to increased production and release of proinflammatory cytokines, reactive oxygen species, and macrophage infiltration. Drastic NAD+ depletion impairs sirtuin function, and replenishment of NAD+ body content could restore energy levels and impaired sirtuin function, possibly rebalancing the maladaptive immune response to
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 感染觸發適應不良的免疫反應，特別是誇大的促發炎反應導致肺組織中的細胞激素風暴，以及淋巴球減少伴隨 CD4+ 與 CD8+ T 細胞的急劇下降。在適應性免疫反應活化後，CD38 在 CD4+ 與 CD8+ 淋巴球中的過度表現進一步加劇 NAD+ 耗竭，導致促發炎性細胞激素、活性氧與巨噬細胞浸潤的產生與釋放增加。急劇的 NAD+ 耗竭損害 sirtuin 功能，而補充體內 NAD+ 含量可恢復能量水平與受損的 sirtuin 功能，可能重新平衡此適應不良免疫反應至

label: mTORC1 to lysosomes
description: The Ragulator is a multiprotein scaffold anchored at the lysosomal membrane that interacts with Rag GTPases to recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acids. By tethering the Rag-mTORC1 complex at the lysosome, Ragulator enables amino-acid sensing to converge with Rheb-mediated activation. Loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. The complex is therefore the lynchpin coupling lysosomal amino-acid detection to mTORC1 and autophagy control.
description_zh_TW: Ragulator 是錨定於溶酶體膜上的多蛋白支架，與 Rag GTPases 交互作用，以回應胺基酸將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體表面。透過將 Rag-mTORC1 複合物栓繫於溶酶體，Ragulator 使得胺基酸感知能與 Rheb 介導的活化匯聚。Ragulator 的缺失會破壞依賴營養的 mTORC1 信號並解除對自噬的抑制。因此該複合物是將溶酶體胺基酸偵測連結至 mTORC1 與自噬控制的關鍵樞紐。

label: Sirtuin deacetylation reaction
description: During the sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation of a lysine, NAD+ is cleaved between its nicotinamide and ADP-ribose moieties, and the acetyl group is transferred to the ADP-ribose to generate 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose (OAADPr) plus free nicotinamide. OAADPr is a stoichiometric by-product, released in equimolar amounts with the deacetylated substrate on every catalytic cycle. This molecule is not merely waste: it binds and activates the TRPM2 cation channel, linking sirtuin activity to calcium signaling and cellular stress responses. A caveat is that OAADPr accumulation can itself feed back on cellular metabolism, and its levels reflect the integrated deacetylase flux of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 在 sirtuin 催化的離胺酸去乙醯化過程中，NAD+ 在菸鹼醯胺和 ADP-核糖基團之間被裂解，乙醯基被轉移到 ADP-核糖上，生成 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose（OAADPr）和游離的菸鹼醯胺。OAADPr 是化學計量的副產物，在每個催化週期中以等摩爾量與去乙醯化的受質一起釋放。這個分子不僅僅是廢物：它能結合並活化 TRPM2 陽離子通道，將 sirtuin 活性與鈣離子訊號傳導和細胞壓力反應聯繫起來。需要注意的是，OAADPr 的積累本身可以反饋影響細胞代謝，其水平反映了細胞整體的去乙醯酶通量。

label: Tenovins
description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

label: Zellweger syndrome
description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

label: IL-7
description: Thymic epithelial cells produce a number of colony stimulating factors and hematopoietic cytokines, including IL-1, IL-3, IL-6, IL-7, TGF-β, oncostatin M, and leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF). Intrathymic and systemic production of these cytokines and growth factors regulates the complex process of thymopoiesis and is responsible for stromal cross-talk within the thymic microenvironment. IL-7 in particular is a crucial cytokine for thymocyte survival and T cell development, making the thymic cytokine milieu a candidate target for therapies aimed at reversing age-induced thymic involution. Loss of TEC-derived IL-7 production with age contributes to declining thymic output.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺上皮細胞產生多種集落刺激因子和造血細胞因子，包括 IL-1、IL-3、IL-6、IL-7、TGF-β、oncostatin M 和白血病抑制因子（LIF）。胸腺內和全身性的這些細胞因子和生長因子的產生調節胸腺生成的複雜過程，並負責胸腺微環境內的基質交談。IL-7 尤其是胸腺細胞存活和 T 細胞發育的關鍵細胞因子，使胸腺細胞因子環境成為旨在逆轉年齡相關胸腺退化的治療候選靶點。隨著年齡增長，TEC 來源的 IL-7 產生減少導致胸腺輸出下降。

label: Superoxide
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: NADPH oxidase is a complex of enzymes activated downstream of AGE-RAGE interaction that produces superoxide, an important reactive oxygen species. When this complex is upregulated, it increases intracellular oxidative stress, and the resulting oxidant burst can activate NF-kB, further amplifying inflammatory gene expression. NADPH oxidase therefore serves as a molecular bridge between receptor-mediated AGE signaling and oxidative damage. This NADPH oxidase-derived superoxide production is a key reason advanced glycation end products behave as pro-oxidant agents, contributing to the oxidative stress component of diabetic complications and aging.
description_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase是AGE-RAGE interaction downstream activated的enzymes complex，produces superoxide這一important reactive oxygen species。當此complex is upregulated，它increases intracellular oxidative stress，而由此resulting oxidant burst可activate NF-kB，further amplifying inflammatory gene expression。因此，NADPH oxidase serves as a molecular bridge between receptor-mediated AGE signaling與oxidative damage。此NADPH oxidase-derived superoxide production是advanced glycation end products behave as pro-oxidant agents、contributing to diabetic complications與aging中oxidative stress component的key reason。

label: Senotherapeutic
description: The term 'senotherapeutic' is an umbrella encompassing both senolytics (which eliminate senescent cells) and senomorphics (which suppress the SASP). Senolytics act on the cellular driver, while senomorphics act on the secretory effector, together spanning the intervention space against senescence. This inclusive definition reflects the field's two-pronged therapeutic philosophy and accommodates agents with dual activity, such as fisetin. Recognizing both under one term aids classification and communication of anti-senescence strategies.
description_zh_TW: 「senotherapeutic」一詞是涵蓋 senolytics（消除衰老細胞）與 senomorphics（抑制 SASP）的傘詞。Senolytics 作用於細胞驅動者，senomorphics 作用於分泌效應器，共同涵蓋對抗衰老的介入空間。此包容性定義反映該領域的雙管齊下治療哲學，並容納具雙重活性的藥劑如 fisetin。在單一詞下辨識兩者有助於抗衰老策略的分類與溝通。

label: Axonal Degeneration
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Among three tested NAD+ precursors (nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and nicotinamide riboside) including NAD+ itself, only NR could prevent axonal degeneration by altering the local NR metabolism within the axon. Axonal degeneration is an early event in acute cerebral injury and in chronic neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, and it is caused by excitotoxicity, which induces strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, suggesting that Nmrk1 is a key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of NR.
description_zh_TW: 在測試的三種 NAD+ 前驅物（nicotinic acid、nicotinamide 與 nicotinamide riboside）以及 NAD+ 本身之中，唯有 NR 能透過改變軸突內局部的 NR 代謝來預防軸突退化。軸突退化是急性腦損傷以及包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症在內的慢性神經退化性疾病的早期事件，且由興奮毒性所引起，後者會誘發神經元中強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，顯示 Nmrk1 是 NR 神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。

label: Cholesterol
description: Malondialdehyde modifies cholesterol by forming MDA-lysine adducts on LDL apolipoproteins, creating MDA-LDL that is recognized by macrophage scavenger receptors. This modification enhances unregulated uptake and foam-cell formation in the arterial wall. The directionality is peroxidation product to LDL modification to atherogenic uptake. A caveat is that other aldehydes (4-HNE, acrolein) modify LDL similarly, so MDA-LDL is a representative but not exclusive epitope. MDA-modified LDL is pro-inflammatory and immunogenic, and its accumulation in plaques is used as a marker of oxidative modification of lipoproteins.
description_zh_TW: Malondialdehyde 透過在 LDL apolipoproteins 上形成 MDA-賴氨酸加合物來修飾 cholesterol，從而產生可被巨噬細胞清道夫受體辨識的 MDA-LDL。這種修飾增強了動脈壁中不受調節的吸收和泡沫細胞的形成。方向性是過氧化產物到低密度脂蛋白修飾到致動脈粥狀硬化的攝取。需要注意的是，其他醛（4-HNE、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 LDL，因此 MDA-LDL 是代表性表位，但不是唯一的表位。 MDA 修飾的 LDL 具有促發炎性和免疫原性，其在斑塊中的累積可用作 lipoproteins 氧化修飾的標記物。

label: Androgen Receptor
description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: Gasdermin E
description: Caspase-3 cleaves gasdermin E (GSDME), releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain and converting apoptosis into pyroptosis. The outcome is dictated by GSDME expression level: in GSDME-high cancer cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 drives pyroptotic lysis; in GSDME-low settings, GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3, reinforcing classical apoptosis. This caspase-3/GSDME switch is the clearest demonstration that the caspase substrate — not the caspase itself — determines the death modality.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 會切割 gasdermin E（GSDME），釋出其成孔的 N 端片段，使細胞凋亡轉為焦亡。結果由 GSDME 的表達量決定：在 GSDME 高表達的癌細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 驅動焦亡裂解；在 GSDME 低表達的情境下，GSDME 反而作為 Caspase-3 的上游活化因子，強化典型細胞凋亡。Caspase-3/GSDME 開關最清楚地表現出：決定死亡型態的是 caspase 的受質，而非 caspase 本身。

label: Exosomes
description: ALIX regulates Exosomes. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. Exosomes are nanovesicles shed by tumor cells that traffic immune-checkpoint ligands and growth signals within the microenvironment. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon Exosomes rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ALIX 調節 Exosomes。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 Exosomes 是腫瘤細胞脫落的奈米囊泡，在微環境中傳遞免疫檢查點配體和生長訊號。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 Exosomes 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: KDM4
description: KDM4 (also known as JMJD2) is a histone demethylase that removes methyl groups from H3K9, including the repressive H3K9me3 mark. In senescent cells, KDM4 expression increases, diminishing H3K9 methylation and thereby enhancing SASP gene expression at loci such as IL-6 and IL-8 by opening repressive chromatin. Inhibitors of KDM4 are in clinical trials for cancer and are being evaluated as senomorphic agents because KDM4 knockdown prevents SASP emergence without affecting cell cycle arrest. KDM4 inhibition is therefore a candidate strategy to blunt the inflammatory SASP.
description_zh_TW: KDM4（也稱為 JMJD2）是一種組蛋白去甲基化酶，可從 H3K9 中去除 methyl groups，包括抑制性 H3K9me3 標記。在老化細胞中，KDM4 表達增加，減少 H3K9 甲基化，從而透過打開抑制性染色質來增強 IL-6 和 IL-8 等位點的 SASP gene expression。 KDM4 抑制劑正在進行癌症臨床試驗，並被評估為同型藥物，因為 KDM4 敲低可阻止 SASP 出現，而不影響細胞週期停滯。因此，KDM4 抑制是抑制發炎 SASP 的候選策略。

label: Senomorphics
description: Senotherapeutics encompass senomorphics as the SASP-suppressing arm of the anti-senescence strategy, complementary to senolytics. Senomorphics modulate rather than remove senescent cells, preserving beneficial acute senescence, and their inclusion under the senotherapeutic umbrella highlights the diversity of mechanisms (mTOR, NF-kB, JAK-STAT, BET, sirtuins). The term thus unifies elimination- and modulation-based approaches within a single conceptual framework. This classification supports the rational design and comparison of anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: Senotherapeutics 涵蓋 senomorphics 作為抗衰老策略中抑制 SASP 的臂，與 senolytics 互補。Senomorphics 調節而非移除衰老細胞，保留有益的急性衰老，其納入於 senotherapeutic 傘下凸顯機制的多樣性（mTOR、NF-κB、JAK-STAT、BET、sirtuins）。此詞因此將消除與調節為本的途徑統一於單一概念框架。此分類支持抗老化介入的合理設計與比較。

label: Neurotransmitters
description: Neurotransmitters and Catecholamines are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neurotransmitters and Catecholamines may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neurotransmitters 和 Catecholamines 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neurotransmitters 和 Catecholamines 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Gossypol
description: Apoptosis is induced by Gossypol. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. The directionality runs from Gossypol toward Apoptosis, so Gossypol is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 Gossypol 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。方向性從 Gossypol 向 Apoptosis，因此 Gossypol 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Puma
description: Nuclear p53 transcriptionally activates PUMA (p53 upregulated modulator of apoptosis), a BH3-only protein that binds and inhibits the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL. Because PUMA can act both as a direct activator of BAX/BAK and as a sensitizer that displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members, p53-PUMA signaling lowers the mitochondrial threshold for cytochrome c release. Cytoplasmic p53 additionally retains the ability to activate BAX and BAK directly.
description_zh_TW: 細胞核內的 p53 會轉錄活化 PUMA（p53 上調凋亡調控因子），一種可結合並抑制抗凋亡 BCL-xL 的 BH3-only 蛋白。由於 PUMA 既能直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能作為置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員的敏化因子，p53-PUMA 訊號降低了粒線體釋出 cytochrome c 的門檻。此外，細胞質型的 p53 仍可直接活化 BAX 與 BAK。

label: MMP
description: MMP promotes Metastasis. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MMP 促進Metastasis。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Dietary AGE Restriction
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Intervention studies in mice show that reduced dietary AGEs attenuate insulin resistance, increase prevention of diabetes, and, in diabetic mice, reduce diabetic vascular and renal complications and improve impaired wound healing. The positive outcomes of caloric restriction in mice may be explained in part by a decrease in AGE intake and a concomitant decrease in oxidative stress. These findings indicate that the glycation load of the diet is not merely a bystander but can modulate insulin sensitivity and metabolic health, reinforcing the idea that dietary AGE restriction is a viable intervention against metabolic dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠的介入研究顯示，減少飲食性 AGE 可減緩胰島素抗性、增加糖尿病預防，且在糖尿病小鼠中減少糖尿病血管與腎臟併發症並改善受損傷口癒合。小鼠中熱量限制（caloric restriction）的正面結果可能部分可由 AGE 攝取減少與伴隨的氧化壓力下降來解釋。這些發現指出，飲食的糖化負載不只是旁觀者，而是能調節胰島素敏感度與代謝健康，強化了飲食 AGE 限制是對抗代謝功能障礙之可行介入手段的觀念。

label: Adrenochrome Semiquinone Radical
description: Adrenochrome undergoes one-electron reduction to the adrenochrome semiquinone radical, a highly reactive intermediate species. Common cellular reducers that drive this reaction include mitochondrial Complex I using NADH, NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase, and non-enzymatic reductants such as ascorbate and adrenaline itself. The semiquinone radical is central to adrenochrome redox cycling, as it rapidly auto-oxidizes to regenerate adrenochrome while producing superoxide anion at a fast rate. This radical-mediated redox loop means that adrenochrome can catalytically amplify reactive oxygen species and oxidative damage, and it has been studied in cardiac tissue where high catecholamine exposure and mitochondrial density make the cycle particularly relevant.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 經受單電子還原成為高度反應性的中間物種 adrenochrome 半醌自由基。驅動此反應的常見細胞還原劑包括使用 NADH 的粒線體 Complex I、NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase，以及抗壞血酸與 adrenaline 本身等非酶性還原劑。半醌自由基是 adrenochrome 氧化還原循環的核心，因為它迅速自氧化以再生 adrenochrome，同時以快速速率產生超氧陰離子。此自由基介導的氧化還原迴圈意味著 adrenochrome 能催化放大活性氧物種與氧化損傷，且已在兒茶酚胺暴露高與粒線體密度高的心臟組織中被研究，使此循環特別相關。

label: Dasatinib
description: Senolytic therapy uses dasatinib as part of the foundational D+Q combination (Zhu et al., Nat Med 2015) for clearing senescent cells. Dasatinib's kinase-inhibitory activity lowers the apoptotic threshold of senescent cells and synergizes with quercetin, and its established clinical safety profile in leukemia facilitates repurposing in senolytic trials. The combination has shown efficacy across multiple senescent cell types and in vivo models, and D+Q has been tested in pilot clinical trials for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and diabetic kidney disease.
description_zh_TW: Senolytic 療法使用 dasatinib，作為清除衰老細胞的基礎 D+Q 組合（Zhu 等人，Nat Med 2015）的一部分。Dasatinib 的激酶抑制活性降低衰老細胞的凋亡閾值並與 quercetin 協同，其在白血病中既有的臨床安全特性有助於在 senolytic 試驗中重新定位。此組合已在多種衰老細胞類型與體內模型展現療效，且 D+Q 已在特發性肺纖維化與糖尿病腎病的試驗性臨床試驗中測試。

label: CTPI2
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Targeting mitochondrial citrate metabolism suppresses inflammation across tissues and improves tissue function and healthspan during ageing without detectable changes in p16 or p21 expression, consistent with SASP modulation rather than senolytic clearance of senescent cells. In aged muscle, senescent-like nuclei defined by the CoreScence gene signature are present at similar abundance and distribution across conditions despite reduced SASP-associated transcription and chromatin accessibility at loci such as Ccl2 and Igfbp4. In the liver, the abundance of p16-positive and/or p21-positive cells remains unchanged while their nuclear histone acetylation is reduced by CTPI2 treatment.
description_zh_TW: 靶向線粒體枸櫞酸代謝抑制多個組織中的炎症，並在老化過程中改善組織功能和健康壽命，而p16或p21表達沒有可檢測到的變化，這與SASP調節而非衰老細胞的senolytic清除一致。在老年肌肉中，由CoreScence基因特徵定義的衰老樣細胞核在不同條件下以相似的豐度和分佈存在，儘管SASP相關轉錄和染色質可及性在Ccl2和Igfbp4等位點降低。在肝臟中，p16陽性和/或p21陽性細胞的豐度保持不變，而它們的細胞核組蛋白乙酰化被CTPI2治療降低。

label: TXNIP
description: In pancreatic beta-cells, SIRT6 preserves glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) and cell survival by repressing expression of TXNIP, a pro-oxidant and pro-apoptotic protein. This repression is achieved through histone deacetylation, with SIRT6 removing acetylation marks at H3K9 and H3K56 in the TXNIP regulatory region. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of TXNIP suppression via chromatin modification. By keeping TXNIP low, SIRT6 protects beta-cells from glucotoxic damage and maintains their capacity to secrete insulin in response to glucose. This links SIRT6's epigenetic function directly to pancreatic beta-cell health and the preservation of glucose homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 在胰島β細胞中，SIRT6透過抑制TXNIP的表達來維持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌（GSIS）和細胞存活，TXNIP是一種促氧化和促凋亡蛋白。此抑制透過組蛋白去乙醯化實現，SIRT6在TXNIP調控區域移除H3K9和H3K56的乙醯化標記。方向上，SIRT6透過染色質修飾位於TXNIP抑制的上游。透過保持TXNIP低水平，SIRT6保護β細胞免受葡萄糖毒性的損傷，並維持其對葡萄糖反應分泌胰島素的能力。這將SIRT6的表觀遺傳功能直接與胰島β細胞健康和葡萄糖恆定的維持聯繫起來。

label: Fructosyl-Amino Acid Oxidases
description: Fructosyl-amino acid oxidases (FAOD), also known as amadoriases, are enzymes found primarily in fungi and bacteria, such as Aspergillus species, that catalyze the oxidation of Amadori products. The reaction yields an unmodified amino acid, a glucosone, and hydrogen peroxide. Because they deglycate early glycation intermediates, FAOD are actively researched for therapeutic and cosmetic applications, and some research explores pairing FAOD with fructosamine-3-kinase to synergistically deglycate damaged structural proteins such as skin collagen. These enzymes represent a repair-based strategy for reducing AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-胺基酸氧化酶（Fructosyl-amino acid oxidases, FAOD），亦稱為 amadoriases，是主要存在於真菌與細菌（如麴菌屬 Aspergillus 物種）中的酵素，催化阿馬多里產物的氧化。此反應產生未修飾的胺基酸、葡萄糖酮（glucosone）與過氧化氫。由於它們使早期糖化中間產物去糖化，FAOD 被積極研究用於治療與美容應用，且部分研究探討將 FAOD 與果糖胺-3-激酶配對，以協同地去糖化受損的結構蛋白如皮膚膠原蛋白。這些酵素代表一種基於修復的減少 AGE 堆積策略。

label: CD73
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD73, the rate-limiting ectonucleotidase that converts AMP to immunosuppressive adenosine in the tumor microenvironment, is downregulated following intermittent fasting. Reduced CD73 expression leads to diminished extracellular adenosine, which can relieve adenosine-mediated immune suppression and enhance anti-tumor immunity. The regulation is observed in vitro under fasting-mimetic conditions, linking IF to both metabolic and immunological remodeling. Because adenosine signaling promotes tumor evasion, CD73 downregulation represents a plausible mechanism by which fasting improves cancer therapy outcomes.
description_zh_TW: CD73是腫瘤微環境中將AMP轉化為免疫抑制性腺苷的限速胞外核苷酸酶，在間歇性斷食後下調。CD73表現降低導致細胞外腺苷減少，可緩解腺苷介導的免疫抑制並增強抗腫瘤免疫。此調節在體外斷食模擬條件下觀察到，將IF與代謝和免疫重塑連結。由於腺苷訊號促進腫瘤逃避免疫，CD73下調代表斷食改善癌症治療結果的一個合理機制。

label: Lactate
description: Lactate can downregulate SIRT3, which in turn increases acyl-CoA synthetase long chain family member 4 (ACSL4) lactylation, thereby promoting ferroptosis and accelerating the decline of nucleus pulposus cell functionality in intervertebral disc degeneration. This cascade connects disc metabolic dysregulation (hypoxia, lactate accumulation) to SIRT3 loss and ferroptotic cell death via the lactylation mark.
description_zh_TW: 乳酸可以下調 SIRT3，後者反過來增加脂肪醯-CoA 合酶長鏈家族成員 4（ACSL4）的乳醯化，從而促進鐵死亡並加速椎間盤退化中髓核細胞功能的衰退。此級聯將椎間盤代謝失調（低氧、乳酸累積）透過乳醯化標記與 SIRT3 缺失和鐵死亡性細胞死亡聯繫起來。

label: RB1
description: RB1, the product of the retinoblastoma gene, enforces quiescence by sequestering E2F transcription factors and blocking the expression of S-phase genes. In its active hypophosphorylated form, pRb binds E2F and recruits repressive chromatin machinery to E2F target promoters, maintaining the G1/S restriction point. Cyclin-dependent kinase phosphorylation inactivates this brake and releases E2F, permitting cell cycle re-entry, while loss of RB1 function promotes unscheduled proliferation in cancer.
description_zh_TW: RB1 是視網膜母細胞瘤基因的產物，透過隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期基因的表達來強制靜止。在其活性低磷酸化形式中，pRb 結合 E2F 並將抑制性染色質機制募集到 E2F 目標啟動子上，從而維持 G1/S 限制點。細胞週期蛋白依賴性激酶磷酸化使這種制動失活並釋放 E2F，允許細胞週期重新進入，而 RB1 功能的喪失會促進癌症中非計劃的增殖。

label: Foam Cells
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Glycated low-density lipoprotein is taken up by macrophages in the arterial wall, and this uptake of modified LDL leads to foam cell formation. Because glycation reduces LDL uptake by the normal cell receptor pathway, modified LDL accumulates, and its subsequent engulfment by macrophages produces lipid-laden foam cells, the hallmark cells of atherosclerotic plaques. The formation of foam cells from modified LDL represents an initiating step of atheroma development and explains why AGE-mediated modification of LDL is considered pro-atherogenic. This pathway links glycation chemistry directly to the cellular pathology of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease.
