description_zh_TW: Glycated low-density lipoprotein被arterial wall中的macrophages攝取，而此uptake of modified LDL leads to foam cell formation。由於glycation reduces LDL uptake by the normal cell receptor pathway，modified LDL accumulates，其subsequent engulfment by macrophages produces lipid-laden foam cells——atherosclerotic plaques的hallmark cells。由modified LDL形成foam cells represents an initiating step of atheroma development，並explains why AGE-mediated modification of LDL is considered pro-atherogenic。此pathway links glycation chemistry directly to the cellular pathology of atherosclerosis與cardiovascular disease。

label: Vasodilation
description: Under normal conditions nitric oxide is a crucial signaling molecule that relaxes vascular smooth muscle via activation of soluble guanylyl cyclase and cGMP production. However, during severe inflammation, injury, or shock, overproduction of NO - primarily by inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) - leads to excessive vasodilation, vascular leakage, and tissue damage. This is the pathway targeted by both aminoguanidine, which blocks NO synthesis at iNOS (upstream), and methylene blue, which blocks NO action at sGC (downstream).
description_zh_TW: 正常情況下，一氧化氮是通過激活可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶和cGMP產生來放鬆血管平滑肌的關鍵信號分子。然而，在嚴重炎症、損傷或休克期間，NO的過度產生（主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）產生）導致過度血管舒張、血管滲漏和組織損傷。這正是氨基胍（在iNOS水平阻斷NO合成，上游）和亞甲藍（在sGC水平阻斷NO作用，下游）共同靶向的通路。

label: Deacetylation
description: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) remove acetyl groups from epsilon-N-acetyl-lysine residues on histone tails, restoring the positive charge of lysine side chains. This increases the affinity of histones for DNA, allowing chromatin to wrap more tightly and generally repressing transcription. HDACs are grouped into classes, with class I and II enzymes using zinc-dependent catalysis and class III sirtuins using NAD+ as a cofactor, and HDAC inhibitors are widely used experimentally to reactivate gene expression.
description_zh_TW: Histone 去乙醯化酶 (HDAC) 可去除組蛋白尾部 ε-N-乙醯基-賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，恢復離胺酸側鏈的正電荷。這增加了組蛋白與 DNA 的親和力，使染色質包裹得更緊，從而抑制轉錄。 HDAC 分為幾類，其中 I 類和 II 類酶使用鋅依賴性催化，III 類去乙醯化酶使用 NAD+ 作為輔因子，HDAC 抑制劑在實驗中廣泛用於重新激活 gene expression。

label: Docetaxel
description: Ivermectin reversed docetaxel resistance in PC3 prostate cancer cells via HSP27 modulation.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 通過 HSP27 調節在 PC3 前列腺癌細胞中逆轉 docetaxel 抗藥性。

label: Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci
description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHFs) are characterized by increased binding of HP1, H3K9me3 marks, macroH2A, and HMGA proteins. These foci are large domains of condensed heterochromatin that form in the nuclei of senescent cells and are believed to contribute to silencing of proliferation-associated genes. SAHF formation requires chromatin regulators including HIRA, ASF1a, and UBN1, and although not essential for growth arrest, their disruption correlates with reduced SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: Senescence 相關異染色質灶 (SAHF) 的特徵是 HP1、H3K9me3 標記、macroH2A 和 HMGA 蛋白的結合增加。這些病灶是在老化細胞的細胞核中形成的濃縮異染色質的大結構域，被認為有助於增殖相關基因的沉默。 SAHF 的形成需要染色質調節因子，包括 HIRA、ASF1a 和 UBN1，雖然對於生長停滯不是必需的，但它們的破壞與 SASP 表達的減少有關。

label: MDM2
description: p53 is inhibited by MDM2. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. The directionality runs from MDM2 toward p53, so MDM2 is the active agent and p53 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: p53 被 MDM2 抑制。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。方向性從 MDM2 向 p53，因此 MDM2 是活性劑，p53 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: SK61_2
description: S6K1/2 (SK61_2), activated by mTORC1 phosphorylation, inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylating it, forming the negative feedback loop that is central to the incoherent bivalent motif underlying rapamycin hormesis. This feedback arm is the backward reaction from the inhibited target (mTORC1) toward the Input node (IRS1, controlled by S6K1/2), and its low Michaelis-Menten constant in the saturated regime strongly increases the probability of biphasic dose-responses. S6K1/2 also deactivates mTORC2, and a significant negative correlation exists between the inhibition of the IRS1-insulin complex and mTORC2 deactivation by the same enzyme S6K1.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2（SK61_2）被mTORC1磷酸化激活，通過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成rapamycin hormesis基礎的incoherent bivalent motif核心的負反饋迴路。這個反饋臂是從被抑製的靶點（mTORC1）向輸入節點（IRS1，由S6K1/2控制）的backward reaction，並且其低Michaelis-Menten常數在飽和條件下強烈增加了雙相劑量反應的可能性。S6K1/2還使mTORC2失活，並且在IRS1-胰島素复合物的抑製和同一酶S6K1對mTORC2的失活之間存在顯著的負相關。

label: Frontotemporal Dementia
description: Frontotemporal dementia is modeled using patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells, which capture the genetics of the disease in a dish. Fibroblasts from individuals carrying mutations in MAPT, GRN, or C9orf72 are reprogrammed to pluripotency and then differentiated into cortical neurons, where they recapitulate TDP-43 mislocalization, tau pathology, and altered neuronal networks. These iPSC-based models enable mechanistic studies, compound screening, and investigation of aging and rejuvenation effects on neurodegeneration without the ethical constraints of fetal tissue.
description_zh_TW: 額顳葉失智症是使用患者來源的誘導多能幹細胞進行建模的，這些幹細胞在培養皿中捕獲疾病的遺傳學。來自攜帶 MAPT、GRN 或 C9orf72 突變的個體的成纖維細胞被重編程為多能性，然後分化為皮質神經元，在其中再現 TDP-43 錯誤定位、tau 病理學和改變的神經元網絡。這些基於 iPSC 的模型能夠進行機制研究、化合物篩選以及衰老和恢復活力對神經退化性變的影響的研究，而不受胎兒組織的倫理限制。

label: Incoherent Bivalent Motif
description: The hormesis exhibited by rapamycin is proposed to arise from a network topology that resembles an incoherent bivalent motif centered in its target mTORC1. In this architecture mTORC1 has a dual role: it is the target of rapamycin inhibition and simultaneously feeds an indirect activating path (via IRS1/S6K negative feedback and PI3K) toward the output mTORC2, yielding two net-opposite influences over the output. This topology induces biphasic dose-responses with high probability, and the backward reaction of the motif has a low Michaelis-Menten constant, consistent with the general rules identified in the coarse-grained screening.
description_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素（rapamycin）所展現的毒物興奮效應（hormesis）被提出源自一種網絡拓撲結構，類似以其標靶 mTORC1 為中心的不一致雙價基序（incoherent bivalent motif）。在此架構中，mTORC1 具有雙重角色：它是雷帕黴素抑制的標靶，同時透過間接活化路徑（經由 IRS1/S6K 負回饋與 PI3K）饋入輸出端 mTORC2，對輸出產生兩個淨效應相反的影響。此拓撲以高機率誘導雙相劑量反應，且該基序的逆向反應具有低 Michaelis-Menten 常數，與粗篩中辨識出的一般規則一致。

label: Adrenaline-quinone
description: Epinephrine (adrenaline) is the starting catecholamine in a well-characterized oxidative degradation pathway that ultimately produces adrenochrome. Through oxidation, which can occur spontaneously via autoxidation at physiological pH or through enzymatic activity, epinephrine loses electrons to form the highly reactive electrophilic intermediate adrenaline-quinone. Adrenaline-quinone is the immediate two-electron oxidation product of the catechol side chain; it is a potent electrophile whose formation commits the molecule to cyclization into the indole ring system. Because adrenaline-quinone is central to both epinephrine breakdown in pharmaceutical formulations and to endogenous catecholamine oxidation under oxidative stress, understanding it is key to adrenochrome chemistry and to the discoloration of epinephrine drug products.
description_zh_TW: Epinephrine (adrenaline) 是 well-characterized oxidative degradation pathway 的起始 catecholamine，最終產生 adrenochrome。通過氧化，可在生理 pH 下自發通過 autoxidation 或通過 enzymatic activity 發生，epinephrine 失去電子形成 highly reactive electrophilic intermediate adrenaline-quinone。Adrenaline-quinone 是 catechol side chain 的 immediate two-electron oxidation product；它是 potent electrophile，其 formation 使分子 cyclization into the indole ring system。由於 adrenaline-quinone 對於 pharmaceutical formulations 中的 epinephrine breakdown 和 oxidative stress 下的 endogenous catecholamine oxidation 至關重要，理解它對於 adrenochrome chemistry 和 epinephrine drug products 的 discoloration 是關鍵。

label: Rejuvenation
description: Rejuvenation can be achieved by cellular reprogramming, which resets age-related epigenetic changes to restore a youthful state. Full reprogramming to pluripotency erases somatic epigenetic marks and restores youthful gene expression, and partial reprogramming achieves rejuvenation without full dedifferentiation. Because aging is associated with reversible epigenetic alterations, resetting DNA methylation and chromatin marks through reprogramming can restore cellular and organismal function. The field now aims to translate these resetting effects into therapies that slow human aging.
description_zh_TW: Rejuvenation可以透過細胞重編程來實現，細胞重編程會重置與年齡相關的表觀遺傳學變化，以恢復年輕狀態。完全重編程為多能性會消除體細胞表觀遺傳標記並恢復年輕的gene expression，而部分重編程則無需完全去分化即可實現返老還童。由於老化與可逆的表觀遺傳改變有關，因此透過重編程重置 DNA 甲基化和染色質標記可以恢復細胞和有機體功能。該領域現在的目標是將這些重置效應轉化為減緩人類老化的療法。

label: Retinoblastoma Protein
description: Quiescence is enforced at the restriction point by the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), which sequesters E2F transcription factors and blocks the expression of S-phase genes. Growth factor signals relieve this inhibition through cyclin-dependent kinase phosphorylation of pRb, allowing cells to re-enter the cell cycle and resume proliferation. This reversible brake underlies the ability of quiescent cells to resume division, and it is mechanistically distinct from the irreversible arrest of senescence.
description_zh_TW: Quiescence 在限制點由視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白 (pRb) 強制執行，該蛋白隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期基因的表達。生長因子訊號透過 pRb 的細胞週期蛋白依賴性激酶磷酸化緩解這種抑制，使細胞重新進入細胞週期並恢復增殖。這種可逆制動是靜止細胞恢復分裂能力的基礎，它在機制上與不可逆的衰老停滯不同。

label: Autophagy Inducer
description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

label: FAK
description: FAK is activated by Integrins. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Integrins are transmembrane receptors that connect the extracellular matrix to the cytoskeleton and intracellular survival kinases. The directionality runs from Integrins toward FAK, so Integrins is the active agent and FAK the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: FAK 由 Integrins 活化。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。 Integrins 是將細胞外基質連接到細胞骨架和細胞內生存激酶的跨膜受體。方向性從 Integrins 朝向 FAK，因此 Integrins 是主動主體，FAK 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Reactive Oxygen Species generation
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Regular physical exercise effectively inhibits reactive oxygen species generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes. Because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is considered the main mechanism of exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Exercise also reduces oxidative stress in rodent models and improves glycemic control, both of which limit AGE accumulation. These effects make physical exercise a non-pharmacological strategy for attenuating glycation stress during aging.
description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動能有效抑制活性氧（ROS）的生成，並提升抗氧化酵素的活性。由於蛋白質糖化反應受 ROS 驅動並加速，因此規律運動抑制 AGE 形成被視為運動相關抗氧化活性的主要機制。運動亦能降低囓齒類動物模型的氧化壓力並改善血糖控制，兩者皆能限制 AGE 累積。這些效應使身體運動成為減緩老化過程中糖化壓力的非藥物策略。

label: p15INK4b
description: CDKN2B encodes p15INK4b, a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that blocks CDK4/6 and thereby enforces G1 arrest. As a tumor-suppressor locus often co-regulated with CDKN2A at chromosome 9p21, its product is a core effector of growth inhibition in response to TGFbeta signaling. In senescence, CDKN2B induction is a key event in paracrine and TGFbeta-driven arrest, acting downstream of SMAD3/SMAD4. The encoding relationship is a fundamental gene-to-protein fact with direct relevance to cell-cycle control.
description_zh_TW: CDKN2B 編碼 p15INK4b，一種阻斷 CDK4/6 從而強制 G1 停滯的細胞週期依賴激酶抑制因子。作為常與 CDKN2A 在染色體 9p21 共調節的腫瘤抑制基因座，其產物是對 TGFbeta 訊號生長抑制的核心效應器。在衰老中，CDKN2B 誘發是旁分泌與 TGFbeta 驅動停滯的關鍵事件，作用於 SMAD3/SMAD4 下游。此編碼關係是對細胞週期控制直接相關的基本基因—蛋白事實。

label: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Beyond its well-known mono-ADP-ribosylation of glutamate dehydrogenase, SIRT4 also functions as a lipoamidase that regulates the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex. By removing lipoate modifications, SIRT4 can influence pyruvate dehydrogenase activity and thereby control entry of glucose-derived carbon into the tricarboxylic acid cycle. Directionally, SIRT4's lipoamidase activity sits upstream of pyruvate dehydrogenase regulation. This broadens SIRT4's control of mitochondrial substrate oxidation and adds to its role in metabolic flexibility.
description_zh_TW: 除了其眾所周知的對穀氨酸脫氫酶的單-ADP-核糖基化外，SIRT4還作為硫辛醯胺酶發揮作用，調節丙酮酸脫氫酶複合物。透過移除硫辛酸修飾，SIRT4可以影響丙酮酸脫氫酶活性，從而控制葡萄糖衍生碳進入三羧酸循環。方向上，SIRT4的硫辛醯胺酶活性位於丙酮酸脫氫酶調節的上游。這擴展了SIRT4對粒線體底物氧化的控制，並增加了其在代謝靈活性中的角色。

label: GDH
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: GDH is the primary substrate through which SIRT4 suppresses glutamine metabolism, yet GDH is also listed among negative regulators in Table 3: high GDH activity can outpace SIRT4 ADP-ribosylation under energetic stress, switching cells toward glutaminolysis/fuel oxidation and away from SIRT4-mediated restraint.
description_zh_TW: GDH 是 SIRT4 抑制穀胺酸代謝的主要底物，但 GDH 也被列為表 3 中的負向調節因子：在能量壓力下，高 GDH 活性可能超過 SIRT4 的 ADP-核糖基化，使細胞轉向穀氨醯胺分解/燃料氧化，脫離 SIRT4 介導的限制。

label: chromatin condensation
description: AIF induces chromatin condensation. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Chromatin condensation is a terminal morphologic hallmark of death in which DNA is compacted, classically by caspase or AIF action. The relationship is directional, with AIF acting as the operative agent upon chromatin condensation rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: AIF 誘發chromatin condensation。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 chromatin condensation 是死亡的終末形態學標誌，其中 DNA 被壓縮，通常是透過 caspase 或 AIF 作用實現的。這種關係是有方向的，AIF 充當 chromatin condensation 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: PIDDosome
description: Caspase-2 is activated by PIDDosome. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The directionality runs from PIDDosome toward Caspase-2, so PIDDosome is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-2 由 PIDDosome 啟動。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。方向性從 PIDDosome 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 PIDDosome 是主動主體，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: BRD4
description: BET inhibitors targets BRD4. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. BRD4 is a bromodomain-and-extra-terminal protein that binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers to sustain oncogenic transcription. The relationship is directional, with BET inhibitors acting as the operative agent upon BRD4 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: BET inhibitors目標BRD4。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。 BRD4 是一種溴結構域和額外末端蛋白，可在超級增強子處結合乙醯化組蛋白以維持致癌轉錄。這種關係是有方向的，BET inhibitors 充當 BRD4 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Mcl-1
description: MOMP is inhibited by Mcl-1. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The directionality runs from Mcl-1 toward MOMP, so Mcl-1 is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: MOMP 被 Mcl-1 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。方向性從 Mcl-1 朝向 MOMP，因此 Mcl-1 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: GCN2
description: Protein restriction activates GCN2, an evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase triggered by amino acid restriction through uncharged tRNAs as well as by ribosome stalling and collision. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, suppressing global protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of ATF4, a key activator of stress response and autophagy genes. Drosophila lacking Gcn2 die when amino acids are restricted, and deletion of Gcn2 in yeast blocks dietary restriction lifespan extension, while overexpression extends lifespan. During PR, GCN2 is initially required for FGF21 induction and also activates hepatic gluconeogenesis in response to decreased amino acid availability.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制活化GCN2，這是一個 evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase，由胺基酸限制透過未充電的tRNAs以及核糖體停滯和碰撞觸發。活化的GCN2磷酸化eIF2alpha，抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性促進ATF4的翻譯，ATF4是壓力反應和自噬基因的關鍵活化因子。缺乏Gcn2的黑腹果蠅在胺基酸限制時死亡，酵母中Gcn2的缺失阻斷飲食限制壽命延長，而過表達則延長壽命。在PR期間，GCN2最初對FGF21誘導是必需的，並在胺基酸可用性降低時激活肝臟糖質新生。

label: Selective Autophagy
description: Damaged or dysfunctional peroxisomes are selectively targeted for autophagic degradation: they are tagged with specific ubiquitin chains (notably Lys48-linked), recognized by autophagic machinery including LC3-interacting proteins and ESCRT components, sealed into autophagosomes, and delivered to lysosomes for breakdown and recycling. This continuous turnover maintains a healthy peroxisome pool.
description_zh_TW: 受損或功能失常的過氧化物體會被選擇性地標記以進行自噬降解：先被特定泛素鏈（尤其是 Lys48 鏈）標記，再由含 LC3 交互作用蛋白與 ESCRT 成分的自噬機制辨識，包入自噬體後送至溶酶體分解回收。此持續週轉維持了健康的過氧化物體儲備。

label: Peroxisome
description: Peroxisomes are the primary site where very long chain fatty acids are shortened into shorter-chain products such as acetyl-CoA that can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation. Impaired peroxisomal beta-oxidation causes toxic VLCFA accumulation, the hallmark of Zellweger syndrome and adrenoleukodystrophy.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome 是極長鏈脂肪酸進行縮短代謝的主要場所，產物如 acetyl-CoA 可進入粒線體完成氧化。過氧化物體 beta-oxidation 功能受損會導致有毒的 VLCFA 累積，這是 Zellweger syndrome 與 adrenoleukodystrophy 的標誌性特徵。

label: Drug Repositioning
description: Ivermectin, long used as an antiparasitic agent, has been repositioned in oncology based on its ability to inhibit PAK1, suppress Wnt/YAP1/Akt-mTOR signaling, and induce death. Because its human safety profile is already established, repurposing circumvents much of the early development risk. The relationship is directional: a known drug is being given a new cancer indication. Caution remains that most anticancer evidence is preclinical, with optimal dosing and efficacy in patients still under study.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 長期用作抗寄生蟲藥，由於其抑制 PAK1、抑制 Wnt/YAP1/Akt-mTOR 訊號傳導和誘導死亡的能力，已在腫瘤學中重新定位。由於其人類安全狀況已經確定，重新利用可以規避大部分早期開發風險。這種關係是定向的：一種已知的藥物正在被賦予新的癌症適應症。需要注意的是，大多數抗癌證據都是臨牀前的，患者的最佳劑量和療效仍在研究中。

label: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: KAP1
description: The RING-domain E3 ligase TRIM28/KAP1 polyubiquitinates SIRT1 (K48-linked) and targets it for proteasomal degradation following severe DNA damage (doxorubicin, etoposide, camptothecin, UV). TRIM28 knockdown or CRISPR knockout stabilizes SIRT1 and reduces its ubiquitination; reconstitution of wild-type TRIM28 — but not the E3-dead C65/68A mutant — restores SIRT1 turnover in vivo and in a purified in vitro ubiquitination assay with UBE1/UBE2L6. TRIM28 is thus both necessary and sufficient as the damage-induced SIRT1 E3.
description_zh_TW: RING 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶 TRIM28/KAP1 會對 SIRT1 進行 K48 型多泛素化，並在嚴重 DNA 損傷（doxorubicin、etoposide、camptothecin、UV）後將其送往蛋白酶體降解。TRIM28 的 knockdown 或 CRISPR 基因敲除會穩定 SIRT1 並降低其泛素化；重新表達野生型 TRIM28——但不含 E3 失活的 C65/68A 突變株——可在體內與以 UBE1/UBE2L6 進行的試管內泛素化試驗中恢復 SIRT1 的代謝。因此 TRIM28 對損傷誘導的 SIRT1 E3 角色既必要且充分。

label: Mitosis
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: SIRT1 cleavage and ubiquitination-mediated degradation are not unique to DNA damage — they also occur during mitosis. Synchronized cells (double-thymidine block, nocodazole) lose SIRT1 as they enter M phase in an MG132-sensitive, Boc-D-FMK-sensitive, transcription-independent manner, with TRIM28-SIRT1 colocalization peaking in prometaphase/metaphase. ATM phosphorylates TRIM28 Ser824 in mitosis as well, dislodging it from heterochromatin — so the same destruction axis runs in dividing cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 的切割與泛素化降解並非 DNA 損傷所獨有——在有絲分裂期間也會發生。同步化細胞（雙重胸腺嘧啶阻斷、nocodazole）進入 M 期時會以 MG132 敏感、Boc-D-FMK 敏感且不依賴轉錄的方式失去 SIRT1，TRIM28-SIRT1 的共定位在前/中期達到高峰。ATM 在有絲分裂中同樣會將 TRIM28 Ser824 磷酸化，使其脫離異染色質——因此同一破壞軸也在分裂細胞中運作。

label: Hemostatics
description: Carbazochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone) is known as a hemostatic agent, one of two hydrazine derivatives of adrenochrome described in the patent, the other being adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine. These hydrazine derivatives serve both for the stabilization of adrenochrome and for the preparation of useful medicines that act to stop bleeding. In the patented process, semicarbazide is added to the adrenochrome solution at 0 to 15 degrees C at pH 5 to 7 to form carbazochrome, which is then isolated by filtration and purified.
description_zh_TW: Carbazochrome（腎上腺紅單縮氨脲）為已知的止血劑，是專利中描述的兩種腎上腺紅肼衍生物之一，另一種為腎上腺紅單胺基胍。這些肼衍生物既用於穩定腎上腺紅，也用於製備具有止血作用的實用藥物。在該專利方法中，於0至15°C、pH 5至7下將氨基硫脲加入腎上腺紅溶液中以形成carbazochrome，隨後經過濾分離並純化。

label: Protein Carbonylation
description: Hydroxyl radicals cause protein carbonylation, an irreversible oxidative modification introduced when the radical attacks susceptible amino-acid side chains (notably Lys, Arg, Pro, Thr) or when lipid-peroxidation products adduct to proteins. Carbonylated proteins lose function and are targeted for degradation by the 20S proteasome. The directionality is from radical insult to stable, diagnostically useful protein modification. A caveat is that carbonylation is a downstream and cumulative marker rather than an acute, quantitative readout of hydroxyl-radical flux.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 導致 protein carbonylation，這是一種不可逆的氧化修飾，當自由基攻擊易受影響的氨基酸側鏈（特別是 Lys、Arg、Pro、Thr）或脂質過氧化產物加成 proteins 時引入。 Carbonylated proteins 失去功能，成為 20S proteasome 降級的目標。方向性是從徹底的損傷到穩定的、診斷上有用的蛋白質修飾。需要注意的是，羰基化是下游和累積標記，而不是羥基自由基通量的精確定量讀數。

label: Nutlins
description: Cancer is treated by Nutlins. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward Cancer, so Nutlins is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 Nutlins 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 Cancer，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: ABT-737
description: BH3 mimetics include ABT-737. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. ABT-737 is a pioneering pan-BH3 mimetic that binds Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Bcl-w but spares Mcl-1. The relationship is directional, with BH3 mimetics acting as the operative agent upon ABT-737 rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: BH3 mimetics 包括 ABT-737。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。 ABT-737 是一種開創性的泛 BH3 類似物，它結合 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w，但保留 Mcl-1。這種關係是有方向的，BH3 mimetics 充當 ABT-737 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Everolimus
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Everolimus, a rapamycin analog (rapalog), is FDA approved for anti-seizure therapy in tuberous sclerosis complex after many years of off-label use. The EXIST-3 multicenter phase III study evaluated adjunctive everolimus in patients with treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC and showed significant reduction in seizure frequency, with approximately 40% of patients in the high-dose group achieving at least a 50% reduction in seizures compared to only 15% in placebo. The success reflects TSC's clearly defined molecular etiology, with highly penetrant mutations driving mTOR hyperactivation making the pathway an actionable target.
description_zh_TW: Everolimus是雷帕黴素類似物（rapalog），在多年仿單外使用後，獲FDA核准用於結節性硬化症（tuberous sclerosis complex）的抗癲癇治療。EXIST-3多中心第三期研究評估everolimus作為輔助治療用於因TSC導致難治性癲癇的患者，結果顯示癲癇發作頻率顯著降低，高劑量組約有40%的患者癲癇發作減少至少50%，而安慰劑組僅15%。此成功反映了TSC明確的分子病因學，高外顯率的突變驅動mTOR過度活化，使該路徑成為可施作的治療標靶。

label: Navitoclax
description: Navitoclax (ABT-263) is a potent BCL-2/BCL-XL/BCL-W inhibitor with strong senolytic activity, effectively inducing apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling their BCL-2-family SCAP dependence. It is limited clinically by on-target thrombocytopenia resulting from platelet dependence on BCL-XL, which has spurred development of more selective BCL-XL-sparing derivatives. Its senolytic efficacy is well established in multiple preclinical models, including oncogene-induced senescence and hematopoietic and lung contexts. The toxicity caveat shapes its use toward intermittent or tissue-targeted regimens, and it exemplifies both the power and the challenge of targeting the BCL-2 family for senolysis.
description_zh_TW: Navitoclax（ABT-263）是一種強效 BCL-2/BCL-XL/BCL-W 抑制劑，具強大 senolytic 活性，透過失能其 BCL-2 家族 SCAP 依賴有效誘發衰老細胞凋亡。其臨床使用受限於血小板依賴 BCL-XL 所致的標靶性血小板減少症，這促使更具選擇性、保留 BCL-XL 的衍生物開發。其 senolytic 功效在多種臨床前模型（包括致癌基因誘發衰老與造血、肺脈絡）中確立。此毒性注意事項使其使用傾向間歇或組織標靶方案，並例示標靶 BCL-2 家族用於 senolysis 的威力與挑戰。

label: ATF4
description: ATF4 emerged as a common and critical downstream mediator of the metabolic reprogramming that occurs following diverse mitochondrial stressors in mammalian cells. Strategies including doxycycline inhibition of mitochondrial translation, actinonin-mediated destabilization of OXPHOS proteins, FCCP reduction of mitochondrial membrane potential, and MitoBloCK-6 impairment of protein import all converge on ATF4 induction through a conserved amino acid response element (AARE) in the promoters of metabolic response genes. Other mediators such as ATF5, p53, and c-Myc also participate in the broader mitochondrial stress transcriptional response.
description_zh_TW: ATF4 作為哺乳動物細胞中多種粒線體壓力源後發生的代謝重編程的共同且關鍵的下游介體而脫穎而出。包括 doxycycline 抑制粒線體翻譯、actinonin 介導的 OXPHOS 蛋白不穩定化、FCCP 降低粒線體膜電位以及 MitoBloCK-6 損害蛋白輸入等策略，都透過代謝反應基因啟動子中保守的胺基酸反應元件（AARE）匯聚到 ATF4 誘導。其他介體如 ATF5、p53 和 c-Myc 也參與更廣泛的粒線體壓力轉錄反應。

label: RAIDD
description: RAIDD forms PIDDosome. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon PIDDosome rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: RAIDD 形式PIDDosome。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。這種關係是有方向的，RAIDD 充當 PIDDosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy
description: Chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) is a selective form of lysosomal degradation in which individual soluble cytosolic proteins bearing a pentapeptide KFERQ-like targeting motif are recognized by the cytosolic chaperone HSC70. The substrate-chaperone complex is then delivered to the lysosomal membrane, where the receptor LAMP-2A monomers translocate the unfolded substrate across the membrane into the lumen for degradation. Unlike macro- and microautophagy, CMA degrades one protein at a time and does not require membrane engulfment or autophagosome formation. CMA activity declines with age and is implicated in neurodegeneration and cancer, and it is subject to regulation by mTORC2 and other signaling nodes.
description_zh_TW: 伴護蛋白介導的自噬（CMA）是一種選擇性的溶酶體降解形式，其中帶有五肽KFERQ樣標靶基序的個別可溶性細胞質蛋白被細胞質伴護蛋白HSC70辨識。隨後受質—伴護蛋白複合體被遞送至溶酶體膜，由受體LAMP-2A單體將未折疊的受質跨膜轉運至腔內進行降解。不同於巨自噬和微自噬，CMA一次降解一個蛋白質，且不需要膜吞噬或自噬體形成。CMA活性隨年齡下降，並與神經退化和癌症有關，且受mTORC2和其他訊號節點的調控。

label: Statins
description: Statins inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, lowering flux through the mevalonate pathway and thereby depleting ubiquinone/CoQ10 — the substrate FSP1 requires to regenerate the membrane radical trap. By starving the FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis, statins can sensitize cells to ferroptosis, an effect that converges with their GPX4-related effects via selenocysteine-tRNA maturation.
description_zh_TW: Statins 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，降低甲羥戊酸路徑的通量，從而耗竭泛醌/CoQ10——這正是 FSP1 重新生成膜自由基陷阱所需的受質。透過饑餓化 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸，statins 可使細胞對鐵死亡增敏，此效應與它們經由硒半胱氨酸-tRNA 成熟對 GPX4 的相關效應交會。

label: CRISPR
description: CRISPR-based genome editing is used in cellular reprogramming to delete or modify genes that limit the generation of induced pluripotent stem cells. In the classic example, CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knockout of the transcription factor Oct4 in reprogramming studies demonstrates how targeted gene disruption can probe the requirements of pluripotency. Beyond knockouts, CRISPRi and CRISPRa allow transient modulation of reprogramming factors and pathways, enabling more efficient and controllable iPSC generation and lineage conversion.
description_zh_TW: 基於 CRISPR 的基因組編輯用於細胞重編程，以刪除或修改限制誘導多能幹細胞生成的基因。在經典範例中，重編程研究中 CRISPR-Cas9 介導的轉錄因子 Oct4 敲除證明了標靶基因破壞如何能夠偵測多能性的要求。除了敲除之外，CRISPRi 和 CRISPRa 還可以瞬時調節重編程因子和途徑，從而實現更有效率、更可控的 iPSC 生成和譜系轉換。

label: Cardiac fibrosis
description: SIRT4 contributes to cardiac fibrosis; global SIRT4 knockout in mice confers resistance to angiotensin-II infusion by suppressing fibrotic deposition. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of profibrotic signaling. This aligns with SIRT4's general tendency to promote pathological remodeling, contrasting with the antifibrotic SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 members. SIRT4's profibrotic action likely reflects its inhibition of mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and promotion of oxidative stress. The opposing roles of SIRT4 versus the protective sirtuins in cardiac fibrosis illustrate the functional antagonism within the sirtuin family and the importance of the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 促進心臟纖維化；SIRT4 的全身敲除通過抑制纖維化沉積賦予對血管張力素 II 輸注的抗性。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於促纖維化信號的上游。這與 SIRT4 促進病理性重塑的總體趨勢一致，與抗纖維化的 SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 成員形成對比。SIRT4 的促纖維化作用可能反映其對粒線體氧化代謝的抑制和對氧化壓力的促進。SIRT4 與保護性 sirtuin 在心臟纖維化中的對立角色說明了 sirtuin 家族內的功能拮抗以及 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的重要性。

label: Superoxide anion
description: Activated neutrophils generate superoxide radicals and other reactive oxygen species through their NADPH oxidase system, with myeloperoxidase also contributing. These oxidants drive the conversion of adrenaline to adrenochrome, and superoxide-derived ROS account for much of the adrenaline oxidation in the presence of stimulated neutrophils, representing over 80% of oxidation at low micromolar concentrations. Superoxide anion is also produced by oxyhemoglobin autoxidation, and its oxidation of epinephrine is a non-enzymatic route to adrenochrome that operates at sites of inflammation and oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Activated neutrophils透過其NADPH oxidase system產生superoxide radicals及其他reactive oxygen species，myeloperoxidase亦參與其中。這些oxidants驅動adrenaline轉化為adrenochrome，而在stimulated neutrophils存在下，superoxide-derived ROS佔了adrenaline oxidation的大部分，在低micromolar concentrations下佔oxidation的80%以上。Superoxide anion亦由oxyhemoglobin autoxidation產生，其對epinephrine的oxidation是一條non-enzymatic route to adrenochrome，作用於inflammation與oxidative stress部位。

label: Caspase-12
description: Caspase-12 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-12 is an ER-localized protease that mediates apoptotic signaling arising specifically from endoplasmic-reticulum stress. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-12, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-12 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-12 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-12 是一種內質網定位的蛋白酶，可介導由內質網壓力引起的細胞凋亡訊號傳導。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-12，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-12 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: HER2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: In HER2-overexpressing breast cancer cells, apigenin induces apoptosis through proteasomal degradation of the HER2/neu oncoprotein, depleting HER2 protein in vivo and consequently inhibiting its auto-phosphorylation and transphosphorylation. This suppresses the HER2/HER3-PI3K/Akt survival cascade and results in cytochrome c release, GADD45 upregulation, and apoptosis, with minimal toxicity toward normal cells. Apigenin's anti-proliferative efficacy is significantly greater in cells overexpressing HER2/neu than in cells expressing basal HER2 levels, and it additionally inhibits STAT3 signaling in HER2-positive lines.
description_zh_TW: 在HER2過表達的乳癌細胞中，阿苯辛誘導凋亡，通過蛋白酶體降解HER2/neu轉譯基因，耗盡體內HER2蛋白，從而抑制其自加磷酸化和跨加磷酸化。這會抑制HER2/HER3-PI3K/Akt存活神經遞質CASCADE，導致西妥體c釋放、GADD45上調和凋亡，對正常細胞毒性最小。阿苯辛在過表達HER2/neu的細胞中，其抗增殖效力顯著高於表達基線HER2水平的細胞，並且它還在HER2陽性細胞系中抑制STAT3信號傳導。

label: Addiction
description: Addiction and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Addiction and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: SIRT6 overexpression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Compared to healthy cells, SIRT6 overexpression significantly accelerates apoptosis in tumour cells. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of tumour cell death, preferentially killing cancer cells while sparing healthy cells. This tumour-selective pro-apoptotic activity supports SIRT6 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy against cancers that retain SIRT6 expression.
description_zh_TW: 與健康細胞相比，SIRT6過表達顯著加速腫瘤細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於腫瘤細胞死亡的上游，優先殺傷癌細胞同時保護健康細胞。這種腫瘤選擇性的促凋亡活性支持SIRT6活化作為對抗保留SIRT6表達的癌症的潛在治療策略。

label: Mediterranean Diet
description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

label: CD36 Receptor
description: CD36 receptor mediates uptake of oxidized LDL as the principal scavenger receptor on macrophages, delivering oxLDL-derived lipid to form foam cells. This non-downregulated pathway drives cholesterol accumulation in the artery wall. The directionality is receptor to pathological lipid internalization. A caveat is that CD36 also handles fatty acids and other ligands, and other scavenger receptors (SR-A, LOX-1) contribute to oxLDL uptake. CD36 also recognizes oxidized phospholipids on oxLDL and, in combination with TLR signaling, links lipid uptake to sterile inflammation.
description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 介導 oxidized LDL 作為巨噬細胞上主要清道夫受體的攝取，遞送 oxLDL 衍生的脂質以形成泡沫細胞。這種非下調途徑驅動 cholesterol 在動脈壁積聚。方向性是病理性脂質內化的受體。需要注意的是，CD36 也處理脂肪酸和其他配體，而其他清道夫受體（SR-A、LOX-1）有助於 oxLDL 的攝取。 CD36 也能辨識 oxLDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，並與 TLR 訊號傳導結合，將脂質攝取與無菌發炎聯繫起來。

label: SIRT7 depletion
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT7 depletion inhibits tumor growth by activating p38/MAPK signaling in breast cancer. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of p38/MAPK pathway activation, which suppresses tumor-cell expansion. Because SIRT7 normally restrains this growth-limiting signaling, its depletion unleashes p38/MAPK activity and curbs tumor growth. This positions SIRT7 as a tumor-promoting factor in breast cancer and identifies the p38/MAPK pathway as a downstream mediator.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7耗竭透過活化p38/MAPK訊號通路在乳腺癌中抑制腫瘤生長。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於p38/MAPK通路活化的上游，後者抑制腫瘤細胞擴增。因為SIRT7通常限制此生長限制性訊號，其耗竭釋放p38/MAPK活性並抑制腫瘤生長。這將SIRT7定位為乳腺癌中的促腫瘤因子，並將p38/MAPK通路確定為下游介導因子。

label: STACs
description: STACs (sirtuin-activating compounds) activate sirtuins through a K-type allosteric mechanism that lowers the Michaelis constant (Km) for both NAD+ and the acetylated substrate peptide, raising catalytic efficiency without changing Vmax. This is the canonical mechanism encoded for the dozen chemical classes of STACs, distinct from the NAD+-boosting strategy (NMN/NR/CD38 inhibition) that restores co-substrate availability.
description_zh_TW: STACs（sirtuin 活化化合物）透過 K 型別構機制活化 sirtuins，降低 NAD+ 與乙醯化受質胜肽的米氏常數（Km），在不改變 Vmax 的情況下提升催化效率。這是一打化學類別 STACs 的典型機制，不同於 NAD+ 提升策略（NMN/NR/CD38 抑制）——後者是恢復輔受質的可及性。

label: Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Fisetin suffers from intrinsically poor bioavailability that restricts its clinical translation. Its water solubility is very low (below 10 ug/mL), and the compound is sensitive to light, heat, and oxidative degradation. After oral administration fisetin is rapidly metabolized in the gut and liver to glucuronide and sulfate conjugates, so systemic exposure of the parent compound is minimal. The review documents that oral fisetin has short half-life and low plasma concentrations, and it attributes these problems to the BCS class II/IV characteristics of fisetin, motivating the development of macro- and nano-formulations to improve its absorption.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin受到本質上較差的生體可用率所苦，這限制了其臨床轉譯。其水溶性非常低（低於10 ug/mL），且此化合物對光、熱與氧化降解敏感。口服給藥後，fisetin在腸道與肝臟中迅速代謝為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸接合物，因此母體化合物的全身暴露量極小。該綜述記載口服fisetin的半衰期短、血漿濃度低，並將這些問題歸因於fisetin的BCS第II/IV類特性，促使開發巨觀與奈米配方以改善其吸收。

label: DNA Hypomethylation
description: SIRT1 deacetylates histone H3 at lysine 79, and this modification promotes DNA hypomethylation and favors the formation of tightly compacted chromatin associated with gene silencing. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic modification of H3K79 sits upstream of altered DNA methylation patterns. This connects SIRT1's histone deacetylase activity to the epigenetic regulation of telomeric chromatin and gene expression. By influencing both histone acetylation and DNA methylation, SIRT1 can exert long-lasting effects on chromatin state that are relevant to aging and genomic stability. The interaction between histone and DNA modifications illustrates how a single sirtuin shapes the epigenetic landscape.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1去乙醯化組蛋白H3第79位賴氨酸，此修飾促進DNA低甲基化並有利於與基因沉默相關的緊密壓縮染色質的形成。方向上，SIRT1對H3K79的酵素修飾位於DNA甲基化模式改變的上游。這將SIRT1的組蛋白去乙醯酶活性與端粒染色質和基因表達的表觀遺傳調節聯繫起來。透過同時影響組蛋白乙醯化和DNA甲基化，SIRT1可以對染色質狀態產生與老化和基因組穩定性相關的持久影響。組蛋白與DNA修飾之間的相互作用說明了單一sirtuin如何塑造表觀遺傳景觀。

label: Gasdermin D
description: Apoptotic caspases-3 and -7 cleave active gasdermin D (GSDMD) at the non-canonical aspartate-88 site, inactivating its pore-forming N-terminal fragment and thereby suppressing pyroptosis. Because these apoptotic caspases activate more slowly than caspase-1, this acts as a delayed negative-feedback brake: the inflammasome initiates pyroptosis, and the slower apoptotic arm damps it to prevent excessive inflammation. The nature of the death ultimately produced depends on which gasdermin substrate is available — GSDMD (inhibited by caspase-3/-7) versus GSDME (activated by caspase-3).
description_zh_TW: 凋亡性的 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 會在非典型天門冬胺酸-88 位點切割活化的 gasdermin D（GSDMD），使其成孔的 N 端片段失活，從而抑制焦亡。由於這些凋亡 caspases 的活化比 Caspase-1 慢，這形成延遲的負回饋剎車：發炎體啟動焦亡，而較慢的凋亡臂則抑制過度發炎。最終產生的死亡型態取決於可用的 gasdermin 受質——GSDMD（被 Caspase-3/-7 抑制）或 GSDME（被 Caspase-3 活化）。

label: Omi/HtrA2
description: Omi/HtrA2 relates to MOMP through the relation is_released_from. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Omi/HtrA2 透過關係式 is_released_from 與 MOMP 相關。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: CCL2
description: CCL2 (MCP-1) is a SASP chemokine regulated by IL-1a and IL-1b that is a potent chemoattractant for monocytes and CCR2+ myeloid precursors, recruiting macrophages and myeloid-derived suppressor cells to sites of senescence. It thereby links the senescent secretome to innate and suppressive immune infiltration and contributes to paracrine senescence and inflammaging. CCL2's recruitment functions make it a central communicator between senescent cells and the immune milieu, and its CCR2-dependent signaling has been targeted to modulate myeloid infiltration in aging and cancer.
description_zh_TW: CCL2（MCP-1）是一種受 IL-1α 與 IL-1β 調節的 SASP 趨化因子，是單核球與 CCR2+ 骨髓前驅細胞的強效趨化劑，招募巨噬細胞與髓源性抑制細胞至衰老部位。它因此將衰老分泌組連結到先天與抑制性免疫浸潤，並貢獻旁分泌衰老與 inflammaging。CCL2 的招募功能使其成為衰老細胞與免疫微環境間的核心溝通者，其 CCR2 依賴訊號已被標靶以調節老化與癌症中的骨髓浸潤。

label: Chromatin Remodeling
description: Methylated DNA is recognized by methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins that recruit chromatin remodeling factors and histone deacetylases to the site. These recruited complexes remove acetyl groups and deposit repressive histone modifications, promoting condensation of the chromatin into a transcriptionally inactive state. This cross-talk between DNA methylation and histone modification establishes a self-reinforcing repressive loop that maintains stable gene silencing across cell divisions, and it is a major route by which promoter methylation converts active genes into silenced heterochromatin.
description_zh_TW: 甲基化 DNA 被甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白識別，將染色質重塑因子和組蛋白去乙醯化酶募集到該位點。這些招募的複合物去除乙醯基並沉積抑制性組蛋白修飾，促進染色質凝結成轉錄失活狀態。 DNA甲基化和組蛋白修飾之間的這種串擾建立了一個自我強化的抑制環，在細胞分裂過程中維持穩定的基因沉默，並且它是啟動子甲基化將活性基因轉化為沉默的異染色質的主要途徑。

label: Dopamine o-quinone
description: Dopamine is biochemically converted into Dopamine o-quinone through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Dopamine acts as the substrate and Dopamine o-quinone as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Dopamine o-quinone。從機制上講，Dopamine 作為底物，Dopamine o-quinone 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Glucocerebrosidase
description: Glucocerebrosidase and Alpha-synuclein are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Glucocerebrosidase and Alpha-synuclein may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Glucocerebrosidase 和 Alpha-synuclein 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Glucocerebrosidase 和 Alpha-synuclein 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Senotherapy
description: Senotherapy encompasses senolytics, the cell-elimination arm that selectively induces apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling SCAPs. This is one of the two principal divisions of senotherapy, the other being senomorphics, and the term captures the spectrum of interventions aimed at the senescent cell. Encompassing senolytics underscores the elimination-based strategy's centrality to the field, given its strong preclinical and early clinical evidence. Senolytic agents range from navitoclax to the D+Q combination and fisetin.
description_zh_TW: Senotherapy 涵蓋 senolytics，即透過失能 SCAPs 選擇性誘發衰老細胞凋亡的細胞消除臂。這是 senotherapy 兩個主要分支之一，另一為 senomorphics，且此詞涵蓋針對衰老細胞的介入光譜。涵蓋 senolytics 強調消除為本策略對該領域的中心性，考量其強健的臨床前與早期臨床證據。Senolytic 藥劑從 navitoclax 到 D+Q 組合與 fisetin 皆有。

label: Ruxolitinib
description: Ruxolitinib, a JAK1/2 inhibitor, reduces SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 in senescent fibroblasts by blocking JAK-STAT3 signaling downstream of SASP cytokines. As a clinically approved drug for myelofibrosis, it is a translatable senomorphic agent whose suppression is targeted to the JAK-STAT arm of the secretome rather than acting on the whole program. The evidence is robust in cellular models and consistent with its established immunomodulatory profile, and the drug also interrupts the feed-forward loop by which IL-6 sustains chronic inflammation. This positions ruxolitinib as one of the most clinically ready senomorphic candidates for dampening senescence-associated inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Ruxolitinib 是一種 JAK1/2 抑制劑，透過阻斷 SASP 細胞激素下游的 JAK-STAT3 訊號，降低衰老纖維母細胞中的 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8。作為骨髓纖維化的臨床核准藥物，它是可轉譯的 senomorphic 藥劑，其抑制特異於分泌組的 JAK-STAT 臂而非作用於整個程序。證據在細胞模型中強健且與其既定免疫調節特性一致，且此藥也中斷 IL-6 維持慢性發炎的會降低正向迴圈。這使其成為最臨床就緒的、用於減弱衰老相關發炎的 senomorphic 候選之一。
